TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALPHINAUD_000_000: , do you have some time to talk?
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALPHINAUD_000_001: I would like to gather everyone in Dawn's Respite and together assess the situation in which we find ourselves...
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Let us take stock of the facts, shall we? The crisis at hand began with the sudden appearance of ominous towers in a multitude of locations throughout the world.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALPHINAUD_000_003: We have since learned that said structures were brought into being by an organization known as the “Telophoroi.”
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALPHINAUD_000_004: The Telophoroi's stated purpose is to recreate the Final Days of eons past, an apocalyptic event that would result in the destruction of all we hold dear. Already have these towers of theirs been the cause of untold suffering.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALISAIE_000_005: Countless innocents kidnapped and imprisoned, their faith perverted for primal summonings...
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALISAIE_000_006: And unless we find a way to deal with the corruptive aura surrounding the spires, we can't even get close enough to rescue anyone.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALISAIE_000_007: Those shielded with the blessing of Light seem able to resist being tempered, at least.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALISAIE_000_008: But after what happened to Arenvald and Fordola, we need to be very, very careful about how we proceed...
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_THANCRED_000_009: Yet while these threats close to home are of paramount concern, we mustn't lose sight of the situation in Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_THANCRED_000_010: As you know, the Telophoroi are under the leadership of Fandaniel and one other delightful fellow: Zenos yae Galvus, the crown prince and our dear friend.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_THANCRED_000_011: To date, he's reclaimed his old body, murdered Emperor Varis, and plunged Garlemald into an even deeper pit of chaos.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_THANCRED_000_012: The capital has probably seen the worst of it. For a good while there, it saw the bloodiest fighting in the war of succession. But that has since changed─and in troubling ways...
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_URIANGER_000_013: Aye, during our reconnaissance, the air was not once rent by the barking of cannons or the cries of discord. 'Twas an eerie fog of silence which did blanket that ruined city.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_URIANGER_000_014: The inhabitants appeared to have been tempered, and with nary a word spoken did they labor to transform the palace into a soaring edifice born of nightmares.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_YSHTOLA_000_015: If they were indeed made thralls, it seems safe to assume that these events, too, were orchestrated by the Telophoroi.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_YSHTOLA_000_016: An army of primals is awful enough, but in light of recent developments, I fear it is only the prelude to an even greater catastrophe.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_YSHTOLA_000_017: We need to devise a means to counter this threat, and quickly, before our allies are overwhelmed.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_GRAHATIA_000_018: We will find a way in Sharlayan, I am sure of it.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_GRAHATIA_000_019: Master Fourchenault's comments regarding the Final Days were curious to say the least. The Forum knows more than it is letting on...
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_TATARU_000_021: We've just received word from Mistress Krile! She says that arrangements for your visit have been finalized.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_TATARU_000_022: You're to head to Limsa Lominsa and board the next ship bound for Sharlayan...
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_TATARU_000_023: And on arrival, present yourselves as “associates of the Students of Baldesion,” come to assist with the order's restoration.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ESTINIEN_000_024: The arrangements may be settled, but what of your thoughts? They must race at the prospect of returning home after so long.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALPHINAUD_000_025: ...I am eager to see it, of course. Of course... Ahem. We should set off at once!
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_TATARU_000_026: Then I'll accompany you to the docks. You need at least one person there to wave and cry and wish you a safe journey!
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_EPHEMIE_000_030: Safe journeys! And please, do be careful!
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Though a part of me looks forward to returning home, I've not forgotten that my father stripped us of the privileges of our family name. I hope it doesn't cause trouble with the officials upon our arrival...
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALISAIE_000_040: What a grim reason to bring you to Sharlayan. Not much to be done about it, I suppose, but I would've liked to give you the grand tour under happier circumstances.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_THANCRED_000_045: Contrary to what you might think, this will be like going home for me as well. I may have learned how to survive in Limsa Lominsa, but it was in Sharlayan where I was taught─quite relentlessly, I might add─the skills to properly live.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_URIANGER_000_050: I shudder to think what manner of truth awaiteth us beyond the Indigo Deep. Still more do I dread the prospect of discussions long overdue...
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_YSHTOLA_000_055: I might have lived in Master Matoya's cave for a good part of my life, but even for me, the thought of “returning” to Sharlayan is quite exciting. I can hardly imagine how it is for the others who lived most of their lives there.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_GRAHATIA_000_060: I never thought the day would come when I would be sailing home again. It always seemed so very far away...
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ESTINIEN_000_065: Sea travel can be tedious, but I don't mind it. 'Tis a rare experience for most Ishgardians.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_TATARU_000_070: Everyone's here! Which is good, because I've already paid for your passage, and the fee is nonrefundable.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_TATARU_000_071: The ship for Sharlayan should be pulling into port soon, so please follow me and have all your luggage close at hand!
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_SYSTEM_000_080: Continue with the main scenario quest?
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALPHINAUD_000_090: I'm fine. Honestly. Better to be waved through with a stern warning than be denied entry, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ALISAIE_000_095: That was about as awkward as expected. Still, we're here now, and that's all that matters!
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_THANCRED_000_100: Even allowing that the years I spent in the First passed here in the blink of an eye, the city feels untouched by time...
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_URIANGER_000_105: Allow me to extend unto thee my warmest welcome, . May the wisdom of my homeland aid us in our endeavors.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_YSHTOLA_000_110: You are doubtless eager to take in the sights. Not to worry, ─the city is not like to vanish before we finish our discussion.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_GRAHATIA_000_115: Here we are at last─the great city of Sharlayan! You may have noticed some similarities with the Crystarium, yes? In fact, I─
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_GRAHATIA_000_116: ...Oh, but we really should let Krile have her say first. We can continue this conversation at another time.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_ESTINIEN_000_120: I am...unaccustomed to fabricating lies on demand. Why should it matter how I earn my living?
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_TATARU_000_125: Wait, what are you still doing here!? Um, I think I can book you passage on the next ship...though I'll have to revise the budget. Again.
TEXT_AKTKMA101_04357_KRILE_000_130: I'm glad I spotted your ship coming into port─the officers are born bureaucrats and sticklers for detail. In any case, you may relax and take a moment to get your land legs back!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I'm fine. Honestly. Better to be waved through with a stern warning than be denied entry, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_ALISAIE_000_005: That was about as awkward as expected. Still, we're here now, and that's all that matters!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_THANCRED_000_010: Even allowing that the years I spent in the First passed here in the blink of an eye, the city feels untouched by time...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_URIANGER_000_015: Allow me to extend unto thee my warmest welcome, . May the wisdom of my homeland aid us in our endeavors.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_YSHTOLA_000_020: You are doubtless eager to take in the sights. Not to worry, ─the city is not like to vanish before we finish our discussion.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_025: Here we are at last─the great city of Sharlayan! You may have noticed some similarities with the Crystarium, yes? In fact, I─
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_026: ...Oh, but we really should let Krile have her say first. We can continue this conversation at another time.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_ESTINIEN_000_030: I am...unaccustomed to fabricating lies on demand. Why should it matter how I earn my living?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_040: I had thought to launch directly into an explanation of what I've learned and how we might proceed...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_041: But this is  and Estinien's first time in Sharlayan─and for the rest of you, a homecoming that was long overdue.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_042: You must have places you wish to visit, and people you're dying to see! Therefore I propose we postpone our agenda so that you all may have sufficient time to recover from your journey and get your bearings in the city.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_043: Once you've settled in, we can reconvene at the Baldesion Annex. How does that sound?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_ALPHINAUD_000_044: 'Tis a fine suggestion. We may not be welcome at the Leveilleur estate as such, but I should like to nose around the neighborhood all the same.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_YSHTOLA_000_045: I am equally untethered, as it were. There is no particular place that my kin call “home”...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_YSHTOLA_000_046: Still, I would not pass up the opportunity to reacquaint myself with the city.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_THANCRED_000_047: Likewise. A quick tour of our old haunts might even yield some useful gossip.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_THANCRED_000_048: The annex was west of the aetheryte plaza, wasn't it? I shall join you there anon.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_URIANGER_000_050: I, too, have places I would be remiss in not visiting forthwith. By thy leave...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_051: What of you, Estinien? My services as a guide are yours for the asking.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_ESTINIEN_000_052: That won't be necessary. Until we reconvene, I prefer to wander as the wind takes me.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_054: Well, Raha, would you like to join us, then? You've been gone for quite a while, and this would be the perfect way to refresh those dusty old memories of yours.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_055: Oh! Of course─if you will have me!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_060: Oh dear... His enthusiasm is infectious, isn't it?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_070: After you, my friend! I am more than content to follow your lead.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_071: G'raha Tia is now accompanying you.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_072: Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_073: In the event you use the Aethernet, G'raha Tia will catch up to you so long as you remain in the same area.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_074: You can leave G'raha Tia behind, however, by entering a different area. You may also speak to him and select the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_075: If you wish to have G'raha Tia accompany you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_076: While G'raha Tia is accompanying you, next try speaking with Krile.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_085: Do not forget Mistress Krile, our worthy guide!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_Q2_000_090: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_091: Private matters to attend to? Very well, we can regroup in Scholar's Harbor when you are ready to resume our tour.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_095: Ah, ! Shall we return to our exploration of Sharlayan?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_100: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_108: Please, go ahead and invite Raha first. He's about to burst with excitement!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_108: You must be accompanied by G'raha Tia and have him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_110: All set? Then let us be on our way!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_111: Our first stop, amusingly enough, will be the Last Stand. It's a café on the west side of the harbor.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_112: Krile is also now accompanying you. Lead your two companions to the Last Stand, and speak with Krile at the designated location.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_113: While you are accompanied, you may encounter “conversation points” along the way which offer additional topics of discussion.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_114: Enter the glowing area and speak with your quest companions to initiate these bonus conversations. Enjoy exploring your surroundings together!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_A3_000_121: Discuss the giant statue in the harbor.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_125: I'm grateful to have Krile's help in reacquainting myself with this place. It's almost as if I'm seeing it all with new eyes, as you are.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_126: Ah, yes, the Last Stand. Now that is an inviting aroma!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_127: Oh, we seem to have lost Mistress Krile. Perhaps we should head back to the harbor and look for her?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_130: Come on, let's head to the café. It may not seem so at a glance, but the Last Stand is actually a very important part of the city.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_131: Now where has Raha disappeared to? We should head back to the harbor and hope he looks for us there─he's liable to sulk if we carry on without him.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_135: With all the unusual wares coming and going at all hours, I expect the assistance of an intrepid adventurer would be highly appreciated.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_136: I see no reason why you couldn't undertake any tasks which pique your interest─you have been cleared by the immigration officials, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_137: I look forward to the day your name is celebrated in Sharlayan the same way it is in Eorzea!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_140: This place is called “the peristyle,” and it is the first stop for cargo unloaded at the docks.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_141: You'll find the usual necessities for daily living and other imports vital to running an island nation, but also supplies that further Sharlayan's pursuit of knowledge─namely, large quantities of books, specimens, and samples. Sorting these stacks certainly seems to keep the attendants busy.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_145: Now that is a sight one could hardly forget─the great statue of Thaliak.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_146: As a Student of Baldesion, I was usually quartered on the Isle of Val, but I would gaze upon the Scholar's wise features every time I returned by ship to the city.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_150: This path leading out towards the sea is known as “the Thaliak Stoa,” so named for the statue of the Scholar which stands at its end.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_151: As you know, the Sharlayan people prize the accumulation of wisdom above all else. Thus when Thaliak was chosen as our patron deity, it was more a matter of pragmatism than belief─an alignment of principles, as it were.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_152: We may have honored Him with a rather impressive sculpture, yes, but our faith is not so restrictive as that of, say, the Ishgardians. Individual Sharlayans can─and do!─worship the divinities of their choosing.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_155: Of course, as you will. We can meet back at that spot in the harbor when you've time to continue the tour!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_160: Yes, there are still places to go and things to show you. Come along!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_168: Here we are at the Last Stand, but where is Raha...?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_SYSTEM_000_169: You must be accompanied by G'raha Tia and have him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_170: And here we are: the Last Stand.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_171: I may have mentioned this before, but although our research into nutrition and food preparation is quite extensive, the average Sharlayan tends to regard seasoning and flavor with...a certain indifference.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_172: How can I put this? The food is, um... It's bland. As encapsulated by our infamous Archon loaf, the prevailing sentiment towards cuisine is dietary value first, and taste a distant second.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_173: There was one pupil at the Studium, however, who could stomach the school's insipid meals no longer. So he quit his lessons and poured all his savings into building a proper eatery.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_174: And so the Last Stand came to be. It is, as the name implies, the sole dedicated outpost of fine dining in Sharlayan. The one and only bastion of the culinary arts in an isle of otherwise mediocre fare.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_175: I seem to recall their burger being hailed as one of the more impressive items on the menu. Not that I ever had the pleasure of eating one myself...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_176: Because you were a typical Sharlayan when it came to “cheap and convenient,” Raha. But surely Tataru has since taught you how to appreciate a well-prepared dish! We should all stop in when time permits, and sample the café's delights!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_177: Shall we press on? The stairs to the side of the café there will take us up to the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_180: The Students of Baldesion would send us to investigate phenomena in locations across the world, so our funds were always stretched thin. And any spare coin I had went to books that caught my eye...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_181: Food was the least of my concerns! Though now, having lived through some rather harrowing times, I've learned what a fortunate thing it is to be able to eat your fill.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_182: Hm. The aetheryte looks different from how I remember it...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_185: On to the aetheryte plaza we go! We just need to head up the stairs next to the Last Stand.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_189: This is the aetheryte plaza...but where is Raha?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_191: I assure you, however, that it's a perfectly functioning aetheryte. Remember to attune yourself before we move on!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_192: Now, being the diligent tour guide that I am, I should make mention of the Confluence─a research facility located on this very plaza. Its much-vaunted discoveries are the reason Sharlayan stands at the forefront of teleportation technology.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_193: In deciphering the underlying principles of Allagan aetherytes, it allowed us to understand and reconstruct what was essentially a lost art.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_194: ...And off we go to our next destination! Our path leads northeast to the Agora, Sharlayan's largest marketplace.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_205: Oh, the markets! I always did look forward to seeing what new wares they had on offer!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_206: Anything worth cracking my coinpurse for today, I wonder...?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_210: You've attuned yourself to the aetheryte? Then let's continue on to the Agora.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_215: Speaking of aetherytes, those teleportation fees do add up after a while...which is why I tended to rely on the far cheaper ferry services.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_216: I was pleasantly surprised when Mistress Tataru informed me that the Scions are reimbursed for transportation costs as part of our duties, but I find old habits hard to break. That, and I'd rather not be bothered filling out the necessary paperwork.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_220: That's the entrance to the Confluence.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_221: I have no doubt their expertise will prove useful at some point, so I suggest you remember the way here!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_225: ...Do you mind if I browse the shelves for a moment? There might be some hidden gems I've yet to read!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_226: Only “a moment”? How optimistic. Feel free to browse all you like, but we won't wait around for you.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_227: Ah. Perhaps I'll return here later, then...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_230: These little open-air book stalls are so uniquely Sharlayan. I'd always thought them a common sight until I visited other nations.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_239: Well, here we are at the Agora, but we've lost Raha...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_240: Welcome to the Agora, where you can find wares made in Sharlayan, as well as a wide selection of imported goods.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_241: They also used to sell questionable “prototypes” from the various research institutes, but I think that practice has thankfully died out. For the most part.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_242: Otherwise, I can think of no better place to stock up for your next big adventure!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_243: ...Am I overselling it? Ahem. On a more serious note, the next stop on our tour is one which has particular relevance to our ultimate purpose here.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_244: We must head back to the aetheryte plaza, follow the path north, then climb the stairs up to that imposing building at the very top.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_255: 'Tis a fascinating experience to walk around the city and contrast my image of the past with the reality of the present...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_256: Ah, what an invigorating breeze. A touch biting, perhaps, but pleasant nonetheless.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_260: The building we're looking for sits at the top of the stairs, to the north of the aetheryte. Just keep walking up, and you'll reach it eventually.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_261: The district we're passing through is called Archons' Design─a name which honors the seven individuals whose contributions were instrumental in the founding of Sharlayan. It is the city's political and financial center, and it also hosts a collection of research institutions.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_265: These little decorative features are typical of Sharlayan architecture. Aside from the research wing, our headquarters on the Isle of Val were rather simple and rustic by comparison.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_270: This is the nymphaeum, an area dedicated to the blessings of water.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_271: For Sharlayans, water represents more than a life-sustaining liquid─it is a reminder of the great flood which precipitated the birth of our nation, as well as a symbol of the knowledge which flows from Thaliak's divine ewer.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_272: This is the reason you see an abundance of fountains throughout the city, and a propensity for utilizing water as a decorative feature in our architecture.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_279: Yes, this is the place we wanted to be, but we're one short...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_280: This grand structure before you is the Rostra!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_281: The name refers to the original public platform erected here, upon which a “forum” of elected representatives would deliver orations and debate policy.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_282: Although the stage has since evolved into council chambers, the nature of the Forum and the duties of its members remain largely unchanged.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_283: ...Am I boring you, Raha? You seem awfully distracted.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_284: My apologies. From here, one can see the entire city spread out below...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_285: The vista put me in mind of my arrival in the First. Those who had gathered at the Crystal Tower asked me how they might go about building a new home.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_286: Naturally, my answers were all inspired by my knowledge of the finest settlement I could think of─the great city of Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_287: And bit by bit, those few buildings grew into a town. A community. The Crystarium... I can almost see its echo...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_288: I see... Feel free to come up here whenever you wish─I don't think the councilors would object to you simply enjoying the view. Such memories should be treasured.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_289: For now, however, the tour must go on! Our spectacle of sightseeing concludes with the fittingly named Journey's End. Walk down the stairs to the east, and continue straight ahead!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_290: Do you not feel the cold? Granted, it is not terribly chilly for these northern climes, but compared to the temperate weather of Limsa Lominsa...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_291: This neighborhood is home to the highest echelons of Sharlayan society. I never did feel comfortable enough to wander these streets on a whim.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_295: The district of Journey's End occupies the eastern block of the city, so all we need to do is take the stairs down from the Rostra...and keep heading east, of course!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_299: We've arrived at Journey's End, except I don't see Raha...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_300: We've arrived at Journey's End! History tells us that this was where those who put ashore with Archon Nyunkrepf built their first homes.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_301: In the present day, it serves as the residential district for the most important officials and the oldest Sharlayan families.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_302: You'll see that one mansion is clearly larger than its neighbors─that estate belongs to our friends from House Leveilleur. All things considered, we should probably keep our distance for the time being...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_303: And with that, we bring our little Sharlayan tour to a close. I hope it has proven to be an entertaining and enlightening experience!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_304: Now, shall we head directly to the Baldesion Annex? You remember the way, don't you, Raha?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_305: Let me think... We head down towards the harbor, cross the bridge to our right, then follow the path below the aetheryte plaza?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_315: Ah, the good old annex! I used to bunk there whenever I had business in the city proper.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_316: Like the time I came to submit the thesis for my Archon qualification...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_317: This is it! The Baldesion Annex!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_320: Have I tired you out with all this walking? Not to worry, I had rooms prepared for you at the annex.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_321: Just follow the path to the west side of the aetheryte, and we'll be there in no time.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_325: Right, we cross this bridge here, as I recall. Stick to the path, and be careful not to end up back in the aetheryte plaza!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_330: Sharlayan is full of educational and research institutions, but there are still professors who prefer to establish their own private practices.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_331: Not that I ever attended the exclusive schools they run in these residences... Perhaps the twins could tell you more about them.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_339: This building is the Baldesion Annex, but without Raha...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_340: As the joyous look on Raha's face has undoubtedly informed you, this is the Baldesion Annex.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_341: If you continue up the hill, you'll arrive on the doorstep of Phenomenon...but I think we've explored enough for one day. We can take you there another time.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_343: I'm back! And I've brought  and Raha with me.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_3: (-???-)Ah, you were right about the ship, then. Hello, G'raha, it's nice to see you again!
(-???-)And it's a pleasure to finally meet you, . I've heard many a tale of your exploits.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_346: Ojika!? Ojika Tsunjika! It has been an age...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_347: Allow me to introduce Ojika─cousin of Ejika Tsunjika and administration officer for the Students of Baldesion. He oversees the day-to-day business of the annex.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_3: I read the reports on the Eureka expedition. I hope Ejika didn't cause you too much trouble. He's impatient and impetuous, but a good sort at heart.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_349: Allow me to introduce Ojika─cousin of Ejika Tsunjika and administration officer for the Students of Baldesion. He oversees the day-to-day business of the annex.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_3: I read the reports on the Eureka expedition... Ejika's passing grieved me beyond words. Thank you for standing by him until the end.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_351: Allow me to introduce Ojika Tsunjika─administration officer for the Students of Baldesion. He oversees the day-to-day business of the annex. You may recall meeting his cousin, Ejika?
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_3: Oh yes, Eureka. I've read the initial reports─quite a shock to hear what's become of the isle. Do take care if you have the opportunity to rejoin the expedition.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_353: Allow me to introduce Ojika Tsunjika─administration officer for the Students of Baldesion. He oversees the day-to-day business of the annex.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_3: The “champion of Eorzea” has featured prominently in Krile and G'raha's reports, so for me, this is akin to seeing a fabled hero come to life! It is an honor to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_355: This place is like a second home for the Students... The Isle of Val served as our main headquarters, of course, but we often had occasion to visit Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_356: Whether to make use of the city's research facilities, attend conferences, or procure supplies from distant shores...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_357: And the annex here was built to provide lodgings for our members while we engaged in such activities.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_3: Now that our former headquarters is on the wrong side of the world─among other things─the annex has become our new base of operations, for all intents and purposes.
And yet it feels so empty. With so many lost to us, our organization is a shell of its former self.
Ever since our former headquarters─along with the isle itself─vanished, the annex has served as our base of operations.
And yet it feels so empty. With so many lost to us, our organization is a shell of its former self.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_362: The day will come when we will see the Students rise again...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_363: But first, we must ensure that the Telophoroi fall!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_364: Through that door on the left there is the main hall, where we can discuss our options moving forward.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_365: ...Once everyone arrives, that is. You probably have time to rest before our discussions begin in earnest.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_366: I've had private quarters prepared for you in the andron, so please, feel free to make yourself at home!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_367: Ah, the nap rooms! Perfect for an afternoon doze...
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_368: Oh, I didn't mean to give you the wrong impression─the chambers are quite well appointed! Far more so than some cheap roadside inn, you may be assured.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_369: 'Twas simply that we were often so busy with research, or exhausted from journeys abroad, that we would slip into the andron just to steal a few winks.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_370: And thus they became known amongst the Students as “nap rooms”─even if many such “naps” might last well into the following morning!
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_3: Say the word, and I'll be happy to show you to your chamber.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_372: Hopefully the others won't be too long in coming! I'll wait for you all in the main hall.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_380: Do you have papers pasted on the walls of your room? 'Twas not unusual for occupants to pin up notes or documents and such, and then forget to take them when they went on their merry way.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_381: Sometimes it was quite deliberate, though. You might see complaints addressed to other members, or a thank-you card for the engrossing literature someone left behind.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_GRAHATIA_000_382: Beloved traditions...that I should know better than to dwell upon. If we are to create a future for the Students of Baldesion and so many others, we must look to the days ahead.
TEXT_AKTKMA102_04358_KRILE_000_390: Feeling refreshed and alert? Our colleagues should be wandering in soon, so I suggest we stay here and wait for them to join us.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_000: If the Forum is intent on concealing its intentions, then a cursory investigation will avail us little, I suspect. We will need to dig deeper─and with the greatest of care...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_005: I still don't understand how the vote could be unanimous... What could possibly convince them all to turn their backs on Eorzea?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_010: The process by which Forum members are elected is fair and equitable─neither wealth nor social standing offers any advantages to a prospective candidate. But fairly elected or not, Master Matoya still found them all to be insufferable.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_015: Our tour of the city was a pleasant distraction. I feel more than ready now to tackle the challenges of the day!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_020: An unsettling change has come over Sharlayan, but together we will divine the underlying cause for the Forum's callousness.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_021: As I mentioned before, however, questioning the councilors directly is a fruitless endeavor. They seem to have already come to a consensus as to what─and how little─they are willing to divulge.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_022: Which is why I began scouring Sharlayan's archive of historical records for any hint of a connection to the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_023: Suffice it to say that progress has been slow─there are only so many dusty pages one can skim in a day. But now that I have this band of willing reinforcements, the search should proceed all the swifter!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_024: Let us reconvene outside Noumenon, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_025: Exit the annex to the right, and you'll find the archives on the western edge of the woods.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_030: My directions were easy enough to follow, I hope? In any case, you stand now before the doors of Noumenon, Sharlayan's grandest collection of books and tomes!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_031: This building is actually only an entrance─and one of many at that─for the archives of Noumenon extend deep beneath the surface like the roots of a tree. The vast halls of the Great Gubal Library pale in comparison to Noumenon's endless maze of subterranean chambers.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_032: Any citizen of Sharlayan is free to enter and peruse its shelves. ...Well, most of its shelves. Only Archons are afforded access to certain restricted vaults.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_033: I've dispatched Y'shtola and Raha to investigate those. Meanwhile, Alisaie and Alphinaud will help me continue my search through the stacks open to the general public.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_034: Your status presents more of a problem. As a non-citizen, you are only permitted to browse the first floor here at the entrance. Even so, there should be a number of books which touch upon Sharlayan history or Forum policy.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_035: Your task will be to find and study the relevant publications. I promise you, a working knowledge of those subjects will make it far easier to spot the sort of clues we're looking for.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_036: Let us be about it, shall we? I've told the others to meet us at the stone benches over there once they've found some promising tomes. Happy reading!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_Q1_000_040:
The title on the spine reads An Introduction to the Heavens.
Read the book?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKONE_000_041: (-An Introduction to the Heavens-)Have you ever gazed at the skies above and contemplated the mysteries contained therein? I speak not of shifting cloud patterns, but of the vastness beyond─of the sun and the twinkling tapestry of the night.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKONE_000_042: (-An Introduction to the Heavens-)Some think the dome above us to be a finite space, yet amongst the leading thinkers of our age, one scholar's depiction of a boundless sea of stars has firmly taken root.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKONE_000_043: (-An Introduction to the Heavens-)Alas, this heavenly sea remains an unreachable, unknowable destination. There are few indeed who can explain, in satisfactory detail, why our own star is believed to revolve around the sun.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKONE_000_044: (-An Introduction to the Heavens-)It was the technologists of Allag who came closest to understanding the laws which govern that starry abyss. It was they who launched Dalamud, and sought to expand beyond our earthbound existence.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKONE_000_045: (-An Introduction to the Heavens-)...Having read of their ancient ambitions, I wonder: has your interest in this field of study waxed or waned?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKONE_000_046: (-An Introduction to the Heavens-)What if I were to tell you that the eternal constellations were arranged differently in the distant past? That their positions continue to shift almost imperceptibly but measurably as we journey into the future?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKONE_000_047: (-An Introduction to the Heavens-)Would it shock you to learn that the stars drift further and further apart, and may indeed do so forever? Are you eager to learn more?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_SYSTEM_000_048: This book is on the wrong subject. Search for works which contain details on the Forum, or mention the history of Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_Q2_000_049:
The title on the spine reads The Voice of a Growing City.
Read the book?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTWO_000_050: (-The Voice of a Growing City-)In the years which followed the founding of Sharlayan, civic policy and other matters of import were decided at the Ecclesia─a public forum at which every citizen was eligible to speak.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTWO_000_051: (-The Voice of a Growing City-)As the city's population grew, however, this format became increasingly impractical. The larger number of participants gave rise to ever-longer debates, resulting in significant delays of vital resolutions.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTWO_000_052: (-The Voice of a Growing City-)Various measures were introduced in an attempt to curtail protracted discussions, but in the year 201 of the Sixth Astral Era, it was ultimately decreed that Sharlayan would transition to a new form of governance.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTWO_000_053: (-The Voice of a Growing City-)The nation would now be led by a body of ninety-nine members─citizens chosen from amongst their peers by means of a nationwide vote. Thus was the Forum as we know it today conceived and created.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_SYSTEM_000_054: You have gained a fundamental understanding of Sharlayan history and the foundation of the Forum. Head outside to the rendezvous point and await your companions.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_Q3_000_055:
The faded title on the spine reads Stewards of Wisdom.
Read the book?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTHREE_000_056: (-Stewards of Wisdom-)During the chaos of the Sixth Umbral Calamity, Archon Nyunkrepf, founder of Sharlayan, bore witness to the madness and savagery of men brought to the brink of despair. Upon raising a settlement on an island in the Northern Empty, he instructed his people thus:
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTHREE_000_057: (-Stewards of Wisdom-)Renounce the ways of war, and pursue enlightenment through knowledge and reason.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTHREE_000_058: (-Stewards of Wisdom-)The Sharlayans took to heart the words of their savior, and thenceforth served as stewards of wisdom.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTHREE_000_059: (-Stewards of Wisdom-)Upon a foundation of accumulated learning, they built a homeland unlike any other─a nation born from strength of minds, rather than strength of arms.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTHREE_000_060: (-Stewards of Wisdom-)With knowledge of economics came shrewd trading. With knowledge of agriculture came bountiful crops. Engineering brought wells and sewers, ending squabbles over water.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTHREE_000_061: (-Stewards of Wisdom-)Wealth of expertise could be bartered for wealth in coin. And the more their wisdom spread throughout the world, the more mankind as a whole would thrive.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKTHREE_000_062: (-Stewards of Wisdom-)And so it was that no matter the trials and tribulations of the age, the citizens of Sharlayan would live by their founder's teachings. For the sake of a better tomorrow─for the sake of a brighter star─they would eschew the tools of war, and with knowledge deliver the world.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_Q4_000_063:
The title on the spine reads Forever Twenty Summers.
Read the book?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFOUR_000_064: (-Forever Twenty Summers-)My beloved seekers of knowledge. Have you ever put learning before your health, and neglected to feed and rest your body as you should?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFOUR_000_065: (-Forever Twenty Summers-)I, too, once engaged in such foolish practices. But one night, engrossed in philosophical study, I had an epiphany:
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFOUR_000_066: (-Forever Twenty Summers-)For all the world's mysteries that drive us to reckless abandon, we have so very few years of life in which to achieve our goals.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFOUR_000_067: (-Forever Twenty Summers-)Thus do I share with you this mantra: I am forever twenty summers young.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFOUR_000_068: (-Forever Twenty Summers-)The number itself is unimportant─you could be nineteen, or twenty-three, or forty. Whatever age you are when you discover this manual, let that be the age you aspire to remain.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFOUR_000_069: (-Forever Twenty Summers-)Through mindful, healthy living, will you extend the time available to spend upon your chosen research─another day, another moon, another summer to grasp the greater truths you pursue.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFOUR_000_070: (-Forever Twenty Summers-)In the pages that follow, we will explore the secrets of maintaining one's physical condition from a biological, aetherological, and arcane viewpoint...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_Q5_000_071:
The title on the spine reads The Story of Sharlayan.
Read the book?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFIVE_000_072: (-The Story of Sharlayan-)Long, long ago, on an island in the northern sea, there lived a Roegadyn man by the name of Nyunkrepf.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFIVE_000_073: (-The Story of Sharlayan-)Nyunkrepf was a student of astrology, and he divined that a flood of terrifying proportions would soon sweep over the lands of Eorzea.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFIVE_000_074: (-The Story of Sharlayan-)So it was that he built a gigantic ship, assembled a crew, and set sail for that imperiled realm.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFIVE_000_075: (-The Story of Sharlayan-)The flood arrived as foretold, and to their horror the strangely churning waters drove the people towards the ocean. It was there, however, that Nyunkrepf's crew hauled them aboard his ark, but the danger had not passed: a towering wave approached, threatening to smash the vessel to pieces!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFIVE_000_076: (-The Story of Sharlayan-)With only moments to spare, Nyunkrepf wove a mighty spell of teleportation, and shifted the entire ship to safety atop Abalathia's Spine.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFIVE_000_077: (-The Story of Sharlayan-)Refugees from the surrounding regions huddled there alongside them, but it was not long before disputes over the dwindling supply of food led to violence and bloodshed.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFIVE_000_078: (-The Story of Sharlayan-)Saddened by the sight, Nyunkrepf gathered to him his crew and his grateful passengers, and abandoned the ark to those reddened peaks. They journeyed to the coast where they built a new ship, intent upon returning to the northern seas.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKFIVE_000_079: (-The Story of Sharlayan-)They landed on the beach of an island, and settled upon that very spot. That settlement prospered and grew, and in time it became the city of Sharlayan we live in to this day.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_Q6_000_080:
The title on the spine reads Roads of Old: The Colony.
Read the book?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKSIX_000_081: (-Roads of Old: The Colony-)Many years ago, on the banks of the Thaliak in the Dravanian hinterlands, a Sharlayan colony once thrived.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKSIX_000_082: (-Roads of Old: The Colony-)This settlement was originally established as a mere outpost to study the aetherial sea in the year 1311 of the Sixth Astral Era.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKSIX_000_083: (-Roads of Old: The Colony-)Scholars dispatched to Eorzea found the facilities wanting, and their demands encouraged a gradual expansion in structures and services.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKSIX_000_084: (-Roads of Old: The Colony-)As rumors spread of a growing community of academics, the area was further inundated with Eorzean students hoping to share in the renowned wisdom of the Sharlayans.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKSIX_000_085: (-Roads of Old: The Colony-)Fifty years later, the Forum passed a motion to recognize what had become a flourishing town as an official Sharlayan colony.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKSIX_000_086: (-Roads of Old: The Colony-)Eorzean residents took to calling the colony itself “Sharlayan,” which led to no small amount of confusion when discussions turned to the subject of the motherland.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKSIX_000_087: (-Roads of Old: The Colony-)In response, some Sharlayan inhabitants, if pressed for a name, would simply refer to it as “Emporium.”
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_BOOKSIX_000_088: (-Roads of Old: The Colony-)Following the exodus, however, goblins and treasure hunters claimed for themselves a corner of the abandoned colony and gave it yet another name: Idyllshire.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_SYSTEM_000_089: The following chapters go on to introduce the most prominent features of Idyllshire. This book does not appear to contain additional information on the Forum, or cover the history of the Sharlayan motherland in greater detail.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_091: I wanted to make sure I'd borrowed at least a few promising volumes. Alphinaud and Krile should also be along shortly.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_092: I was delayed in similar fashion. As far as I could see, no titles in the Archon stacks mentioned the Final Days specifically, so we have no choice but to start with the tangentially relevant tomes─if they are even that.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_093: At present, the plan is to skim through as quickly as we dare, and share our discoveries as we make them.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_094: It would've been nice to invite everyone to the estate. Plenty of comfortable places to read, and a ready supply of hot tea...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_095: Oh, I was always quite fond of reading outside.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_096: ...But it's not about the little pleasures, is it? You miss your home.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_097: It's been...difficult. After our arrival, we managed to speak with one of the family servants and ask how things were.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_098: It seems our dear father has instructed the staff that even if Alphinaud and I were to return to Sharlayan, we were not to be allowed across the threshold.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_099: A harsh measure, indeed. I hope that our efforts to understand his position─and that of the Forum─will perhaps lead to a reconciliation...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_100: We'll mend this rift one day. I'm certain of it.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_101: And what of you, G'raha? Have you been to visit your family? Or do they not live here in the city?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_102: Ah, well... My situation is also somewhat complicated. I was raised in Sharlayan, yes, but I was born rather further away.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_103: In the southern reaches of Ilsabard, in fact. For generations, my people have dwelt in Corvos, the coastal region opposite the island of Thavnair.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_104: The Allagans founded a city in that fertile land, and by ship, brought in the subjugated tribes of the Miqo'te to serve as laborers.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_105: Of course, the massive earthquakes of the Fourth Umbral Calamity brought an end to the empire's reign. And when the Fifth Calamity froze the seas solid, many of the tribes still living in Corvos braved the journey back to Eorzea...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_106: My ancestors, however, chose to remain, that they might prevent the remnants of Allagan technology from being misused.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_108: For the past fifty years, yes. Some semblance of local culture remains, as is the case for most imperial provinces, but Garlemald renamed the region “Locus Amoenus.”
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_109: ...When I was a boy, a nearby town came under the jurisdiction of an illustrious imperial family─the nobles of House Darnus.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_110: House Darnus demonstrated a singular interest in Allagan civilization, and so my tribe was forced to consider a plan of action.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_111: For some time already, voices had been raised in favor of abandoning our ancient customs─after all, the Allagan Eye no longer passed to our eldest children as reliably as it once had.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_112: Fear of discovery eventually tipped the scales, and the decision was made to bury our ties to the knowledge and traditions of Allag.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_113: As the last child born with the Allagan Eye, I was given over to the custody of friends in the Students of Baldesion, who had me registered as a Sharlayan citizen.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_114: I never even considered... Forgive me, it was an unkind question.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_115: Even Thancred was taken in by Archon Louisoix, was he not? Stories of adopted waifs and rescued orphans are more common among Sharlayans than you might think.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_116: Yet regardless of our origins, we are all provided with an equal opportunity to learn. And with sufficient perspicacity, we outsiders can even earn the vaunted title of “Archon.”
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_117: 'Tis exactly why I have such love for this country. And why I wish it to remain a nation of which its citizens can be proud.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_118: Hear, hear! Another good reason to get to the bottom of the Forum's stubbornness─aside from the trifling matter of our impending doom.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_119: Excuse us while we try to make some headway into these books, . More company should be arriving any moment now!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALISAIE_000_120: There are others better suited to poring over old history books, so I thought I'd try my luck with more recent events. If I can find anything to better inform the Forum's baffling behavior...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_125: Hm? What else do I know of Corvos? Precious little, I am afraid─I've not returned since Master Galuf first brought me here.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_126: I can tell you that Corvosi rebels still seek to slip the yoke of their imperial masters, though the fighting is far less fierce than it once was.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_GRAHATIA_000_127: Oh, and they have carpets. Flying carpets! The legends are quite extraordinary!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_131: Although I must say, the pickings were quite slim indeed─Mistress Krile has already flicked through every history book devoted to disasters, and more than a few which barely made mention of them.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_132: As such, we will be looking into research papers on the Umbral Calamities, as well as articles written by prominent Forum members. Perhaps their knowledge of the Final Days comes from an unexpected source...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_133: Speaking of which, might I ask you a few questions related to the Final Days?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_134: I'm the only one here who didn't witness the events of Amaurot firsthand, and fear I may be overlooking critical details.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_135: My thanks! Now, where to begin...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_136: First things first─what kind of phenomena did the ancients encounter as the Final Days drew nigh?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_A7_000_138: A complete destabilization of creation magicks.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_A7_000_139: Primals of unrivaled power were summoned from the aether.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_A7_000_140: The worst kind of phenomena you can imagine!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_141: Yes, the unfolding catastrophe wrought havoc on all manner of life...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_142: The chaos extended to the ancients themselves, causing their powers of creation to spiral out of control. Fear and despair manifested in terrible, tangible fashion─meteors raining from the sky, fire erupting from the ground, indescribable abominations prowling the streets...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_143: Ahem, I believe Hydaelyn and Zodiark were summoned after the Final Days had arrived. Quite deliberately, in fact.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_144: If we are speaking of phenomena caused by the Final Days, the chaos of creation magicks run rampant is what first comes to mind. Fear and despair manifested in terrible, tangible fashion─meteors raining from the sky, fire erupting from the ground, indescribable abominations prowling the streets...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_145: Well, that certainly is an accurate─if somewhat ambiguous─impression.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_146: To expound upon that explanation, the unfolding catastrophe wrought havoc on all manner of life...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_147: The chaos extended to the ancients themselves, causing their powers of creation to spiral out of control. Fear and despair manifested in terrible, tangible fashion─meteors raining from the sky, fire erupting from the ground, indescribable abominations prowling the streets...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_148: That more or less aligns with my understanding. If only the arts of creation had survived until the present day, we might have had something substantial to analyze.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_149: To the best of our knowledge, however, those techniques were not preserved or passed on. Y'shtola surmises that the closest known magick is that of the summoning rituals promulgated by the Ascians.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_150: Was there aught else of note which heralded the approach of the Final Days?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_A8_000_152: The entire star was engulfed by disaster all at once.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_A8_000_153: They say it began with a keening sound from the land itself...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_A8_000_154: Alphinaud, you can answer this one!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_155: I...think you may be misremembering. As I recall, 'twas more of a gradual spread.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_156: The Amaurotines spoke of a “keening” sound that rose from the land itself just before a region was visited by catastrophe. We never did hear this sound ourselves, of course, thrust as we were into the midst of the madness...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_157: Ah, yes, the Amaurotines spoke of it, didn't they? We never did hear this sound ourselves, of course, thrust as we were into the midst of the madness...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_158: But it seems that each and every one of the catastrophes was preceded by this ominous noise. Eventually it resounded all across the star, and not even Amaurot was spared.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_160: The Amaurotines were debating the cause of an anomaly which had been observed in the lands across the sea. By this fact alone, we can deduce that the Final Days occurred not all at once the world over, but rather had a point of origin from which it began to spread.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_161: Others also spoke of a “keening” sound rising from the land itself, just before a region was visited by catastrophe. We never did hear this sound ourselves, of course, thrust as we were into the midst of the madness...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_162: So the ground was crying out, you say? To be considered the harbinger of doom, it must have been quite distinctive...and probably quite loud.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_163: I'll have to speak with one of Noumenon's mammets, and ask after any books which make mention of such a sound.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_164: Last but not least, would you describe how the ancients sought to quell this unprecedented calamity? What definitive action did they take?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_A9_000_168: They knocked Dalamud from the sky.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_169: Yes, with Elidibus serving as His heart. So many gave themselves in sacrifice to bring Him into being...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_170: Ah, I believe it was Zodiark who was summoned in response to the Final Days. Many sacrificed themselves to bring Him into being, with Elidibus serving as His heart...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_171: Surely you can't be serious! That was the Seventh Umbral Calamity─hardly an event of the distant past. And even if Dalamud had existed at the time, bringing down a moon of any kind would surely only make things worse!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_172: The ancients summoned Zodiark in response to the Final Days. Many sacrificed themselves to bring Him into being, with Elidibus serving as His heart...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_173: We do not know exactly how Zodiark brought salvation to the star, only that by His godlike will were the laws of nature set aright.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_174: Then, once the balance was redressed, the ancients offered up a further sacrifice to heal the ravages of the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_175: Lives sprouted anew, and it was these fledgling souls they intended to render unto Zodiark. A “trade” that would have allowed them to resurrect the shades of loved ones absorbed by the primal...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_176: ...Or might have, had Venat and her fellows not manifested their opposition in the form of Hydaelyn.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_177: Thank you─both of you─for the detailed review. I feel much more confident now in my understanding of events.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_178: With all that freshly in mind, it does make me wonder what the Telophoroi truly mean when they speak of bringing back the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_179: We've seen what they're doing with those towers of theirs. Is forcing people to summon primals a kind of catalyst? Are they attempting to mirror the conditions caused by unstable creation magicks?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_180: Or are they simply using the Final Days as a figure of speech? A convenient metaphor for the scale of destruction they plan to unleash...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_181: <sigh> But this is all just pointless conjecture at this stage. Let us return our attention to the Forum, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_182: We should keep an eye out for Y'shtola, but 'tis time we began studying these research papers...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_190: Many Forum members are also researchers or professors. If they know aught of the Final Days, then that knowledge might surface in their writing. That is my hope, anyway...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_195: It really is comforting to have all these dedicated assistants on hand. Right, then! Enough chatting, more reading!
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_200: I'm the last, am I? Well, my extended search of the Archon stacks produced one or two possibly useful books.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_201: ...But I wouldn't get your hopes up.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_202: If you recall, Urianger learned of the Source's reflections from The Gerun Oracles. For its potential to cause panic and confusion, that tome was deemed apocrypha and sealed away in the Great Gubal Library.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_203: 'Tis even less likely that knowledge of the unsundered world, not to mention the horrors of the Final Days, would be left sitting on a shelf for any curious scholar to find.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_204: It stands to reason then that my colleagues─be they Archons or councilors─should perforce be largely ignorant of the subject.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_205: Yet when you confronted Master Fourchenault with knowledge of the Telophoroi and their machinations, he scoffed at the suggestion that they posed a threat. He seemed adamant that the Forum would know if the Final Days were truly upon us.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_206: Which only supports the conclusion that whatever privileged wisdom is guiding the Forum's behavior, it is being kept secret from the rest of the nation.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_207: ...Not that I mean to excuse myself from reading duty. Whether they contain mention of the Final Days or no, these books could yet hold something of value.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_208: You weren't thinking of leaving, were you? There's plenty of work for everyone.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_SYSTEM_000_209: You labor for what feels like an age as Y'shtola's research assistant...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_ALPHINAUD_000_210: I've found naught of interest so far. I think Y'shtola might be right about not getting our hopes up.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_SYSTEM_000_221: Your efforts to gain G'raha Tia's attention go unnoticed. He appears to be lost in his reading...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_YSHTOLA_000_225: Thank you for your help, but I think I can manage the rest without your assistance. If I were you, I'd steal a few quiet moments for myself...
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_230: Oh dear, you look exhausted! But what about your studies? Were you able to find any books on the subjects I mentioned?
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_231: Then the day was well spent! Should you wish to read them again, a mammet at the reference desk will point you in the right direction.
TEXT_AKTKMA103_04359_KRILE_000_232: For the moment, though, I suggest you take a well-deserved rest─we might be occupied with our research for quite some time...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_000: Ready for a tea break, ? I know I am.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_001: Honestly, my neck and shoulders are going to calcify if I don't stretch my legs and walk around for a bit...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_002: You know the Last Stand down in the harbor, don't you? Come and meet me near the outside tables, and I'll treat you to their coffee. It's quite good!
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_010: As busy as ever, I see. How very Sharlayan that no other gourmet café has sprung up to compete for customers...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_011: Actually, this crowd gives me an idea: before we place an order, why don't we ask a few questions and gauge the mood of the city?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_012: I'm interested to hear what the average citizen has to say about the Telophoroi. We might even learn something new. Worth a try, don't you think?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SYSTEM_000_013: Alisaie is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SYSTEM_000_014: You can leave Alisaie behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SYSTEM_000_015: If you wish to have Alisaie accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_025: Someone here at the café should be willing to speak with us. Let's ask around!
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_Q2_000_030: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Alisaie?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_031: No rest for a hero, eh? Do what you must. I'll wait for you at the Last Stand.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_035: Right. Ready to pick up from where we left off?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SYSTEM_000_040: Alisaie has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SYSTEM_000_049: Alisaie wishes to hear what the citizens have to say. Bring her with you before attempting to engage them in conversation.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HILDOISE_000_050: Yes? I don't believe I've had the pleasure...?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_051: Pray excuse the interruption, but we were hoping you might share your thoughts on the Telophoroi and their unconscionable plans...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HILDOISE_000_052: My goodness, if it isn't the young Miss Leveilleur.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HILDOISE_000_053: My apologies, but I work in the offices of the Forum, and if word reached Master Fourchenault that I was helping you...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_054: I see... We're sorry to have bothered you.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HILDOISE_000_060: I do not wish to give offense, but your companion is a well-known figure in the city, and you never know who might be watching...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_PIRONDIERRE_000_065: What, what─what is it? Can a man not enjoy a moment of private respite? If you're looking to share a table, then I respectfully request that you look elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_066: You misunderstand, sir─we were simply wondering if you knew of the Telophoroi. These enemies of peace have promised an end to all we hold dear, and─
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_PIRONDIERRE_000_067: Wait. You're that House Leveilleur girl, aren't you?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_PIRONDIERRE_000_068: And this  with you is obviously a foreigner. Hmph. I'd heard you were disowned for helping outsiders indulge their barbaric whims, and here you are giving truth to the rumor...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_PIRONDIERRE_000_069: I'll thank you to leave me be. I've naught to say to the likes of you.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_070: Well! I must apologize. 'Twas foolish of me to expect an onze of civility from one so enlightened. Come, .
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_PIRONDIERRE_000_075: Did I not make myself clear? Away with you, and let me dine in peace.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_080: Well, the customers have been decidedly uncooperative. Maybe the staff would be more willing to answer our questions.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_090: Welcome, ! What can I offer you today?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_091: Wait, is that Mistress Alisaie I see there!? My word, how long has it been!?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_093: Meet Dickon, the owner of the Last Stand. I used to frequent his café on occasion, in between lessons at the Studium.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_094: That seems like an age ago now. I remember hearing that you and Master Alphinaud had set sail for Eorzea, but then you never came back.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_095: Lately there's been gossip about your father disowning the pair of you. Everything all right at home?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_096: It's...complicated. And I hadn't expected complete strangers to be so familiar with our situation quite so quickly. Everyone has an opinion, it seems...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_097: Well, it is House Leveilleur. No matter how discreet Master Fourchenault may have been, news of your family's doings never stays secret for long.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_098: Things being what they are, what brings you back to the city now, of all times?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_099: We have questions, and only Sharlayan has the answers. Tell me, Master Dickon: have you heard anything about an apocalypse called the Final Days?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_100: What, like the end of the world? Nothing like that, I'm afraid. And that's what you're here to find? Information on this...apocalypse?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_101: Yes, whatever we can learn. Unfortunately, your patrons appear to be unwilling to speak with me.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_102: I wish there was more I could do to help...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_103: Hm, but maybe there is. You're a visitor to Sharlayan, aren't you?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_104: Then few will know your face. We should be able to pass you off as a server with none the wiser.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_105: We just finished preparing a few orders. Strike up some friendly conversation while you're setting down the food, and you might just get the answers you're looking for.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_106: Not a bad idea. I hate to ask, but...what do you think?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_107: That's the spirit! Pay attention, now, and I'll explain where each of these dishes needs to go.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_108: The tea set is for the chatty group sitting by the water's edge.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_109: The omelette is for one of our regulars─a Highlander by the name of Gisla. She's sitting at an outside table with a friend of hers.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_110: Behind them, you should see a Miqo'te gentleman. He ordered the oven-baked lobster.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_111: Got all that? If you're not sure, just ask and I'll explain again. Good luck!
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_120: I think you'll be better off if I stay here, out of sight. Find out what you can, and there'll be a hot cup of coffee waiting for you.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_125: Any troubles? Remember: the tea set goes to the group by the water.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_126: The omelette is for Gisla, a Highlander woman sitting outside with her friend.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_127: Last but not least, our famous lobster goes to the Miqo'te man seated directly behind those two ladies.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HERMENJART_000_136: Oh, my tea set! Lovely, thank you!
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HERMENJART_000_137: ...The Telopho-who? I'm sorry, I've never heard of them, or their “final days.”
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HERMENJART_000_138: My friends and I are somewhat uninformed when it comes to current events. Now, if you wanted to hear about ritual arcane practices of the Sixth Astral Era─common or esoteric─then I'd be happy to talk your ear off...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HERMENJART_000_139: Excuse me, I didn't order this! Where is my tea set?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HERMENJART_000_140: You work here, don't you? I'm still waiting on that charming little tea set...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HERMENJART_000_141: Ahem, I only ordered the tea set. I can't possibly eat this as well, so if you would be so kind...?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_HERMENJART_000_142: I always like to order this when I'm discussing arcane theory with my peers. It's my favorite treat!
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_GISLA_000_154:
Ah, finally! Two, four, six, eight!♪
Let's dig in─no time to waste─♪
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_GISLA_000_155: What? The Telophoroi? Ah, yes! I remember seeing the name in the latest gazette.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_GISLA_000_156: That and some grand claim about the end of days. Same old senseless warmongering. When will these fools grow tired of spilling each other's blood?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_GISLA_000_157: Best stay out of it, I say. The Forum made the right choice, and I fully support our decision to remain neutral!
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_GISLA_000_158: Is this on the house? Because I'm not paying for oven-baked lobster I didn't order. Now, where is my omelette?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_GISLA_000_159: Gods above, I'm starving! I've never known the service to be this slow...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_GISLA_000_160: I know I didn't order this, but I'm beginning to wish I had. It smells divine...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_GISLA_000_161: The Last Stand really does make the best omelettes in the world. The fluffiest egg. The tartest sauce. I could eat it every day for a year!
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SMITUTIA_000_174: At last, the oven-baked lobster is mine! You have no idea how long I've scrimped and saved and suffered to afford this heavenly dish...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SMITUTIA_000_175: The Final Days? This is the first I've heard of it.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SMITUTIA_000_176: Although, that would explain why my friend has been rushed off his feet. It must be a busy time to be a gleaner.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SMITUTIA_000_177: Hm? You don't know what a gleaner is? They're...collectors, of a sort. Travel the world procuring things that we haven't got here in Sharlayan─priceless books, unusual live specimens, and so forth.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SMITUTIA_000_178: So named for those folk who trail after the reapers in the fields, picking up every grain which was missed. Aye, by all accounts, gleaning is a most meticulous and demanding profession.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SMITUTIA_000_179: If these Telophoroi make good on their audacious threats, then many uncatalogued rarities could be lost forever. Why else would the gleaners be buzzing about in such a frenzy?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SMITUTIA_000_180: Watch the harbor, and you'll see what I mean─they're carting loads in from the docks all day. It's never been this hectic before. Not like this.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SMITUTIA_000_181: Er, you don't need to butter me up, you know... I've already ordered one of the most expensive things on the menu.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SMITUTIA_000_182: Gods, the anticipation... I've heard it melts in your mouth like the most succulent roast ever made!
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_SMITUTIA_000_183: I've wanted to try this meal ever since I saw it served at another table. Ah, the aroma alone was worth every gil I scraped together!
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_DICKON_000_190: I hope you and Mistress Alisaie got what you needed! ...She must be fond of you, eh? I've never known her to bring anyone to the café before.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_200: Any trouble with the customers? Were you able to get anyone talking?
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_201: Interesting... They seem unaware of the Final Days, aside from whatever vague news the gazettes are printing.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_202: Even Dickon had nothing to offer, and he's the best source of gossip in the city. Hmmm... If the Forum does have secret knowledge, then they've done an impressive job of ensuring no one whispers it in the wrong ear.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_203: In any case, thank you for playing the part so well! Here─that cup of coffee I promised.
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_204: But let's enjoy our drinks somewhere else, shall we? Maybe behind the peristyle, away from the gossips and their wagging tongues...
TEXT_AKTKMA104_04360_ALISAIE_000_210: Yes, this should do nicely. Out of the wind, and out of sight.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALISAIE_000_000: We should tell the others what we've learned about the gleaners.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALISAIE_000_001: Go on ahead to Noumenon, and I'll join you in a moment─Master Dickon will want his cups back!
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Where is Alisaie? I thought she was with you.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_YSHTOLA_000_015: My loyal assistant returns! There is a lexicon on the first floor that I need you to─ Ah. You've found something, haven't you?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_GRAHATIA_000_020: Is that coffee I smell? Did I miss the tea break?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_030: Welcome back, . Been for a walk and cleared your head, have you?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALISAIE_000_031: Not exactly. We did some impromptu investigating and turned up information on the gleaners...
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_YSHTOLA_000_032: It makes sense. The gleaners take their requests directly from institutions and bureaucrats, but as you say, they ultimately answer to the Forum.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_YSHTOLA_000_033: A sudden and significant increase in gleaner traffic and in cargo... It certainly gives the impression of an overarching plan being put into motion.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALPHINAUD_000_034: Let us see what theory we can build from the facts...
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALPHINAUD_000_035: As Y'shtola observed earlier, Noumenon's archives appear to contain no information concerning the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Coupled with what  and Alisaie learned at the Last Stand, we can be reasonably sure that most Sharlayans know nothing of that particular period of ancient history.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALPHINAUD_000_037: Yet my father and his colleagues are not only familiar with the Final Days, but are also somehow certain that the destruction being perpetrated by the Telophoroi is wholly unlike these apocalyptic events...
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALPHINAUD_000_038: Moreover, the Forum claims to be so occupied by a duty of such pressing importance that they saw fit to unanimously deny Eorzea's request for aid.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALPHINAUD_000_039: And now the gleaners, official agents of the state, have been mobilized on an unprecedented scale.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_040: I do not think it a stretch to conclude that the gleaners' recent activities are in service to the Forum's secretive ends.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_041: In which case, our next course of action seems obvious: we visit Labyrinthos and assess the situation for ourselves. And if we're lucky, the gleaners will be far more receptive to our questions.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_A1_000_044: What should we expect down there?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_A1_000_045: Anything would be better than burying my head in another dusty book...
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_046: I'm glad you approve! You won't be disappointed, I promise!
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_047: Oh, I would hate to spoil the surprise!
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_048: I understand not everyone is the studious type. Consider this a welcome change of pace, then!
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_GRAHATIA_000_049: As for myself, there are a few more subjects I should like to research. I may join you later, but feel free to leave behind your borrowed books and be on your way. I'll see to it that each is returned to its proper place.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_050: That would be a great help. Thank you, Raha!
