TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALISAIE_000_051: Let's head down the stairs over there, and I'll show you where the entrance is.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_GRAHATIA_000_060: Watch your step in Labyrinthos. It's rather more perilous than a simple storehouse. Although that will likely make the experience all the more attractive to an adventurer like you!
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALISAIE_000_070: Ready? Labyrinthos is not too far from here, but you may find the path a bit disorienting.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALISAIE_000_071: I'll take the lead, so stay close!
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_SYSTEM_000_072: Follow Alisaie and try not to fall behind.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALISAIE_000_075: Here we are! Through this door and down the stairs.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALISAIE_000_076: You did remember to attune to the shard back there, didn't you? It will make your life much easier if you need to come back in a hurry. Otherwise, we should keep moving!
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALPHINAUD_000_080: I've not been to Labyrinthos in the longest time. Even as a student, my visits were few and far between.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALISAIE_000_085: You didn't take a wrong turn into the Rostra there, did you? I doubt the Forum would take kindly to you barging into a private session.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_YSHTOLA_000_090: How did the Forum learn of the Final Days, and exactly how much do they know? More to the point, what do they intend to do about it? Hopefully the answer to at least one of those questions lies below...
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_100: We're all here now, yes? I've taken the liberty of securing permission for our group's descent.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_101: Right, everyone onto the lift and down we go!
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_NILZOZO_000_105: Your entrance papers appear to be in order. Do you wish to descend into Labyrinthos, ?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Excuse me, are you a gleaner? If you don't mind, I have some questions to ask...
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ALISAIE_000_115: ...Hmmm, fascinating, but could we go back to what you were saying earlier?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_YSHTOLA_000_120: Nay, I am not shirking my duties. I've not been down here in an age, and wished to get my bearings before I went bumbling about.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_YSHTOLA_000_121: From what I can see, however, there is naught obviously out of place. It seems we shall have to resort to discreet inquiries, as usual.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_125: Most of those gathered here appear to be gleaners. Why don't you wander around and try making small talk?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_DOBBIN_000_130: You want to know what I'm doing? Hauling books. And ore. And fauna. If it needs hauling, I haul it.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_DOBBIN_000_131: Every decade or so, they take stock in Labyrinthos─you know, sort and tidy up the inventory. Never seen an operation like this before, though.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_DOBBIN_000_132: They just did one a few summers ago, even! Then, with no warning at all, this mess gets dropped in our laps. Orders from on high. Damned if I know the reason. Could be that they're changing the layout, eh? Preparing for the next big expansion...
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_SYSTEM_000_133: Your exchange with Dobbin has taught you about “Taking stock in Labyrinthos.”
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_DOBBIN_000_134: Soon as the guildship sent out the summons, I knew this would be a rough job. They never call on us out of the blue for anything easy...
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_TIEVE_000_135: Let me think, let me think! The rhea seeds should be Item 1058, cumin seeds 1059, snurbleberry 1060...or were they 1061!?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_TIEVE_000_136: Argh, my head feels like it's stuffed with moko grass! Why more loads to take out than carry in!?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_TIEVE_000_137: Why do all this at once and risk mixing it up!? What if someone mistakes the Coerthan carrots for the Gyr Abanian carrots? What then!?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_SYSTEM_000_138: Your exchange with Tieve has taught you about “Large shipments coming in and out of Labyrinthos.”
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_TIEVE_000_139: Huh!? So 2023 was La Noscean topsoil? Then 2024 was...was...from Thanalan? Or the Shroud!?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ERENVILLE_000_140: You here to help or give me more headaches? Because you don't have the look of a gleaner, and I'm in no mood for idle chatter.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ERENVILLE_000_141: One of my colleagues was so exhausted he took a tumble and crashed into a pile of crates. Now I have a pack of marmots running loose...
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_SYSTEM_000_142: Your exchange with Erenville has taught you about “Exhausted gleaners.”
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_ERENVILLE_000_143: Those little devils are quick as sin and twice as hard to catch. I suppose I had better start searching...
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_150: Any luck, ? What tales did the gleaners have to tell?
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_151: So this grand operation began without warning? And for every item they bring in, they're sending more inventory somewhere else. Hmm... That would explain the haggard faces I've been seeing.
TEXT_AKTKMA105_04361_KRILE_000_152: We were right─the Forum is definitely up to something. And they're turning Labyrinthos upside down in the process.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_000: Those little devils are quick as sin and twice as hard to catch. I suppose I had better start searching...
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_010: We would do well to learn more of what, specifically, the gleaners are being tasked to do, as well as who has tasked them to do it.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_011: If you're game, , I have an idea...
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_012: Didn't one of the gleaners you questioned say something about escaped marmots?
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_013: Perhaps if you were to help him capture said creatures, he might be inclined towards a more friendly and enlightening conversation...
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_014: In the meantime, I will turn my charms upon this gleaner here. We can compare notes afterwards. Happy hunting!
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_020: Terribly sorry to disturb you! I need to submit this report of mine, and quickly─it's a bit overdue. Could you remind me of the approximate date the guildship was enlisted to help facilitate this most recent operation?
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_030: You wish to help me find the marmots? I've nothing suitable to pay you for your services, but if you're offering out of the goodness of your heart, I'd welcome the assistance.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_031: The name is Erenville, friend. Specialist in the collection of live specimens.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_032: That said, the capture of these Nagxian marmots is a trial I've no desire to repeat. “Grizzled mice,” they call them.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_033: For a mercy, there are no other marmot species on this tier at present, so there should be no mistaking our little fugitives. If you happen to catch any, stuff them in this sack. Gently, of course.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_034: Where to begin, you wonder? I've not seen any scampering around here, so we'll need to widen our search into the surrounding forest.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_035: Be on your guard. There are beasts out there that won't hesitate to prey on a marmot─or you.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_036: I'll search the trees to the west. The eastern part of the forest is all yours. Good luck.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_SYSTEM_000_051: Barely have you readied the sack when the grizzled mouse scampers off into the underbrush...
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_SYSTEM_000_062: The rodent nimbly evades your grasp before once more disappearing into the trees...
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_SYSTEM_000_072: More prepared for its speed this time, you succeed in closing the sack over your elusive quarry!
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_080: How did you fare? I tracked down three of the pack, which leaves one unaccounted for...
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_081: Ah, there's the odd marmot out.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_082: Wait here a moment while I put our friends in a holding cage.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_083: Thankfully, the marmots seem to be unharmed. They've held up well in isolation, but it's much too soon to release them into the habitat.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_084: It's a good thing we were able to recapture them so swiftly. You have my thanks.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_A1_000_086: Who tasked you to capture them in the first place?
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_A1_000_087: What will you do with the marmots now?
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_088: Why, the authority in charge of Labyrinthos, now and in perpetuity. The same officials who've had us working day and night of late─the honorable members of the Forum, who else?
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_089: Suitable for consumption and easy to breed─those were the two conditions I was given for the stock I was instructed to procure.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_090: That's for the Forum to decide. They are the guiding authority behind Labyrinthos after all, and this job was but one small part of this great inventory of theirs.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_091: Suitable for consumption and easy to breed─those were the two conditions I was given for the stock I was instructed to procure.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_092: I don't know what the Forum has planned for these creatures, but at the very least, I doubt they'll be served for dinner today or tomorrow.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_094: Is this the gleaner you mentioned? The one who was looking for lost marmots?
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_095: Interesting company you keep, friend. Who are you folk, anyway?
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_096: I am Krile of the Students of Baldesion. These others are my associates.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_097: Truth be told, the Forum's decisions of late have not sat entirely well with us. That is why we made the descent into Labyrinthos─we hoped that by seeing those decisions put into action, we might more fully understand their reasoning.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_098: Wise and practical. Never hurts to try and gain a broader perspective, does it?
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ERENVILLE_000_099: Anyway, duty calls─other animals to capture and enclosures to empty. Once again, I'm sorry that I can't offer you more for your services.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_100: Did you learn anything new from your friend there?
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_101: So we've confirmed that the order for this ambitious operation did indeed come directly from the Forum. However, the gleaners have not been informed of its purpose...
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_102: I'd say that fits with everything we've heard thus far.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ALPHINAUD_000_103: We also discovered when the operation was begun. The Forum contacted the gleaners' guildship and put their people to this great work some four days after the Telophoroi made their chilling declaration.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ALPHINAUD_000_104: As seasoned travelers, the gleaners keep abreast of news from every corner of the world out of necessity. Thus am I inclined to trust that their calendar of events is accurate.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_YSHTOLA_000_105: Altogether, it gives the distinct impression that this undertaking was a sudden and unexpected development...
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_YSHTOLA_000_106: Yet I find it hard to believe that such a comprehensive restructuring of Labyrinthos and its archives could have been planned in so brief a window.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_YSHTOLA_000_107: Nay, this plan was long in the making─they were but awaiting the right time to put it into effect.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ALISAIE_000_108: And the Telophoroi's declaration was what set it all in motion?
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_YSHTOLA_000_109: It seems likely. But let us not leap to conclusions just yet.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_YSHTOLA_000_110: For the moment, I suggest we conduct a wider investigation of Labyrinthos. The more facilities we visit, the more pieces of the puzzle we stand to find.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_111: In that case, how about we head to the Archeion? From there, we can reach the lower─
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_113: I'm fine...truly. The sudden descent has left me with a bit of headache, that's all.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_114: Nothing that will stop me from soldiering on. Let's be about it, then!
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ALPHINAUD_000_115: At least allow me to take the lead. I'm fairly certain I remember the way to the Archeion.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ALPHINAUD_000_116: We follow the path east, through the forest where you were chasing after that mouse...or marmot, was it? Anyway, 'tis the trolls you need to watch out for!
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ALISAIE_000_120: Were you caught in mist on your way here? The sprayers keep the air humid, so the habitat feels as close as possible to a natural forest.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_YSHTOLA_000_125: This is the foremost material archive in Sharlayan. I should love to explore its treasures shelf by shelf, but I fear we have little time for such indulgences.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_130: Don't worry about me, I'm hale and healthy! In fact, I'm beginning to suspect that...
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_KRILE_000_131: ...Nay, let's discuss this later. The investigation demands our undivided attention.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ALPHINAUD_000_140: Behold, the Archeion. As Noumenon serves as Sharlayan's literary archive, so does this structure house the city's wealth of material data.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ALPHINAUD_000_141: The architecture, too, is similar. This building you see is merely the upper entrance─an access point to the vaults carved into the cliffside itself.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ALPHINAUD_000_142: Within those vast rooms are stored countless samples and specimens, as well as the detailed records which describe them.
TEXT_AKTKMA106_04362_ALPHINAUD_000_143: In a manner of speaking, the Archeion contains a physical history of Sharlayan's unwavering dedication to the accumulation of knowledge.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALISAIE_000_000: Were you caught in mist on your way here? The sprayers keep the air humid, so the habitat feels as close as possible to a natural forest.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_YSHTOLA_000_005: This is the foremost material archive in Sharlayan. I should love to explore its treasures shelf by shelf, but I fear we have little time for such indulgences.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_KRILE_000_010: Don't worry about me, I'm hale and healthy! In fact, I'm beginning to suspect that...
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_KRILE_000_011: ...Nay, let's discuss this later. The investigation demands our undivided attention.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Well, we won't learn anything of value standing out here. Let us proceed into the main building and speak with the custodian.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Greetings. We are here to peruse the Archeion's vaults.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_GUIDEOFTHEARCHEION_: Peruse? You are clearly not gleaners, then. Might I ask your affiliation?
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_KRILE_000_032: We belong to the Students of Baldesion, but...is that relevant? I was given to believe that the vaults─those open to the public, at least─were...open to the public.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_GUIDEOFTHEARCHEION_: Ordinarily, yes, that would be the case. At present, however, access is restricted. Only persons directly involved in the reorganization efforts are permitted to enter.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_YSHTOLA_000_034: Not us, then. I suppose we had better move along to another facility.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_KRILE_000_035: This building has a lift which connects to the middle tier, yes? Might we at least make use of that?
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_GUIDEOFTHEARCHEION_: That service has also been suspended, I am afraid. For the time being, priority has been given over to the conveyance of inventory.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALISAIE_000_037: What, so this is as far as we can go!?
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_GUIDEOFTHEARCHEION_: I apologize for the inconvenience. Please come again after our restructuring operation is concluded.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALISAIE_000_039: By that time, it will be too late. And we were so close to getting answers...
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_YSHTOLA_000_040: We need to rethink our approach. Let us step outside for the moment, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALPHINAUD_000_050: The Forum must be wary of exposure indeed to so heavily restrict the use of public institutions...
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALISAIE_000_055: If they're going to close off facilities, then they ought to announce it! The students must be furious!
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_KRILE_000_060: Labyrinthos is constructed in the shape of a mortar. This upper layer is called the “Outer Circuit,” and the “Medial Circuit” lies one tier below us...
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_TROUBLEDSTUDENT0436: How can they close the Archeion? I mean, really...
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_YSHTOLA_000_070: We are at an impasse. As we have no other leads, I should like to pursue this one further...
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_YSHTOLA_000_071: But I doubt that our stone-faced custodian will be swayed by heartfelt pleas. We must seek another means to access the lower levels.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_YSHTOLA_000_072: 'Tis likely that the people in this area are involved in the restructuring in one way or another. If we were to ingratiate ourselves, they might allow us to accompany them on the lift.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_YSHTOLA_000_073: Let us ask around. Surely someone is in need of a few strong backs to lighten the load.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_TIREDSTAFF04363_000: What's that? Take you down on the lift with me? Sorry, but not a chance. I've been up and down all day, and only now have I finally found a spare moment to rest.

I did see a gleaner fellow heading out the gate there, though. Shouldering a large pack─engaged in some manner of task. Maybe he'll be headed down below after he's done with...whatever it is he's doing.
Please, even talking is an effort. Go and bother that gleaner I told you about...
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_TROUBLEDSTUDENT0436: Am I taking the lift? Oh, no, we're just students. They won't let us into the Archeion, even though we found...
...Actually, we have no idea what it is we found─there's no record of such a creature anywhere. But it was wandering around Tranquility, and so we thought to donate it to the vaults.
Oddest little squeal, don't you think? Anyway, I suppose we'll have to take care of it until the Archeion is open again.
At first we thought it might have escaped from one of the research laboratories, but when we reported our find to the Studium, they were just as dumbfounded as we were...
If it truly is a newly discovered species, we could have our names appear in a gazette!
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ERENVILLE_000_091: ...Ah, it's you again. I don't mean to be rude, but I'm in the middle of another task. The cloudkin I need to capture is close. Very close.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ERENVILLE_000_092: Hm? You wish to help me with this, too? You spend your time in unusual ways, my friend.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ERENVILLE_000_093: Still, two hunters are generally better than one. Very well.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ERENVILLE_000_094: The canal here is a common gathering spot for birds of all kinds, but the one I'm after today is the hornbill.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ERENVILLE_000_095: Its feathers are green, and its cry a distinctive “caw.” Single it out and shoot it with this sleeping dart.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ERENVILLE_000_096: The effects are short-lived, so I'll lie in wait down by the riverbank to claim our quarry. Be sure to hit the right one!
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_SYSTEM_000_100: Search your surroundings for the hornbill. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target the hornbill and use the blowgun with .
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALISAIE_000_110: I took a quick peek inside, but it's awfully dark in there...
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_YSHTOLA_000_115: The Medial Circuit which Erenville mentioned is the tier directly below us.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_YSHTOLA_000_116: Unlike the lowest level of Labyrinthos with its rigid security, one can usually roam the middle layer quite freely. Let us see what we might find.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_KRILE_000_120: I never would've noticed this cave on my own! Thank the Scholar that Erenville knew of it...and that you were there to persuade him to share.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALPHINAUD_000_130: This must be it─the entrance to the mineshaft.
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALPHINAUD_000_131: 'Tis faint, but I hear something moving within... Creatures homed there by the researchers, you think?
TEXT_AKTKMA107_04363_ALPHINAUD_000_132: Well, slavering beasts aside, we will need to watch our footing. We should tighten our straps and such before we continue.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Man-made though it may be, this shaft was designed to resemble a natural cave system. Heed Erenville's warning and do step carefully.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_YSHTOLA_000_005: The Medial Circuit which Erenville mentioned is the tier directly below us.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_YSHTOLA_000_006: Unlike the lowest level of Labyrinthos with its rigid security, one can usually roam the middle layer quite freely. Let us see what we might find.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_KRILE_000_010: I never would've noticed this cave on my own! Thank the Scholar that Erenville knew of it...and that you were there to persuade him to share.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALISAIE_000_020: Assuming everyone's tightened their straps and checked their gear, then I say we head on in. Given the terrain ahead, though, it might be wise to leave some distance between us─we don't want to be stumbling over each other if it comes to a fight.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALISAIE_000_021: Take it slow, and don't forget to check your surroundings from time to time! We can meet up again at the other end of the tunnel.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALISAIE_000_030: ! Did you know Krile almost took a tumble back there? She can't possibly still be dizzy from the lift...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_KRILE_000_035: I was being careful, I swear! The slope was steeper than I thought, and I lost my footing for a moment, that's all. I'm not injured, if you don't count my pride...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_YSHTOLA_000_040: That mineshaft was infested with mythrilcaps. Some sort of research project, I wonder?
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_YSHTOLA_000_041: I suppose they are a most unusual creature. Why did they develop such long limbs when all they do is shuffle about narrow tunnels?
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Everyone seems to have made it through without incident. Nothing of consequence, at least. And, as promised, the tunnel has delivered us into the Medial Circuit.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_051: As I recall, this tier is where they keep a wide variety of samples for agricultural production.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_052: If Erenville's assumption holds true─that specimens are being collected in preparation for a great migration─then we should see evidence of such plans in the area's research projects.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Let's follow the path to the nearest farming facility and see what we see...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_060: My memories of this place are a touch hazy, but if we keep to the path heading north, then we should eventually arrive at a farm of some kind...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_KRILE_000_070: Aha, now I know where we are─this is Meryall Agronomics.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_KRILE_000_071: Labyrinthos is host to a wide variety of vegetation, which allows us to conduct studies on cultivation methods utilized in foreign lands.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_KRILE_000_072: And it is this facility which coordinates and oversees those efforts. The “fruits” of their research go to feed their Labyrinthos colleagues, or so I hear.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALISAIE_000_073: More notable successes might make it to the Agora. Foods so exotic you'd be hard-pressed to guess their origin, let alone how they might taste.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_KRILE_000_074: Indeed! Mystery vegetables without a name, only a list of nutritional benefits scribbled on a card...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Hm... I see no gleaners hereabouts, yet these workers seem to share that same sense of urgency.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_076: 'Tis possible they know something of the Forum's plans and their underlying motivations. Worth looking into, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_077: See what you can coax from the workers. The rest of us will do the same or cast about for useful clues.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_080: ...And so you've spent years researching these high-yield cultivation techniques?
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALISAIE_000_085: I'm told this cart holds the harvest meant for the larders here. Nothing out of the ordinary...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_KRILE_000_090: A field full of ripe vegetables being left to rot on the vine. Not a single picker hard at work. Clearly procuring readily available fresh food is not the Forum's priority...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_YSHTOLA_000_100: I took a moment to survey the surrounding area. There are several other facilities nearby we can investigate if we fail to learn aught of value here.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_JEBKE_000_110: Oh, hello there! We weren't expecting visitors─not with use of the lift being restricted. How did you make it down here, anyway?
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_JEBKE_000_111: The mineshaft, you say? Well, you're a much hardier soul than I!
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_JEBKE_000_112: Under normal circumstances, I'd reward such tenacity with a guided tour of the fields, but I'm afraid the Forum has us filling order lists a malm long.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_JEBKE_000_113: Massive-yet-detailed requests. Literal wagonloads of crop samples, and hardly any time to put them together.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_JEBKE_000_114: When I first heard of this grand “reorganization,” I assumed we would be shuffling around old stock to make room for the new. Then came the orders for ridiculous quantities of seeds we've already thoroughly researched.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_JEBKE_000_115: Passing strange, eh? I pressed for an explanation...and was met with vague assurances that all would be revealed in due course. Not the most satisfying answer...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_JEBKE_000_116: Visit us again when the lift is back in normal operation. I should hope we'll have all-new crops to show you by then...but we probably won't.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_CARRIER04364_000_11: <huff> <huff> ...Do I have aught to be taken down below? More than I can carry, and then some!

Most of our stock is sent off via the cargo lift, but some has been earmarked for aerial transport. Hence the stack of crates atop that hill over there. Gods, hauling the lot up that slope was a job and a half...
Right, back to it, then! Once I'm done here, I think I'll take some fresh fruit to the Last Stand and have them whip me up a dessert...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_HARVESTER04364_000_: What crops are we raising? Well, as you can see, this one is a variety of grape.

Only needs a good source of sunlight to grow, and the conditions here are nothing short of perfect. Hardly surprising, given that it's native to a particular locale in the very place upon which Labyrinthos was modeled─a region in the south of Ilsabard.

It boasts remarkable habitat diversity, allowing for myriad flora and fauna to thrive. Chilly peaks in the north give way to swaths of temperate plains, which in turn transition into a hot, humid coastline.
Such bountiful territory is ever contested, as you might expect. Used to be called Corvos before the imperials renamed it Locus Amoenus.

The Forum saw it not as a prize, however, but as a researcher's ideal environment─one whose climates we strove to recreate within the confines of Labyrinthos. It's since provided a rich foundation for countless experiments in cultivation.
Once we've picked the fruit, we'll need to take cuttings. Rather a lot of them, in fact. Wonder if they're planning to grow a new vineyard somewhere...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_YSHTOLA_000_130: The stack of crates on the hill is going below? That sounds promising. I'll gather the others and join you there.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_SYSTEM_000_140: The labels on these crates tell the story of their contents: bundles of common seeds and saplings, accompanied by sheaves of reports.
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALPHINAUD_000_145: It feels wrong to spy on Erenville, helpful as he's been...but what other choice do we have?
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_ALISAIE_000_150: Let's get after him already! We've waited too long as it is!
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_KRILE_000_155: Forgive me, my attention has been elsewhere... We were following Erenville, weren't we?
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_YSHTOLA_000_160: Is Krile still feeling unwell? I've never seen her so distracted...
TEXT_AKTKMA108_04364_YSHTOLA_000_161: Keep an eye on her, but keep moving, too─we cannot let our quarry slip away.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_ALPHINAUD_000_000: It feels wrong to spy on Erenville, helpful as he's been...but what other choice do we have?
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_005: Did you see which way Erenville went...?
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_KRILE_000_010: Forgive me, my attention has been elsewhere... We were following Erenville, weren't we?
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_ALISAIE_000_020: Erenville was headed westwards along the path outside the Archeion. Come, we can still catch him!
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_ALPHINAUD_000_030: It seems Y'shtola wishes to have a word with us.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_ALISAIE_000_035: We've fallen too far behind. And this damned mist won't help matters!
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_050: Hold a moment. I have an idea.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_051: If memory serves, that colossal wall-like structure is Logistikon Beta─one of Labyrinthos's climate control centers.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_052: It should have its own lifts, with which one could access the upper or lower tiers... Aye, if I were an agent of the Forum, it would make for a convenient meeting place...
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_053: But even if we happen to find Erenville in the company of said agent, we cannot expect them to reveal issues of importance as we nonchalantly stroll past.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_054: Nay, we shall have to remain undetected.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_ALPHINAUD_000_055: If only G'raha and his Vanish spell were here...
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_056: Oh, but there are other ways of turning “invisible.”
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_059: Unaccustomed to transfiguration? Worry not. It will wear off with the passage of time.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_060: I suggest you and your green companions hop along and catch up with Erenville. Should you feel the magicks fading, return to me and I will refresh the enchantment.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_KRILE_000_061: Um...and what am I to do in the meantime?
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_062: Wait here with me. In your current state of mind, you'd be as likely to leap into the jaws of a predator as you would learn anything of note.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_063: Which reminds me: ware the creatures hereabouts. In that form, you are essentially defenseless.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_064: You have changed into a toad! You must remain transfigured in order to progress with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_065: You will return from your transfigured status if you move too far away. Look to your map for the transfiguration's area of effect.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_066: Speak with Y'shtola to restore or prolong the transfiguration.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_075: Stand still, and I shall recast the spell. The transformation should last long enough to allow you to find and spy upon Erenville.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_KRILE_000_080: <sigh> I would've enjoyed being a toad for a little while, if only for the change of pace... But Y'shtola is right. I am too preoccupied with other matters.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_089: Alphi-toad's stare speaks volumes, all of which you presume are variations of “Why are you not a toad?” Speak with Y'shtola to have her recast the spell.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_091: Alphi-toad and Ali-toad are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_092: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_093: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_118: Ali-toad glares tiny toad daggers at you, likely in a furious attempt to express the sentiment that “This won't work if you're not a toad!” Speak with Y'shtola to have her recast the spell.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_121: Alphi-toad attempts and fails to shake his head, but you nevertheless understand that he is telling you this is the wrong way.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_126: Ali-toad turns to face the north. Perhaps she is suggesting you cross the bridge...
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_Q2_000_130: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companion?
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_132: Alphi-toad hops back towards Y'shtola and Krile.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_136: Ali-toad hops back towards Y'shtola and Krile.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_SYSTEM_000_150: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_ALISAIE_000_160: Our toad performance needs work, apparently. I'll have to pay more attention the next time I see one...
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_YSHTOLA_000_165: You've come back alone? Where are your warty companions?
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_ALPHINAUD_000_170: I suppose we should have known a gleaner who specializes in animal procurement would not be so easily deceived... Yet he seemed inclined to put his trust in us all the same.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_ALPHINAUD_000_171: More importantly, perhaps, we've discovered a new piece of the puzzle─this “momentous duty” the Forum agent mentioned.
TEXT_AKTKMA109_04365_ALPHINAUD_000_172: Sharlayan has been called to action, and the Telophoroi's declaration was the catalyst. Whatever charge it is they hope to fulfill, they deem it of sufficient import to disrupt all of Labyrinthos, not to mention ignore Eorzea's request for aid...
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_ALPHINAUD_000_000: If we happen to cross paths with Erenville again, I should like to thank him properly.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_YSHTOLA_000_005: You've come back alone? Where are your warty companions?
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_ALISAIE_000_010: What duty could warrant the direct involvement of the Forum and the commitment of all its resources?
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_ALISAIE_000_011: Judging by what we just heard, none of the gleaners were offered any kind of explanation. At this point, it seems abundantly clear that we'll learn nothing new by pressing them further.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_ALISAIE_000_012: We should head back to Y'shtola and Krile for the moment. See what they think of this.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_ALISAIE_000_025: It's funny how normal the forest seems now. As a toad, it was all so much more ominous and threatening...
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_YSHTOLA_000_030: Welcome back. I trust you found Erenville, then?
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_YSHTOLA_000_031: Interesting... I had a feeling you would learn something important─even if that something was simply a confirmation that no one knows much of anything.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_YSHTOLA_000_032: We should share this with Krile, then discuss how we'd like to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_YSHTOLA_000_033: Assuming we find her back at the farm. She was still behaving oddly, so I bade her return and rest there...
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_YSHTOLA_000_034: Perhaps not the best decision, in hindsight. Would you mind checking near those flowers she was so entranced by? The rest of us can survey the more distant areas, just in case she decided to wander.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_ALPHINAUD_000_040: My father may be right─that I am still groping in the dark for answers. But I needed him to know that I would never stop searching. I owed that much to Arenvald...and myself.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_ALISAIE_000_045: Thank the gods for Scholarch Montichaigne. I absolutely loathe arguing in circles.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_GRAHATIA_000_050: I apologize for the trouble I've caused you. I was pondering the significance of what I had just read as I left the restricted section...
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_GRAHATIA_000_051: ...And knocked over the security mammet on my way out. I promise to be more vigilant next time.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_KRILE_000_055: You may encounter some raised eyebrows, but do continue to claim the Students as your sponsor whensoever the need arises.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_KRILE_000_056: I believe in the guiding principles of the Scions...and I know my grandfather would have as well.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_YSHTOLA_000_060: Well, at least we've been allowed to remain in the city.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_YSHTOLA_000_061: And our endless investigations have not been in vain─we now know that this mysterious duty of theirs began with whatever the Forum discovered in the aetherial sea.
TEXT_AKTKMA110_04366_YSHTOLA_000_062: With our freedoms so sorely curtailed, however, we will struggle to learn aught more of substance here in Sharlayan...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_000: My father may be right─that I am still groping in the dark for answers. But I needed him to know that I would never stop searching. I owed that much to Arenvald...and myself.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_YSHTOLA_000_005: We shall have to think very carefully about how we are to proceed from here.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_GRAHATIA_000_010: I apologize for the trouble I've caused you. I was pondering the significance of what I had just read as I left the restricted section...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_GRAHATIA_000_011: ...And knocked over the security mammet on my way out. I promise to be more vigilant next time.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_KRILE_000_015: You may encounter some raised eyebrows, but do continue to claim the Students as your sponsor whensoever the need arises.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_KRILE_000_016: I believe in the guiding principles of the Scions...and I know my grandfather would have as well.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_020: The overall picture has grown clearer, yes, but that's in spite of the Forum being so maddeningly vague about this duty of theirs.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_021: Why are they so reluctant to explain their actions in plain words?
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_022: Survival, come what may... Is Father's work so vital that it takes precedence over his own family?
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_AMELIANCE_000_024: (-???-)When I heard you'd been dragged before the Forum, I came as swiftly as I could. I am so very glad they allowed you to stay...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_AMELIANCE_000_027: And you fine people must be the Scions of the Seventh Dawn. How lovely it is to finally meet you!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_028: Mother, please. We don't wish to make things difficult for you. If word reaches Father that you were here─
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_AMELIANCE_000_029: Oh, bother that. Am I to be chastised for speaking with my own children!? I am well aware that you and “Master Fourchenault” are not on the best of terms at the moment, but I've been absolutely desperate to see my darlings again!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_AMELIANCE_000_030: You will come by the house, won't you? I have gifts waiting.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_YSHTOLA_000_031: The timing couldn't be better. As matters stand, we shan't be going anywhere until we discuss matters with Thancred's group and reconsider our options.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_YSHTOLA_000_032: Go, visit your home. We will be back at the annex when you are ready to rejoin us.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_033: I'm not sure we─ , what do you think?
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_AMELIANCE_000_035: What a splendid day this has turned out to be! Champion of Eorzea, I insist that you join us!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_AMELIANCE_000_036: Ah, but we must be quick about it. Not for my own benefit, but should my husband return and find you enjoying our hospitality, the servants will be made to suffer the consequences.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_AMELIANCE_000_037: ! If you would be so kind as to escort my children to the estate...?
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_038: And then she was gone─and with her any opportunity to protest...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_KRILE_000_039: Indeed─the matter is settled. Enjoy yourselves, you three!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_040: I'm sure Alphinaud thinks nothing of it─he invited classmates over all the time. But I, well... I wasn't the most... It was a different time for me, all right!?
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_050: I apologize... My mother is not one to take no for an answer. Still, I am glad─relieved, even─to see her in such high spirits.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_051: What say you, ? Though it seems we shall have little enough time to enjoy it, will you accompany us on our visit home?
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Let us give Alisaie a push, then, and be on our way.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_Q2_000_070: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_071: What? Right now? Nothing for it, I suppose, but Mother was most insistent you come as well. We shall be waiting for you by the Rostra.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Shall we hurry along to the estate? Mother will be wondering where we are.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_SYSTEM_000_080: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_088: Oh no, I'm not going to suffer this by myself. Make sure Alphinaud is coming along first!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_SYSTEM_000_089: You must be accompanied by Alphinaud and have him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_090: Fine... If we're going, then let's get it over with! But be sure to stay in the entrance hall─no peeking into our private chambers, thank you very much!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_091: Whyever not? Your room was always perfectly neat and tidy...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_092: Everyone has things they'd rather keep to themselves, don't they? Cherished mementos you couldn't bring yourself to throw away, childhood toys─
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_093: I mean, uh... Gah, never mind! The Leveilleur estate is that way, straight down the stairs. Come on!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_SYSTEM_000_094: Alphinaud and Alisaie are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_SYSTEM_000_095: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_SYSTEM_000_096: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_A3_000_100: Discuss the view from the bridge.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_105: After all we've been through together, 'tis strange to be here with you now. To come full circle and see how much has changed...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_106: Are you ready to visit the estate? Mother will be cross if we come without Alisaie. The Rostra was to be our rendezvous point...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_110: The Leveilleur estate is in the northern part of Journey's End, just down the stairs from the Rostra.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_111: Oh, and please don't make a fuss when we get there. It's only a house!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_112: Alphinaud will be at the Rostra. Mother wants to see both of us, so let's go and grab him, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_115: When Alisaie and I were little, this bridge was as far as we were permitted to wander alone.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_116: I say “alone,” but my mother or a servant was always somewhere nearby, keeping a watchful eye.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_117: And now look at us. Traveling to different continents...different worlds, even.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_120: As children, Alphinaud and I would often wait here for our father to come home from work.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_121: It must've been a day when his meetings ran long, because I remember growing restless, and leaning out over the railing to watch the water rush by.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_122: Father, of course, arrived at that exact moment. Came pounding down the path in a panic, crying out my name...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_125: Oh yes, this is where I first practiced magic on an actual person.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_126: Alisaie had fallen, you see, and scraped her knee quite badly─so I tried casting the simple restorative spell I had only just learned.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_127: How she smiled when the wound closed. The joy and relief... That was, I believe, the very moment I chose the healing arts as the main subject of my studies.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_130: We used to come here all the time with Grandfather! In summer, I would dip my hands and feet in the fountain and splash about...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_131: Not Alphinaud, though─even back then, he wasn't very fond of playing in water. He'd make any excuse to avoid it.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_132: Which would explain how I came to swim like an auk, and he sink like a stone!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_135: Not going after all? Then neither shall I! Though I suppose I'll never hear the end of it from Mother if we don't... Hmm. We'll wait at the Rostra in case you change your mind.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_140: Decided to come with us? And you're sure about this? <sigh> All right...if only to see the smile on Mother's face.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_AMELIANCE_000_150: Oh, are you the advance party? I should like to receive you all at once, if that's not too much to ask!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_SYSTEM_000_151: You must be accompanied by Alphinaud and Alisaie, and have them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_AMELIANCE_000_160: And here you are at last! Please, do come in!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALISAIE_000_170: And that was that. Only the gods know when we'll be back again...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_180: Thank you for indulging Mother's request─I can see it meant a lot to her. And I, uh, shall refrain from inquiring as to the content of your private conversation.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_181: Our visit was all too brief... For now, however, it will have to suffice. As will these tokens of home that we carry with us─these gifts to help us remember who we are and whence we came...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_ALPHINAUD_000_182: But enough sentimentality. Let us return to the annex and rejoin our companions!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_KRILE_000_190: Enjoyed your time with the Leveilleurs, I hope? I would ask how the twins fared, but their new outfits tell the tale!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_KRILE_000_191: I only hope we can help them to reconcile with their father, that they might return home one day with their heads held high...
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_KRILE_000_192: In the meantime, we edge ever closer to the secret the Forum strives to hide. And the flower bequeathed to you by Hydaelyn is sure to guide us going forward.
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_KRILE_000_193: I'm confident that once we've heard your report from Thavnair, we'll be well equipped to plot out our next move!
TEXT_AKTKMA111_04367_KRILE_000_194: I'm confident that once you've scouted out the situation in Thavnair, we'll be well equipped to plot out our next move!
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_000: Though I have read much on the subject of Radz-at-Han, this visit shall be my first. 'Twill be interesting to see how the Hannish mean to contend with the tower, different as their magical and technological disciplines are.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_005: So it's back to Thavnair... Had I known earlier, I would have considered more suitable attire.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_010: I have Krile's instructions in hand. If you are ready to set out, then so are we.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_011: Having been to Thavnair before, I can travel by aetheryte, but what of the rest of you? Another sea voyage would waste time we do not have.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_012: Krile was of the same mind, and has already secured the aid of the good folk of the Confluence. We'll take ourselves there.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_015: Thou wilt recall the hunt for Iceheart, unto whose sanctuary we delivered thee owing to the knowledge of our comrade Moenbryda.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_016: Moenbryda was an authority on aetherology─a field of study she did embark upon in pursuit of her parents' example.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_017: Both are authorities in their own right...and both are researchers at the Confluence.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_018: Haven't you gone to see them yet?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_019: I attempted to do so earlier, but to my shame, my courage failed me at the last.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_020: As it hath the many times I thought to reach out to them after sending that fateful letter.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_021: Neither time nor introspection have revealed unto me the words I should speak, and thus have I kept my silence...
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_022: Whether you come with us or no is your choice and yours alone.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_023: If it is too difficult, we'll manage.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_024: Thou art kind to say so, but I have no intention of forsaking our cause. I shall go to the Confluence, and I shall face that which hath long been overdue.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_025: If it's settled, then let us be off. When we arrive, we should look for a researcher named Kytte.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_030: Well now, this is rather a lot of stern faces... Are my library books overdue again?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_031: Not to our knowledge. We're associates of Krile of the Students of Baldesion. We seek passage to Thavnair, and understand that you can assist us.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_032: Ah, the test subjects! Welcome, welcome!
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_034: Oh, you hadn't heard? Well then, allow me to explain.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_035: So, in order to travel to an aetheryte, you ordinarily need to be attuned to it beforehand.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_036: Otherwise you can't use it as a beacon to seek out while you're a mess of aether hurtling along the Lifestream.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_037: An inconvenient but incontrovertible limitation of aetheryte teleportation.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_038: But what if I were to tell you that there's a way to travel to an aetheryte without being attuned to it?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_039: A way to teleport instantly to places you've never been!?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_040: For long years, we've labored to make such travel possible, that people might move about more freely.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_041: And we've finally done it! We've created a new kind of aetheryte that doesn't require attunement!
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_043: Well, my language may have been a bit misleading. The user need not attune to these aetherytes, but the aetherytes themselves must have been pre-attuned to each other, thereby facilitating travel between the two points.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_044: But it just so happens that of our first test pair of aetherytes, one has been installed here in Sharlayan, and the other over in Yedlihmad, a port town in Thavnair!
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_045: As you may know, our nation has long maintained strong ties with Radz-at-Han. And indeed, we owe much of this breakthrough to the contributions of their alchemists.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_046: So to sum up, we're to “test” these aetherytes. How fortuitous...for you...
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_047: I should mention that an accident has impaired my ability to channel aether. Will this be a problem?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_048: Not at all! As a matter of fact, you might say these aetherytes were made for people like your good self. The magicks imbued within will whisk you away without any effort on your part.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_049: A veritable dream come true. And far be it from me to worry about such things, but do we have permission to make use of your shiny new invention?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_050: The only permission required is yours, so assuming you're willing, we're all set!
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_051: It may come as a surprise, but we actually struggle to find test subjects. Most people seem to have an unreasonable fear of their souls gradually disintegrating as they drift helplessly in the Lifestream─in the statistically unlikely event that something goes awry.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_052: But it's plain that you aren't most people! Heh heh, Mistress Krile truly knows how to pick 'em!
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_053: If I might change the subject... Are Master Wilfsunn and Mistress Bloewyda not present today?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_054: Oh, you didn't hear? They've recently resigned their posts. Their expertise was needed elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_055: A large-scale project helmed by the Forum itself, as I understand, but I'm not privy to the details.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_057: Any other questions? No? Then let's get going before you change your minds! Please see to your preparations and head outside to the aetheryte plaza. I'll be along shortly.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_060: In case you were wondering, the aetheryte still functions like a normal one. It's just been upgraded to allow unattuned travel. I'll see you there shortly.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_065: Given my experience with teleportation, I'd be lying if I said I didn't have reservations, but I will trust in Krile.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_070: Though words unsaid yet weigh heavy on my heart, I shall devote mine all to our task in Thavnair.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_075: I shall teleport the tried and trusted way. Good luck.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_KYTTE_000_080: Oh, you're back? Forgot something, I take it. Just give the word and I'll have you in Thavnair again before you can say “aether sickness”!
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_SYSTEM_000_090: You manage to will yourself to your feet, but given your condition, will you be able to reach Estinien in time...?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_095: Heh, no stopping...our champion... Now, quickly... Find Estinien...before he─ Hurrrk!
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_110: You there, I need three drinks. Something that helps with aether sickness.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_MERCHANT04368_000_1: B-By the Manusya, a traveler! Er, I mean...greetings! Greetings and welcome!
You are wise, good sir, to come to me! My special amra lassi, made with only the finest and freshest ingredients, is famed for calming unruly bellies!

By way of a warm welcome to Thavnair, I'm pleased to offer it to you for the low, low price of nineteen thousand and eight hundred gil! For not one, not two, but three bottles! A bargain amongst bargains!
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_SYSTEM_000_115: The price is highroad robbery, and you want to say as much to Estinien, but you realize any words of warning you cry out would be accompanied by your last meal...
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_SYSTEM_000_116: You must stand before Estinien and, using gestures, deny that the deal is fair.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_120: Nineteen thousand and eight hundred gil... That's a reasonable deal...isn't it?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_SYSTEM_000_121: You must stand before Estinien and, using gestures, deny that the deal is fair.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_122: Hm... Perhaps it's a bit expensive? Still, if it's special like he says...
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_SYSTEM_000_123: You must stand before Estinien and, using gestures, deny that the deal is fair.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_124: Hm? I thought you could barely stand. What do you need to tell me that's so urgent?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_125: ...Wait. I shouldn't buy the lassi. This merchant is swindling me.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_MERCHANT04368_000_1: S-Sincerest apologies, sir, but I appear to have my prices confused! It's actually one thousand eight hundred and ninety gil for the three bottles of lassi!
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_128: Hmph. That confusion would've been quite costly. For both of us. Very well, then─your coin.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_129: Here, a bottle for each of you. Take them to the others and get some rest.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_130: I'll be back after I've explored the town.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_135: “A teensy-weensy touch,” she says... Not even my hardest night's drinking comes close...
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_141: Praise...be to the Twelve... My stomach doth loosen its death grip...
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_142: My heartfelt thanks to thee and Estinien─and to the fine fruits of this land.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_145: Ne'er hath teleportation induced such terrible discomfort... 'Twas torturous in its intensity, and I would sooner swim a score malms...
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_150: You were...in time? Excellent... You've spared us Tataru's wrath...
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_151: Sweet...sweet release... If you haven't already, you should have yours too.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_152: Right, I'm ready to get on with it. That lassi truly worked wonders.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_153: Back on your feet, I see.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_155: Aye, I've bound it. 'Tis the most I could do against this heat short of shedding my armor.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_156: ...May I ask where you got the cord for it?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_157: A local vendor. The man said it's a Thavnairian weave─tough and not easily unraveled.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_ESTINIEN_000_159: Ninety-four hundred gil─a steal, I was told. 'Tis nothing fancy, but I've always valued function over form.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_160: That's...incredible. I daresay not even Alphinaud could hold a candle to you.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_A2_000_162: It's not uncommon for merchants to set their prices high, but doesn't it seem excessive here?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_A2_000_163: Are all Hannish merchants so unscrupulous?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_A2_000_164: I expected the Azure Dragoon to put up more of a fight.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_165: I am inclined to agree with thine assessment. It doth seem excessive─unusually so.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_166: One mustn't be too quick to paint a diverse people with a single brush. If such doth prove to be commonplace, I would presume it symptomatic of societal instability.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_167: ...On that subject, I shall refrain from making comment. Yet I cannot help but observe that the merchants seem overzealous in their pursuit of profit.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_168: Claiming Thavnair as its dominion, the nation of Radz-at-Han hath long thrived as a hub of commerce.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_169: In the beginning, there were the Arkasodara, a Matanga tribe indigenous to this island.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_170: Over time, they came to be joined by other races, and through their intermingling a culture rich and distinct did emerge.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_171: From alchemy to textiles, the products of Hannish culture have come to be celebrated and coveted the world over. A development only aided by the nation's prime location as a waypoint betwixt east and west.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_172: All of this hath combined to make a trading power of Radz-at-Han, yet such a status cannot be taken for granted. Nay, it must needs be maintained through judicious governance and stringent regulation.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_173: Neither of which I see any evidence, given that merchants at a gateway town are free to fleece hapless travelers and tarnish the reputation of the nation at large.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_174: Just so. That opportunistic pricing is rampant doth suggest that oversight is much weakened...or mayhap that the people have fallen upon hard times.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_URIANGER_000_175: Whatever the truth may be, 'twould be prudent to ascertain the current state of affairs.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_176: Prudent and practical, aye. We've naught to lose by learning more.
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_177: So, ere we seek out Krile's acquaintance, shall we see what information we can gather here in Yedlihmad?
TEXT_AKTKMA112_04368_THANCRED_000_178: Excellent. We didn't exactly get off to a flying start, but we'll make up for it.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_URIANGER_000_000: Be thou assured that I am quite recovered. Lassi is truly a boon for unruly stomachs.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_ESTINIEN_000_005: Is it truly so amusing to see my hair bound? 'Tis how I used to wear it. A functional fashion.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_ESTINIEN_000_006: Perhaps you were confused by how you found me following Nidhogg's demise. It had fallen loose after the chirurgeons removed me from my armor and put me to bed. I simply decided to leave it that way for a time, seeing as I would not don the Azure Dragoon's helm again.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_THANCRED_000_010: Right, let us split up and make inquiries in town. , the pier is yours.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_THANCRED_000_011: Once we have learned what we can, we regroup by the aetheryte...off-putting though the mere sight of it may be.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_SYSTEM_000_020: The crate is laden with fruits, but they are on the verge of spoiling, as if they have been left too long.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_SYSTEM_000_021: Gazing out from the pier, you spy boats moored off nearby isles, with the silhouettes of larger seafaring vessels farther away.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_SYSTEM_000_022: Compared to other ports you have visited in the past, there appears to be very little activity.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_QEFIRAZ_000_023: Well now, if it isn't a traveler... You're a rare sight in these unsettled times.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_QEFIRAZ_000_024: People have been giving us a wide berth since that accursed tower suddenly appeared on Narunnair.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_QEFIRAZ_000_025: If it just stood there and loomed ominously, perhaps things would be fine after a fashion, but no─it had to spawn fell fiends as well.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_QEFIRAZ_000_026: We still have our lives thanks to the Radiant Host, but business is as good as dead. What'll become of us, only the gods know...
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_QEFIRAZ_000_027: It's a shame not everyone's as brave as you. Or foolish.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_DJINALEEL_000_028: What am I doing? Oh, recording my sales. Still do it daily out of habit, though I don't know why I bother. Hardly sell anything these days.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_DJINALEEL_000_029: Business has never been this terrible...but I suppose things could be even worse. I could have a consortium to keep afloat, like Khalzahl.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_DJINALEEL_000_030: I don't envy his position. Better to be alone with my little operation, I've come to realize.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_DJINALEEL_000_031: You're a traveler, by the looks of you? If you have a moment, perhaps you could pay Khalzahl a visit. He'd be glad for tidings from abroad.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_DJINALEEL_000_032: Like as not, you'll find him at the Saltwind's Sails, the harbor guild building across the water from here.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_DJINALEEL_000_033: If times are tough for me, they must be a thousand times worse for Khalzahl. I can't help but worry for him.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_PORTMANAGER04368_00: And what do you expect me to do?
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_KHALZAHL_000_050: The Dalmascans aren't coming!? But we already have everything they ordered! What are we supposed to do with it?
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_PORTMANAGER04368_00: I don't know, but yelling at me isn't going to help. All I know is that their plans have changed, and that's that.
Look, you must have known this might happen. The Empire is at war with itself, and the provinces are in chaos.
And then there's the tower sitting on our doorstep spitting out monstrosities.
The city has its defenses, but we've been afforded no protection out here. We can't blame foreigners for not wanting to take the risk.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_KHALZAHL_000_055: Gah! But this will be an enormous loss!
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_KHALZAHL_000_056: All right, all right... Forget about the Dalmascans. Surely some ships are still coming?
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_KHALZAHL_000_057: We have fresh produce, handicrafts, medicines─all the perennial Hannish favorites.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_KHALZAHL_000_058: Our consortium works closely with merchants and artisans to supply only the finest wares. Quality is guaranteed!
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_PORTMANAGER04368_00: <sigh> I know all these things, Khalzahl, I do.
Which is why I regret to say I have nothing for you. All voyages have been canceled or indefinitely postponed.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_KHALZAHL_000_062: Wait, you're a foreigner, are you not? A merchant!? Please tell me you're a merchant!
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_KHALZAHL_000_064: I'm sorry, but we're discussing important matters. If you need something, please talk to one of the others.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_MATSYA_000_066: M-My name is Matsya, and I'm here to see Khalzahl...
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_MATSYA_000_067: Oh, it seems he's busy. I'll come back later, then...
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_KHALZAHL_000_070: If foreign vessels won't come to us, why not use our own to deliver the wares to them!?
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_PORTMANAGER04368_00: It's not so simple, Khalzahl. And besides, everyone is in the same boat. Everyone.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_MATSYA_000_081: Ah, I remember seeing you back in the guild. You wanted to speak with Khalzahl, too, did you?
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_MATSYA_000_082: I'm Matsya, a fisherman of Akyaali─a nearby village.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_MATSYA_000_083: I sell my catch to Khalzahl, who offers it to foreign merchants. But he hasn't bought anything for a while now.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_MATSYA_000_084: When I heard that the consortium had been struggling, I became worried and decided to come and see him.
TEXT_AKTKMA113_04369_MATSYA_000_085: ...Just as soon as he's free, anyway. He's a hardworking man, and I dare not disturb him.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_KHALZAHL_000_000: If foreign vessels won't come to us, why not use our own to deliver the wares to them!?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_PORTMANAGER04368_00: It's not so simple, Khalzahl. And besides, everyone is in the same boat. Everyone.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_010: Um...if I may ask, what is it that you do?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_011: An adventurer, you say! And you travel the world, helping people...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_012: Then...that must mean you're great at dealing with strangers! Please, won't you teach me to be like you?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_013: You see, I've brought some fresh fish with me─the portion I couldn't preserve─and I want to sell them.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_014: The problem is, I'm terrible with people. I've ever only dealt with Khalzahl, and I can't talk to customers without getting my trunk in a twist...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_015: So please...as silly as it might sound, will you not peddle the fish in my stead, and show me how it's done?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_016: If you're willing, please let me know, and we can begin at once!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_017: The events to follow cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_THANCRED_000_020: Folk here are rather...business-minded, for want of a better word, but at least they are welcoming of foreigners. In ordinary times, this harbor must overflow with visitors from all over the world.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_URIANGER_000_025: 'Tis a storehouse like any other, at first glance. Yet in contrast to its scale, there is a distinct lack of activity.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_ESTINIEN_000_030: Seeing as there's dried fish, I wondered if there might be dried squid as well...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_040: You'll do it, then? Show me how to deal with customers? I'm in your debt!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_041: Right, please try peddling my fish to...shall we say, three people here in Yedlihmad. I will observe you and learn!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_042: Matsya is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_043: You can leave Matsya behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_044: If you wish to have Matsya join you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_055: To travel to unfamiliar places and speak with unfamiliar peoples... Your conversational skills must be astounding!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_060: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Matsya?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_061: O-Oh, did you have other things you needed to do? In that case, I'll head back to the pier for now...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_065: Ah, you're back! Shall we continue where we left off, then?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_070: Matsya has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_081: You should have Matsya accompanying you before you attempt to sell the fish.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A2_000_087: Fish, fish! I got fish here! Fresh fish, straight from the sea's bosom to your mouth!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A2_000_088: Greetings, friend. How fare you of late?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_089: Er...I'm sure your bosom fish are very fresh, but this is rather sudden... I don't need any fish right now, so thanks but no thanks.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_090: You fail to make a sale...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_091: N-Never mind, it never goes well the first time. I'm sure you'll fare better with the next customer!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_092: Greetings to you too. <sigh> I suppose I'm well enough given the circumstance...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_093: Things have settled down somewhat, but it was utter chaos when that tower first appeared. Everyone grabbing whatever they could, trampling over each other to get to the city...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_094: Many remain there for now, but I could not stay away. Had to come back─continue with my life, such as it is.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_095: Whether or not it was the right choice...only time will tell.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A3_000_097: It's too risky out here. Maybe you ought to move to the city too.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A3_000_098: There's no place like home, but don't do anything dangerous, eh?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_099: Well, I make sure to keep well clear of the tower. And when more monsters emerge from it, I heed the Radiant Host's instructions.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_100: No place safer than the city, of course, but if everyone up and left, what would happen to Yedlihmad? Dangerous though it may be, I'll keep doing what I've always done, to the extent I can.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A4_000_102: I understand. Were it me, I'd probably carry on doing what I do best as well.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A4_000_103: All right. Best of luck to you, and stay safe.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_104: Oh, trust me, I don't. I make sure to keep well clear of the tower, and when more monsters emerge from it, I heed the Radiant Host's instructions.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_105: I hope they deal with it soon so we can get back to our normal lives. To the days when you could earn as much as you gave, and tuck into a meal satisfied that you did good work...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A5_000_107: Speaking of meals, why not have some fresh fish today?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A5_000_108: Those days will come again before you know it. Till then, stay safe!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_109: What do you do for a living, if you don't mind me asking?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_110: Well now, a fishmonger! Do you have your goods with you? If so, I'd like to buy some.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_111: Like me, you're doing your part to keep things normal. I respect that.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_112: Th-Thank you for your custom! The catch of the day is shallows cod─delectable stewed in coconut milk, or baked with a sprinkle of salt.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_113: You succeed in making a sale!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_114: You too, friend. And best of luck to us both.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_115: The conversation ends without a sale...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_116: N-Never mind. Sale or no, the way you established a rapport was very enlightening. Come, let's find another potential customer!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MEHRUNNAH_000_119: Heh, when you bait me like that, how can I not bite? Very well, give me some of your fish!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_120: Th-Thank you for your custom! The catch of the day is shallows cod─delectable stewed in coconut milk, or baked with a sprinkle of salt.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_121: You succeed in making a sale!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_130: That you should make a sale on the first attempt... I've learned a lot already, and I hope to learn more still!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_131: That was just the first person, so not to worry. We still have plenty of opportunities.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_145: A hawker, are you? Do you sell fruit, by chance?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_146: If so, I want to buy some amra. Let's say a dozen. They don't need to be export quality.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A6_000_148: Amra shmamra! My fresh fish is the only thing you need!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A6_000_149: What do you need so many amra for?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_150: Um...no? As I said, it's amra that I want. If I wanted fish, I would've asked for it!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_151: You fail to make a sale...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_152: Oh well... If it's not what they want, then there's no point forcing it. Let's move on to the north side of town, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_153: Why, for eating, of course! It may seem like a lot, but of late, I go through that much in no time at all.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_154: I am a stocktaker by trade, but with no vessels coming these days, the wares are beginning to pile up.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_155: By the same token, nothing is coming in from overseas. But not a day goes by that someone doesn't come asking when the next shipment is arriving for this and that and this and that...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_156: All of it wears me down, and I find myself feeling constantly hungry...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A7_000_158: Are you sure you're actually hungry?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_160: You know, when I think on it, I'm not so sure...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_161: Rather than hungry, perhaps I've been feeling...unfulfilled? And I try to fill the void by gorging on food I like.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_165: Thank you. A pity you don't sell fruit, but I enjoyed our little chat! It took my mind off my troubles for a moment.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_166: The conversation ends without a sale...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_167: N-Never mind. If nothing else, you left her with a positive impression. Let's move on to the north side of town, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_168: Heh, I'll try not to, thank you. Perhaps it's for the best you don't sell fruit. Still, I enjoyed our chat. It took my mind off my troubles for a moment.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_169: The conversation ends without a sale...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_170: N-Never mind. If nothing else, you left her with a positive impression. Let's move on to the north side of town, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_171: Fish? I do like fish, as a matter of fact. Why do you ask?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_172: Oh, so you're a fishmonger! Apologies for the misunderstanding!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_173: Hmm... Seeing as you're here, do you happen to have Akyaali sardine? They're perfect in a spicy soup.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_174: We certainly do, madam! And if you like it spicy, I also recommend them pickled in oil with a generous amount of chilies.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_NASHREEN_000_175: Oh, that does sound like a wonderful challenge! I didn't have fish in mind at first, but I daresay I'll enjoy these. Thank you!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_176: You succeed in making a sale!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_180: We're doing great so far... Dare I hope that we can make it three of three?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_181: Not a bad result so far... Let's see if we can finish on a high note!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_182: Don't lose heart yet. We'll sell something to the next person, I'm sure of it!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_195: What is it? If you don't mind, I'm rather busy.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_197: Aether sickness? No, no, nothing so unusual. In my hurry to get back to work, I just ate a little too quickly...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A9_000_199: Some fresh fish will settle your stomach, and mine are the freshest of all!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A9_000_200: You should take it easier─eat more slowly and savor your food.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_201: Ugh, food is the last thing I need right now... Go and sell your fish to someone else!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_202: You fail to make a sale...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_203: N-Never mind, we just approached him at a bad time─and timing is everything, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_204: Thank you so much for your demonstration─it was a truly eye-opening experience. Come, let us return to the pier.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_205: Would that I could, but I can't afford to be idle. Like as not, circumstances will surely get worse before they get better.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_206: And so I'm working as hard as I can while I still can, the better to be prepared.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A10_000_208: What an industrious young man you are!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A10_000_209: How do you intend to prepare?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_210: W-Well, it's not like I'm trying to impress anyone...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_211: Now, if you'll excuse me, I must be getting back to work. Take care.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_212: The conversation ends without a sale...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_213: T-Too bad we couldn't make a sale, but we did manage to build something of a relationship...?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_214: Thank you so much for your demonstration─it was a truly eye-opening experience. Come, let us return to the pier.
