TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_215: By stockpiling supplies. For that, I need to earn coin so I can buy food, medicine, what have you.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A11_000_217: How about some fish for your supplies? They're fresh caught!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_A11_000_218: Do we have anything suitable, Matsya?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_219: Aye, well, fish wouldn't be bad, but I don't want to go through the hassle of preserving them myself. I'd rather buy stuff that's ready to store.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_220: So I'm afraid I'll have to pass on your fish. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must be getting back to work.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_221: The conversation ends without a sale...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_222: T-Too bad we couldn't make a sale, but we did manage to build something of a relationship...?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_223: Thank you so much for your demonstration─it was a truly eye-opening experience. Come, let us return to the pier.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_224: Oh, er...we do have some dried products too─Thavnairian cucumber and puff-paya fish.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_225: They're the last of the batch, so if you're interested, you can have them for a discount.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_BHAZAHMA_000_226: Truly!? By all means, I'll take them all!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_SYSTEM_000_227: You succeed in making a sale!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_228: Heh heh, you remembered what I told you earlier─that I preserve what I catch. Which serves to show the importance of being attentive!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_229: Thank you so much for your demonstration─it was a truly eye-opening experience. Come, let us return to the pier.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_240: Come, let us return to the pier. I wish to thank you properly for your kind help.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_250: Th-Thank you so much for showing me how to talk to customers.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_251: You managed to sell to everyone you approached. Any merchant in Radz-at-Han would be envious of your success!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_252: Watching you at work was truly inspiring! By applying the lessons I've learned, I hope to one day peddle as well as you!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_253: You managed to sell to two of the three people you approached. Adventurers do indeed have great conversational skills!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_254: Watching you at work was very enlightening. By applying the lessons I've learned, I hope to one day peddle as well as you!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_255: You managed to sell to one of the three people you approached. It was difficult, but when you put your mind to it, you succeeded.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_256: Though you did fail too...but there are lessons to be learned in both success and failure! By applying yours, I'll endeavor to become a better peddler.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_257: Though you didn't manage to sell any fish in the end...but the way you fearlessly approached strangers gave me much courage!
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_258: When I peddle my wares, I'll remember your example and endeavor to be fearless too.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_259: Still...there's only so much I can do alone. I hope that things will return to normal for Khalzahl soon...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_KHALZAHL_000_260: I thought I heard a familiar voice, and who should it be but Matsya...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_261: Khalzahl! H-Have you finished your business at the guild?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_KHALZAHL_000_263: Forgive me... Try as I might, I can't find any buyers.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_KHALZAHL_000_264: With no ships coming in and hardly any going out, there simply aren't any options. At this rate...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_265: So...you can't buy my fish anymore?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_KHALZAHL_000_266: I'm sorry, Matsya. I truly am. But for now, you must peddle your own goods.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_KHALZAHL_000_268: I want to help you, I do. But as it stands, I can barely help myself.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_KHALZAHL_000_269: I've poured my all into the consortium, and I'll be damned if I let it fall apart. I've friends and families depending on me, and I can't─I won't─fail them. The Sisters as my witness.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_271: N-Not to worry. Using what I've learned from you, I'm sure I'll manage...somehow.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_MATSYA_000_272: Well, I had best return to my village. My thanks again, and please take care on the road.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_URIANGER_000_280: Mayhap owing to the island's small size, the tower's impact upon the people's lives doth appear more pronounced here than in Eorzea.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_ESTINIEN_000_285: There you are. Gotten over the aether sickness, have you?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_THANCRED_000_290: I see you've been busy. Managed to learn a tidbit or two, I trust?
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_THANCRED_000_291: I see... We also heard that the tower is affecting many locals' livelihoods, but to think that it would be to such an extent...
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_THANCRED_000_292: For another notable─if not wholly unexpected─discovery, disappearances and kidnappings are disturbingly commonplace.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_THANCRED_000_293: As before, the culprits are almost certainly tempered imperial soldiers.
TEXT_AKTKMA114_04370_THANCRED_000_294: And as before, they mean to use the faith of their hapless thralls to call forth a lunar primal. Business as usual for the Telophoroi.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_000: Helping a struggling fisherman you've only just met to peddle his catch... Yes, you would do something like that.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_005: Mayhap owing to the island's small size, the tower's impact upon the people's lives doth appear more pronounced here than in Eorzea.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_ESTINIEN_000_010: That Matsya fellow you were helping─he's Arkasodara, is he not?
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_ESTINIEN_000_011: Apparently, 'tis almost exclusively his people that are being kidnapped. Should he be traveling alone?
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_012: If summoning is this perpetrator's aim, it doth stand to reason that Arkasodara would be their primary targets.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_013: For 'tis the faith of their ancestors which prevaileth in this land, and many are devout adherents still.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_014: We'd better go after him. Akyaali lies to the west, as I recall─the same direction as Krile's acquaintance, incidentally.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_ESTINIEN_000_015: It's settled, then. Keep your eyes peeled while we make for the village.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_SYSTEM_000_020: You do not see Matsya nearby, but the elevated ground up ahead may provide a better vantage point...
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_SYSTEM_000_030: You do not see Matsya from here either...
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_031: (-???-)N-No! Leave me alone! Help! Somebody, help!
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_SYSTEM_000_032: Matsya's voice─and it came from the north!
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_050: H-Huh? Where did they go? Why are you here...?
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_051: I see you found him in time.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_052: Y-You and your friends came to look for me? I don't know how to thank you...
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_053: On my way home, I took a moment to stop and rest. Think about what to do about, well...everything.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_055: Kidnappers. We'd heard that the Arkasodara were being targeted.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_056: Surely you have as well? Perhaps it's best if you took refuge in the city.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_057: We've considered it, me and the others. But fishing is all we know─the ocean all we have.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_058: I see... That's your decision to make, but you should take care not to travel alone.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_060: 'Tis our understanding that strange fiends have emerged from the tower. What canst thou tell us of these beings?
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_061: Not much, I'm afraid. I have no idea what they are.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_062: But I've heard that some bear an unsettling resemblance to our divinities.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_063: For that reason, some have taken to calling the tower “Zot”...
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_064: "House of divinities“ in the old tongue, it means.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_065: But they're not true divinities. They're monstrous imitations that bring only death!
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_066: To have one's faith so twisted is a grievous indignity, and full justified art thou in thine outrage.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_067: Know that 'tis for no other purpose but to neutralize the tower that we have journeyed to this land.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_068: In time we may be forced to contend with these false gods, and thus we would learn all we may about them. Wilt thou not tell us of thy divinities and their true nature?
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_069: You've come all this way to save us...? Really!? To think I had you peddling fish...
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_070: But to answer your question─yes, of course! We would gladly tell you about our gods. “We,” I say, because I'm a terrible storyteller, and I'd ask my fellow villagers to do it.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_071: So please come to our village. We're good, gods-fearing folk, all of us, and we'd be honored to share our knowledge. And fish!
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_072: What sayest thou? Shall we pay visit to Akyaali?
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_073: Wonderful! Just follow the road west and down the hill─you can't miss it!
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_074: So, 'tis the simulacra of Thavnairian gods that are being summoned... If any doubt existed before, there can be none now: the kidnapped Hannish are imprisoned in the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_075: I pray that we will be able to save them...
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_076: Though indeed, saving them will mean confronting their false gods, like as not. Aye, as you said, we'd do well to study their religious traditions. To Akyaali.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_080: A charming little village. Shame about the hideous tower.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_085: Familiar though I am with the myths and legends of this island, to hear them spoken by heirs to this storied heritage giveth them new life.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_ESTINIEN_000_090: Mark you that platform out on the water. Some manner of shrine, perhaps?
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_100: Welcome to Akyaali, my friend! The name means “white beach,” and there isn't much here save that...but please make yourself at home.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_101: Your companions have already begun talking to everyone. Feel free to show yourself around and do the same.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_102: Any one of us can tell you about our gods, but you could do worse than to start with Khanga and old Hasveydah. They're free at the moment, as it happens.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_110: I'll try to think if there is anything useful I can share with you as well. After all, I still owe you for rescuing me on the hill!
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_KHANGA_000_120: Hm? You wish to know about our gods? What a curious visitor you are. Most want fish. In any case, I'm happy to oblige.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_KHANGA_000_121: Now, I don't know how it is whence you hail, but our isle is home to many gods.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_KHANGA_000_122: They can be divided into two groups: the Manusya, beings of wisdom who assume the form of men; and the Mrga, beings of might who assume the form of beasts.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_KHANGA_000_123: Together They are divinities─Their forms and personalities many and varied.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_KHANGA_000_124: Some are kind and gentle, others stern and temperamental─just like we mortals can be.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_KHANGA_000_125: All are possessed of great insight and experience, and by heeding Their teachings, we strive to be better people and live better lives.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_KHANGA_000_126: Different though They may be, both the Manusya and the Mrga are equally divine and equally revered.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_HASVEYDAH_000_127: Interested in learning about our gods, you say? Heh, that's what I like to hear! Prick up your ears, then, and listen.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_HASVEYDAH_000_128: In ancient times, the Manusya and the Mrga─deities who look like men and beasts, respectively─were locked in conflict.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_HASVEYDAH_000_129: Eventually, seeking the wisdom of the Manusya, the Mrga cast aside Their own heads and took up those of Their foes.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_HASVEYDAH_000_130: Likewise, the Manusya coveted the might of the Mrga, and so They too resolved to trade heads.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_HASVEYDAH_000_131: Thus were born new gods possessed of both might and wisdom, and They ushered in an age of harmony between the two factions.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_HASVEYDAH_000_132: From then on, as a sign of Their esteem for one another, the Manusya have worn animal faces, and the Mrga the limbs of men.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_HASVEYDAH_000_133: We honor the Manusya and the Mrga by incorporating Their sacred images into works both practical and artistic. Try looking out for them, eh?
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_140: There you are. Learned a thing or two about our gods, I trust?
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_141: While you were off talking to the others, I remembered something that may be of interest.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_142: If you could let your friends know, I'll go and fetch it from my home at once.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_143: Apologies for the wait. I wished to show you this hanging scroll which depicts three of our most revered deities.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_144: By all means, we should like to see it.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_145: They are Manusya─you heard about Them already, yes? Three sisters.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_146: The center one is the eldest. Cinduruva, a goddess of wisdom. For this, alchemists hold Her in the highest.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_147: To Her right is the middle sister, Sanduruva. As a goddess of wealth, She counts many traders among Her followers.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_148: And on the left is Minduruva, the youngest sibling. She presides over the crafts, and so is beloved by weavers.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_149: Although each is worshipped for different reasons, the sisters are usually portrayed together in these works, which people keep in their homes for good fortune.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_URIANGER_000_150: In like fashion to the Manusya, the deities of Eorzea preside over myriad aspects of life. And what of the Mrga, if I may ask?
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_151: The Mrga hold power over nature. In ages past, They were revered as guardian deities in times of conflict.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_152: If you have occasion to visit our temples and ruins, you'll find Their images there.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_153: Among them is a god who possesses a gaja's head, and He is venerated as the progenitor of the Arkasodara.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_154: And then there are dragons. They occupy a special place in our history.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_156: It's said that an ancestor of the satrap─that's the ruler of Radz-at-Han─forged a covenant with a dragon divinity in ancient times.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_157: This divinity has since acted as the guardian deity of the satrap. Legend holds that, if ever the satrap is in need, his dragon ally will fly to his aid!
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_159: You claimed to be a terrible storyteller, but nothing could be further from the truth.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_160: The passion you bear for your faith is plain to hear. I am confident that the information you've given us will serve us well in our efforts to deal with the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_MATSYA_000_161: That is very kind of you to say. Thank you! I will pray for your success.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_162: Right, I believe it's time we sought out Krile's acquaintance.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_163: An alchemist by the name of Nidhana.
TEXT_AKTKMA115_04371_THANCRED_000_164: According to Krile's notes, we're to find her at a place called the Great Work, further north along the coast.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_MATSYA_000_000: D-Did you say you're going to see Nidhana!? Oh, how I envy you!
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_MATSYA_000_001: She's brilliant and beautiful, kind and understanding...and did I say she's beautiful?
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_MATSYA_000_002: <sigh> I could stare at her dainty ears and adorable trunk all day... And those eyes! When you meet her, take care you don't drown in them!
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_MATSYA_000_010: The Great Work is situated at a cove to the north. Follow the road north to reach it.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_URIANGER_000_020: In such manner did we find them... What could have befallen these people?
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_ESTINIEN_000_025: If there was a battle, there's a conspicuous lack of blood.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_THANCRED_000_030: Oh, for the days when I enjoyed such fervent adoration. But on this occasion I am glad to entrust the burden of popularity to Estinien.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_URIANGER_000_035: 'Tis said that shellfish is ideal for those who have suffered blood loss. Mayhap we should have acquired some from Matsya...
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_VARSHAHN_000_040: Pray pay me no mind. I am here that I may be of service. Nothing more.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_050: Allow me to thank you for answering our call. Many towers have appeared around the world, and we are grateful that you would assist us with ours.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_THANCRED_000_051: Though Krile herself is tied up with another investigation,  is an eminently capable substitute, and we will spare no effort to aid you.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_THANCRED_000_052: So, if I understand correctly, you seek to make talismans that can nullify aetheric emissions.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_053: Indeed we do. As you know, the tower emits vast concentrations of aether; one cannot go anywhere near it without being tempered.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_054: As such, we can only study the tower from afar, and are powerless to deal with it in any consequential way.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_055: In order to strike back, the satrap bade us alchemists create enchanted talismans. Talismans that will allow our soldiers to venture into the tower, even should they lack innate protection.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_URIANGER_000_056: Could such a thing be possible?
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_057: Admittedly, we are still in the midst of testing, but we are quite confident.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_058: Even prior to this, our people have long pursued countermeasures against the aetheric corruption of primals.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_059: Of the methods tested to date, those utilizing dragon scales proved the most promising.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_060: Owing to their aetheric density, the scales are highly resistant to disruptive forces. The mightier the dragon, the greater the resistance.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_061: We seek to amplify this protective property through our alchemy.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_062: Thanks to the scales provided by His Excellency, we have been able to make steady progress with the talisman.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_063: Soon we will be ready to conduct a field test...and here is where you and your blessing of Light come in.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_A1_000_065: Whatever it is, just leave it to me!
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_A1_000_066: What exactly is it that you need me to do?
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_A1_000_067: Better than having my blood drawn, I suppose...
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_068: Thank you! Lest you wonder, we ask only that you serve as an escort.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_069: Nothing complicated, I assure you. We ask only that you serve as an escort.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_070: Ahaha, perhaps so! And knowing my colleagues, they won't be satisfied with blood alone...
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_071: But as for your task, we ask only that you serve as an escort.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_072: I will explain in greater detail later, but you will be venturing into the tower's field of influence.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_073: And so, for your own safety, I would first test how well your blessing shields you. With your permission, of course.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_THANCRED_000_074: In that case, Urianger and I will find other ways to make ourselves useful. Seeing as you all work to the point of collapse, I suspect you could do with more hands.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_075: We would be grateful for any assistance you can provide!
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_076: If you are ready, then let us put your blessing to the proof.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_077: If you exit the Great Work and turn south, there will be a hill to the right. I will meet you at the top after seeing to some preparations.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_VARSHAHN_000_080: Good luck with the test. I shall remain here to assist the other alchemists.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_SYSTEM_000_085: You see a lantern designed in the local style.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_090: I hope you didn't have trouble finding this place─or climbing the hill. Not all are accustomed to the physical strain.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_091: I give you the fruit of our sweat, tears, and many a sleepless night: the drunken deepa!
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_092: A deepa is a lantern presented to the gods as an offering. Taking inspiration from the tradition, we created this device to test the talisman's efficacy.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_093: Upon activation, it will move a certain distance before emitting a powerful blast of aether.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_094: In lieu of corruption, those lacking sufficient protection will experience severe aether sickness.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_095: For your test, you will be exposed four times. That should be enough to ascertain your blessing's protective capability.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_096: Please begin whenever you're ready. I shall be observing from a safe distance.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_100: To reduce the risk of accidental exposure, the drunken deepa will emit a blast only after it has moved a certain distance. Follow it closely and bathe in the aether four times!
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_LANTERN04372_000_11: Commencing aetheric exposure testing. Repeat: commencing aetheric exposure testing. Retreat to a safe distance if you are not the subject.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_SYSTEM_000_111: Follow the drunken deepa's lead and try not to fall behind.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_SYSTEM_000_112: You are struck by a powerful blast of aether, but suffer no ill effects.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_LANTERN04372_000_12: Subject has no irrepressible urge to empty their stomach? Confirmed─resuming test. Please follow.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_SYSTEM_000_121: You are struck by another powerful blast of aether, but suffer no ill effects.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_LANTERN04372_000_13: Subject stomach and bowel integrity holding? Confirmed─resuming test. Please follow.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_SYSTEM_000_131: You are struck by yet another powerful blast of aether, but suffer no ill effects. The blessing of Light appears to be keeping you safe from harm...
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_LANTERN04372_000_14: Subject fortitude rated...impressive! No irregularities...confirmed. Resuming test. Please follow and brace for final discharge.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_SYSTEM_000_141: You are struck by the strongest blast of aether yet, but survive completely unscathed!
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_LANTERN04372_000_14: Aetheric exposure testing concluded. Please collect and deliver me to the supervising alchemist.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_LANTERN04372_000_15: Congratulations on retaining your composure and your humours.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_160: Ah, you've returned─and not on your knees. A promising sign! But come, let me take the deepa off your hands.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_161: Thank you! I shall replenish its aether for when we test the talisman.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_162: So, no dizziness or nausea or anything of the sort? You're feeling perfectly fine?
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_163: Then the strength of your blessing is beyond doubt. There is no risk that the tower will corrupt your aether.
TEXT_AKTKMA116_04372_NIDHANA_000_164: With this, we can request your aid for the task ahead with easy hearts.
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_000: Hmm... You are a capable warrior too, are you not? Would you be amenable to assisting me with another errand?
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_001: You see, our talisman requires the use of a special ink, but we have exhausted our stores of a key ingredient for it─spiritweed.
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_002: The herb grows not far from here, and I would like to go and harvest some. With the recent spate of kidnappings, however, we Arkasodara travel alone at our peril.
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_003: Will you not come with me as my escort? I would compensate you for your troubles, of course.
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_004: I'm in your debt! Without further ado, let us head to Kadjaya's Footsteps. It is situated on the road which runs east of the Great Work.
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_010: I-I may simply be imagining it, but I feel as though we're being followed...
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_020: Gods, but that gave me a fright... To think that the moment I ventured outside the safety of the Work...
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_021: Thank the Sisters I asked you to come with me. You're all right, I hope?
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_022: Good, good. Let's continue on, then. It isn't far now─just through these pillars and up the rise.
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_031: Kadjaya was a great dancer, and those who follow in her─well, you know─they come to this place to train and dedicate their dance to their ancestors.
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_032: A happy benefit of this is that spiritweed grows here in abundance. I will set about harvesting at once, if you would be so good as to stand guard.
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_033: The kidnappers aren't like to return soon, but better safe than sorry.
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_040: I'll gather the herb as quickly as I can. Please stand guard for me.
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_050: I have enough spiritweed to last us a good while. Thank you for keeping watch!
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_051: Let us head back to the Great Work, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_060: , my thanks again for your assistance. With your help, we're that little bit closer to completing our talisman!
TEXT_AKTKMA117_04373_NIDHANA_000_061: This isn't much, but please accept it as a token of my gratitude.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NIDHANA_000_000: If you will excuse me, I shall return to my work on the talisman.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_001: Ah, you are both back. Excellent.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_002: I have a message for you, Mistress Nidhana.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_003: It would seem the stores of giantsgall are running low.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NIDHANA_000_004: What? But when last I looked, there was still plenty...
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_005: I suspect that was before Urianger told everyone about their tempering cure, and Estinien shared his knowledge of dragons. Your peers have since been inspired to fashion a number of new talisman prototypes.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NIDHANA_000_006: I see... Well, if it leads to new possibilities, then far be it from me to complain, but we will need to replenish our stores...
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_007: I should be happy to tend to this if you like.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NIDHANA_000_008: As much as I appreciate the offer, my dear boy, I can't in good conscience send you out there alone while kidnappers are at large.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NIDHANA_000_009: ─loath though I am to press another task on you so soon, might I ask you to fetch the giantsgall?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NIDHANA_000_010: In case you're not familiar, giantsgall is a type of ore found on the island. Owing to its hardness and aetherial conductivity, it has applications in many disciplines─alchemy not least of all.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NIDHANA_000_011: The quarry where it is found, aptly named Giantsgall Grounds, isn't far away, so it shouldn't take much of your time. May we impose on you once more?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NIDHANA_000_012: Thank you! Upon arriving at the grounds, please seek out a man named Zeynuha. He will furnish you with the ore.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_013: At the very least, permit me to accompany you. It so happens I have an errand of my own that will take me to the outpost nearby.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_014: May we borrow a pair of hamsa, Mistress Nidhana?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NIDHANA_000_015: By all means. Do try to be patient with them─those that survived are still in training.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_016: I will bring the hamsa to the entrance. Meet me there when you are ready.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NIDHANA_000_020: Despite his tender years, Varshahn is thoughtful and dependable. It's easy to see why he was chosen to be the satrap's attendant!
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_030: Here are our hamsa, . If the creatures look familiar, it is because they are close kin to your Eorzean dodos.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_031: Hamsa have long been kept as livestock in Thavnair, and many a hatchery may be found here. Alas, the largest of these was recently razed by monsters from the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_032: On account of said hatchery being situated near the tower, the Radiant Host repurposed its remnants as an outpost.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_033: That is where my errand takes me, and your own destination is but a stone's throw away.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_034: If you have no objections, let us first make for the outpost. We set forth at your word.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_040: You are ready? Then let us depart. You need only ride and relax─my bird and I will take the lead for yours to follow.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_Q1_000_041: Mount the hamsa and travel to the outpost?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_042: Let us be off. If you haven't ridden dodos before, be warned that they have a wobbling gait.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_043: That spectacular formation stretching out over the water is called Khadga─a word which means “sword.”
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_044: This sword, legend holds, was wielded by the Manusya against the Mrga before it was cast down at conflict's end.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_045: To the left and requiring no introduction is the tower. As you can see, it straddles a small isle.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_046: Almost there. Though the main part of the hatchery is atop the cliff, the outpost itself is on the beach.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_047: And here we are. Manned by the Radiant Host, this outpost is our first line of defense against the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_048: Well, well, who should it be but young Varshahn. On an errand for the satrap?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_049: I am. His Excellency bade me come to collect your report.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_050: He also wished to express his heartfelt gratitude to the brave men and women of the Radiant Host for their unflagging dedication.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_051: We simply do our duty, but we are honored to receive His Excellency's regard.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_052: And yet, for his boundless benevolence, his treatment of one so young could be regarded as...callous.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_053: Though we have enjoyed relative peace and calm these past few days, this remains the front line of battle. No place for children.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_054: Your predecessor too often traveled alone. It's been, what, two years now since you took over? I wonder how the fellow is faring...
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_055: Like those before him, he went on to represent the satrap in foreign lands. Wherever he may now be, I am certain he is well.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_056: As for myself, I assure you that all I do, I do of my own volition, and gladly. I pray you do not think ill of His Excellency.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_057: Certainly not, lad... Whatever happens, my faith in the satrap is unwavering. But still I worry for you.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_058: We would be overcome with sadness if something were to befall you, for you are as a little brother to us all. Take care, do you hear?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_060: And who might this be? Not Hannish by the look of .
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_061: Permit me to introduce , of the Eorzean contingent, come to assist in the making of the talisman.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_062: From Eorzea, you say! Towers have appeared over there too, yes? Tell me, what is the situation like?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_063: May I suggest that you exchange information with our soldiers? Both parties would stand to learn something of value, I believe.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_064: An excellent idea. Given the unprecedented nature of the threat, some of ours are understandably anxious. We would be glad for any tidings you can share.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_065: You two, bring Varshahn the latest report, and answer any questions he may have.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_070: All appears quiet with the tower at the moment. I daresay the soldiers won't mind if you approached them.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_BREEDINGSTAFF04374_: The last monster that came out of the tower laid waste to the hatchery, slaughtering many good hamsa. The poor creatures didn't deserve it...
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_SYSTEM_000_080: This is the fellow that carried you hither. Its breathing is somewhat ragged, perhaps due to its inexperience as a mount.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_090: It occurs to me I have yet to properly introduce our company.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_091: We are the Radiant Host, a military order under the satrap's command. Our duty is to preserve peace in the land, be it patrolling the streets or dealing with heretofore unknown threats such as now.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_092: We train hard, and admit only capable warriors to our ranks. Even so, we've struggled to contend with the fiends from the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_093: Though we succeeded in striking them down on the two occasions they came in force, we had to pay a heavy price.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_094: What of the towers in Eorzea? Do they likewise spawn monsters?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_095: So it's much the same everywhere... With every nation struggling, we cannot expect calls for outside aid to be answered.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_NAHBDEEN_000_096: My thanks not only for the information, but for accompanying Varshahn besides. While he's wise beyond his years, he's still a child, and we couldn't bear to see him come to harm.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_KHUTEEYU_000_097: You wish to know about the tower? To be honest, we know little and less about it ourselves.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_KHUTEEYU_000_098: This “Tower of Zot,” as folk have taken to calling it, suddenly appeared where it did on the isle of Narunnair.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_KHUTEEYU_000_099: We're safe from its influence at this distance, but go too far into the water, and you'll expose yourself to its corrupting aether.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_KHUTEEYU_000_100: You're a foreigner, aren't you? How are they dealing with the tower in your homeland?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_KHUTEEYU_000_101: Our struggles are not unique... Then our hopes still lie with the talismans. We must keep the monsters contained until they're ready.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_KHUTEEYU_000_102: When the tower first appeared, we sent scouts on a boat to investigate. But it quickly became apparent that something was amiss.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_KHUTEEYU_000_103: One after another our comrades were corrupted. We could only look on in horror as they slew each other...
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_IMHUDI_000_104: Ah, I've heard about you. The visitor from Eorzea. Is there anything you can tell us about the Telophoroi?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_IMHUDI_000_105: We know that they're the ones behind the tower, and that they've declared war on the whole world.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_IMHUDI_000_106: But why are they doing this? What is it that they want? This, we don't understand.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_IMHUDI_000_107: ...What? They want to die...and take everyone with them!? What madness is this!?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_IMHUDI_000_108: Well, you can bet that we won't let those bastards have their way! We'll fight them with everything we have, like our Eorzean and Far Eastern brothers!
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_IMHUDI_000_109: Grrr, those demented fools... If they want to go to hell, they can bloody well arrange their own passage, and leave the rest of us out of it!
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_120: Finished speaking with the soldiers, have you? I hope it was as enlightening for you as it was for them.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_121: As a neutral nation and trading hub both, Radz-at-Han ordinarily receives a steady stream of news from abroad. Alas, this stream dried up when trading vessels stopped coming.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_122: Amidst the dearth of information, everyone will have been grateful for your account.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_123: ...But come, you had best see to your original errand. As mine will keep me here awhile longer, however, I'm afraid I cannot guide you the rest of the way.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_124: Worry not, the path is straightforward─you need but follow the road east. Upon the hamsa, you will arrive before you know it.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_125: Brief though it was, I enjoyed our time together. Till we meet again.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_VARSHAHN_000_130: Lest you have forgotten, to get to the Giantsgall Grounds, you need but follow the road east. The hamsa should deliver you there quite quickly.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_SYSTEM_000_140: Though the hamsa appears to want to return home, it reluctantly offers you its back.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_SYSTEM_100_140: Should you become separated from your steed, speak with the Radiant beastkeeper at the Hamsa Hatchery to mount it again.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_BREEDINGSTAFF04374_: If you're looking for your hamsa, it returned here by itself a while ago. You still have need of it?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_SYSTEM_000_160: No sooner do you arrive at your destination than the hamsa dashes off...
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_SYSTEM_000_165: Speak with the Radiant beastkeeper at the Hamsa Hatchery to mount the hamsa, then ride it to the Giantsgall Grounds.
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_ZEYNUHA_000_170: Aye, this is indeed the Giantsgall Grounds, and I am Zeynuha. Is there something you require?
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_ZEYNUHA_000_171: Giantsgall for the alchemists, you say? But of course they shall have it!
TEXT_AKTKMA118_04374_ZEYNUHA_000_172: They labor tirelessly to deal with the tower, and 'tis the least we can do to provide them with the materials they need.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_ZEYNUHA_000_000: Here you are─a sack of the purest giantsgall. We always set some aside for our alchemist friends.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_ZEYNUHA_000_001: When you deliver it, let the good folk of the Great Work know that we're grateful for their efforts. If they need more, they need but ask.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_ZEYNUHA_000_010: Payment? You needn't worry─the satrap will see us compensated. But even if he did not, we wouldn't hesitate to provide what we can. We're in this fight together, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_NIDHANA_000_020: Ah, welcome back, . Dare I hope you have the giantsgall?
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_NIDHANA_000_021: Oh my, such fine specimens! Thank you so much for bringing these!
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_NIDHANA_000_022: We now have everything we need to make our next prototype─one that should be capable of passing our most rigorous tests.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_NIDHANA_000_023: When it is ready, it will be time for the true test, so please take your ease while you can!
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_THANCRED_000_030: Nothing unusual so far. Don't worry about us─think only of your own task.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_URIANGER_000_035: The warding scale doth promise to alter the course of conflict. Yet even as it giveth us cause to rejoice, we must needs brace ourselves for the Telophoroi's response.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_ESTINIEN_000_040: What of that boy... Varshahn, was it?
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_ESTINIEN_000_041:
Running this and that errand for the satrap, you say...
...Hm? Why do I ask? 'Tis nothing. Curiosity.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_RADIANTHOST04375_00: The satrap has granted you the use of this boat. May it serve you well!
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_NIDHANA_000_050: This is a rather finer boat than I had expected, but I won't complain.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_NIDHANA_000_051: All that remains is to board and be on our way. Oh, and if I should become corrupted, do not stay your hand. Of course I pray it does not come to that, but you must protect yourself.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_NIDHANA_000_052: Other alchemists can fulfill my role, but you and your blessing are one of a kind...and perhaps our only hope for toppling this tower. For all our sakes, do not hesitate to do what must be done. Whatever that may be.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_NIDHANA_000_053: ...Well, the longer I draw this out, the more nervous I become. Let's be off!
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_Q1_000_056: Head to the Tower of Zot with Nidhana?
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_RADIANTHOST04375_00: Ah, you are returned! But...where is Mistress Nidhana?
Manusya preserve... Just when we had succeeded in making the talisman...
I-I must report this at once! Meanwhile, please return to the Great Work!
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_ESTINIEN_000_075: Hm... Bad tidings, I take it.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_THANCRED_000_080: ...Something's gone awry, hasn't it? What happened?
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_THANCRED_000_081: So it was Fandaniel after all... Damn that bastard!
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_THANCRED_000_082: I'm sure you wanted to do more...but you were right to return here first.
TEXT_AKTKMA119_04375_THANCRED_000_083: We must tread warily lest we endanger Nidhana and the other captives.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_ESTINIEN_000_005: Hm... Bad tidings, I take it.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_010: First, we must inform everyone of the situation, Nidhana's colleagues included.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_011: I'll call them together for a gathering...but I think it would be best if you were the one to explain.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREAT: Though Nidhana is trapped in the tower, she's still alive, yes?
Then we must make warding scales. As many as we can.
The prototype works perfectly. This, Nidhana proved at peril to herself.
So let us make more scales, that she and all those who were taken might be saved!
Aye! As alchemists, this is how we will help win the fight!
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_020: My friends, the satrap has been made aware of the tragedy.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_021: He offers his heartfelt condolences, and reiterates his pledge to provide you with all that you require. To that end, he bade me give you this linkpearl, that he might personally discuss the production of the warding scales with you.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_022: And for our Eorzean visitors, I bear an invitation.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_023: In her report, Mistress Nidhana noted your vital contributions to the talisman's creation.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_024: This fact came to the satrap's attention, and in recognition of your deeds, he wishes to meet you.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_025: In addition to thanking you in person, he would also discuss further avenues of collaboration.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_026: And so, if it is agreeable, will you not accompany me to Radz-at-Han for an audience with His Excellency?
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_027: We should be honored, of course. Closer cooperation between our lands can only be to the benefit of all.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_028: Then it is settled. Please come to the gates east of the Giantsgall Grounds, and I will show you into the city.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_030: Of the satrap, I only know the common tidbits. That though the position is hereditary, he is not considered a sovereign. And that, despite possessing considerable authority, he wields it sparingly.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_031: Given the esteem in which the locals hold him, however, it's safe to assume he's good at his job. We could do far worse for an ally.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_URIANGER_000_035: Be it here or in Eorzea, all share in the desire to deliver the captives. Thus united, I pray that we may join in common cause with the satrap.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_ESTINIEN_000_040: When last I visited, the city was brimming with life. I expect the tower has dampened the mood somewhat.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_050: All present? Then let us proceed.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_051: Owing to the threat of the tower, the city is currently in a state of high alert, and strict restrictions are in place for entry.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_VARSHAHN_000_052: Though you have been granted special permission, I ask that you remain close to me at all times.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_URIANGER_000_060: That we should encounter one of the first brood in such a circumstance...
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_ESTINIEN_000_065: If our course of action is decided, let's not tarry.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_070: That meeting took a rather unexpected turn, but we now have a clear objective ahead of us.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_071: Let us rejoin our comrades in Sharlayan, and muster a suitable crew for our foray into the Tower of Zot.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_072: Oh, and if you haven't already done so, be sure to attune to the aetheryte here before departing. Unless of course you enjoy violent nausea...
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_080: Just as I was getting used to balmy Thavnair, we're back in chilly Sharlayan... Take care not to catch your death, eh? We need you for the battles to come.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_081: Now then, everyone appears to be here, so let us take stock of all the developments and discoveries.
TEXT_AKTKMA120_04376_THANCRED_000_082: Now then, your investigation here remains, but when that's over, we can take stock of all of the developments and discoveries.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_KRILE_000_000: Since there has been progress in both investigations, shall we share the findings from our respective locales?
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_NAHBDEEN_000_010: Ah, our friend of Eorzea, we've been expecting you! You and yours will lead the mission into the tower, I'm told.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_NAHBDEEN_000_011: The warding scales will be delivered soon. Till then, please stand by at the boat we have readied.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_NAHBDEEN_000_012: When your fellows arrive, I will direct them to join you. We pray for your safety and success!
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_NAHBDEEN_000_020: If the satrap trusts you and yours to lead the mission, then you must be formidable warriors indeed.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_NAHBDEEN_000_021: Glad are we to count you as allies!
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ALISAIE_000_030: Unnngh... If this is the future of aetheryte travel, I think I'll stick to boats...
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Aye... No warning, however emphatic, could have prepared me for that...
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_GRAHATIA_000_032: On account of which we are a little late, but fighting fit! Mostly.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_VARSHAHN_000_033: My friends, permit me to thank you for accepting this mission.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_KRILE_000_034: You must be...hm... We should still call you Varshahn, I suppose?
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_VARSHAHN_000_035: Indeed. It would not do to confuse our soldiers.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_KRILE_000_037: For our part, we are humbled that you should see fit to entrust us with your warding scales. Please convey as much to His Excellency.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_VARSHAHN_000_038: One for each of you. Please accept them with my blessings.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_THANCRED_000_039: Our thanks. With these, we can go anywhere those with the blessing of Light can go.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_THANCRED_000_040: Not only for this operation either, but all the ones to come. We can finally break your monopoly on primals.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_A1_000_042: I've been waiting for this day!
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_A1_000_043: I wouldn't mind carrying on as before, you know.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_A1_000_044: In that case, they're all yours from now on.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_THANCRED_000_045: So have we, my friend. So have we.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_THANCRED_000_046: Hah, spoken like our champion. Rest assured we'll ever have need of you, though we will do what we can to lighten your burden.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_THANCRED_000_047: Ah, but I'm afraid we can't let you retire just yet. You're the Scions' brightest star, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_YSHTOLA_000_048: If everyone is amenable to it, let us review the strategy for good measure.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_YSHTOLA_000_049: As previously agreed, we will divide into two groups.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_YSHTOLA_000_050: and  band will break through the tower's defenses and locate its core.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_YSHTOLA_000_051: Meanwhile, the rest of us will tend to the prisoners, who will doubtless want for healing due to the duress of repeated summonings.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_URIANGER_000_052: The primals which the tower bringeth forth shall be deities of Thavnairian myth.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_URIANGER_000_053: As we have no prior experience with such foes, pray exercise the utmost caution when confronting them.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ALPHINAUD_000_054: We commence the operation at your word, my friend.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ALPHINAUD_000_055: For the people of Thavnair─nay, the entire world─we must prevail!
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_A2_000_062: Form a party and enter the Tower of Zot.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ALPHINAUD_000_070: I may have taken up new arms, but my role is unchanged. I am a healer, through and through.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Yet in knowing who once wore this sage's mantle, I wonder... When all is said and done, will I look back on the battles I chose to fight with pride?
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ALISAIE_000_075: My warding scale is safely tucked away. I'm ready when you are, .
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ALISAIE_000_076: I may not be the Azure Dragoon, former or otherwise, but I guarantee that I'll give as good as I get!
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_THANCRED_000_080: With Y'shtola keeping them company, the other party will be able to hold their own against the enemy if needs be.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_THANCRED_000_081: So we can tackle our own task without worrying over them. Come, let us be about it!
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ESTINIEN_000_085: First this armor, blessed with Ratatoskr's power, and now Vrtra's scale... Much has changed for dragons to show me such favor.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ESTINIEN_000_086: And with Nidhogg with me, in spirit and in hand, no obstacle will bar our way.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_URIANGER_000_090: Aside from primals, within the tower we shall for a certainty encounter enthralled imperial soldiers.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_URIANGER_000_091: Defenders conveyed hither by means unknown, who will stop at nothing to hinder our efforts...
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_YSHTOLA_000_095: Lest you worry, I've not forgotten my healing spells.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_YSHTOLA_000_096: Be it restoration or destruction, this sorceress can command whatever magicks the situation requires.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_GRAHATIA_000_100: Though our parties are separate, I will trust in you─as I know you will trust in me.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_GRAHATIA_000_101: Let us both give it our all, and add another rousing chapter to the saga!
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_KRILE_000_105: This is the closest I've ever been to one of the towers. Such a sinister aura it exudes...
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_KRILE_000_106: It's been a while since last I took to the field, and I can't help but feel nervous. But with everyone at my side, I'm sure all will be well!
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_VARSHAHN_000_110: The Radiant Host and I will be watching from the outpost, ready to act at the first sign of unusual activity.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_VARSHAHN_000_111: May the scales serve you well, and protect you in lieu of Vrtra's fangs and claws.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_CINDURUVA_000_120: No matter the cost, we must protect the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_ESTINIEN_000_130: Whew... Carrying all those Matanga may have been the true struggle...
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_THANCRED_000_140: The liberated prisoners are being transported to Radz-at-Han for treatment.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_THANCRED_000_141: Alisaie and Y'shtola will oversee the administration of the tempering treatment, with support from those who know a healing spell or two.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_THANCRED_000_142: We'll go and join them in the city once you've had a moment to catch your breath.
TEXT_AKTKMA121_04377_SYSTEM_000_143: You may now enter the Tower of Zot with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_000: Whew... Carrying all those Matanga may have been the true struggle...
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_THANCRED_000_010: Had enough rest, have you? You never were one for being idle. Right─Varshahn bade us come to Meghaduta at our earliest convenience.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_THANCRED_000_011: The others will join us there once they have finished tending to the prisoners.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_THANCRED_000_012: Ah, wait. On second thought, you and Estinien should go on ahead. I need to make a quick detour by the Great Work.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_THANCRED_000_013: We left G'raha in the alchemists' care, you see. Best to fetch him before he's crammed into a specimen jar.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_014: Just you and me, then. The guardsman at the gate should wave us through.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_THANCRED_000_020: When we delivered G'raha to the alchemists, they were not a little excited.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_THANCRED_000_021: Perhaps it was Nidhana's rescue that brought them joy, but given their fascination with Estinien, I'm not quite sure...
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_025: With the tower gone, I expect that the state of alert will be lifted.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_RADIANTHOSTGATEKEEP: Ah, honored Scions! You are free to enter at your leisure!
As I cannot leave my post, I'm afraid you must make your own way.
Should you require directions in the city, the sentry stationed at the fountain atop the steps should be glad to assist you.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_040: Though I have been to Radz-at-Han before, this place is a veritable maze.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_041: Rather than risk getting lost, we had best ask for directions from this sentry at the fountain.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_042: Lead the way...and don't expect me to act as your tour guide like certain others.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_SYSTEM_000_043: Estinien is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_SYSTEM_000_044: You can leave Estinien behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_SYSTEM_000_045: If you wish to have Estinien accompany you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_055: First, we should seek out the sentry in front of the fountain.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_056: ...Name of the fountain? No idea. Do fountains normally have names?
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_Q2_000_060: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Estinien?
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_061: Lost your way, I take it. Hardly surprising in this maze of a city. Best return to where we started.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_065: Found your bearings, have you? Then let's get going to Meghaduta.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_SYSTEM_000_070: Estinien has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ALZADAALSPATHGUARD0: Ah,  , I presume. I understand you are here for an audience with the satrap. If you require directions to Meghaduta, I should be glad to provide them.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_SYSTEM_000_081: You should have Estinien accompanying you before receiving directions.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ALZADAALSPATHGUARD0: Ah,  , I presume. I understand you are here for an audience with the satrap. If you require directions to Meghaduta, I should be glad to provide them.
The satrap's residence is situated in Dharma, the highest part of Radz-at-Han.

To get there, I would ordinarily recommend a route that takes you by the bazaars in the city's north. Due to the state of alert, however, most businesses are currently closed, and the aetheryte disabled.
As such, I will provide you with an alternate path. First, please ascend the steps next to this fountain, then continue left.
There will be more steps, and upon ascending them, you will emerge on Paksa's Path.
Proceed through the large door on the right, and you will arrive at Ruveydah Fibers. Within you will find another sentry who will give you further guidance.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_091: In other words, we head up. Sounds straightforward enough.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ALZADAALSPATHGUARD0: You wish to hear the directions again? But of course. To get to Meghaduta, first ascend the steps next to this fountain, then continue left.
There will be more steps, and upon ascending them, you will emerge on Paksa's Path.
Proceed through the large door on the right, and you will arrive at Ruveydah Fibers. Within you will find another sentry who will give you further guidance.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_115: You heard the sentry. We head up.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_120: Ah yes, I know about this portal. It leads to a nearby isle. The treasure vault of one of Radz-at-Han's wealthiest families.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_121: They took the god of luck for their guardian, on account of which they occasionally open up a section of their vaults. For aspiring treasure hunters to try their own “luck”, or so they say.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_122: There are also coffers hidden across the land that act as portals. Find one, and you gain access to the vault.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_123: Something to bear in mind in case you exhaust your funds while on the road. 'Tis a troublesome experience, as I can personally attest.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_RUVEYDAHFIBRESGUARD: Heading to Meghaduta, are you? In that case...
Heading to Meghaduta, are you? In that case, please follow this hallway to my right and go through the door at the top of the stairs.
You'll emerge at the entrance to the airship landing, where another sentry should be on hand to assist you.
Incidentally, if you ascend the steps to either side of me, you'll find the workshops of Ruveydah Fibers. Though you're free to observe the artisans, take care not to lose your way.
If you are heading to Meghaduta, please follow this hallway to my right and go through the door at the top of the stairs.
You'll emerge at the entrance to the airship landing, where another sentry should be on hand to assist you.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_155: Quite an ordeal to get to the satrap's residence... It could stand to be a more obvious route, like the one to the Vault or Kugane Castle.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_160: Ah, Thavnairian weave. Hard to imagine more vibrant stuff. I daresay Aymeric would be partial to the gold thread. And the blue, of course. He loves his blue.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_161: I've never put much thought into what I wear. A spare set of clothing is usually all I carry, and if that isn't enough, I can always obtain something locally.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_LANDINGGUARD04378_0: If you are here for an airship, I'm afraid all flights have been suspended until further notice.
If you are here for an airship, I'm afraid all flights have been suspended until further notice.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_176: So the state of alert is still in effect. Perhaps it's for the best.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_177: That aside, we're not here for an airship─we have business at Meghaduta.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_LANDINGGUARD04378_0: Oh, in that case, permit me to direct you!
From here it's quite simple, really. Ascend these steps, and then continue straight ahead and across the bridge. You cannot miss it.
To get to Meghaduta, simply ascend these steps, and then continue straight ahead and across the bridge. You cannot miss it.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_195: Confusing as it is, you'd think they intended to make a maze out of Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_196: Kugane was flat, at least. If you became lost, you could head to higher ground to get the lay of the land.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_200: Ah, I remember passing by here with Varshahn. The situation being as it was, he regretted not being able to show us the sights.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_201: Life has yet to return to normal here, but when it does, you ought to pay another visit.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_202: Though the city is confusing, the food is quite good. I'm partial to hamsa myself─the meat's surprisingly tender and flavorful.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_MEGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_0: Greetings and welcome to Meghaduta. May I inquire after your business?
Greetings and welcome to Meghaduta. May I inquire after your business?
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ESTINIEN_000_216: We are members of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, come at the invitation of His Excellency.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_MEGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_0: Ah, of course. We have been expecting you.
I will show you into the audience chamber, if you would please follow me.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ALPHINAUD_000_220: Our apologies again. I hope we didn't force you to conclude your conversation prematurely.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ALISAIE_000_230: So, what were you and Vrtra talking about?
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ALISAIE_000_231: ...Nothing? Very well, if you say so.
TEXT_AKTKMA122_04378_ALISAIE_000_232: The others have gone ahead to the High Crucible. Let's catch up to them.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALISAIE_000_000: Like his sister Tiamat, Vrtra is possessed of a gentle soul. I'm glad they're on our side.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALPHINAUD_000_010: The attendant was kind enough to give me directions to the High Crucible. First, let us return to the mulberry orchard.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I understand the mulberries are for the silkworms. Grown a stone's throw away from the satrap's residence... It gives it the quintessential Thavnairian flair, don't you think?
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALISAIE_000_030: From here, we're supposed to follow the path left and past the mulberries...
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALPHINAUD_000_040: The word Yuj apparently means “bind” in the local tongue, and this district is so named because it connects all others in the city.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALPHINAUD_000_041: If we manage to come this far, we shouldn't have trouble finding the High Crucible─or so I was told.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALISAIE_000_050: Where the street turns, enter the door straight ahead then descend the steps...
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALISAIE_000_051: I thought the Crystarium was confusing, but it doesn't compare to Radz-at-Han. The architecture and decorations make it even harder to get your bearings.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALISAIE_000_052: Anyway, let's see where this door takes us.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALISAIE_000_060: Whew, it seems we're on the right track.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALPHINAUD_000_070: And here is the aetheryte plaza. So far so good, and there isn't much further to go.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALPHINAUD_000_071: From here, we just need to cross to the other side of the hall, then pass through the larger of two doorways. The High Crucible lies beyond.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALPHINAUD_000_072: I suspect the others have already collected the warding scales. Come, let us join them.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_THANCRED_000_080: You took your time. Got turned around, I take it?
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_URIANGER_000_085: Though this land hath been afforded a respite, in turmoil do many others languish still. Our work is far from finished.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALPHINAUD_000_090: What an immense laboratory... How many such places were enlisted to help forge the warding scales, I wonder.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_YSHTOLA_000_095: Excellent. You're in time to hear the latest good news.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_KRILE_000_100: The Students have previously turned to Radz-at-Han's alchemists for help with the analysis of various artifacts.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_KRILE_000_101: That is how I became acquainted with Nidhana. I'm glad we could rescue her, and pray she makes a full recovery...
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_GRAHATIA_000_105: I'm quite well now, I assure you. As they say, the stronger the taste─and stranger the color─the more effective the remedy.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_GRAHATIA_000_106: With my body trying to replenish the aether I spent, however, I'm feeling rather famished...
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_GRAHATIA_000_107: I think a sampling of the local delicacies is in order. Hamsa cuisine would be a good place to start, perhaps?
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ESTINIEN_000_110: As I heard it, after you defeated Nidhogg, his scales found their way into the hands of the Firmament's artisans.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ESTINIEN_000_111: Steeped in power as they are, it's no surprise that they were coveted. Still, it is a strange legacy for the vengeful wyrm.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_ALISAIE_000_120: We're last, of course, but at least we found the place.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_NIDHANA_000_130: The last thing I remember before being absorbed into the tower was you rushing towards me...
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_NIDHANA_000_131: I can only imagine the hardships you and yours must have had to overcome to rescue us.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_NIDHANA_000_132: No amount of words will suffice to express my gratitude, but I hope the flower's radiant glow says everything I cannot.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_KRILE_000_140: It's good to be back, and with the fruit of our labors safely in storage!
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_KRILE_000_141: For now, we have but to wait for the others to return from their respective meetings with the Alliance leaders.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_KRILE_000_142: As Thancred suggested, you should get some rest in the meantime!
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_KRILE_000_150: Your chamber is comfortable, I hope? If it's cold in there, just let me know─we have plenty of blankets to spare.
TEXT_AKTKMA123_04379_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_1: Welcome back, ! Krile has apprised me of your recent accomplishments. What an amazing feat to eliminate a tower, and pave the way to deal with the rest.

While it isn't much, I've changed your sheets and plumped up your pillow. After all, there's nothing like collapsing in a nice clean bed after completing a major malmstone, be it penning a thesis or defeating deiform entities!
So, would you like to take a look at your new and improved lodgings now?
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_GRAHATIA_000_000: I hope you didn't mind us barging into your room for our late-night feast. For what it's worth, it did me a world of good to put our troubles to one side, if only for a moment.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_010: Oh, there you are! Feeling refreshed, I hope?
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_011: I was about to make my way to the Studium, as it happens.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_012: I wanted to try and speak with Scholarch Montichaigne and thank him for coming to our rescue in the Rostra.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_013: As it turns out, he'd come here to see us following the hearing, only to find that we'd already departed for Thavnair. Knowing him, he was probably hoping to chew the cud with his former students.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_014: Since we're still waiting for Y'shtola and the others, I thought now the perfect time to pay him a visit. Care to join me?
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_015: Then it's settled! The twins will be coming too, assuming Alphinaud can tear himself away from his new toys. I'll let you rally the troops while I go on ahead to Phenomenon.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_GRAHATIA_000_016: Considering my recent impropriety, perhaps I should avoid showing my face around the Studium for a time...
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_017: That might be for the best. If the others should return, tell them we will not be long.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_GRAHATIA_000_020: Unlike some of the Scions, I am not an alumni of the Studium. As such, I have no acquaintances there I am obliged to visit.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_GRAHATIA_000_021: And while I would love nothing more than to pore over the many great tomes of Phenomenon, I fear my presence there would stir up more unwanted trouble...so! For now, I will be patient. Much as it pains me to do so.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALPHINAUD_000_025: If Father can master these fiendish contraptions, then so can I!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_031: The scholarch himself was here? In that case, what are we waiting for?
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALPHINAUD_000_032: I too am eager to see him, though I somewhat dread the thought of visiting the Studium. I daresay our notoriety precedes us...
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_033: ...Alphinaud of all people worrying over his reputation. And at our alma mater, no less! Will wonders never cease.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_034: You'll understand soon enough. Off we go!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALPHINAUD_000_040: It feels like only yesterday that I first walked through these doors...
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_045: See that sculpted pitcher above the entrance? That's the mark of Thaliak, the Scholar. Bearer of the waters of knowledge. It's no exaggeration to say that Sharlayan itself is one enormous shrine to Him, and that's especially noticeable here in the Studium.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_050: Here it is: Phenomenon. While I expect you made note of it before─one can hardly miss it─this is the first time you've been here on official business, correct?
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_051: While most of the space is taken up by the expansive auditoriums, it also houses numerous laboratories, testing grounds for experimental magicks, and a host of administrative offices and so forth.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALPHINAUD_000_052: As the center of what would later become the Studium, it was established to promote the study of aetherological phenomena, hence the name.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Though with aether being a fundamental aspect of nature, its scope expanded to include every conceivable facet of life and even the universe itself.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALPHINAUD_000_054: And then, in the four hundred and thirty-second year of the Sixth Astral Era, Phenomenon was decreed complete and the Studium officially opened as a place of learning.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALPHINAUD_000_055: With a long and storied history, it is without question the world's leading authority in aetherology, the arcane, the occult, astromancy, and countless other fields, standing proud as─
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_057: You always did enjoy giving the grand tour to new students!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_058: Indeed, I've long since lost track of how many times he has recited that same foppish speech. Such is his undying love for his old stamping ground.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_059: He was in top form back then. Youngest to enter the Studium, graduated with highest honors in magical arts and aetherology, undisputed champion of the debating chamber...
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_060: Hold on. You both joined the Studium at the same age, yes? And from where I stand, you're equally prodigious scholars.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_061: Nice of you to say, but Alphinaud actually entered half a year before me. Nor did I do well enough to graduate with honors. And I am certainly not the Studium's most notorious master debater.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_062: In all respects have I ever been in his shadow. If nothing else, just remember that this was where the legend of Alphinaud Leveilleur began.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_063: We should expect everyone to be fully aware of our recent escapades. Hopefully, we'll be somewhat more welcome here than we were at the Last Stand.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_064: I know better than anyone the adoration the student body has for Alphinaud, and with a bit of luck, it might work to our advantage.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_065: Well, there's no time like the present.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_066: First things first, let's look for Scholarch Montichaigne. Other faculty tend to frequent their offices, but unfortunately for us, he's fond of wandering wheresoever his whims take him...
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_067: Let's split up and ask the students if they've seen him!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALPHINAUD_000_070: I assure you, I'll tell you all about it after my business with the scholarch has concluded!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_STUDENTA04380_000_0: (-Overzealous Student-)The scholarch!? Tell me, my good fellow, does this have something to do with saving the world from catastrophe?
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_STUDENTB04380_000_0: (-Solemn Student-)Might we turn our attention to Master Leveilleur's graduation thesis? I, too, have my doubts regarding our policy of nonintervention...
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_STUDENTC04380_000_0: (-Bright-eyed Student-)Is it true that your experiences overseas are the reason you have incurred the ire of the Forum? Oh, what I wouldn't give to see you butt heads with those old codgers!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_075: Things were bad enough during our school days, and Alphinaud's time abroad has only heightened his fame. Or should that be infamy?
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_076: He had his rivals and detractors, of course. Though most of them gave that up after his adoring fans set upon them like ravenous dogs.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_ALISAIE_000_077: Alphinaud, on the other hand, never paid them much notice. They were simply beneath him...
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_KRILE_000_080: Unsurprisingly, the scholarch is not in his office. I did, however, speak with one student who saw him not long ago, so he can't have gone far.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_STUDENTD04380_000_0: Th-That was Alphinaud Leveilleur, wasn't it? The Alphinaud Leveilleur!
And he's with his sister and Master Baldesion's granddaughter! This can only mean one thing─an event of epoch-shattering proportions is fast approaching! Spread the word!
Oh, sorry, you said you're looking for the scholarch, yes? Knowing him, he could be anywhere, but Miss Aliapoh should have a better idea.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_STUDENTD04380_000_1: What could warrant the sudden return of so many esteemed alumni? Is there truth to the rumors...? I must get to the bottom of this!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_110: Are you lost? Wander in off the street, perhaps?
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_111: Wait, don't tell me... You're a trainee gleaner fresh off the guildship! I'm right, aren't I?
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_112: Oh, how silly of me, an orientation is in order. Ahem! Allow me to bid you a warm welcome to Searchers' Meet!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_113: Let me start with a question: what is the most important thing you'll find in the Studium?
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_114: That's right─books! And what's the second most important? Why, that's simple... Everything else!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_115: That's what we deal in here at Searchers' Meet. Whenever the students or tutors find themselves in need of equipment or materials, they come to us. If we don't have it in our stores, we send the gleaners off to find it.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_116: Honestly, you wouldn't believe some of the requests we get. Eye of paissa this, tongue of gigantoad that...it's enough to make your hair stand on end! Which is possibly what some of our students are trying to accomplish, this being a school of magic and all.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_117: As our newest gleaner, you'll have your work cut out for you, but I think you'll find it quite rewarding!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_A1_000_119: The only thing I'm interested in gleaning is information on the scholarch's whereabouts.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_A1_000_120: I've tracked down many miscellaneous knickknacks in my time, but I'm no gleaner...
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_121: I beg your pudding? You're not a gleaner? Then this...was all an elaborate ruse!? No, wait─come to think of it, you never actually claimed to be one in the first place. My mistake!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_122: So what you're telling me is...you're not a gleaner? Yes, that's exactly what you said, isn't it... And you're looking for a scholarch? I'm afraid we don't have any of those in stock, but I can─ Ohhh, you mean him!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_123: He was here, but...now he's not. I did speak with him shortly before you arrived, though. He said he was on his way to Makers' Meet.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_124: Go back the way you came in, and you'll see it on the opposite side of the entrance. It's a laboratory of sorts, home to many rare and expensive curios...not to mention alarmingly frequent accidents. If you lose your way, just follow the bloodcurdling screams.
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_QIHALIAPOH_000_125: Ha! In the time it's taken me to tell you all of this, the scholarch has probably already left! Best of luck finding him─ I've a feeling you'll need it!
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_STUDENTE04380_000_1: Yes, the scholarch was here a short while ago. He offered me advice on my current research project.
Though we spoke at length, I don't recall him mentioning where he was planning to go next. When we parted ways, he went down the corridor. Perhaps to one of the auditoriums?
It's strange seeing Makers' Meet so empty. People usually treat it like a common room...
TEXT_AKTKMB101_04380_SYSTEM_000_160: You have been granted the run of Phenomenon. If you are game, Qih Aliapoh would put your artisanry to good use.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_000: While Scholarch Montichaigne is best known for his role as head of the Studium, he is said to be one of the finest mages Sharlayan has ever produced.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Having seen for myself the ease with which he weaves extraordinarily complex and powerful magicks, I have no reason to doubt the claim.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALISAIE_000_005: Some of my earliest memories are of Scholarch Montichaigne, actually. He was a close friend of our grandfather.
