TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALISAIE_000_006: He would come for tea and amaze us with his tricks, much like his demonstration with the paper and ink. He's a huge part of why I wanted to enter the Studium in the first place.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_010: Well, that's given me much to mull over. I feel as though we're one step closer to understanding the Forum's true motives...and the mysteries of life itself, for good measure.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_011: It's funny─ I came here with the intent of expressing my gratitude, only to leave more indebted than before. I've a feeling his friendship and support will be a great boon to us in days to come.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_012: And on that note, let's head back to the annex. Perhaps on the way, you could better acquaint yourself with Qih Aliapoh as the scholarch suggested, while I share our findings with Raha.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Estinien returned not long after we'd departed for the Studium. A shame that he missed the chance to attend our lecture with the scholarch... Or perhaps not.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALISAIE_000_025: You'd better not let your guard down around Qih. One small favor becomes another, then another, and before you know it, you'll be running to the other side of the world in search of a bottle of wine or some other rubbish.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALISAIE_000_026: Then again, it might make for a welcome change of pace from your usual heroics, and as the scholarch said, it could also lead to interesting discoveries.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_030: It seems I've done an adequate job of relaying Scholarch Montichaigne's lecture to Raha. Given his experiences in the field of souls and memories, he had no trouble understanding it.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ESTINIEN_000_035: Having spent most of the time in Thavnair, I've yet to fully grasp the lie of the land here in Sharlayan. Even finding my way to the annex proved a challenge.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_GRAHATIA_000_040: Ah, welcome back. From what I hear, your trip to the Studium proved most educational.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_GRAHATIA_000_041: While you were away, I received word from our fellow Scions.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_GRAHATIA_000_042: As expected, news of the warding scales was met with much joy. Preparations are now underway to bring the leadership of the Grand Company of Eorzea and the Eastern alliance together to determine a way forward.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_GRAHATIA_000_043: Our friends have asked that we bring the scales in our possession to Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALISAIE_000_044: So the time has come for us to go on the offensive?
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_GRAHATIA_000_045: It's too early to say for certain, but that does seem to be the way the winds are blowing.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_GRAHATIA_000_046: I, for one, can think of no reason to oppose such a plan, but let us see what awaits us in Vylbrand.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_047: Let's start by getting the scales out of storage. Give me a hand would you, Estinien?
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_048: Phew... I didn't realize these crates were so heavy.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_049: I shouldn't complain, though. Vrtra and the alchemists of the Great Work put their heart and soul into each and every one of these scales, so you must treat them with the utmost care.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALISAIE_000_050: Are you not coming with us?
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_051: As much as I would like to escape the Forum's watchful gaze, I've little choice but to stay behind.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_052: We're already on thin ice, and if I─in my capacity as our official representative─were found to be consorting with foreign powers... Well, you can imagine how that would go.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_053: I shall remain here, and do my utmost to avoid ruffling any more feathers as I await word from Master Matoya and our other allies.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_054: With luck, we'll soon have good news of our own to share.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_055: The tide is about to turn─ I can feel it. To Limsa Lominsa!
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KRILE_000_060: If you learn aught of interest, be sure to let me know! In the meantime, I will do what I can to aid our cause, though I fear that will be precious little given the circumstances.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ZANTHAEL_000_065: Ah, I was told to expect you. As you may or may not be aware, the Admiral is at present entertaining the Elder Seedseer and the sultana.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ZANTHAEL_000_066: Three of the most powerful women in the world in one room... Do you need a moment to prepare, or shall I show you to them?
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_070: My apologies for calling you away from Sharlayan at such short notice.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_071: On the contrary, we are honored and grateful. And pleasantly surprised to be joined by such esteemed company.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KANESENNA_000_072: 'Twas only right that this discussion be conducted in person.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KANESENNA_000_073: We are locked in a war of attrition. Our forces struggle to contain the threat posed by the towers, and it is only a matter of time before we are overwhelmed.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KANESENNA_000_074: Victory will only be claimed through decisive action, and we have taken the initiative to set the wheels in motion.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_075: It is reassuring to learn we are all in accord...
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_076: ...But might I ask what your plan entails?
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_NANAMOULNAMO_000_07: It hinges entirely on the warding scales and our ability to utilize their potential to the fullest.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_078: During your time in Sharlayan, the allied nations have been engaged on separate fronts, with no end in sight.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_079: To make matters worse, a surge in abductions of kobolds, Sahagin, Ixal, and Ananta have given rise to an increasing number of primals as well.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_080: But your triumph in Radz-at-Han has given us cause to hope once more.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_NANAMOULNAMO_000_08: The time has come to free ourselves of this menace.
And it is you, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, who have shown us the way!
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KANESENNA_000_083: While the bulk of our forces will continue to hold the Telophoroi at bay, we will dispatch our finest to strike at the enemy's heart: Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KANESENNA_000_084: These brave few will be the Ilsabard contingent.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_085: To think such progress has been made in so short a span!
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_087: The first is to provide aid to the people of Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_NANAMOULNAMO_000_08: As previously reported, countless imperial soldiers and civilians have been tempered. Robbed of their free will, they serve the Telophoroi's every whim without question.
They too are victims. It is our duty to deliver them from their suffering, not for strategic or political gain, but because it is the right thing to do.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_NANAMOULNAMO_000_09: I do not ask that we set aside the decades of conflict and conquest─that we simply choose to forgive and forget.
I ask only that in choosing to remember we do not also forsake our compassion and morality, for without that, there can be no reconciliation. Only death without end.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_092: Aye, on that we can all agree. Our second objective is the colossal tower that Thancred and Urianger observed in the capital.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_093: Though its purpose remains unclear, there's reason to believe the smaller spires are merely a precursor of what's yet to come.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_094: Until the Tower of Zot was toppled, we'd failed to make any headway─though the same could be said of the Telophoroi. They're certainly in no rush to press further into our lands.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_095: I'd wager the spires' primary purpose is to divide and keep us occupied...while they work towards our annihilation.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KANESENNA_000_096: This would appear to be substantiated by Y'shtola's analysis of the towers' influence on aetherial currents.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KANESENNA_000_097: Based on her observations inside the Tower of Zot, the spires siphon aether from the land, consuming it to maintain their form. However, they draw forth far more than is required for this task alone.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KANESENNA_000_098: The excess of aether remains unaccounted for, but we can be sure it is not being harnessed for our benefit.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_099: It wouldn't surprise me in the least if it was being redirected to the larger spire in the capital. There's a logic in that. Regardless, once we have uncovered the truth...
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_100: ...We'll bring their schemes crashing down, along with their infernal towers.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ESTINIEN_000_102: But what would you have us do? I assume it's more than handing over the scales and being on our way.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_103: We want you and your scales to join the Ilsabard contingent.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_104: Consider it an official request, from both the Grand Company of Eorzea and the Eastern alliance. Do you accept?
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALISAIE_000_105: Perhaps you should be the one to answer that...
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_110: Couldn't have put it better myself.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KANESENNA_000_111: Y'shtola, Thancred, and Urianger have already pledged their support, and are on their way to meet the rest of the contingent.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_KANESENNA_000_112: They were positive you would come to the same decision as they did. Luckily for all involved, their prediction was correct.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_NANAMOULNAMO_000_11: Once you have delivered the warding scales to Ala Mhigo, the contingent will embark on its journey to Ilsabard.
Raubahn and Lord Aymeric are overseeing preparations, so I suggest you make yourselves known upon arrival.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_115: Pack warm clothing─furs and the like. Without it, the cold will do you in before the Telophoroi so much as draw steel. As for us, we'll keep the enemy busy while you're gone. They're not the only ones who can create a diversion.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MERLWYB_000_116: Now go, safe in the knowledge Eorzea will be as you left it─or better─upon your return.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ZANTHAEL_000_120: Though we are used to attending to dignitaries, it is rare to receive so many at once.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ZANTHAEL_000_121: Oh, and did you recognize the sultana's shield? None other than Jenlyns Straightblade, captain of the Sultansworn.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ZANTHAEL_000_122: Nowhere near as imposing and impressive as Storm Marshal Slafyrsyn, but I nevertheless sense there's more to him than meets the eye...
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_125: I'll admit, this is all rather daunting, though not quite in the way I was expecting...
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_126: We'll be standing shoulder to shoulder with our alliance's finest. The best of the best. The Warrior of Light, and...well, me.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_127: It's silly, I know. Perhaps this is my way of distracting myself from the part I should be worried about...marching into Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALISAIE_000_130: You know, I'm quite looking forward to seeing who's been selected for the Ilsabard contingent. I've a few people in mind. Care to make a friendly wager?
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_GRAHATIA_000_135: I must quiz Thancred and Urianger on the conditions we can expect in Garlemald. I know it's cold, but how cold? Will I need to keep my ears covered? They can be a bit sensitive at times...
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ESTINIEN_000_140: If Aymeric asks after me, say I'm getting on fine and leave it at that. Don't you dare breathe a word about the cord.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_AYMERIC_000_145: Ah, fancy meeting you here. I trust our mutual friend is settling into life as a Scion?
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_AYMERIC_000_146: Collaboration never was his forte. The moment the fighting ended, off he'd go, like a gaelicat swept up in a strong breeze.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_AYMERIC_000_147: But rest assured, he will always be there when you need him. Probably.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_RAUBAHN_000_150: Ah, the wanderers return! You've been busy, bringing down a tower and producing the keys to destroying the rest of them.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_RAUBAHN_000_151: You should be proud. Those warding scales of yours are what's made this whole venture possible.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ALPHINAUD_000_152: Will you and Lord Aymeric be leading the contingent?
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_AYMERIC_000_153: Regrettably, no. Our role is to organize the various delegations into a cohesive unit. Once we have seen you all off, it's back to our respective posts.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_AYMERIC_000_154: We dare not neglect our duties for too long lest our defensive efforts fall into disarray.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_AYMERIC_000_155: And just between us, there was a fair amount of opposition to the formation of the Ilsabard contingent. The very suggestion that we send out some of our finest troops behind enemy lines to render aid unto the Garleans has made me rather unpopular in certain quarters...
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_AYMERIC_000_157: Sadly not, though I do my best. Truth be told, I'd much rather be at your side, charging into the fray. Alas, I've battles of my own to fight, where words may serve me better than any blade.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_RAUBAHN_000_158: I hate to say it, but Lord Aymeric's struggles mirror my own.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_RAUBAHN_000_159: For the time being, the best we can offer you is the peace of mind from knowing Eorzea is in safe hands.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_RAUBAHN_000_160: As you fight the good fight in Ilsabard, I and the other commanders will do what we can to convince the naysayers that our cause is just.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_SHADOWHUNTER_000_16: Much has occurred since we parted ways in Werlyt. From what I gather, the protective talismans you obtained led to the formation of this expeditionary force.
Word of your exploits travels quickly. From what I gather, the protective talismans you obtained led to the formation of this expeditionary force.
My contribution on this occasion is but a minor one, that being the information I have shared with Maxima. For the sake of the people of Garlemald, may the fates be on your side.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ESTINIEN_000_166: So you're not coming with us.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_ESTINIEN_000_167: Strange. I thought you'd have a stake in this.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_SHADOWHUNTER_000_16: I do. The Telophoroi have laid waste to my homeland and enslaved my people.
But though every mote of my being cries for vengeance, I cannot be the one to deliver it. My presence alone would place the entire mission in jeopardy.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_SHADOWHUNTER_000_17: I stand accused of murdering Emperor Varis and plunging Garlemald into chaos. Were I to travel with the Ilsabard contingent, it would give my countrymen ample cause to question our motives.

Conversely, those who believe me innocent may instead celebrate the return of a former legatus and attempt to raise me to a position of leadership, further destabilizing the region and complicating the contingent's mission.
Whether I am branded a villain or hailed as a hero, I would only hinder your efforts.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_A3_000_174: We will deliver your people from harm, in your stead.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_A3_000_175: I doubt they'll be pleased to see the champion of Eorzea set foot on Garlean soil...
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_A3_000_176: I understand. Werlyt is in your hands.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_SHADOWHUNTER_000_17: For what it is worth, you have my gratitude.
You and your comrades have the strength and courage to deliver my countrymen. I am certain of it.
A fair point, but so long as you refrain from announcing your arrival to all and sundry, the average person should have no inkling as to your identity.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_SHADOWHUNTER_000_18: Although your titles and deeds are common knowledge, only a select few would recognize you on sight alone.
Perhaps one day, they will learn that the Warrior of Light is not a demon to be feared, but a  deserving of their trust.
And I will defend it to my dying breath. After the sacrifices my sons and daughters made, I can do no less.
I and the government of Werlyt intend to offer refuge to those fleeing Garlemald. Should that time come, we will be ready.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MAXIMA_000_184: In light of Gaius's rather unique circumstances, I instead will assume the role of your guide.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_MAXIMA_000_185: Though I may have defected for political reasons, my love for Garlemald endures. I would stop at nothing to protect her and her people.
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_RAUBAHN_000_186: Well said. Might I ask you to escort our friends inside?
TEXT_AKTKMB102_04381_AYMERIC_000_187: You might even bump into an old acquaintance or two. And if I don't see you again ere you depart, may the Fury guide and protect you. All of you.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ALPHINAUD_000_000: With the knowledge that our allies will hold the line in our absence, we may devote our attention to the Ilsabardian front.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ALISAIE_000_005: I suppose it's easy for some people to forget there are civilians in Garlemald, too, when the only imperials they've ever known are soldiers...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_GRAHATIA_000_010: So that's Gaius Baelsar. The horrors he must have seen... Many of his own making, I do not doubt.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ESTINIEN_000_015: Like Gaius, I too stand accused of Varis's murder, though I am rather less recognizable on sight. Still, it's something to bear in mind once we reach Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_AYMERIC_000_020: I neglected to mention earlier that we received a report from our troops that may be of interest to you. While engaged with a lunar primal, a great wyrm swooped down from the skies above and came to their aid.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_AYMERIC_000_021: This wyrm, as described, was the spitting image of Tiamat. It would seem she too continues to wage war against the Telophoroi.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_RAUBAHN_000_025: Once we've seen the contingent on its way, I will return to my duties here in Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_RAUBAHN_000_026: As many of our most capable will be traveling with you to Garlemald, we who remain will have to fight that much harder to make up the difference. But let no man say I do not welcome the challenge. Aye, this old bull isn't ready to hang up his horns yet!
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_SHADOWHUNTER_000_03: Regardless of how my countrymen receive you, the cold will not treat you kindly. Underestimate it at your peril.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_040: The other members of the Ilsabard contingent are gathered in the Royal Palace.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_041: I shall inform them of your arrival, so please make your way inside as soon as you are ready.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: Ah, the remaining members of the Scions. Your friends and most of the Ilsabard contingent await you within.
Would you like me to see you through?
Do you wish to meet with the rest of the Ilsabard contingent?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LUCIA_000_065: I've led troops into battle many a time, but never a unit with such a diverse range of talents.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LUCIA_000_066: While I've been briefed on their capabilities, I expect you could provide additional insight into their strengths and weaknesses. I'd appreciate any advice you may have.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_070: I cast my lot with the Populares to bridge the divide between Garlemald and her territories, that all may be united in common cause.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_071: But we were disparaged as a radical element. Dissenters looking to destabilize the Empire from within. Many friends and even my parents perished in “unfortunate accidents.” I, too, would surely have met the same fate had I not defected.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_072: Nevertheless, I still dream of equality and peace for us all. As the world itself stands on the brink of collapse, I hold out hope that one day that dream will become reality.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_075: I am glad to see you well, . Grandmother was worried for you.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_076: The night I agreed to come hither and join the contingent, the gods sent her a strange dream.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_077: Two suns─one burning red, the other frozen black. Closer they circled, closer and closer, and as they danced the world fell to ruin. In blinding chaos she spied blackened silhouettes, and knew at once that one was yours.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_078: Yet we knew not how to interpret this dream, save as a sign that great danger awaits. But whatever lies ahead, I will walk with you, traveler.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LYSE_000_080: It seems so long ago we were sailing across the Ruby Sea, and charging about the Azim Steppe with Cirina and the others. I'd say we're overdue for another adventure!
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LYSE_000_081: Ah, it brings back memories to see so many familiar faces. We've been through so much together. Good times and...not so good.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LYSE_000_082: I expect Garlemald will be mostly the latter, but I'd like to believe we'll look back on these days more fondly in the years to come. But for that to happen, we'll have to make it out of this alive. Don't you die on me, aye?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_SICARD_000_085: Until the Empire fell, Garleans were the only ones we was allowed to impose “tariffs” upon at sea. Weren't easy pickin's, but I made myself a pretty gil.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_SICARD_000_086: Since they've been so generous to me and mine, perhaps it's time I returned the favor and gave a little somethin' back.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_090: In case you were wondering, Eschiva will be staying behind to defend the Twelveswood with my sisters.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_091: She was of the opinion she would make a useful addition to our contingent─and was eager to make good on her vow to accompany me as well. Which was...flattering...but ultimately, it was decided that her skills would be better put to use keeping our homeland safe. I am of course obligated to share with her every detail when I return.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_092: With so many people from so many places, I'm rather out of my element.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_093: Regardless, I am a Seedseer, and will endeavor to acquit myself accordingly.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_YSHTOLA_000_100: Besides the delegates assembled here, the Amalj'aa and several other tribes offered to send troops of their own.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_YSHTOLA_000_101: Unfortunately, due to their physiology, many would struggle simply to survive in the harsh climate of Ilsabard. They would also likely prove tempting targets for abduction by the Telophoroi...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_YSHTOLA_000_102: All things considered, they can better aid the cause by bolstering our defenses in Eorzea─though their eagerness to do more has been noted.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_YSHTOLA_000_103: We few shall have to suffice. Ere we embark, we must distribute the warding scales to our comrades. Care to do the honors?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_YSHTOLA_000_110: I suspect a few of our comrades will be rather pleased to speak with you again, which is why I thought you'd be the ideal candidate.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_YSHTOLA_000_111: In the meantime, I have a bone to pick with Thancred and Urianger regarding their wagging tongues...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LUCIA_000_120: Warding scales for the Ishgardian delegation, I take it?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LUCIA_000_121: Many thanks. These talismans may prove to be the deciding factor in the battles to come.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LUCIA_000_122: I find myself...conflicted by this foray into Garlemald. Sent by the Empire to infiltrate Ishgard, only to throw in my lot with those whose secrets I was supposed to be stealing...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LUCIA_000_123: And now I lead a mission to save the countrymen I betrayed.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LUCIA_000_124: But that is doubtless why I was chosen by Lord Aymeric. He would have me put my extensive knowledge and former ties to good use. I will not disappoint him.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LUCIA_000_125: For the future of Ishgard, Garlemald, and the world at large, I will lead us to victory.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_131: So these are the famed warding scales? Enough for me and my men, I see.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_132: I myself am especially grateful for this opportunity to visit distant lands. I wish to follow in the footsteps of Master A-Towa and learn all there is to learn of this star we call home.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_133: Indeed, that is the primary reason I volunteered to join the expedition. To journey outside the Twelveswood, much less enter into imperial territory, is a rare privilege afforded a Padjal.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_134: Not that I'm tagging along to see the sights. The Garleans would benefit from my healing magicks, as would our comrades, should fighting break out.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_135: Under normal circumstances, I would not be allowed to travel outside of the Twelveswood. The Elder Seedseer, however, has granted me special permission.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_136: She has bid me lend my magicks to the people of Garlemald while learning all I can of their ways. In so doing, I will come closer to understanding myself and my place in the world...or so she says.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ARUHNSENNA_000_137: I say it is past time our allies benefited from the power at a Seedseer's disposal. Some bemoan that we hide our light under a bushel, and I intend to address that criticism.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_SICARD_000_140: I hear you've got somethin' for us.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_SICARD_000_141: Ahh, them scales everyone's been talkin' about. Pretty little things, ain't they? Reckon they'll be worth a gil or two when this is all over, but we'll hold on to 'em for now.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_SICARD_000_142: And one more thing─ I know what you're all thinkin'. “Why didn't they send Eynzahr instead?”
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_SICARD_000_143: Buggered if I know. All the Admiral and Captain Hyllfyr told me was they needed someone to help “safeguard the future.” And here I am. Can't say they haven't got a sense of humor.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_SICARD_000_144: 'Course, some of you might be wonderin' what good a pirate is on dry land, in the middle of the soddin' snow of all places. Well, me and my crew'll do whatever needs doin', so let's set sail─or however the sayin' goes on airships.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LYSE_000_150: That a set of warding scales I spy? Not that I would know what they'd look like...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LYSE_000_151: Wow, look at these! Even a layman like me can tell they're bursting with aether. All the better to fend off the...tempering waves? Is that the right term?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LYSE_000_152: Anyway, these'll give us one less thing to worry about. Which just leaves the other mountain of whatever else is waiting for us in Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_LYSE_000_153: Only one way to find out, eh? And nervous or not, I'd march through all seven hells if it gave me a chance to put Zenos back in the grave where he belongs.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_155: We heard it would be cold in Garlemald, so we came prepared...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_156: Oh, the talismans! We are to keep these close at all times, yes? I will see that no one misplaces theirs.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_157: Ah, and before I forget, I have a message from Hien.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_158:
"In distant lands, in times of strife,
Together, stand; together, fight,
In darkness shines the light of life.“
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_159: ...I hope I have done his words justice. Doma, like much of Othard, has been plagued by the towers. Yet while he could not be here, he wished to express his shared conviction.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_160: Hien and Yugiri labor without rest to unite the people, and with their aid will we keep the enemy at bay.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_CIRINA_000_161: And we of the Steppe and the Eastern alliance will repay their efforts by ending this war!
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_170: Do you have a warding scale for me, too?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_171: Thank you for this─and for going to such incredible lengths for the sake of my people.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_172: Though I have little to offer in return, I would impart some advice, if I may. You have been told by many to ware the cold of Ilsabard, and I cannot stress enough that this is no token warning.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_173: I will be distributing specially made warming tinctures─courtesy of the Alchemists' Guild─but understand that they are no substitute for proper protection.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_174: I leave the provisioning of said protection to your discretion. Now, let us proceed to the Ala Mhigan Quarter.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_MAXIMA_000_175: While you make your final preparations, I will have the pilots ready the airships.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ALISAIE_000_180: If you've anything you still need to take care of, you'd better see to it now!
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_THANCRED_000_185: This coat is quite warm, but I have something rather thicker for occasions like these. There's no telling how long we'll be out in the open, and we can't go starting fires willy-nilly if we want to avoid detection.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_URIANGER_000_190: Concoctions to fortify the flesh against wind and cold are commonly sold in the Ul'dahn markets─though they are of dubious provenance and efficacy.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_URIANGER_000_191: 'Tis said, however, that in recent days the Alchemists' Guild hath produced a tincture capable of such a feat. Mayhap the achievements of their Thavnairian counterparts did spur them to action, that they not be put to shame.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_YSHTOLA_000_195: It's something of a constant refrain that we require warmer clothing. My present garb may be lacking, fur collar notwithstanding...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_GRAHATIA_000_200: Since my “revival,” I've been lax in expanding my limited wardrobe. Think we have time for a quick trip back to Old Sharlayan? I recall a rather fetching coat...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ESTINIEN_000_205: Preparations? I've got my armor and my lance. What more could I need?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: I believe the other members of the contingent are at present acquiring supplies for the journey ahead. Are you not in need of anything else?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ALPHINAUD_000_220: This is our last chance to make ready before we set forth.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_THANCRED_000_221: You needn't worry about Urianger and I. We still have what we wore in Garlemald before.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_THANCRED_000_222: Estinien claims to be quite warm and toasty beneath his armor, and since he spent a fair bit of time up north recently as well, I have no reason to doubt his words.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_THANCRED_000_223: Most of the others will be borrowing Grand Company stock. The rest of you could do likewise, I suppose, provided you're not overly concerned with style.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_YSHTOLA_000_224: Hmm... Not to put too fine a point on it, but I wouldn't be seen dead in one of those ridiculous overcoats. If only I had time to find something to my liking...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_225: (-???-)Hark! Is that the cry of Scions in need of a tailor I hear?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_227: Muahaha! I have my ways. Oh yes, indeed!
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_228: You thought you could sneak off to Ilsabard without telling me?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_230: Now, you will wear these garments I've made for you whether you like it or not!
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_GRAHATIA_000_232: But...why do you need a new outfit as well? Wait─are you coming with us!?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_000_233: What? No. Of course not, silly. It's all in the name of fashion! Rather, the pursuit of the highest quality fashion! Besides, how can I expect others to wear my creations if I've never worn them myself?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_000_234: Ah, I did have one other thing to share.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_000_235: Aergmhus and Bluomwyda have finally returned from assignments in faraway lands!
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_000_236: They'll be staying at the Rising Stones for a while, to keep an eye on events throughout Eorzea.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_000_237: Since they'll be running things back at headquarters...I was wondering...if I could lend a hand...in Sharlayan?
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_YSHTOLA_000_238: Oh, why not. You can keep Krile company in the Baldesion Annex.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ALISAIE_000_239: Yes, we'd love to have you there. And I heard Aergmhus and Bluomwyda did a fine job carrying on in our stead while we were lying comatose. With them in charge of the Rising Stones, we've nothing to worry about.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_000_240: My thoughts exactly! Also, while I'm confident you won't go collapsing again (because a certain someone who shall remain nameless isn't in a position to transport your souls to another world), if anything similarly disastrous were to happen, I'll be well positioned to do something about it.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_000_241: Anyway, I've got a few things to take care of, and then I'll make my way to Sharlayan...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_000_242: I really do hope these new clothes are enough to keep you warm in Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_000_243: It's not much, but it's the only thing I can do for you, other than pray for your safe return. Which I will. Every day...
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_ALPHINAUD_000_244: Let's not keep the contingent waiting any longer.
TEXT_AKTKMB103_04382_TATARU_000_245: Here are your winter woolies, handcrafted by yours truly!
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_GARLONDPILOT_100_00: We'll depart once the contingent has finished its preparations.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_TATARU_000_000: I'm told the airship pilot has been sent to meet you.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_TATARU_000_002: All right, this is where we go our separate ways. Do be careful, won't you?
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_TATARU_000_010: I modeled your clothing on what Alphinaud and I wore when we journeyed from Lord Haurchefant's “Falling Snows” to Ishgard for the first time.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_TATARU_000_011: In those days, I barely knew one end of a sewing needle from the other, and as you've always had very...individual tastes, I let you pick your own outfit.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_TATARU_000_012: I'd like to think my skills have improved since then─but do you know what's more important than skill? Heart and soul! There's plenty to be found in each and every one of my works!
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_GARLONDPILOT_000_02: It's an honor to finally meet you! We of the Garlond Ironworks will be ferrying you and your contingent across the mountains and into Garlemald.
For many of us, it will be something of a homecoming. Our illustrious founder was only our most notable imperial defector.
For that reason, the company is committed to the success of this expedition.
Our resources are at your disposal, and if there is aught we might do to be of further assistance, please do not hesitate to ask!
If you are ready to depart, I will ready the engines.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_025:
Upon boarding the airship, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_026: In addition, you will be required to participate in battle. Your progress will be saved at certain points. In the event that you are defeated, you will be able to try again from the most recent of these.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_027: Please note that if you enter battles associated with other quests or log out from the game, this progress will be lost.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_030:
In the coming battle, you will fight as Thancred. You have two objectives:
1. Place explosives on the imperial magitek.
2. Deactivate the frontline magitek units via the control terminal.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_031: If the guards detect and pursue you, enemy forces will become more aware of the threat you pose, as indicated by the threat awareness gauge.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_032: The gauge will gradually fill until you defeat all alerted enemies.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_033: If the gauge is completely filled, the guards will call for reinforcements and the mission will end in failure.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_034: Use Swift Deception to avoid detection as you go about completing your objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_040: Success in this mission hinges on the following points:
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_041: Swift Deception renders Thancred invisible and increases his movement speed.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_042: While active, enemy soldiers and magitek will be unable to perceive Thancred's presence, even if they are within close proximity. However, it has no effect on the guard dogs' acute sense of smell, and they will be able to detect Thancred regardless.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_043: Moreover, this action can only be used outside of combat. It will also be unavailable when Thancred attempts to deactivate magitek fields or execute certain other actions.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_044: Thancred's Silent Takedown will instantly render a soldier unconscious. It can only be used while Swift Deception is in effect.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_045: Though it cannot be used on magitek or guard dogs, utilizing Silent Takedown whenever possible is essential in clearing a path to your objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_046: As guard dogs can detect Thancred even when Swift Deception is active, you can instead use a Bewilderment Bomb to distract them and sneak past unnoticed.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_047: Conversely, Bewilderment Bombs have no effect on magitek or soldiers, so take care to choose the right tool for the situation.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SYSTEM_000_048: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 82 or above to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_GARLONDPILOT_000_04: The airship is ready when you are. But say the word and we'll have you in Ilsabard before you know it.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_ALISAIE_000_050: Shouldn't be long before we have a half-decent camp with so many helping hands. I was concerned the snow might hinder our progress, but our Ishgardian friends are used to working in conditions like these.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_GRAHATIA_000_060: Our comrades certainly haven't wasted any time establishing a base of operations...
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_LUCIA_000_065: Once everything is in place, we will discuss our next move.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_MAXIMA_000_070: This is all that remains of Laterum... Homes become empty husks. If this is the state of the outlying villages, I dread to think what has become of the capital.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_ARUHNSENNA_000_075: The tempered soldiers are sleeping soundly while they undergo treatment. There are too many to attend at once, but I and the other healers will see to all eventually.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_SICARD_000_080: Hells' bells, this place is bloody freezin'! Rather be tied to the topmast in a storm than suffer this cold any longer! Anyone what can spare a swig o' rum? That'll sort me right out!
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_PIPIN_000_085: We've asked the Ironworks members and some of our other comrades to stay with the airships. In the event we are discovered, we must be ready to move them swiftly to a safer location.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_LYSE_000_090: Raubahn taught me a lot about military strategy during exercises in the Fringes. Coordinating units with wildly different capabilities, surveying and securing hostile terrain, that sort of thing. Now, I have the chance to put his teachings into practice.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_CIRINA_000_095: Vergilia is in our care, along with the rest of the tempered. “Glory to Garlemald, glory to Garlemald,” they still whisper in their sleep, even as they writhe in pain...
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_ALPHINAUD_000_100: In spite of the obstacles we've faced, our plan proceeds apace. Just a little farther and we will reach the capital itself.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Still, we mustn't get ahead of ourselves. As soon as the camp has been made fit for purpose, we are to discuss a course of action with Lucia.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_ALPHINAUD_000_102: Would you mind asking Y'shtola and G'raha to join us in that building to the northeast of the camp? Alisaie and I will meet you there.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_YSHTOLA_000_110: A meeting? Yes, I'll make my way over once my head has cleared.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_YSHTOLA_000_111: In truth, I've been feeling out of sorts since we arrived. The air is thick with a palpable aura of malevolence...
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_YSHTOLA_000_112: 'Tis the monstrous tower on the horizon. Jagged, hideous, unholy... Even at this distance, its presence is overwhelming.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_YSHTOLA_000_113: Much like the sensation I felt in the Tower of Zot, only far more terrifying. Aether flows unceasingly towards it, converging into a swirling mass of unfathomable power.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_YSHTOLA_000_114: ...For a blessing, the constant chill in the air is helping to anchor my senses in the here and now. Tell the others I shall be with you in a few moments.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_GRAHATIA_000_120: You will be pleased to know most of the tempered have been quartered inside the nearby buildings and are receiving treatment as we speak.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_GRAHATIA_000_121: I do however feel no small amount of guilt for commandeering civilian homes. The occupants may be long gone, but everything is exactly as they left it...
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_GRAHATIA_000_122: Considering the length of time that has clearly passed since, one would expect to find them ransacked. Strangely, there are no signs of anything having been stolen.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_GRAHATIA_000_123: It's possible that everyone fled at the first sign of trouble, though it seems to me they left far too many useful possessions behind... Aye, although there is no conclusive evidence, I strongly suspect they were tempered.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_GRAHATIA_000_124: Sorry, I was merely thinking aloud... You mentioned a meeting? I will make my way there.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_LUCIA_000_130: Thank you for informing the others of our meeting.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_LUCIA_000_131: When everyone is here, we will begin.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_ALPHINAUD_000_140: I've never thought myself much of an explorer, though I suppose my adventures have taken me to all sorts of strange and distant places. With that in mind, traversing an ice field should be a simple feat!
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_EMMANELLAIN_000_145: There's this odd perception that Ishgardians have lived their whole lives in the snow, but it really wasn't that bad before the Calamity. And afterwards, well, I was rarely more than a few paces from a raging fire...
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_EMMANELLAIN_000_146: This dreadful place, on the other hand, is nothing but cold, cold, cold! And it's my understanding that Ilsabard has always been this way. Gods, can you imagine!?
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_ALISAIE_000_150: Gods be good... If it's this cold with Tataru's clothing, I dread to think how we'd fare without it! I must remember to thank her when next we meet.
TEXT_AKTKMB104_04383_ALISAIE_000_151: It makes me realize, too, that while the people of Garlemald have spent their whole lives in conditions like these, even they'd be hard-pressed to survive away from the warmth of their homes. If there are any survivors, we must find them, and quickly.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I've never thought myself much of an explorer, though I suppose my adventures have taken me to all sorts of strange and distant places. With that in mind, traversing an ice field should be a simple feat!
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_005: So, it's into the Eblan Rime we go. But where do we even start looking in such a place?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_010: What ho, chums! Been given something to do, have you? As it happens, I too have been ordered to make myself useful!
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_011: Sounds like rather a tall order...
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_012: Ahem. Since you ask, we're to scour the Eblan Rime for survivors.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_013: What!? Wander around ice fields on the off chance you'll find someone!?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_014: You'd take forever to finish the job without the benefit of my expertise─or more specifically, my telescope! Come friends, I know just the spot to begin our search!
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_015: ...I'll probably regret this, but we may as well humor him.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_020: The few buildings I can see don't appear to be residences. They may still warrant investigation, though.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_025: I'm surprised by how many wild beasts there are roaming about the place. Perhaps now that the soldiers have gone, they're free to wander and forage as they please.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_030: I spy with my little telescope...
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_031:
A massive...sheep-thing? Or maybe it's a cow? Not what we're after, either way.
...Is that an aether current? Ah, no, just a wind sprite.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_032: Hmm... Other than that, it's all snow, snow, snow. But lo! What do I see o'er yon hillock?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_033: There's no mistaking it. That's a girl.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_035: Over there, behind that tree. It looks like she's running away from something...though surely not us? She wouldn't even know we're here unless she had a telescope like mine.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_036: All I can tell...is that...she's wearing a pale green dress...a rather fetching one, at that!
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_037: She'll be long gone by the time we get anywhere near, but we should be able to follow her footprints.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_038: I'll let Lucia know where you're heading.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_039: Oh, and take these warming tinctures with you!
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_040: The poor girl must be chilled to the bone, if not on the verge of freezing to death.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_041: That's...actually very thoughtful. Thank you. But won't you need some for yourself?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_042: No, no! I'll be fine! As a man of chivalry, my honor demands I do no less. And lest we forget, the very reason we are here is to protect those in need.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_EMMANELLAIN_000_050: Why are you still here!? If you dally any longer, you will miss your chance to play the hero!
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_SYSTEM_000_060: A trail of fresh footprints lead east...
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_070: According to the label here, this place was used by those involved with extracting ceruleum...
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_075: Hmm... Other than the footprints, I see no signs of recent activity.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_SYSTEM_000_080: These footprints appear to be the same as those you saw previously, and they lead towards the building...
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_090: We're getting closer. I'm sure of it.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_091: At first, we thought she'd gone inside the building, but the door doesn't look to have been opened in some time.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_092: She might still be nearby, so we'll keep looking around here.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_093: Then again, it's also possible that she ran right past this place. Would you mind searching up ahead?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_100: As Emmanellain said, it's highly unlikely she was running away from us.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_101: Even so, we mustn't do anything to startle her. For all she knows, we're soldiers of an invading army, so we need to be careful not to give the wrong impression.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_SYSTEM_000_110: The girl in the green dress anxiously surveys her surroundings.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_SYSTEM_000_111: Were you to call out to her from this distance, it might attract wild beasts to your location. It would be safer to get closer first, but you must do so without drawing her attention.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_SYSTEM_000_112: Follow the girl from a safe distance.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_SYSTEM_000_113: The appearance of yellow turning indicators signify that she will detect you when turning around. Make use of cover such as rocks to approach her without being seen.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_SYSTEM_000_114: Similarly, a circular area indicator signifies that you will be detected for following too closely.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_SYSTEM_000_115: Should you fail to complete the objective, you may try again by returning to the designated location.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_Q1_000_116: Attempt to follow the girl in green again?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_121: Stay back! This house is packed with explosives! Take another step and I'll blow this place sky-high!
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_122: Please! We just want to talk!
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_123: I'm Alphinaud. This is my sister, Alisaie, and our good friend .
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_124: We have no intention of hurting or taking anything from you or anyone else. I give you my word.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_125: We and our comrades have come to provide aid to the people of Garlemald─
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_126: Aid!? You savages are the ones responsible for all of this! You did this to us!
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_127: We didn't, I promise you. One of the other reasons we came was to find out what happened here, in fact.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_128: The Telophoroi are the ones to blame. They're the ones who laid waste to Garlemald, and they won't stop until they've destroyed the entire world. They're the enemy─our enemy.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_129: On our way, we encountered imperial soldiers who had been made their thralls. Those poor souls are now in our care, and we are striving to cure them of their affliction.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_130: You're the first person we've met who wasn't already enslaved... How were you able to escape the Telophoroi's influence? Are there any others like you?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_131: ...I'm sorry, I don't mean to overwhelm you. Let's start with introductions. Can you tell me your name?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_132: (-Licinia-)I...my name's Licinia. As for how I've managed to stay sane...
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_133: (-Licinia-)I've been asking myself the same question. Ever since that night...and the roar, that terrible roar... And then the screams. I was screaming too, I think. I'm not sure. I can't remember.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_134: (-Licinia-)Then came the silence. Everything was still.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_135: (-Licinia-)It was like...waking up from a nightmare. I thought that maybe the fighting had stopped, so I stepped outside...
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_136: (-Licinia-)If your hells are real, I saw one that day.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_137: (-Licinia-)I ran...past friends, people I'd known all my life. Eyes vacant. Dead. Staring at the sky.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_138: (-Licinia-)Others were mad and violent. I saw them struggle with soldiers, but didn't stay to watch. I fled, as far as my legs would take me.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_139: Do you have family here? Is this their home?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_140: (-Licinia-)No, this is Victors' Spoils. A mansion for retired soldiers. Or it was, but now me and my─me and a few others are, um, borrowing it.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_141: (-Licinia-)As for the explosives...I was making that up.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_142: (-Licinia-)I just wanted to keep everyone else safe, and I didn't know if you were... <sigh> The truth is, our supplies are running low. You said you're here to help. Can you?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_143: Of course! Whatever assistance we can provide, we will.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_LICINIA_000_144: (-Licinia-)Thank you. I'd better tell the others first, though. Wait here.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_WEAKENEDGARLEAN_000: Licinia says you can be trusted...but these are desperate times. We'd be fools to let foreign troops into our home.
Having said that...were you to provide us with means of heating the place─as a sign of goodwill─perhaps we could take you at your word...
If that is too much to ask, then leave us be.
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALPHINAUD_000_149: Time to put my firewood-gathering skills to use. Could you provide the spark with a little magic, Alisaie?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_ALISAIE_000_150: We'll have a fire burning in no time. May we build it under that gazebo?
TEXT_AKTKMB105_04384_WEAKENEDGARLEAN_000: The what...? Oh, you mean the bower. Yes, yes, do as you will.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Early signs of frostbite... This must be treated quickly.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALISAIE_000_005: What they need most is a decent meal. We've food back at the camp, but there's the distance to consider.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_WEAKENEDGARLEAN_000: I can feel my fingers again...
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_HUNGRYGARLEAN_000_0: All's well... All's well... With food in my belly and a song in my heart...
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_030: Hmm? Sorry, I was... I'm still finding it hard to come to terms with all that's happened. Now that you're here, though, I'm hoping things might change for the better.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_031: You know, I've worked up quite a sweat from all that running about, so I'll leave space around the fire for the others.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_032: As you can tell, they're in a far worse state than me. We were planning to look for somewhere warmer or with more food, but they're not going anywhere until we nurse them back to health...which I don't know how to do. Is there anything you can do to help them?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_040: Before the civil war, I was a student. The others were officials of some sort, I think... Heh, even after all this time together, we hardly know the first thing about each other.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_041: What I do know is this: we're Garleans. When times are hard, we stick together, no matter what.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALPHINAUD_000_050: I can treat their frostbite and their wounds. But it will take time for the fire to do its work...
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Now would be a good occasion to make use of Emmanellain's tinctures─the ones that can warm the body from the inside out. Would you make sure everyone gets one?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALPHINAUD_000_060: If there's something that can be said for Lord Emmanellain, he's not one to leave others at the mercy of the cold. Of course, being a man of Coerthas, I'm sure he is more aware than most of its dangers, but I sense that is not the only reason.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALPHINAUD_000_061: Ever since the warm welcome we received at Camp Dragonhead, the hospitality he and his brothers have afforded us has been nothing short of exemplary. Perhaps they aspire to live up to the example set by Lord Edmont.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_WEAKENEDGARLEAN_000: The numbness is beginning to subside, though I suspect once the fire dies, it will return with a vengeance.
Warming tincture? I've never heard of such a thing. No harm in trying...
But tell me, have you heard aught of the city? Though calling it that seems absurd after what's happened. It's nothing but ruins now...
The few buildings still standing offer no more than meager protection from wind and snow. Food production, water purification...the magitek that sustained us has come to a grinding halt.

What machina that remains operational cannot be run for lack of ceruleum. Of course, Cerulea Ingens is full of the stuff, for all the good it does us. No one here knows the first thing about extraction or refinement...
Many of our ancestors succumbed to the bitter cold when first they came to these lands. Much as we are now.
But with discipline and order, any obstacle can be overcome. When every man knows his duty and is held to account if he shirks it. Without a hierarchy, this is what we are reduced to.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_HUNGRYGARLEAN_000_0: All is well! Yes, never better!
Oh, what sweet libation is this? Is it...poison, by any chance?
Hahaha! 'Twas a joke, a joke! Hahaha! Ha...ha... Ahh... “If I laugh, 'tis that I may not weep”─so said the poet. And alas, my tears would freeze on my cheek ere they fell.
We are the blessed damned, to bear witness to the fall of the great Empire, while our brethren lie dead...or live on as puppets of flesh.

First came the war,
Then came the roar,
When morning came,
Garlemald was no more!

In a cacophony of gunfire, explosions, and screams was our beloved capital razed to the ground. From the rubble rose the disheveled remnants, their lavish finery caked in ash as they shuffled mindlessly towards the palace...
Each bearing a fragment of stone or metal─an offering perhaps to the architect of our destruction. A hopeful few tried to reason with the deranged, only to be beaten for their kindness...
But I knew better than to plead with the horde. I fled with my health─if not my conscience preserved. Now I wait with my fellow cowards for our final judgment.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_HUNGRYGARLEAN_000_1: If you listen─listen very, very carefully, you can hear it. The sound of my stomach eating itself. Would that it could devour my soul.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ABSENTGARLEAN_000_1: Hmm? A tincture? May as well drink it, I suppose.
This? It's a radio. You don't have them where you come from, I take it? We use them to listen to messages sent by others, even over great distances.
There are different types, but this model is by far the most popular. Made with quality components crafted with the finest ore─sourced from Locus Amoenus, it is.

Not all that useful since the capital fell into ruin. The people at the broadcasting station must've either fled or...ended up like all the others, because all we've been hearing is the same music, being played over and over again...
"Home Beyond the Horizon.“ An ode to the brave men and women sent to reclaim our ancestral homeland of Locus Amoenus.
We may have founded an empire in these frozen wastes, but we always hoped to take back what was once ours.
'Tis a solemn reminder that though we must suffer great hardship, better days will surely come...
Despite everything, I believe that Emperor Varis yet lives, and that he speaks to us through our radios.
It was a cunning strategy, faking his murder. He must've foreseen this catastrophe and chosen to conceal himself, that he may one day make his triumphant return...
Yes...yes, I'm sure of it. Emperor Varis would not be defeated so easily.
I have faith you will deliver us from this madness, Your Radiance. By your grace shall Garlemald be reborn...
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_141: So this is what you gave the others? Thank you. I'll save it for later.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_142: Actually, I've a few things to ask you.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_143: Are you part of the group staying in Laterum?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_144: I saw Legatus Vergilia's troops heading towards the Magna Glacies a few days ago. Are they the ones you encountered?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_145: Camp Broken Glass, you call it... And Vergilia and her men are all there now. Hmm...
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_146: So how did you reach the Magna Glacies? Did you cross the mountains on foot?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_147: Airships... Then there might be a way to─
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_150: A voice from inside, you say? You must be imagining things. Everyone's out here!
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_151: Perhaps a baby almasty has found its way into the house. It wouldn't be the first time.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_152: Without the soldiers to scare them off, wild animals have been roaming closer to the settlements. Some have been known to attack people, too...
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_153: I-I've just had an idea. If you and yours are strong enough to defeat a legatus, then surely a few beasts shouldn't pose a threat.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_154: If you've a mind to continue helping us, perhaps you could head to the other side of the lake. There's a small group of tappers living there─people whose job was to extract ceruleum. They still do, from what we can tell.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_155: I've already tried asking if they would share their fuel with us, but they're not willing to give it away. They want food in exchange─lots of food─and that's something we don't have and can't get on our own.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_156: On top of that, to even reach their den, we'd have to make our way past all those creatures.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_157: Would you be willing to go in our place? We only need enough ceruleum to last until the others are strong enough to travel to your camp. If the offer still stands, that is. Oh, and I don't expect you to give up your own supplies...but there might be another way to pay the tappers.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_A1_000_159: If it's ceruleum you need, then ceruleum you shall have!
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_A1_000_160: You'd best watch out for “baby almasties” while we're away.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_162: Hmm? Ah, yes, of course! If I see any, I'll be sure to shoo them away!
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_163: To reach Tapper's Den, you'll have to cross the lake. The ice is thick enough to support a person's weight, but if you'd rather not take the risk, you'll need to take the long way around.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_164: Finding the entrance can be a bit tricky, too, so it's easier to just look for someone standing guard outside. However you decide to head there, please be careful.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_LICINIA_000_170: I'm not sure what else the tappers might need besides provisions, though I daresay that capable fighters like yourself can offer them other forms of compensation. Culling dangerous beasts, that sort of thing.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ARMEDMAN04385_000_1: Who goes there!? How did you find us?
What do you mean I stand out like a sore thumb? Hmph! If the purebloods over at Victors' Spoils hadn't given away our location, you'd never have found us!
Those stuck-up arseholes... Thought they could come waltzing in here demanding ceruleum with nothing to offer in return. Hah! Looks like the boot's on the other foot now the capital's gone to shite!
So they've resorted to sending you to “negotiate”? I know your game, sellsword. If they think we'll give in to intimidation, they've got another think coming!
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALISAIE_000_191: Just after you left, Licinia asked me to go and catch up with you, in case you needed a hand. Someone must've let slip that I've a little experience in transporting barrels of ceruleum...
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALISAIE_000_192: So this is Tapper's Den... Well then, after you.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_193: Who are you!? What happened to the guards!?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_194: Eorzeans and rebels here to save the people of Garlemald?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_195: That doesn't make any godsdamned sense! Why in the hells would you pass up this chance to put those imperial bastards to the sword!?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALISAIE_000_196: Let me guess. None of you are Garlean? You were brought here from other lands?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_197: Gyr Abania, Yanxia, Bozja, Dalmasca, to name but a few. Some dragged here against our will, others fed bollocks about a better life, all put to work extracting ceruleum.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_198: All given the esteemed title of “aan”─placing us firmly on the bottom rung of the ladder.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_199: But the old hierarchy means nothing in the new Garlemald, says we. About the only thing that's escaped more or less unscathed is Cerulea Ingens. Still sustaining us, even with our paymasters out of the picture.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALISAIE_000_200: We hear you're experts in drawing up ceruleum from the bottom of the lake. But how can you do that if it's frozen over?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_201: Ha! Wouldn't you like to know? Trade secrets, I'm afraid.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_202: At any rate, it's not as if ceruleum is used for much these days, what with the city in ruins. We take enough to power our heaters and save the surplus for later. And though it helps stave off the cold, it does sod all about our hunger unless we can trade it away.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_203: Speaking of which, be sure to tell your contingent we've got ceruleum by the barrelful. If they're interested, we'll exchange it for whatever provisions they're willing to spare.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALISAIE_000_204: We can certainly ask. But if you're all free to go now, why carry on living here?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_206: Even if we managed to get back to our homelands, there'd be nothing left for us, thanks to the Empire. And the knowledge and skills we acquired working here would be practically useless outside of Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_207: So we're staying for the time being. Long as there's a need for ceruleum, we'll find a way to get by, even if Garlemald as we knew it is gone for good.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_210: If you're wondering why we'd post guards outside, it's because we've had trouble with other refugees, and I don't mean the ones at Victors' Spoils. Some of them come bearing weapons, and won't take no for an answer.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_JARECK_000_211: As for the two guards you met on the way in, I'll tell them what we've discussed─once they've recovered from the beating you gave them. Come to think of it, maybe we should ask your contingent to send some bandages and healing balm...
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALISAIE_000_220: Regardless of what the Ilsabard contingent does for the people of Garlemald, the Empire itself is already a thing of the past.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALISAIE_000_221: For many, that would be a cause for celebration, while for others, their whole way of life will have been turned upside down.
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALISAIE_000_222: After all the atrocities committed in the Empire's name, perhaps it is for the best that it is consigned to history. But what of the ordinary people, their lives, their stories? Should they be forgotten too?
TEXT_AKTKMB106_04385_ALISAIE_000_223: Hmm... I suppose there'll be plenty of time to ponder that later. For now, let's see about getting some ceruleum.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_000: The fire we built at Victors' Spoils won't last forever, and it's too dangerous for Licinia and the others to search for more kindling. If we can get them some ceruleum, that'll be one less thing for them to worry about...for a time, at least.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_JARECK_000_010: So, you've come seeking ceruleum, have you?
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_JARECK_000_011: What!? Those purebloods up at Victors' Spoils sent you?
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_JARECK_000_012: To turn to their enemies for help...they must be more desperate than I'd thought. Then again, Licinia's got her little sister to think about...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_013: A sister? But we only saw Licinia and three men.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_JARECK_000_014: It's possible she died from whatever was ailing her. If she needed treatment, I doubt there'd be any way to get it around here.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_JARECK_000_015: I may have refused Licinia at first─thinking she'd come back with something to exchange─but I can spare them a bottle's worth of ceruleum.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_JARECK_000_016: Consider it a reward for introducing me to the rest of your contingent. Be sure to send them our way, you hear?
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_017: I can't for the life of me think why Licinia would keep her sister a secret from us, but we can ask about that after we've delivered this ceruleum. Come on, let's hurry back!
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_JARECK_000_020: I don't know the details, but she mentioned a sister three years her junior who's in poor health. That being the case, I thought her people would be willing to cough up some supplies in exchange for ceruleum...but maybe they didn't have anything after all.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_030: This isn't right. It's too quiet...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_031: I would've thought Alphinaud would still be treating them by the fire...but they're nowhere to be seen.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_032: I'll look inside the house, while you search outside. They can't have gone far!
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_WEAKENEDGARLEAN_000: Ungh... Damn it... Damn it all!
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALPHINAUD_000_050: They asked me...asked me to help carry supplies...but when I followed them back here...they attacked me.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Caught me off guard... Forced me...to defend myself. I fear they fared rather worse than me...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_WEAKENEDGARLEAN_000: You can't fool us. We know...we know what you're about!
Vultures, that's what you are! Waiting in the wings for us to show weakness, then in you swoop!
Here to help? What rot! All a ploy...to make us lower our guard...
Let you in...put ourselves at your mercy... Put us in chains, steal our lands...get your revenge...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALPHINAUD_000_056: You're wrong... That's not what any of us want.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_057: Save the arguments for later, we've got bigger problems!
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_058: I found empty medicine bottles and a bed that was still warm.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_059: It's true─ Licinia was hiding her sick sister inside the house!
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_060: But now...there's no sign of either of them.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_061: Where are they? Where did they go!?
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_WEAKENEDGARLEAN_000: Away from you and yours. And if you think I'll tell you, you're a fool. I'd never give up my people!
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_063: We're trying to help them, you idiot!
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_064: Her sister's ill─the empty bottles prove it. So the medicine ran out, or she put it in her pockets to make it easier to carry...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_065: ...or to avoid the sound of clinking glass.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_066: There are beasts everywhere─ How could you let them go alone!?
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_WEAKENEDGARLEAN_000: You invade our homeland...taint it with the same sorcery used to slay our countrymen... A Garlean should sooner die than suffer the insult!
Better for them to flee...keep their purity intact...than be corrupted by your vile magicks!
We were waiting...waiting for a chance to free them...since the moment you arrived...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALPHINAUD_000_072: I cannot say how Licinia and her sister will react when we find them, but find them we must.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Go on without me, both of you. I first need to tend to my injuries...and theirs. I will join you in the search after.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_075: We'll do our best to find them quickly.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_076: There's only one path out of here, so that's where we'll start.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALPHINAUD_000_080: I will follow as soon as I can. After I've given them some basic treatment, I'll take the men inside the house and use a light sleeping enchantment to help them rest─and ensure that they don't cause any more trouble.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALPHINAUD_000_081: I'm sorry...but this is something I must do.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_WEAKENEDGARLEAN_000: Rob us of our lands...rob us of our pride... No, no─I'll not allow it...
Better to die free than live in servitude and shame. The girls...the girls'd say the same...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_090: Two sets of fresh footprints... Young women, judging by the size.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_091: This is definitely them. Come on.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_100: The trail stops at the frozen lake. Perhaps they chose this route so as not to leave footprints.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_101: I can't think of any other reason. Look at this place─it's crawling with beasts, and I can only imagine how hard it must be for her ailing sister to cross the ice.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_102: We could really do with Alphinaud's help, but we can't afford to wait for him. Let's split up and look for clues.
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_SYSTEM_000_110: The empty bottle smells faintly of alcohol. The thin coating of dirt indicates it has been here for some time, and is unlikely to have any connection to Licinia or her sister...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_SYSTEM_000_115: The wet paper half-buried in the snow appears to be a flyer for a theater group, though the run of shows advertised has long since ended...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_SYSTEM_000_120: The blood staining the snow appears to be fresh. Judging by the amount, the victim may have been severely wounded...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_SYSTEM_000_121: The trail of blood leads southeastwards...
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_150: There must've been something we could've done... But what?
TEXT_AKTKMB107_04386_ALISAIE_000_151: ...Should we have never come here? Would they still be alive if we hadn't?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALISAIE_000_000: If only we'd had a chance to talk things over...but it's too late now. Too late by far.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_010: We have already caused enough harm here. Let us return to the camp before we cause any more.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_011: As for those inside the house, we should send someone to take care of them. Someone who isn't us.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_012: All we can do for now is make our report to Lucia...and do everything in our power to prevent further tragedy.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_013: So let us linger here no more. Come...
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Would you mind giving Lucia a full report?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALISAIE_000_025: We mustn't forget to send some of our allies to Tapper's Den. We still owe them for the bottle of ceruleum.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_YSHTOLA_000_030: Treatment of the tempered is proceeding as well as can be expected. If there is anything to report, you will be sure to know, though I gather you have a report of your own to deliver...
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ARUHNSENNA_000_035: Is something the matter? The twins look out of sorts, and you too seem a bit...off.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_MAXIMA_000_040: Forgive me for saying, but the three of you appear rather drained since your return. Is there aught I might do to be of assistance?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_LUCIA_000_050: Alisaie and Alphinaud tell me they have finished their preliminary search for survivors, but refrained from saying much more than that.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_LUCIA_000_051: Clearly they are reluctant to provide details. Might I ask for your account?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Perhaps it is unwise to volunteer for a mission so soon after the previous disaster... Nevertheless, I shall not squander this opportunity.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALISAIE_000_065: I know, I know. This won't bring back Licinia or her sister.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALISAIE_000_066: Taking the same risks, making the same mistakes... It's possible, but better to try than to give up. Every time.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_YSHTOLA_000_070: I worry they were not in the best state of mind to volunteer for this undertaking, but what's done is done. I know you will take good care of them─and yourself as well, I trust.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ARUHNSENNA_000_075: They are...resilient in the face of hardship. You as well.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ARUHNSENNA_000_076: But good intentions and stubborn determination alone will not be enough to bring our mission to a successful conclusion. Be on your guard.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_MAXIMA_000_080: Jullus pyr Norbanus... It is unusual for one so young to achieve such a high rank. Very unusual.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_MAXIMA_000_081: His uniform identifies him as a member of the Ist Legion, which has a particularly fierce reputation. Whoever his superior may be, I advise you to approach them with caution.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_CIRINA_000_085: We captured the boy as he was about to make off with our food. He must be very hungry to take such risks.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_CIRINA_000_086: Maybe we should give him something to eat. Reward him for his boldness.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_MAGNAI_000_090: The lowly task of keeping watch over provisions would not normally befit the Sun. But these being unusual circumstances, I will let no man take that which is not by rights theirs.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_LUCIA_000_100: You will be received as invited guests, and so I urge you to observe proper social etiquette and conduct yourselves accordingly.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_LUCIA_000_101: Your safe return takes precedence above all else. Remember this.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_LUCIA_000_102: Thancred in particular will be worried sick if you're gone too long. May the Fury watch over and keep you.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_LUCIA_000_110: As I said before, Thancred can be quite the worrier, but rest assured he only has your best interests at heart...
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_120: Are you and the children ready?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_121: I will explain the route once we are outside your camp.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_122: If anyone attempts to follow us, we will judge it an act of hostility. We will not hesitate to take appropriate measures.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_LUCIA_000_123: I would expect nothing less. You have our full cooperation.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_130: We will do only as instructed. After all, this is what we have been striving for ever since we arrived.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALISAIE_000_135: Where do you think their headquarters are? I assume there are a few others beside him and this commander he mentioned.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_140: All right, this is far enough. Listen carefully.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_141: We head over that hill, then follow the road until we reach Liminal Station IV.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_142: Children in the lead. I want you where I can see you.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALISAIE_000_143: We do have names, you know. I'm Alisaie, and he's Alphinaud. And last but not least, there's .
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_144: ... Where have I heard that before...?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_145: No matter. “Alphinaud” and “Alisaie” will watch the road ahead, while we bring up the rear.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_146: I wasn't lying about there being many dangers, so you're to run─not saunter, run─towards the station. If you even think about going for your weapon, the deal's off. Should any creatures bar the way, we go around them.
