TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_SYSTEM_000_147: Once you choose to depart, Jullus will accompany you. Alphinaud and Alisaie will then begin moving towards the destination.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_SYSTEM_000_148: Make your way to Liminal Station IV without falling behind.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_SYSTEM_000_149: If you leave Jullus behind for any reason, or lose sight of Alphinaud and Alisaie, you may try again by returning to the starting point.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_160: Ready to make a dash for the station?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_170: Over that hill, then follow the road until we reach the station. So, are you ready?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_SYSTEM_000_171: Once you choose to depart, Jullus will accompany you. Alphinaud and Alisaie will then begin moving towards the destination.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_175: Whenever you are ready, . Just give the word to Jullus.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALISAIE_000_176: What are we waiting for? Let's get this over with.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_177: I'm still unsure about leading the way, but we will do our best!
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_180: It's nothing like the ones in Thanalan...
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_195: If it's conversation you want, save it until we've arrived.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_Q3_000_200: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Jullus?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_201: Having second thoughts? Hmph! Very well. Return to and regroup where we started.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_205: No shuffling along at a snail's pace to give your comrades a chance to pursue us. You're to run as fast as you can─understood?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_SYSTEM_000_206: Jullus will now accompany you. Keep up with Alphinaud and Alisaie and head for your destination.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_SYSTEM_000_210: Jullus has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_215: Can't any of you follow simple instructions?
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_SYSTEM_000_216: Speak with Alphinaud or Alisaie at Camp Broken Glass to try again.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_220: This is it. The first stop, that is.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_221: Good. It looks like your friends knew better than to follow us.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_223: No. We're stopping here so I can check for pursuers. Since it appears you've kept to your side of the bargain, we can carry on.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALPHINAUD_000_230: We're getting closer to the imperial palace...if one can still call it that. It truly is a terrifying sight to behold...
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_ALISAIE_000_235: I wonder what sort of conditions Jullus and his comrades are living in. If they've any sense, they'll have picked somewhere like Victors' Spoils to take shelter.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_240: North of the station is Regio Domorum, one of the main residential areas. Or at least it was.
TEXT_AKTKMB108_04387_JULLUS_000_241: The afflicted roam the streets in packs. They'll tear us to shreds if given the chance. Keep close─no wandering off. Understood?
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_000: We're getting closer to the imperial palace...if one can still call it that. It truly is a terrifying sight to behold...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALISAIE_000_005: I wonder what sort of conditions Jullus and his comrades are living in. If they've any sense, they'll have picked somewhere like Victors' Spoils to take shelter.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_010: From here, we'll be heading northeast, keeping to the left of the railway.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_011: While the route itself is straightforward, getting past the hordes unseen is anything but. Keep your weapons at the ready.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_012: They would attack their own countrymen?
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_013: Aye. They spare their own but slaughter the rest without hesitation.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_014: Though we'll try to avoid detection, the chances of sneaking by completely unnoticed are slim at best. I will lead the way, but in the event we are seen...you're to fight them off.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_015: Those two will follow us, provided they can refrain from drawing their weapons. While I doubt they would be foolish enough to stab their guide in the back, I will not take that chance. With that said, let us proceed...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALISAIE_000_035: Godsdammit, we're perfectly capable of holding our own...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_040: I see why your comrades chose you.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Jullus, our contingent has a cure for the afflicted, or “tempered” as we call them.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Your people would need to be taken into custody that we may administer the treatment, but they would eventually regain their sanity.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_043: Is that so? For all I know, your “treatment” would simply force them to forsake one master for another.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_044: As far as I and my legion are concerned, they are no longer our people. They're beyond saving.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_045: Those who thought differently and tried to reason with them were butchered for their bleeding hearts. Come─we have to keep moving.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALISAIE_000_060: I hate to watch you bear this burden alone...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_070: Looks like we're not being followed. We will continue onward.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_080: The surest way to limit casualties is to reach our destination without drawing attention to ourselves. Perhaps afterwards we can try again to convince Jullus that the tempered can be saved...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALISAIE_000_085: He truly believes there's nothing that can be done for them. No wonder he isn't afraid to get his hands dirty...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_090: ...I meant what I said─these “people” deserve only death. I stayed my hand before only out of a desire to remain undiscovered, and that is still the higher priority. We should continue to avoid any unnecessary confrontations.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Such a transformation is likely irreversible...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALISAIE_000_115: To think they were once ordinary people...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_120: Look at what they have become. Would you still stand there and claim that they can be cured!?
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_121: Those exposed to a vast quantity of a primal's aether may suffer severe corruption...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_122: Even with treatment, such victims are beyond salvation.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_123: Then you admit it. Now that you have seen these monstrosities for yourself, perhaps you will think twice before speaking of a cure.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_130: Though I wish there was another way, I thank you for keeping us from harm.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALISAIE_000_135: Even here in the outskirts, it's plain to see how vastly different Garlemald is compared to other cities...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_141: You have kept your side of the agreement, so I will keep mine. This way.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_145: Seems secure enough, but hardly the most hospitable of places.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_150: This is Tertium, one of Garlemald's largest stations. It now serves as our headquarters.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_151: I've already sent the twins ahead. I will be with you soon, so wait for me at the bottom of the stairs.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_160: Go on, down the stairs, like I told you.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_161: Or is this your first time into an underground station? They're all over Garlemald. Even during severe blizzards, we could use them to travel from one end of the city to another. Back when they were still in operation, that is.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALISAIE_000_165: I had no idea they had such expansive structures built underground...
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_170: It's plain to see why they chose this as their base of operations.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALISAIE_000_171: They could have done a lot worse. Even so, I imagine it's not the easiest place to live.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_172: Indeed...and if Jullus was willing to make the perilous journey to Camp Broken Glass in search of food, their own supplies must be all but exhausted.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_ALPHINAUD_000_173: They may be shielded from the wind and snow, but it's still bitterly cold. Much like Victors' Spoils, it must be a constant struggle to keep their people warm.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_174: Lower your voices. While you may be here as my “guests,” the others will not take kindly to your presence.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_JULLUS_000_175: My commander is in the locomotive, over there.
TEXT_AKTKMB109_04388_QUINTUS_000_190: I will deal with you in a moment.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_000: It will take more than a trifle such as this to deter us.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Compared to what Garlemald's people have suffered in recent days, these collars are a minor inconvenience.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALISAIE_000_005: I have to remind myself not to touch it, even if it starts to itch. I'd rather not set if off by accident...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALISAIE_000_006: ...Anyway, enough about that. Let's learn what we can from the refugees.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_010: As per Lord Quintus's instructions, I am to supervise you during your time here in Tertium.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_011: Before you ask, no I don't have a key or any other means to remove your collars. Nor would I tell you if I did. And if you try anything, you'll soon wish you hadn't.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_012: So, do you truly intend to speak with the others, or was that merely a ruse?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_013: We're in no hurry to disobey Lord Quintus, if that's what you mean. Or perhaps you doubt the wisdom of his decision?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_014: ...Do as you will. But remember, I'll be watching.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_015: If I catch wind of you doing anything untoward─trying to trick our people into turning their coats and the like─those shock collars will be the least of your worries. Understood?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALISAIE_000_016: Though we're somewhat compromised, to put it lightly, let's not waste this opportunity. I suggest splitting up and learning what we can of their situation. And above all else, don't use magicks of any sort.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_017: You, on the other hand, may go wheresoever you wish. Even outside the camp. I know full well I couldn't stop you if I tried.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_018: But do not forget, if you do anything to endanger us or our interests, Alphinaud and Alisaie will pay the price.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Is there aught we may do to ease your woes?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALISAIE_000_025: So cold...and probably hasn't had a proper meal in days.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALISAIE_000_026: If only we'd brought some food with us. But perhaps I could use a little magic to─ No, I mustn't. Gods, this is so frustrating...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_030: You heard what I said. Don't make me repeat myself.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_SYSTEM_000_041: This young soldier is on the verge of losing consciousness.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_CAESO_000_050: You came with Jullus, didn't you? Well, whatever business brought you here, you'd best keep your hands off that aetheryte. It's deactivated, but I'd rather you didn't mess about with it.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_CAESO_000_051: There are others throughout the city. Built by Garleans─for Garleans. Could teleport all over in the blink of an eye, provided there was a terminal nearby.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_CAESO_000_052: These days, however, we use the aetheryte's power to keep this place lit, though that comes at the cost of its normal function.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_CAESO_000_055: My expertise in maintaining magitek weaponry isn't exactly applicable to the machina you'll find here, but I'll see if I can get this aetheryte working again. Anything to keep busy...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_MARCELLINUS_000_060: I know who you are. The so-called champion of Eorzea. Come to gloat, have you!?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_MARCELLINUS_000_061: I'll wipe that smirk off your face... By the blood of our fallen compatriots, I swear I'll─ Ugh!
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_MARCELLINUS_000_063: Of all the times... The worst of the lot within striking distance and I can't even muster the strength...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_MARCELLINUS_000_064: If it weren't for the IIIrd bleeding us, we'd be the end of you...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_MARCELLINUS_000_065: Vergilia's treachery nearly cost Lord Quintus his life, but we made our escape. Took shelter in a mansion─tended to the wounded as we prepared to strike back─and then...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_MARCELLINUS_000_066: Night fell and we gathered around the radio...then the roar, the terrible roar. The capital was in chaos, but we were spared...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_MARCELLINUS_000_067: ...If you can call this a mercy. Mind intact, but body broken. A soldier in name alone.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_MARCELLINUS_000_068: I'd cut you down where you stand if I could. Murderer...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_MARCELLINUS_000_070: How it must pain Lord Quintus to see our proud legion reduced to this. My suffering, my regrets─they are nothing compared to his.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_OCTAVIA_000_081: I-I served under Lord Gaius in the XIVth Legion. I was there on the night the Praetorium fell...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_OCTAVIA_000_082: You and your adventurers... You killed them. My comrades, my friends... Swept them aside in their dozens, as though they were nothing to you...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_OCTAVIA_000_083: ...And maybe I am too. Just another faceless enemy to be cut down. But it won't be long until our countrymen return─until you get what you deserve. Mark my words!
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_OCTAVIA_000_085: I was ready to abandon all hope...until I saw you. You... Soon, very soon, we'll make you pay for every life you've taken!
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_SYSTEM_000_090: This radio is the same model as the one used at Victors' Spoils. Perhaps it is what saved the soldiers here from being tempered...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Did you learn anything of note?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Then your findings are consistent with my own. Their plight is desperate indeed.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_102: The sick and injured are at greatest risk. Without warmth and proper nutrition, I fear they will soon perish.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_103: I realize there is precious little we can do for them at present, but I cannot bear to see them suffer.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_104: Please, will you help me tend to them?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_110: There are several people in the next carriage I have yet to speak with. Could you start there?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_FLAVIUS_000_120: Who's there? My eyes, they... I can't see all that well...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_FLAVIUS_000_121: Aaah... Thank you. The numbness has subsided a little.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_FLAVIUS_000_122: But I know...I won't last much longer. You should look to the others who can still fight. Give them my ration...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_FLAVIUS_000_123: If me going hungry means someone else lives to see another day, so be it. Least I can still serve in that way...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_FLAVIUS_000_130: Would...would you stay with me a little longer...? Hold my hand... Yours are so much warmer...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_140: So those you met fare no better? I was afraid you would say that.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_141: I know we were warned against meddling in their affairs, but we can't leave them like this. Perhaps we might gain permission to have the contingent deliver supplies?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_142: Quintus may have made his feelings on the matter quite clear, but even he must recognize they are not in a position to refuse help...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_143: Maybe Jullus could persuade him? Though we'd need to persuade Jullus first...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_161: Jullus, the people here have barely enough food and fuel to survive. Have you and the other soldiers been able to procure any more supplies?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_162: We've been scavenging provisions from the nearby houses, as most families keep─kept, rather─some stored away in the event they were snowed in.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_163: Still, going out and getting it is dangerous work, and we've a lot of mouths to feed.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_164: Fuel is the greater concern, though. We had some ceruleum set aside...until it was stolen.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_165: We haven't identified the culprit. Could've been other refugees, or one of the afflicted for all we know.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_166: Either way, we're down to the last dregs. Without the heating they need, those in poor health are only going to get worse instead of better...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALISAIE_000_167: If it's ceruleum you need, our contingent has secured a ready supply. We can have some sent over!
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_168: We will not accept your charity.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_169: If we can hold on a little longer, the situation is sure to change. Aye─everything will change...
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_A1_000_171: One of your comrades mentioned something along those lines.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_A1_000_172: Those mysterious countrymen of yours, I assume?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_173: Heard something of it, have you? Well. From what I've seen, there's little you could do to interfere, so there's no harm in telling you.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_174: One of our scouts spotted a hooded man issuing instructions to the afflicted─or in the bastard's words, “loyal servants of the Telophoroi.”
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_175: Then, he made his way inside the imperial palace─or what stands in its place.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_176: We'd identified the seat of the enemy's power, we realized. Lord Quintus dispatched a messenger to the Xth Legion saying as much, and instructing them to join forces with the provincial legions. To prepare for a combined assault on the Telophoroi.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_177: Once our allies arrive, your contingent will be sent running for the hills. Then, we shall reclaim the capital by our own hand!
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_178: And how do you intend to survive in the meantime? At this rate, many of your countrymen will perish long before reinforcements reach Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_179: They need help now. Say the word, and we will bring you ceruleum.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALISAIE_000_181: So? Did he agree to it?
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_182: No. He will not place Garlemald in the debt of her enemies.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_183: I have, however, been ordered to search for ceruleum outside. As you are under my watch, you will come with me.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_ALPHINAUD_000_184: Very well. After all, many hands make light work.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_185: <sigh> You lot are more trouble than you're worth.
TEXT_AKTKMB110_04389_JULLUS_000_186: Once we are outside, you will follow my instructions to the letter. We depart shortly.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Although this is hardly the solution we had in mind, it will have to suffice for the time being.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_005: Without our healing magicks, there's little we can do for these people beyond offer words of encouragement. But this way we'll be able to offer them tangible assistance.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_010: We will begin our search for ceruleum in Regio Urbanissima.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_011: The first location is Forum Solius, a park to the northwest of this station.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_012: You are to remain close at all times and act only as ordered. Follow me.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALPHINAUD_000_020: To think this macabre graveyard for warmachina was once a park...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_030: So, this is the park... I'm surprised they found space for one amongst all these buildings.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_031: Actually, the recreational areas came first. The houses were later built around them.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_032: "A healthy society requires communal spaces for children to play, and adults to socialize.“
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_033: This park was named after the founding father of the Empire, the great Solus zos Galvus.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALPHINAUD_000_034: Did we come to extract ceruleum from the wrecked magitek armor?
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_035: No, we've already drained it dry. Same goes for the rest of the machina in the vicinity.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_036: But as our ceruleum has been stolen, we must scour the city for every last drop.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_037: And while I don't expect to find anything here, I've decided to try one more time, in case something has been overlooked.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALPHINAUD_000_038: I see. Then with your permission, we will commence the search.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALPHINAUD_000_040: I don't imagine there would be much need for magitek in a park of all places, but then again, I wasn't raised in Garlemald. They may have uses for ceruleum that I've yet to consider.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_045: This...whatever-it-is appears to have some sort of symbolic meaning relating to this park. Even though the place is named after Solus, it doesn't seem to be a statue of him. Well, at least not anymore.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_046: Maybe it was once a fountain? Or somewhere the man himself used to sit? Not that it would matter, even if we knew, but I can't help wondering.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_SYSTEM_000_051: Jullus ignores you as he stares at the water in silence, as if searching for something he knows has gone and will never return...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_SYSTEM_000_060: Though rather small by Garlean standards, the structure is reminiscent of a merchant's stall. Perhaps it was built for children to play at shopkeeper.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_SYSTEM_000_061: There is nothing inside resembling magitek or any other devices that would be fueled by ceruleum...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_SYSTEM_000_065: Several points of interest are marked on the map of Forum Solius. The pond, children's play areas... To your knowledge, however, none would require the use of ceruleum.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_SYSTEM_000_070: A cursory inspection of the wrecked magitek armor confirms that the fuel canisters have long since been drained of ceruleum, as Jullus said.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_SYSTEM_000_075: The contraption is built in the style of imperial warmachina armed with a battery of weapons and capable of transforming into different configurations...but on closer inspection, it appears to be no more than a children's slide.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALPHINAUD_000_081: There's no sign of any ceruleum.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_082: Hmm... Hardly surprising, but disappointing nonetheless.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_083: I couldn't help noticing you gazing at the pond. Is something the matter?
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_084: What? Yes─ I mean, no, I'm...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_085: It's just...I used to bring my brother and sister here to play.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_086: The pond was heated to stop it from freezing over, so like all the other children, they just had to wade in and splash about. Would've stayed there if I didn't drag them out. We'd be sopping wet when all was said and done. Every time.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_087: And every time, when we'd get home, Mother would scold us, saying we'd catch our death walking around like that...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALPHINAUD_000_089: With a ceruleum-powered heater, by chance?
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_090: I suppose it must have been... Come to think of it, I remember seeing engineers changing out a tank beneath a hatch...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_091: But that was a long time ago, when the water still flowed clear and wasn't this...brackish muck.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_092: We can't see a thing, and I can't remember where the hatch might be.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_093: With the machinery most likely broken, the amount of filth in there is probably the only reason it hasn't frozen over. I'd wager it's still unbearably cold, though.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_094: Jullus...what are your thoughts on magic?
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_095: The average Garlean would jump out of their skin if they saw it. But the Ist has a few foreign signiferi and medici, so it doesn't scare me.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_096: Then I take it you won't mind if I employ a little now.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_097: Alphinaud, as you have a knack for finding dry wood, why don't you bring me some? Once that's done, a blast of Verfire should do the trick.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_099: You're not planning to go in there, are you?
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_100: Of course I am. That tank isn't going to fetch itself.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_101: It's nothing so involved as extracting unprocessed ceruleum from a frozen lake like how the tappers do it. We're talking about a shallow pond in a park. And we have a way of warming ourselves up after.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_A1_000_105: A little friendly competition might make things interesting...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_A1_000_106: The last thing we need is you catching a cold.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_A1_000_107: Step aside while I drink the pond dry! That way, we'll find it in no time!
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_108: Last one to find a ceruleum tank is a rotten egg! Though I daresay we'll both smell like rotten eggs when this is over...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_109: If you're that concerned for my well-being, you can dive in and help me look! The quicker we find that ceruleum, the sooner we can get out of here.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_110: That may be the stupidest thing I've heard in a while! And that's saying something considering who my brother is.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_111: I can't fault your enthusiasm, though. Let's do it my way first, and if that doesn't work...perhaps then you can try your method. With Alphinaud's help.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_120: G-G-Gods be good, it's cold! Perhaps we sh-sh-should've listened to Jullus after all!
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_125: I can't believe what I'm seeing...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_SYSTEM_000_130: You delve into the murky water but come up empty-handed. To add injury to insult, the icy wind on your damp clothing chills you to the bone...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_SYSTEM_000_135: Beneath the water, your fingers catch on what you think might be a handle...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_SYSTEM_000_136: You open the hatch and retrieve a ceruleum tank!
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_SYSTEM_000_137: However, your grand discovery comes at great personal cost, as you become acutely aware of the freezing cold and a rancid odor emanating from every ilm of your body. Jullus will doubtless feel compelled to pinch his nose shut when you deliver to him your prize...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_140: You f-f-found it!? Hmph! There must be another one around here s-s-somewhere!
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_150: Did you find anything? <sniff> <sniff> I hope you did...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_152: And there's still some ceruleum left!
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_153: Ah, the fire's still not ready... Hold on, I'll give Alphinaud a hand!
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_154: Call me an Ul'dahn because by fire I am reborn...and my clothes are mostly dry now, too.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_155: I appreciate you recovering the ceruleum, but I wish you'd taken the time to discuss the plan with me beforehand.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_156: Despite the way you've been treated, in Lord Quintus's eyes, you're still envoys deserving of protection. If you were to die on my watch, he would be most displeased.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_157: Your concern is duly noted, but all's well that ends well.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALPHINAUD_000_158: Jullus, you mentioned coming here with your younger siblings. Did you grow up in Garlemald?
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_159: I did. Not far from here.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_160: My father was an accomplished researcher in his youth, and for his contributions to the Empire awarded an estate. We lived well─better than many.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_ALISAIE_000_161: What was Garlemald like in those days?
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_162: ...Everything. It was everything you could imagine...and so much more.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_163: Even during the coldest winters, we always found warmth and comfort at home.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_164: Coming in from the snow, taking off your coat and sitting down for a hot meal...with family...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_165: Visiting friends and relatives, receiving that same welcome. Knowing they had everything they needed.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_166: Walking down the street, seeing the lights in all the houses, hearing the faint sounds of laughter and song. Of happiness...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_167: And although the summers came and went all too quickly, in that brief respite, the ice would melt and the forgotten grass make its triumphant return.
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_168: Grey clouds gave way to blue skies. Some mornings, we'd climb to the top of the tallest building we could find to watch the sun rise...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_169: ...Never again. Those rooftops are rubble. Those friends dead, and those memories... But if I could reclaim even a fraction of what we once had...
TEXT_AKTKMB111_04390_JULLUS_000_170: Soon, our chance will come. We just need to hold on a little longer...
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Owing to the wealth of experience I've accrued in gathering firewood, I was even able to provide Jullus with some basic pointers on the subject. I thought it might help to further build a rapport...and to distract him from his other concerns.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_ALISAIE_000_005: Well, at least my clothes are finally dry. Though they could still do with a proper wash.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_010: All right, now that you've recovered from your escapades in the pond, there's another location I'd like to search, just outside the park.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_ALPHINAUD_000_020: The warmachina appears to be patrolling the area of its own volition. I wonder whether it is simply following its original orders, or if it now serves the Telophoroi...
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_ALISAIE_000_025: Everything was built on an enormous scale, and with thick, cleanly cut stone─much like Amaurot. Given what we now know, such similarities are no coincidence.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_030: As you can see, this place is littered with the remnants of various types of warmachina.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_031: While my comrades and I have already recovered the tanks from the less-damaged units, those that took a more severe beating are harder to scavenge. We decided to save those for another time─that time being now.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_032: Rather than prise them apart, piece by piece, it would be quicker to remove the outer casing using compact explosives. With luck, we'll gain access to the tanks without rupturing them.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_033: Though the force generated by these devices is relatively weak, I would advise you stand well clear to avoid being hit by any shrapnel.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_034: Before even bothering, though, you should check the machina's ceruleum gauge to see if there is any left. It should still provide an accurate reading even when the unit itself is inactive.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_035: If the gauge is broken... I'll let you decide whether to use an explosive or not. Should you need more, come to me.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_040: You still have the explosives I gave you, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_041: Remember to check the ceruleum gauge before attempting to remove the outer casing.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_042: If the gauge has been damaged and you can't determine if there's any fuel left to recover, use your best judgment.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_046: I've a fair amount of explosives to spare today, but tomorrow is another story. We can't afford to waste them on units with nothing to offer, so be sure to check the gauge first.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_047: Of course, if the gauge is damaged, it's up to you to make the call.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_SYSTEM_000_050: According to the ceruleum gauge, this unit's fuel tank is empty.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_SYSTEM_000_051: After successfully removing the warmachina's outer casing and retrieving the ceruleum tank, you find it to be completely empty...
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_SYSTEM_000_055: The ceruleum gauge on this unit appears to have been broken, giving you no way to determine how much fuel its tank may hold...
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_SYSTEM_000_056: After successfully removing the warmachina's outer casing and retrieving the ceruleum tank, you find it to be completely empty...
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_SYSTEM_000_060: The ceruleum gauge on this unit appears to have been broken, giving you no way to determine how much fuel its tank may hold...
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_SYSTEM_000_061: You retrieve the warmachina's ceruleum tank to find...it is still half-full! Or half-empty, depending on one's perspective. Either way, Jullus will surely be pleased by your discovery.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_SYSTEM_000_065: You need to ask Jullus for more explosives.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_070: More explosives? ...Wait, is that what I think it is?
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_071: You've done it again! Truly, luck is on your side.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_072: With this, we should be able to refuel quite a few of our heaters.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_073: It's time we headed back. Wait here while I go and see how Alisaie and Alphinaud are faring.
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_MARCELLINUS_000_075: Why are you here? To laugh at our misfortune!?
TEXT_AKTKMB112_04391_JULLUS_000_080: Alphinaud and Alisaie will be fine...providing they do not resist.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_MARCELLINUS_100_000: Why are you here? To laugh at our misfortune!?
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_000: You will accompany me back to your camp, where I will meet with your leader and present Lord Quintus's demands.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_001: Before we depart, however, there is something I would ask of you.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_002: Assuming your contingent complies, the supplies they surrender will need to be transported here.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_003: That task falls to Legionaries Marcellinus and Octavia, who will pilot magitek armor to your headquarters. You are to inform them that we are leaving shortly.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_004: Tell them to ask the iyl for further details. In those words.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_005: Once you've seen to that, meet me by the exit.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_MARCELLINUS_000_011: "Ask the iyl,“ he said? Heh...heh heh... <sigh>
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_MARCELLINUS_000_012: So. That's to be the way of it. After all this...
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_MARCELLINUS_000_013: How ironic that you should be the one to deliver the news.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_MARCELLINUS_000_014: If those are my orders, then so be it. For the glory...of Garlemald...
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_OCTAVIA_000_020: What do you want with me!?
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_OCTAVIA_000_021: "Ask the iyl“... So Lord Quintus has reached a decision.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_OCTAVIA_000_022: I knew he would understand. That he would recognize the savage is a ruthless, merciless creature, and to defeat him, we too must be...uncompromising...
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_OCTAVIA_000_023: I...am ready. In the name of Emperor Varis, for the glory of Garlemald, I will fulfill...my duty!
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_A1_000_032: Their duties involve more than the transportation of supplies, don't they?
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_A1_000_033: What do you mean by “ask the iyl”?
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_034: Duty is rarely a simple thing. We have been given additional orders, though whether we will be required to follow them depends entirely on your contingent.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_035: I am not at liberty to divulge that. What I can say is this: you have no cause for concern if our demands are met.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_036: You and I are in this together now. Like it or not, we have to cooperate.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_037: There is one other matter... A place I'd like to visit on the way to your camp.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_038: It's a short walk from here. Follow me.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_SYSTEM_000_050: Jullus lingers by the ruins, reluctant to leave and reluctant to stay. Unable to move on...
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_JULLUS_000_060: We will make no attempt to resist.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_LUCIA_000_070: Much and more has occurred since last we met.
TEXT_AKTKMB113_04392_LUCIA_000_071: As for determining what comes next, we must speak with Lord Quintus.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_JULLUS_000_000: We will make no attempt to resist.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_010: Before we proceed, tell me what you know of the Ist Legion and the disposition of their forces.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_011: They were preparing for war while the refugees in their care were left to go hungry? A reckless, shortsighted plan that risks the welfare of the people they are sworn to protect.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_012: Nevertheless, we cannot compel them to accept our aid. If we were to arrive in force with the intent to do so, we would only incite panic...but perhaps they can be persuaded to follow one of their own.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_013: Go with Jullus back to the station and have him lead the refugees here. Some may be unwilling or unable to leave, but for the time being, I'll take what I can get.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_014: Alphinaud, Alisaie, and the scouts sent to extricate them should already be at the station. I will also have our other comrades in the area lend their support should it be needed.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_020: I will have food and bedding prepared for the refugees. Getting them here safely, however, is my immediate concern...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_URIANGER_000_025: 'Tis a comfort to see thee none the worse for thy recent ordeals.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_GRAHATIA_000_030: Oh, I did not expect you to arrive so soon. There's been a...development. Perhaps you had best see for yourself.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_COLLEAGUESOLDIER_00: What are you doing back here? Where are Jullus and the others!?
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_ALISAIE_000_041: We arrived just before you did...and too late.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_JULLUS_000_042: Too late for what? What's happened?
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_COLLEAGUESOLDIER_00: It's Lord Quintus... He took his own life.
After the news about the Xth, he relieved us of our duties. Then, when he was alone, he...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_URIANGER_000_046: Thancred and the others─assisted by the soldiers─have seen to the remains.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_URIANGER_000_047: In due course shall the legatus be afforded a proper burial.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_COLLEAGUESOLDIER_00: He released us from our duty...
He wanted us to be free. Free to choose our own fate.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_JULLUS_000_050: Without him to guide us, we're... I...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_GRAHATIA_000_051: I have just this moment spoken with Lucia.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_GRAHATIA_000_052: We are ready to commence the transfer of the refugees here to Camp Broken Glass, should they be willing to accept our aid.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_COLLEAGUESOLDIER_00: ...But most of us just want to live. Songs and standards be damned─we just want to live.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_ALISAIE_000_055: We'll need to speak with the refugees. They'll have to decide for themselves if they wish to come with us.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_ALISAIE_000_056: If any would prefer to stay, we can have supplies brought over for them. It'll be a hard journey for the others, but we'll see they reach our camp safely.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_COLLEAGUESOLDIER_00: After what happened to his family, the Ist was all Jullus had left. Now even that's been taken away from him...
He's not alone in that, either. There's a comfort in having someone to follow. Someone to lead...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_THANCRED_000_070: ...Best not to dwell on it. Not when there's work to be done.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_SABINIANUS_000_080: It was only ever a dream, wasn't it. To think we could reclaim it. Rebuild it all ourselves...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_SABINIANUS_000_081: Before this all began...I sent my wife and daughter away to the provinces...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_SABINIANUS_000_082: If there's a chance I might see them again, I'll take it. So take me. Take me with you...please.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_SABINIANUS_000_090: I can walk, I think. Just give me a few more moments...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_CAESO_000_100: Well...got the aetheryte sorted in the end. All it took was a few adjustments, and now it works as well as it ever did...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_CAESO_000_101: From what I can tell, the one in Laterum is also functioning as normal. That's where you lot are staying, isn't it?
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_CAESO_000_102: Now that most of us are packing up and leaving this place, I reckon there'll be more use for me and my skills over at your camp...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_CAESO_000_110: Since the aetheryte's functioning again, why not give it a try? Be a waste if no one did...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_FLAVIUS_000_120: Ah...it's you. The one who treated me with such kindness...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_FLAVIUS_000_121: I heard from the others that you're not from around here... Heh...I thought you were one of us. Not that it makes much difference now.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_FLAVIUS_000_122: Purebloods, migrants, savages... After a while the words start to lose meaning...until all you're left with is anger and fear and hate and I'm...I'm too tired...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_FLAVIUS_000_123: If you and yours have come to offer aid, I'd be glad to accept.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_FLAVIUS_000_130: I don't believe I asked you your name...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_FLAVIUS_000_131: ... Thank you. I will remember it... Always.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_ALPHINAUD_000_141: Our rescue, the attack on Camp Broken Glass...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_ALPHINAUD_000_142: ...What we'd hoped to talk about with Quintus...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_ALPHINAUD_000_143: But all of that can wait. More urgent matters demand our attention.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_ALPHINAUD_000_144: Are any of the refugees willing to come to our camp?
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_ALPHINAUD_000_145: Thank the Twelve. Thank the Twelve...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_THANCRED_000_146: You and I should go first and secure the route back to Camp Broken Glass.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_THANCRED_000_147: With all the creatures and tempered skulking about, I expect we'll have our hands full.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_THANCRED_000_148: This should come in handy. Conqueror's Chain, courtesy of our Lominsan friends. I'd save it for the tempered, though.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_THANCRED_000_149: I'll mark a few points that need surveying on your map. Once you've taken care of the riffraff, we'll meet back at our camp.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_ALPHINAUD_000_160: I will stay with the refugees and do what I can to protect them.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_ALPHINAUD_000_161: While I have no doubt that you and Thancred will do a fine job clearing a path, we must be ever vigilant for threats that may have slipped the net.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_POPMESSAGE_000_170: A tempered soldier bars the way! Subdue him first, then use the Conqueror's Chain.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_SYSTEM_000_175: You see no threats on the path ahead.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_THANCRED_000_181: As expected, I ran into a few beasts who went down without much of a fight. The tempered proved somewhat troublesome, but those chains should keep them under control until our allies take them into custody.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_THANCRED_000_182: With that taken care of, I'm to gather a few supplies and then return to the station.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_THANCRED_000_183: While I see to that, would you mind apprising Lucia of our progress?
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_THANCRED_000_184: As it happens, I have some rather pertinent information from our recent scouting forays, but I'll save that for later. First things first, and all that.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_YSHTOLA_000_190: Welcome back. I hope they haven't been working you too hard...
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_200: Ah, . I was informed of Quintus's suicide... It must have come as a great shock to his men.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_201: What of the refugees? I'm told some were receptive to our proposal, but I would hear your firsthand account.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_202: That so many did not hesitate to accept proves how desperate their situation has become. We'll do our best to make them feel welcome.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_203: The troops who participated in the ambush are no exception. They will be afforded the same treatment as any other refugees, perfidy notwithstanding. After all, even if I wanted to make an example of them, there's no one left to learn from it.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_204: We will tell our allies that these soldiers were acting under the direct orders of their legatus, and that following his suicide, they offered a full and unconditional surrender.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_205: Perhaps Quintus thought that had he lived, he would be tried as a war criminal, and his men punished with him. Perhaps, by taking his own life, he hoped to absolve them of any culpability. Or perhaps, like too many others, he was a true believer to the end.
TEXT_AKTKMB114_04393_LUCIA_000_206: Who can say. I didn't know the man, or his heart. His reasons, noble or otherwise, died with him, and it falls to us to clean up the mess...
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_YSHTOLA_000_000: I see that you're still standing. Might I convince you to sit down? ...No, I thought not.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_LUCIA_000_010: I assume you're curious about how matters have progressed here in your absence. Quite well, as it happens.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_LUCIA_000_011: Now that we've procured ceruleum from Tapper's Den, the recently repaired heaters can provide much-needed warmth.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_LUCIA_000_012: Furthermore, we've prepared sufficient food for everyone. Those from Tertium shall find a hot meal waiting upon their arrival.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_LUCIA_000_013: There's one for you, so go ahead and get some well-earned rest. I believe that we're capable of wielding a ladle or two without your assistance.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_LUCIA_000_014: On your way, might I ask you to seek out Y'shtola? She was but recently attending to the wounded, but she's meant to be taking a rest herself. See that she is.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_LUCIA_000_020: Were it not for you, Alphinaud, and Alisaie, the people of Tertium may well have perished. Though they may not realize it yet, they owe you their lives.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_YSHTOLA_000_030: Yes, yes, I have been taking proper breaks and imbibing sufficient water. But what of the Warrior of Light? You and the twins have an established history of reckless disregard for your own well-being.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_YSHTOLA_000_031: We're all fortunate that none of you landed yourselves in my care. I've already quite enough to deal with, between the tempered and the Ist's wounded.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_YSHTOLA_000_032: Alas, though I can mend their bodies, the toll their experiences have taken on their hearts and minds is another matter altogether.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_YSHTOLA_000_033: For their sakes, we mustn't waver─but nor must we rush ahead in eagerness to see the day won, and in so doing invite disaster...
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_SYSTEM_000_035: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 83 or above to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_SYSTEM_000_040: Upon settling down for supper, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_SYSTEM_000_041: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_Q1_000_042: Settle down for a restful supper?
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Are you certain that you've recovered? You mustn't push yourself, especially after an experience like that.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_THANCRED_000_055: No apologies necessary, least of all to me. If anything, there's a strange comfort in knowing I'm no longer the only one to have been used as a villain's puppet. Though I pray you'll be the last...
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_URIANGER_000_060: Full glad am I to see thee awake and restored to thine own flesh once more.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_YSHTOLA_000_066: My apologies─I realized too late that the aether emanating from the tower was distorting my perception. 'Twas likely a temporary effect, but I remain wary.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_GRAHATIA_000_070: Thank heavens you're you again. Gave me quite a fright.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_ESTINIEN_000_075: Whatever that was, let's not do it again, eh?
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_LUCIA_000_080: I will require a detailed report on what occurred whilst you were...not yourself. For the contingent, of course.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_LUCIA_000_081: It can wait until later, however. For now, it's enough that you've returned.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_MAXIMA_000_085: The body that you were forced to inhabit turned cold and stiff the moment you were returned to your own. Perhaps the soul it belonged to is long gone...
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_MAXIMA_000_086: Let us pray it is so, for I doubt it would be better off in the care of Zenos or Fandaniel.
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_ALISAIE_000_090: You're certain you're well? Nothing out of place? No missing bits?
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_ALISAIE_000_091: Good. Though I won't promise the same for Fandaniel and Zenos after I'm through with them...
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_ALISAIE_000_092: How much must these people suffer before they're satisfied?
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_ALISAIE_000_093: How many cruel, pointless tricks must they play?
TEXT_AKTKMB115_04394_ALISAIE_000_094: Prelude to the Final Days or no, this ends now!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I realize that my sister is...eager to proceed, but please be sure that you've fully recovered before you throw caution to the wind.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALISAIE_000_005: So, how shall we strike them down?
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_010: ...I suppose your experience was a bit different, though. Unlike you, I had the pleasure of being stuck with Lahabrea while he went gallivanting about doing a poor impression of me. It adds another layer to the insult, believe you me.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_URIANGER_000_015: Full glad am I to see thee awake and restored to thine own flesh once more.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_021: My apologies─I realized too late that the aether emanating from the tower was distorting my perception. 'Twas likely a temporary effect, but I remain wary.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_GRAHATIA_000_025: Thank heavens you're you again. Gave me quite a fright.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ESTINIEN_000_030: Whatever that was, let's not do it again, eh?
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAXIMA_000_035: The body that you were forced to inhabit turned cold and stiff the moment you were returned to your own. Perhaps the soul it belonged to is long gone...
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAXIMA_000_036: Let us pray it is so, for I doubt it would be better off in the care of Zenos or Fandaniel.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_040: Are you well enough to make your report?
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_041: This “Anima” was summoned with the corpse of Emperor Varis? Does their depravity know no bounds?
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_042: It seems not. More to the point, we can surmise that wave of aether issued not from the Tower of Babil, but from the primal lurking within it...
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_043: A primal whose cry rang rather more loudly in your ears than ours.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_044: If you were taken to the tower itself, then this proves beyond a shadow of a doubt that it is the beating heart of the Telophoroi's machinations.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_045: In which case, we have some highly relevant information.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_046: As many of you know, ever since we dispatched troops to free the Leveilleurs, we've been developing a plan to infiltrate the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_047: According to Thancred and his scouts, the main structure is lousy with tempered and enemy magitek.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_048: Furthermore, the road leading to it has collapsed, making it difficult to approach in numbers.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAXIMA_000_049: Thus do we propose dividing our forces into two parties─one to distract, and one to infiltrate.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAXIMA_000_050: The diversionary force will be comprised of the Ishgardian, Gridanian, and Lominsan delegations.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAXIMA_000_051: They will begin the construction of bridges, to make the Telophoroi believe we are marching upon the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAXIMA_000_052: Meanwhile, the best suited of our Ala Mhigan, Ul'dahn, and Eastern comrades will use a different method of ingress.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_054: The facility marked in red is the Enceladeum, a vast magitek manufactory. In ruins now, of course.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_055: But the freight tunnel connecting it to the erstwhile imperial palace remains intact.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_056: While the Telophoroi's attention is elsewhere, our infiltration force can use it to enter the tower undetected.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_057: Be aware, however, that the underground rail network remains very much operational.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_058: The tempered are using it to bring supplies to the tower even now.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_059: ...If it can carry their materiel, it can carry us too, providing we sneak aboard unseen.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_060: The Scions will lead the infiltration party. Once inside, you must locate and dispatch Fandaniel and Zenos.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_A1_000_062: We will save the people of Garlemald─and those who suffer the world over.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_A1_000_064: It's time we ended this, once and for all.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Aye. Jullus and so many others have lost much to the Telophoroi. We shall ensure they lose no more.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALISAIE_000_066: We'll get our fill─you and me both.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_067: Aye. There will be no more casualties of the Telophoroi's maniacal ambition.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_068: How quickly can we enact this plan?
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_069: Fandaniel made it quite clear that haste is a priority.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_GRAHATIA_000_070: Of paramount concern, even, assuming he didn't name the tower “Babil” on a whim.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_GRAHATIA_000_071: In Amon's time, it meant “gateway of the gods.” Xande used it to refer to a voidgate, but in this case, it almost certainly alludes to something altogether greater...
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_GRAHATIA_000_072: ...The eldest and most powerful of primals.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_073: All the more reason to act now. The rest of the contingent is aware of the plan, and are ready to move at a moment's notice.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_074: You are to proceed north to Forum Patens. Lyse's group will meet you there.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_075: As ever, we are grateful for your foresight.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_076: This is the moment we've been waiting for. Spare no effort in your preparations.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_080: Lyse's party ought to have secured the tunnel by now. Rendezvous with them and make your way inside.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LUCIA_000_081: May the Fury guide you...and us all.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAXIMA_000_085: Those not taking part in the assault will defend this camp and the airships, as well as safeguard your escape route from the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAXIMA_000_086: You need not worry about what comes after─so fight with all you have.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_CIRINA_000_090: I am to accompany you into the tower. It is an honor, as ever!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAGNAI_000_100: The Sun does not sneak. ...However, he will travel this path of yours, and those who walk with him will bask in his radiance.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_110: ! The way into the tunnel is clear. We've made sure of it.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_A2_000_112: I wish you'd made sure to bring a coat instead.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_A2_000_113: Then we'd best get in there before we freeze. Especially you.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_114: Oh, I'll warm up when I throw a punch or two.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_115: Oh, the shoe will be on the other foot once we're in, believe you me. A good fight should warm us right up!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAGNAI_000_116: Hmph. Barely enough cloth to swaddle a newborn. Clearly, you have spent too long around this feral dog of a Dotharl.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_SADU_000_117: Watch your tongue, fool, lest I feed it to the crows!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAGNAI_000_118: We will see who is the fool when you freeze to death. Expect me not to warm your ill-prepared hide─these furs are for myself and my Nhaama alone, should I be blessed to meet her this day.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_SADU_000_119: As if any woman of worth would wish to be warmed by you, “little sun.” Should we find such a warrior within, she will bask in my glorious flame.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_CIRINA_000_120: Stop, both of you! Save your fire for the enemy. As for extra furs, I have plenty to spare!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_122: Hello, everyone! All set for battle, I see.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_123: Yes, free of unnecessary encumbrances, if rather more susceptible to the cold. Let us review our strategy─quickly, if you don't mind.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_124: Pipin's group has gone ahead to the Enceladeum. We are to meet them there.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_125: We wait until the tempered's attention is drawn by our diversionary force, then we sneak onto the train. Next stop: the Tower of Babil!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_CIRINA_000_126: If any─tempered included─are injured, we Xaela will tend to them.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_CIRINA_000_127: You Scions must press on, no matter what.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_128: We should avoid moving as a group until we're underground, so we'll need to make our own ways to the Enceladeum. See you there.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_130: We'll stagger our departures so as not to raise suspicion. You go on ahead.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALISAIE_000_135: Who could possibly be cold at a time like this? My pulse is pounding with anticipation!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_140: ...I think it's time I was off. If I look at Urianger for one more moment I'm liable to freeze solid.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_URIANGER_000_145: C-C-Cold? N-N-Nay, I feel nary a thing...
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_150: Fear not─no serious wounds have gone untreated. Nor will I stand for being left behind while the rest of you rush headlong into danger, so you needn't bother suggesting it.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_GRAHATIA_000_155: ...And you're one-hundred percent certain you're alright? No odd specters haunting your wake? Nothing feels...tingly?
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ESTINIEN_000_160: I am unfamiliar with this route. The entrance Gaius and I used was demolished in the construction of that towering monstrosity.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_165: Just head north, and you'll reach the Enceladeum soon enough!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_CIRINA_000_170: The Scions are welcome to our spare furs as well! Erm, you might mention that to Urianger...
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAGNAI_000_175: A “glorious flame”...? Nay, I would have seen it, were it so...
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_SADU_000_180: I crave battle, not this insipid chatter.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LENTESTEARSGATEKEEP: Apologies, but we need a moment more to finish our sweep of the station. Wouldn't want to leave anything to chance.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_PIPIN_000_190: Hail! It's good to see you, .
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_PIPIN_000_191: We heard that you collapsed, but were given only the most cursory explanation. I'm glad you've recovered─and quickly enough to take part in the operation, at that.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_PIPIN_000_192: As you will have heard, we've secured the way in. Some few are to remain behind to keep your escape route clear.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_PIPIN_000_193: Our comrade from Lente's Tears will lead the way into the station. I'll join you soon.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_PIPIN_000_200: I will send the others to meet you in the station below.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LENTESTEARSGATEKEEP: The station is right this way. Tread lightly, now.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_CIRINA_000_211: Consider the enemy well and truly distracted!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_213: Our primary objective is, of course, the Telophoroi's leaders.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_214: But should we be presented with an opportunity to vanquish Anima, we must seize it.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_215: If it is indeed the force behind the towers, destroying it will deliver our allies from the Telophoroi's reign of terror.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_216: And I, for one, would not see the Garlean people manipulated any longer, be it by primal, Ascian, or anything else.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_217: Hear, hear. There's been enough of that.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_218: We came to help the people of Garlemald, and that's what we're going to do. Together!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_PIPIN_000_220: The train should be along any moment now. Prepare to board, everyone!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_A4_000_232: Form a party and enter the Tower of Babil.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_240: I'm only too aware that our intervention may not be what many of Garlemald's people want or need right now.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_241: Not every tragedy can be laid at the feet of the Telophoroi. Certainly not that of Licinia and her sister.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_242: Nevertheless, we must follow our conscience, and mine has led me here.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALISAIE_000_245: Much as I'd like to be the one to wipe the grin off Fandaniel's smug little face, I haven't lost sight of why we're here.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALISAIE_000_246: Our ultimate goal is to prevent the Telophoroi from doing any further harm, no matter how.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALISAIE_000_247: But if I do get the chance to introduce my fist to his jaw─and gods, do I hope I do─I won't turn it down!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_250: We were only able to ascertain that the tunnel connects to the tower. I fear I have little to offer as to the details of the interior or present situation therein.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_251: If Fandaniel is to be believed, we don't have the luxury of time to scout ahead, so we'll have to trust in your instincts. They've served us well enough thus far.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_URIANGER_000_255: 'Tis no meager delight to watch Alisaie and Alphinaud grow more resolute in mind and heart.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_URIANGER_000_256: And remarkable though their accomplishments may be, I doubt not that they are destined for still greater things.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_URIANGER_000_257: Grant them thy protection, Master Louisoix. I implore thee...
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_260: Assuming Fandaniel intends to make Zodiark serve as a catalyst for the Final Days...
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_261: One cannot but wonder if he willingly parted ways with the other Ascians long ago.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_262: Surely they would not have permitted the very god they created to forestall the world's end to be used in such a way.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_GRAHATIA_000_265: If Fandaniel truly is Amon, to create a gate through which a primal may pass will not be beyond him.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_GRAHATIA_000_266: From what I gather, he was utterly brilliant─and utterly mad.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ESTINIEN_000_270: When Zenos murdered Varis, Gaius was upon him in an instant. Seldom have I seen such fury.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ESTINIEN_000_271: I won't pretend to know the bond they shared, but pain, fear, rage...I know them well. I know what can drive a man to drown in them.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ESTINIEN_000_272: Though his homeland may have wished for his blade, my lance will roar in its stead.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_PIPIN_000_280: The train we're boarding is meant to carry supplies and armaments and the like.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_PIPIN_000_281: With any luck, we can slip past the tempered as they go about loading the freight.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_285: It's likely that Anima, at least, will notice when we enter the tower. There's no point in trying to stay hidden after that.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LYSE_000_286: So when the time comes, I say don't overthink it, and cut a path straight through!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_CIRINA_000_290: Strange. Though this will be a more fearsome fight than any Naadam, I feel at peace...
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_CIRINA_000_291: Maybe it is because I have Sadu, Magnai, and you at my side.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_CIRINA_000_292: Maybe it is because we fight for all Xaela, and more peoples besides. There is but one path─that which leads to victory!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_SADU_000_295: Aye, aye, kill no man. I have not forgotten your instruction. I must settle for crushing the ironmen's toys. Their blue blood will feed my flames!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAGNAI_000_300: Your comrades tell me that the Telophoroi abducted you on the selfsame eve they so rudely interrupted our meal. A brazen feat that would make a Buduga proud.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_MAGNAI_000_301: But even had it not ended poorly, it was a disappointment in many respects. I have decided that when we return triumphant, the Oronir will hold a far grander feast on the Azim Steppe. You have permission to attend.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_LENTESTEARSGATEKEEP: The area is secure. May I escort you to the top of the tower?
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALISAIE_000_330: Stand there for just a moment, please.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALISAIE_000_331: ...A prayer for good luck. Now you can't possibly fail!
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_THANCRED_000_335: We're moving out to rendezvous with the remainder of the contingent. Leave everything here to us.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_URIANGER_000_340: Fear not for Krile. Go forth...and return, I prithee.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_345: She channeled a dangerous amount of aether. And that's to say nothing of the teleportation magick she must have used to get here.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_YSHTOLA_000_346: Yet Krile and Hydaelyn both were clearly willing to take the risk. Hmm.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ESTINIEN_000_355: We've no time for worrying over what's done. Let's go.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_370: If all of the tempered are affected, Jullus and his comrades likely put up quite the struggle.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_371: We'll find a way to save them─we must. I only pray we are not too late.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_ALPHINAUD_000_372: In the meantime...may the Twelve carry you to victory.
TEXT_AKTKMB116_04395_SYSTEM_000_373: You may now enter the Tower of Babil with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I have faith in you. Now and always.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_ALISAIE_000_005: Stand there for just a moment, please.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_ALISAIE_000_006: ...A prayer for good luck. Now you can't possibly fail!
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_THANCRED_000_010: We're moving out to rendezvous with the remainder of the contingent. Leave everything here to us.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_URIANGER_000_015: Fear not for Krile. Go forth...and return, I prithee.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_YSHTOLA_000_020: I'm the last person who should be scolding others for using dangerous teleportation magicks. But if that is indeed how Krile reached us in time, I do wish Hydaelyn had taken a little more care...
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_YSHTOLA_000_021: Regardless, 'tis nothing Urianger and I cannot put right.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_ESTINIEN_000_025: We've no time for worrying over what's done. Let's go.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_GRAHATIA_000_040: My apologies─I was lost in thought. This device is of Allagan design, which leads me to think I was right about Fandaniel.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_GRAHATIA_000_041: No matter what he claims, he still has an attachment to the trappings of his past...
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_GRAHATIA_000_042: Whether knowing this will make your path forward clearer, I cannot say, but bear it in mind.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_GRAHATIA_000_043: But let us turn to the task at hand. As Hydaelyn said, the flow of aether will transport you to Mare Lamentorum.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_GRAHATIA_000_044: We must hope this ally of Hers can provide you with the necessary assistance to restore the seal before Zenos and Fandaniel arrive to stop you.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_GRAHATIA_000_045: It seems we are ever one step behind, but I have faith that you'll make up the difference.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_GRAHATIA_000_046: Know that whatever awaits, our prayers are with you. Now go─beyond the sky!
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_GRAHATIA_000_050: Spare a glance our way from on high, will you? We shall not waver, knowing that you're counting on us.
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_Q2_000_070: Travel to the Tower of Babil?
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_POPMESSAGE_000_085: The vision's grief takes form and lashes out!
TEXT_AKTKMB117_04396_SYSTEM_000_100: No steps echo through this looming spire save your own, but you nevertheless sense a presence above...
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: You must confront those lost souls, yes, but you need not expel them by might of arms...
A feather-touch, a firm word─simple methods may send them away, faint echoes as they are.
Ware the strength of sentiment that drives them, however. Emotions that do not fade even with the passage of centuries...
And make haste. Though yet distant, unwelcome guests draw closer...
Of the six elemental brands, only those of levin and wind are intact.
If the other brands are not reforged, Zodiark may yet be freed.
Find the spirits of the sacrificed, and do what must be done...
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SHADOWTHREE4397_000: We were happy... At peace with the star.
We nurtured it. Helped it grow. With our will, our creations...
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SHADOWFOUR4397_000_: We were the star's beating heart. Its life...
Every soul a drop of blood flowing through its veins...
To live. To learn, to create...to make better.
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SYSTEM_000_065: As the whispers die, the final spirit fades. No shadows of times long lost remain around the Drowning Brand.
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SYSTEM_000_066: An unusually lustrous dog is gazing at you with what seems to be fond anticipation.
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SYSTEM_000_067: It appears to be waiting for you to follow it.
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SYSTEM_000_080: Follow the lustrous dog and try not to fall behind.
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SYSTEM_000_081: The dog silently regards the spirit that lurks near the brand.
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SYSTEM_000_090: Perhaps the dog will let you pet it once you have dealt with the lingering spirit.
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SHADOWFIVE4397_000_: We and the star were fulfilled...
Wanted for naught, mourned for naught...
So why... Why did it have to end!?
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_POPMESSAGE_000_105: The spirit's resentment takes form and lashes out!
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SHADOWFIVE4397_000_: The Final Days taught us to fear a death forced upon us.
The injustice of duties and dreams left unfulfilled. The grief of unexpected partings...
Swift as darkness, cold as ash.
Such tragedy, yet no catharsis! Such truth, yet no consolation...
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SYSTEM_000_114: As the whispers die, the spirit fades. All is silent and still around the Numbing Brand.
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SYSTEM_000_130: The lustrous dog is once again staring at you expectantly, and who are you to deny it? Follow and try not to fall behind.
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SYSTEM_000_131: The dog silently regards the shadow that lurks near the brand.
TEXT_AKTKMB118_04397_SYSTEM_000_140: The dog continues to focus on the shadow, as if to say, “Stop petting me and get on with it, please.”
TEXT_AKTKMB119_04398_A1_000_002: We must protect the brand! Come on, boy!
TEXT_AKTKMB119_04398_A1_000_003: Cry havoc and let slip the dog of war! That's you, by the way.
TEXT_AKTKMB119_04398_SYSTEM_000_004: The dog nudges you with its nose. You get the feeling it wants you to...hop on?
TEXT_AKTKMB119_04398_POPMESSAGE_000_011: With a powerful leap, the dog takes flight!
TEXT_AKTKMB119_04398_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: I sense his presence on the moon no longer.
If you need not follow, then I beg you stay and listen to what I have to tell you.
Of Zodiark...and the end of all things.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: Before we speak at length, I believe a change of surrounds is in order.
I have more than ill tidings to share, you see. I sensed others arriving not long ago.
Though my communions with Hydaelyn have grown infrequent, I have learned enough from Her to know these are your comrades.
And as luck would have it, they have already reached my abode. Come, let us join them.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_THANCRED_000_010: Dare I ask what happened before we arrived?
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_URIANGER_000_015: May we presume this being is a native of the moon?
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: Yes, they are indeed the three I sensed.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_031: We did what we could to subdue the tempered before making our way here.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_032: Not without casualties, unfortunately. Some few detonated explosives, killing themselves and others.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_033: The contingent's healers had their hands full tending to the injured and enthralled when we took our leave.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_URIANGER_000_034: Lest you wonder, Mistress Krile hath also been delivered unto their care. Serving as a conduit for Hydaelyn's power hath taken its toll, but she will recover in due course.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_035: As for Alphinaud and Alisaie, they insisted on remaining in Garlemald while we three rushed to your aid. It appears, however, that matters here have already come to a conclusion...
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_036: But what manner of conclusion, if I might ask? And is this the ally whom Hydaelyn bade you seek out? He is not unlike the shades of Amaurot.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: Not unlike, perhaps, but not the same. I was created by Hydaelyn, together with this place. It has ever been my duty to keep vigil over Zodiark. Or rather, it was my duty...
And not without consequence, I am afraid, for now the delicate weave of the star, preserved by His presence, will begin to unravel.
If you mean to avert the Final Days, you shall have need of─
My attempts to forestall Zodiark's release have all but exhausted my strength.
If you might allow me to rest a short while, I will share with you all I can.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_044: Please do. You need not exert yourself on our account.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_045: These crystals contain records of your time here, yes? May we peruse them while we wait?
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: By all means. If you would review them chronologically, might I suggest beginning with those on the upper floor?
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_047: I shall leave that to you, , while I see what can be gleaned from the crystals on these lower levels.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_THANCRED_000_050: Zodiark defeated... While He may have been in an incomplete state, that's nevertheless an impressive feat.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_THANCRED_000_051: But even if you hadn't, His demise was inevitable─Fandaniel would've seen to it one way or another.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_THANCRED_000_052: That said, he probably would have wielded Zodiark's power to wreak untold destruction before taking his own life, making this the better of two unfavorable outcomes.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_URIANGER_000_055: Dost thou suppose our host hath maintained his solitary vigil since the very beginning, without rest or relief?
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_URIANGER_000_056: If so, these records comprise the sum total of his existence. We must needs handle them with care.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_060: Pray review the records on the upper floor, and I will see if there is aught to be learned down here.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_SYSTEM_000_070: As you gaze into the crystal, ancient knowledge of Zodiark flows through your mind...
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_MEMORYA04399_000_07:
(-Crystalline Memories-)Daily summary: no abnormalities detected...
Daily summary: no abnormalities detected...
Daily summary: no abnormalities detected...
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_SYSTEM_000_072: These appear to be records of a long, lonely vigil on the moon, dating back to the beginning of Zodiark's imprisonment.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_SYSTEM_000_080: As you gaze into the crystal, knowledge of past calamities flows through your mind...
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_SYSTEM_000_081: The records describe how, with each Rejoining, Zodiark's thirst for freedom grew, as did the strain on the brands.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_SYSTEM_000_082: Maintaining Zodiark's imprisonment appears to tax Hydaelyn greatly...
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_SYSTEM_000_090: As you gaze into the crystal, knowledge of past Rejoinings flows through your mind...
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_SYSTEM_000_091: The records describe the watcher's efforts to prepare in the event Zodiark broke free from His prison.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_SYSTEM_000_092: The records go on to describe maintenance carried out regularly with the “Loporrits,” though it is not clear who or what they are.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_SYSTEM_000_100: As you gaze into the crystal, a record of an unexpected visitor flows through your mind...
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_SYSTEM_000_101: The records note the watcher's musings when Elidibus is spotted on the moon, though clearly not for the first time.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_MEMORYB04399_000_10: (-Crystalline Memories-)It is clear he and his brethren have a keen interest in freeing Zodiark from His prison, and yet they have made no attempt to destroy the brands. Perhaps they prefer He remain hidden from mortal eyes until the final Rejoining.
(-Crystalline Memories-)Perhaps they realize we would never dare bring harm to Zodiark, so long as He remains imprisoned.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_110: Did you learn anything of import?
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_111: So it is as we suspected. Maintaining the brands requires a great deal of Her energy and focus─and this cost has grown higher with every Rejoining.
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_112: That would explain why contact with Her has become rather infrequent since the Seventh Umbral Calamity.
