TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_113: I too made a rather startling discovery...
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_114: This heavenly body we know to be the moon was in fact created by Hydaelyn!
TEXT_AKTKMC101_04399_YSHTOLA_000_115: When the watcher said he was created together with this place, I thought he only meant this facility... Truly, Hydaelyn's powers are far beyond anything I could have imagined.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_THANCRED_000_000: The moon...is a ship? Well, now I've heard everything.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_URIANGER_000_005: I should very much like to hear more of this extraordinary story...
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_010: It may be true, but others will struggle to believe it. I can scarcely believe it myself.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: The time is come for you to be on your way.
The crater at the heart of Mare Lamentorum, where Zodiark was imprisoned, is not so easily traversed, however.
Let us call upon Argos, the familiar whom you met earlier. He should have no trouble bearing you across.
As Hydaelyn created me as the gaoler, so too did She create Argos as the guard...
It is his nature to appear when needed, and yet he is nowhere to be found. Strange... Mayhap the imbalancing of aether has affected him.
Let us make for the Crushing Brand, and attempt to call upon him there.
You need but recall the path you walked with Argos before, and you will find your way.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_027: If he labors in service to Hydaelyn's plan, I see no reason not to do as he suggests. Shall we make for this Crushing Brand, then?
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_THANCRED_000_030: With a little preparation, it might be possible to traverse the gap on foot.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_THANCRED_000_031: Then again, it would be a long, long way down if one should slip... Perhaps another time.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_URIANGER_000_035: Naught could prepare me for the boundless beauty of Etheirys. Shining, shimmering, amidst a sea of stars.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_URIANGER_000_036: A blue sapphire, and but one of countless other jewels brimming with life, no doubt...
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_040: So close and yet so far. Does not the harsh terrain remind you of somewhere we've been before? The Dravanian forelands, aye.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_041: A place that rejects the intrusion of outsiders. Where solitude reigns supreme... At the very least, it sounds suitable for Zodiark's prison.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: The place we seek is just ahead at the Chlorophosgrot.
You see, Argos cannot manifest without sufficient concentrations of ambient aether.
You would be hard-pressed to find a greater confluence than inside this cavern.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_THANCRED_000_060: The guard of Zodiark's prison, eh? Blood red eyes, slavering maw, and built like a behemoth, I'd imagine. Let's hope he's friendly.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_URIANGER_000_065: Curious... This place doth call to mind Pla Enni, home of the Nu Mou.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_070: This entire cave is thrumming with ambient aether...
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_071: Alas, any further analysis will have to wait.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: The lunar spongoi draw aether from the ground, which is then dispersed in the air. At present, however, the ambient energies are not quite sufficient for Argos to manifest.
Might you be willing to spare some of your own to help the spongoi along?
Given time, the lunar spongoi would suffuse this space with sufficient aether, but we need not wait if you are willing to provide a helping hand.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_SYSTEM_000_100: Argos manifests in a flash. He seems glad to see you again.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_WATCHEROFMOON_000_1: A most fascinating creation of Hydaelyn's, would you not agree? Should the need arise, he is even able to create reflections of himself on a whim.
Though I assure you it was no reflection which accompanied you earlier to the brand.
No, Argos was quite eager to be at your side then, as he is now, it seems.
I cannot recall when last he showed such an affinity for anyone. Indeed, I thought him more likely to shy away from you and your companions.
Perhaps it was more than a sense of duty that compelled him to aid you before.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_107: I believe we are all ready.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_WATCHEROFMOON_000_1: Then let us return outside that you may cross the chasm.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_THANCRED_000_110: I was expecting something a little more intimidating and less...“man's best friend.”
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_URIANGER_000_115: To whom wouldst Hydaelyn entrust the command of so grand a vessel, I wonder?
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_120: Dalamud has long been described as the “loyal hound” of Menphina due to its relation to the greater moon...
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_121: It seems highly improbable─if not impossible─for ancient peoples to have known of Argos, but now I wonder whether there is some connection...
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_SYSTEM_000_125: Argos favors you with what could almost be described as a conspiratorial grin.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_WATCHEROFMOON_000_1: Your destination is the structure there across the Cradle of Darkness.
But climb onto Argos's back, and he will take care of the rest.
Once you arrive, it should not take long to find the ship's crew. The facility is designed to rouse them from their slumber in the event of Zodiark's destruction.
Heed their counsel. Together, you may guide the star and its people to a kinder fate.
This is where we part ways. But know that I shall ever be watching and praying for your success.
Worry not for me. Real though I may appear as you and yours, I am but a part of this moon. A creation of Hydaelyn, entrusted with the memories of an acquaintance long dead, but not forgotten.
My charge of Zodiark has ended, but so long as the moon exists, I shall not want for purpose.
I shall remain, ever watching, ever praying for your success.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_150: Our ally's assurances notwithstanding, we cannot be certain what awaits us on the other side, so perhaps it would be best if we did not all go at once. I propose the two of us cross first while Thancred and Urianger wait here.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_153: A malefic aether yet permeates from the crater. Remnants of Zodiark, most like.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_155: This structure is enormous...though that is hardly surprising given the size of the average Amaurotine.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_157: Right, then. Let us head inside and...oh?
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_URIANGER_000_158: Most intriguing. A means by which he conserveth energy, mayhap?
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_THANCRED_000_159: Well, I certainly wouldn't want him to blink out of existence on our account, helpful as he's been.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_A2_000_161: Thank you, Argos. We'll take things from here.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_A2_000_162: Stay here where it's safe, all right?
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_163: If Argos is to remain without, let us not keep him waiting overlong.
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_Q3_000_170: Ride Argos and return across the chasm?
TEXT_AKTKMC102_04400_YSHTOLA_000_180: Its scale is reminiscent of Amaurot, or rather, the replica we visited on the First.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_URIANGER_000_000: Given the present crisis, Hydaelyn doubtless sought to facilitate cooperation betwixt pilot and passenger...
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_URIANGER_000_001: Indeed, 'twould require a heart as hard as diamond to raise one's voice in anger to beings possessed of such profound...saccharinity.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_YSHTOLA_000_005: I find Urianger's reasoning somewhat flimsy, but the crew seems amicable enough.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_THANCRED_000_010: They must be the Loporrits mentioned in the watcher's records.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_THANCRED_000_011: Not at all what I expected. But the watcher did bid us heed their counsel...
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_THANCRED_000_012: I assume the one who gave that rousing speech was their leader, though we might have to ask about in order to track them down. Come on then, let us be about it.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_THANCRED_000_020: I only saw them from a distance, but their fur was brown if that helps at all.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_URIANGER_000_025: The Loporrits all appear to have set about their tasks. Whither is their leader, I wonder?
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_YSHTOLA_000_030: Such a fascinating apparatus, though it's hard to believe it could house so many crew members. Even so, there is nothing else here to suggest other types of accommodation.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_SINGINGWAY_000_041: (-Singingway-)The leader of the crew? Not me, I'm afraid. Singingway's the name!
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_SINGINGWAY_000_042: (-Singingway-)I'm in charge of the construction and maintenance of the atmospheric circulation system. Only the crispest, cleanest air for the people of Etheirys─and that's a promise!
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_SLEEPINGWAY_000_051: (-Sleepingway-)Sleepingway... My job is...is... Hmm. Perhaps I'd better ask...
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_061: When did you get here? Who let you in? Why wasn't I told!?
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_A1_000_064: Were you the one giving orders earlier?
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_066: Leader? Ah, yes─ahem! Look no further─I am the one you seek.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_067: Me? Oh, yes─of course! As the only one around here capable of doing anything properly, it falls to me to take charge of the others.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_068: ...What was that supposed to be? Your humming─if one can even call it that─is atrociously off-key! It should sound more like this!
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_069: As leader of the Loporrits, I cannot allow substandard attempts at musicality to go unremarked, even if you are a guest. But being the magnanimous sort that I am, I'll forgive you this once.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_THANCRED_000_070: Well, well. Looks like you beat us here.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_071: Your friends, I take it. Is this all of them?
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_072: A group comprised entirely of children? What must their parents be thinking?
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_073: This isn't a nursery, after all. Though perhaps we should build one. Or did we build one already?
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_074: No matter. You needn't worry your pretty little heads. All will be well, I promise.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_075: But goodness me, we shouldn't be standing about gawping. I must take you to meet the others.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_076: If you could run along back toward the entrance, you'll find a path that leads to the central platform on the upper floor.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_077: There's no wrong way to reach it, but it's the large, glowing ball at the center, if you should find yourselves lost.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_LIVINGWAY_000_078: I shall gather the others and meet you there.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_THANCRED_000_079: Well, then. Back to the upper floor it is.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_THANCRED_000_090: Given their size, getting from one end of this place to the other must be exhausting. I honestly don't know how they do it.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_URIANGER_000_095: 'Tis astounding how the Loporrits─despite their diminutive stature─are able to maintain such gargantuan facilities.
TEXT_AKTKMC103_04401_YSHTOLA_000_100: The aetheric composition and density of this sphere is quite similar to the crystalline concepts we've seen before. It likely shares their capacity for storing memories and knowledge.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_THANCRED_000_000: Why do I get the feeling we're going to have our hands full dealing with the Loporrits?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_URIANGER_000_005: 'Tis unfortunate that the domiciles were constructed in error, but their willingness to perform such sweeping renovations is a testament to their commitment.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_URIANGER_000_006: I cannot fathom the resources required for a facility so vast...
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_YSHTOLA_000_010: I should have realized something was amiss when Livingway referred to us as children. What other delightful misconceptions do they hold, I wonder.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_MAPPINGWAY_000_015: Oh dear. I certainly hope Buildingway can complete the renovations before more guests arrive.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_MAPPINGWAY_000_016: Or perhaps he should leave them as they are? That way, you'd have more space to lounge about.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_020: Right, then. Now that you're here, we need you to teach us all you can about your people, and quickly!
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_021: It won't be long before the Final Days are upon us in all their terrible grandeur, so it is imperative that we be prepared to receive our passengers-to-be.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_022: If there is anything─anything at all─that may displease them, it must be addressed posthaste.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_023: And address it we shall. Here at Bestways Burrow, we have assembled everything required to offer our guests the best way forward!
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_024: ...Ahem. We have produced myriad amenities we understand to be essential for day-to-day living, and I wish to hear your opinions on them!
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_025: I'm sure you've all worked up an appetite, so why don't we start with foodstuffs? Meet me at the Carrotorium, and we'll see about filling your bellies.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_YSHTOLA_000_026: She does not want for enthusiasm. The notion of Etheirys rotting to its core being a matter of course is rather concerning, though.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_YSHTOLA_000_027: Nevertheless, let us take this opportunity to learn more of the Loporrits and this vessel.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_THANCRED_000_030: ...Am I the only one who suspects we're not going to find anything edible whatsoever?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_YSHTOLA_000_035: Given their earlier confusion regarding our size, I cannot help but wonder if they even know the first thing about us...
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_URIANGER_000_040: Hast thou spied the peculiar sentinels patrolling the vicinity? Approach them with caution─or better yet, not at all─for they make no distinction between friend or foe.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_045: You're a lot smaller than we expected, but I trust you still have large appetites, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_050: Welcome to the Carrotorium! Here we create prototypes of the various sundries required by our soon-to-be passengers.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_051: Allow me to introduce the head of foodstuff production─
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_052: Cookingway! Pleasure to meet you all!
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_053: Our work has involved no small amount of trial and error, but after many, many cycles of painstaking labor, I daresay we have created the finest cuisine our guests could ask for.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_054: I've learned all about the essential nutrients for a healthy and balanced diet from the reference materials we received! Why, I've practically worn the words from those invaluable pages!
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_055: Naturally, we've also considered ease of growth and production. We will not want for ingredients!
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_056: I must insist you try some. We have fresh stock recently prepared on account of...well, because we just woke up, and were all quite famished.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_057: Hop along the platforms here, and you'll find a storage unit full to bursting with delectable delights. Help yourself to anything you like.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_060: I'm eager to hear what you think of our work. I'm sure there's some small room for improvement, but I'm confident you'll be satisfied!
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_065: One serving's never enough. You'll be back for seconds and thirds, I'm sure of it!
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_070: You open the storage unit and find a rainbow-colored assortment of carrots.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_077: From frond to tip, no scratches or blemishes mar this immaculate specimen. Nevertheless, if not for its excessive length and girth, one might think it was an ordinary carrot.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_078: The blue variety is strangely supple to the touch and smells vaguely of mint. Its excessive length and girth only adds to the dubiousness of this so-called carrot.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_079: While it has no peculiar smell to speak of, the yellow variant is unusually light and springy. These qualities, together with its excessive length and girth, would lead anyone to question whether it is indeed a carrot.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_080: The soft texture and redolent aroma of this crimson creation belie its staggering weight. The excessive length and girth only compound the mystery, leaving you perplexed as to the nature of this “carrot.”
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_Q2_000_081: Are you certain you wish to eat this carrot?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_082: On second thought, you elect to simply take  for now. Due to its bizarre qualities, it would be prudent to ask Cookingway whether it is safe to eat first.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_090: So, did any of our selections set your mouth to watering?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_091: Ah yes, a fine choice! One of my personal favorites, actually.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_092: Please, dig in! I'm eager to hear what you think.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_100: I hope you enjoy it as much as we do!
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_105: Judging from the expectant faces, it is clear you are expected to eat the carrot where Cookingway can observe your honest reaction to his work.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_110: With great trepidation, you take a bite out of the carrot...
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_111: There is a satisfying crunch as you sink your teeth into the orange skin, and a warm tingling sensation runs down your spine. With the second bite, a wave of euphoria washes over you, and you drown in bliss. Alas, as you finish, the elation fades, leaving you with a desperate craving for another carrot.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_112: You are taken by surprise when blue juices burst forth from the carrot and dribble down your chin. As you take your second bite, you can feel your mental faculties sharpening. Your mind opens to the universe, and for a brief moment the mysteries of existence are simple, transformative truths...but the revelation is fleeting... When you at last finish the carrot, a sweet-yet-sour aftertaste lingers on your tongue, and the number forty-two in your mind.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_113: You snap off a piece of the carrot, enjoying its crunchy texture. Righteous confidence surges within you, a certainty that you are the center of the universe─that all creation is a story and you the star, beloved and perfect and special. A god, worthy of worship and prayer...or at the very least a second roll should the dice treat you poorly.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_SYSTEM_000_114: The carrot is oddly tender, but as you begin to chew, a rich aroma fills your nostrils. A newfound vigor begins welling within you! The rumbling of your stomach, however, suggests it may simply be indigestion.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_115: The carrot met with your approval, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_120: What did you think? Unlike anything you've ever tasted, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_121: The carrot of happiness is full to bursting with nutrients and is guaranteed to leave you feeling satiated. It's a staple among us Loporrits.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_122: The philosopher's carrot improves mental fortitude. Something of a shock at first bite, but it's well worth the enhanced powers of cognition.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_123: The lucky carrot is...well...to be honest we're not quite sure how it was first made. A happy accident, you might say. But as the name suggests, after eating one, you'll feel blessed with good fortune.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_124: The iron carrot can be a bit difficult to digest, but the boost to endurance it promises makes it the perfect meal before a day of heavy lifting.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_125: We have plenty of other varieties, too. Bleeding carrots to improve blood flow, dream carrots to help with sleep...
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_126: So you see, we have a carrot for every occasion!
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_A3_000_129: But...what if I don't like carrots?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_A3_000_130: I can certainly see demand for this in Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_131: Then why do you seem so disappointed? If they're lacking somehow, we need to know.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_132: You don't like carrots...? Oh, you must mean you don't like them served in this fashion. Worry not─we have puréed versions on hand if you haven't the time to chew.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_133: Sharlayan? What in blazes is that?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_YSHTOLA_000_134: I take it you too had a wide assortment of carrots to choose from and naught else?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_YSHTOLA_000_135: If I may ask, what exactly did these collaborators share with you about cuisine on Etheirys? Surely you are aware we have an abundance of dishes and foods you could emulate?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_136: Of course we are! But, well...it was only quite recently that we established contact...
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_137: Even holding a conversation was a struggle at first, so imagine our surprise when they sent a mountain of books and documents with no clear instructions. The sheer amount of information was overwhelming! If it wasn't for that encyclopedia I found, we would have been at a loss where to begin.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_LIVINGWAY_000_138: And so we decided, rather than divide our resources to prepare a variety of middling and potentially unsatisfying meals, it would be more efficient to devote our efforts to the production of a single perfect food.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_THANCRED_000_139: That's all well and good, but man cannot live on raw carrots alone.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_141: You mean steaming, boiling, roasting, and the like? I suppose we could prepare the carrots in other ways...
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_142: But our primary concern was efficiency, and what's more efficient than sinking your teeth into a carrot fresh from production?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_THANCRED_000_143: A rather strange approach to take for one named Cookingway, isn't it?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_144: Well, technically speaking, Cookingway isn't my given name. When first created, we were all named in the old tongue─you know, that otherwise impenetrable parlance the watcher speaks?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_145: After we received a great tome of words─a dictionary, that is─from our collaborators, we learned your language. Adverbs, gerunds, present-continuous verb conjugations... Just the basics.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_146: Then, we found the terms related to our given tasks, and used them to form new names. Aren't they helpful?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_THANCRED_000_147: No, not really. But it does explain a great deal.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_URIANGER_000_148: Wherefore didst thy kind deem such a change necessary?
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_COOKINGWAY_000_149: When the rest of your people arrive, we want to be certain they understand immediately what each of us does. You'd never be able to pronounce our original names anyway.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_YSHTOLA_000_151: I hope our critiques, such as they are, were helpful to you.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_YSHTOLA_000_152: Though if you should decide to preserve flora and fauna from Etheirys as well, you would be able to offer the passengers a more balanced diet.
TEXT_AKTKMC104_04402_YSHTOLA_000_153: Until such a day─one I pray comes sooner than later─it would appear there is naught but carrots on the menu.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_THANCRED_000_000: I hate to admit it, but...I did rather like the carrots.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_YSHTOLA_000_010: While I'm sure the Loporrits would hop at the chance to expound upon carrots in exhaustive detail, perhaps it's time we moved on?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_COOKINGWAY_000_015: Hungry for more carrots? Fear not, you can eat to your heart's content after you've seen the rest of Bestways Burrow.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_020: I think we've had our fill of carrots for now. Let's move on to other necessities, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_021: Our clothing production is sure to impress. This way!
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_THANCRED_000_030: It's hardly Sunsilk Tapestries, but perhaps we'll be pleasantly surprised.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_URIANGER_000_035: Garments born of the heavens, crafted with methods ancient and forgotten. Dress befitting we who walk in shade, stewards of the esoteric...
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_YSHTOLA_000_040: Do you suppose the clothes they prepared will be as grossly oversized as the carrots?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_050: Here we are─the apparel production station.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_051: We've chosen to employ more traditional methods for this task─creation magicks!
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_052: Hydaelyn, in Her infinite wisdom, blessed us with the selfsame affinity for magic Her people possessed. We have other amazing talents, of course─and I know you're dying to hear about them─but I will regale you with the details another time.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_053: That said, we did run into a spot of trouble at first. Our magic alone was not sufficient to see our work done.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_054: In the end, we discovered crystallized aether was a wonderful catalyst that could provide us with the extra vis we needed.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_056: Ah, the sweet sound of recognition! You will also be impressed to hear we've read all about your habit of changing attire to match your chosen profession. For the sake of efficiency, I presume? This has also been taken into account with our designs.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_057: But why take my word for it when you can simply try on our clothes?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_058: Make yourselves known to the workers and they will see to the rest!
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_060: If you're worried about sizing, don't be. It should be a simple matter to adjust our concepts as required...and it will be required.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LOPORRITA04403_000_: Ah! I-It's you! One of the visitors from Etheirys! Goodness me, Mappingway wasn't kidding─.
Oh, right! You're here to try on a set of clothes, yes?
What would you have me fashion for you today?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_A1_000_074: An outfit that embodies my bloodlust.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LOPORRITA04403_000_: Ahem. This will only take a moment.
A perfect fit, if I do say so myself.

I would be lying if I said I understand what bloodlust is, but I assume it's something you enjoy. I made certain the clothes are flexible yet sturdy enough to endure...whatever it is you plan to do while wearing them.
Nothing too billowy or frilly, as you can see. Also light and durable─sure to serve you well wherever your travels might take you!
I'll be honest─I know nothing of fashion, let alone fashion on Etheirys. B-But I'd wager no one down there has ever worn anything like this fine ensemble. Perhaps you can start a new trend!
Would you look at that. Speechless! And there I thought you may not like it.
If you've a mind to try something else, why not speak with my fellow artisans?
I'm sure they'd be happy to oblige.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_SYSTEM_000_089: You must continue wearing these garments in order to progress.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_SYSTEM_000_090: You will change back to your normal garments if you move too far away. Look to your map for the garment change's area of effect.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_SYSTEM_000_091: Speak with the restless Loporrit to restore or prolong the garment change.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LOPORRITA04403_000_: Oh no! What happened to your outfit? Not to worry, I have another right here.
A fresh change of clothes? Say no more!
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LOPORRITB04403_000_: Ah! N-No one said you'd be coming! Could you give me a moment to clean up my station?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_SYSTEM_000_111: You must be wearing garments provided by the restless Loporrit in order to progress.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LOPORRITB04403_000_: Ah! N-No one said you'd be coming! Er...how can I help you?
You wish to try my clothes? Really?
O-Of course! It would be my honor! Did you have anything in mind?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_A1_000_119: Got anything with a little more...flair?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_A1_000_120: I'm looking for clothes with an altogether different design.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LOPORRITB04403_000_: I-I think I can handle that. Let's see...
Some of my best work yet.
Times and tastes truly have changed. It used to be so rare for anyone to request clothing with a focus on form over function.
Thankfully, I had a spare concept for robes made using a different fabric. I think it looks rather fetching.
You're a strange one, aren't you? I honestly wasn't sure what to do when you didn't ask for anything specific.
I take my work seriously, however, and am never one to disappoint. That ensemble is a blend of concepts from myriad professions─all-purpose attire for the modern  of Etheirys!
It's a relatively new concept incorporating an idea that's never been tried with clothing before.
Fragrance! Can you smell the carrots? <sniff> <sniff> Ah, simply divine!
I was worried how the concept would turn out when put to the proof, but it looks stunning on you!
Won't you go and show Livingway? I'm sure she's eager to see what we've come up with.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_SYSTEM_000_133: You must continue wearing these garments in order to progress.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_SYSTEM_000_134: You will change back to your normal garments if you move too far away. Look to your map for the garment change's area of effect.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_SYSTEM_000_135: Speak with the jubilant Loporrit to restore or prolong the garment change.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LOPORRITB04403_000_: What happened to my concept? No matter─I can fix this!
Looking for a fresh set, are we? Here you go.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LOPORRITA04403_000_: The people of Etheirys are sure to love that concept.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_160: Oh? What happened to the change of wardrobe?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_SYSTEM_000_161: You must be wearing garments provided by the jubilant Loporrit in order to progress.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_166: The result of much trial and error, but I know quality work when I see it.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_167: Shhh. You needn't speak. I can see your adoration for the moon and we Loporrits in your eyes. No doubt your friends feel the same having sampled our creations.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_THANCRED_000_168: Sorry to have kept you waiting...
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_YSHTOLA_000_169: They insisted we sample all of their concepts ere we returned.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_THANCRED_000_172: ...I think it's past time we returned these clothes.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_173: I was so confident our garments would meet with your approval... <sigh> Whatever are we doing wrong?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_174: The watcher taught us that, in his time, everyone wore the same robes. To do otherwise was against social etiquette.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_175: We thought we could appeal to modern tastes by tailoring the robes to specific professions, but...
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_YSHTOLA_000_176: Please, you mustn't be so hard on yourself. Should we resort to evacuating the people of Etheirys, they will most certainly have need of your attire.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_YSHTOLA_000_177: 'Tis clear you spared no effort in addressing our needs, but you must understand that we are not quite so...homogenous.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_YSHTOLA_000_178: Speaking for myself, what I wear now better suits my tastes, even if it is of inferior make.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_YSHTOLA_000_179: But there are others whose choices may be influenced by traditions or personal experience. Rather than make assumptions for the whole, you must consider the individual and their potential preferences.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_180: I fear we've underestimated the complexity and diversity of your people. <sigh> Even if we'd memorized every tome we received, I doubt we'd have fared much better.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_181: Maybe we're doing you a disservice trying to shower you with our baubles and frippery, thinking it was for your benefit when you'd be better off on your own...
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_THANCRED_000_182: ...There are some who might agree. People who prefer to keep others at arm's length, even when they know they shouldn't.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_THANCRED_000_183: As one such former fool, I'd like to ask you a question.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_THANCRED_000_184: This plan to evacuate and escape the Final Days─did it account for the reflections of the Source as well?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_185: Um... Not that I'm aware of...
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_186: We were born of Hydaelyn's love for Etheirys, and the salvation of the people on that star, and that star alone, has ever been our aim.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_187: Surely it's better to devote ourselves to saving one world than to divide our efforts across fourteen, and risk failing them all?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_YSHTOLA_000_189: Livingway, might we have leave to explore Bestways Burrow unattended? You have given us much to think about.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_URIANGER_000_192: If I may, I should like to accompany thee a while longer.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_194: I-I mean, you're more than welcome to. There was actually something I wished to speak with you about.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_LIVINGWAY_000_195: Let's be off then, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_200: Ahhh! M-My apologies. I wasn't trying to spy or anything.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_201: Everyone's been talking about the visitors come from Etheirys, and I wanted to see what all the fuss was about.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_202: I was excited at first, but now...now I'm worried.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_203: What if the people of Etheirys refuse to come? What if we can't save them!?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_204: <sigh> It's clear we've made a mess of things.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_205: Oh, but wait! You still haven't visited the domiciles! Once you see them, you'll understand how wonderful the moon truly is, I'm sure of it.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_206: (-Growingway-)I'll be waiting for you by the teleporter near the entrance. Oh, and the name's Growingway, by the way. See you soon!
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_211: Thank you! Thank you so much, uh...er... Sorry, what should I call you?
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_212: , eh? Crikey, even your names are amazing.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_213: Well, , we'll be using this teleporter to enter the residential area.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_220: Gosh, that was embarrassing. I promise to be more careful from now on.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_221: Since the residential quarters are closed for now, I've rerouted the teleporter to allow travel between floors instead. Hopefully it proves useful in the meantime.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_GROWINGWAY_000_222: <sigh> A shame you couldn't see it, though. You really would've liked it.
TEXT_AKTKMC105_04403_SYSTEM_000_223: You can now travel between the upper and lower floors of Bestways Burrow via the teleporter.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_000: It may not seem like it, but we've been planning for this far longer than I'd care to admit.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_001: Each time we woke up, we'd have long discussions about how to save as many of you as we can. Felt like everyone had an opinion on this or that.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_002: But the one thing we all agreed upon was that the people of Etheirys wouldn't take action to save themselves until it was far too late.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_003: That's why we're striving to make the moon a vibrant, magical place they'd hop at the chance to visit, rather than waiting for the flames of oblivion to get them off their tails and force them to accept our invitation.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_004: The residential quarters may not be up to the necessary standards just yet, but there are plenty of other places worth seeing!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_005: You've already had a look around the Carrotorium, but wait until you see what's waiting for you at the east end of the burrow. Follow me!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_010: Good, you're here. Through this door is Greatest Endsvale!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_011: It was named as such because it's the vale to end all vales. The most beautiful forest you'll ever see.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_012: We understand the people of Etheirys enjoy taking leisurely walks through “natural spaces” and the like, so I'm sure you'll enjoy it.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_013: How about we start with a nice stroll to the fountain? This way!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_020: So, what did you think of the forest? Isn't it positively pleasant? Simply sublime?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_A1_000_022: I couldn't see the forest or the trees...
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_A1_000_023: I didn't see any─wait. You don't mean those crystals out there are...
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_A1_000_024: 'Tis as transcendent as burying your face in a chocobo's plumage and taking a good, long whiff!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_025: You're pulling my tail! You're in the forest right now!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_026: Right you are! Our forest is made of crystals and constructs, dotting the landscape as far as the eye can see.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_028: Hearing you say that means more to me than you know. Personally, I'd say this place is the pride of the burrow.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_029: Building this place was a challenge, let me tell you. Since we were born here, we've never seen trees in person before, let alone a forest.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_030: The information sent by our collaborators was quite enlightening, but after much deliberation, we decided to use crystalline constructs in place of living trees.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_031: And thanks to our atmospheric circulation system, this place produces air as clean as that you'd find in a forest on Etheirys!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_032: The fountain here behind us, powered by the rather large crystal adorning its top, plays a vital role in supplying us with fresh water.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_033: Much time and effort was spent making it the most spherical of spheres, and I daresay the unparalleled roundness speaks for itself.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_034: I enjoy nothing more than a nice, long stretch and a spot of relaxation whenever I come up here. You look like you could do with a stretch yourself.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_040: Feeling tense, ? Why not stretch and relax?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_SYSTEM_000_041: Growingway looks at you expectantly. Perhaps it would be best to oblige him with a quick stretch.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_042: Is...is that how people stretch on Etheirys? Please tell me it isn't.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_SYSTEM_000_043: Growingway is bewildered by your bizarre interpretation of his instructions. Perhaps it would be best to oblige him with a tried-and-true stretch instead.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_044: That's the spirit! I feel more relaxed simply watching you.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_045: A sight worth the many years spent building this place.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_046: If it's not too much to ask... It's always been a dream of mine to take a walk through this forest with someone from Etheirys. Could we maybe...?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_050: <gasp> You will!? Oh, be still my quivering whiskers!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_SYSTEM_000_051: Growingway is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_SYSTEM_000_052: You can leave Growingway behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_SYSTEM_000_053: If you wish to have Growingway accompany you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_064: Ahhh... Nothing like a relaxing stroll to forget one's worries, eh?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_Q2_000_065: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Growingway?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_066: I understand... Being Hydaelyn's chosen and all, I'm sure you have more important things to do. If you change your mind, though, I'll be over at the fountain.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_067: Y-You're back? You're back! I mean... Ahem. It's good to see you. Looking to take a walk through the forest, are you?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_070: I was thinking, ...that I could be more helpful to you by teaching you a little about the moon and what it is we do.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_071: When we were first created, the moon's sole purpose was to hold Zodiark, and there was absolutely nothing to be found here.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_072: Eventually, Hydaelyn gave us our first task: furnish the moon with propulsion systems capable of facilitating travel to other stars.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_073: It sounds impressive, and I suppose in some respects it is, but it was only possible thanks to all the knowledge Hydaelyn shared with us. We also had a lot of time to get it done. Six thousand years, give or take.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_A3_000_080: Ask if you can taste the rainbow...crystal.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_081: What...? N-No! I'm not sure what it is you do with crystals on Etheirys, but we don't eat them─and certainly not this one. It's possessed of all six elements─wind, lightning, fire, earth, ice, and water. We use crystals like these to maintain the moon's elemental equilibrium.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_082: It's worth mentioning, though, that because of Hydaelyn's influence─being the embodiment of tranquility and stasis and all─manipulating the elements here is different than it might be on Etheirys.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_083: A conjuring of fire would sooner dry your clothes than singe them, for example. Put simply, the aetheric conditions are ill-suited to growth, which is why the surface is mostly barren.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_084: Of course, this was all necessary to keep the raging energies of Zodiark in check.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_090: This may come as a surprise, but we didn't begin building the habitable areas until after the propulsion systems were ready.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_091: Considering how long it took, I wish we'd started sooner. Who would've thought we'd need four thousand years to make all this?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_092: It certainly wasn't work you dare rush, either. We had to create infrastructure and countless supporting systems, some of which wouldn't be operational until hundreds of years later.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_093: And then there was that brief period where our productivity came to a screeching halt─when that bizarre red satellite was sent up from Etheirys. The Allagans' mischief, I think.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_094: We thought maybe some new, nefarious actor was colluding with Zodiark. All we could do was stand by and brace ourselves for the worst.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_095: I can't tell you how relieved we were when Hydaelyn informed us of its destruction. Oh yes, there was much joyous humming that day.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_100: Say, do you notice anything peculiar about the treetops? I mean, apart from the fact they're massive crystals, and not trees.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_101: I'll give you a hint: it's the golden rings emanating from the glowing spheres.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_102: Along with the device fixed near the ceiling, they fulfill a role similar to our sun─and do so better, even.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_103: The sun and similar celestial objects in the great expanse radiate energy that is harmful to your bodies. These rings shield you from that energy while allowing you to bathe in the perfect amount of sunlight. Or rather, a close approximation of it.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_104: Pretty impressive, wouldn't you say? Oh, and if you look closely, you'll see different types of “trees” have ever-so-slightly different curvature! Yes indeed, this forest truly is the greatest.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_110: There was something else I wanted to tell you about. Uh... Oh, right.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_111: The propulsion systems and habitat facilities were completed around two thousand years ago, and with that, the most important features were fit for purpose.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_112: Which was all well and good, except we still knew absolutely nothing about the present-day people of Etheirys.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_113: “Why not go and visit Etheirys yourself?” you might ask. Strictly forbidden. Were our technology or knowledge of the moon's true purpose exploited for evil ends...the results could be disastrous.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_114: Then there were a few more Rejoinings, and it became increasingly difficult to converse with Hydaelyn.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_115: Fearful we might lose the ability to communicate with Her altogether, we beseeched Her to find people on Etheirys we could trust to help.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_116: We were quite fortunate everything worked out as it did.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_120: With the exception of routine inspections and maintenance, we remained asleep and waited, hopeful Hydaelyn would find someone who would help us.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_121: Eventually She did, and though Her power was waning, we were able to speak to them directly for a short while.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_122: We shared with them everything we could, including our knowledge of the heavens, and a means to travel here to the moon.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_123: They certainly didn't waste any time with what we taught them. No more than a few years after that, our collaborators found a means to convey messages and supplies to us from down below.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_124: With all the letters, books, and other resources they sent, we learned enough to start making more meaningful changes to the moon.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_125: And now you're here, hopefully enjoying yourself as much as I am!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_126: I knew you would like Greatest Endsvale, I knew it!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_127: Thank you again for coming here, by the way. I know it was just a walk through the forest, but it meant a lot to me.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_THANCRED_000_129: I take it you've already received the grand tour? A shame we missed it.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_LIVINGWAY_000_130: (-???-)Growingway! I've been looking all over for you!
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_131: Oh! I, uh... Is this about the teleporter to the residential area?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_LIVINGWAY_000_132: No, never mind that. We have more pressing matters at hand.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_LIVINGWAY_000_133: I will be calling an emergency meeting shortly, and your attendance is required.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_GROWINGWAY_000_134: Really...? I can't imagine why you'd need me there, but if you insist.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_LIVINGWAY_000_135: We won't be away long, so you all are more than welcome to continue looking about the burrow. Now, come along, Growingway.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_YSHTOLA_000_136: Before we arrived, you seemed to be in the midst of a rousing conversation with your guide. Did you learn anything of import?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_THANCRED_000_137: They've spent twelve thousand years preparing for this?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_THANCRED_000_138: With the appointed hour fast approaching, I can certainly understand their restlessness. But still...
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_YSHTOLA_000_139: It remains to be seen if the people can be persuaded to evacuate when there are yet no signs of the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_YSHTOLA_000_140: What's more, the technology of this place defies imagination. I doubt there are many who would readily come to terms with living in such surroundings.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_THANCRED_000_141: Whoever these collaborators are, unless they are possessed of the world's most charming personalities or a means to forcibly evacuate people, they will meet with a great deal of resistance.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_YSHTOLA_000_142: Indeed. Even if faced with annihilation, the decision to forsake all one knows cannot be made lightly.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_URIANGER_000_143: Forgive me, friends, but I must beg your leave. There is another matter which yet begs for mine attention.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_THANCRED_000_144: Of course. We can accompany you if you like.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_URIANGER_000_145: Nay, that will not be necessary. If you will excuse me.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_THANCRED_000_150: Huh... What do you suppose has suddenly tickled his fancy?
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_YSHTOLA_000_160: 'Tis clear now that difficult decisions lie ahead of us.
TEXT_AKTKMC106_04404_YSHTOLA_000_161: Preparation for the evacuation of Etheirys is indeed crucial, but I am not yet willing to forsake our world and its reflections─and I trust I am not alone in my reticence.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_YSHTOLA_000_000: The Final Days will make brave fools of us all.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_THANCRED_000_010: Did Urianger seem strange to you? More so than usual, I mean.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_THANCRED_000_011: I know he has a penchant for keeping his own counsel, but I'd be lying if I said I wasn't worried. Would you go and see if he's all right?
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_THANCRED_000_012: Y'shtola and I will remain here and see what else we can learn about the Final Days. If you hurry, perhaps you can catch up to him.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_THANCRED_000_020: Better for only one of us to go, in case it's a delicate matter.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_YSHTOLA_000_025: Urianger usually puts more effort into concealing his clandestine endeavors. Or perhaps he's simply given up on trying to hide it, knowing we'll find out eventually.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_YSHTOLA_000_026: In any case, that he acts with good intentions is plain. So please, give him the benefit of the doubt.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_SYSTEM_000_030: Urianger appears to be heading towards the entrance to Bestways Burrow...
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_SYSTEM_000_040: Urianger ventures off into Mare Lamentorum for reasons unknown. You must tread carefully, else he might sense your presence...
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_SYSTEM_000_041: Follow Urianger from a safe distance. The objective will end in failure if you are noticed, or if you fall too far behind.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_SYSTEM_000_042: Should you fail to complete the objective, you may try again by returning to the designated location.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_URIANGER_000_050: In truth, my reason for traveling hither was to effect a plan of mine own. A plan which may pave a way forward for us all.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_URIANGER_000_051: "May,“ I say, for there is no guarantee of success. 'Tis the reason I set out alone...that failure, should it come, would be mine to bear alone.
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_URIANGER_000_052: Yet thou standest before me with proffered hand and open heart...
TEXT_AKTKMC107_04405_URIANGER_000_053: 'Twould be remiss of me to refuse thy amity, and so I ask─wouldst thou join in mine endeavor?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_000: I thank thee for accompanying me.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_001: 'Tis a simple plan, in truth. We shall not be long away from Bestways Burrow.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_002: Difficult decisions must needs be made in the coming days, but I nevertheless believe we are all of one mind in our desire to save the people of Etheirys.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_003: To make clear our resolve to the Loporrits, I would offer them a gift. But its making doth require a most singular ingredient.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_010: Ah, an abundance of spongoi. Excellent.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_011: I chanced to spy this aggregation when crossing Zodiark's erstwhile prison.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_012: Using a spell taught to me by the Nu Mou, I believe these shall suffice for the gift I would fashion.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_013: The magick requireth considerable concentration, however. Might I prevail upon thee to stand watch whilst I perform the incantation?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_SYSTEM_000_021: Urianger is wholly absorbed in weaving his enchantment. Until his work is complete, he will need to be kept safe from harm...
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_SYSTEM_000_030: Surveying the nearby area, you see no sign of potential threats. This would be a good opportunity to see how Urianger is faring...
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_SYSTEM_000_041: Urianger remains fixated on his work...
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_043: A magicked ink, every onze as efficacious as that crafted by the Nu Mou.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_044: Rare is the occasion I would conjure mine own, but is nevertheless a most useful skill.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_045: The resulting product is, admittedly, possessed of no preternatural properties, but its hue is one of mine own choosing, which I pray the Loporrits will appreciate.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_LIVINGWAY_000_046: (-???-)! Urianger! Oh, thank goodness. I thought you had been eaten, or had perhaps fallen into a crater.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_LIVINGWAY_000_047: Y'shtola has been looking all over for you, . She says she needs to speak with you about something most urgent. Dire, even.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_LIVINGWAY_000_048: She was also quite clear that she wishes to speak with  alone. Which means, I'm afraid, you must stay behind, Urianger.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_LIVINGWAY_000_049: But worry not! It just so happens we need your help with an errand─delivering a package from the Watcher's Palace to Bestways Burrow. It's quite large and heavy─perhaps even too heavy, for we poor Loporrits─and we would be ever so grateful if you could lend us a hand.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_A1_000_051: Well, I suppose I should be going, then...
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_A1_000_052: How about an extra pair of hands before I go and meet with Y'shtola?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_LIVINGWAY_000_055: I-I mean, yes, very good. Let us not keep you, then. She said she would be waiting for you in Greatest Endsvale...or somewhere thereabouts. I'm sure you'll find her soon enough.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_LIVINGWAY_000_056: No, no, that won't be necessary. Urianger's help should more than suffice.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_LIVINGWAY_000_057: And I'm sure you don't want to risk getting on Y'shtola's bad side by keeping her waiting. She seems...prickly. Now, off with you.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_LIVINGWAY_000_058: Are you insinuating I would betray the trust of Hydaelyn's chosen? Or worse─do anything to risk getting on Y'shtola's bad side!?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_LIVINGWAY_000_059: She's clearly not one to be crossed, nor made to wait. Now, off with you!
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_URIANGER_000_060: Worry not, . I shan't be long.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_THANCRED_000_070: Everything is all right with Urianger, then? That's a relief.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_YSHTOLA_000_080: Oh, . We thought you would be away for far longer.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_YSHTOLA_000_081: A dire emergency? I said no such thing.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_YSHTOLA_000_082: But as you are here, I could use your assistance with one small matter.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_YSHTOLA_000_083: Runningway, a companion of Growingway's, apparently has much to tell us of the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_YSHTOLA_000_084: The problem, however, is that he is determined to live up to his name, refusing to stay still long enough for us to hold a conversation.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_THANCRED_000_085: Is there anywhere he's likely to stop and rest? Or perhaps there's a way to slow him down?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_GROWINGWAY_000_086: Wh-What's the rush? I was thinking we should wait here, maybe enjoy a cold mug of carrot juice, and...no? <sigh> Well, if it's really that important...
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_GROWINGWAY_000_087: You can try using these...balls. Of mousse flesh. Not to be confused with...the other thing.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_GROWINGWAY_000_088: Ahem. Runningway's other notable feature is his incessant chatter, so you'll have no trouble finding him in a crowd. And when you do, try lobbing your balls at him.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_YSHTOLA_000_089: Crude, but if it proves effective... He was here in Greatest Endsvale when last I saw him. Let us split up and find him.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_SYSTEM_000_100: Search your surroundings for Runningway. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target Runningway and throw mousse balls with .
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_RUNNINGWAY_000_101: Hm? Yes, I'm Runningway. Do you mind explaining why you hit me in the face with your balls... Of mousse flesh?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_RUNNINGWAY_000_102: I'm highly knowledgeable about the Final Days?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_RUNNINGWAY_000_103: Hah, that's the most ridiculous thing I've heard since I woke up! Who told you that joke?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_RUNNINGWAY_000_104: As if we've got time to look into the Final Days when there's so much to do before the great voyage.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_RUNNINGWAY_000_105: It's true that Hydaelyn did impart to us some knowledge of the event, but I know about as much as any other Loporrit around here. Less, probably.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_RUNNINGWAY_000_106: I don't know why anyone would think it's funny to go around telling people I'm an expert, but they'd better hope I don't get my paws on them!
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_RUNNINGWAY_000_107: Sorry I couldn't be of more help, but if there's nothing else, I've work to do!
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_THANCRED_000_110: Any luck? I tried near the entrance, but there was no sign of him.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_GROWINGWAY_000_115: Oh no, you caught him? I-I mean... Well done you...
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_YSHTOLA_000_120: I could find neither hide nor...hair of him. How did you fare?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_YSHTOLA_000_121: So, he knows no more than the others.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_GROWINGWAY_000_124: I misremembered. Yes, that's it! I misremembered. Terribly sorry about that.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_GROWINGWAY_000_125: Hmmm. Afraid I'm drawing a blank, though. Try as I might, I can't remember who I was thinking of.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_THANCRED_000_126: On an unrelated note, what of Urianger? I assume you spoke with him earlier, but did he say when he'll be returning?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_THANCRED_000_127: On his way to the Watcher's Palace with Livingway?
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_THANCRED_000_128: Between Growingway's sudden lapse of memory and our lack of other leads, maybe our time would be better spent lending Urianger a hand.
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_GROWINGWAY_000_129: Wh-What!? Now hold on a moment!
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_GROWINGWAY_000_130: It's all coming back to me. Yes, I remember!
TEXT_AKTKMC108_04406_GROWINGWAY_000_131: The information you're looking for is in the archives. Yes, that's where you'll find all sorts of useful knowledge, including that pertaining to the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_THANCRED_000_000: If some scheme was afoot, surely Urianger would be the first to see through it.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_THANCRED_000_001: Then again, he does tend to give others the benefit of the doubt...
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_005: I am beginning to grow tired of these games.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_010: Oh, what to do, what to do... I promised Livingway I would help, but...
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_011: No. I promised I'd help, so that's what I'll do!
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_012: The archives are on the second floor of the main plaza, the eastern wing. Follow me!
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_013: I suspect the Loporrits are up to something, but if there is aught to be learned of the Final Days, I think it best we play along. For now, at least.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_THANCRED_000_020: The architecture of this place is impressive, though more than a little confusing to navigate.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_THANCRED_000_021: Is it too much to ask for clearly marked exits? Or a map, perhaps?
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_025: What other knowledge do you suppose we could glean from their archives?
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_030: The archives are right through this door, but it seems to be locked.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_031: I guess we'll just have to go and find whoever has the key.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_033: If you have naught else to tell us of the Final Days, you need only say so. We can ill afford to be wasting time here, as you well know.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_034: Did you yourselves not tell us we must act quickly?
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_036: The moon was to be a perfect paradise for the people of Etheirys, and we're running out of time to make everything ready for their arrival.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_037: We hoped you'd see the wonders we have to offer, but you've found nothing but faults and flaws in our work. Only one of you saw our potential, so you others must be kept here.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_THANCRED_000_038: Ah, so that's Livingway's game. Run us about in circles and, failing that, lock us away so we can't put the plan at risk.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_040: He understands what is at stake... What must be done.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_041: I fear you've misjudged us, Growingway. Never have we decried the notion of using the moon as a means of escape.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_042: That said, my heart breaks at the thought of abandoning Etheirys and her reflections to their doom. If there is a way to avert the Final Days, I wish to find it. We all do.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_043: We may fail, but our efforts would never be at the expense of your plans.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_044: But why would you take that risk!?
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_045: There's no room for ifs and maybes now.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_046: The people of Etheirys will escape here to the moon. They'll be safe, and we'll finally get to see all their happy, smiling faces.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_047: I'm sorry, but we can't let you leave. We just can't.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_048: Do what you must, but...try not to hurt them.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_GROWINGWAY_000_049: I'll be back in a moment. Don't do anything rash while I'm gone.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_THANCRED_000_050: If we dally, they'll overwhelm us with sheer numbers. I say we knock these ones out, split up, and make our way to the exit.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_051: Agreed. Let us reconvene where Argos awaits outside.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_THANCRED_000_100: There you are. Didn't rough them up too badly, did you?
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_111: We must hurry to the Watcher's Palace and find Urianger.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_THANCRED_000_120: A declaration of hopes and aspirations... I hadn't thought of it that way before.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_THANCRED_000_121: The Loporrits may be in good hands now, but that doesn't change the fact that their plan is a last resort I'd rather not employ.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_THANCRED_000_122: Let's see it doesn't come to that. For the First and all the other reflections.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_125: The Loporrits think so highly of the people of Etheirys, yet it seems this evacuation plan is the only way they know to express their adoration.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_126: If we had been more clear in our intentions from the start, mayhap we could have avoided this wrinkle...
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_YSHTOLA_000_127: Something to keep in mind in future.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_WATCHEROFMOON_000_1: I chanced to spy you crossing the chasm, and I feared something was amiss.
But all is well, and more importantly, I have been given the opportunity to behold a wonderful sight.
Keep the Elpis close, and its light will be your guide.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_MAPPINGWAY_000_135: There is little I can do to help stop the Final Days, but should you need to know of star traversal, look no further!
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_MAPPINGWAY_000_136: Such knowledge I can offer in abundance, so do not hesitate if you find yourself wanting.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_SINGINGWAY_000_140: The others will be so happy to hear Urianger is going to stay and teach us all about Etheirys.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_SINGINGWAY_000_141: We'll have to be careful not to get too distracted by his lessons─there's still maintenance to carry out, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_PUDDINGWAY_000_145: Nice to meet you... Name's Puddingway.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_PUDDINGWAY_000_146: Sorry again for all the trouble... We promise we'll do better. Honest.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_LIVINGWAY_000_150: Well, that was all rather embarrassing, wasn't it? At least we're on the same page now─people and Etheirys. We'll save both, or at least give it a good try.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_A1_000_152: Make sure everyone listens to Urianger, would you?
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_A1_000_153: Tell Growingway I look forward to our next walk together.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_A1_000_154: You Loporrits sure are an excitable bunch.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_LIVINGWAY_000_155: Oh, we'll be all ears. And you know we can be!
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_LIVINGWAY_000_156: I will. I'm sure he'll be glad to hear it.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_LIVINGWAY_000_157: Well, it's not as if we've been waiting twelve thousand years to meet the people of Etheirys. Oh wait, we have! But that's neither here nor there. Under Urianger's tutelage, we'll strive to become more hospitable hosts, and see that the moon is fully equipped to meet the needs of its potential passengers.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_URIANGER_000_160: 'Twas a relief to see Livingway was pleased with my gift of ink.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_URIANGER_000_161: “To serve and serve well”... Though their knowledge may be lacking, their boundless love is a blessing without peer.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_URIANGER_000_162: It will be no easy task to prepare them for what must needs be done, but gladly do I embrace this duty...even if it doth necessitate that we part ways for a time.
TEXT_AKTKMC109_04407_URIANGER_000_163: Forgive me my absence, but I have the utmost faith in you. In all our fellow Scions. When next I return to Etheirys, I pray I find you all in good health and good spirits.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_000: A declaration of hopes and aspirations... I hadn't thought of it that way before.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_001: The Loporrits may be in good hands now, but that doesn't change the fact that their plan is a last resort I'd rather not employ.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_002: Let's see it doesn't come to that. For the First and all the other reflections.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_URIANGER_000_005: I need not remind you of the dangers we face, nor the countless lives at stake both in the Source and its reflections. Go with courage, my friend, and pray give the others my regards.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: I chanced to spy you crossing the chasm, and I feared something was amiss.
But all is well, and more importantly, I have been given the opportunity to behold a wonderful sight.
Keep the Elpis close, and its light will be your guide.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAPPINGWAY_000_015: There is little I can do to help stop the Final Days, but should you need to traverse the stars, look no further!
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAPPINGWAY_000_016: Such knowledge I can offer in abundance, so do not hesitate if you find yourself in need.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_SINGINGWAY_000_020: The others will be so happy to hear Urianger is going to stay and teach us all about Etheirys.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_SINGINGWAY_000_021: We'll have to be careful not to get too distracted by his lessons─there's still maintenance to carry out, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_PUDDINGWAY_000_025: Nice to meet you... Name's Puddingway.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_PUDDINGWAY_000_026: Sorry again for all the trouble... We promise we'll do better. Honest.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LIVINGWAY_000_030: Well, that was all rather embarrassing, wasn't it? At least we're on the same page now─people and Etheirys. We'll save both, or at least give it a good try.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_A1_000_032: Make sure everyone listens to Urianger, would you?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_A1_000_033: Tell Growingway I look forward to our next walk together.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_A1_000_034: You Loporrits sure are an excitable bunch.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LIVINGWAY_000_035: Oh, we'll be all ears. And you know we can be!
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LIVINGWAY_000_036: I will. I'm sure he'll be glad to hear it.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LIVINGWAY_000_037: Well, it's not as if we've been waiting twelve thousand years to meet the people of Etheirys. Oh wait, we have! But that's neither here nor there. Under Urianger's tutelage, we'll strive to become more hospitable hosts, and see that the moon is fully equipped to meet the needs of its potential passengers.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_040: With the Loporrits in Urianger's capable hands, we needn't worry about affairs here in our absence.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_041: Knowing now the face of their “earthly collaborators,” there is much to discuss with Alphinaud and the others.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_042: Let us return to the Tower of Babil. Our battle for the star will soon begin in earnest, and we must be prepared.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_050: I'd forgotten how cold it was here in Garlemald. A testament to the Loporrits' ingenuity that I felt no such discomfort on the moon.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_060: Gods, I can scarcely believe we went to the moon and back...
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_061: But we'll have time to reflect on that later. Right now, we need to head back to Camp Broken Glass and deliver a thoroughly detailed report to Lucia.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_062: I'd like very much to know how everyone is getting on here as well. They'd only just begun to treat the tempered prisoners when we left.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_063: I share your curiosity, but warning our allies of the Final Days is of greater importance.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_064: I speak not only of the contingent, of course. The heads of state of every nation must know what we have learned.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_065: We know not when or where or in what manner the Final Days will begin to manifest, and so we must see that everyone is prepared.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_066: Agreed, though we may wish to stress the importance of discretion, lest the public be sent into a panic. Not that anyone in a position of responsibility should need to be told as much, but it bears repeating.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_067: Anyway, first things first. To Camp Broken Glass.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_080: It's good to see you all again. No worse for your lunar adventure, I hope.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_081: We've done what we can for now, and believe me, we intend to tell you all about it.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_082: But before we do, might you tell us what's become of Garlemald in our absence?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_083: We succeeded in subduing the tempered inside the Tower of Babil. We took many alive, but combined with those who were already in our custody, the number requiring care has grown exponentially.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_084: The inclement conditions here have made it difficult─if not impossible─to treat them all here, and so we have petitioned the aid of the allied nations.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_085: Some are, understandably, hesitant to proffer assistance, particularly those that were but recently subject to imperial occupation. That said, several others have agreed to grant them refuge for treatment.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_086: With the assistance of your fellow Scions, we endeavor to see them safely transported and subsequently cured of their tempering.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_087: Will all the tempered be relocated?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_088: Not all, no. We have sufficient shelter to attend to those whose treatment has begun, and enough healers have volunteered to remain until their patients have recovered.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_089: Jullus is one such patient, though he is not yet fit to receive visitors.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_090: Truth be told, it was a miracle he and those in his company were not harmed in the chaos. If not for Alphinaud and Alisaie's timely assistance, I daresay none of them would be with us today.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_091: In light of recent developments, have the Alliance leaders come to any decisions regarding Garlemald?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_092: Given the tremendous ramifications of what has happened here, it will take time to determine what must be done. In the meantime, they intend to work with the Eastern alliance to keep a close watch over the provinces.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_093: We have other news to share: shortly after Anima was defeated, we received reports that each and every tower has vanished.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_094: For a mercy, the process was apparently not quite as violent as that you experienced in Thavnair. Those who were trapped within them have been rescued and are receiving treatment. To hasten this endeavor, the beast tribes have received instruction in the magicks needed to cure tempering.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_095: Master Matoya is no doubt thrilled the mother porxie affords her so many visitors.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_096: Yes, we are grateful for her ongoing efforts, as well of those of our comrades near and far.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_097: As for the contingent, several of our members have been granted leave to return to their homelands after the transfer of tempered has been completed.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_098: Lucia and I will remain, along with a small force to continue offering aid to those here in Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_099: The Empire may be no more, but there are yet those who call these lands home.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_100: I believe that accounts for recent events here. So─what of the moon and the Telophoroi?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_101: The Final Days... Gods, I prayed your victory would mark the end of our troubles.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_102: There is still much we do not know, but the Alliance leaders must be told. Would you be willing to contact them in our stead?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_103: Yes, of course. I will send word forthwith.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_104: We'll also release your fellow Scions from their present duties, that they may return to Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_105: Your energies are better spent finding a means to avert the coming apocalypse.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_106: Speaking of your fellow Scions, you will be happy to hear that Mistress Krile, though still on the mend, has been moved to the Baldesion Annex and given into Tataru's care.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_107: Thank you. I look forward to seeing them both upon our return.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_108: Let us be on our way, then.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_109: One last thing, if I may.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_110: After your confrontation with Zodiark, you said Zenos took his leave, and in all likelihood he has returned here to Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_111: I have a mind to dispatch scouts to try and ascertain his whereabouts, but first wished to ask if you believe there is merit in doing so.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_A2_000_113: If they found him, they would not likely live to tell the tale.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_A2_000_114: If you're expecting a trail of destruction to follow, you won't find one.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_117: To dispatch good soldiers in pursuit of such a beast...would be to send them to their deaths.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_118: Aye. You are the only foe he considers worthy.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_119: And even if my men found him, who but you could even hope to bring low that monster?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_121: And I suppose if anyone is to hunt him down, it must be you. Who else could even hope to bring low that monster?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_122: Pray forget I entertained the notion.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_123: While on the subject of Zenos, the Xth Legion has made an official proclamation.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_124: They denounce the crown prince and condemn his role in the Empire's downfall.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_125: His very title has become a source of shame among his former subjects, and its continued use serves only to hinder relations with foreign nations.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_126: For this reason, he has been declared as Zenos viator Galvus, outcast and enemy of Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_127: Fandaniel is no more, and now his own people turn against him. It seems he's naught but his bloodlust to keep him company.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_128: Better that than an army to see it sated. At any rate, I will not keep you longer. I pray you safe passage back to Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_LUCIA_000_130: Your findings will be relayed to the Alliance leaders word for word. And should we spy anything out of the ordinary here in Garlemald, all shall be informed at once.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_135: Once my countrymen have recovered, it falls to me to tell them what's become of Zenos and the Empire.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_MAXIMA_000_136: I realize there is no kindness in withholding the truth, but...it will wound them.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_TATARU_000_140: Oh, it's so good to see you! And free from chilblains, I take it?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_TATARU_000_141: You'll be pleased to know everything's been kept in order since you've been away. I even brought a few useful knickknacks with me from back home.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_TATARU_000_142: But no sooner had they arrived than I received word of Krile in poor health, and you on the moon! If you meant to give me a fright, you succeeded.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_KRILE_000_150: Welcome back, . We were so terribly worried about you.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_KRILE_000_151: Though it is plain I have caused my own fair share of worry, and for that, I apologize.
