TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_KRILE_000_152: Hydaelyn called to me that day when you entered the Tower of Babil. Her pleas were faint but desperate, and I knew at once She required a vessel to carry out Her will.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_KRILE_000_153: What came after feels like a dream barely remembered. My body flowing through the Lifestream toward Garlemald...
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_KRILE_000_154: When I regained consciousness, I was all aches and frostbite, exhausted of aether. So exhausted, in fact, I could only laugh, for it was in that moment I understood Raha's weariness from the Tower of Zot.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_KRILE_000_155: Would that I could laugh at a time like this. Though we prevented Zodiark from being unleashed upon the world, I am curious to know what else took place there on the moon...
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_KRILE_000_156: Ah, perhaps we should wait for the others to join us before you give your account.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_KRILE_000_157: Let us reconvene in the main hall once they've arrived.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_KRILE_000_160: For a blessing, I've recovered enough to get out of bed. Even if I hadn't, I could not well miss you recount your exploits on the moon.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_Q3_000_170: Wait for your comrades to arrive?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_ALISAIE_000_171: Sorry to have kept you all waiting.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_172: Not at all. We understand you've been quite busy.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_THANCRED_000_174: Duty keeps him away, I'm afraid, though  can explain why better than I.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_GRAHATIA_000_176: And we are to escape via the moon? What of the Source and its reflections?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_ESTINIEN_000_177: I've no intention of standing by while the world falls to ruin.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_ESTINIEN_000_178: So, how do we stop this?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_179: Unfortunately, we have no answers at present.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_180: If the celestial currents have grown stagnant, as was the case in the time of Amaurot, the solution would be to alter the flow of aether throughout the entirety of the star.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_181: The ancients accomplished this by summoning Zodiark, sacrificing half the star's population in the doing. But it should go without saying that such a sacrifice must not─cannot─be repeated.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_182: Which leaves us with the daunting task of identifying the underlying catalyst for the Final Days, a feat which even the Amaurotines could not accomplish.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_183: Unfortunately, we found no clues in Mare Lamentorum.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_ALPHINAUD_000_184: There is still much we do not know about the catastrophe itself, let alone what may have caused it.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_ALPHINAUD_000_185: The Final Days were marked by the corruption of the Amaurotines' creation magicks, but we command no such power. Which invites the question: what havoc is in store for us?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_ALPHINAUD_000_186: If we knew that much, perhaps we could draw some parallel with the events of the past, and thereby form some semblance of a plan.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_YSHTOLA_000_187: Perhaps we should start with the Forum, then. Having worked with the Loporrits in secret all this time, there is surely more they can tell us.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_TATARU_000_188: Forgive the interruption, but I've urgent news!
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_TATARU_000_189: The Forum is holding a public assembly in the plaza outside. Some sort of announcement!
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_ALISAIE_000_190: What is Father up to now?
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_KRILE_000_191: There's only one way to find out.
TEXT_AKTKMC110_04408_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_2: Krile tells me the Forum made a rather momentous announcement. So there's to be a great exodus, is there?
I'm reminded of my narrow escape from the Isle of Val. The realization, the running, the mixture of relief and regret after. “Why me?” I asked myself. “Why me?”

Why us? Why now? Why wonder─there's no use fretting over the cosmic morality or lack thereof. We're here, and we'll get through this together. And who knows, maybe my luck will rub off and grant everyone a narrow escape. There's no harm in praying for as much.
Oh, but enough of my rambling─I'm sure you're exhausted. Your chamber awaits!
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_TATARU_000_000: Oh, ! I was just about to call for you.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_TATARU_000_001: I'm afraid we've received another call for assistance. This one comes from Radz-at-Han...
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_TATARU_000_002: The others have assembled in the main hall to discuss the situation. You must join them at once!
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_TATARU_000_010: I heard all about the Final Days from Krile, but I had no idea we'd feel the impact of it this soon...
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_KRILE_000_021: Our worst fears have come to pass. But moments ago, we received grim tidings from our contact in Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_KRILE_000_022: Vile beasts have appeared as if out of nowhere, claiming one victim after the next. What's more, they say the very sky burns above them...
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Good gods... Are the Final Days already upon us?
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_KRILE_000_024: It would appear so. Sadly, that is all the information we have at present. No doubt the people of Radz-at-Han are busy fighting for their lives...
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ALISAIE_000_025: Then we must go at once! They need our help!
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_GRAHATIA_000_026: Agreed. Krile, you'd best remain here with Tataru and gather what knowledge you can. You are in no condition for a long journey, I imagine.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_KRILE_000_027: ...Very well. Similar phenomena may have been observed elsewhere, and if so, we must know about it at once.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_THANCRED_000_029: Let us make first for Yedlihmad. We must prepare ourselves for what may lie ahead.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ALPHINAUD_000_040: We do not wield the creation magicks that the ancients did, yet still these abominations appear. Whatever could be the cause?
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ALISAIE_000_045: With the fall of the tower in Thavnair, the Hannish were beginning to enjoy a semblance of peace. And now this.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_THANCRED_000_050: No similar creatures have been sighted here in Sharlayan. That said, the early signs may manifest in other regions ere long. We must be prepared for every eventuality.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_YSHTOLA_000_055: In ancient times, the phenomenon was first observed in places where the celestial currents had grown weakest. 'Twould seem there is a stagnancy of aether in the skies above Radz-at-Han unbeknownst even to Vrtra.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_GRAHATIA_000_060: If this calamity has indeed come to Thavnair, it is all too likely that Corvos across the strait finds itself in a similar predicament.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_GRAHATIA_000_061: Even now, it remains an imperial province, and as such, it may be some time until we can ascertain the situation there. We can only hope that Krile and Tataru will be able to provide us with some insight sooner rather than later.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ESTINIEN_000_065: If the might of Vrtra is not enough to hold these fiends at bay, Radz-at-Han is in dire straits indeed. We must go at once.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_KRILE_000_070: I would rather accompany you to Thavnair...but Raha's concerns are well founded. The last thing I would want is to be a burden.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_KRILE_000_071: And so I will remain here with Tataru, and do all I can to gather knowledge that might serve us in the battle to come. Godsspeed in your journey, .
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_TATARU_000_075: I'm glad for Krile's support. I'll also call upon Hoary Boulder and the others to assist us. They will be our eyes and ears in the field, as they have been many times before.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ALPHINAUD_000_080: So the beasts are not born of creation magicks run amok, but are rather the altered forms of the people themselves. In that sense, this manifestation of the Final Days differs from that which we witnessed in Amaurot.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ALPHINAUD_000_081: ...And for the worse, I daresay. If any man, woman, or child could become a beast at any moment, there is no telling whence the next threat might come. We must exercise extreme caution.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ALISAIE_000_085: Don't worry. No matter how grim things might get, I won't lose heart. I'm ready whenever you need me.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_THANCRED_000_090: If it's true that the people themselves have transformed into beasts, why, even the Radiant Host could suffer the same fate. Or us, perish the thought...
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_YSHTOLA_000_095: I shall survey the environs closely as we go about our search. There may be some clue as to how we can combat this phenomenon.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_GRAHATIA_000_100: Innocent souls twisted and reformed into unholy abominations. I thought I had seen the last of such nightmares with the sin eaters...
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_GRAHATIA_000_101: We must act quickly, ! Every moment we tarry means another soul may be lost to this nightmare.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ESTINIEN_000_105: Usually the most dangerous foe in a wyrm's domain is the wyrm themselves. If I were Vrtra, I would be as offended as I am horrified.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_AWAHEEN_000_110: Everyone has assembled, yes? I thank you for lending us your aid in our battle against the blasphemy. Let us review our plan of attack.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_AWAHEEN_000_111: I would have you board this boat and circle around to the north side of the island.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_AWAHEEN_000_112: There you will find a dense jungle we call Vanaspati.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_AWAHEEN_000_113: It is a sacred wood, home to many temples and a number of villages.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_AWAHEEN_000_114: Vrtra and the Radiant Host have gone there ahead of us.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_AWAHEEN_000_115: I ask that you join them, and do all in your power to destroy this blasphemy.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_A1_000_118: Form a party and enter Vanaspati.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_AWAHEEN_000_130: I pray we are not too late to spare the settlements within Vanaspati the fate that has befallen our city.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_AWAHEEN_000_131: Once we meet with Vrtra and the Radiant Host, they should be able to tell us more of the present situation.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_HANNISHROYALGUARD_0: Continue with the main scenario quest?
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ALPHINAUD_000_140: While Estinien and Vrtra defend Radz-at-Han from above, we on the ground must find a means to prevent these transformations...and soon.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_ALISAIE_000_145: After so long, and so many sacrifices, we finally found a way to cure the tempered. But these poor souls...they vanish without a trace. Is there truly no saving them...?
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_THANCRED_000_150: The stillness in the air puts me ill at ease. We must be wary.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_YSHTOLA_000_155: Worry not. I can see your aether, and that of our companions. We have not suffered the fate of those unfortunate souls.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_GRAHATIA_000_160: All life must end in death. Yet death, in turn, gives birth to new life─such is the flow of aether. To think that natural cycle could simply be...cut off─the very thought makes me shudder.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_AWAHEEN_000_170: Our Radiant Host has eliminated the immediate threat to the city, though it pains me to know those beasts were once my own people...
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_AWAHEEN_000_171: There is no telling when or where the next transformation might occur. We must remain vigilant and steel ourselves for whatever is yet to come.
TEXT_AKTKMD101_04409_SYSTEM_000_172: You may now enter Vanaspati with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ALPHINAUD_000_000: While Estinien and Vrtra defend Radz-at-Han from above, we on the ground must find a means to prevent these transformations...and soon.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ALISAIE_000_005: After so long, and so many sacrifices, we finally found a way to cure the tempered. But these poor souls...they vanish without a trace. Is there truly no saving them...?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_THANCRED_000_010: The stillness in the air puts me ill at ease. We must be wary.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_YSHTOLA_000_015: Worry not. I can see your aether, and that of our companions. We have not suffered the fate of those unfortunate souls.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_020: All life must end in death. Yet death, in turn, gives birth to new life─such is the flow of aether. To think that natural cycle could simply be...cut off─the very thought makes me shudder.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_AWAHEEN_000_030: Forgive me, my friends, but I must return to Meghaduta for the time being. There, I can better manage this crisis and dispatch my troops as the situation demands.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ALPHINAUD_000_031: In that case, we shall carry out an investigation of our own here in the city.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Mayhap the residents can tell us more about the first of the transformations, and the conditions under which it occurred.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ALPHINAUD_000_033: If we can ascertain what exactly triggered these tragic events, it may give us some insight as to a possible solution.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ALPHINAUD_000_034: Time is of the essence. Let us split into three groups that we may cover more ground.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Alisaie and I will see to Paksa's Path. Thancred and Y'shtola, pray make for Dharma.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ALPHINAUD_000_036: I leave Artha to G'raha and you, . Any information you can gather on the first blasphemy or the manifestation of the Final Days here in the city would be most helpful.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ALPHINAUD_000_037: When we have completed our respective inquiries, let us reconvene in front of Meghaduta, that we might share what we've learned with the satrap.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_041: Artha is home to the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya, whose alchemists forged many of our warding scales.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_042: That seems as good a place as any to begin our investigation, don't you think? I spoke briefly with Nuhadeen, the chief alchemist there, on our last visit. He should be happy to answer our queries.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_SYSTEM_000_043: G'raha Tia is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_SYSTEM_000_044: You can leave G'raha Tia behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_SYSTEM_000_045: Should you part ways, G'raha Tia will return to his original location. Speak with him there and he will accompany you once more.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_055: Let us make for the High Crucible and speak with Nuhadeen. His discerning eye may reveal to us truths we have overlooked.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_Q2_000_060: Are you sure you wish to part ways with G'raha Tia?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_061: Very well. I shall be waiting for you at Alzadaal's Path whenever you are ready to resume our investigation.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_065: Ready to get back to it? Excellent!
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_SYSTEM_000_070: G'raha Tia has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_NUHADEEN_000_080: Hm? Forgive me, traveler, but I am rather too busy at the moment to entertain you.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_SYSTEM_000_081: You should have G'raha Tia accompanying you before proceeding with the investigation.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_NUHADEEN_000_085: Ahh, I remember those red eyes. You were with those “Scions” who commissioned the scales from us, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_NUHADEEN_000_086: I welcome you back to the High Crucible. What brings you here in these troubling times?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_087: We are assisting the satrap in investigating the crisis that plagues the city. Did you happen to catch sight of any of the creatures?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_NUHADEEN_000_088: I did. As I was going about my work, I was disturbed by crashing footsteps so powerful that the very ground shook.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_NUHADEEN_000_089: I rushed outside, and could not believe what I beheld. The night sky was burning...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_NUHADEEN_000_090: Suddenly, I heard panicked screams coming from the direction of Balshahn Bazaar. In the next instant, a monstrous beast poked its head out from amidst the stalls!
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_NUHADEEN_000_091: A handful of the Radiant rushed to the scene, only to be sent sprawling as the fiend and its minions propelled themselves skyward.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_092: ...So the blasphemy came from the vicinity of the markets. This knowledge may prove useful. I thank you for sharing your tale.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_093: Well, I do believe we now know where we should inquire next. To the bazaar, then.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_105: According to Nuhadeen, the blasphemy came from the direction of Balshahn Bazaar. Let us inquire there to see if any of the vendors or customers can enlighten us further.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_110: So this is Thavnairian weave...I must say, it bears a resemblance to the traditional fabrics of Corvos. Small wonder, really, given that it's just across the water.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_111: ...Not that I am much of an expert in Corvosi culture, of course. I've not had the occasion to visit my ancestral home since coming to Sharlayan, and like as not I will never reside there again.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_112: That said, in recent days I've felt more acutely aware of my heritage...and grateful for it. It is thanks to my forebears that I inherited the Royal Eye─and with it, the wisdom of ancient Allag.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_113: And so...well, I simply hope that my countrymen are safe. And one day, when this calamity is but a memory, I would like to see Corvos again, if only once.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_NUHADEEN_000_120: After toiling days and nights to fashion your allies' warding scales, a great number of our alchemists were granted a respite.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_NUHADEEN_000_121: In part because of this, the damage here at the Crucible was limited. On the other hand, we have not heard from many who were at home during the attack. We can only pray that they are safe.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_VARSRA_000_130: Forgive me, but my shop's closed until further notice. Needless to say, we've more pressing concerns these days...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_VARSRA_000_131: Forgive me, but my shop's closed until further notice. Needless to say, we've more pressing concerns these days...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_132: We have come not in search of wares, but information concerning the enormous fiend that tore through the bazaar. Did you perchance witness anything?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_VARSRA_000_133: Afraid not, my friend. I was here the whole time, so I only saw its little minions. Made a mess of the place, they did.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_VARSRA_000_134: While that was all going on, the great big one tore through the west side of the bazaar. You'd have better luck asking there.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_135: ...And with that, I do believe we've learned all we can from the bazaar. Let's take a moment to review our findings.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_VARSRA_000_140: The beasts that attacked us here were scrawny little things, but they caused as much damage as that bigger one. Until the Radiant saw them off, it was all I could do to run for dear life...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RAHDVIRA_000_150: Sisters have mercy, what is happening to the world!? What am I to do...? Is nowhere safe!?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RAHDVIRA_000_151: Sisters have mercy, what is happening to the world!? What am I to do...? Is nowhere safe!?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_152: Settle down, friend. The danger has passed...at least for now. If it's not too painful to remember, could you tell us what you saw?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RAHDVIRA_000_153: F-First I heard the screams...then a horde of ravening beasts came charging towards us!
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RAHDVIRA_000_154: One of them was huge─bigger than a marid! Throwing people about like rag dolls...and it was eating them!
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RAHDVIRA_000_155: I hid. Under the counter. Saw others do the same.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RAHDVIRA_000_156: But the shrieking and wailing kept getting louder...more voices in the throng. Beasts or victims, I couldn't tell─I knew not what was happening. I still don't...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_157: That is enough, my good man. You were brave to share with us your tale. Many of your fellow merchants are safe. The High Crucible, too, has survived mostly unscathed. Pray stay close to your friends and loved ones, and rest your body and mind while you are able.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_158: I suspect that is the most we can expect the people here to tell us. I think it best we find a place outside the bazaar where we might rest and review our findings.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RAHDVIRA_000_160: What nightmare is this... When will it end?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ZEYTAHNUR_000_170: Is something the matter, traveler? If you are lost, perhaps I could be of assistance.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ZEYTAHNUR_000_171: Is something the matter, traveler? If you are lost, perhaps I could be of assistance.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_172: Your offer is most appreciated. We are not lost, but we are in need of information. Might you know anything about the gargantuan beast that rampaged through the bazaar?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ZEYTAHNUR_000_173: Aye, I saw it all. Though I wish I had not.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ZEYTAHNUR_000_174: I was going about my work, when all of a sudden a piercing scream cut through the air. I turned around, and there was the fiend, its massive body bursting through that entryway with the force of a tidal wave. And then it was gone, as quickly as it came...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_175: That is the extent of what we will learn here, I think. Shall we take a moment to consider our findings elsewhere?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_ZEYTAHNUR_000_180: Fortunate was I to be inside my shop at the time. The owner of the stall across from me was hawking his wares on the street. Suffice it to say, he wasn't so lucky...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_190: It might distress those still traumatized by the incident to discuss what we've learned within earshot...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_200: Judging by their accounts, the transformation had already occurred by the time the beast reached the bazaar.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_201: It tore through the west side of the bazaar and headed towards the aetheryte plaza...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_202: In other words, the blasphemy may have first appeared in this vicinity. That being the case, the people in that meyhane can surely tell us more.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_210: You could see the terror in the eyes of those poor merchants. Would that we could do something to allay their fears...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_CUSTOMER04410_000_2: Gods, what I wouldn't give to unsee that horrible sight!
Going after that enormous beast, are you?
Aye, I saw it...including the very instant that poor bastard transformed! Damn the gods for putting me there!
It started over there, by the window. A few men, merchants, probably. Talking and drinking.
Conversation must've taken a turn for the worse. Next thing I know, their leader─I suppose he was─buries his head in his hands, and black mist was swirling about him!
Then his whole body...bursts apart, and there stands a hideous, slavering beast... Massive and foul...all gaping maws and bulging eyes!
His friends start shrieking, then the black mist comes again, until the change takes them too... The stuff of nightmares, I tell you...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_227: Nightmarish, indeed... Incidentally, do you perchance know who those merchants were?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_CUSTOMER04410_000_2: No, I'm a decorator by trade. Not much cause to mingle with their sort.
Saw Mihleel the barmaid chatting with them, though. She might know something.
By the time it was done, every last man at their table had turned into some hideous thing. The rest of us were lucky to escape with our lives...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RHULMEIRA_000_240: Even after repairing all that damage, it'll take a while for business to pick up again...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RHULMEIRA_000_241: Even after repairing all that damage, it'll take a while for business to pick up again...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RHULMEIRA_000_242: You mean the blasphemy? That's what the Radiant have been calling it, anyway.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RHULMEIRA_000_243: I saw it, too. We all did. I was standing here at the counter as Mehryde poured me a drink, when suddenly there came this dreadful sound, like a pained, angry groan.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RHULMEIRA_000_244: It was unlike anything I've ever heard. I turned around in shock, and from an ominous cloud of black mist rose the creature, enormous and ghastly to behold.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RHULMEIRA_000_245: As for what happened next...to recall it sends shivers up my spine. By some stroke of fortune, I was able to slip outside before the beast got its claws on me...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RHULMEIRA_000_246: But the sight that greeted me offered no solace─the blue sky above turned red as blood. Mehryde, myself, and the other survivors clung to each other for dear life until the Radiant Host came to our aid.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_247: ...Wait. Did I hear you correctly? The beast manifested before the sky began to burn?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RHULMEIRA_000_248: I'm certain of it. The windows here offer a clear view of the sky, and I saw nothing out of the ordinary until the beast appeared and began to rage.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_RHULMEIRA_000_249: Even if you're not here to drink, why not stick around and make the place look less empty? I only ask that you mind the carpet. There may be a few bloodstains concealed beneath...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_260: Concerning words, to say the least. And yet, it is too soon to jump to conclusions. Let us talk to this Mihleel, and see if she might enlighten us further.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_265: Oh...hello there. Welcome to Mehryde's Meyhane. What can we get you?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_270: Oh...hello there. Welcome to Mehryde's Meyhane. What can we get you?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_271: We have come not for libations, but rather for information. You are Mihleel, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_272: We are investigating the so-called blasphemy on the satrap's behalf. We hear it was one of your customers─a merchant─that first underwent the transformation. What can you tell us about him?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_273: He...he was something of a regular here, especially of late.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_274: Khalzahl was his name. He ran his own consortium, dealing primarily in the exports of Thavnairian specialties.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_A4_000_276: Where have I heard that name before...?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_A4_000_277: It's through him we met Matsya.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_278: It definitely rings a bell. Come to think of it, didn't you meet a Khalzahl when you first came to Thavnair?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_279: If I recall correctly...he ran a trading operation in Yedlihmad. It was through him that the Scions were acquainted with the fisherman Matsya.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_280: Yes, the names ring a bell. Didn't you meet them both on your first trip to Thavnair?
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_281: If I recall correctly...Khalzahl ran a trading operation in Yedlihmad, and it was there that you made Matsya's acquaintance.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_282: Yes...that is the same Khalzahl, no doubt. A rather successful man, from what I gather.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_283: That said, it was clear that he had fallen on hard times of late. Those ghastly towers popping up everywhere cannot have been good for business.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_284: Even now, with the towers gone, the collapse of the Empire has led to all sorts of problems elsewhere. The market for luxuries is surely not what it once was...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_285: Trying times for the head of a trading consortium, indeed...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_286: Khalzahl was a compassionate man. Even as his own business suffered, he did what he could to provide for the artisans, fishermen, and many others who counted on him to sell their wares.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_287: Indeed, that was the very topic of yesterday's meeting, as far as I could hear. Yet as they discussed matters further, Khalzahl's tone grew grave and grim... It was then that...that...
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_288: Forgive me. I would not have you recall the memory if it brings you pain. If I could, I would ask just one more thing.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_GRAHATIA_000_289: Did you notice anything unusual about Khalzahl in particular? Please...anything at all!
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_290: Sorry, nothing springs to mind. Perhaps someone else can help you.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_291: Khalzahl lived for his work, and had no family that I know of. His employees and associates knew him best, but...they too are lost to us.
TEXT_AKTKMD102_04410_MIHLEEL_000_292: Still, perhaps his neighbors know something I do not. I can direct you to them, if you believe it would help. What do you say?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_000: Thanks to Mihleel, it appears we have a new lead. Let us leave no stone unturned!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_CUSTOMER04410_000_0: Those poor merchants... Turned into frightful beasts, to the last man...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MIHLEEL_000_010: Khalzahl made his home in Kama, a nearby residential area.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MIHLEEL_000_011: From what I gather, Khalzahl lived there since childhood and was known throughout the neighborhood.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_012: Kama...the name is new to me. How do we get there?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MIHLEEL_000_014: I cannot promise that you will find what you seek there, but if nothing else, it is a start.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_015: Come, let's see where this lead takes us.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_030: The residents of Kama should know more of Khalzahl's circumstances.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_031: If we follow Mihleel's directions, we'll be there in no time.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_Q2_000_035: Are you sure you wish to part ways with G'raha Tia?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_036: Very well. I will return to the meyhane for the time being. When you are ready to resume the investigation, meet me there.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_040: And with that, we're off! Let us see what we can learn about the merchant Khalzahl.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_SYSTEM_000_045: G'raha Tia has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_050: Let's see... After leaving the meyhane, we're to retrace our steps and head back towards the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_055: From here, we ascend the stairs...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_060: Ah, this must be Yuj. In which case, we should take the path leading southeast.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_065: If we keep going this way, we should arrive in Kama before long.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_070: Walking these unfamiliar streets is quite the adventure, is it not? I can only hope we can explore Radz-at-Han at our leisure once this crisis has passed.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MIHLEEL_000_080: Forgive me... I know nothing of this “blasphemy,” nor what caused those poor men to take on such hideous forms.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MIHLEEL_000_081: That said, I could tell that Khalzahl cared deeply for his colleagues and clients. He did not seem the sort to willingly damage the trust they placed in him.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_090: ...And this must be Kama! We've arrived at last!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_091: Let us begin questioning the residents without delay. No doubt someone here can tell us more about Khalzahl.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_092: Given recent events, I imagine many are taking shelter indoors.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_100: To see the streets so empty, I wonder if some residents have fled Radz-at-Han altogether.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_SYSTEM_000_115: You should have G'raha Tia accompanying you before proceeding with the investigation.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHTI_000_120: Khalzahl, you say? Yes, I've known him since he was a boy.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHTI_000_121: If there was ever a man who was born to be a merchant, it was him. Always early to depart and late to return, he'd spend his days procuring the finest wares and seeking out willing customers. You could say it came to him as easily as breathing.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHTI_000_122: Sadly, business was flagging of late. No surprise, really, what with how dangerous travel has become. He was cooped up in his house from dawn till dusk the other day─no doubt racking his brain for a way to turn his fortunes around.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHTI_000_123: Then, at night, I heard the door open. I looked out to see Khalzahl sitting on a bench, his head hung low. A man with the weight of the world on his shoulders...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_124: I see. The situation must have been quite dire, indeed...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_125: Did you notice anything else out of the ordinary?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHTI_000_126: Nothing to speak of. Other than the troubles with his consortium, he was the same old Khalzahl. Cordial and honest, like always.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHTI_000_127: These questions you are asking...has something happened to him? He wasn't caught up in that terrible incident at the bazaar, was he?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHTI_000_128: I don't travel much these days, but my daughter's told me not to venture outside. Stuck in here as I am, I've heard little about these bizarre goings-on.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_129: Rest assured, the city is safe for now, but the situation may change without warning.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_130: I urge you: stay close to your daughter, and be prepared to take refuge should the satrap order it.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHTI_000_135: Yes, I shall do just that. Thank you for your concern, and pray stay safe as well.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_PARIGHA_000_140: Hmmm...? Could you come back another time? I just woke up, and I'm not exactly in the mood for idle chitchat.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_PARIGHA_000_141: Hmmm...? Could you come back another time? I just woke up, and I'm not exactly in the mood for idle chitchat.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_142: Well, that's one way to avoid the panic, I suppose...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_143: Pardon our intrusion. You may not have noticed, but a great danger has come to Thavnair. I encourage you to stay alert, and prepare to flee the city should the situation turn dire.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_144: But before we leave you in peace...pray allow us to ask a question or two. Did you know a local merchant named Khalzahl? If so, did you notice anything unusual about him recently?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_PARIGHA_000_145: Khalzahl? Aye, I know him. In fact, we spoke just the other day.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_PARIGHA_000_146: Like many others, his business was doing poorly. Still, it seemed as though he'd managed to turn things around, thanks to a generous order from Ruveydah Fibers. Why, he was practically dancing in the streets.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_PARIGHA_000_147: I haven't spoken with him since, but I assume it all went well. Djinabaha might be able to tell you more, though. As I recall, he was the one who brokered the arrangement.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_148: Djinabaha at Ruveydah Fibers... This sounds promising.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_149: Djinabaha at Ruveydah Fibers... Let's make a point to visit him after we've spoken with other locals.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_PARIGHA_000_155: I must've been working myself too hard... I only intended to take a short nap, but when I woke up, it was already sunset. Come to think of it, hasn't the sky been red rather longer than usual?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_165: From what we've heard, our man Khalzahl was truly at wits' end.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_166: And it all came to a head at the meyhane... Perhaps his arrangement with Ruveydah Fibers did not go according to plan? I expect this Djinabaha can tell us more.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_170: If I am not mistaken, these stairs lead to Dharma.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_171: It is...quite the sight, the red sky above.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_172: During the Final Days of yore, the heavens burned and the stars fell. Creation magicks run amok─that was my assumption when I saw Amaurot.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_173: Perhaps the ancients believed the same─that the terror of a single powerful individual was the cause of their calamity.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_174: And yet, those selfsame horrors now manifest themselves before our eyes. What could it be that sets the heavens aflame and turns ordinary men into beasts?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_180: They're farming silkworms... This must be Ruveydah Fibers, where we should find Djinabaha.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_185: We must protect our wares lest the beasts come again!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_SYSTEM_000_186: Djinabaha will not speak to you alone. Return with G'raha Tia accompanying you to proceed with the investigation.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_190: ...And hurry, I say! There's no time to waste!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_191: Pardon me, but you are in charge of buying and selling here, yes? We have a few questions that we'd like to─
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_192: I'm sorry, but I simply don't have time to chat.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_193: If you haven't noticed, we have our hands full at the moment. We must carry all our wares and equipment to safety before those accursed beasts return.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_194: In that case, might we be of assistance? Perhaps we could speak when the job is done.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_196: You can start by helping us move our equipment. Ask the others what to put where.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_197: And you can carry our fabrics.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_198: Go through that door and speak with Kamala. She'll tell you the rest.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_199: Remember, these textiles are our livelihood. Handle them with care.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_210: You'll get your answers after you've kept your side of the bargain. Now, off with you.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_220: This area is for employees only. Out, out!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_221: What's that? You've come to help!? Oh, praise be to Minduruva!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_222: Kind stranger, I welcome your assistance. On your way here, you passed three storehouses, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_223: I'd like you to carry that small crate to Nahbrifhal, by the storehouse near the hatchery.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_224: The crate of clothing is for Mahnuha...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_225: ...And that massive crate there goes to Zeymeira by the middle storehouse. Watch your back with that one.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_226: Those are all the crates we have ready. Once they've been delivered, consider your work here complete!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_NAHBRIFHAL_000_230: This is where we store all our instruments and materials for both our silkworm hatchery and weaving workshop. I would show you around, but I'm expecting a delivery any moment now.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_NAHBRIFHAL_000_235: Thread, is it? Then you've come to the right place. We thank you for your aid.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHNUHA_000_240: This storehouse is where we keep our finished products. Carpets, curtains, assorted garments and the like. Needless to say, we keep it tightly guarded.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHNUHA_000_245: If you have any crates of finished products such as carpets, clothing, and the like, pray bring them here to our primary storehouse.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_MAHNUHA_000_246: A crateful of clothing, is it? I can take that off your hands. Many thanks for the delivery!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_ZEYMEIRA_000_250: The crates we keep here are packed to the brim with fabrics, and it might surprise you just how heavy they can get. Do take care to lift with your legs, or you'll regret it!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_ZEYMEIRA_000_255: I say, you're quite the brawny one, aren't you? A good thing, that. Never know when you'll need to defend yourself in these unpredictable times.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_ZEYMEIRA_000_256: A crateful of fabrics, is it? Exactly what I was hoping to receive. Here, let me put that away for you.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_260: You've carried all the crates to the storehouses, you say? And so quickly, too! Why, I've never seen anyone so strong!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_261: I and my associates will see to the rest, so please return to Djinabaha and assure him our work is proceeding apace.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_262: To tell the truth, we're grateful for this distraction. Too many terrible happenings of late. But generous souls like yourself give me hope that we may emerge from this trial even stronger. I pray we meet again in more peaceful times.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_KAMALA_000_270: Pack it all up, and quickly, now! We'll not let any of our precious fabrics be trampled and torn by those beasts!
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_280: Done as I asked, have you?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_281: If Kamala is satisfied with your work, then so am I. You have done us a great favor, traveler.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_282: I, too, have delivered the instruments and apparatus entrusted to me.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_283: You both have my thanks. With our wares safely stored away, we'll not lose any more to those fiends.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_284: I take it that your establishment did not escape the attack unscathed?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_285: We did not. Thankfully, most of our workers had already left for the day. But those of us still here saw it all...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_286: We looked to the burning skies in confusion...and then, before we could even begin to make sense of it, a hideous creature burst through the doors, shrieking...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_287: We ran for our lives, but one of my colleagues was not so fortunate. He cried out─a scream of such agony, such terror─and in the next instant, he, too, sprouted fearsome claws...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_288: The sight of it caused another fellow to panic, and then...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_290: ...I'm sorry. There was something you wanted to ask?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_291: Indeed. You knew the merchant Khalzahl, did you not? I believe he had some dealings with your establishment.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_292: Khalzahl? I know him well. We'd arranged for his consortium to deliver a large shipment of fabrics, but in the end, we received a better offer, and had to turn him down.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_293: I understand his business is struggling, but so is ours. Another of our most reliable trading partners agreed to transport the goods for a much smaller commission, and we'd have been fools to refuse.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_294: I felt terrible for withdrawing the offer...but you must understand, we simply had no choice.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_DJINABAHA_000_295: He tried to put on a brave face when I delivered the news, but his dejection and despair were plain as day. He said he'd discuss it with his associates, but I could tell he'd all but given up hope...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_297: You remember what we saw in Vanaspati, yes? Soldiers and jungle dwellers pushed to the very brink turning into beasts one after the next...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_298: It would seem the same phenomenon occurred here. The poor craftsmen attacked by the fiends, as well as those that witnessed it...all undergoing the change.
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_299: I suspect that everything began with Khalzahl. By all accounts, it was he who suffered from the most profound and piercing despair...
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_300: ...Wait. Could that be it? That such intense emotions were what triggered his transformation?
TEXT_AKTKMD103_04411_GRAHATIA_000_301: Much remains unclear, but I believe we are drawing closer to an answer. At any rate, we must discuss our findings with the others.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_DJINABAHA_000_000: Can the despair in a man's own heart consign him to such a terrible fate...?
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_GRAHATIA_000_010: We were to reconvene with the others in front of Meghaduta, were we not? That should be just outside.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_GRAHATIA_000_011: With any luck, they will have already returned from their own investigations.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_GRAHATIA_000_012: My friend, we must take our leave. I pray that your establishment is spared further tragedy. But remember: your lives are far more precious than any wares. If you are ordered to flee, do so without hesitation.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_DJINABAHA_000_013: Indeed... I thank you for your concern, and pray you two take care as well.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_THANCRED_000_020: Finished your rounds and ready to share?
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALISAIE_000_030: Damn it all... Staying calm isn't exactly my forte...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_MATSYA_000_035: We meet again. You...you do remember me, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_MATSYA_000_036: You saved my skin twice over in Yedlihmad. And now I find myself turning to you for help once more... But let us tarry here no longer!
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_040: We must save Palaka's Stand. Whatever it takes.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Matsya. It pains me to put you into harm's way, but I would ask your aid as well.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_MATSYA_000_042: O-Of course! Palaka's Stand is not far, just down that hill.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_MATSYA_000_043: But as I told His Excellency before, the path was blocked by terrible creatures. I had no choice but to turn back.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_044: In that case, this is what we shall do...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_045: . I ask that you take the lead and dispatch any beasts you encounter.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Alisaie and I will keep Matsya hidden amidst the trees, and follow when the path is clear.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_047: There is no telling what dangers await us. Keep your eyes peeled.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Good work, , though I worry for Matsya...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALISAIE_000_081: We must heal those we can, and quickly! I see no beasts, but stay on your guard!
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_090: There...you'll be fine. The pain will soon pass.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALISAIE_000_095: His wounds are deep, but he may yet be saved. Go and help the others!
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_MATSYA_000_100: When I last came here to sell my fish, everyone was so bright and cheerful. This is a nightmare...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_YERUVVET_000_105: The horror... I pray that the Sisters will see us through this calamity...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_SYSTEM_000_110: The villager has no pulse, nor do they appear to be breathing...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_SYSTEM_000_115: There is nothing you can do for this villager.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_SYSTEM_000_120: The cooling body has already begun to stiffen...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_SYSTEM_000_121: The massive wounds suggest the villager was gored by a terrible beast...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_SYSTEM_000_125: This villager has been dead for some time.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_PALAKASMANC04412_00: Have you...have you come to...help us?
Too late...too late... My family...my friends... <sob>
I...I am fine, thank you... Please...save the others...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_SYSTEM_000_140: Though the villager's injuries do not appear to be life-threatening, he does not respond to your efforts. His breathing grows more ragged and shallow, and his vacant eyes are those of a man who has lost the will to live...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_PALAKASMAND04412_00: Even if I wake...the nightmare goes on... No...leave me to sleep...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_SYSTEM_000_143: You call out, but the man does not respond...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_SYSTEM_000_144: This poor soul is beyond saving.
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_150: Are these the only villagers who survived?
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_151: I can only hope others managed to flee. But if the rest have been turned to beasts... By the Twelve...
TEXT_AKTKMD104_04412_ALPHINAUD_000_152: Let us do what we can to see that the damage spreads no further. And no matter what comes, we must keep our spirits high...lest we ourselves suffer a similar fate.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_ALISAIE_000_000: His wounds are deep, but he may yet be saved. I will see to him─pray look after the others!
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_005: When I last came here to sell my fish, everyone was so bright and cheerful. This is a nightmare...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_YERUVVET_000_010: The horror... I pray that the Sisters will see us through this calamity...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_SYSTEM_000_015: There is nothing you can do for this villager.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_SYSTEM_000_020: This villager has been dead for some time.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_PALAKASMANC04412_00: I...I am fine, thank you... Please...save the others...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_SYSTEM_000_030: This poor soul is beyond saving.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_ALPHINAUD_000_040: I can tend to the rest. Pray look after Matsya─no doubt what we have seen here weighs even heavier on his heart than ours.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Stay by Matsya's side, . Unlike us, he is not accustomed to seeing such horrors...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_061: This is Yeruvvet, the elder here. He is hurt, but─praise be to the Sisters─he still lives!
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_YERUVVET_000_062: Young Matsya here has told me everything. I have not the words to express my gratitude for your aid.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_YERUVVET_000_063: When the heavens began to burn, we were afraid, but did our best to carry on as we always have done...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_YERUVVET_000_064: Until today, when those unholy beasts came pouring into our village, a flood of midnight and death...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_YERUVVET_000_065: There are no words to describe what followed. Men and women I have known since they were babes struck down by the creatures, only to rise again to join the murderous horde, in the guise of those same hideous fiends...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_YERUVVET_000_066: In the chaos, a handful of our villagers fled for their lives. I can only hope they have found their way to safety...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_YERUVVET_000_067: Matsya, do you perchance remember Qerasaf and Mehvan? The young couple who always bought your freshest catches...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_068: How could I forget, Elder? When I first came to peddle my wares─desperate to eke out a living─they showed me such kindness...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_069: Others shunned me as an outsider, as is their way. But Qerasaf and Mehvan bought my fish, and sung its praises. They turned my fortunes around!
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_YERUVVET_000_070: Alas, I fear they are in terrible danger. I saw them running towards Agama Temple, one of those beasts in close pursuit.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_YERUVVET_000_071: They had their child─still but a tiny babe. To elude these fiends while caring for one so young is an impossible task, surely. I beg of you, go to their aid...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_072: I...I want to help them. Yet I am but a fisherman─I cannot face beasts on my own. Will you come with me?
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_073: Oh, thank you! Agama Temple lies to the west of here. We must hurry!
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_ALISAIE_000_080: Don't worry─Alphinaud and I will watch over the village until you return. Go and find Matsya's friends.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_091: It was built by those who worship Saint Agama, but has sadly fallen into disrepair in recent years.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_092: If my friends made it this far, no doubt they are hiding somewhere amidst the ruins.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_094: That was Qerasaf! Oh, no─this is not good!
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_098: P-Please do! The cry came from the ruins. You must hurry!
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_099: Y-Yes, I understand... The cry came from the ruins! You must hurry!
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_110: That was Qerasaf's voice─I'm sure of it! Oh gods...gods have mercy...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_SYSTEM_000_130: The man lies motionless on the ground, bearing a grievous wound...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_131: I'm sorry, . I tried to stay behind, but I couldn't...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_QERASAF_000_134: My arms...so heavy... And my legs... I cannot feel my legs...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_QERASAF_000_136: I need to find them...need to be with them...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_138: Qerasaf! No, Qerasaf─you must stay strong!
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_QERASAF_000_139: More time... I thought I had...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_146: Mehvan still lives. And she has their child...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_147: We must search the jungle between here and Palaka's Stand. There is nowhere else she could have gone. I think...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_148: Forgive me, Qerasaf... Once we have saved your wife and child, we will return and lay you to rest...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_SYSTEM_000_150: You see no tracks or other signs of recent travel. Mehvan and the child must be elsewhere...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_SYSTEM_000_170: If Mehvan and her daughter came through this area recently, you see no evidence of their passage...
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_ALPHINAUD_000_180: ...There. Your wounds have closed. Can you stand?
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_ALISAIE_000_185: Just a moment, . I'll be with you shortly.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_190: D-Did you see any sign of them? I found nothing!
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_191: Perhaps the beasts have chased them farther from the village.
TEXT_AKTKMD105_04413_MATSYA_000_192: Oh, gods above, I beseech you! Pray deliver Mehvan and her little one to safety...
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_000: If Mehvan fled deeper into the jungle, she and her child are in grave danger! Wh-Whatever are we to do!? Gods have mercy!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_A1_000_002: You must try to stay calm, Matsya.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_A1_000_003: You cannot let fear consume you...
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_A1_000_004: Do you want to turn into a beast like the others?
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_005: But...how can I at a time like this? They could be dead!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_006: So...if I allow myself to be overcome by this fear, I, too, might become a beast? I am not sure I understand, but I will do my best...
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_007: Fear...consume me? What are you talking about?
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_008: Then...I, too, could become a beast? I...I understand. I think.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_009: M-Me? A beast? What are you talking about!?
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_010: Gods... So that is what causes it? Then I have no choice...I must keep my fear in check.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALISAIE_000_011: I've seen to the wounded. How did the two of you fare? Did you find your friends?
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALISAIE_000_012: ...I see. In that case, let us help you find the mother and child.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Before we leave, we must ensure the village will be safe in our absence.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Alisaie and I will patrol the area and search for more beasts.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Would you and Matsya speak with Elder Yeruvvet? Pray explain to him the situation, and join us as soon as you are able.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALISAIE_000_016: We will save Mehvan and her child. We can do that much for Qerasaf...
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_020: <sniff> It will not be easy... But I will tell the elder about Qerasaf...
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_YERUVVET_000_030: I am heartened to see you both safe, but what of the family?
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_YERUVVET_000_032: Say no more. I understand. We have lost another of our dear friends...
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_YERUVVET_000_033: Qerasaf may be gone, but there is still hope for Mehvan and their child. Please find them, I beg of you!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_YERUVVET_000_034: And if, in your search, you come across anyone else who escaped the slaughter, pray tell them what has happened.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_YERUVVET_000_035: I will do my best to keep the villagers safe...and their spirits high.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_036: Come, let us rejoin your friends at once!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_YERUVVET_000_040: Qerasaf and Mehvan married only three summers ago. The day their daughter was born...I had never seen them so happy. They did not deserve this─none of these people did.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALPHINAUD_000_045: We encountered no beasts during our patrol, thankfully.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_050: Where might Mehvan have run off to? Think, Matsya, think!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALISAIE_000_060: I'm pleased to report that the vicinity appears to be beast-free─no doubt thanks to your earlier efforts.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALISAIE_000_061: And with that, let us resume our search for your friend and her child. Where should we begin, Matsya?
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_062: If we follow Ksiroda south, we will arrive at Purusa, a temple. It is a sacred place where people go to commune with the divinities.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_063: It's possible that Mehvan sought shelter there, and perhaps other villagers as well...
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALISAIE_000_064: Then it's settled. Matsya, stay close to me, all right?
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALISAIE_000_065: You two, take the lead. Keep an eye out for beasts and anyone in need of help.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALPHINAUD_000_066: Very well. We make for Purusa, as quickly as we are able. With me!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_SUFFERER04414_000_0: Th-Thank you... I thought I was done for...
Hm? Mehvan? She is a friend of mine, too, but I have not seen her...
She must still be out there somewhere, trying to avoid the beasts. And with her child, gods... Worry not for me─I can make my way back to the village on my own!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_080: , wait! Purusa lies just up ahead, but something terrible has happened!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_081: The beasts have come, and many have already been killed!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_082: Alphinaud and Alisaie have gone to do what they can, but there are so, so many─more than I could count. You must be ready...
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_MATSYA_000_090: I...I am fine. I will be safe hiding here. Please, you must help those people!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALPHINAUD_000_095: Remain calm, and do not wander off! I will tend to the wounded.
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALISAIE_000_100: Stay strong! We'll keep you safe─I promise!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_POPMESSAGE_000_130: The villager transforms into a beast and lunges towards you!
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALPHINAUD_000_140: There you are! How fare the others?
TEXT_AKTKMD106_04414_ALPHINAUD_000_141: ...I see. You've seen to all the beasts in sight? In that case, let's have everyone gather in front of the temple.
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_ALPHINAUD_000_000: We must go after them at once!
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_ALISAIE_000_010: Over there! My view was blocked by the trees, but I'm sure I saw someone being chased by a beast!
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_ALISAIE_000_011: , go with Matsya and search along the river! Alphinaud and I will circle around from the south!
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_MATSYA_000_020: We've reached the Font of Maya... Maybe they're hiding in the ruins?
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_SYSTEM_000_030: Mehvan's lifeless body floats before you, battered and broken. Her death no doubt came swiftly.
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_SYSTEM_000_031: Her infant daughter, however, is nowhere to be seen...
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_SYSTEM_000_035: There is nothing more you can do for the ill-fated Mehvan. Her child, however, may yet be saved...
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_SYSTEM_000_040: You take the babe into your arms. If she yet lives, you cannot tell, but she will surely not survive unless you carry her to the surface at once.
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_SYSTEM_000_045: It is too late for Mehvan, but perhaps not for her child...
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_MATSYA_000_055: Oh no, no, no... Wh-What do we do? What do we do!?
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Did you find Mehvan and the child!?
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_ALPHINAUD_000_062: You have the child!? Let me see her!
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_ESTINIEN_000_075: Go. I will keep watch until your work is done.
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_ALPHINAUD_000_080: We have done what we can. 'Tis for the villagers of Palaka's Stand to perform the funeral rites.
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_ALPHINAUD_000_081: If nothing else, Mehvan and Qerasaf died as they lived─as themselves, and not as beasts. Their souls will find peace in the aetherial sea.
TEXT_AKTKMD107_04415_ALPHINAUD_000_082: To think the day would come when even that smallest of solaces would be this comforting...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ALPHINAUD_000_005: ...May their souls be reunited one day. For that and so many other blessed possibilities, we must avert the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ESTINIEN_000_011: In that case, let's head to Palaka's Stand. No doubt Vrtra is awaiting us.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_YERUVVET_000_020: First hordes of beasts, now a mighty wyrm... Our world grows stranger by the day...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_030: Rest easy, for all is well here.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_031: Young Matsya returned with the babe safe in his arms. Owing to a warm bed, the girl hath already begun to regain her strength.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_032: Less joyously received was word of the mother and father's fate, as well as that of their transformed neighbors...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_033: How many children of Thavnair must we lose to this calamity?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_034: Mothers and fathers, brothers and sisters, sons and daughters... Every death another void that can never be filled...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_035: We who survive them must carry the weight of their memory, as we strive to regain a semblance of what we have lost.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_036: Qerasaf and Mehvan's babe is a child of Thavnair as well. I thank you for returning her to us safe.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_YERUVVET_000_037: O, most great and merciful wyrm... I have not the words to express my gratitude...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_YERUVVET_000_038: They say that were it not for you...brave Matsya and the child would have been lost to us forever.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_YERUVVET_000_039: Long had I heard the rumors that a mighty dragon had forged a pact of friendship with the satrap, but never would I have expected such a kind and gentle soul.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_040: Truth in part...but not in whole.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_041: I am Vrtra, and for years uncounted hath this isle served as mine abode.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_042: ...An isle I have ruled over as satrap, with Ahewann as my loyal servant.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_043: (-???-)Are my ears to be believed!? You were the true satrap all along!?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ALISAIE_000_044: Nidhana!? What are you doing here?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_045: I heard from the Radiant that you had gone to help the people of Palaka's Stand in their time of need.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_046: And so I and several of my colleagues from the Great Work came to offer our services.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_MATSYA_000_047: The alchemists have already brewed up some potions for Mehvan's daughter!
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_048: But enough about us─you and your role are the far greater enigma!
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_049: If you were the true satrap all along, could it be that young Varshahn was...created...to serve as your emissary?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_050: Thou didst suspect the boy was but a simulacrum?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_051: A rumor has circulated for many years around the High Crucible that our most skilled alchemists were once commissioned by the satrap's family in secret to fashion a mammet indistinguishable from a living boy.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_052: Looking at Varshahn with that knowledge...I simply put two and two together.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_053: I was not alone in drawing this conclusion. But like me, they no doubt recognized that the satrap was using the simulacrum to work more closely with his people, and decided not to press the issue.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_054: I had always assumed one of Ahewann's associates was manipulating it from afar─though the truth is indeed far more surprising!
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_055: It is an honor to meet you in the flesh, Master Vrtra. Pray allow me to express my gratitude.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_056: If you had not believed in and given unto us your scales, I do not know where we would be. Thank you...from the bottom of my heart.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_057: 'Twas thou and thy fellow alchemists that fashioned the means to unmake the towers. You were the saviors not only of Radz-at-Han, but the star.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_058: Far too kind you are, Master Vrtra...but the star yet wants for salvation. Once more will my colleagues and I commit the knowledge and resources at our disposal to the mission of aiding the people, in this their darkest hour.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VRITRA_000_059: 'Twould seem this place is in good hands. I would return to see how Radz-at-Han fares. What will you do, Scions?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ALPHINAUD_000_060: I worry for the survivors we met at Purusa. Shall we pay them a visit before making our way back?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_061: In that case, might I ask a favor? Nothing too burdensome, I promise. This way!
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Curious, isn't it? The burning sky is so ominous, yet the crackling flames here are somehow...calming.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ALISAIE_000_075: What a lovely aroma... I wonder what sort of spices those are?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ESTINIEN_000_080: Vrtra chose to reveal his identity to the villagers of Palaka's Stand before all others. A wise choice, considering the warm reception. Heh, he even seemed a little relieved...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ESTINIEN_000_081: It remains to be seen how the people of Radz-at-Han will take the news, but if this was any indication, he need not worry.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_MATSYA_000_085: Oh, ! Running through that dark jungle, there was a time when I thought all was lost! Had Master Vrtra and Estinien not arrived when they did...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_MATSYA_000_086: ...No. I must focus on the good. Mehvan's precious daughter is safe and sound, and that is all that matters.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_090: Needs to simmer just a bit longer, I'd say...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_091: In the meantime, I was hoping I might ask you a few questions. The red sky, these terrible beasts... What in the name of the Sisters is happening here in Thavnair?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_092: Oh my, that's rather a lot to take in...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_093: ...It would seem the situation is even more grave than we suspected. Thank you, friend. My colleagues and I will use your knowledge to see if it can further our own research.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_094: ...And with that, here we are! A pot of piping hot chai, brewed from my own secret recipe of spices and tea leaves, together with hearty helpings of rich milk and purest sugar!
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_095: I've made enough for everyone in the village. Might I trouble you to deliver a few cups?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ALPHINAUD_000_096: The drink has medicinal properties, then?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_097: Not in the least! The ingredients are quite ordinary. It's so very tasty, though, and has a way of lifting the spirits.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_098: The spicy aroma and distinctive sweetness of chai is a simple, everyday pleasure on our island. Sometimes the best medicine is the simplest.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ALPHINAUD_000_099: A lovely sentiment, Nidhana. By all means, allow us to assist.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ESTINIEN_000_100: While you lot distribute hot beverages, I'll do a sweep for errant beasts to slay─a far less arduous task, no doubt. When you've finished, look for me at the Wakeful Torana.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ALPHINAUD_000_110: I heard that the survivors we met at the temple have all returned safely. The crisis may not have passed, but being home and among friends should do much to ease their spirits.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_ALISAIE_000_115: The aroma of that chai truly is irresistible... Do you suppose Nidhana would mind if I helped myself to a cup?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_120: I would be most obliged if you could deliver a few cups of chai to the villagers. I am certain it will do much to soothe their aching bodies and heavy hearts.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_TIREDMAN04416_000_1: Hm...? Wait. I know you. You were the one who saved us from those beasts back at the temple...
Were it not for you─well, let's not even think about that. At times like this, we mustn't dwell on what might've been, but look to the future...
But what future awaits us? How can Radz-at-Han hope to recover from this? Most of my friends are gone, and I don't know where to turn...
A cup of chai? Well, if you insist...

Ahhh...that aroma has a way of clearing the mind... Come to think of it, we've faced our fair share of trials in the past as well. And no matter how hard the times, we've always come together as a people united.
One day at a time, one step at a time─for that is all any of us can do. Yes... Back to work. Once I've finished this cup. Thank you.
First order of business is securing food and shelter. We also must contact our friends in the city and see how they fare. Hah, no rest for the weary!
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NAHBSHAYRA_000_150: Look at them all, lazing about! Knowing full well the beasts might strike again at any moment! Do they not realize their lives are in danger!?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NAHBSHAYRA_000_151: Well, I, for one, intend to survive! I'm too young to die! Yes, I'll leave this island behind if I must!
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NAHBSHAYRA_000_152: But...but where would I go? Is anywhere safe these days!?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NAHBSHAYRA_000_153: A cup of chai? Can't you see I have more important things to worry about!?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NAHBSHAYRA_000_154: No...no, you're right. It is precisely in times like these that we must strive to remain calm and steady.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NAHBSHAYRA_000_155: I do believe I'll visit the elder and see what needs to be done. If there is any way I can aid my village and my friends, I will do it.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NAHBSHAYRA_000_160: Ahhh...how the warmth of the chai spreads through all my limbs... I can't remember the last time I've breathed so easily.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VISHRYDE_000_170: I'm sorry, I... I just want to be left alone...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VISHRYDE_000_171: My best friend and I...we fled the village together... One of the beasts took him, and...and...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VISHRYDE_000_172: It was all I could do to run. All the while...I could hear this monstrous voice screaming my name...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VISHRYDE_000_174: Ahh... We used to drink chai together often. Shared stories over steaming cups after a hard day's work.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VISHRYDE_000_175: Thank you, friend. The pain may never pass, but I must press on all the same. For his memory, and for we who must remember...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_VISHRYDE_000_180: Many thanks for the chai. It helps me to remember him as he was, cup in hand and a smile on his lips...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_190: Thank you for delivering the chai, . Did it help to lift the villagers' spirits?
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_191: That is heartening to hear, indeed! The Final Days show no signs of abating, but that is all the more reason that we must try to keep our composure.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_192: Our lives have been forever changed. The people we have lost will never return to us. These tragedies will long weigh on our hearts...
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_193: But we have the capacity to live with our suffering. To carry the agony till we too join the fallen in death.
TEXT_AKTKMD108_04416_NIDHANA_000_194: It is not a surrender, but a recognition. For it is only in acceptance that we find the strength to move forward.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I heard that the survivors we met at the temple have all returned safely. The crisis may not have passed, but being home and among friends should do much to ease their spirits.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALISAIE_000_005: The aroma of that chai truly is irresistible... Do you suppose Nidhana would mind if I helped myself to a cup?
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_NIDHANA_000_010: Hardship is an inescapable part of life, we believe. And so our traditions teach us how we might overcome these trials. Perhaps this is why we are quick to adapt to new situations.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_TIREDMAN04416_000_0: First order of business is securing food and shelter. We also must contact our friends in the city and see how they fare. Hah, no rest for the weary!
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_MATSYA_000_030: As you have finished your deliveries, might I talk with you for a moment? I was curious to know...what has become of Mehvan and Qerasaf's remains.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_MATSYA_000_031: Oh, thank you, friend. Surely, they will be able to rest peacefully by each other's side.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_MATSYA_000_032: I and the people of Palaka's Stand will perform the rites as soon as we are able.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_MATSYA_000_033: As for the child...it will not be easy for her, growing up without her parents, but I promise to do what I can. Once she is able to eat solid food, the fish I catch will help nourish her.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALISAIE_000_034: Well, we've finished delivering the chai. I do believe everyone has a piping hot cup.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALPHINAUD_000_035: I could almost believe there's a magick at work, how their tension fades with every sip. Let us pray that Palaka's Stand has seen the last of those transformations─at least for now.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALPHINAUD_000_036: They are still at risk─as every village in Thavnair, like as not. Still, I trust we can leave this place in the care of our friends from the Radiant and the High Crucible. Shall we return to Radz-at-Han?
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_NIDHANA_000_037: By all means, do not let us keep you further! There are still many who have need of your wisdom and strength to deliver them from this terrible calamity.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_MATSYA_000_038: And I will do what I can as well! I will bring rations and supplies from Akyaali─we have plenty to spare.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALISAIE_000_039: Then let us find Estinien and be on our way. Where did he wander off to again?
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALISAIE_000_040: The Wakeful Torana? Near the bridge to Radz-at-Han, as I recall. Very well, then.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_NIDHANA_000_050: Worry not─my colleagues and I will watch over this village when you have gone. And should my research bear any new fruit, you shall be the first to know!
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_MATSYA_000_055: When you and your friends entrusted me with the child, I was beside myself with fear. In bringing her back safe, however, I realized I was capable of so much more than I ever believed.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_MATSYA_000_056: Nothing could be more terrifying than that moment I faced the beasts in the jungle. But I survived. I survived...and come what may, I will survive again.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_MATSYA_000_057: Without you, I never would have found the strength. I thank you, and promise to make the most of this lesson.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALPHINAUD_000_060: I have apprised Estinien of the situation at Palaka's Stand, so we needn't have that conversation.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALISAIE_000_065: How do you suppose the others have fared in the capital? I hope things have not been too eventful in our absence.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ESTINIEN_000_070: Alphinaud told me everything. Full glad am I to hear the people are safe.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ESTINIEN_000_071: Likewise, you will be pleased to know I found no evidence of lingering beasts in the jungle and ruins. 'Twould seem you finished off the last of them.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ESTINIEN_000_072: Trying times yet lie ahead for the people of Thavnair. Fortunately, they have a wise and benevolent satrap to shepherd them through.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ESTINIEN_000_073: Speaking of which, I received word from Thancred not a short while ago. He awaits our return to the city on Alzadaal's Path. Come.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALPHINAUD_000_080: There is a lingering sense of desolation here, but that is much preferable to the panic and chaos we saw before.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALISAIE_000_085: The poor old woman who became a beast said her grandson had gone to Palaka's Stand. I hope he survived...
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ESTINIEN_000_090: 'Twill be a struggle for the people to come to terms with these tragedies. But they are far stronger than you may think.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_THANCRED_000_100: It is good to see you safe. Given the skies, 'tis all too easy to fear the worst.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_THANCRED_000_101: I am pleased to report that we've succeeded in quelling the threat here in the city. The beasts have all been felled, and the citizens are safe for now.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_THANCRED_000_102: I've also heard from the Radiant that an important proclamation will be made in the city square, though they said no more than that. Might you have any idea what this is about?
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_THANCRED_000_103: ...So Vrtra is finally coming out from behind the curtain. I suppose we, too, should hear what he has to say.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_THANCRED_000_104: To Meghaduta, then. But before that...it would appear that word of the assembly has not yet reached all the citizens.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_THANCRED_000_105: If anyone along the way seems unaware, we'd best enlighten them.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_THANCRED_000_110: I'm sure everyone will hear about it soon enough, but those who don't attend will be kicking themselves later for missing what's certain to be a historic moment.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_HANNISHBOYB_000_120: A-Are the beasts all gone? I've been hiding, and...I'm too scared to go out and look.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_HANNISHBOYB_000_121: O-Oh, that's a relief! I thought one of those beasts was going to eat me!
