TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_HANNISHBOYB_000_122: I wonder where Varshahn is... He's the slowest runner. I hope he got away.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_HANNISHBOYB_000_123: Hmm... He could be with the other people from the palace. Maybe I'll see him in the square!
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_HANNISHMAN04417_000: L-Leave me be, please! I swear to you, my flesh tastes absolutely terrible!
...Oh, gods, what are you doing, scaring me like that? If we're not quiet, those beasts'll find us!
But that's where the satrap was killed─with my very eyes I saw him crushed in that creature's maw! So many lives lost...such terrible carnage...
And you say there is someone else who would lead Radz-at-Han in his stead!? Whoever they are, if they say anything to sully the memory of our beloved satrap, I'll make them regret it!
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALPHINAUD_000_140: It would seem the people still have lingering doubts...and I cannot blame them.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALPHINAUD_000_141: Yet we know what strength is afforded us with one of the first brood on our side. I have faith the citizenry will come to understand and accept him in time.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALISAIE_000_145: People are slowly making their way here, but many are still gripped by fear and doubt. Hopefully Vrtra's message of hope will resonate strongly enough with the ones willing to listen, and spread to every corner of Thavnair...
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_THANCRED_000_150: Finished rounding up the stragglers? The proclamation will begin shortly─let's wait here, lest we miss something important.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_YSHTOLA_000_155: Welcome back, . Alphinaud told me everything.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_YSHTOLA_000_156: I was pleased to hear that Vrtra has chosen to reveal himself at last. The people of Radz-at-Han need a strong and wise satrap more than ever.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_GRAHATIA_000_160: I hear you were able to bring the situation at Palaka's Stand under control. Every life lost is a tragedy, but you should take pride in doing what you could.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_GRAHATIA_000_161: When I assumed command during the earlier panic, I did so instinctively and out of necessity. 'Twas not my place to give orders, but I am glad the people heeded them.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_GRAHATIA_000_162: But now they have need of a true leader─a magnanimous and just satrap who can guide them every step of the way. Fortunately, they are blessed with one such soul. If anyone can protect and guide them through this calamity, it is he.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ESTINIEN_000_165: Wyrm and man, working towards a common goal...
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALISAIE_000_170: We have no better, safer course of action to offer them than fleeing to the moon. I know this. And yet, Vrtra and his people love their home. There must be something we can do...
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_THANCRED_000_175: Their solution sits ill with me. But if life has taught me anything, it's that there is little to be gained from arguing with Sharlayans. We must take it upon ourselves to find a better way.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_YSHTOLA_000_180: Even were Vrtra to acquiesce to their proposal, just how do the Sharlayans intend to transport the nation's entire populace to the moon?
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_GRAHATIA_000_185: That soldier of the Radiant there─if I am not mistaken, he accompanied Ahewann to Vanaspati. Could it be that he knew Vrtra's identity all along...?
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ESTINIEN_000_190: Under normal circumstances, the Forum's proposal would be regarded as sheer madness. But when the sky burns, even madness can sound appealing.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ESTINIEN_000_191: Doubtless Vrtra is loath to abandon his home. And yet, absent other options, he cannot dismiss the option out of hand...
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_HANNISHROYALGUARD_0: I have been entrusted with a message meant for you and your companions. When you are done speaking amongst yourselves, I would share it with you.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALPHINAUD_000_200: As far as we have come─and after all the horrors we have seen─there is still so much we do not know about the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMD109_04417_ALPHINAUD_000_201: Could it be as Nidhana said? That the cause of this phenomenon is beyond our comprehension? And, if so...are we powerless to forestall it?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ALPHINAUD_000_000: No matter what my father and the Forum say, giving up and abandoning this place cannot be our only recourse!
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ALISAIE_000_005: We have no better, safer course of action to offer them than fleeing to the moon. I know this. And yet, Vrtra and his people love their home. There must be something we can do...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_THANCRED_000_010: Their solution sits ill with me. But if life has taught me anything, it's that there is little to be gained from arguing with Sharlayans. We must take it upon ourselves to find a better way.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_YSHTOLA_000_015: Even were Vrtra to acquiesce to their proposal, just how do the Sharlayans intend to transport the nation's entire populace to the moon?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_GRAHATIA_000_020: That soldier of the Radiant there─if I am not mistaken, he accompanied Ahewann to Vanaspati. Could it be that he knew Vrtra's identity all along...?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ESTINIEN_000_025: Under normal circumstances, the Forum's proposal would be regarded as sheer madness. But when the sky burns, even madness can sound appealing.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ESTINIEN_000_026: Doubtless Vrtra is loath to abandon his home. And yet, absent other options, he cannot dismiss the option out of hand...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_HANNISHROYALGUARD_0: Greetings, honored Scions of the Seventh Dawn. I have a message from His Excellency the satrap.
“Brave Scions. You have my gratitude for aiding my people in this most trying of times.
“Alas, matters here at Meghaduta prevent me from meeting you all in person.
“As a token of mine appreciation, I have arranged for a feast to be held in your honor. May it nourish you in preparation for the trials ahead.”
...Such are the words of Master Vrtra. The feast he speaks of awaits you at Mehryde's Meyhane. Pray make your way there whenever your business here is done.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ALPHINAUD_000_035: We thank you for your kindness. Indeed, I was hoping we might find a place to discuss our next course of action, and that seems an ideal venue.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_HANNISHROYALGUARD_0: Ah, and to you, . There is someone we had hoped to introduce to you in particular.
While I am loath to detain you further, might you spare a moment of your time?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ALISAIE_000_038: A personal invitation, knowing full well your services are in the highest demand right now? This must be important. Worry not─we'll save some food for you, so take all the time you need.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_HANNISHROYALGUARD_0: Thank you, friend. Whenever you are ready, please join me in the aetheryte plaza. I shall go on ahead.
Access to the aetheryte you see there has been restricted to a select few ever since the tower first appeared.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but it was deemed too dangerous to permit the free movement of visitors at a time of emergency─a risk we could not take.
In light of recent developments, however, the satrap has decided that such restrictions would only hinder our efforts to combat the Final Days.
As such, I would encourage you to attune with the aetheryte before proceeding along the corridor.
Ah, you must be wondering what this place is.
You stand in the Hall of the Radiant Host, from where our leadership oversees all of Radz-at-Han's military operations.
Sundrop, our destination, lies just ahead.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_070: Ah, so you're the one I've heard so much about?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_RESIDENTOFFICER_000: Wait, I know you! Ah, but forgive me. Idle chatter can wait.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ULDAHMILITARYATTACH: Well, look who we have here! Word of your deeds in Radz-at-Han has reached the sultanate, so you know.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ALAMHIGOMILITARYATT: The liberator of Ala Mhigo is always a welcome sight. If I can be of service in any way, just ask.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ISHGARDRESIDENTOFFI: ...Hm? Ah, sorry...I was─ Oh, ! Ishgard remembers, let there be no doubt. The Fury favors us this day, that we may stand in the presence of a true hero.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_DOMANRESIDENTOFFICE: To think I would meet Doma's savior here, in this distant land...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_HANNISHROYALGUARD_0: Welcome to Sundrop. Without further ado, allow me to introduce you to─
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_111: Oho! So you're the famous , eh? I knew it the moment you stepped through the door! You've the look of one who's walked through hell!
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_HANNISHROYALGUARD_0: Shirabaht, please! You are speaking to the satrap's honored guest and a savior of our people. Can you not show a modicum of respect?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_113: What disrespect is there in paying a fellow warrior a compliment? We're all friends here, or will be soon enough.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_114: More formally, then, for the benefit of my countryman. It is a pleasure to have you with us, O great champion of Eorzea, Scion of the Seventh Dawn, Warrior of Light, and all-round good egg, I'm sure.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_A1_000_118: This talk of eggs reminds me I'm late for dinner...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_119: I hear you've been to Kugane, where you'll have seen all sorts of foreign embassies and whatnot.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_120: Well, we've got them here in Radz-at-Han, too. Other lands send delegates to oversee trade and diplomatic dealings. Then there are military matters to discuss, which is why all these officers are stationed here in Sundrop.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_121: A fool with too many scars and knees that ache in the winter! The name's Shirabaht, and I attend to business here. As for what sort of business, how can I put it...?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_122: Radz-at-Han welcomes delegates from other lands to oversee trade and diplomatic dealings. Then there are military matters to discuss, which is why all these officers are stationed here in Sundrop.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_123: Bahahaha! A  after my own heart! I like that!
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_124: Don't you worry─I'll keep it short. There's just a thing or two we'd like you to remember. First of all, about the room you're standing in now...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_125: Radz-at-Han welcomes delegates from other lands to oversee trade and diplomatic dealings. Then there are military matters to discuss, which is why all these officers are stationed here in Sundrop.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_126: I imagine you're more than familiar with each of the nations they represent, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_131: And last─but never let it be said least─Ishgard. They're the eyes, ears, and mouths that bridge the distance between Radz-at-Han and their respective homelands.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_132: We've used this brief respite to share the details of our plight with our overseas counterparts.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_133: And wouldn't you know it, all of their leaders requested a few words from you specifically. You're a  in high demand, eh?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_134: And so, would you mind regaling us with your own account? Indulge us before you indulge yourself.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_LIMSARESIDENTOFFICI: I thank you for the report. The conditions under which men are turned to beasts, the aetheric anomalies you have observed...you have given us much to consider.
It is concerning that the first transformation apparently occurred before the skies turned red. 'Tis contrary to what one would expect...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ISHGARDRESIDENTOFFI: Thankfully, the information you conveyed to Lucia upon your return from the moon has already proved invaluable.

As soon as reports of the calamity here in Thavnair reached the Grand Company of Eorzea and our Far Eastern allies, our leaders knew at once that the Final Days were indeed upon us. They began taking steps to assess the extent of the phenomenon's spread.
Our agents were able to confirm that, for the time being, the skies burn only over the Bounty, including this island and Corvos.
Alas, that is of little comfort...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_RESIDENTOFFICER_000: Aye. All throughout allied lands, there have been reports of people transforming into hideous beasts.
From what little we have learned, these incidents are similar in nature to that involving the merchant Khalzahl.
As was the case here, the victims underwent the change prior to the heavens being set ablaze.

And so, while the burning skies have yet to manifest beyond the Bounty, the transformations do not appear to be subject to any similar restriction. If anyone anywhere overcome by despair can turn, then nowhere is safe!
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_145: That's about the size of it. Speaking of which, we ought to give these creatures a name, don't you think?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_146: Here in Radz-at-Han, we've taken to calling the first to change─which tend to be the biggest─“blasphemies.”
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_RESIDENTOFFICER_000: As fitting a name as any. To ensure clarity in future communications, we shall urge our comrades to adopt this terminology.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ULDAHMILITARYATTACH: Our leaders have taken measures to deal with the threat, to the best of our abilities.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ALAMHIGOMILITARYATT: Aye. Each nation has assembled their own groups of elite soldiers to put down these so-called blasphemies and their spawn as and when they appear.
At the same time, they are doing all in their power to put the people's minds at ease, and prevent panic and fear from spreading.
That said...brave souls with the strength and fortitude to fell these terrible fiends are not easily found.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_DOMANRESIDENTOFFICE: Just so. And it is for that very reason that we turn to you.
Pray lend us your strength, and help us to slay the blasphemies that plague our homelands!
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_154: Now, now...you don't have to give your reply before dinner. I should also mention that each blasphemy seems to possess wildly different characteristics. What works well against one may serve you poorly against another.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_155: So before you go rushing off to save everyone's day, have a word with the delegates. They'll tell you what to expect.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_156: ...And with that, I do believe our friend here has a feast to attend. Spare a thought for us while you're tucking into all that fine cuisine, eh?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SYSTEM_000_157: You have gained access to the role quests for Endwalker! A separate quest line and story is now available for tank, melee DPS, physical ranged DPS, magical ranged DPS, and healer roles.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SYSTEM_000_158: To undertake these quests, speak with any of the delegates in Sundrop, and agree to help defeat the blasphemies that plague their respective homelands.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_160: Thanks for taking the time to stop by. You're free to talk with our delegates more if the mood strikes you, or head off to your banquet if you've had your fill of words for the day.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_SHIRABAHT_000_161: Ridding the lands of blasphemies is an important task, to be sure, but one that's best done on a full belly and a good night's rest, if you ask me. Do take care of yourself, you hear?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_HANNISHROYALGUARD_0: Pray forgive Shirabaht her rudeness. She can be a bit...boisterous at times, but it is simply her nature.
Anyway, my apologies for keeping you from your hard-earned rest. You will be rejoining your companions, yes? Do you know the way to the meyhane?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_A2_000_173: I know Radz-at-Han like the back of my hand!
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_A2_000_174: I have a terrible sense of direction.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_HANNISHROYALGUARD_0: Glad to hear you're becoming familiar with our fair city. You'll be pleased to hear that all drinks are on the house, so order whatever suits your fancy.
Truly? A remarkable weakness for such a well-traveled adventurer. Anyway, you can either use the Aethernet, or go by foot via the aetheryte plaza.
From there, cross through Balshahn Bazaar and continue down the passage. You'll find yourself right in front of the meyhane.
When you arrive, pray request the drink of your choice. Mehryde says that, tonight, it's on the house.
And with that, I must return to my post. On behalf of all the Radiant Host, I thank you and your friends once more for lending your strength and courage to Radz-at-Han in our time of need.
We shall endeavor to fight the good fight to the end, that we might honor Ahewann's legacy and serve Master Vrtra well. You have my word that your efforts will not be in vain.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ALPHINAUD_000_190: Forgive me for not waiting to make a toast. My throat was utterly parched...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ALISAIE_000_195: I know I must eat to regain my strength, but between you and me, I don't have much of an appetite.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_THANCRED_000_200: The threat here has been quelled, but our job's only just begun...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_YSHTOLA_000_205: Good you could join us. Mihleel over there will be happy to take your order.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_GRAHATIA_000_210: How was your meeting with the Radiant? I would love to hear more...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ESTINIEN_000_215: I'm overdue for a good meal.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_MIHLEEL_000_220: Welcome! When the satrap asked us to entertain a party of honored guests, I was wondering who it might be... This is a lovely surprise, to say the least.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_MIHLEEL_000_221: By the way, I heard all about Khalzahl from your friend G'raha Tia. I understand there was nothing that could be done, but...I was heartened to hear he meant us no harm.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_MIHLEEL_000_222: I cannot thank you enough for dispatching the beasts. As the smallest token of our thanks, your food and drink tonight are Mehryde's treat. Speaking of which, what shall I start you off with?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_A3_000_224: A piping hot mug of chai, please.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_A3_000_225: A glass of your finest local spirits!
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_MIHLEEL_000_227: As you wish. Pray join your friends, and I will bring you your drink.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_MIHLEEL_000_230: Your drink is on its way. Please, have a seat.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_YSHTOLA_000_240: Welcome back. Whatever did the Radiant want with you, pray tell?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_YSHTOLA_000_241: Our allies have sent military delegates? That's news to me. Mind sharing the details?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ALPHINAUD_000_250: The Final Days─how far has the phenomenon spread, and how does it manifest itself in each land? I must reach out to my friends in each nation and find out all I can.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ALISAIE_000_256: Well, I suppose I do feel better on a full stomach, after all. Burning skies? Blasphemies? Not if I've got anything to say about it!
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_YSHTOLA_000_260: If the Forum truly has been spurred to action by Hydaelyn's prophecy, then is it not odd that the Antitower was entrusted to Master Matoya, who bears them no love?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_YSHTOLA_000_261: No doubt She has a reason for this, and I would know what it is...
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_GRAHATIA_000_265: Nothing like a feast to lift the spirits. I trust you enjoyed yourself as well?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_ESTINIEN_000_270: Beasts and blasphemies may be running amok in nearby lands outside the influence of Radz-at-Han and the alliance. If so, I may need to go hunting.
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_THANCRED_000_280: Now, then...is there anything we've forgotten to mention? Are your arms and armor in good order?
TEXT_AKTKMD110_04418_THANCRED_000_281: In that case, it's time we each attended to our tasks. And when you arrive on the First, give my regards to Ryne. Tell her I miss her.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_ALPHINAUD_000_000: The Final Days─how far has the phenomenon spread, and how does it manifest itself in each land? I must reach out to my friends in each nation and find out all I can.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_ALISAIE_000_006: Well, I suppose I do feel better on a full stomach, after all. Burning skies? Blasphemies? Not if I've got anything to say about it!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_THANCRED_000_010: Should Ryne ask questions, don't hide the truth from her. If anything, see if she has any insights to offer.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_THANCRED_000_011: She's not a child in need of protection, but a comrade we should be willing to rely upon. Even if a part of me may always beg to differ.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_YSHTOLA_000_015: If the Forum truly has been spurred to action by Hydaelyn's prophecy, then is it not odd that the Antitower was entrusted to Master Matoya, who bears them no love?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_YSHTOLA_000_016: No doubt She has a reason for this, and I would know what it is...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_ESTINIEN_000_020: Beasts and blasphemies may be running amok in nearby lands outside the influence of Radz-at-Han and the alliance. If so, I may need to go hunting.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_GRAHATIA_000_031: Empty now, of course, but it should allow you to operate the tower's systems in the Umbilicus.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_GRAHATIA_000_032: If even the smallest fragment of Elidibus's essence remains, it should be possible to locate it.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_GRAHATIA_000_033: As for access to the Umbilicus, pray seek out Lyna for assistance. Chances are she still stands watch at the Accensor Gate.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_GRAHATIA_000_034: Should she or anyone else ask after me, tell them...I am living my life to the fullest. That I am happy, hardships and all.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_GRAHATIA_000_035: ...Well, we had best be on our respective ways. Gods willing, we will see each other again ere long.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_041: Have you been well? You and the others...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_A1_000_044: We've no shortage of troubles, but we're well enough.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_045: Full glad am I to hear that. I trust my lord is enjoying himself.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_046: Then things are much the same for you as they were here. My lord is doubtless enjoying himself.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_047: He...he said this to you? These exact words?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_048: Oh, to know that he is happy... It fills my heart with joy.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_049: Thank you, . For taking care of him.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_050: When next you see him, please tell him not to overexert himself. Futile a request though it is.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_051: And tell him that all is well here.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_052: The peace you gifted us continues, and we work hard to build new lives for ourselves.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_053: In the course of this we occasionally bicker, but we've never been more optimistic for the morrow.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_054: If I had to mention one dilemma, it would be the question of our governance. Even as we speak, debate rages on over how we should run the city in the Exarch's absence.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_055: Most are of a mind that the Settlement council should continue to oversee the general running of the Crystarium, while representatives are elected to determine policy and handle diplomacy.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_056: Thus far nothing is set in stone, but however we choose to proceed, we will not replace our lord. No one could.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_057: ...Have we recently observed any unusual phenomena?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_058: No, I cannot say there have been. Curious that you should ask me this question, though...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_059: Some days ago, Ryne came and asked the very same. She was rather unsettled─in stark contrast to how cheerful she has been of late.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_060: She and other Crystarium youths just hosted a festival, you see.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_061: It proved so popular that there are already plans for another celebration─one much bigger than the first.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_062: Between her preparations for the festival and the restoration of the Empty, she struck me as happy and full of life.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_063: Ryne has been dedicating herself to the restoration of the Empty, you see.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_064: Though it will take many long years, the goal seems to have given her a newfound sense of purpose and fulfillment.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_065: So when I saw her in a state of such worry, I couldn't help but feel worried in turn. Especially since she wouldn't tell me what troubled her.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_066: I daresay she would be more willing to confide in you. May I ask you to broach the subject with her?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_067: You wish to enter the Umbilicus? Very well. I shall fetch the key at once─and take the opportunity to find Ryne.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_068: Please wait for me in the city, in front of the Cabinet of Curiosity, shall we say. I will be along as soon as I can.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_SYSTEM_000_070: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_BEQLUGG_000_072: (-???-)...Do my old eyes deceive? Is that truly ?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_BEQLUGG_000_073: Hah, it is! Full glad am I to see you hale and whole, my friend!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_074: What a wonderful surprise it is to have you back with us─and at this most opportune time!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_075: In case you haven't heard, we are planning to produce a tome chronicling events from the Flood to the night's return.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_076: For this project, we intend to draw upon records kept by the world's peoples.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_077: Historical and contemporary firsthand accounts will be the centerpiece of the tome, but yours would be the one to crown them all!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_BEQLUGG_000_078: I've been asked to contribute a chapter on the soul─a subject that is key to understanding much of your endeavors.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_BEQLUGG_000_079: In the course of developing the spirit vessel, I gained valuable insights into travel beyond the rift. Knowledge that will allow me to attest to your existence and deeds!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_080: There is no end to the questions I would ask you, but if you could indulge me just one for now...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_081: In your quest to restore the night, you faced many a formidable foe.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_082: Among them, who offered you the greatest struggle?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_A3_000_084: Titania, driven mad by Light and loneliness.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_A3_000_086: Hades, who bore the burden of his people.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_A3_000_087: This may come as a surprise, but...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_088: Ah yes, Titania, the fallen faerie king. Against such a fiendishly playful opponent, I can well imagine that even the Warrior of Darkness must have struggled.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_089: But you succeeded in setting them free, and your victory proved a pivotal moment in your quest. We will see that it features prominently in the tome!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_090: Ah yes, Lord Vauthry, former leader of Eulmore and the final Lightwarden you cast down. Building his paradise on Mt. Gulg, he proclaimed his existence immaculate and took the name Innocence.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_091: Your reckoning with him was, without a doubt, a defining moment in history, and we will see that it features prominently in the tome!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_092: Ah yes, Hades, he who sought to resurrect his ancient brethren. He was the final obstacle in your quest to restore the night; your battle in the depths of the Tempest the stuff of epics.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_093: Yet compelling as it is, I worry that mere words wouldn't do justice to that fateful confrontation...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_094: Not that we would think to omit it entirely, of course. No, at the very least, we will impress upon readers that it was the climax of your hero's journey.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_095: T-Truly? I never would have guessed... But then if I could, I suppose I wouldn't have had to ask.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_096: 'Tis a tremendously eye-opening answer, and we will see that your account of this battle features prominently in the tome!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_BEQLUGG_000_097: I know you'd love to talk  ear off, Moren, but we really should be on our way. Those documents from Eulmore won't collect themselves.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_MOREN_000_098: Of course, of course. And afterwards, would you care to join me for tea? I was hoping you might clarify a few points in your treatise...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_BEQLUGG_000_099: Till next time, then. Do tell the others to look after themselves.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_BEQLUGG_000_100: Our overzealous friend, in particular─remind him not to overexert himself. Again and again till his ears fall off, if that's what it takes for him to take it to heart.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_ARKIL_000_101: (-???-)<gasp> Is that the Warrior of Darkness!?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RIQITIO_000_102: It's ! It's really ! What are you doing here?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RIQITIO_000_103: If you're going to battle, I can give you some medicine! I made it myself!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_EIRWEL_000_104: Best not, Riqi. You'd only give  a stomachache.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_EIRWEL_000_105: We've come to see Moren. To get his advice.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_EIRWEL_000_106: One of the guard finally agreed to teach us how to fight. But first, we need to choose a fighting style.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_EIRWEL_000_107: While I know that I want to be a mage, Arkil isn't sure.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_ARKIL_000_108: Magic isn't really my thing. So I was thinking of taking up the axe. Or the sword. Or maybe the bow!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_ARKIL_000_109: They all seem all right, but it's hard to decide, so I thought I'd ask Moren. He knows about lots of things.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RIQITIO_000_111: Ooh, ooh! Why don't you have the Warrior of Darkness choose for you?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RIQITIO_000_112: What do you think suits Arkil best? Axe, sword, or bow?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_A4_000_114: For smiting your opponent, the axe.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_A4_000_115: For protecting your friends, the sword.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_A4_000_116: For fighting and hunting both, the bow.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RIQITIO_000_117: The axe... If you took up the axe, you could be just like...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RIQITIO_000_119: The sword... If you took up the sword, you could be just like...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RIQITIO_000_121: The bow... If you took up the bow, you could be just like...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RIQITIO_000_123: I love that tale! Let's borrow the book today!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_EIRWEL_000_124: It's really popular, though. I hope it's still there...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_ARKIL_000_125: Thanks for helping me decide, Warrior of Darkness! I'll start with that style, and maybe try something else later on.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_ARKIL_000_126: And when I get really strong, I hope to have a bout with you!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_127: (-???-)Hmph... Such fun 's been having basking in the adoration of musty old bookworms and wide-eyed younglings, but does  spare a thought for me? Of course not!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_128: (-???-)I waited and waited and waited, but  won't so much as acknowledge the presence of  beautiful branch even though they're right here! Such a heartless thing our sapling is! Cold and cruel and heartless!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_A5_000_131: O faithful Feo Ul, loveliest of branches! How I have missed you!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_A5_000_132: Don't you have more important things to do, Your Majesty?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_133: Why do you say it like a question!? Where's the love, the respect─the awe!?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_134: ...But disappointed as I am, I'll overlook it this once. I know you have a lot on your mind right now.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_135: If you truly missed me, you should have cried for me at the top of your lungs the instant you arrived!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_136: To make up for it, you will call with twice the passion next time. Though for there to be a next time, you've some few struggles to overcome.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_137: I've no end of important tasks to attend to, but unlike some, I know what my priorities should be! And since when did my sapling become a twisted old tree that says such unkind things!?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_138: ...But disappointed as I am, I'll overlook it this once. I know you have a lot on your mind right now.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_139: So, my adorable sapling. The world is on the verge of destruction, is it?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_140: Hehe, how do I know this? Joined as we are, spying on you is as simple as sliding down the back of a rainbow.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_141: Would that I could aid you in your quest...but the fate of we fae folk is bound to that of the star. Whither it goes, so too do we follow. Such is our way.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_142: The most I could do for you is spare you the pain, by gifting you the sweetest of eternal dreams...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_143: But if escape's not to your liking, then you must struggle with your fellow mortals.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_FEOUL_000_144: Ah, but here are the ones you were waiting for. I wonder, what manner of conclusion awaits at tale's end...?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_146: ! It's so wonderful to see you again!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_LYNA_000_147: You doubtless have much catching up to do, so I shall leave you to it. I've taken the liberty of unlocking the Umbilicus, and you may enter at your leisure.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_150: I'm relieved to hear that everyone is well.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_151: I've had this feeling, like a pit in my stomach, and I was afraid that something might have happened...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_152: Maybe I'm overthinking things, but...it's just that...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_153: I'm the Oracle of Light, but I've never spoken with Hydaelyn. Never once heard Her call.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_154: Even so, I've always had this feeling deep inside me. A connection to something immense.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_155: These past few days, though, that connection has...wavered. As if that immense something was distant, then close, then distant again...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_156: And then, the other night, I was jolted awake by the feeling it had been completely severed.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_157: Wanting some fresh air, I went to open the window...and to my horror, the sky was ablaze. Like during the starshower...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_158: But then I blinked, and everything was normal. The next day, no one said a thing. No one else had seen what I had seen.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_159: As far as I could tell, nothing was out of the ordinary. I began to wonder if it was a figment of a half-remembered dream...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_160: ...? What are you not telling me?
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_161: I have to know─please! It doesn't matter how terrible it is!
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_162: It wasn't my imagination, then. The doom we witnessed in Amaurot has come again...
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_164: Like I told you before, all is well here in the First.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_165: So don't worry about us. Please. Look only to the threat before you.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_166: We're fine right now, and even if we weren't, we've learned how to survive.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_167: Should the Final Days reach us here as well, you may be assured we won't go quietly.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_168: No, we'll hold on until you can find a way to save all our worlds.
TEXT_AKTKME101_04419_RYNE_000_169: So long as you continue your fight, so too will we, united in purpose beneath a blazing sky.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_RYNE_000_000: You're headed to the Umbilicus to consult with Elidibus, right?
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_RYNE_000_001: I'll do some consulting of my own and speak with Lyna. Decide how we might best prepare for the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_RYNE_000_002: So it's farewell for now, but we'll see each other again. I'm certain of it.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_RYNE_000_010: We lived through the Flood and the tyranny of the Lightwardens. We're survivors. Do what you need to do, and know that we will too.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_CRYSTALGATEKEEPER_0: The captain has told me all. Give the word, and I will show you to the Ocular.
Still have unfinished business in the Ocular? If so, let me know.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_040: The man stands dutifully by the aetheryte-like device. A guide for this facility, in all likelihood.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_041: You attempt to get the man's attention, but if he sees or hears you, he gives absolutely no indication.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_042: As Elidibus warned, it appears your form is intangible...
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_050: The remarkably large man wears a black robe and a half mask─much like the phantoms you encountered in Mare Lamentorum and the recreated Amaurot...
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_051: It would seem you have made it to your destination.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_052: You gesticulate wildly and shout all manner of greetings and obscenities, but the man does not so much as glance in your general direction...
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_PROPYLAIONUSER04420: This is the right place, yes? Propylaion?
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_061: Judging by the woman's words, this facility is called “Propylaion.”
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_062: You attempt to gently prod the woman to attract her attention, but feel nothing─and it seems neither does she.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_PROPYLAIONUSER04420: Very well, let's wait a while.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_070: The device is reminiscent of an aetheryte. Perhaps it is possible to attune with it...
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_071: Despite attempting to channel and focus your energies, you fail to attune with the device. You can only assume it operates differently.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_SYSTEM_000_080: You suspect this door leads outside. But how to open it...?
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_EMETSELCH_000_090: In case you didn't know, it's rude to stare. Stop.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_Q3_000_095: Continue with the main scenario quest?
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_HYTHLODAEUS_000_100: This is hardly my first time here, but the scenery never fails to take my breath away. Why, it feels as if you could reach out and touch the heavens!
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_HYTHLODAEUS_000_101: Now then, to begin our guided tour... Perhaps you already know these things, but for the sake of thoroughness, I shall start with the basics.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_HYTHLODAEUS_000_102: Using concepts to give shape to aether, creation magicks allow us to bring forth anything we desire, be it inanimate objects or living beings.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_HYTHLODAEUS_000_103: Anyone may conceive of concepts, but they must all undergo evaluation at the Bureau of the Architect.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_HYTHLODAEUS_000_104: As part of that process, living beings and certain arcane entities may be sent here to Elpis for in-depth observation and study.
TEXT_AKTKME102_04420_HYTHLODAEUS_000_105: Heh heh, a fascinating facility, isn't it? I daresay you will enjoy touring it with us.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_EMETSELCH_000_000: In case you didn't know, it's rude to stare. Stop.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_010: Now then, our friend Hermes. Aside from overseeing the facility, he also conducts his own research.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_011: Chances are he will be at the main observation hub, so let us seek him out there first.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_012: Attired as you are, however, you stand out a little too much. Our dear Emet-Selch wishes to keep a low profile for his errand, so...
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_013: Do you know how to make a robe? The basic concept will do.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_EMETSELCH_000_015: No. Your whim, your responsibility. You're getting not another thimble of aether out of me.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_016: <sigh> The way he scrimps sometimes, you'd think he wasn't a nigh-bottomless font of magic...
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_017: Very well, I shall make the robe, but perhaps you can assist. Come, let us search for the requisite material.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_EMETSELCH_000_020: No means no. Just be grateful I'm even willing to wait.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_031: An aetheric rope. I want you to use it to capture, shall we say, two petaloudai.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_032: There are three species here, I believe. Any two different kinds should serve.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_033: Now, I should mention that the strength of the rope is tied─no pun intended─to the strength of its user.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_034: As your aether is still thin compared to ours, you'll need to weaken the petaloudai first. Good luck!
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_040: Remember, it's a pair of petaloudai we require. Any two different kinds should serve.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_050: You've caught the petaloudai? Come, come, let us see.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_051: Yes, these fine fellows will do nicely. And now for a spot of reversion...
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_053: It's nothing fancy, but then we're trying not to stand out. Try it on for size.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_A1_000_055: You turn living beings into clothing? Just like that?
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_A1_000_056: Won't someone be angry with us for using those creatures?
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_057: Well, not just like that. You need to revert them to their constituent aether first.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_058: Lest you wonder why I asked for two species, it is due to the difference in their aetheric balance. Blending them allows us to produce garb with superior aetheric stability.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_059: Oh, it's fine, there's no one around to tell us off. And besides, we can always make more petaloudai. They need only a tiny amount of aether.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_060: It may take some effort to get the form and composition right, but anyone familiar with the concept should be able to manage.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_EMETSELCH_000_061: Well and good to disguise and educate it, but it won't fool anyone who can see worth a damn.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_062: Fair point, but at the very least it should spare you unwanted attention from casual observers.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_063: Emet-Selch speaks true. Even dressed like us, your unusual nature will be plain to those who think to look.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_064: Should someone question your presence, don't make up excuses, much less try to explain what you actually are. No, best to simply say that you're a familiar.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_066: Ah, of course─Azem's. If you say you belong to , people will give you the benefit of the doubt for any and all outlandish behavior.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_068: For lack of  presence, absolutely. Were  here, 'd have been the first to propose the idea─and you know it.
TEXT_AKTKME103_04421_HYTHLODAEUS_000_069: With that, your story is settled. Let us continue with our errand!
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_000: As dubious as it is, passing you off as Azem's familiar is probably the best approach. Should  take offense that others so readily believe  recklessness is to blame,  is welcome to mend  ways.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_001: ...Pass as a child in your original size? I think not. Augmented or no, your aether is still far too thin to be considered normal.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_010: If you are ready, let us continue along the path to Anagnorisis.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_011: The place serves as an observation hub and residence both.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_012: Someone there should be able to point us in the direction of Hermes.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_020: I was wondering what she was examining, but it seems to be the bush itself...
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_025: Let's see if this observer knows Hermes's whereabouts.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_031: We wish to speak with Chief Hermes. Do you know where we might find him?
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: Well, now... By your mask, I assume you are one of the Fourteen. I wasn't aware there was to be a visitation...
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_033: Between you and us, it's something of a surprise. Your discretion in the matter would be appreciated.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: I see, I see. My lips are sealed!
The chief should be out conducting observations as usual. His focus of late has been aquatic creatures, so I expect you will find him at one of the pools here.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_036: The pools, you say? Many thanks, and apologies for disrupting your work.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_037: I say, Hythlodaeus... While I've never met Hermes, you know him well, do you not?
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_038: That being the case, couldn't you simply find him by his aether?
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_040: As you know, Emet-Selch and I can discern the color of souls.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_041: By the same token, we can also see aether quite keenly, and from great distances.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_042: With this skill, I could readily locate Hermes, but I felt that it would be a waste of an opportunity.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_043: We're here to perform an assessment, after all. By searching the ordinary way, we stand to gain insight into Elpis and the man in charge of it.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_044: This is as much for your own enjoyment, like as not. But point taken.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_045: If you're going to accompany us, make yourself useful and help us look for Hermes.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_046: According to his profile, he has short, dark hair.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_047: So you know, it's because we're in Elpis that we don't have our cowls up. A special exemption due to the need to be aware of dangerous creatures.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_048: Elsewhere, we do not exhibit our individuality. It's unseemly. This is all common sense, but I would not assume you possess any.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_049: Heh heh! It's a rare treat indeed to be able to search for someone by their appearance, and I thank you for humoring me.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: Still looking for the chief? He should be out observing somewhere, likely at one of the pools.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_METEION_000_065: Heh heh! They have such funny faces!
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_070: The tenet of the Words of Mitron is to create aquatic life both unique and beneficial. Aquatic.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_EMETSELCH_000_071: What would possess them to put this creature in the sky? And is it even aquatic to begin with...?
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_075: The ambystoma was submitted to the bureau not long ago, and I'm pleased to see it has found its way here.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HYTHLODAEUS_000_076: We'll make sure these little ones don't wander off like their adventurous fellow. Go on and lend Hermes a hand.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_SYSTEM_000_090: It seems Hermes and Meteion have found their quarry, a creature known in this age as an ambystoma.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_SYSTEM_000_091: Yet though it has been safely extricated from the tree, Hermes appears to have found himself in quite the predicament...
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_METEION_000_092: The ambystoma. Hermes saw it high up the tree.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_METEION_000_093: He climbed up to get it. But it jumped on him, and he slipped...
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_A1_000_096: Everything is under control, I trust?
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_097: (-Hermes-)<grunt> No, no, I'm fine, if a little embarrassed...
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_098: (-Hermes-)<grunt> Yes, rest assured this is nothing new to me. I've ended up in far more compromising positions in the course of my work.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_099: (-Hermes-)Now, for your own safety, please stand back...
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_102: Quite all right, yes... My apologies for making you worry, Meteion.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_104: , you are called? An intriguing name, somehow reminiscent of a new creation...
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_105: Thank you for coming after me.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_106: As for you, little one, you must be more careful.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_107: You may be able to fly, but it doesn't mean you cannot fall and hurt yourself.
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_109: Oh no, I had forgotten all about its fellows!
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_110: Truly? What a relief... I must thank Emet-Selch and Hythlodaeus when I return to them. But first, with the distractions out of the way...
TEXT_AKTKME104_04422_HERMES_000_111: As chief overseer of Elpis, permit me to welcome you to our facility. I hope you will enjoy your time here.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EMETSELCH_000_000: The tenet of the Words of Mitron is to create aquatic life both unique and beneficial. Aquatic.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EMETSELCH_000_001: What would possess them to put this creature in the sky? And is it even aquatic to begin with...?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HYTHLODAEUS_000_005: The ambystoma was submitted to the bureau not long ago, and I'm pleased to see it has found its way here.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HYTHLODAEUS_000_006: We'll make sure these little ones don't wander off like their adventurous fellow. Go on and lend Hermes a hand.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_010: I'm glad they're safe! Hermes and the ambystoma!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_SYSTEM_000_015: The ambystoma stares at you unflinchingly, as if regarding something novel.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_SYSTEM_000_016: Regarding it in turn, you notice that it appears to be floating, if ever so slightly.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_020: Well, we mustn't keep the others waiting. Let us return to Anagnorisis.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EMETSELCH_000_030: No more errant creations to distract us from matters of actual import, I trust.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HYTHLODAEUS_000_035: 'Twas blissfully uneventful in your absence. The little ones were on their best behavior.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_040: Some creations stay outside. Others stay at Ktisis. Like the ambystomas!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_SYSTEM_000_045: Perhaps it's only your imagination, but something in the creature's demeanor bespeaks proud defiance for having gone on an adventure.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_050: My apologies for the trouble. Owing to your kind assistance, all the ambystomas are safe and well.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_051: I will presently send them back to their space, if you would go on ahead to the main building.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_052: Upon entering, you will see a table and chairs─a meeting area. We may speak there.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EMETSELCH_000_053: Very well. Take care not to let the creatures slip away again.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_060: Will you be attending as well? If so, you should join the others at the building.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HYTHLODAEUS_000_065: While Emet-Selch has been accommodating thus far, he is the one who has business with Hermes. If you wish to attend, you will have to ask his permission.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EMETSELCH_000_070: Most would jump at the chance to serve in the Convocation. And yet...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HYTHLODAEUS_000_075: Don't mind us, my friend. Please tend to Meteion.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_080: Forgive me. I will make it up to you, I promise.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_090: I'm sorry, ... I didn't want─ Didn't mean─ <sigh>
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_091: ...A walk. Perhaps we can go for a walk?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_100: Hermes gets sad. When he thinks about death.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_101: When others are sad, I'm sad too. That's how I am. How he made me.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_102: But don't worry. I'm fine now.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_104: You want to learn about Elpis and Hermes? Ooh, ooh, teach you! I can teach you!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_105: We could take turns! I tell you something...then you tell me something!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_110: It will be! It will be!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_112: Awww... I won't be a bother. So please, . Please!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_113: Hehe, you won't regret it! I'll teach you lots and lots of things!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_114: Um, where to start... Ah, yes! Let's talk to Memnon. He should be near the aetheryte.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_115: I'm not good at explaining, but Memnon is. So I'll have him explain instead.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_SYSTEM_000_116: Meteion is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_SYSTEM_000_117: You can leave Meteion behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_SYSTEM_000_118: If you wish to have Meteion accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_130: Let's go and talk to Memnon. He should be near the aetheryte.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_Q3_000_135: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Meteion?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_136: Oh, are you busy? Then I'll wait at the building.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_140: Ah, you're back! Let's go, let's go!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_SYSTEM_000_145: Meteion has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_150: Ah, the aetheryte. Anyone can use it to teleport anywhere!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_151: Well, maybe not anywhere. Not to the ground or other isles.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_152: For that, you need teleporters. Oh, and permission!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_SYSTEM_000_161: You should have Meteion accompanying you before initiating conversation.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_MEMNON_000_166: Though you look like a person, ... I assume you are a familiar like Meteion. Is there something you need?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_167: This is . Could you teach  about Elpis?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_MEMNON_000_168: Ah, a newly arrived familiar, is ? Very well, I should be glad to introduce our fair facility to .
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_MEMNON_000_169: As you know, it is mankind's duty to make the star a better place. As part of this duty, we employ creation magicks to bring forth new life.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_MEMNON_000_170: However, we cannot simply release our works into the world, for it would lead to chaos.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_MEMNON_000_171: No, any and all life-forms must undergo extensive testing to determine their fitness to exist. Testing which is conducted here in Elpis.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_MEMNON_000_172: Every candidate is subjected to rigorous study, in which we identify their properties, surmise what habitats might be suitable, and speculate as to the effects they may have on the environment and other species.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_MEMNON_000_173: Should it be judged a beneficial addition to the star, it will be allowed to take its place in the world.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_MEMNON_000_174: The two of you, too, were created with the hope of making the star a better place. So heed your masters well and be good, do you hear?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_175: We will, Memnon, we will. Thanks for the lesson!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_176: You had a turn. Now I get a turn!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_A4_000_179: From a place far, far away.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_A4_000_180: From a place facing a great threat.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_182: Hmmm, then I probably don't know it. I don't know much about other places.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_183: Th-There's such a place? I had no idea...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_184: Crys...tarium? I've never heard of it.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_185: But this place is important to you. I can feel it.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_186: Oh, my power! I haven't told you about it.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_187: A creation. Let's find a creation. One not being watched. Then I'll explain my power!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_195: Let's find a creation. One not being watched. Then I'll explain my power!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_201: Oh no, we call them oreiai. If there's many. If it's just one, we say oreias!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_202: Though they're cute, they can be naughty.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_203: Sometimes, they run off with concept crystals. And Hermes has to run after them!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_MEMNON_000_210: The desire to learn is a good thing. I wish you well in your endeavors, my dear familiar.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_231: But...I don't remember seeing it before. Perhaps it's new?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_232: Anyway, I'll try reading its mind. That's my power!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_233: Hmmm... I can't read it. Or maybe...there's nothing to read?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_234: Wait... Please, wait... I'll try again. With you this time...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_236: This is my power. I can read the emotions of those around me, and project my emotions to others in return.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_237: I am not actually speaking to you in your mind. Rather, you are converting my emotions into words and intention─a process performed subconsciously by intelligent life-forms.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_238: This ability is vital to my mission, for it allows me to interact with intelligent beings even should they communicate via unknown languages or other nonverbal means.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_239: As a consequence, I am clumsy at speaking...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_240: Yet though I struggle to express myself in this fashion, Hermes wants me to speak as much as possible, for everyone has thoughts and feelings that they may wish to hide...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_241: I harbor an affection for you. One that is difficult to define.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_242: Aside from the fact that you share common traits with us, your thoughts are complex. Prismatic. They draw me in, and leave me wanting to know more.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_243: Out of respect for your privacy, I will refrain from using my power when speaking with you. Nevertheless, I want you to know that I wish to be your friend.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_245: Heh heh, good! Now it's my turn again! So...what are you good at?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_255: Ooh, fighting! That must mean you're strong!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_256: Hermes is strong too. But he doesn't like to fight. Even when creations fight him.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_260: Oh, not creating...but crafting? Putting things together with your hands...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_261: That sounds like fun! I can't use creation magicks. But maybe I can learn to craft!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_265: Ooh, gathering! I like gathering too!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_266: What do you gather? Where do you go? How do you get there? Do you fly too!?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_270: Playing? I'm still not sure what that means...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_271: Hermes says, “Let's play.” But then he goes for a walk. Or looks at creations. It's fun, but no different from work.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_272: Ooh, a secret! That's something you want to hide! Just leave it to me...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_273: There! I've blocked it out. I can't block everything─not strong feelings. But that wasn't too strong.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_274: I-I think we might be bothering it...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_275: Let's keep going. We'll go and see Euanthe next. She's usually in a small building. One on the west row.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_280: Let's go and see Euanthe. She's usually in a small building. One on the west row.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EUANTHE_000_300: Well now, I don't believe I've seen you before.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EUANTHE_000_305: Well, well, if it isn't Meteion. I see you've brought a friend today.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_306: Greetings, Euanthe! Um, an apple. Could you make me an apple?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_307: The kind Hermes likes. Covered in syrup. I want to share it with !
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EUANTHE_000_308: Oh, candied apple? Hermes is certainly partial to them, but you know you can't eat, Meteion. You weren't made to do so.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EUANTHE_000_310: It may seem that way, but it's due to your ability to share others' feelings. You've taken Hermes's likes for your own.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EUANTHE_000_311: In any case, I can't prepare an apple right now, but I'll bring one for Hermes soon. I promise.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_312: I'm sorry, ... I wanted to show you my favorite thing. Then I could ask about yours. But I failed...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_316: Ooh, that's what you like? Yes... Yes, I can feel it! Your joy and happiness!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_317: And it makes me happy too! Thanks for sharing it with me, !
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_318: Well, we've walked and talked a lot. Maybe Hermes has finished talking too. Shall we go and see?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_319: Well, we've walked and talked a lot. Maybe Hermes has finished talking too. Shall we go and see?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_330: I hope Hermes isn't sad anymore...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EUANTHE_000_340: Between you and me, Hermes's eating habits are atrocious. We may not be reliant upon food to the extent that our smaller creations are, but our diets eventually catch up with us.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EUANTHE_000_341: If we don't consume the requisite balance of nutrients, we grow weak and lethargic. Yet Hermes consumes candied apples as if they were a staple...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EMETSELCH_000_345: What, back already? Pity. A bit longer and we might have snuck away without you...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HYTHLODAEUS_000_350: Ah, excellent timing. 'Twas a refreshing constitutional, I hope?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_365: There you are. I can see the fresh air has done Meteion good.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_366: wanted to learn about you and Elpis. So I taught !
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_367: About this place. About my power. About your favorite food!
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_368: I'm not sure if that last one will be of any use...
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_369: But I do appreciate your keeping Meteion company. While you were away, I finished speaking with our guests.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EMETSELCH_000_370: Finished? Hardly. You requested time to consider the invitation, so we have no choice but to occupy ourselves with an inspection of your work.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_372: It has been decided that Emet-Selch and Hythlodaeus will accompany me as I tend to my duties.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_373: If you wish to learn more, perhaps you would like to come too?
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EMETSELCH_000_374: I'm compelled to remind you that  is in no way associated with the Convocation. We simply chanced to meet at Propylaion.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_EMETSELCH_000_375: There is no guarantee that the matters we discuss will remain private.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_HERMES_000_376: I do not mind. To see the joy  presence brings Meteion, I cannot imagine our mysterious friend harbors malicious intent.
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_377: is kind. Really, truly!  taught me as much as I taught !
TEXT_AKTKME105_04423_METEION_000_378: You're coming, of course? To watch Hermes? You're bound to learn lots and lots!
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_EMETSELCH_000_000: It is held that all civil organizations should conduct their affairs with total transparency, and the Convocation is no exception.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_EMETSELCH_000_001: But that doesn't mean we are obligated to show our work to unknown entities such as you. Consider yourself privileged─and behave accordingly.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HYTHLODAEUS_000_005: Though I see new creations on a daily basis, here they look at them with a different eye. It will be interesting to observe Hermes at work.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_METEION_000_010: This time we all get to go for a walk! Isn't it exciting?
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_020: If everyone is ready, there are a few creations I need to check on. First, we shall return to the spot where we found our wayward ambystoma.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_021: Have care when you step outside a hub, for there may be more unruly creatures about.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_EMETSELCH_000_030: All vim and vigor now. Hmph. When we were discussing his nomination, he was melancholy incarnate.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HYTHLODAEUS_000_035: Ah yes, the ianthine petalouda. One of the newest species of the ever-popular butterfly.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HYTHLODAEUS_000_036: ...Hm? You're still bothered about your robe? Don't be. The few specimens we repurposed won't be missed.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_METEION_000_040: So beautiful, petalouda! I hope they make it into the world!
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_050: This here is a new species of petalouda we recently set loose.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_051: It has been doing very well, managing to maintain a stable existence thus far. If it can see its observation period to the end without issue, we shall release it unto the world.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_052: Tell me─do you know the difference between living beings and arcane entities?
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_053: It is the presence of a soul. Yet the soul isn't something you can choose to have at will.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_054: No, it manifests only in those beings whose forms adhere to the laws of creation. That can endure on their own.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_055: Beings that do not fulfill this requirement, such as those spontaneously born of magic or natural phenomena, do not have souls.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_056: No matter how much it might resemble flora or fauna, if it lacks a soul, then it is considered an arcane entity.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_057: So you see, it is not for mankind to decide what is living. That domain lies beyond our manipulation, and it is hubris to assume otherwise.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_058: But come, let us head to the nearby beacon. I've received a report that arcane entities have gathered there.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_EMETSELCH_000_060: We're meant to be observing Hermes, but instead we're stuck with Meteion...
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_EMETSELCH_000_061: Well, I suppose she herself serves as proof of his prowess as a researcher and creator both.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HYTHLODAEUS_000_065: A fascinating creation─much like yourself, little one. Renowned as Hermes is for his flying life-forms, 'tis a rare privilege to be able to see one of his works in progress.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_METEION_000_070: Interesting! You're interesting too! Tell me, how did you find the ambystoma?
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_080: Ah, yes. Lightning pneuma, just as the report said.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_081: Although we call this structure a beacon due to its form, it's in fact a magical device. By manipulating the balance of elements, it keeps the isle airborne and maintains the climate thereupon.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_082: In the course of its operation, it often sees an internal shift towards a given element.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_083: Right now that element is lightning, which draws the pneuma here to replenish their aether.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_085: Would you care to assist me in her stead, and feed the pneuma?
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_086: By using this lightning converger, you can harness ambient lightning and focus it into a ball. A veritable feast for our dazzling friends.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_087: Go on, give it a try.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_090: Go on and use the lightning converger near the pneuma. It will harness ambient lightning and focus it into a ball. A veritable feast for our dazzling friends.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_101: See how they gather to feed. How they express themselves through their actions despite their lack of words.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_102: Speech is not the sole defining characteristic of a thinking, feeling creature. Nor is silence an indication that they do not possess these qualities.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_103: Be it a soulless arcane entity such as the pneuma, or an ephemeral life-form such as the petalouda, all seek to perpetuate their existence. To survive.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_107: A good question. I can answer it from a theoretical standpoint, but it ultimately falls to the Bureau of the Architect to pass judgment.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_108: Those with exceptional vision such as Hythlodaeus may be able to ascertain her true nature...
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_109: But to me, it doesn't matter. She is herself, and that is all I need to know.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_METEION_000_110: Oh... You've finished already? I-I'm sorry... I was in the way...
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_111: Not to worry, my dear. They missed nothing of note, and we still have plenty of work for them to observe.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HERMES_000_112: Next, we will head east to the Mourning Dew. I need to speak with some observers there.
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_EMETSELCH_000_120: ...Was there a guiding theme or any method to the madness that is this random assortment of features?
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_HYTHLODAEUS_000_125: Ah, this fellow has been the talk of the bureau! The combination of a carefree aspect and endless rows of fangs is strangely charming!
TEXT_AKTKME106_04424_METEION_000_130: It's adorable, but beware its sneeze! Hermes went flying once!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_000: Never before had I heard of dynamis or entelechies. I can only assume the Elpis flower was submitted to the bureau before I joined.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_METEION_000_005: Entelechy or no, we're friends! In thinness!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_010: All appears to be well. This shouldn't take long.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_020: Not that I or anyone else would be able to make use of it even if we knew...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_021: But it irks me to discover that there is an entirely different form of energy─and no one told me.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_022: That personal annoyance aside, Hermes's knowledge is undeniably impressive. Given that there are none among the Fourteen who specialize in the celestial, he would be a welcome addition.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_023: Assuming he can be persuaded to join, that is. I still can't understand his hesitation...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_A1_000_025: Why did you join the Convocation?
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_027: Oho, you wish to know why Emet-Selch was chosen for the Convocation? I should be glad to share the tale!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_030: Lest you've forgotten, we're to learn about Hermes. Not me. My misspent youth is not your concern.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_040: (I'll tell you the tale when we're away from sensitive ears.)
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_A2_000_047: I want to learn about the Convocation.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_049: Hmmm... If you would accompany us, I suppose you should at least know that much.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_050: The Convocation of Fourteen is a governing body that determines myriad policies. Our goal is to ensure that all is right in creation, that our star may know a brighter future.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_051: As the name suggests, the council is comprised of fourteen offices, each of which is held by an individual chosen for their surpassing abilities.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_052: Depending on the office, one is required to either be an authority in a certain field, or possess skills that would facilitate the performance of their stipulated duties.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_053: The former category includes Mitron, specialist in aquatic life; Loghrif, specialist in terrestrial life and husbandry...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_054: Halmarut, specialist in fungal and plant life; Emmerololth, specialist in medicine and healing...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_055: And Lahabrea, specialist in creation magicks, who has brought forth phantom beings of the highest complexity.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_056: As for the latter category, there is Altima, advocate of the arts; Igeyorhm, champion of enlightenment and rhetoric; Pashtarot, preserver of discipline and order...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_057: Emet-Selch, keeper of the aetherial realm─or “Underworld” in the vernacular; Fandaniel, pursuer of extant phenomena...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_058: And Azem, traveler of the world and counselor to the people.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_059: ...What? Should I be revealing such details to you? Don't be silly. Even children know this much, and you would do well to remember it all.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_060: Then why did you bother me!? <sigh> Honestly, I'm beginning to think you were created for the sole purpose of trying my patience...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_070: My apologies for the wait. I have inspected the ampelos to my satisfaction.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_071: All is well with the creature, and I daresay it won't be long ere it is released unto the world.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_072: Another creation, however, reportedly isn't faring so well─the charybdis.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_073: That is what we shall tend to next.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_074: If you would follow me, my friends, we shall return to the main isle and head north.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_080: A serpentine bird...or a winged snake?
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_085: There is a slight difference in aetheric balance between these charybdises.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_086: By this, it may be assumed that they aren't the original creations, but their offspring.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_METEION_000_090: Why is this one blue and shiny...?
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: Uwaaah! ...Oh, forgive me, I thought another member of the Convocation had come. This is turning out to be an eventful day...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_100: I understand there is a problem with one of the charybdis.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: As you know, the charybdis is based on a sea creature. Owing to adjustments to enhance its affinity to wind, it is capable of flight.
The specimens created from the concept could all fly without issue, but a problem arose in subsequent generations.
This third-generation creature was born with an aetheric balance leaning strongly towards water. Its aquatic origin reasserting itself, it would seem...
The result being its affinity to wind is diminished, and it cannot fly. No matter what we try, we can't get it to rise even the slightest bit.
For such change to manifest in so few generations... I fear they are too unstable. Flawed.
With your permission, I will revert the creatures, and recommend to the bureau that the concept be revised.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_108: ...With its aetheric balance leaning towards water, the charybdis would indeed struggle to manipulate wind.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_109: Yet it is too early to conclude that it cannot fly. Having failed at first, it may simply have developed a fear.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_110: I shall transform and fly with it, helping it to manipulate wind until it finds its wings.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: What!? Y-You needn't go to such lengths...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_112: You don't know? <sigh> But of course not...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_113: Transformation is an art in which one manipulates a vast quantity of aether to construct another body around oneself.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_114: In practice, this allows one to assume any conceivable form, and thereby transcend the limits of one's flesh.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_115: Yet convenient though it may be, transforming in the presence of others is considered vainglorious in the extreme. As uncouth and unseemly as running about robeless. Shameful.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_116: Am I to understand you make a habit of this?
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_117: N-Nothing of the sort. It's just that, when transformed, I can wield the wind and fly.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_118: It may seem excessive, but what is our shame next to the lives of these creatures?
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_119: They deserve a chance, and we owe it to them to do all in our power!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_122: Yes, I believe I have a solution. Emet-Selch─may I trouble you to move that charybdis away from its fellows? Somewhere out of sight.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_123: Meanwhile, I'd like the rest of you to help me prepare here.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_124: What mischief are you scheming now?
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_125: No mischief, I assure you. I would but spare you the need to report to your colleagues that Hermes committed an indiscretion.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_126: So have a little faith, and run along.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_130: Well? Are your preparations for the scheme that is clearly not a scheme complete?
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_135: Hythlodaeus is a man of ideas. I wonder what he has thought up this time...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_METEION_000_140: We must help the charybdis to fly. Or else they will all die!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: Such bother when we could simply begin anew... But I shall defer to the chief overseer.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_150: Emet-Selch is out of sight? Good. Let's speak of the plan.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_151: It's a stroke of genius, really: we have Emet-Selch train the charybdis!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_152: Aside from being able to fly untransformed, he can readily see aether currents.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_153: And with his adept spellcraft, he can also employ suitable wind magicks to guide the creature along.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_154: While he is indeed capable of all you described, it is not his duty. I am loath to trouble him with it.
