TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_155: Don't be! As I mentioned, it would also be for his own sake. With that settled, let's begin at once!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_156: ─I want you to go to Emet-Selch. Tell him that you have a favor to ask.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_157: He will be disinclined to cooperate at first, but you mustn't be discouraged. With our friend, the trick is to be unflaggingly persistent.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_158: Off you go, now, and good luck!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_SYSTEM_000_159: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the words “I have a favor to ask” to indicate to Emet-Selch that you have a request.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_170: The rest of us will be right behind you. We wouldn't think to miss the fun!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_175: With apologies to Emet-Selch, but this may be the best approach. Let us work together to win him over!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: M-Me...? Uh...perhaps it's best if I watched from afar...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_SAYTODO_000_190: I have a favor to ask
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_195: Well? Are your preparations for the scheme that is clearly not a scheme complete?
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_SYSTEM_000_196: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the words “I have a favor to ask” to indicate to Emet-Selch that you have a request.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_200: Oh no you don't! I'm not lifting a finger!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_201: Ugh. I don't know what Hythlodaeus is up to, and I will not be made to know. I refuse!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_SYSTEM_000_202: If Hythlodaeus is to be believed, relentless insistence may serve to wear down the ever-weary Emet-Selch...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_SYSTEM_000_203: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the words “Please, Emet-Selch” to plead with Emet-Selch.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_215: You may tell Hythlodaeus he can contrive another brilliant solution─one that doesn't involve me!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_SYSTEM_000_216: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the words “Please, Emet-Selch” to plead with Emet-Selch.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_220: If I didn't know better, I'd say Emet-Selch is enjoying himself. Not that he'd ever deign to admit it.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_225: It's flying... It's really flying, as if it were born to do so... Thank goodness...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_METEION_000_230: Look, ! Look how well the charybdis flies!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_SYSTEM_000_240: The charybdis appears to be the subject of Emet-Selch's undivided attention. You may need to wave rather forcefully in his general direction to remind him that you and the others exist.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_SYSTEM_000_245: Emerging from his reverie, Emet-Selch notices you, and begins to descend with the charybdis...
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_246: I have no words to express my gratitude. Thanks to you, the charybdis has learned to fly.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_247: And  and I could relax and have a pleasant chat.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_249: The creature needed some small assistance at first, but soon it was flying more or less on its own. I doubt you will need to repeat the lesson.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: I witnessed it all from afar─the charybdis flies!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_252: Indeed. With this, we've proven that even a creature with skewed aetheric balance is capable of flight.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_253: Though we helped it to achieve this, the charybdis is a herd animal. They may well aid their struggling kin in like fashion if and when the need arises.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_254: Keeping this in mind, I bid you continue observing them.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: If that is what you want...

But if I may say so, rather than hoping an idealistic possibility comes to pass, would it not be simpler to have the concept adjusted? That way, we could guarantee that anomalies such as this specimen are never born in the first place.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_257: These creatures are already here. We will spare no effort in giving them a chance to survive.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: As you wish, Chief. As you wish.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_261: Well, that concludes all of my present tasks.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_262: Let us return to Anagnorisis for now.
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HYTHLODAEUS_000_270: I thoroughly enjoyed myself─at the end most of all!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_HERMES_000_275: Now you've seen what I do. Was it everything you were expecting...?
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_METEION_000_280: All the creations are happy. That makes me happy too!
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_290: ...What? Want to apologize for forcing me to help, do you?
TEXT_AKTKME107_04425_EMETSELCH_000_291: Save your breath. You didn't force me to do anything─I merely chose the most expeditious way to have done with an impediment to our business.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HYTHLODAEUS_000_005: I thoroughly enjoyed myself─at the end most of all!
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_010: All the creations are happy. That makes me happy too!
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_020: Tell me, . In the course of watching me, have you learned aught of value?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_A1_000_022: Nothing so far, but I'm hopeful that will change.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_A1_000_024: I'm not sure what I'm looking for, but I don't think I've found it yet...
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_025: I see... If you told me what it is you seek, I would be able to better accommodate you.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_026: Dynamis, you say? Curious that such an obscure phenomenon should be of interest to you.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_027: If only my work were more interesting... Nevertheless, I'm still indebted to you for keeping Meteion company. If there is aught I might do, you need but ask.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: Chief Hermes, what good fortune to find you here.
The lykaon─I'm afraid it's done it again.
No sooner did we release one for observation than it set upon the nearby okyupetes, slaughtering them.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_032: Was the creature hungry? Or somehow provoked?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: I had just fed them myself, and the okyupetes were keeping a wide berth. It is the nature of the lykaon that is to blame. Their innate viciousness.
Temperament aside, it is an outstanding creation, perfect in form and function.
Though it may not be suited for release, I've no doubt that the bureau will accept its concept for preservation.
In any case, there's no point in postponing the inevitable. Doros will revert them all once the paperwork is in order.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_037: Where is the scene of the incident?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_ANAGNORISISSTAFF044: Just off the path to the Twelve Wonders. As you make your way, you should see it on the left. I don't know if Doros is still there, however.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_EMETSELCH_000_040: If this is part of his work, then I would observe. We follow.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_EMETSELCH_000_050: A fearsome beast, this lykaon... But where is it now?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HYTHLODAEUS_000_055: The okyupete is no easy prey. With its hooves and horns, it was designed to be formidable even on land.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HYTHLODAEUS_000_056: Yet they didn't stand a chance against the lykaon...
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_070: The lacerations and burns are unmistakable. A lykaon was indeed responsible.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_071: But the creature is nowhere to be seen. Doros must have taken it away.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_072: The man makes his base at the Twelve Wonders. I shall go and seek him out there.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HYTHLODAEUS_000_073: Emet-Selch and I will search the area for good measure. Just to make sure the lykaon did not escape.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_074: My thanks. Let us meet at the Twelve Wonders when you have finished.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_075: I will go on ahead. Please follow with .
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_076: Come, come. It's down this path and over the bridge.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_080: There it is─the Twelve Wonders. Hermes is looking for Doros. Let's look for Doros too!
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_081: He's a man with long, blond hair...I think. I'll know him when I see him!
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_SYSTEM_000_082: Meteion is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_SYSTEM_000_083: You can leave Meteion behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_SYSTEM_000_084: If you wish to have Meteion accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_095: Come on, let's find Doros. He's a man with long, blond hair...I think!
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_Q3_000_100: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Meteion?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_101: All right! I'll wait in front of the Twelve Wonders.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_105: Ready to look for Doros again? Let's go, let's go!
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_SYSTEM_000_110: Meteion has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_SYSTEM_000_121: You recall that you do not actually know what Doros looks like. You should have Meteion accompanying you before initiating conversation.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_THETWELVEWONDERSSTA: ...Hm? If you're with Meteion, then I assume you're on an errand for Hermes. What can I do for you?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_123: S-Sorry, wrong person! We're looking for Doros...
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_THETWELVEWONDERSSTA: Ah, I see. We do have similar hair, so people often mistake us from afar. I hope you find him soon.
Don't worry, you're hardly the first ones to mistake me for Doros, and you certainly won't be the last.
Once I get back and record today's results, I should finally be able to put that report to bed...
Once I get back and record today's results, I should finally be able to put that report to bed...
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_132: Not Doros! His hair is long, but the color is wrong.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_THETWELVEWONDERSSTA: ...Doros? I think he returned a short while ago.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_SYSTEM_000_140: You recall that you do not actually know what Doros looks like. You should have Meteion accompanying you before initiating conversation.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_142: Well now, if it isn't Meteion. What brings you here?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_143: Ah, I thought I heard familiar voices!
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_144: I didn't realize you two had decided to help me search for Doros. Thank you.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_145: You're in charge of the lykaones, I believe. Where are they now?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_146: (-Doros-)Out in the fields in restraints. Frenzied as they were, I couldn't well return them to Ktisis.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_147: (-Doros-)Once I've submitted my report, I'll see them reverted without delay.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HYTHLODAEUS_000_148: It's as he says. The beasts are indeed quite ferocious.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_149: (-Doros-)Y-You're one of the Fourteen! Wh-What brings you here!?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_EMETSELCH_000_150: Nothing you need concern yourself with. As you were.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_151: We've heard the news─that a lykaon slaughtered okyupetes. As the observer in charge, you are of the opinion that they are not fit to be released?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_152: (-Doros-)Aye, I am. Their abnormal aggression and exceptional strength makes for a highly problematic combination.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_153: (-Doros-)It matters not where they are released. Lykaones would threaten other species and upset the natural order.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_154: Could it be that the specimens observed are an outlier?
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_155: (-Doros-)Highly unlikely. We've created a good many of them; all exhibited the same tendencies.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_156: (-Doros-)Even when we used Kairos to begin with a fresh slate, their behavior was unchanged.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_158: (-Doros-)A memory reconfiguration system. The chief himself created it.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_159: (-Doros-)It allows us to erase or alter memories, that we may observe creations in different environmental conditions without needing to remake them from scratch.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_EMETSELCH_000_160: Quite impressive...and potentially dangerous. Depending on the intensity of the aetheric emissions, Pashtarot may wish to have words with you.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_161: Rest assured I've kept all values within prescribed limits. And to prevent misuse, its applications are limited to those authorized by the chief overseer.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_162: Do not misunderstand. To manipulate a subject's memories is an intrusive act I deeply abhor. But it is still preferable to execution.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_163: (-Doros-)Come now, Chief, let's not be so melodramatic! What was born of aether is simply being reduced to its original state.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_164: (-Doros-)I know the distinctions concern you, but we mustn't lose sight of the bigger picture─making rational choices for the sake of a more prosperous star.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_165: (-Doros-)If a creation cannot be properly studied even with the aid of Kairos, we remake it. If a creation is deemed a detrimental existence, we unmake it. 'Tis all for the greater good, and none question the necessity of such routine processes.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_166: I understand these things, I do. I would never think to unleash a clear and undeniable threat unto the world.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_167: Yet insignificant though their individual lives may be next to all creation, it is all the lykaones have.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_168: Before we seal their fates, we owe it to these beings to exhaust all options. To ensure that nothing has been overlooked.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_DOROS_000_169: (-Doros-)If you insist. Let me provide you with a full report, and we may take it from there.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HYTHLODAEUS_000_170: Would it be possible for us to attend the discussion? That Emet-Selch may better carry out his duties.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_172: Pray show them to the meeting room.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_HERMES_000_180: We have a duty to the star, this I know. But it doesn't mean we don't also have a responsibility to the lives we bring into existence here.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_190: To man, other beings are just things. To be used and controlled. Like magic.
TEXT_AKTKME108_04426_METEION_000_191: That's what Hermes told me once...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_HERMES_000_010: I fear this discussion may take a while, during which time...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_012: It's not me, Hermes. It's you...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_013: I won't go to the meeting. I'll stay with .
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_HERMES_000_014: Loath though I am to impose, may I leave Meteion in your care again?
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_HERMES_000_015: I'm in your debt. If you'll excuse me...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_020: Can you help me with something, ?
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_021: The meeting will make Hermes sad. I want to cheer him up. With a flower.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_022: Hermes likes flowers the most. Of all the creations in Elpis.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_023: Most creations are expected to be interesting. Or beautiful. Or strong. Better in some way.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_024: But flowers are different. They're designed to suit our emotions. What we feel and want to convey. Hermes likes that.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_025: I can't make flowers. So I'll search for one. And I want you to search with me.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_026: Let's start here. At the Twelve Wonders.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_027: Meteion is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_028: You can leave Meteion behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_029: If you wish to have Meteion accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_044: Let's search the Twelve Wonders first.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_Q2_000_050: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Meteion?
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_051: All right! I'll wait at the building.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_055: Hermes is still talking. We still have time!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_060: Meteion has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before you examine the flowers.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_070: You should have Meteion accompanying you before you examine the flowers.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_071: Vibrant purple flowers bigger than your hands adorn the tree.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_072: Oooh, so big and bright! I love them!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_073: ...But they might be too bright. You have to think of the recipient. That's what Hermes said.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_074: Let's head outside next. Don't worry─we won't wander far.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_080: A tall, slender tree rises before you. You crane your neck to look for flowers.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_081: No flowers... If there were apples, we could've covered them in syrup...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_082: Let's head outside next. Don't worry─we won't wander far.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_090: Lots of flowers in the fields. We should be able to find something nice!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_100: You should have Meteion accompanying you before you look for flowers.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_105: An array of beautiful flowers grow in the bed, their mix of colors forming a pattern.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_106: These would be better for Hermes...but they're hedged in.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_107: That means we shouldn't touch them. They're either under observation or poisonous.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_108: Any other place should be fine, though. Let's keep looking!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_110: Vibrant or subdued...? Interesting or plain...? Hmmm...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_120: Set on a tall, thin stalk, the oddly shaped flower is mesmerizing in its undulations...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_121: Oh, a coneion! A flower that can move!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_122: When Hermes wasn't looking, it shot seeds at him. Not a good gift, maybe...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_123: But you're good, ─at spotting flowers! We'll find something soon!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_130: You're good at observing, . Just like an observer!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_140: You spy nothing promising nearby. At best, common-looking grasses with some few tiny flowers...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_150: Come on, let's get closer! But not too close!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_160: A terrible stench reminiscent of sodden old boots pervades the air... Without a doubt, the culprit is the morbol-like creature before you.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_161: It's an adonis! The things around its mouth look like petals. But the flowers are the orbs on its head!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_162: When Hermes inspected it, it swallowed him up. He didn't leave his room for days. What do you think, ? Would he like it?
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_A3_000_164: It's probably not the good sort of memory...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_A3_000_165: I'd rather not go near that thing...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_167: Finding a good flower... It's harder than I thought.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_168: I'm sorry, , but could we search a little more? Maybe as far as the fields over there. I'll pick something after that, I promise.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_170: I've never given a gift before... Were you nervous too? For your first time?
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_SYSTEM_000_180: Lush, green fields stretch out before you, ending where the sky begins...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_182: ...Hm? The shiny thing over there. What could it be?
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_190: I learned something new recently─the meaning of Philomythes Notos!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_191: “Notos” is a south wind person...and “Philomythes” is his joy! Why is he joyful? Because this place is so beautiful!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_200: Ooh, Elpis flowers! They're here too!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_201: Hermes likes and dislikes them. At the same time.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_202: Like me, they're entelechies. Like me, they feel his pain and turn dark...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_203: That's only for Hermes, though. For others, they're always white and bright.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_204: Truly!? The flower was dark in your home!?
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_205: Then...do you have it too? A dark emotion?
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_A4_000_207: I've known the pain and sorrow of loss.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_A4_000_208: I've felt great fury and frustration.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_A4_000_209: I've been plagued by doubt and anxiety.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_A4_000_210: I daresay I have a few.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_212: Hermes has known the same. The feeling that a part of you is gone. Again and again. But no one notices...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_213: Please, . Won't you lend it to me? Your pain and sorrow...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_215: Hermes has felt the same. A fire burning in your breast. A trembling hand. But no one understands...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_216: Please, . Won't you lend them to me? Your fury and frustration...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_218: Hermes has felt the same. A shortness of breath. The walls closer and closer. But only him. No one else feels it...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_219: Please, . Won't you lend them to me? Your doubt and anxiety...
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_220: You don't have to say it. I can feel it's something you want to hide.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_221: But won't you lend it to me? The darkness inside you?
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_222: I want you to make the flower dark. In front of Hermes.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_223: He has been in a dark place. Since before he created me. He needs to know that he isn't there alone. That others are sad too.
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_225: Thank you, ! Thank you! It means more to me than I can say!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_226: I can't wait to see how Hermes reacts! Let's go back and fetch him!
TEXT_AKTKME109_04427_METEION_000_230: It seems they're still talking. Let's wait until they've finished.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_EMETSELCH_000_000: The prodigal familiar returns, and after causing all manner of trouble while we were in our meeting, I'm sure.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HYTHLODAEUS_000_005: Were you able to get some rest? Please, do not hesitate to let us know if you're feeling tired─I worry we might exhaust your scarce reserves of aether.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_METEION_000_010: I'm glad Hermes saw the flowers. Thank you, .
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_METEION_000_011: It will help...I hope. Today will be difficult for him.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_020: An all-too-brief interlude, perhaps, but it is time I attend to my next task.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_021: As Emet-Selch and Hythlodaeus are aware, we reached a verdict regarding the fate of the lykaones.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_024: Doros has followed the correct protocols, and, as chief overseer, I can find no fault in his judgment.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_025: The lykaones would disrupt the natural order, ravaging and consuming other species until they themselves starve and perish. They cannot be released into the wild, and they cannot be allowed to remain here in Elpis.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_026: I intend to petition the Bureau of the Architect to have the concept preserved as a restricted-purpose hazardous life-form. Hythlodaeus has pledged to support me in this endeavor.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_027: Yet whatever the bureau decides, the existing lykaones have served their purpose...
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_028: Doros has already isolated the creatures, and is preparing to carry out the necessary measures.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_029: I will join him forthwith. It is my duty to witness the...conclusion...to this study.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_EMETSELCH_000_030: If you are resolved, then we have but to accompany you.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_031: Of course. Let us be off, then. We return to the main isle.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_040: Doros! Are you hurt!? What happened here!?
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_DOROS_000_042: I had them bound with aetherial shackles. But they became frenzied, even more so than usual, and broke free...
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_DOROS_000_043: I was able to stop four. The other three escaped...
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HYTHLODAEUS_000_044: ...I see them. Two have taken to the air above the Twelve Wonders.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_EMETSELCH_000_045: The last is up ahead, lurking in the fields.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_EMETSELCH_000_046: You and  handle that one. The pair in the sky, you can leave to me.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_047: ...If this is how it must end, then so be it.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HYTHLODAEUS_000_048: I will render assistance to Emet-Selch, unneeded though it is.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_049: Meteion, you are to stay here with Doros.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_051: The lykaones must be reverted. I would spare you their pain. And mine.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_052: This is my burden, not yours. But if you are intent on helping, then please, follow my lead.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_METEION_000_060: Stay with Hermes, . He will need someone...when the time comes...
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_DOROS_000_065: Never mind my wounds, they are easily healed. It is the lykaones which concern me...
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_070: I appreciate your help...and lament that it is necessary.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_071: There it is─our quarry. Within striking distance at present...but if it feels threatened, it may well flee beyond our reach.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_072: Here is my plan. You will approach slowly, in full view, and draw the lykaon's attention.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_073: Now, I warn you: its abilities are as fiery as its temperament. Once it spots you, it will unleash orbs of flame...
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_074: But fear not. By my measure, you are more than equal to the task. Withstand the onslaught for a few brief moments, and that will give me time to catch it unawares.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_080: A few moments is all I require. Just make sure that you command its attention!
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_POPMESSAGE_000_090: The lykaon unleashes an orb of pure flame!
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_POPMESSAGE_000_095: The lykaon manifests more fiery spheres!
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HERMES_000_100: Not quite yet! Stand your ground a little longer!
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_HYTHLODAEUS_000_110: It has been quite an exciting visit for you thus far. Oh, you weren't injured, were you? Good, good.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_EMETSELCH_000_120: The other lykaones have been taken care of.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_EMETSELCH_000_121: The incident is resolved, and life in Elpis continues as normal...or ends, as the case may be.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_EMETSELCH_000_122: Rationally speaking, I understand Hermes's argument. No matter how well deserved the rest, there is a pang of sadness when a colleague leaves us.
TEXT_AKTKME110_04428_EMETSELCH_000_123: Yet never has a departure caused me such grief as Hermes appears to feel. What must it be like to experience such torment...?
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_EMETSELCH_000_000: ...I don't know what answer he's searching for, or if it is within our power to give it. But I believe he would make a fine Fandaniel, and that if he rejects us out of hand, we will all be lesser for it.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_010: Where to now? If there is anywhere you would like to visit before we leave, I should be glad to show you the way...
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_EMETSELCH_000_011: Hermes has not yet outright refused his position with the Convocation─merely postponed the decision.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_EMETSELCH_000_012: As such, I may as well resume my assessment. If we cannot accompany him, then I will content myself with questioning his colleagues.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_013: Ever the pragmatist. Then allow me to remain your humble guide.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_014: And what of you, ? Will you continue along with us?
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_015: Wonderful! Our fellowship travels on unbroken. I say we explore another part of Elpis, and see what new encounters there are to be had.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_016: If you would follow me, we will first head back towards Anagnorisis.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_EMETSELCH_000_020: Didn't we part ways with Hermes not far from here? Given the size of Elpis, I expect our paths will cross again before long...
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_030: From here, we follow the path northwards to Notoneus.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_031: There we will find one of the neus which facilitate travel between the islands of Elpis.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_032: First-time travelers must be accompanied by someone with the requisite permission─which I have previously been granted. We only need use the device together once, and henceforth you will have leave to use it freely.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_EMETSELCH_000_040: Unless the need is pressing, I won't be tracking Hermes with my aetherial sight. 'Tis poor manners to spy on someone's comings and goings in such a fashion. So don't ask.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_EMETSELCH_000_041: Social conventions notwithstanding, perceiving aether requires deliberate and intense concentration, and we otherwise keep our eyes on the corporeal world.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_050: Here we are: Notoneus. This neus will take us to Kallimelios Zephyros, the western island.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_051: That's it right there, looming large over us.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_052: Step this way, and we can soon admire the view from above!
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_EMETSELCH_000_060: And there I thought you were a harmless stray familiar...
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_EMETSELCH_000_061: As far as I'm concerned, this nebulous talk of future this and changing history that can wait. First, I mean to find out exactly who you are and what you hope to achieve here.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_065: The future... Our future. I am deathly curious to hear more.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_070: My apologies, but before we move along, a colleague has tasked me with a matter which I'd rather not leave unresolved.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_071: It involves finding a certain concept-engraved crystal...and the quick-fingered oreias which made off with it.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_072: An oreias, you say? I think we might have seen the culprit before being distracted by that business with the shark. Would you like us to follow its aetherial trail?
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_073: That would, of course, lead us only to the oreias─there is no guarantee that it hasn't dropped or stashed away the crystal you seek.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_074: Please! Even that much would be enormously helpful. While you are hunting down the thief, I can follow behind and scour the forest floor just in case.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_075: Could I ask you to join the search? I would appreciate another pair of eyes to cover the land to the west of here...
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_076: Many thanks! There's a small bridge leading into Poieten Oikos─let us meet up there once we've exhausted our efforts.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_EMETSELCH_000_080: The problem you present is vexing enough without adding the old Azem into the equation.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_EMETSELCH_000_081: <sigh> And she wonders why these lines upon my brow grow deeper, when she herself wields the hammer and chisel...
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_HYTHLODAEUS_000_085: The Azems, both mentor and student, are a force to be reckoned with. I find them a delight, personally, but they have a habit of making Emet-Selch look as if he bit down on a sour grape.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_090: Our last searcher returns. I am afraid the oreias no longer had the crystal, nor was I able to find it as I followed in its wake.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_091: I don't suppose you fared any better...?
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_093: Wonderful! Now I can focus on your tale without that missing concept nagging at my mind. Have you always had a knack for finding things?
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_A2_000_095: I've often been asked to do so.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_A2_000_096: Traveling and searching go hand in hand.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_097: Oho! You too? Some of us seem destined to always be searching. For ourselves and for others.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_098: You travel often, then? It seems we have something in common.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_099: Long ago, when I held the seat of Azem, I was forever trekking back and forth across the star in search of answers to people's problems.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_100: Naturally, the need for such journeys has lessened considerably since I entrusted the position to my whimsical successor...
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_101: Yet I am still eager to come running should an old acquaintance or new interest require my personal attention.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_102: That is what brings me to Elpis, in fact. Many times has my presence been requested; my opinions sought concerning the habitat of this or that creation.
TEXT_AKTKME111_04429_VENAS_000_103: Agreeing to help locate that missing crystal was a minor distraction...which now promises to become a major revelation! How strange and wonderful it is the way one thing leads to another. Wouldn't you agree?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_EMETSELCH_000_000: The problem you present is vexing enough without adding the old Azem into the equation.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_EMETSELCH_000_001: <sigh> And she wonders why these lines upon my brow grow deeper, when she herself wields the hammer and chisel...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_HYTHLODAEUS_000_005: The Azems, both mentor and student, are a force to be reckoned with. I find them a delight, personally, but they have a habit of making Emet-Selch look as if he bit down on a sour grape.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_010: Thank you again for your timely help. Now then, 'tis time I returned this stolen property.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_011: If you would go on ahead to my accommodation, I will join you as soon as I have attended to that task.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_012: Follow the path straight ahead to the building at the top of the slope. I have the entire place to myself, so we can speak without fear of being disturbed or overheard.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_EMETSELCH_000_020: Yes, this will be far more comfortable than interrogating you on the side of the road.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_HYTHLODAEUS_000_025: You needn't be nervous around Venat─those white robes mark her as one of fair and impartial reasoning.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_HYTHLODAEUS_000_026: Aside from the emissary, Elidibus, such garb is worn only by those who have stepped down from public office to serve as advisors. Whatever you have to say, she will listen without judgment.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_030: Welcome to my temporary abode. Please, make yourself at home while I put on some tea.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_040: Shall we begin our investigations, then?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_041: I am acquainted with Hermes, of course, but only as a visitor received by the chief overseer of Elpis. Of the man himself, I know only that which is common knowledge.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_042: Thus I suggest we fall back on the tried-and-true method of conversing with the locals. The observers who live here can surely tell us more of Hermes and Meteion, and I have a good idea of where we might begin...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_045: Ah, there's nothing like enjoying the fresh air after being cooped up inside writing reports.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_050: See you the woman standing in front of yonder building? Her name is Ismene.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_051: She is the one who made arrangements for my stay in Elpis, and from what I recall, she has held her position here for quite some time. Chances are she can provide us with some insights.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_052: Go and ask your questions. I will help with drawing out answers if need be, but I leave the choice of topic up to you.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_060: Let us speak with Ismene. You know more of this coming calamity, so I think it best that you lead the conversation.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_070: Questions? For me? Well, I suppose I have no other pressing duties at the moment...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_SYSTEM_000_071: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_073: Greetings, Ismene. My friend here is desperately curious about Chief Hermes, and I was wondering if you might indulge .
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_074: Certainly, Mistress Venat. Anything to be of service!
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_075: What do you wish to know?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_A2_000_077: What kind of person is Hermes?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_079: Well, I can only answer from my own experience, but...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_080: I would describe him as a quiet man─reserved, you might say─and occasionally somewhat poor with his choice of words.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_081: His reticent nature, however, does not prevent him from carrying out his duties as chief overseer.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_082: The man is a walking archive when it comes to life-forms. He can discuss any species in incredible detail, and is the leading authority on concepts with the power of flight.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_084: Well, he is an authority on flying life-forms, and has expansive knowledge of living creatures in general. Is that what you wished to know...?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_085: How would you describe him as a person? As a colleague?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_086: He is a quiet man─reserved, you might say─and occasionally somewhat poor with his choice of words.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_087: His reticent nature, however, does not prevent him from carrying out his duties as chief overseer.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_088: I hope that answers your question. Was there anything else?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_A3_000_090: How long has Meteion been here?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_A3_000_091: Do you know of Meteion's abilities?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_092: I cannot rightly say... As the chief's personal creation, Meteion has not been subjected to observation and study like other concepts.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_093: So one day, she was simply there. And what do you make of her abilities?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_094: I understand that she is a highly unusual familiar, able to read emotions and communicate directly with one's mind. Exactly how she was created with that talent, however, is a mystery to me.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_095: It's no secret that she is a highly unusual familiar. Of late, the chief often makes his rounds with her, like a mother hen raising her chick.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_096: I understand that she is able to read emotions and communicate directly with one's mind. Exactly how she was created with that talent, however, is a mystery to me.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_097: My apologies. I wish I could explain her nature in more depth, but I've not had occasion to discuss it with Chief Hermes.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_A4_000_099: Do you wish you knew him better?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_101: The chief may not be the most gregarious individual, but he engages with us as is necessary for everyone to perform their duties. I wouldn't want to intrude upon his privacy for the sake of curiosity...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_102: Though if you wish to learn more about Meteion, you could try speaking with Timaios─another expert in the creation of flying concepts.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_103: He should be conducting his observations on the banks of the stream, somewhere to the east. Oh, and, uh, unless you take a particular joy in rambling discourse, I suggest you keep your questions concise.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_104: I...beg your pardon? I've known Chief Hermes for many years. Though I cannot say we are close, he has never withheld information to the detriment of our duties, if that is what you mean...?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_105: Forgive us, we seem to have veered slightly off course here. Is there perhaps someone else who could tell us more about Meteion?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_106: That would be Timaios. He has a similar expertise with flying concepts, and is more than eager to discuss the subject.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_107: You'll find him conducting his observations on the banks of the stream, somewhere to the east. Oh, and, uh, unless you take a particular joy in rambling discourse, I suggest you keep your questions concise.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_108: We shall keep that in mind. Thank you for your patience and your insight.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_109: Think nothing of it. If there is aught else you need during your stay, please, do not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_110: Come, , I think we've taken enough of Ismene's time.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_ISMENE_000_120: You are a familiar, yes? Belonging to Mistress Venat? You couldn't have been blessed with a finer master.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_130: Our investigation is off to a fine start, wouldn't you agree?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_131: From here, I propose that we split up. I shall continue making inquiries with the resident observers, if you could track down the colleague Ismene mentioned.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_132: Given how you steered that previous conversation, 'tis plain you need no assistance from me.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_133: While I did feel compelled to interject once or twice during that previous conversation, you seem more than capable of drawing forth the answers you seek.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_134: Although I felt compelled to take the reins of that previous conversation, your, uh, “fearless” style of interrogation will eventually lead you to the answers you seek.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_135: All I ask is that you watch your footing around the stream! We can meet back here once you've finished speaking with this Timaios.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_140: I will start from one side of the compound and make my way through, speaking to as many people as I can. We should have plenty to discuss upon your return.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_150: Yes, yes, I am Timaios, but please keep your voice down. You'll startle the birds.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_SYSTEM_000_151: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_153: ...So, what is it you wished to speak about?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_A6_000_155: Is it true you're an expert on flying creations?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_A6_000_156: What do you think of Chief Hermes's flying creations?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_157: A fellow enthusiast, are you? Well, settle in, and we can discuss the finer points of this fascinating craft!
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_158: My deep and abiding love of avian artistry can be traced back to when I was but a young boy, stricken by the transcendent beauty of a glorious, golden-feathered creature my father had designed. It was then and there that I vowed to one day surpass that masterpiece...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_SYSTEM_000_159: Timaios launches into a rambling and unstoppable discourse...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_160: ...And thus did I secure an observer's role here in Elpis, and at last realize my childhood ambition. Here, the dreams I once dreamed are an everyday reality, in which I find fulfillment through the research and creation of new flying life-forms!
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_161: An abridged recounting of events, as was doubtless to your disappointment. Is there any specific part you would like me to expound upon...?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_162: ...Hm? You were hoping for my opinion on Chief Hermes's creations? Then why didn't you say so!?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_163: Chief Hermes's work? A worthy subject, indeed...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_164: Those beings which soar through the clouds, majestic and graceful, are ever a favorite of creators. Even now, with so many varieties in existence, the flood of newly imagined concepts continues unabated.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_165: What sets the chief's creations apart, however, is how they benefit from his boundless knowledge of the celestial realm.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_166: Birds that climb so high that they disappear from view. Others which traverse the boundless sky in moments, and all without riding the currents...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_167: I know of none save he who can conceive of such marvels. Even we who prize elegance of form above all else are dumbfounded by his genius.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_A7_000_170: Meteion, too, is a marvel, then?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_172: Now, see here. When I take up the threads of creation and begin to weave, I must do so in the belief that I am giving birth to something beautiful. If, in my heart, I knew I was appropriating another's inspiration...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_SYSTEM_000_173: Timaios launches into a rambling and unstoppable diatribe...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_174: ...And such an unconscionable, disgraceful act would be deserving of the utmost scorn!
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_175: Therefore, despite my admiration for Meteion as a concept, I have made a conscious effort not to delve too deeply into the inner workings of her nature.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_176: My opinion on that matter would be superficial at best...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_177: Despite my admiration for Meteion as a concept, I have never delved too deeply into the inner workings of her nature.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_178: I know that she has a gift for communicating via emotions, but otherwise, her abilities are a mystery to me.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_179: If Chief Hermes should choose to submit Meteion's concept to the Bureau of the Architect, then will the design be registered for public scrutiny. Analyzing a colleague's creation before that step is...frowned upon, to say the least.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_180: Of course, if he came to me─a fellow artisan─looking for advice, that would be an entirely different story.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_A8_000_182: Do you know of dynamis and entelechies?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_A8_000_183: I could tell you more of Meteion's nature, if you like...?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_185: Those terms do sound vaguely familiar... Was there not a flower made here in Elpis which exhibited properties of one or the other?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_186: It must have been centuries since I last heard anyone speak of such things. Has there been a resurgence in interest?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_187: No, no, no! Did I not just explain how that was frowned upon!? I couldn't possibly circumvent conventional practice by...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_188: ...Hm. Unless you were sharing such information in the hopes of receiving a constructive opinion...on the application of advanced creation techniques...then I would be practically obligated to...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_SYSTEM_000_189: Timaios launches into a rambling and unstoppable deluge of justifications...
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_190: ...So you see, ethically I have no choice but to allow you to disclose Meteion's lesser-known qualities!
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_192: Those terms do sound vaguely familiar... Was there not a flower made here in Elpis which exhibited properties of one or the other?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_193: It must have been centuries since I last heard anyone speak of such things. And you know how they relate to Meteion and her design?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_194: Then why bring up the subject? I'm flattered that you sought my insight, but I cannot afford to neglect my duties for the sake of idle chatter.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_195: Now, I really must return to my observations. Surely you have your own tasks to attend to?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_TIMAIOS_000_200: As I said, I have work to be getting on with. If you wish to speak more, you'll have to wait until I've finished for the day.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_210: Back already? That was quick work. You were obviously clever enough to head off any of that “rambling” Ismene mentioned.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_211: Ah, good timing. I finished my own investigations not long ago.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_212: At last! You were gone so long I was beginning to wonder if you'd slipped into the stream and banged your head, or something equally unfortunate.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_213: So, have you any new findings to share?
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_214: I see. Even an expert in the field had little understanding of Meteion's capabilities, let alone an awareness of dynamis.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_215: My questions resulted in much the same answers. Hermes's colleagues view Meteion as his personal project, and could provide no details beyond those which you just told me.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_216: Which leads me to believe that the only person with any significant knowledge of dynamis is Hermes himself.
TEXT_AKTKME112_04430_VENAS_000_217: Yes, we've made some progress here...but more information is needed if we are to reach any definitive conclusions.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_ISMENE_000_000: You are a familiar, yes? Belonging to Mistress Venat? You couldn't have been blessed with a finer master.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_010: At present, the strongest link we have to the Final Days is the power of dynamis...and the entelechies which can control it.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_011: Yet most scholars are only vaguely aware of these terms, let alone study them in any depth. Except for Hermes, it seems.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_012: Thus I am inclined to stay our current course, and learn all we can about the chief overseer and his familiar.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_013: And on that subject, was there aught else of note you can tell me about Meteion? Aside from her unorthodox method of communication?
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_A1_000_015: There are more like her. She has sisters...
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_A1_000_016: She and her sisters were created to journey to the stars and search for intelligent life.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_017: ...I rather wish you had mentioned that earlier. In any event, would you care to elaborate?
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_018: So these siblings of hers now travel the great expanse in search of deeper meaning...
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_019: Thank you. Though the mystery at hand remains unresolved, I feel you've touched upon a vital clue─one we should keep in mind as we continue.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_020: Next, I propose we take ourselves to Peripeteia Krystalline, not far from here. Just follow the path to the west.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_030: This tower and the one further along are both part of Peripeteia Krystalline, the facility where they archive all of Elpis's observational and testing records.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_031: Despite how they appear from the outside, the interior is actually a vast area of magically interconnected spaces, which...while fascinating, is not the reason we are here, is it?
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_032: I shall cut my architectural lesson short, and see what those two archivists have to share.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_033: If you could find someone to speak with over at the other tower, I shall join you there anon.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_040: How odd that I should suggest this approach without a second thought...
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_041: You've come from a time and place that is dramatically different. Yet here we are, working side by side─or apart, as the situation demands─with barely a word of explanation required.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_042: No matter the centuries which separate us, we are of the same star. We share a connection. And I hope that together, we might find the answers you seek.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_PERIPETEIASTAFFA044: You have questions for me? Certainly! Just a moment while I conclude my current appointment...
...Indeed. So if you could provide a comprehensive log of those behaviors, we should then have sufficient data for our official records.
Now, what was it you wished to speak with me about?
...The chief overseer's “personal research project”? And by that, I assume you mean Meteion?
Such undocumented studies are difficult to track. After all, hardly a day goes past without seeing a researcher trailed by one creation or another...
I'm afraid I cannot tell you exactly when Meteion appeared. Only that she now spends much of her time at Chief Hermes's side.
Although... I do recall an interesting tale my dearest Galene shared with me...
...Ah. Galene is my partner, and a fellow researcher here in Elpis.
She was returning late one night when she caught sight of Chief Hermes sending Meteion heavensward. A host of them.
For several days, she would speak of that scene with wonder, describing it as one of the most beautiful spectacles she had ever witnessed.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_060: That sounds like a story I should like to hear.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_PERIPETEIASTAFFA044: Mistress Venat! I thought you had already returned to the surface!
Permit me to thank you again for your invaluable contribution to our concept placement proposal.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_063: Pray do not mention it. As you say, my original plan was to leave after that task, but I have since become engrossed with Chief Hermes's research.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_064: Would you favor me with a retelling of this sight which so delighted your Galene?
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_PERIPETEIASTAFFA044: Of course. Or you could hear it from her lips directly, if you prefer?
At present, she should be observing a subject in Metabaseos Thalassai.
She does enjoy her time there, watching the sea creatures hunt and play; gazing upon the salty waters of the world's oceans, recreated in such sublime detail.
I imagine you must find similar joy in indulging your boundless curiosity, Mistress Venat...
Even though such pursuits must continually and regretfully delay your return to the star.
'Tis a rest well deserved and long overdue, I should think. How greatly have we prospered for the wisdom you accumulated during your travels as Azem.
And what would Elpis be without your earlier academic work? The theories you developed served as the basis of many techniques still in use today.

Man is a creature of contemplation, but none embody that nature with as much enduring passion as you! Aye, I daresay there is not a soul alive more worthy of a return. I shall rejoice the day you depart on your final journey.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_075: Well, shall we take this opportunity to meet with Galene in person?
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_PERIPETEIASTAFFA044: Then allow me to reconfigure the door to the archives here.
It will take you up to the skyway, and spare you the need to avoid hostile concepts on the ground.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_078: That would be most helpful, thank you.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_080: The other archivists said naught we hadn't already heard, but this story of Galene's sounds promising...
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_PERIPETEIASTAFFA044: I have opened the path to the skyway.
Once you pass through the door, simply walk straight across to the next tower and ask for admittance to the upper tier.
Upon arriving at the upper tier, walk straight across the skyway, and you will find yourself at the entrance to Metabaseos Thalassai.
Galene will be eager to share her tale with you, I am sure.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_100: The tower ahead is still part of Peripeteia Krystalline. We will need to ask for passage through to the upper tier.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_PERIPETEIASTAFFA044: Do you need to return to the skyway?
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_PERIPETEIASTAFFB044: Then allow me to prepare the path. If you need further assistance, there is always an observer or two out on the upper skyway.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_120: That door leads into the Thalassai, but perhaps we can trouble this person for assistance with finding Galene.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_PERIPETEIASTAFFB044: Passing through to Metabaseos Thalassai? Allow me to link the door to the upper skyway...
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_METABASEOSSTAFF0443: ...Mistress Venat!? I was not told to expect─ We would have prepared an official welcome!
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_131: Please, there is no need for fanfare. I only wish to speak with Galene, if that might be arranged...?
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_METABASEOSSTAFF0443: Yes! Galene! Of course! I will inform her immediately.
Ah, but she may be engaged in a testing phase. You could be in for something of a wait... Should I let her know your business is urgent?
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_134: That won't be necessary. This lovely view will keep us occupied until she is ready to receive us.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_140: So, another piece of the puzzle falls into place.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_141: From what we've learned thus far, I think we can safely conclude that Hermes hasn't been revealing the details of his research to others.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_142: Which suggests that either someone will appropriate his discoveries and make use of them...or that Hermes himself will have a hand in causing the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKME113_04431_VENAS_000_143: Since we have no reason yet to suspect the former, we should consider the latter the more likely possibility. Proceeding under that assumption, our next step should be to divine why─or even if─he might desire such a terrible fate for our star.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_000: I should like to visit the site from which Hermes sent forth the Meteia. If we are fortunate, we might find some hint of what drives this research of his.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_001: Galene said she spotted them in the southeast, rising from an isle she could see from the edge.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_002: If we stand at that same vantage point, it should not prove too difficult to locate the isle in question. Let's take a look, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_010: Now, if I were conducting some mystery research, where would I go...?
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_012: Have you the means to fly? 'Tis quite a distance away.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_013: Hm. Inconvenient, but hardly an insurmountable problem.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_015: My friend, would you mind creating a double to carry  here over to that island?
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_017: Stubborn creature. There is no place on this great star we have not together traveled, and still he remains obstinate in the presence of strangers.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_018: Argos has rather exacting standards, I'm afraid.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_019: What? You've ridden him before...? Ah─your “before” meaning my “after.” Not at all confusing, that.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_021: But speaking of the here and now, the quick solution is for us to face off in a sparring match.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_022: Demonstrate to him that you are capable of holding your own against me in battle, and you should convince Argos that you are worthy of his back.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_023: And besides, I might even teach you a thing or two into the bargain.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_024: You seem doubtful. But useful lesson or not, it will certainly be a moment to remember─a memory of the distant past to cherish!
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_025: What say you, traveler out of time?
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_A1_000_028: I will do what I must.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_A1_000_029: And if this memory turns out to be a bad one...?
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_031: I had a feeling you might say something like that. Know that you “must” give a good showing, however!
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_032: That's up to you, isn't it? If a loss would sting, then you had better win!
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_033: Clear your mind and prepare your weapons. I will await you at the clearing over yonder.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_SYSTEM_000_040: The entity is identical to the one you encountered in Mare Lamentorum...except this Argos is pointedly ignoring you.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_050: Shall we begin? Be warned: I'll not go easy on you!
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_SYSTEM_000_055: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 87 or above to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_060: Argos will soon have us standing on the very spot where the Meteia made their departure into the night sky. With luck, we will learn something of Hermes's intentions.
TEXT_AKTKME114_04432_VENAS_000_061: My hope is that we find no connection─no festering wish for oblivion. Then we might have Hermes and his considerable expertise working for us, rather than against us.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_000: Let us move over to the edge before mounting, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_001: That will allow Argos to catch the currents rising up from below, and give us a smooth ride over to the isle.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_010: Climb onto Argos's back and we can be off. ...You know, I honestly cannot remember the last time he carried anyone but me.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_SYSTEM_000_020: Argos motions to his back with his muzzle. You've been given the go-ahead to hop on!
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_SYSTEM_000_022: Argos launches into the air with a powerful leap!
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_030: Isn't this pleasant? Argos certainly seems to think so.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_035: Now, what was the name of that tree...?
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_040: Noe...something... Ah! Noetophoreon! Quite a striking specimen, is it not?
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_045: Brace yourself for the landing─I wouldn't want you tumbling off at the last moment.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_050: There are any number of places where Hermes might be in Elpis...
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_051: But we could do worse than to look in Ktisis Hyperboreia, the largest facility. It stands in Ethoseletikos Boreas, the northern isle.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_052: I wonder, ─for an institution which claims to studiously research every species destined for release into the world, did you not question how they find room for them all on so few islands?
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_053: The answer lies within Ktisis itself. I touched upon the practice before back at the archives, where a vast area is stitched together out of multiple conceptual spaces. The same holds true for the interior of this facility and its magically constructed environs.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_054: 'Tis there, within those sprawling habitats, that the chief overseer and most of Elpis's observers conduct the bulk of their work.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_055: Come, the simplest route is via the neus north of Poieten Oikos...
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_SYSTEM_000_060: This appears to be the teleporter Venat told you about.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_SYSTEM_000_061: Motes of light yet hang in the air, suggesting the device was but recently activated...
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_070: Ah, good, the neus acknowledged you as my guest. You should now have the authority to use it as you wish.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_071: As for the way to Ktisis Hyperboreia, we follow this path, then turn left at the crossroads.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_080: Here we are: the grandest research facility in Elpis.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_081: We should head inside and ask after Hermes's whereabouts...
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_HYTHLODAEUS_000_082: (-???-)Hermes is at another facility...as we have just discovered.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_HYTHLODAEUS_000_083: Furthermore, we've confirmed that his studies into dynamis, as well as his creation of Meteion, were entirely private pursuits.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_HYTHLODAEUS_000_084: No one else we spoke with appeared to possess the chief's depth of knowledge on the subject, and neither did we hear any tales of stolen research.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_HYTHLODAEUS_000_085: Which means that if Hermes himself harbors no desire to bring down an apocalypse, then he might be recruited to help prevent one...
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_087: According to your story, the Fourteen divined the connection between the celestial currents and the Final Days, but were never able to pinpoint the root cause of the calamity.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_088: With our people's greatest minds─not to mention Hythlodaeus's sharp eyes─committed to the pursuit of a solution, such an outcome seems...inconceivable.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_089: The only possible explanation is if the nature of the catalyst was so inexplicable that even we failed to perceive it.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_090: And what better fits that description than the invisible, intangible dynamis?
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_HYTHLODAEUS_000_091: Which in turn, leads us to our next question: how did Hermes, in his role as Fandaniel, not recognize the subject of his own research?
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_HYTHLODAEUS_000_092: We must assume that he either knew and was unable to help, or that he was otherwise prevented from identifying the cause in the first place. At this juncture, all we can do is speculate.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_093: To be clear, the Convocation does not tolerate acts of deception or malice. We are practiced at perceiving truth, and would have known had Fandaniel lied to us.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_094: Hermes has no conscious wish for the world to end. Of that, I am certain.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_095: It seems there is more to the tale after all.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_VENAS_000_096: We conducted an investigation of our own, you see...
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_097: How comforting... We seem to have reached the exact same conclusion.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_098: I see no reason to delay further. 'Tis time we brought Hermes into the fold, as it were.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_102: Save your thanks. I did not say I believed your ridiculous story.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_103: This does not mean I believe your ridiculous story.
TEXT_AKTKME115_04433_EMETSELCH_000_104: But as Emet-Selch, I have a duty to examine any potential threat to our existence. No matter how ludicrous or personally offensive I may find it.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_EMETSELCH_000_000: Do not approach me, do not speak to me, and do not dare presume to treat me as a friend. I am merely carrying out my duty.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_VENAS_000_005: How lovely─our merry duo has become a quartet.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_VENAS_000_006: Past disagreements are no reason to reject collaboration in the here and now. I commend Emet-Selch for his practicality.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_010: I think the time for leisurely exploration is past. If I might have a moment to adjust my vision...
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_011: ...There he is. On the next isle over. Meteion is with him.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_012: Hermes appears to be in the midst of an observational study, but I suggest we hurry over before they venture elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_013: Head straight down the path─we can teleport to Misopses Euros from the device at the bottom of the slope.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_SYSTEM_000_020: This appears to be the teleporter to Misopses Euros.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_EMETSELCH_000_030: What, you expect me to praise you and your progress? On the contrary, I'm simply surprised you made it this far.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_EMETSELCH_000_031: Then again, even with you slowing her down, there is no denying that Venat is an accomplished researcher. Her wealth of wisdom and experience is unmatched, and her achievements in creation magicks─in any field, frankly─are nothing short of extraordinary.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_EMETSELCH_000_032: Though the singular brilliance which sets her apart can make her motives somewhat impenetrable at times...
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_EMETSELCH_000_033: As her student and successor puts it, she is a force of nature, at once so close...and at the same time, so very distant.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_VENAS_000_035: Misopses Euros is interesting in that it is the only region in Elpis which lacks a researcher hub.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_VENAS_000_036: This is largely due to the nature of its observation sites, within which they let loose creatures anticipated to be unruly and dangerous.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_VENAS_000_037: I have also heard tell that the area is kept deliberately sparse in the event that─ Well, let us just say that no one should live near the neus which provides access to a certain...facility.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_040: They are close by, within the Hungering Gardens. That would be the circular enclosure you see just up ahead.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_EMETSELCH_000_041: Well, then, ─make yourself useful and bring Hermes out here to us.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_EMETSELCH_000_042: If I were to go, he would assume I was only there to press him on the Fandaniel matter. Of all of us present, you stand the best chance at convincing him to put aside his work for the moment.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_043: But the creations in there are not exactly─
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_044: Hmm, then again, perhaps  can handle them...  did survive a bout with Venat, after all!
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_045: Off you go to find Hermes, but do be prepared to come to blows with the garden's denizens!
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_050: Someone needs to go into the Hungering Gardens to speak with Hermes, and it seems Emet-Selch has nominated you for the task!
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_POPMESSAGE_000_060: Botanical abominations bear down upon you with ravenous intent!
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HERMES_000_061: , what are you doing here! I thought you were keeping Hythlodaeus and Emet-Selch company?
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HERMES_000_062: ...An “important matter.” And unrelated to my decision on Fandaniel, you say?
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HERMES_000_063: Then, yes, I will come. As soon as my work here is finished.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HERMES_000_064: It will not be long, I promise, but you should really wait outside the garden with the others. This is no place for idle exploration.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HERMES_000_070: You needn't be concerned for our safety. Meteion and I are protected by a ward which conceals our presence from the creatures.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_METEION_000_075: We're taking notes! We'll talk later?
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_VENAS_000_085: I was prepared to swoop in if need be, but 'tis clear you have faced your fair share of monstrous opponents.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_091: ...And were briefly entangled with the denizens of the Hungering Gardens as well, I see─or should I say, smell.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_092: I cannot speak for certain Convocation members, but I for one am impressed with your fortitude! Well done indeed!
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_093: Now that you've convinced Hermes to confer with us, let us pray that things will soon take a turn for the better.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_094: For as fascinating as it would be to meet the Emet-Selch who would recreate Amaurot in the depths of the ocean, I think it best for all concerned if such tragic events never came to pass.
TEXT_AKTKME116_04434_HYTHLODAEUS_000_095: Be it in our future or your past─assuming yours is not truly written in stone. Naive hope that that is...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_HYTHLODAEUS_000_000: Hm? Why am I always so forward thinking? I simply wish to enjoy all that life has to offer!
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_VENAS_000_005: I was prepared to swoop in if need be, but 'tis clear you have faced your fair share of monstrous opponents.
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_EMETSELCH_000_010: Hermes said he would not be long, yes? Then we shall wait here until he emerges...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_EMETSELCH_000_020: Ugh, this is an exercise in futility... You have to be the one to find her, ! Follow her voice!
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_HYTHLODAEUS_000_025: If I cannot perceive her aether, what else have I to offer but my rousing support!? Ahh, Hermes truly is a master of his craft...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_VENAS_000_030: I've strained my senses to their limits, but found nothing. You must calm your mind, that you might hear it─that you might feel her silent voice!
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_HERMES_000_035: Meteion! Where are you!? Please, answer me! What has happened to you? To your sisters...?
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_SYSTEM_000_040: You calm your mind, your senses questing for any hint of Meteion's presence...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_SYSTEM_000_041: ...But you fail to hear her voice. She must be elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_METEION_000_045: (-Meteion-)It seeps...into my mind... Our voices... Reporting...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_METEION_000_046: (-Meteion-)No, no! Hermes mustn't hear them! I have to run...to hide...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_SYSTEM_000_047: Meteion's anguished voice grows distant as the source seems to flee down the slope...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_SYSTEM_000_050: You strain to catch even the faintest whisper, but fail to hear Meteion's voice. She must be elsewhere...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_METEION_000_057: Oh...oh no, we can't tell them that! We must run... Run far away!
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_SYSTEM_000_059: Meteion's anguished voice fades as you sense her climbing to the top of the ridge...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_METEION_000_070: (-Meteion-)How...? How did it come to this...?
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_METEION_000_071: (-Meteion-)Is this the reason we traveled to the stars? Why we sought out other life-forms?
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_METEION_000_072: (-Meteion-)Is this it? Is this the answer!? No, it cannot be...it cannot be!
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_SYSTEM_000_073: Meteion's anguished voice drifts away to the south...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_METEION_000_080: (-???-)Compiling report for dissemination to Hermes and all peoples of Etheirys...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_METEION_000_081: Processing expedition data... Preparing profiles on intelligent civilizations...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_SYSTEM_000_086: Meteion's anguished voice flees towards the lake...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_EMETSELCH_000_088: Panicked and confused... Which will make it all the more difficult to predict her movements.
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_VENAS_000_089: Hermes. What do you make of this situation?
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_HERMES_000_090: The Meteia are linked to a single mind─a shared consciousness which connects them across any distance. I suspect something has happened which disrupted its usual harmony...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_VENAS_000_091: How might we access this shared consciousness of theirs?
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_HERMES_000_092: Much as you would approach any sentient being: directly.
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_HERMES_000_093: In the Meteia's case, that means speaking to any incarnation within physical reach.
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_VENAS_000_094: So unless we can track down the Meteion we just lost, we have no means to communicate with them...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_VENAS_000_095: No way of knowing what befell her sisters; no way to provide directions or guidance.
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_EMETSELCH_000_096: Then we had best set our musings aside, and concentrate on how we might find her!
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_EMETSELCH_000_100: A frantic search will avail us little. We must be clever about this...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_HYTHLODAEUS_000_105: 'Tis a shame there is no registered concept we could use to create another Meteion. Assuming of course we could link her to the shared mind! But no, if it were a viable solution, Hermes would have surely suggested it...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_VENAS_000_110: In the Final Days, aether is twisted by the invasion of dynamis from beyond the star, its progress intensified by feelings of fear and despair and anguish...
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_VENAS_000_111: Nay, I like not the picture which emerges with these latest pieces.
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_HERMES_000_120: Oh, my dear Meteion... What did you witness out there that frightened you so?
TEXT_AKTKME117_04435_HERMES_000_121: Why do you seek to keep it from us? How terrible could it possibly be...?
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_000: A frantic search will avail us little. We must be clever about this...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_VENAS_000_005: In the Final Days, aether is twisted by the invasion of dynamis from beyond the star, its progress intensified by feelings of fear and despair and anguish...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_VENAS_000_006: Nay, I like not the picture which emerges with these latest pieces.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_HERMES_000_010: My apologies, I... We should focus on the task at hand.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_HYTHLODAEUS_000_020: Correct me if I'm wrong, but Meteion renders herself invisible by matching her aetheric density to that of her surroundings, does she not?
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_HYTHLODAEUS_000_021: If so, could we not then disrupt her concealment with a surfeit of aether? Much how Emet-Selch solidified your presence when first we met you!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_022: Don't be absurd. I can hardly channel aether to a recipient whose whereabouts are hidden from me.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_HYTHLODAEUS_000_023: Which is why we must all work together.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_HYTHLODAEUS_000_024: will continue the search in the same manner as before, but this time with you in tow. Once  ascertains Meteion's likely location, you proceed to reveal our wayward familiar with a swift aetherial downpour!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_VENAS_000_025: Very clever. And thankfully, she has made herself easier to capture by fleeing towards Lethe.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_VENAS_000_026: Assuming she is made visible, it should prove no great feat to herd her into a corner.
