TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_HYTHLODAEUS_000_027: Then we have our plan.  and Emet-Selch will be our tracker and trapper respectively, while we others predict and obstruct Meteion's avenues of escape.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_HYTHLODAEUS_000_028: Emet-Selch and I will keep an eye on each other's aether to help coordinate our efforts. Let us be about it!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_029: ...Well, it seems we are partners for the time being. Let us return to where we last saw Meteion and pick up the trail from there.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_030: I will keep myself in a state of preparedness, ready to rain down aether at a moment's notice─meaning it falls to you to keep the way clear.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_SYSTEM_000_031: Emet-Selch is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_SYSTEM_000_032: You can leave Emet-Selch behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_SYSTEM_000_033: If you wish to have Emet-Selch accompany you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_045: Now, did Meteion go straight ahead towards the pier...or did she stray from the path somewhere?
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_046: As the only one who can hear her voice, you will need to take the lead.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_Q2_000_050: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Emet-Selch?
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_051: Aren't you the one who went to all the trouble of traveling into the past to avert an impending apocalypse? But fine, fine, be my guest! I will await you at the entrance to Lethe.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_055: The would-be savior of Etheirys past and future returns. After you, my good hero.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_SYSTEM_000_060: Emet-Selch has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_SYSTEM_000_070: You should have Emet-Selch accompanying you before you attempt to reveal Meteion.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_SYSTEM_000_075: You calm your mind, your senses questing for any hint of Meteion's presence...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_SYSTEM_000_076: ...But you fail to hear her voice. She must be elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_077: Nothing this way? We try another route, then.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_METEION_000_080: (-Meteion-)Why can't I fly? Are my functions being restricted!?
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_METEION_000_081: (-Meteion-)Hide─yes, I'll just have to hide, then. Where no one can find me...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_SYSTEM_000_082: Meteion's anguished voice heads towards the water's edge...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_083: She went into the lake!? As if this wasn't tiresome enough...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_084: Well, at least that open expanse should make her easier to find. We won't lose her this time!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_090: Ugh. The indignation, to drag my robe through the water. Hythlodaeus better not breathe a word of this to Azem...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_091: Still, mild humiliation will be the least of our concerns if we fail to get our hands on Meteion!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_095: We should be able to reach the bottom of this drop by climbing down the rocks at the water's edge.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_096: Do not even think of dragging me over the falls. Final Days or no, if I end up drenched from head to toe, I swear I will feed you to a remora.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_METEION_000_100: Not here... I'm not here... Please...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_101: By that rock, is she? Very well!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_A3_000_104: There's no need to run, Meteion!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_A3_000_105: We will hear your report, good or bad!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_METEION_000_106: ...? What are you saying? Everything is so faint...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_METEION_000_107: I'm sorry... I'm not strong enough. Stay away. I'm begging you...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_METEION_000_108: Don't make me say it. It will break him. His poor, fragile heart...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_110: Once the others are in position, the two of us can herd her into their midst!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_120: Keep after Meteion! Hythlodaeus and I will coordinate our movements!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_125: Is this neus not in use? It seems to have been left to the mercy of the elements...
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_126: Either way, it bears no trace of Meteion's essence. We move on!
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_SYSTEM_000_129: You should have Emet-Selch accompanying you before attempting to herd Meteion towards Hythlodaeus and the others.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_140: Now, where to close the trap...?
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_VENAS_000_155: If all Hermes means to do is listen to Meteion's report, then it is his right to do so.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_VENAS_000_156: But once he receives the answers to his question, what then? The fate of the world may very well hinge upon the choice he makes in that moment...and we must be there when he makes it.
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_160: Why, Hermes? Why could you not leave well enough alone!?
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_161: Will these answers assuage the pain you feel when a creation is returned to aether?
TEXT_AKTKME118_04436_EMETSELCH_000_162: Had you never cast your accursed question to the distant stars, you may have one day learned to be at peace upon this one...
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_EMETSELCH_000_000: Do you understand why Hermes would do this? His logic escapes me entirely...
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_005: If all Hermes means to do is listen to Meteion's report, then it is his right to do so.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_006: But once he receives the answers to his question, what then? The fate of the world may very well hinge upon the choice he makes in that moment...and we must be there when he makes it.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_011: Considering the expansive dimensions of the place, even we may have a difficult time locating his aether. All I can say is that he entered from the rooftop, and likely arrived at the uppermost point in the facility.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_EMETSELCH_000_013: Of course we pursue him. No matter what Hermes might be thinking, Meteion is a potential threat that needs to be brought under our control.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_EMETSELCH_000_014: The Convocation's duty to safeguard this star takes precedence over any personal stake in the matter.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_016: 'Tis clear we stand on a precipice, but we have yet to determine beyond a shadow of a doubt that Meteion's is the hand which tips us over the edge.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_017: Nevertheless, if we are to learn the truth of the Final Days, we must give chase. And even if neither Hermes nor Meteion is ultimately responsible, we cannot leave them to suffer this torment alone.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_018: Agreed on all counts. To Ktisis Hyperboreia we go!
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_EMETSELCH_000_020: I mislike the look of this...
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_025: Judging from the crowd, something is afoot.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYPERBOREIASTAFF_00: I saw naught out of the ordinary. Does anyone know what caused it?
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_041: Excuse me, has something happened inside Ktisis?
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYPERBOREIASTAFF_00: Mistress Venat! I'm so glad you're here!
No one knows what prompted it, but the alarum was sounded and Ktisis put into a state of alert.
Procedure dictated that we evacuate immediately, and we have yet to investigate further...
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_046: And what does this “state of alert” entail exactly?
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYPERBOREIASTAFF_00: A field of dampening magick is draped over the entire facility, usually in response to escaped entities and the like.
Ktisis scholars and observers are unaffected, but everything─and everyone─else is weakened to a fraction of their usual capabilities.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_049: Then consider us forewarned. We do, however, have urgent business with Chief Hermes, and must enter the premises regardless.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_050: ...That said, if Hermes is willing to enact such measures, I wonder what other obstacles he has seen fit to drop in our path.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_051: With that enfeebling spell in place, we're not like to be at our fighting best.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_052: And I was hardly an effective combatant to begin with! I've little to offer beyond my aetherial vision.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_EMETSELCH_000_053: Then you will put that talent of yours to good use. You were fairly skilled at spotting weaknesses, if I recall.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_054: “Fairly skilled”? Now you've gone and raised everyone's expectations...
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_055: You all need only make the most of your strengths, and I will fill in the gaps as required.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_056: I was once Azem, after all. 'Twas my job to rise to the occasion─be that as defender, aggressor, or healer.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_057: I feel better about my lack of prowess already!
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_058: And you, Emet-Selch, can impress us with your arcane majesty. You lob potent spells as easily as breathing, but can also channel that power in a protective manner if you so choose, yes?
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_EMETSELCH_000_059: Eh!? Well, yes, should the situation call for it...
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_060: Excellent! That should cover us on all fronts.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_061: Your tale led us here, , so 'tis only right that you lead us now. No matter what lies ahead, we will win through to Hermes and Meteion.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_062: And then we will face the future together!
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_A1_000_072: Form a party and enter Ktisis Hyperboreia.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_EMETSELCH_000_080: From the moment we met you, our visit has devolved into a never-ending series of complications and irritations. In spite of this, I have gained one useful thing:
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_EMETSELCH_000_081: An awareness of dynamis. To think that a power with the potential to corrupt aether had largely escaped our notice...
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_EMETSELCH_000_082: Whether or not I believe your tale, the facts underpinning your narrative will be the source of much debate.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_EMETSELCH_000_083: So understand that I act not for the sake of you or your fantastical quest. My duty demands that I apprehend Meteion─and if that now means Hermes as well, then so be it.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_085: I said that Hermes was likely perched somewhere at the highest point of the facility, but reaching him will be no mean feat.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_086: To put it simply, Ktisis Hyperboreia contains a multitude of vast spaces linked together at the seams, meaning the interior is far more massive than even this grand structure might otherwise suggest.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYTHLODAEUS_000_087: But even a colossal facility filled top to bottom with savage creations will not stop you─not with Venat and Emet-Selch at your side. And I will be there too, of course, cheering you on!
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_090: Bleak as the contents of Meteion's report might be, many could hear it and remain content with their lives.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_091: But not Hermes. For him, the veneer of perfection has long been cracked, and it was to the distant heavens he looked for the means to repair it.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_092: I understand his anguish after a fashion─my own refusal to return is in opposition to the world's established order.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_093: Yet for me, the imperfections only enhance the fragile beauty of our star. I will fight to see it delivered from destruction, warts and all.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_HYPERBOREIASTAFF_00: I will not seek to impede such an august company from going about its business. But please, do be aware that many of the specimens within are far from docile.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_110: Are you feeling at all recovered? I understand that your exertions were more than purely physical, but resting one's body, if only for a moment, is never without merit.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_111: As for Hermes... I think it unlikely he will create more entelechies.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_112: He poured much of himself into Meteion, and now that she and her sisters are gone─dissipated, in his mind─the grief must be unbearable.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_113: He will blame himself. He will believe that, had he never acknowledged his dissatisfaction with the world, then the Meteia would have never been born to suffer and die.
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_VENAS_000_114: The offer to join the Fourteen will be a welcome distraction, and one day hence, he will face the advent of the Final Days in the role of Fandaniel...
TEXT_AKTKME119_04437_SYSTEM_000_115: You may now enter Ktisis Hyperboreia with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_VENAS_000_000: , listen to me. Our duty now is not to denounce Hermes for his misguided determination, or to convince Emet-Selch and Hythlodaeus that they have been deceived.
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_VENAS_000_001: No, we must instead ensure that the experiences Hermes sought to expunge are preserved.
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_VENAS_000_002: What remains in our memories alone will be our weapon against the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_VENAS_000_003: You must fight this battle in your age, and I in mine...
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_VENAS_000_004: Come, let us walk together once more. I will see you to the doors of Propylaion.
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_SYSTEM_000_005: Your time in this age is drawing to an end.
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_SYSTEM_000_006: Upon speaking to Venat, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_SYSTEM_000_007: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_Q1_000_010: Continue with the main scenario quest?
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_TATARU_000_020: You've a knack for turning up exactly when needed, and this is no exception!
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_KRILE_000_031: I'd heard you were off in the First as part of our efforts to investigate the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_KRILE_000_032: Well, as so often seems to be the case, while you were away, we've had some few developments...
TEXT_AKTKME120_04438_KRILE_000_033: ...Which we can discuss in just a moment. For now, however, I cannot tell you how wonderful it is to have you back!
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_TATARU_000_000: You've a knack for turning up exactly when needed, and this is no exception!
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_010: So, have you learned aught more of the Final Days?
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_011: Then the journey was well worth the risk. No doubt your newfound knowledge will be a great boon to us all.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_012: Unfortunately, during your time on the First, events here have taken a turn for the worse.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_013: The Scions are running themselves ragged trying to contain the spread of blasphemies, but it's a losing battle.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_TATARU_000_014: To try and ascertain the where and why of it, Alisaie and Alphinaud have been traveling all over...
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_TATARU_000_015: Of all the regions they've visited, Locus Amoenus is one of the worst affected.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_TATARU_000_016: Thancred, Estinien, and G'raha took a detachment of allied soldiers there to offer aid and succor to those in need.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_TATARU_000_017: But the province is vast. They only managed to visit a handful of coastal villages! It was an accomplishment worth celebrating, still, but a drop in the bucket at best...
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_018: In the meantime, Y'shtola and Master Matoya have been making a concerted effort to establish contact with Hydaelyn in the aetherial sea, but to no avail.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_019: As for Tataru and I, we've been keeping a close eye on the Forum.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_020: From what we gather, they've been constructing a vessel to ferry people to the moon. An ambitious project that has likely been years, if not decades in the making. However, since we've seen no sign of it thus far, I suspect it's still incomplete.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_021: You will also recall the proposal issued by Master Fourchenault to the people of Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_022: Following their discussion, Vrtra declared his support for the plan and urged those who wished to evacuate to accept the Forum's invitation.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_023: So far, so good. But that's where things get a little strange...
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_024: Apparently, the Forum caught wind of the lunar teleporter in the Tower of Babil, and decided to use it to deliver people to the moon instead of their mysterious ship.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_TATARU_000_025: Therefore, to secure safe passage for the Hannish refugees to the tower, Alphinaud, Alisaie, Estinien, and G'raha traveled to Garlemald not long ago.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_TATARU_000_026: Trouble is, the capital was hardly the safest place to begin with, and now...
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_027: ...The Final Days have come to Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_028: Shortly after our friends arrived, they were sent to rendezvous with Master Fourchenault. Then, panic broke out, and our communications were severed.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_029: From what fragments we were able to make out before the linkshell went completely silent, we can only assume the phenomenon has spread to the capital.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_030: The others need you, . Please, you must help them!
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_031: Having you there will make all the difference. I'm sure of it.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_TATARU_000_032: Camp Broken Glass was their first port of call, so you'd best start there.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_TATARU_000_033: Hopefully, Lucia will know where they are!
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_034: There's no telling what you'll be walking into, so you had best take every possible precaution.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_KRILE_000_040: I'll be sure to let Thancred and Y'shtola know you're back. At least they're still responding to their linkpearls.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_TATARU_000_045: It pains me to send you off alone into unknown peril after you've only just returned, but Twelve willing, you won't be alone for long.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_LUCIA_000_050: ... And not a moment too soon.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_LUCIA_000_051: The skies over Garlemald are ablaze, but it's events on the ground that concern me.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_LUCIA_000_052: As you will have heard, your fellow Scions arrived ahead of you.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_LUCIA_000_053: We cut the customary greetings short after we received word from our troops on the Magna Glacies that the Forum's airship had landed.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_LUCIA_000_054: It was then that the heavens began to burn...
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_LUCIA_000_055: I dispatched your friends at once to ensure the refugees come to no harm.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_LUCIA_000_056: I would have you join them immediately. Additional support is en route, but we will discuss them later. I trust you are ready to depart?
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_SYSTEM_000_057:
Upon departing for the Magna Glacies, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_SYSTEM_000_058: In addition, you will be required to participate in battle. Your progress will be saved at certain points. In the event that you are defeated, you will be able to try again from the most recent of these.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_SYSTEM_000_059: Please note that if you enter battles associated with other quests or log out from the game, this progress will be lost.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_SYSTEM_000_060: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 88 or above to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_ALPHINAUD_000_070: That the Final Days should manifest here too, after everything these people have suffered, is a fate cruel beyond words.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Nevertheless, with allies old and new at our side, there is yet reason to be hopeful.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_GRAHATIA_000_075: Though there'll be time later to discuss your journey to the First, there is one thing I must ask.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_GRAHATIA_000_076: Did you perchance speak with our friends in the Crystarium?
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_GRAHATIA_000_077: Lyna and Beq Lugg both warn me against overexerting myself?
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_GRAHATIA_000_078: Strange that they would express such similar sentiments─identical, in fact─but their advice is duly noted.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_ESTINIEN_000_080: We couldn't save them all, but if we'd arrived any later, it would've been a massacre.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_ESTINIEN_000_081: Things were looking bleak until you and the Ist turned up.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_FOURCHENAULT_000_08: This is the contingent's base of operations, I take it?
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_LUCIA_000_090: At the very least, I am glad our own members are accounted for.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_JULLUS_000_095: It's been a while since last we spoke. For some time, I was...not myself.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_JULLUS_000_096: Lucia and the others told me what happened that night...and about the events that took place while I was receiving treatment.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_JULLUS_000_097: It was only then that I realized the lengths you and yours go to... I know I might never be able to repay you, but I'll be damned if I don't try.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_JULLUS_000_098: And most of all... I want to thank you. All of you. For everything you've done and continue to do for the sake of my people.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_ALISAIE_000_100: To see Zenos standing there, so uncaring and unrepentant. Gods, I don't know what came over me.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_ALISAIE_000_101: I just blurted out the first thing that came to mind. But looking back on it...I stand by those words.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_ALISAIE_000_102: I would say I hope they won't incite him to further villainy, but to be honest, I doubt he even remembers what I said.
TEXT_AKTKMF101_04439_ALISAIE_000_103: Anyway, enough about all that. It's good to see you again!
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_000: That the Final Days should manifest here too, after everything these people have suffered, is a fate cruel beyond words.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Nevertheless, with allies old and new at our side, there is yet reason to be hopeful.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALISAIE_000_005: We still need to quiz you about your time on the First, if we ever get more than a moment's respite.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_010: Though there'll be time later to discuss your journey to the First, there is one thing I must ask.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_011: Did you perchance speak with our friends in the Crystarium?
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_012: Lyna and Beq Lugg both warn me against overexerting myself?
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_013: Strange that they would express such similar sentiments─identical, in fact─but their advice is duly noted.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ESTINIEN_000_015: We couldn't save them all, but if we'd arrived any later, it would've been a massacre.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ESTINIEN_000_016: Things were looking bleak until you and the Ist turned up.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_FOURCHENAULT_000_02: This is the contingent's base of operations, I take it?
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_JULLUS_000_025: It's been a while since last we spoke. For some time, I was...not myself.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_JULLUS_000_026: Lucia and the others told me what happened that night...and about the events that took place while I was receiving treatment.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_JULLUS_000_027: It was only then that I realized the lengths you and yours go to... I know I might never be able to repay you, but I'll be damned if I don't try.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_JULLUS_000_028: And most of all... I want to thank you. All of you. For everything you've done and continue to do for the sake of my people.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_URIANGER_000_030: I daresay Master Fourchenault was as nonplussed as we to learn the identity of Hydaelyn's lunar custodians. As he will soon discover, they have much and more to offer the Forum.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_URIANGER_000_031: Might I suggest we return to the annex forthwith?
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_URIANGER_000_032: We may yet have time to discuss thy recent adventures ere we are summoned to the Rostra.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_THANCRED_000_040: Not that I'm complaining, Urianger, but I wasn't expecting to see you quite so soon.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_URIANGER_000_041: Nor I thee. In extolling the virtues of Etheirys, I did inadvertently awaken in the Loporrits a desire to avert our beloved star's demise.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_042: Krile tells us you have obtained new knowledge that may aid us in our ongoing efforts.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_043: I've news to share regarding our study of the aetherial sea, but your findings are certain to be of greater interest, and so I would rather hear them first.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_044: To what revelations did Hydaelyn's Elpis flower lead?
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_045: Then this “dynamis” is what drives the Final Days...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_046: If it and akasa are one and the same, this all but proves Nidhana's theory.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_047: Were an entity, through sheer force of emotion, to channel this vast, dormant reservoir into a raging river...its power might surpass even that of aether.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALISAIE_000_048: But if our star is so replete with aether, said entity would need to be outside its influence to effectively manipulate the dynamis of the great expanse.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_050: Or rather, the sorrow and suffering of fallen civilizations that she has been hoarding for millennia...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_051: Untold anguish and fear and hatred, drawn from every corner of the universe... All for a single purpose: the destruction of Etheirys.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ESTINIEN_000_052: Then our foe is no longer some unknowable calamity.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ESTINIEN_000_053: We have but one aim─to defeat Meteion.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_054: You make it sound so simple...but you're not wrong.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_055: Vanquish Meteion and we deliver the world from the Final Days. But to even attempt it, there are two conditions.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_056: First, we must determine her location.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_057: Before Meteion escaped, an enchantment was placed upon her by Venat. The woman who would become Hydaelyn.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_058: The implications of temporal magicks are not entirely understood, and so we cannot assume that our Hydaelyn and the Venat you met in Elpis are one and the same. Nevertheless, due to Her intrinsic qualities as an all-powerful being, I'd wager that Hydaelyn possesses the knowledge we seek.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_059: Whether She would share that knowledge with us, however, remains to be seen.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_060: After all, She intends for us to flee Etheirys, not to stay.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_KRILE_000_061: Do you suppose She has abandoned Her pursuit of Meteion?
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_A1_000_063: The Venat I know would never give up.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_A1_000_064: No, but Meteion is still out there.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_KRILE_000_065: That's my impression, too. Otherwise, She wouldn't have used me as a conduit for Her will, or provided clues such as the Elpis flower.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_KRILE_000_066: Aye, though not for lack of trying on Hydaelyn's part. Surely, that's why She used me as a conduit for Her will, and provided clues such as the Elpis flower.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_KRILE_000_067: I believe She has been waiting...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_070: We must find a means to reach Meteion.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_071: Naturally, our chosen method will depend entirely upon wheresoever she has made her nest.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_THANCRED_000_072: Then communing with Hydaelyn must by necessity come first.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_THANCRED_000_073: Did you and Master Matoya have any luck with your investigation into the aetherial sea?
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_074: Sadly not. Though we enlisted the help of Arenvald and other Echo-blessed allies, we couldn't detect so much as a whisper from Hydaelyn, even from within the Antitower.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_075: Master Matoya is of the opinion that in the years since abandoning it, the Forum has found some other method of receiving instructions from Hydaelyn.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_076: If so, it would most likely be some form of apparatus for observing the aetherial sea, built closer to home.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_0: (-Ojika Tsunjika-)Sorry to interrupt, we've just received word from the Forum.
(-Ojika Tsunjika-)Your presence is required in the Rostra, where they intend to discuss the great exodus.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALISAIE_000_079: Then Father was able to persuade them!
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_080: They're finally taking us seriously. Let's hear what they have to say.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Father has granted us the opportunity we've been waiting for.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_091: Though we know not what information─if any─they intend to reveal, there's only one way to find out. To the Rostra!
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALISAIE_000_095: Well, that was a much quicker response than I was expecting. Nice to know our efforts on the Magna Glacies didn't go unnoticed.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_THANCRED_000_100: After sending G'raha and Estinien back to Garlemald, I stayed in Locus Amoenus for a time. Being an imperial province, it was already in turmoil before the onset of the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_THANCRED_000_101: You wouldn't believe the difficulties we had overseeing the evacuation of the villages we visited. I have faith the detachment we left behind will continue our work and shepherd the people to safety. To what safety can be found in a world coming to an end.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_URIANGER_000_105: 'Twas Hydaelyn's commandment that in the event Zodiark should perish, the Loporrits were to deliver the people of Etheirys from harm.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_URIANGER_000_106: Though that be the limit of their duties, they possess knowledge unparalleled of the great expanse and the means of its traversal.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_URIANGER_000_107: Should they be persuaded to assist in our efforts to reach Meteion, we would do well to heed their counsel.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_110: Master Matoya has suspected for some time that the Forum has been constructing a new facility for the purpose of surveying the aetherial sea.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_111: Of course, as the custodian of the Antitower, which would presumably be rendered obsolete as a result, she has a few things to say about that. Nothing that should be repeated in polite company, you understand.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_115: To think the Crystal Tower of the First is capable of such feats as sending one's soul into the distant past...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_116: The events you witnessed─and helped shape─may yet hold the key to forestalling the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_117: I'm reminded of dear friends in a future I unmade. Whose selfless efforts saw the Eighth Umbral Calamity averted...in this timeline, at least. Too much has been sacrificed for us to abandon Etheirys now.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ESTINIEN_000_120: At first, I wasn't sure what to make of Hermes and his motives.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ESTINIEN_000_121: But it's like we discussed at the Great Work. When faced with the harsh realities of life, some seek the release of death. Others grow defiant. They fight.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ESTINIEN_000_122: Either way, it is our right to choose.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_KRILE_000_125: After you left for Garlemald, I went to Labyrinthos and tried to reach Hydaelyn using the Elpis flowers.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_KRILE_000_126: Alas, my attempts were in vain. I can only assume that She spent a vast amount of Her power in the confrontation with Fandaniel and is presently unable to communicate.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_KRILE_000_127: Indeed, as Her presence left my body, I could feel how faint it had grown...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_TATARU_000_130: I hope you don't mind me staying behind while you attend your big meeting.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_TATARU_000_131: The Rostra reminds me a bit too much of the Supremely Scary Tribunal in Ishgard. You'll forgive me if I keep my distance...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_THEROSTRAGUIDE04440: The Forum is in session, and as such, the Rostra is closed to visitors.
A Scion of the Seventh Dawn? Very well, you may wait in the corridor.

Of course, entry will only be permitted on the condition you leave your armaments at the door. Lest you forget, this sacred institution holds rational discourse in the highest; the implements of war are expressly forbidden.
I suggest you make your way inside. The Forum takes a rather dim view of lateness.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALISAIE_000_160: While I very much take issue with the Forum's approach to selecting whom to save and when, they're not wrong for wanting to minimize potential conflicts.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALISAIE_000_161: Fortunately, if this plan of ours actually works, the great exodus itself will become entirely unnecessary...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_THANCRED_000_165: My affinity for espionage may have earned me the title of Archon, but I was completely unaware of the Forum's plans. There may have been clues here and there, had I been of a mind to look for them...but contemplating that possibility only serves to further wound my pride.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_THANCRED_000_166: Not that anyone could have realistically surmised that their brilliant stratagem was to build a giant ship, fly to the moon─a still-larger vessel in truth─and use that to travel to another star. Even now, the whole idea seems positively absurd when spoken aloud.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_URIANGER_000_170: Of late, I have seen no sign of the Loporrits...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_URIANGER_000_171: This being their first opportunity to experience the wonders of Sharlayan, the potential for misadventure is nigh infinite...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_YSHTOLA_000_175: I'm a little vexed that we've yet to learn of the Forum's replacement for the Antitower, though I expect that in time, they'll share that too with us─and with Master Matoya, if they've any sense.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_180: The further we pursue the mysteries of the universe, the more I struggle to comprehend the fortuitous nature of time itself.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_181: We measure and quantify it based on observations of celestial bodies, such as the sun and moon, but from your account it is unclear whether the ancients viewed time in a similar manner...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_182: I mention this because while Venat knew the Final Days would reoccur at a defined point in the future, she presumably had no way of knowing exactly when.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_GRAHATIA_000_183: Even so, the completion of the Forum's preparations to escape to the moon aligning so closely with the advent of the Final Days is surely no coincidence...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ESTINIEN_000_185: Perhaps if Midgardsormr were still alive─in the traditional sense, that is─he could have offered to help the vessel attain the necessary speeds.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ESTINIEN_000_186: Then again, there's no guarantee his contribution would make enough of a difference to matter.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_KRILE_000_190: Phew... I'll admit, bringing up the issue of the Forum's incomplete ark was more than a little daunting.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_KRILE_000_191: They were, to their credit, quite open about the current state of affairs. What was even more surprising, though, was when they took Alphinaud up on his offer!
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_FOURCHENAULT_000_19: Rest assured, I have every intention of honoring the Forum's decision.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_200: Sorry about not letting the rest of you in on my plan. I was, admittedly, thinking on my feet for the most part.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_201: But since we require both a means of communing with Hydaelyn and reaching Meteion...
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_202: ...In the spur of the moment, I saw involving ourselves with the completion of the ark as a way to work towards both objectives simultaneously.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_203: However, we must first keep our end of the bargain by solving the problem of the aetherburner.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_204: I'd like to think it is not a challenge beyond our combined expertise. Or at least the expertise of our extended circle of associates.
TEXT_AKTKMF102_04440_ALPHINAUD_000_205: It might behoove us to learn how an aetherburner actually works before we attempt to improve it, though!
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_000: As Father seems so eager to help, maybe we can have him educate us about the aetherburner.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALISAIE_000_005: While I very much take issue with the Forum's approach to selecting whom to save and when, they're not wrong for wanting to minimize potential conflicts.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALISAIE_000_006: Fortunately, if this plan of ours actually works, the great exodus itself will become entirely unnecessary...

There may have been clues here and there, had I been of a mind to look for them...but contemplating that possibility only serves to further wound my pride.

Even now, the whole idea seems positively absurd when spoken aloud.

TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ESTINIEN_000_030: Perhaps if Midgardsormr were still alive─in the traditional sense, that is─he could have offered to help the vessel attain the necessary speeds.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ESTINIEN_000_031: Then again, there's no guarantee his contribution would make enough of a difference to matter.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KRILE_000_035: Phew... I'll admit, bringing up the issue of the Forum's incomplete ark was more than a little daunting.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KRILE_000_036: They were, to their credit, quite open about the current state of affairs. What was even more surprising, though, was when they took Alphinaud up on his offer!
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_FOURCHENAULT_000_04: As instructed, I shall take you to see the aetherburner.
Meet me outside the Archeion. I trust you can make your own way there.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_042: So the ark is being built in Labyrinthos. Hardly surprising. Where else could they conceal such a massive undertaking...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Where once we were refused entry, we are now welcomed as guests...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALISAIE_000_055: It seems so long ago we first set foot here.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_THANCRED_000_060: Some would surely object to the Forum allowing “foreign elements” to have the run of their secret facilities. We should count ourselves lucky.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_URIANGER_000_065: Among the many and varied documents sent to the moon, I did chance upon several inventories made in the Archeion.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_URIANGER_000_066: Mayhap the Forum believed such records would provide insight into the intricacies of clerical duties. Regardless, the Loporrits did not consider them worthy of more than a cursory glance.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_YSHTOLA_000_070: That we have been granted permission to enter the lower levels is proof of our increased standing. Would that they had been willing to confide in us sooner...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_GRAHATIA_000_075: It has been many moons since I last visited Labyrinthos. As vast as the archives were back then, they've only continued to grow in the days since.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ESTINIEN_000_080: I don't understand the appeal of reshaping it to look like the world above. Make your peace with what it is, or go outside if that's what you prefer.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KRILE_000_085: Do they intend to carry everything in the Archeion to the moon? They said they'd started loading scientific records and biological samples, but do they really need all of it?
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_FOURCHENAULT_000_09: Our destination lies in the lower levels.
The Forum, in its wisdom, has granted you access to the Archeion's lift.
Step inside and have Ophilyne take you to the Medial Circuit.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_OPHILYNE_000_095: You wish to use the lift, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_FOURCHENAULT_000_10: I have sent your associates ahead to Logistikon Alpha, on the other side of Meryall Agronomics.
Actually...there is something I have been meaning to...
...No, never mind. It can wait. Let us attend to the matter at hand.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_150: We are to wait here while our father arranges for us to use the next lift.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_151: “Here” being Logistikon Alpha, where the atmospheric conditions of Labyrinthos are regulated.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_152: Water is drawn from underground and dispersed as vapor, stimulating the formation of artificial clouds and rain.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_153: By manipulating the temperature and air circulation, they are able to create the ideal environment for the growth and preservation of the biological samples kept here.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALISAIE_000_154: Hold on. How do you know so much about it?
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_155: Why, Father brought me here as a child.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_157: Actually, you're the one who left me behind, when you went off somewhere with Grandfather.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_158: The night before, I'd been asking Father how clouds are made, so he decided to show me. It was fascinating─I peppered him with questions the entire time.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_URIANGER_000_159: 'Tis all too easy to take for granted the many interweaving aspects of the natural world. To grow inured to the wondrous.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_URIANGER_000_160: But having gained an understanding of the complex mechanisms employed by the Loporrits in recreating a similar environment, I have come to view such processes in a new light.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_URIANGER_000_161: The subterranean gardens of Labyrinthos, the lunar prison forged to contain the ancient Zodiark, the habitations built for all mankind 'neath the moon's surface... Each unique, yet undeniably similar.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_FOURCHENAULT_000_16: Ever since Hydaelyn unfolded to us the grim fate that awaits Etheirys, every essential resource we could spare has been delivered to Labyrinthos, in preparation for the great exodus. But that is not all...
It is also a testing ground for the technologies that will allow us to settle on distant stars.
Though the Loporrits have endeavored to make the moon inhabitable, that is not our final destination. Mankind must learn to propagate life where there is none, to thrive where all is barren.
Alas, time is not on our side.
I have arranged for you all to enter the Central Circuit. It is there that most of our preparations for the great exodus are carried out, the construction of the ark among them.

Though our plans have been made public, access remains highly restricted. You, however, will not be subject to said restrictions, and will have free rein to come and go as you please. Such was the will of the Forum, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_169: We will prove ourselves worthy of their trust. Your trust.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_HESTER_000_180: By decree of the Forum, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn are permitted to enter the Central Circuit.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_190: This is it... The Central Circuit!
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALISAIE_000_195: Please tell me we're almost there... Or is there another underground level we have to reach? The Even-more-central Circuit, perhaps?
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_THANCRED_000_200: The farther down we travel, the more expansive the sky above becomes, artificial though it is.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_THANCRED_000_201: Would that the heavens elsewhere could be so idyllic...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_URIANGER_000_205: The temperate environment here is not unlike that of Bestways Burrow, though the diverse vegetation doth produce a far more complex bouquet of aromas. A welcome difference indeed, for I have grown weary of the scent of carrots...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_YSHTOLA_000_210: I imagine the secrets kept here would be of great benefit to mine own research, but I will refrain from indulging my curiosity for the time being.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_GRAHATIA_000_215: The sooner we can get a look at this aetherburner of theirs, the sooner we can start working out how to improve it!
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ESTINIEN_000_220: I have no idea what makes Alphinaud so confident we can solve this problem of theirs. Relentless optimism, I presume. A not-unwelcome trait in a youth...but less so in a gambler. Aye─let us resolve never to let him set foot in the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KRILE_000_225: We might finally have the chance to commune directly with Hydaelyn...provided we somehow manage to succeed where Sharlayan's finest engineers have failed. Still, it won't hurt to have a look!
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_HESTER_000_230: Do you wish to enter the Central Circuit?
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_FOURCHENAULT_000_24: The aetherburner is being constructed not far from here.
Overseeing the work is Kokkol Dankkol, after whom the forge is named.
Once the necessary introductions have been made, I shall leave you with him to discuss the particulars. This way.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_250: Perhaps you'd like to break the ice?
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_THANCRED_000_230: For a closely guarded secret, you can see practically everything from outside, even with the magical barrier surrounding it...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_URIANGER_000_235: Surely the Forum hath already petitioned the aid of the Loporrits, given their familiarity with such technologies...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_YSHTOLA_000_240: While many of the facilities within the Central Circuit seem to be visible from the upper levels, the more secretive work must be carried out behind closed doors.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_GRAHATIA_000_245: He hasn't even realized we're here... Or perhaps he has realized, but just doesn't care.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ESTINIEN_000_250: I was expecting the Skysteel Manufactory, but instead I find the village smithy...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KRILE_000_255: He looks lost in thought, although it seems he's hit something of a stumbling block...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_FOURCHENAULT_000_26: This is the man we seek. Do try not to startle him...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_270: There are no oaths or contracts binding the members of the Ilsabard contingent, and in many ways, it was even more loosely organized than the Crystal Braves.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_271: Nevertheless, I knew none would refuse this call to arms. Truly, we have been blessed with trustworthy and dependable allies.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALISAIE_000_275: Though Bahamut is long gone, the internment hulks are far from safe.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALISAIE_000_276: It could be much worse, of course. They won't have to fight their way past Meracydian dragons, nor is there any danger the elder primal might be summoned again.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALISAIE_000_277: Even so, I daresay there are still a fair few Allagan creations and contraptions remaining to bar our friends' way. I only hope that Grandfather watches over them.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALISAIE_000_280: Well, I'm all for relying on the power of friendship, but we're now left with the rare luxury of having nothing to do. There must be something that requires our attention!
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_THANCRED_000_285: First the Telophoroi, and now the Final Days. Heh─no one can accuse the Ilsabard contingent of backing down from a challenge!
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_THANCRED_000_286: Of course, they weren't all so committed to the cause when we first set out.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_THANCRED_000_287: But after seeing the example set by you, Alphinaud, and the others, the change was palpable. They couldn't help but believe.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_URIANGER_000_290: What serendipitous irony that the remnants of the Seventh Umbral Calamity would become the keys to mankind's salvation. Never more certain have I been that Master Louisoix watcheth over us from the aetherial sea...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_YSHTOLA_000_295: I'm confident that even the deadliest of Allagan defense mechanisms are no match for our allies.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_YSHTOLA_000_300: At this rate, some of them might soon have as many accomplishments to their names as a certain Warrior of Light.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_GRAHATIA_000_305: Time and time again, it seems that Allagan something-or-other are either the cause of or the solution to our problems.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_GRAHATIA_000_306: Hmm... To think the selfsame materials that once launched Dalamud will now be used to help ferry mankind to the moon. There's a poetry in that.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ESTINIEN_000_310: ...Considering how much of a fuss he made at the time, I don't see why he takes every opportunity to bring it up. It was just firewood.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_3: 'Preciate you doin' all this, but I ain't gettin' me hopes up just yet!
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KRILE_000_320: It's times like these we're reminded of how famous─or infamous─Alphinaud has become. Who'd have thought he could achieve so much with a single linkpearl conversation!
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KRILE_000_321: As we're expecting rather a lot of visitors in the near future, I'd best return to the surface and inform the relevant parties.
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KRILE_000_322: I also have a contact of my own that might be worth a try...
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_ALPHINAUD_000_323: Oh? And who might that be?
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KRILE_000_324: That's for me to know and you to find out!
TEXT_AKTKMF103_04441_KRILE_000_325: And on that note, I leave matters here in your capable hands. Best of luck!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALISAIE_000_000: Though Bahamut is long gone, the internment hulks are far from safe.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALISAIE_000_001: It could be much worse, of course. They won't have to fight their way past Meracydian dragons, nor is there any danger the elder primal might be summoned again.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALISAIE_000_002: Even so, I daresay there are still a fair few Allagan creations and contraptions remaining to bar our friends' way. I only hope that Grandfather watches over them.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALISAIE_000_005: Well, I'm all for relying on the power of friendship, but we're now left with the rare luxury of having nothing to do. There must be something that requires our attention!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_THANCRED_000_010: First the Telophoroi, and now the Final Days. Heh─no one can accuse the Ilsabard contingent of backing down from a challenge!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_THANCRED_000_011: Of course, they weren't all so committed to the cause when we first set out.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_THANCRED_000_012: But after seeing the example set by you, Alphinaud, and the others, the change was palpable. They couldn't help but believe.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_URIANGER_000_015: What serendipitous irony that the remnants of the Seventh Umbral Calamity would become the keys to mankind's salvation. Never more certain have I been that Master Louisoix watcheth over us from the aetherial sea...
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_YSHTOLA_000_020: I'm confident that even the deadliest of Allagan defense mechanisms are no match for our allies.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_YSHTOLA_000_021: At this rate, some of them might soon have as many accomplishments to their names as a certain Warrior of Light.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_GRAHATIA_000_025: Time and time again, it seems that Allagan something-or-other are either the cause of or the solution to our problems.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_GRAHATIA_000_026: Hmm... To think the selfsame materials that once launched Dalamud will now be used to help ferry mankind to the moon. There's a poetry in that.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ESTINIEN_000_030: ...Considering how much of a fuss he made at the time, I don't see why he takes every opportunity to bring it up. It was just firewood.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_0: 'Preciate you doin' all this, but I ain't gettin' me hopes up just yet!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Though our friends are searching for refined adamantite and sacred relics, we will only know if they meet your requirements once they have arrived.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALPHINAUD_000_041: In the meantime, is there aught else we might do to be of service?
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_0: Ha! You've already done more than enough!
If I had to say, though, I could use someone who knows a thing or two about Allagan technology...
You there! The lad with the red eyes n' matchin' hair! You seem to know more than the average scholar!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALPHINAUD_000_045: Ha! If only Master Kokkol knew how right he was. While he and G'raha establish a rapport, why don't we help with preparations for the great exodus?
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Indeed, this would mean going above and beyond the terms of our arrangement─but I propose this not to curry favor.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALPHINAUD_000_047: As confident as I am that we will succeed, we must be ready for every eventuality. This would also be an opportunity to familiarize ourselves with the logistics of traversing the great expanse. And if nothing else, it beats twiddling our thumbs while we wait for the adamantite.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_0: Well, ain't you a bunch of helpful buggers? If you've a mind to lend a hand, I know where you ought to go.
Sharlayan Hamlet is lousy with researchers and scholarly types, busyin' themselves preparin' for the exodus. Pah! That lot need all the help they can get!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_GRAHATIA_000_060: I shall endeavor to provide Master Kokkol with whatever information he should require!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_0: I'll admit, without refined adamantite, I ain't got a bloody clue how else I could get the aetherburner performin' any better! If you lot don't come up with the goods, we're buggered!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALPHINAUD_000_070: In order to protect the secrets of the Central Circuit, the researchers must navigate a bewildering maze of paperwork before they are permitted to return to the surface.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALPHINAUD_000_071: I suppose it's no different than any other aspect of Sharlayan society. We do love our bureaucracy. It's very much a mirror of the city above, which is perhaps how it came to be called Sharlayan Hamlet.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_THANCRED_000_075: As surprised as I was to learn the Forum planned to send everyone to the moon, I can't imagine how the commonfolk must feel about it.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_URIANGER_000_080: Do my senses deceive me? In the shadow of yon corner...
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_URIANGER_000_081: Hmm. One can but hope this leadeth not to mischievous undertakings.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_YSHTOLA_000_085: What a quaint little settlement this is. A shame it is hidden underground.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ESTINIEN_000_090: I don't mind a bit of heavy lifting, but I draw the line at paperwork. So much as wave a sheaf of documents at me and I'll put my lance through it.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALISAIE_000_100: From what I can tell, a lot of the people actually live down here.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALISAIE_000_101: I don't know how much help we can offer, but I daresay they'll benefit from some of that “fresh inspiration” Scholarch Montichaigne mentioned.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALISAIE_000_102: Let's start by asking around, ideally without getting in anyone's way!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_ALPHINAUD_000_103: Let's meet by the aetheryte once our work is done.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_SILKENGRIN_000_110: Oh, um, hullo. Are you one of the new helpers?
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_SILKENGRIN_000_111: Working on the aetherburner? Oh dear... I hear things have come to a standstill on that front.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_SILKENGRIN_000_112: Even so, I'd choose that over my current duties. Checking and loading samples, day in, day out. It's tiring, thankless work...
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_SILKENGRIN_000_113: Still, no one'll be cross if I misplace a few legumes or what have you. The Forum's got enough on their plate as it is, what with deciding who gets to board the ark and when. Lot of powerful people have “opinions” about that.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_SILKENGRIN_000_114: My heart goes out to Master Fourchenault and the others. Hardly get a moment's rest, I expect. Do they even have time to sleep?
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_SILKENGRIN_000_120: It's a race against time to prepare for the great exodus, but with everyone in such a rush, we're bound to make mistakes.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_STEADYCURRENT_000_1: Helping with the ark? Even with all the power Master Kokkol's managed to squeeze out of the aetherburner, it's still not enough, apparently.
And now I hear the Final Days have arrived. Horrible creatures running rampant all over... <sigh> If only we'd begun the exodus sooner.
People are dying, and there'll be no end to it if we don't fulfill our duties.
But we will. We've spent years preparing for this moment. Believe in the plan, and all will be well.
If the aetherburner isn't up to snuff, we'll have to begin the exodus sooner than planned so we can make as many trips as possible.
Might fail to meet the projected targets, too. If so, we'll be faced with some hard choices about what to leave behind. And who...
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_PAULTISANNE_000_140: Offering to help? That's very kind, but I should be able to organize the rest of the documents by myself.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_PAULTISANNE_000_141: It's mostly lists of the things we'll need once we arrive on the moon, and then whichever star we choose as our new home. My duties largely concern the maintenance of living conditions, so I'll be a lot busier after we depart.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_PAULTISANNE_000_142: I hear that our lunar collaborators have come down to assist in our efforts. I'm looking forward to finally meeting them in person, after having communicated with them in such a limited capacity thus far.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_PAULTISANNE_000_143: To be perfectly honest, I've not even the slightest idea what they look like! I do hope they're not enormous, looming giants... Why, I would much prefer something small and fluffy, like that behatted rabbit that ran by...
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_PAULTISANNE_000_145: Come to think of it, rabbits don't normally wear hats, do they? Or run on their back paws? Hmm... Perhaps it was an escaped sample.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_URIANGER_000_150: 'Twould appear the Loporrits have infiltrated Sharlayan's most heavily guarded facility. How, I know not.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_GROWINGWAY_000_155: Crikey! I wasn't expecting to see you here, !
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_GROWINGWAY_000_156: I'm sorry I didn't have a chance to say good-bye. And for, uh, having those other Loporrits attack you. Terrible misunderstanding, that.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_GROWINGWAY_000_157: Not to worry, though, as all have since recovered from the rather savage beating you administered. They bear you no ill will! Well, perhaps a little, on account of the savagery, but time heals all wounds! Most, anyway.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_SINGINGWAY_000_160:
Hum hum-hummm～♪
What joy to sample the delights of Etheirys!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_COOKINGWAY_000_165: How marvelous it is to see you again! You'll be pleased to hear I've learned much since our fascinating discussion at the Carrotorium.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_COOKINGWAY_000_166: It's all thanks to Urianger, you see. He's taught me the finer points of cooking, which, despite my name, I knew very little about. So many dishes, so many hard-to-pronounce words!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_COOKINGWAY_000_167: Actually, I was rather hoping he'd show me how to bake an Archon loaf. They're quite popular, I hear, though it doesn't sound like it contains any flavor to speak of. Still, if that's the sort of thing your kind enjoys, I shall make enough to last the whole journey!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_LIVINGWAY_000_171: Our friends in the Forum brought us to see their teeny-tiny toy boat, which was quite impressive considering they didn't use any creation magicks.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_LIVINGWAY_000_172: What we're really interested in is Etheirys itself, though we now find ourselves in a sort of funny, underground, miniaturized version of it.
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_LIVINGWAY_000_173: We were hoping the Forum would give us a guided tour, but it appears they're rather preoccupied. Honestly! All that time to prepare, and they're still not ready!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_LIVINGWAY_000_174: I suppose we'll just have to show ourselves around. Or at least, that's what we were planning to do until we chanced upon Urianger and your good self!
TEXT_AKTKMF104_04442_LIVINGWAY_000_175: Since you're both dawdling about, engaging in idle chitchat, perhaps you could show us a few points of interest! Won't that be fun?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_LIVINGWAY_000_000: If you're too busy to show us the sights, we'll find other ways to keep ourselves amused, don't you worry.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_005: Crikey! I wasn't expecting to see you here, !
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_006: I'm sorry I didn't have a chance to say good-bye. And for, uh, having those other Loporrits attack you. Terrible misunderstanding, that.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_007: Not to worry, though, as all have since recovered from the rather savage beating you administered. They bear you no ill will! Well, perhaps a little, on account of the savagery, but time heals all wounds! Most, anyway.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_010:
Hum hum-hummm～♪
What joy to sample the delights of Etheirys!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_COOKINGWAY_000_015: How marvelous it is to see you again! You will be pleased to hear I've learned much since our fascinating discussion at the Carrotorium.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_COOKINGWAY_000_016: It's all thanks to Urianger, you see. He's taught me the finer points of cooking, which, despite my name, I knew very little about. So many dishes, so many hard-to-pronounce words!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_COOKINGWAY_000_017: Actually, I was rather hoping he'd show me how to bake an Archon loaf. They're quite popular, I hear, though it doesn't sound like it contains any flavor to speak of. Still, if that's the sort of thing your kind enjoys, I shall make enough to last the whole journey!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_020: A tour of Labyrinthos? Hmm... An unexpected, yet prudent suggestion...
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_021: Given the similarities betwixt this artificial environment and Bestways Burrow, 'twould be in our best interests to have the Loporrits acquaint themselves with those conditions deemed optimal by their Sharlayan collaborators.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_022: I fear, however, that continued reliance upon my limited knowledge would risk narrowing, rather than broadening, their perspectives. Mayhap thou art better suited to lead this venture?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_023: What a marvelous idea! Might we begin with that great, big wotsit over yonder?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_024: Ah, yes. The wotsit. I shall leave its explanation to . <chuckle>
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_030: The Loporrits' technical expertise doth far outstrip our own. We would be wise to allow them to form their own conclusions as to the function of the various apparatus, rather than offer uninformed suppositions of our own.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_031: Unless, that is, unbeknownst to me, thou art possessed of surpassing knowledge concerning the construction and operation of advanced Sharlayan─ahem─wotsits?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_LIVINGWAY_000_035: Considering Singingway and Growingway's specialties, I expect them to pay full attention to your explanations, which I am sure will be most informative!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_040: My word! What magnificent architecture! Such immaculate curvature!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_041: I'll have to make several adjustments to my work if I'm to match this degree of craftsmanship! I shall leave no corner unrounded!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_COOKINGWAY_000_045: This is all very intriguing, I'm sure, but where are the food preparation stations? The, uh...what was your word for it...kitchens?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_COOKINGWAY_000_046: That reminds me─ Puddingway, our newly appointed chief of pudding research (a discipline he himself founded after sampling Urianger's delights), has gone in search of Etheirys's ultimate sweet treat. Well, provided it's a pudding, as that's all he ever talks about these days. Have you seen him?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_050: Goodness me! To build something so large without creation magicks...is positively stupendous!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_051: Perhaps you could direct our attention to its most important features?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_060: Splendid! The perfect spot from which to view this astonishing apparatus!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SYSTEM_000_070: Search the apparatus for points of potential interest. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target an area and inspect it with .
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_071: Well, if I were to hazard a guess, water drawn from underground─presumably with some other mechanism─is purified here and stored in that tower before being distributed elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_073: I knew it! A design brilliant in its simplicity. I daresay it would take only a moment to install in even the harshest of environments. For us Loporrits, that is!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_LIVINGWAY_000_074: Indeed, securing a reliable source of water is of the utmost importance for any fledgling settlement.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_075: We have read, however, that peoples of Etheirys sometimes make their homes in arid deserts and such. How are they able to survive?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_A1_000_077: Many settlements in Thanalan are built near an oasis.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_A1_000_078: Areas near waterfalls are common sites for villages in Gyr Abania.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_079: So wherever you choose to live, you're never far from water...
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_080: Oh dear... I worry we won't be able to procure the necessary amount!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_081: We can provide enough water to keep them from drying out completely, but it would appear they rely on it far more than we'd anticipated!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_082: Hmm... A few adjustments may be in order, once we've calculated the average rate of consumption per individual...
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_083: It may also be worth learning more about how exactly they obtain their water in the first place.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_084: Master Alphinaud spoke of the machinery responsible for that feat during our journey through Logistikon Alpha, did he not?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_085: Mayhap the Loporrits will share his appreciation for the engineering marvel.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_086: Oh, yes! That sounds absolutely splendid!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_087: We must journey beyond the sanctuary of Sharlayan Hamlet. I shall lead the way.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_088: Y-You mean we'll have to brave the untamed wilderness!?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_LIVINGWAY_000_089: A valid concern indeed. We could not help but notice the many dangerous-looking creatures with big, nasty teeth lurking beyond the safe confines of this settlement.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_LIVINGWAY_000_090: Were we not escorted here by burly custodians, I dread to think what would have become of us!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_091: Regrettably, to many a hungry predator with the aforementioned big, nasty teeth, Loporrits may appear to be a potential and rather appetizing source of sustenance...
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_092: Might I impose upon thee to assist in securing safe passage to Logistikon Alpha?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_093: For my part, I shall act as escort to Livingway and Cookingway. I entrust Singingway and Growingway to thy care.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_094: A more valiant protector they could not wish for. Godsspeed.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_095: If it's all the same to you, I'd rather not be eaten by some horrid beastie.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_096: Come along, Growingway. To the water extraction wotsit!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_100: I've a feeling the way forward is not as clear as we'd like... Could you go and take a look?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_105: Perhaps you could tell the local beasties we're not nearly as delicious as we might appear!?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_110: I say! That fiend had a mind to feast on roasted Loporrit!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_121: I really hope this water extraction wotsit is worth these harrowing experiences!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_122: All part of the fun, some might say, but I'd rather not be burnt to a crisp, if it's all the same to you!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_LIVINGWAY_000_130: You've done well to see those two here safely. They can be a bit skittish at the best of times, so I'm pleasantly surprised they didn't run off and get themselves killed!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_135: That was all very exciting, but I'd rather not do it again... Wait. How exactly were we planning to head back later?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_140: Let's get moving! That building looks nice and solid and safe!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_COOKINGWAY_000_145: I couldn't help noticing a distinct lack of carrots along the way. Or many of the other vegetables I was expecting to see, though I did catch a glimpse of some sort of bipedal tomato charging about. Must be my imagination.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_150: My friends, I bid you welcome to Logistikon Alpha.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_151: Our destination doth lie at the lift's top. Pray, follow me.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_160: On this occasion, 'twould behoove us to seek the counsel of those qualified to describe the workings of the apparatus. They may also be in possession of schematics or other useful documentation, should the Loporrits request them.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_URIANGER_000_161: As the Forum's esteemed guests, 'tis unlikely that they would be refused, yet thou knowest as well as I the changeable dispositions of Sharlayan bureaucrats.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_LIVINGWAY_000_165: As I understand, places like Labyrinthos are the exception, rather than the rule. You don't all build enormous, underground living spaces like this, surely?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_170: That was terrifying, but at least the scenery was more pleasant than wossname...Garlemald! As a first impression of Etheirys, it was far from favorable.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_GROWINGWAY_000_171: Anyway, onwards and upwards! Quite literally, as is the case here!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_COOKINGWAY_000_175: Forgive me for asking, but are we any closer to the kitchens? Come to think of it, why am I even here? Atmospheric manipulators are hardly my area of expertise.
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_180: Marvelous! Simply marvelous! So, this is where the magic─or science, rather─takes place! The perfect environment to sustain life, artificially created!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_181: The knowledge we'll gain here will be essential when we start looking for new stars for your kind to inhabit. Apparently, most of them don't even have air for you to breathe!
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_182: You're all very lucky that Etheirys just so happens to provide everything you need to thrive. Or did mankind turn out the way they are because of the available resources, I wonder?
TEXT_AKTKMF105_04443_SINGINGWAY_000_183: Either way, it's nothing short of miraculous! And I cannot wait to see more of it!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_URIANGER_000_000: On this occasion, 'twould behoove us to seek the counsel of those qualified to describe the workings of the apparatus. They may also be in possession of schematics or other useful documentation, should the Loporrits request them.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_URIANGER_000_001: As the Forum's esteemed guests, 'tis unlikely that they would be refused, yet thou knowest as well as I the changeable dispositions of Sharlayan bureaucrats.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_LIVINGWAY_000_005: As I understand, places like Labyrinthos are the exception, rather than the rule. You don't all build enormous, underground living spaces like this, surely?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_GROWINGWAY_000_010: That was terrifying, but at least the scenery was more pleasant than wossname...Garlemald! As a first impression of Etheirys, it was far from favorable.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_GROWINGWAY_000_011: Anyway, onwards and upwards! Quite literally, as is the case here!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_SINGINGWAY_000_015: I should like to study this primitive yet nevertheless intriguing contraption a while longer, if I may. That the Sharlayans were able to build something of this complexity with their limited knowledge and resources is most impressive!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_020: This is all very wonderful, I'm sure, but I was rather hoping to learn more about your nourishment provision facilities. In other words, where is the food?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_URIANGER_000_021: I believe both the knowledge and consumables you seek may be found at Meryall Agronomics.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_URIANGER_000_022: As I imagine Singingway and the others intend to study every conceivable facet of this apparatus, wouldst thou be so kind as to escort our visiting culinarian?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_023: Yes, that sounds much more interesting! Hopefully, I'll be able to see firsthand some of the delicacies Urianger was telling me about.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_024: Even his incredibly vivid─if a bit too verbose─descriptions cannot compare to sampling them myself. Not to mention Etheirys will soon be no more...so I must learn all I can while there is still time!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_025: Let us brook no further delay!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_URIANGER_000_030: 'Twould appear I have inadvertently taken upon myself the more demanding duty─entertaining three inquisitive Loporrits to thy one. Yet be that as it may, 'twill be my pleasure to impart what little knowledge I possess to our would-be saviors.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_040: This is the place, yes? The heady aroma was enough to guide me here, and I've spotted several of the fruit and vegetables featured in our compendium!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_041: I'd dearly love to try some, but I read that those who help themselves to a farmer's crops without permission are often caught and put into pies!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_042: Perhaps you could ask whoever's in charge if they would be willing to part with a few samples?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_SYSTEM_000_043: Cookingway is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_SYSTEM_000_044: You can leave Cookingway behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_SYSTEM_000_045: If you wish to have Cookingway accompany you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_055: I suppose if they did put me in a pie, I could just eat my way out. Wait, they get quite hot inside, don't they? On second thought, let's stick to the plan for now.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_Q2_000_060: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Cookingway?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_061: Oh. Something else to attend to? It's all right, I'll wait here. Patiently...and hungrily.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_065: Sampling foodstuffs is the very reason I wanted to visit Etheirys!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_SYSTEM_000_070: Cookingway has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_080: <sigh> What a fine mess this is...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_SYSTEM_000_081: You should have Cookingway accompanying you before attracting Jebke's attention.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_085: <sigh> What a fine mess this is...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_086: Ah, it's you, the one who climbed down the mineshaft!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_087: I'd show you around if I could, but I'm rushed off my feet preparing for the exodus.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_088: And I'm not the only one. We've all got to find ways to do what we do down here up there─first on the moon, then on whichever star the Forum decides will become our new home.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_090: Don't you want to go to the moon?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_091: Well, it's better than waiting for the Final Days to claim us...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_092: But no matter how carefully it's all planned, we'll never be able to take every variety of flora and fauna with us.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_093: Even the ones we can take may not survive in their new environment. So many species, doomed to extinction...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_094: Sorry, that's not what you came to talk about, is it?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_095: Nothing quite so dire, I assure you. We merely wish to sample a little of your produce, if we may?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_100: As Urianger informs me, the key to exquisite cuisine lies in selecting only the very best ingredients.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_110: I've an enormous list of seeds, saplings, and whatnot to take to the Central Circuit. But I suppose that means anything not on the list is to be left behind... What a waste.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_120: Oh! I know what these are! Grapes, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_121: Let's see if they are as delicious as they look...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_122: So sweet, so sour! The taste is much like a ripe philosopher's carrot...and yet the texture is entirely different.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_123: The contrast between the outer skin and the fruit within is most peculiar, though far from unpleasant. Yes, I think I'll try another...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_124: Well, that's certainly given me food for thought, though in a far less visceral manner than any philosopher's carrot... But tell me, what is your opinion of grapes?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_A3_000_126: I'd brave an erupting volcano for a choice bunch!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_A3_000_128: Ghastly things. I'd rather eat rancid gigantoad eyeballs.
