TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_129: Yes, they are rather moreish, aren't they? And from what I've read, quite versatile, too. Something about people stepping on them to make intoxicating beverages, as I recall.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_130: Meh? An expression of indifference, I assume. In all fairness, our compendium did note they are valued more as an ingredient for spirituous beverages rather than as a fruit for regular consumption.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_131: How odd! No accounting for taste, is there?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_132: Anyway, that's enough about grapes for the time being. On to the next treat!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_140: Orange by name, orange by nature!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_141: What came first, the fruit or the color? Who cares? Let's eat!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_143: Equal parts sweet and sour, as with the grapes, yet nothing alike. Hmm... I may have to consult Urianger about expanding my vocabulary. I simply cannot find the words to describe it!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_144: Perhaps what I'm looking for is, “bitter.” This is all very complicated, you know. So many flavors, so many choices... And each individual with their own personal preferences...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_145: Now I see why you all turned your noses up at the idea of eating nothing but carrots! Marvelous though they still are in my estimation─let no one say I said otherwise!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_146: Ah, but speaking of carrots, I've yet to sample any of the vegetables. Let's see what's in that field over there!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_150: That color...that texture... Are they some sort of enormous, round carrots?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_151: No? In any case, proper nomenclature is less of a concern than the taste...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_152: Blech! It's so hard and flavorless, I may as well be chewing a piece of wood! That all but confirms it─these are nothing more than misbegotten failures masquerading as goodly carrots!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_DELOYS_000_153: Stop, stop, stop! Can't you see these are pumpkins!?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_DELOYS_000_154: And no one with any sense would try eating them raw! You're supposed to cook them first!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_155: Do you not find it an awful bother?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_DELOYS_000_156: Far from it! Cooking is a joy unto itself.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_DELOYS_000_157: And what's more, it broadens the range of ingredients that we may safely eat.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_DELOYS_000_158: But above all else, cooking allows us to draw out the full potential of our produce. Pumpkin stew has been one of my favorite dishes for as long I can remember!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_159: Then perhaps even these hard blocks of plant matter can become as delicious as the orange I sampled...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_160: I wonder, though, if there is anything even more delicious... How about that yellow fruit over yonder?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_170: What a wondrous fragrance! With luck, it'll have a flavor to match.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_171: As I've no idea how these are eaten, I'll just bite into it!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_174: A lemon? You mean it's supposed to taste like this!?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_175: How can something so similar to an orange be so revolting?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_176: Ack... It may be some time before my palate recovers from this ordeal. As such, I had best call an end to this round of sampling. Let's say our farewells and return to the others.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_180: Good grief... I fear that lemon has irrevocably ruined my sense of taste...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_200: Finished, have you? I trust you found something to your liking.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_201: I'm rather enamored with the grapes and oranges. Less so the pumpkin, though I learned the hard way they're not to be eaten raw.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_202: Then there was the lemon. The deceiver. I still feel so violated...
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_204: I'd hate for you to leave with a bad taste in your mouth─in more ways than one─so I'll give you this lemon muffin I baked. If this doesn't change your opinion, nothing will!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_205: More lemon!? Have I not suffered enough?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_206: Nevertheless, it would be remiss of me to spurn this opportunity to─oof, bit of sick came up there─learn more of your inscrutable ways.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_207: Very well, lemon muffin! Do your worst!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_211: Although I still detect a hint of lemon, it complements the sweetness of the dough to create a perfect harmony!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_212: I never would've guessed its vile bitterness could be utilized so elegantly. My good chap, this is simply breathtaking!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_213: See? We rarely use lemon in its natural state, but it has a starring role in all sorts of recipes, and the same is true for many other ingredients.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_214: It comes down to making the most of the resources at our disposal. And sometimes, that can even be the difference between life and death.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_215: I know we won't be able to take every species with us. No doubt the Forum agonized over what was worth preserving...and what will be consigned to history. Hard choices, but make them we must if we're to survive.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_216: Such strength of will... Now I know what Hydaelyn sees in your kind.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_217: Mankind, the Loporrits─we were both born from the accumulated knowledge of the ancients.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_218: They learned all there is to learn about the nature of sentient life and the fates of the stars themselves.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_219: Once a civilization has fulfilled the basic requirements for survival, it will inevitably seek to eliminate all forms of negativity and achieve perfection.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_220: And therein lies its folly...and its downfall.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_221: For perfection is an unattainable ideal. 'Tis the paradox of the immaculate carrot.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_222: Yet civilizations since time immemorial have deemed the pursuit of perfection as “progress.” They pay no heed to the costs incurred in their futile quest, and all too often become the architects of their own demise, their dreams forever unfulfilled.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_223: What, then, is the alternative? The answer lies in knowing that our existence can never be perfect. To be content with what we have and make the most of it.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_224: When life gives you lemons, make lemon muffins!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_225: Err...pardon my Eorzean, but what in the seven hells are you on about? And who are you, anyway?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_226: Cookingway, at your service! I'm here to help prepare for the trip to the moon!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_227: And once you get there, you'll be able to try my carrots. I've been growing all different kinds!
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_228: But don't worry, there'll be room for your crops too. We'll work together to preserve as many of Etheirys's species as possible, if you're up to the challenge.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_229: Yes, of course! I look forward to it.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_230: Well, this has all been highly productive. Probably. Let's go and see if Urianger and the others have run out of machinery to inspect, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_240: So he's one of the Forum's lunar collaborators... Not quite what I was expecting, but he seems a decent sort.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_JEBKE_000_241: I'm glad he enjoyed the lemon muffin, too. Hopefully the next time he has one, he won't be compelled to wax poetic about the meaning of life and the immaculate carrot again.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_URIANGER_000_245: By Cookingway's broad grin, I assume your excursion was a roaring success?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_LIVINGWAY_000_250: Where have you and Cookingway been!? If the two of you were engaged in pursuits of an educational nature, you should've taken me, too! I am the leader, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_GROWINGWAY_000_255: Oh...there you are. <yawn> Have the others finished talking about rain-making wotsits yet?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_SINGINGWAY_000_260: Not to rub it in, but we had the most fantastic time while you were away! Urianger was able to obtain all manner of meteorological data for us to pore over. I'll be sure to put my newfound knowledge to good use once we return to the moon.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_SINGINGWAY_000_261: It's my duty to make your journey as comfortable as possible, though there's no telling how long it will be. A hundred years? A thousand? Hmm... Probably closer to five thousand, give or take.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_270: That was most enlightening, especially the part with the lemon muffin.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_271: Actually, I was wondering, do you know of any other places famed for their cuisine?
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_A4_000_273: Limsa Lominsa is home to the Culinarians' Guild...and many less-than-savory establishments.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_A4_000_274: The Far East has oodles of noodles.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_275: Would that I had time to visit... <sigh> The more I learn of Etheirys, the more I wish we could spare it from the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMF106_04444_COOKINGWAY_000_276: Alas, Hydaelyn's orders are to flee, not to resist. If only there was some other way...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_LIVINGWAY_000_000: Where have you and Cookingway been!? If the two of you have been engaged in pursuits of an educational nature, you should've taken me, too! I am the leader, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_005: Oh...there you are. <yawn> Have the others finished talking about rain-making wotsits yet?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SINGINGWAY_000_010: Not to rub it in, but we had the most fantastic time while you were away! Urianger was able to obtain all manner of meteorological data for us to pore over. I'll be sure to put my newfound knowledge to good use once we return to the moon.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SINGINGWAY_000_011: It's my duty to make your journey as comfortable as possible, though there's no telling how long it will be. A hundred years? A thousand? Hmm... Probably closer to five thousand, give or take.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_COOKINGWAY_000_015: Mmm, muffins... I wonder if this is how Puddingway felt the first time Urianger made pudding?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_COOKINGWAY_000_016: Though I'm not sure that actually was pudding, come to think of it. Something about it seemed a bit...off...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_020: . I trust thy time at Meryall Agronomics did...<cough>...bear fruit?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_021: Our own efforts, too, were rewarded─we now possess an embarrassment of educational riches.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_022: No doubt our guests' relentless pursuit of knowledge could occupy them─and us─for a fortnight. Alas, time is of the essence.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_023: Let us return to Sharlayan Hamlet forthwith. I shall gladly attend to each and every Loporrit there, should further questions within my power to answer arise.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_030: The Loporrits want for activities and stimulation, but I struggle to conceive of how to busy them whilst we wait...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_LIVINGWAY_000_035: Oh, no, there was nowhere in particular I was hoping to go.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_LIVINGWAY_000_036: I simply wish to see, hear, feel, and think as much as I possibly can while we're here... Hmm? What is that look for? What did I say?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SINGINGWAY_000_040: That was ever so delightful! And with this much information, I can fine-tune the moon's environs for your people's comfort! It's surprisingly tricky to estimate the appropriate temperature settings for beings so lacking in fur...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_COOKINGWAY_000_045: Why did I not ask Jebke how to make carrot muffins!? We could have had baked goods bursting with happiness...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_051: Yes, , that was indeed me verbalizing a sigh to express my emotional state. Do you want to know why?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_052: Because I saw the reconstructed environmental data for Etheirys at Logistikon Alpha, that's why!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_053: A forest so lovely, and so...so...leafy. Are all of your forests like that?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_A1_000_055: The Black Shroud is quite leafy indeed, and a place of utmost tranquility.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_A1_000_056: They're verdant, at least. The trees of Dravania stand particularly proud.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_A1_000_057: You should see the forests of the First─one was purple!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_059: With a star so wonderful, it comes as no surprise that you're reluctant to leave it behind. I was a fool to think otherwise─to assume that the moon was something worth being proud of.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_060: How ridiculous we must seem to you. Trying so hard, yet achieving so little...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_061: Not at all. Thy works are no less worthy for their uniqueness.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_THANCRED_000_065: Oh, I was able to glean a fair bit from the researchers while helping to move their cargo.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_THANCRED_000_066: Preparations have proceeded without interruption here, despite news of the coming end. We have the Forum's leadership to thank for that.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_THANCRED_000_067: That doesn't mean people aren't worried, though. Quite the opposite.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_THANCRED_000_068: Knowing disaster could strike at any moment, they hurry to complete their work, equally aware that a single error could be the difference between life and death. And we can hardly tell them there's no cause for concern...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_069: Perhaps not... Though aided by our goodly Growingway, we may yet find other ways to lighten their burden.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_070: M-Me!? Be of use to...to people? I'm honored that you would think me so capable, but I'm not sure that I'm up to the challenge...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_072: If you say so, I... I suppose it can't hurt to try.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_THANCRED_000_073: I passed someone moping in the western plaza that looked to be in need of a helping paw. Perhaps you might start with him?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_074: 'Tis as good a place as any. Come.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_THANCRED_000_080: You'd best go with them. I don't think Urianger misjudged him, but Growingway does look like he could use some emotional support.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_THANCRED_000_081: I still have work to complete elsewhere. I trust that I won't return to find any Loporrits in tears...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_WORRIEDRESEARCHER04: ...It is you who would help me? Is my anxiety truly so obvious?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_092: A burden shared is a burden eased. Pray, tell us of thy troubles.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_WORRIEDRESEARCHER04: Those little fellows do look like good listeners...
I'm an engineer, you see. And what they say of the ship─that it's the sum of decades of Sharlayan ingenuity, that it's built with peerless Allagan technology─is all true, but...
I know─I know─that none of that's a guarantee.
We've never before launched a starfaring vessel─let alone flown it in the great expanse. All the tests we've run have been on the ground!

Only operational personnel and cargo will be aboard for the first voyage, but even so... If it fails us then, what can we do? And if it doesn't, it could fall apart on the next flight, or the one after that...
We've done everything we can to prevent that from happening, but it hardly matters. We thought the aetherburner's design was flawless, too, and look how that turned out...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_099: Thou art familiar with these most daunting technologies, and thus dost thou hold the power to allay his fears.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_100: Oh! I, er...I'm not sure about that, but, well...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_101: Maybe you could tell me if there are any aspects of the ship's design that you're especially worried about?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_WORRIEDRESEARCHER04: Our ability to walk about and perform our tasks, for one. I've devised a means by which to employ Gravity─a spatiotemporal spell─to regulate the environment, but what if it's not strong enough? What if everyone floats away and begins crashing into things as soon as we've left the star?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_103: Aha, gravitation! Maybe I can be of help after all!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_104: Up there is not so different from down here, you see. The same rules apply, and if you consider them as part of one great big cosmos rather than separate places...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_105: I suspect both parties shall find comfort in this conversation.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_106: Yet if Thancred's tale be true, still others would benefit from insights born of experience.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_107: Might I prevail upon the Loporrits to attend them?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_LIVINGWAY_000_108: An excellent idea, if I do say so myself! There is naught we'd like more than to ease the hearts of the fine people of Etheirys─and learn more about them while we're at it.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_109: Full glad am I to hear it. Gather thy companions and bring them hither.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_110: , thou hast a gift for finding souls in need of succor.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_111: Pray seek thee out the distressed and the apprehensive, and inform them that help is at hand.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_112: I shall await them here, that I might introduce each to a suitable Loporrit.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_LIVINGWAY_000_113: Oh, I do so look forward to that. A place for every Loporrit, and every Loporrit in their place!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_120: The Final Days doubtless weigh heavy upon the minds of many in Sharlayan Hamlet, pillars of the exodus as they are.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_125: Yes, precisely! However, it would also be prudent to have a redundant system in the event of failure...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONONE04445_000_: By the gods, my chest is tight... Am I dying? Is this what dying feels like?
Oh! Do pardon me─I didn't see you there. There is no cause for concern, I assure you.

No cause for concern...even though we may need to depart at any moment...and if the hull I designed buckles under the strain, the entire vessel may explode on launch, claiming countless lives and dooming all mankind...but that is highly unlikely! Yes, yes, highly unlikely... Highly...
...Our visitors can help me triple check for structural flaws, you say? Why, that would be wonderful! I'm breathing more easily already.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONTWO04445_000_: Consult our collaborators? I suppose that would be more effective than sitting here brooding.

I'm attempting to calculate how much cargo we can consolidate into fewer trips, should the aetherburner make our original estimates unfeasible─but there are simply too many variables. I feel as if my brow will turn inside out...
But perhaps our lunar associates will have more insight into how much weight constitutes too much weight for our purposes. Thank you for letting me know.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONTHREE04445_00: Just leave me to my misery... The Forum can appoint someone else...
<sigh> I apologize─I simply don't know what to do. How am I supposed to pilot the ark if I'm already falling apart under the pressure?
You know a starship pilot that I might speak with? Truly?
Well, then, there's no time to waste! They can help me prepare for this monumental task...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONFOUR04445_000: ...What am I thinking about? The medical facilities on the ship, of course.

I designed them with the assistance of our sages and chirurgeons, but to imagine every illness or injury that one might face in that great expanse is beyond any of us. To say nothing of the effects that living out there indefinitely might have on the body...
...The crew from the moon! Why did I not think of that?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONFIVE04445_000: Blasted assistants! Where have they gone off to at a time like this?

Beg pardon, but I have not the time for idle chitchat. I need to reconfirm that aether levels are consistent throughout the vessel's machinery, and it seems I shall have to do so single-handedly! I swear, when I find those assistants of mine...
...The Loporrits are willing to help? Why didn't you say so?
At least they won't moan about how they “checked two dozen times already” and “haven't slept in weeks.” Lazy sods...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONSIX04445_000_: ...My face? What's wrong with my─ Ow! Perhaps I am a bit tense.

I was tasked with ensuring that the proper fauna─and only the proper fauna─are brought with us to the moon. However, the suitability of a few species is still under debate, and I can hardly make the decision myself when I know so little about the environment up there...
Including the Loporrits in our discussions is a wonderful idea! I absolutely will, thank you! Perhaps their biology itself might offer some clue, as well...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONSEVEN04445_00:
Fifty-six bunches of weeds in the ground,
Fifty-six bunches of weeds.♪
Rip one out, add to the mound,
Fifty-five bunches of weeds in the─
Eep! I-I'm not neglecting my duties, I swear!
I was in need of a little break, you see, but then I found myself unable to relax at all, so I went on a walk, and then I noticed these weeds, and...
...Pleasant conversation partners and oh-so fuzzy? Goodness me, that does sound like a much better way to relax!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONEIGHT04445_00: Have you heard anything of what's on the moon?
I have no doubt that we can make it up there, but the “searching for a new star” part of the plan sounds awfully vague to me.

I asked the Forum, but they will only tell us that our collaborators “have everything under control.” Forgive me, but I don't feel particularly safe wandering through the sea of stars on gods-know-what made by gods-know-who!
You mean to say that I can speak with them directly!? Amazing! I hope they like questions...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONNINE04445_000: Concerns? Nay, there's no point in worrying at this stage. It'll only make the work go that much the slower.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SYSTEM_000_221: This woman seems to be coping well.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONNINE04445_000: All we can do is keep at it.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONTEN04445_000_: Aha...haha! The end of the world is nigh, yet the work goes no faster! Schedules are such temperamental things─feasible one moment, utter bollocks the next!
And yet...I've never felt so alive!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SYSTEM_000_232: This one is beyond your help. Only sleep can save her now.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONTEN04445_000_: I can't stop now─I've got my second wind! Or my second-second wind... Hahaha!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONELEVEN04445_0: You! Yes, you, you idiot! Have you seen an envelope lying about?
This imbecile refuses to give me the alchemic I ordered without that bloody slip of parchment!
Unless your friends have a spell to make me remember where I dropped my damned envelope, I doubt they'll be more help than you... And you've wasted enough of my time already!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SYSTEM_000_243: It would be unfortunate for all involved to inflict this man upon the Loporrits.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONELEVEN04445_0: Did I drop it on the path? Did I leave it at home? Why in the seven blasted hells can I never find things when I need them!?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONTWELVE04445_0: Apologies, but I am awaiting a delivery. Whatever it is will have to wait.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SYSTEM_000_251: It seems this gleaner is too busy to chat, for his benefit or otherwise.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONTWELVE04445_0: If it's urgent, you had best ask a different gleaner.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONTHIRTEEN04445: Is anything bothering me? Well, I've been loading cargo for bells now, so my back feels like a voidsent's played it as a piano. My feet and knees as drums and cymbals, too.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SYSTEM_000_261: This gleaner seems fine, if in need of a break.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONTHIRTEEN04445: Ah, sitting. From the mightiest emperor to the lowliest peasant, who doesn't enjoy a good sit?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONFOURTEEN04445: I too noticed people becoming...rather tense, so I rushed out to pluck some fresh and fragrant tea leaves! Now I need only track down a hundred or so cups...
But don't you worry─I can manage. I hope your plan to cheer everyone up goes well!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SYSTEM_000_274: This woman is doing better than you are!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONFOURTEEN04445: When plucked early, this particular cultivar's leaves are redolent with a scent that clears the mind and soothes the soul. Precisely what my hardworking colleagues need.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONFIFTEEN04445_: Worries, worries... No, I believe I'm fine, thank you! I've been confiding in my colleagues, and it's helped a lot. Can't recommend it enough.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SYSTEM_000_281: This researcher already has the support she needs.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_PERSONFIFTEEN04445_: It's a stressful time, of course, but having colleagues I can count on makes all the difference.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_290: ! He said... He said he was glad we spoke! And he thanked me...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_291: <sniff> It was all worth it after all, wasn't it? E-Even the mistakes we made. Because now, we can tell them what not to do...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_WORRIEDRESEARCHER04: Growingway has been a godssend. I can look upon what we've built with clarity now.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_301: Through thine efforts, word hath spread throughout Labyrinthos.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_302: Verily, to a far greater number than we anticipated. Livingway doth gather more Loporrits as we speak.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_303: I shall assign each in accordance with their skills, that new bonds of friendship might be forged.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_304: Should greater matters require not thine attentions...watch over them, I prithee.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_310: I pray that Livingway is joyed to see so many heartened souls when she doth return.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_THANCRED_000_320: Remind me to invite Urianger for a drink, when we have a moment to breathe. We're long overdue for one.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_THANCRED_000_321: We can raise a glass to Moenbryda.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_LIVINGWAY_000_325: I was so busy asking questions about Etheirys that I never thought to ask more about Urianger...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_LIVINGWAY_000_326: I'd like to, but where would I begin?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_GROWINGWAY_000_330: I assure you that my fellow Loporrits are equally excited to have this opportunity. They were humming the whole way here!
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_SINGINGWAY_000_335: We spent so long gazing at this star. Wondering, and hoping... But to be here now, to walk among the people, to be a part of their lives and know that we've made a difference... It's so much more than I ever dreamed.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_COOKINGWAY_000_340: Goodness me, I've never felt like there was too little time before! There are so many people to talk to, so many things to learn...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_WILFSUNN_000_345: The classical Roegadyn language isn't so different from Eorzean. Did you ever wonder why we named our daughter “moon's bride”?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_WILFSUNN_000_346: When I first held her, the moon was shining silver and full─the whole world seemed aglow. I knew it had chosen her─that she would be a beacon of that selfsame light.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_WILFSUNN_000_347: Of course, we'd later hear our fair share of jokes about how we ought to have gone for “sun” instead, with how bright and stubborn she was. But fiery as my Moenbryda was, she was always kind. Kind and gentle.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_BLOEWYDA_000_350: Oh... You must be one of the Scions, correct?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_BLOEWYDA_000_351: Thank you for caring for my daughter. The time she spent with you was all too short, but I know she was proud to have you as comrades.
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_BLOEWYDA_000_352: Urianger is too, I'm sure. And I certainly feel better for knowing he has good friends to look after him. See that he comes home from time to time, will you?
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_360: Oh, ... Be assured that I am fine. I am...
TEXT_AKTKMF107_04445_URIANGER_000_361: Full glad to see them, too, after so very long. Gladder still that it was in your company. As difficult as it was to accept their kindness, 'twould have been far harder had I faced them alone...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THANCRED_000_000: Remind me to invite Urianger for a drink, when we have a moment to breathe. We're long overdue for one.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THANCRED_000_001: We can raise a glass to Moenbryda.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_LIVINGWAY_000_005: I was so busy asking questions about Etheirys that I never thought to ask more about Urianger...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_LIVINGWAY_000_006: I'd like to, but where would I begin?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_GROWINGWAY_000_010: I assure you that my fellow Loporrits are equally excited to have this opportunity. They were humming the whole way here!
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_SINGINGWAY_000_015: We spent so long gazing at this star. Wondering, and hoping... But to be here now, to walk among the people, to be a part of their lives and know that we've made a difference... It's so much more than I ever dreamed.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_COOKINGWAY_000_020: Goodness me, I've never felt like there was too little time before! There are so many people to talk to, so many things to learn...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_WILFSUNN_000_025: Classical Roegadyn isn't so different from Eorzean. Did you ever wonder why we named our daughter “moon's bride”?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_WILFSUNN_000_026: When I first held her, the moon was shining silver and full─the whole world seemed aglow. I knew it had chosen her─that she would be a beacon of that selfsame light.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_WILFSUNN_000_027: Of course, we'd later hear our fair share of jokes about how we ought to have gone for “sun” instead, with how bright and stubborn she was. But fiery as my Moenbryda was, she was always kind. Kind and gentle.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_BLOEWYDA_000_030: Oh... You must be one of the Scions, correct?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_BLOEWYDA_000_031: Thank you for caring for my daughter. The time she spent with you was all too short, but I know she was proud to have you as comrades.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_BLOEWYDA_000_032: Urianger is too, I'm sure. And I certainly feel better for knowing he has good friends to look after him. See that he comes home from time to time, will you?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_URIANGER_000_040: Ahem. Thou hast my gratitude for lending courage to the Loporrits.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_URIANGER_000_041: Not disposed to rest on their laurels, several of our guests have elected to accompany my countrymen to their stations.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_URIANGER_000_042: Some few may still come hither seeking counsel, and so shall I remain to aid them as need be. If thou art needed elsewhere, do not let me detain thee.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THANCRED_000_043: As a matter of fact, I was hoping you might check on Alisaie. Last I saw, she was struggling to carry an enormous pile of boxes out the west gate...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THANCRED_000_044: I could go myself, but we both know whose help she's less like to scorn.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THANCRED_000_045: Not to mention that─much to my misfortune─I can think of several other things I ought to be doing. Until later!
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_URIANGER_000_050: Pray assist Mistress Alisaie. She hath taken up too great a burden, like as not.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_URIANGER_000_051: Livingway and I shall attend to matters here.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_060: ! What are you doing out here?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_061: No, I don't mind if you help with the boxes, but it's far from the most exciting of tasks. Are you sure?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_063: We need to get these to Aporia. Time is short, of course─but they're full of organic specimens and samples, so try not to be too rough with them.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_064: Alphinaud should be waiting for us when we arrive. I'll see you there!
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_SYSTEM_000_065: Deliver the crate of samples to Alphinaud.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_SYSTEM_000_066: You will have three minutes to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_070: I can't shake the feeling that there are more of these than when I started. Did I pick up an additional crate somewhere...?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Fancy seeing you here! To what do I owe the pleasure?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_SYSTEM_000_081: Alphinaud is clearly awaiting delivery of the samples...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_SYSTEM_000_084: Oh, you're helping with the crates! Wonderful─you can put that there, with the others...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_085: You have my gratitude, but how did you come to be involved in this?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_086: Hah, then I suppose I have Thancred to thank as well.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_087: If you're wondering why we were tasked with bringing these boxes to Aporia to begin with─so was I.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_088: It turns out that this is a base of operations, of sorts. Those with final say as to what is included in the ship's manifest can be found here.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_091: You carried all of that at once!? Are you trying to injure yourself?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_092: Oh, hush. They're lighter than they look─and not everyone has your delicate arms.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_093: I suppose we should let someone know that we've finished...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_094: Theopauldin is in the courtyard. We can report to him.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_095: Why don't you come along? You should get credit for your assistance, at least. Considering where we are, we might even learn something interesting!
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_100: I keep thinking that I've seen him elsewhere, but I cannot for the life of me remember when.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_110: Gods, it never ends, does it? <sigh> What can I do for you?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_111: We've brought samples from Sharlayan Hamlet─series one-one-zero? The crates are by the entrance.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_112: Ah, thank you. I had expected one of my colleagues, but we are dreadfully shorthanded...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_113: Just a moment─you are Fourchenault's children, are you not?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_114: Alphinaud and Alisaie, at your service. You're well acquainted with Father, I take it?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_115: Quite! I've been friends with your parents since our days at the Studium. I remember when you were yea high, waddling hither and thither...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_116: Clearly, it's been quite some time since we've met. 'Tis good to see you again─wielding your father's nouliths, no less!
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_117: You knew our parents when they were young? What were they like? Pray, spare no detail!
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_118: I should like nothing more than to regale you─alas, I am meant to be in charge here, and reams of paperwork want for submission.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_119: We can help with that! In exchange for the sort of stories our parents would never willingly divulge, of course.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_120: Er...very well, then. There happen to be three sets of documents in need of delivery, so how about you each take one?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_122: You will find a Forum representative waiting to collect these near the southernmost structure. I hope I haven't kept her waiting too long...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_123: Never mind Alphinaud and Alisaie─I'm certain they will be back soon enough.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_130: Who are you, by the by? The twins' minder?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_LEGISLATOR04446_000: Are you not one of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn? I thought you were meant to be working on the aetherburner...
Theopauldin's paperwork! I was beginning to worry he had misplaced his quill.
I appreciate your help in seeing these documents to my hands at last. As for your other task...
Pray keep this between us, but I sincerely hope you Scions succeed.
The exodus is, without a doubt, the most monumental undertaking in the history of the Forum, and so we must be circumspect in all respects. Risk is a privilege we cannot afford ourselves.
At its heart, however, Sharlayan has ever been a nation of the curious. 'Twould be a tragedy indeed if we were the ones to stymie your pursuit of truth.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_150: Quick and efficient. I daresay you have a talent for this work.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_151: The twins' papers only needed be delivered to elsewhere in the facility, so they should be returning any moment...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_152: We return—with not a scrap of paperwork remaining on our persons, you will note.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_153: You both have my thanks─and my apologies for sending you on an errand far below your ambitions. Why, even as a babe, you struggled out of your swaddling clothes, and...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_154: That is quite enough of that, thank you! It was compromising stories of our parents that we'd asked to hear, to reiterate.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_155: Of course, of course. I've known your father for so long, I must have something. Hm...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_156: Well...as you know, part of why the Leveilleur name garners such respect in Sharlayan is your family's storied history.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_157: You two can trace your ancestry directly to those who came aboard Nyunkrepf's Hope─a lineage few can claim.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_158: I've never thought much of it myself. It's not as though our forebears founded our nation. They were simply there when it happened.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_159: Nevertheless, it has traditionally been a point of pride.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_160: 'Tis why Nyunkrepf's pronouncement─“Renounce the ways of war, and pursue enlightenment through knowledge and reason”─has ever been our family's creed.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_162: Archon Louisoix looked not to Nyunkrepf's words, but his deeds. He asserted, in defiance of his peers, that choosing to save the great and the small from the rising tides was the true mark of our founder's virtue.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_163: Perhaps it was his expertise─his knowledge of ancient prophecy and the fall of civilizations─that led to him to conclude that to eschew conflict at every turn was to consign mankind to his doom...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_164: There will ever be conflict, and calamity will follow. Thus...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_165: “To ignore the plight of those one might conceivably save is not wisdom─it is indolence.”
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_166: You remember his words well. Indeed, Archon Louisoix lived by that personal creed, and used every means at his disposal to bring succor to those in need─Sharlayan or no.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_167: No one loved and admired your grandfather more than his son...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_168: Yet Fourchenault could not reconcile Louisoix's deeds with the philosophy of their forebears and his peers─a philosophy in which he believed so fervently, yet made a pariah of his father.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_169: Fourchenault agonized over this contradiction for much of his life.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_171: A son may carry his father's blood, but his choices are his own to bear─is it not always thus?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_172: Gods know Fourchenault's a cranky old goat, so I'm sure you butt heads often enough. Yet even so, you must know that you are constantly in his thoughts. Every moment of every day─and that is not an exaggeration in the slightest!
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_173: You should have seen him when you were born─barely recognizable, he was, with a kind of dumbfounded grin I'd not seen since he first took a fancy to your mother. He was practically skipping when he told me the news.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_174: Take my word for it─he loves you to an embarrassing degree.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_175: But he is also frustratingly single-minded. Once he's decided that a given action is for the best, he will stay the course no matter who or what opposes him.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_176: A profoundly annoying habit when you're on the other end of it, as I'm sure you will agree.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_178: Thank you for your insight. When next we meet our parents, I shall mention that we spoke.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_179: Try not to get me into too much trouble, now! I need the Forum on my side.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_THEOPAULDIN_000_180: Speaking of which, I ought to be getting back to work. I have to make sure those specimens you brought make it to their proper places, or the cranky old goat will have my hide. We can speak again later!
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_182: G'raha! Surely Kokkol hasn't driven you out of the forge already?
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_GRAHATIA_000_183: For better or for worse, no. However, he has set me a task that requires more than my single pair of hands...and here you are!
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_GRAHATIA_000_184: I could use at least one of you, but I won't object to more.
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALPHINAUD_000_185: Unfortunately, Alisaie and I have prior commitments, and we have delayed too long as it is...
TEXT_AKTKMF108_04446_ALISAIE_000_186: What about you, ? Can you spare the time?
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_ALPHINAUD_000_000: 'Tis strange to hear Father spoken of in such a way...but I suppose he would find your view of me no less odd.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_ALISAIE_000_005: Much as I'd like to press Theopauldin for more revealing tidbits, we should be getting back to our tasks.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_010: In the event that our─and I quote─“promised heap of adamantite falls right out of the bloody sky and into my lap,” Master Kokkol wishes to be ready to put the proverbial hammer to anvil at a moment's notice.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_011: To fabricate these parts, however, he needs the flames in Kokkol's Forge to burn hotter. He sent me to increase the amount of aether being funneled to his furnaces.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_012: The flow of fire-aspected aether in Labyrinthos is regulated by an elemental reactor south of here─to which I have borrowed the key.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_013: The adjustment will require two people to carry out safely...but I can explain the process when we arrive.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_ALISAIE_000_014: This is where we part, then.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_ALISAIE_000_015: We'll see you in Sharlayan Hamlet once the adamantite arrives, if not before.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_020: The reactor is housed within this facility.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_021: I'll be the one to go inside and adjust the fire aether output.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_022: When I do, a rather large amount of water-aspected aether will issue from the vent at the top. I expect this to attract at least a few elementals─which we would both rather not be drawn into the reactor itself. Trust me.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_023: Can I ask that you put down any that draw too near? They'll pose you little trouble, I'm sure.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_POPMESSAGE_000_030: An apa is lured by the siren song of water-aspected aether!
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_POPMESSAGE_000_031: Further creatures have been attracted by the font of aether!
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_040: Did everything go smoothly out here?
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_041: I thought as much. No major complications to speak of inside, either.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_042: ...And the water aether appears to be venting properly.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_043: I expect Kokkol will have seen a difference in his forge-flames by the time I return.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_044: Since I have you...there was another matter I thought to discuss with you.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_045: Nothing terribly important─merely something I've been considering.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_046: Part of this, I shared with everyone. Yet you, and only you, have been to Elpis...
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_047: As we have established, refined adamantite is a product of Allag. Of the empire's twilight years, in fact.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_048: It was a material which saw much use as part of the Allagans' efforts to extend beyond the bounds of this world─Dalamud, of course, being the most prominent.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_049: Of those who would push further─expand Allag's empire to encompass the heavens and the stars above─perhaps the greatest was its infamous technologist, Amon.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_A1_000_051: Amon wanted to travel the sea of stars?
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_A1_000_052: Did he remember his life as Hermes?
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_053: He did. He must have had his own reasons, however, for there is no evidence to suggest that he retained memories of his life as an ancient.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_054: I believe he had his own reasons. There is no evidence to suggest that he retained memories of his former life.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_055: He only joined the Ascians once the empire was all but dust, as you know.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_056: If not his memory, though, what drove him to pursue the idea with such fervor?
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_057: This may seem far-fetched, but what if souls, like minds, have...a personality, so to speak? A natural disposition towards which they are inclined?
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_058: We know with relative certainty that it was the gross decadence and inexorable decline of Allag that moved Amon to resurrect Emperor Xande.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_059: The empire's people spoke lightly of death and destruction, experimenting on those they deemed beneath them to fill the emptiness in their hearts.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_060: In facilitating Xande's return, Amon provided these languid souls with the means to free themselves from the mire of their own indolence.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_061: ...Or would have, had not Xande been convinced by his own death that life itself was meaningless.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_062: Amon's desire for his countrymen to conquer the heavens could only be a means to the same end─to instill the people with new purpose.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_063: Like Hermes before him, Amon was appalled by how those around him lived, but could never bring himself to believe that those lives were devoid of meaning.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_064: And both of them sought that meaning, that hope, in the distant stars.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_066: Ultimately, it is the consequences of their actions which matter. Their motives are of no moment. And yet...
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_067: To reach those stars on wings of adamantite. To travel to the ends of creation and beyond. The promise of hope everlasting...that much I do understand.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_068: But enough musing for now. Why don't we see how Kokkol is getting on?
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_070: I did thoroughly brief Kokkol on refined adamantite's history. I only volunteered to go to the reactor because I was finished and there was little else to do.
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_GRAHATIA_000_071: Hopefully that dispels any misapprehensions that I was kicked out for prattling on...
TEXT_AKTKMF109_04447_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_0: Whew! I can feel those flames a-blazin' from here!
Glad you found someone capable, G'raha, but there's not much left for you lot to do.
'Less you can conjure up that refined adamantite any faster...?
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_GRAHATIA_000_000: I did thoroughly brief Kokkol on refined adamantite's history. I only volunteered to go to the reactor because I had finished and there was little else to do.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_GRAHATIA_000_001: Hopefully that dispels any misapprehensions that I was kicked out for prattling on...
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_0: <sigh> I do trust you to deliver on your promise, I do. Only...
I hate waitin'! I want that adamantite, and I want it now!
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_GRAHATIA_000_012: We...er, share your impatience, I assure you. Is there truly nothing else we can assist with in the meantime?
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_0: I wish! This sittin' about's unbearable. Pity the Forum frowns on recreational explosions...
Well, so long as they can't prove it was premeditated. Get you gone─I've mistakes to make!
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_GRAHATIA_000_015: ...In that case, I suppose I should go and return the key to the reactor. I'll have one more look to make sure that nothing has gone wrong. Unintentionally or otherwise.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_GRAHATIA_000_016: I'm certain there are better uses for your time, however. I will join you in Sharlayan Hamlet anon!
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_0: Any smoke risin' from the building behind me will be entirely unrelated to what I didn't say, got it?
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_SYSTEM_000_030: If you wait here, your companions are bound to turn up sooner or later...
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALISAIE_000_040: I had no idea how massive a weight it was until he lifted it off my shoulders... But more importantly, his words were an affirmation that the path we walk is the right one.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALISAIE_000_041: A part of me might have been satisfied so long as my family and friends survived the Final Days. But to save this star is what we all want most, and if those same people believe that I can help see it done, who am I to say otherwise?
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALISAIE_000_042: Come what may, I will fight for this world of ours until the very end.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_THANCRED_000_045: If I never see another crate again, it will be too soon.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_URIANGER_000_050: Unaided, we Scions could never have gathered such a bounty. Refined adamantite, relics sacred and ancient alike...
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_YSHTOLA_000_055: Lyse sent a letter along with Gridania's contribution. It seems she traveled there to aid in their adamantite recovery.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_YSHTOLA_000_056: Evidently, journeying to Gridania was quite the trial. As was getting into the Dalamud shard. As was reaching its depths...
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_YSHTOLA_000_057: I suspect she will have few kind words to say about the Allagans when next we meet.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_GRAHATIA_000_060: I cannot wait to see what our friends from the Ironworks do with the ship!
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ESTINIEN_000_065: The time has come to claim our prize. Are you prepared?
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_KRILE_000_070: I apologize for not informing you earlier of Erenville's involvement. He was something of a contingency plan.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_KRILE_000_071: Thank goodness we had him and his fellow gleaners to hand, though. It would have been monstrously difficult to locate Cid and transport the Hannish delegation here otherwise...
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_TATARU_000_075: <cough> My throat hurts from directing so many people to Labyrinthos...but that only proves we got our money's worth!
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALPHINAUD_000_080: We've finally managed to clear the harbor, which means the rest is in the engineers' capable hands.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALPHINAUD_000_081: Meanwhile, Father has issued to us an invitation.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALPHINAUD_000_082: As was agreed, he will reveal the means by which Hydaelyn may be contacted.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALPHINAUD_000_083: We are to meet him at Aporia when we're ready. Given the vital knowledge She holds, I suggest we leave without delay.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALPHINAUD_000_084: It transpires, however, that the Forum's method for speaking with Her is not without risks. I am curious to hear what those might entail─but regardless, be warned.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_TATARU_000_085: Most of those who arrived with the adamantite have offered to stay and see to any remaining tasks that need doing.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_TATARU_000_086: The Forum has already asked for my assistance in overseeing the process, so you needn't worry about a thing!
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALPHINAUD_000_087: Thank you, Tataru. We're off to Aporia, then!
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_TATARU_000_090: I don't want any of you getting hurt─but I do hope you'll wring as much information out of Hydaelyn as you can. For all we know, this is the one and only opportunity we'll get.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_FOURCHENAULT_000_10: . I have already shown the others inside.
You will want to speak with Clarilaine. She has the key to the lift, and can send you down after me.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_CLARILAINE_000_110: You're with Master Fourchenault, yes? Just step inside the lift here.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_CLARILAINE_000_120: You are welcome to use the lift whenever you like.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_FOURCHENAULT_000_13: From here, we proceed to the heart of Labyrinthos, and its most closely guarded secret─Thaumazein.
It marks the beginning and end of our efforts─whence we delved to seek audience with the star, and whence we will embark on our journey to the heavens.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_FOURCHENAULT_000_14: I bid you welcome to Thaumazein. Direct your attention toward its center to behold the ark over which we have long labored.

As you can see, 'twas designed as a medium-sized craft, the better to reduce fuel consumption. Miniaturizing magicks have been applied to its interior to ensure that the thrust-to-weight ratio does not place too great a limitation on its freight capacity.
The aetherburner, as you know, has been removed for further modification, but we shall reattach it soon enough.
I have received word that Kokkol and several of your allies are working on it with an intense fervor.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALPHINAUD_000_144: They are sure to see it done. 'Twas by their expertise that many a prior disaster was averted.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALPHINAUD_000_145: If anything, I fear they will not afford us much time for speaking with Hydaelyn ere they finish...
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_FOURCHENAULT_000_14: Point taken. Let us move on. I must warn you again, however, that even with the benefit of our device, to treat with Her is not a simple feat.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALPHINAUD_000_150: To think how many generations labored for this end...and that we aim higher still.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALPHINAUD_000_151: We must spare no preparation─and that means speaking with Hydaelyn, no matter the cost.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALISAIE_000_155: I can well imagine the zeal with which they're working on the aetherburner, and all I can say is that I'm glad we have something to do other than get in their way.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ALISAIE_000_156: Once it's ready, we'll see to it that the ship is put to good use!
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_THANCRED_000_160: I doubt this is what Erenville meant when he said that there remains much we do not know, but I still can't believe everything that was hidden underneath the city this entire time.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_URIANGER_000_165: 'Twould seem enchantments most advanced have been woven into the ship's very bones. Wilfsunn and Bloewyda were doubtless called upon for their expertise in teleportation magicks...
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_YSHTOLA_000_170: We must learn of Hydaelyn's greater plan. We can only hope that She also knows the current location of Meteion...
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_YSHTOLA_000_171: ...And we can do neither if we do not focus on whatever trial awaits us within.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_GRAHATIA_000_175: It was the Allagans who first combined the mechanical and aetherial sciences into a revolutionary discipline.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_GRAHATIA_000_176: Given that this ship is nothing short of a technological marvel in that precise vein, Allagan salvage should suit it well.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_ESTINIEN_000_180: You feel it too, don't you? The ship is impressive, but it pales in comparison to the vast primordial power beneath our feet...
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_KRILE_000_185: If meeting Hydaelyn proves difficult even for the Forum, then perhaps I─
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_KRILE_000_186: Oh, 'tis an unformed idea at this phase, I'm afraid. I will duly inform you if anything comes of it.
TEXT_AKTKMF110_04448_FOURCHENAULT_000_19: I have done what I can to impress upon you the gravity of what lies ahead.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_000: To think how many generations labored for this end...and that we aim higher still.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_001: We must spare no preparation─and that means speaking with Hydaelyn, no matter the cost.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_005: I can well imagine the zeal with which they're working on the aetherburner, and all I can say is that I'm glad we have something to do other than get in their way.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_006: Once it's ready, we'll see to it that the ship is put to good use!
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_010: I doubt this is what Erenville meant when he said that there remains much we do not know, but I still can't believe everything that was hidden underneath the city this entire time.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_015: 'Twould seem enchantments most advanced have been woven into the ship's very bones. Wilfsunn and Bloewyda were doubtless called upon for their expertise in teleportation magicks...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_020: We must learn of Hydaelyn's greater plan. We can only hope that She also knows the current location of Meteion...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_021: ...And we can do neither if we do not focus on whatever trial awaits us within.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_025: It was the Allagans who first combined the mechanical and aetherial sciences into a revolutionary discipline.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_026: Given that this ship is nothing short of a technological marvel in that precise vein, Allagan salvage should suit it well.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ESTINIEN_000_030: You feel it too, don't you? The ship is impressive, but it pales in comparison to the vast primordial power beneath our feet...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_035: If meeting Hydaelyn proves difficult even for the Forum, then perhaps I─
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_036: Oh, 'tis an unformed idea at this phase, I'm afraid. I will duly inform you if anything comes of it.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_FOURCHENAULT_000_04: We make for the lift at the center of this chamber. Come.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_050: This doesn't strike me as particularly dangerous, unless one is afraid of lifts.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_055: With the ship in the way, I didn't even notice this was here!
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_060: They must employ a full cohort of engineers just to maintain the lifts...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_065: As a means of communing with the heart of the star, 'tis disappointingly mechanical in design...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_070: The aether here is more brilliant than I have ever seen.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_075: ...Am I the only one feeling terribly nervous? Surely not.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ESTINIEN_000_080: I doubt there's anything worth worrying over. Not for Hydaelyn's champion, at any rate.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_085: I should hope that Master Fourchenault has more to share ere sending anyone stumbling into the aetherial sea.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_FOURCHENAULT_000_09: As you all know, alongside our physical world exists an aetherial plane─what we refer to as the “aetherial sea.”
At the heart of the star, the physical and aetherial are one and the same. Thus, the deeper we go, the easier it becomes to pass between said planes.
We utilized this principle in constructing the Antitower, and once more here in Thaumazein.
No sooner did the Forum decide that an exodus from the star would be necessary than it began work on this facility.
Our work culminated in a device that allowed us to peer deeper into the aetherial sea than ever before, in search of Hydaelyn's ever-fainter echoes...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_096: And you communicate with Her through this device?
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_FOURCHENAULT_000_09: For a time, yes, but since the Seventh Umbral Calamity, it has been rare to hear even a whisper.
If you wish to reach Her, you must journey closer to the center of the star than we have ever dared, beyond the Aitiascope.
Even so, I make no guarantee that you will find Her. Nor of your safety─not so deep in the aetherial sea.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_100: We understand. But if we are to deliver this world, we have no choice but to try.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_FOURCHENAULT_000_10: ...I know. I only wish we could do more than observe your progress from afar.
The Aitiascope's ocular lens, by which we may peer into the aetherial sea without placing ourselves at hazard, lies above us. Through it, we can watch and guide you.

In those swirling depths, there are pockets of aether so dense and turbulent that they can unravel one's soul. If we determine that you are at risk of coming into contact with such a pocket, we will recall you with teleportation magicks.

To that end, it would be best if one familiar with the composition of your souls remained here to assist in assessing said risk. Otherwise, there is an increased probability that we will extract you too early...or too late.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_106: I have thought upon this much, and...in truth, I do not believe that I am fit to join you in the trials ahead.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_107: The events at the Tower of Babil drained me, yes, but even before that, your capabilities far outstripped my own.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_108: This is no time to have a weak link in our vanguard. No matter how much she may wish it were otherwise.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_109: ...If I assist in the manner that Master Fourchenault has laid out, however, I may still be of use.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_110: Will you trust in me to do so?
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_111: I can think of none I'd trust more! Compared to all that effort you put into keeping us alive while our souls were in the First, preventing us from dissolving into aether on a single expedition ought to pose no challenge at all.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ESTINIEN_000_112: And even if we did, I expect you would hunt us down and restore us to health somehow.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_113: You flatter me! But rest assured that I will be keeping a close eye on all of you.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_FOURCHENAULT_000_11: Those in ages past referred to the aetherial sea as the “Underworld,” our final resting place.
In its embrace is memory washed away, leaving only the purity of one's soul...or so we believe.
Yet what of these memories? Few think to ask what becomes of them, cast adrift on aetherial tides.
Some theorize that they linger for some time─those associated with strong sentiment, in particular.
In those depths, memories of the departed may even coalesce around you, for hatred or for love.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_FOURCHENAULT_000_12: Thus do I caution you to be wary─but also to have faith. Remember those who did gladly extend a hand to you, that they may lift you up once more.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_A1_000_132: Form a party and enter the Aitiascope.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_140: We have always tried to do the right thing...but we have not always been kind, nor merciful.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_141: I should not be surprised if some few harbored resentment for us as they passed on...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_142: We must face these truths, and meet them as they come.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_145: Maybe our enemies are down there. But if we've beaten them once, we can beat them again.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_146: I'm more concerned about our meeting with Hydaelyn. We may find our truth, but what if...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_147: ...No, I would rather not think on it. Let us move on.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_150: If some part of them remains in the aetherial sea, do you think...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_151: ...Forgive me. That's not why we're here. And no matter what happens, she'll always be with us─with Ryne, most of all.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_152: She'd tell us to live for the here and now. To do what must be done. And we will.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_155: If Hydaelyn be unwilling or unable to divulge Meteion's location, I shall see our comrades delivered to the moon, one and all.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_156: I pray, however, that this eventuality doth not come to pass.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_157: While even a sliver of hope remaineth, we must needs fight on.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_160: I now understand why these facilities are so heavily guarded.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_161: If it fell into the wrong hands, the wisdom of Hydaelyn could be dangerous, 'tis true...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_162: However, that danger is naught compared to what would result should the commonfolk en masse venture into the aetherial sea unprepared─which they most certainly would, if they thought it would allow them to speak to the dead!
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_163: Once that secret got out, no rational argument could dissuade people from wanting to see their loved ones, no matter how ephemeral the meeting.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_165: I cannot help but think of those who were transformed into beasts.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_166: Their aether dissolved into nothingness, their souls forever lost...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_167: Yet I daresay Fandaniel still wanders the aetherial sea. As do ancients who gave rise to Zodiark, setting in motion so many cataclysmic events...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_168: If there is a justice or morality at work that governs our fates, I do not know it. Nor do I think any man ever will.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ESTINIEN_000_170: I've seen more than enough death in my time. Friends, enemies...far too many to count.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ESTINIEN_000_171: Once, revenge was all I lived for. All that hate, all that anger...what good did it do?
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ESTINIEN_000_172: None, that's what. Way I see it, there's no point living for the past. It's the present that needs protecting.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_180: I hope to guide you via linkpearl while you're inside, but given the density of the aether, I'm not sure how long the connection will hold.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_181: Even if you can't hear me, however, be assured that I am watching over you.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_FOURCHENAULT_000_18: Once you are below, you should proceed through the Aitiascope to the central observatory.
That is where the objective lens is located. We can manipulate it to direct an aetherial current deeper into the sea.
Though I shall assist you in every way possible, this is your journey to make. When you are ready, I bid you step forth.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_SYSTEM_000_200: During this quest and when using the Duty Support system, you have the opportunity to undertake this trial with a party of Scions. Some of these allies' roles will differ from those you are normally able to select.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_SYSTEM_000_201: Additionally, you may now enter the Aitiascope with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_A3_000_212: Form a party and face Hydaelyn.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_220: If strength is the courage to confront your failings and accept that you are worthy of another chance...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_221: To rise from the ashes while the fire still burns...bloodied but unbowed...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_222: Then my friends have made me strong.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_225: Emet-Selch called us incomplete. “Pitiful creatures,” he said, and maybe we are.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_226: Pain, grief, fear... They walk with us wherever we go.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_227: But we proved to him that we deserve to live, and we'll prove it to Hydaelyn, Meteion...to the universe itself, if we must!
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_230: Pain and despair...aye, we're old friends. I've lost count of the times I've cursed my own powerlessness.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_231: But it's the blessed moments in between that I choose to hold in my heart. Memories...and possibilities. I fight to keep those things alive.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_232: Minfilia and Ryne─to say nothing of you lot, I know─would never settle for less.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_240: Hmm... Methinks we possess a surfeit of healers.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_241: Perhaps I shall call upon mine Amber Carbuncle in lieu of celestial blessings...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_242: Fear not─from unity and camaraderie doth my strength arise, not my choice of magicks.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_245: Should we bring our singular talents to bear as one, even gods may fall.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_246: ...Nevertheless, I prithee throw thyself not into peril, lest our curative resources be spent.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_250: From the ruins of a sundered paradise did She rise, to grant this star new life.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_251: As its will, long has She labored to guide Her children.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_252: Make no mistake─this trial puts to proof Hydaelyn's own faith.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_255: Never─in the past, present, or future─have I found only happiness. To live is to be ever beset by hardships great and small.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_256: Yet it is in adversity we find the strength to strive for the next moment of peace, and the next, no matter what trials we face.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_257: By this strength have the will of gods been defied and the fortunes of men been forever changed. May it be so again this day.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ESTINIEN_000_260: What─surprised to hear me and “love” mentioned in the same breath?
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ESTINIEN_000_261: I've not a heart of stone. Even in my darkest hour, there were people I cared for. Mentors, comrades... That mad woman who gave her life for us...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ESTINIEN_000_262: Then you and Alphinaud threw my eyes off a bridge, and I've never known peace since.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_270: She has given us all She can.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_271: We must share what we know with Father and the Loporrits at once, that it not go to waste.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALISAIE_000_275: I will keep Hydaelyn's words in my heart─as talisman and lodestone both.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_280: She and Hydaelyn were two of a kind, weren't they?
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_281: Full of love for the star and its people. Always holding to hope for our future...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_URIANGER_000_285: 'Tis fortunate that Fourchenault hath kept Livingway apprised of our progress. We require the Loporrits' aid more than ever.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_290: Far be it from me to refute Hydaelyn's own words... Yet even if Her actions were neither kind nor just, we can yet give them a nobler meaning.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_YSHTOLA_000_291: We can make Her faith the salvation of mankind.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_300: If dynamis is ruled by emotion, perhaps prayer has more tangible results than I suspected─albeit ones that are not always obvious to us.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_301: In which case, we may hope that Hydaelyn's wishes continue to move the hearts of men as they set forth time and time again.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ESTINIEN_000_305: A bit small for a welcoming party, but I've never been one for crowds.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_310: Thank goodness! I never would have forgiven myself had any of you come to harm.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_LIVINGWAY_000_315: ! Did you meet Hydaelyn? Pray tell─how is She?
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_FOURCHENAULT_000_32: I am glad to see you well. Though we could roughly place your souls, deep as you went, we could neither see nor hear you...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_KRILE_000_321: The fluctuations in your aether near the end gave me quite a fright! What in the world happened?
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_LIVINGWAY_000_322: You mean to say Hydaelyn is...is...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_LIVINGWAY_000_323: No, there's no time to feel our feelings! We must carry out Hydaelyn's will without delay.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_LIVINGWAY_000_324: We'll find Meteion if it's the last thing we do!
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_LIVINGWAY_000_325: ...If you wouldn't mind handing over the crystal, that is. The fancy navigatory one.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_FOURCHENAULT_000_32: To the edge of the universe, where congregates the despair of countless stars... You are determined to see this through?
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_327: We are. Should words fail us, we will fight...to the bitter end.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_328: I know that it pains you to accept this. Would that I need ask nothing more of you...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_ALPHINAUD_000_329: Yet we have only two means to travel the great expanse─the moon, and Sharlayan's ark. I am all too aware that without both of them, there will be no exodus...but I nevertheless beg you to honor the agreement we made.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_FOURCHENAULT_000_33: The Forum's decision will be honored. You have earned the right to use the ship as you see fit, and I could not rescind it even if I wanted to.
As it happens, I do not, and would do all within my power to aid your cause.
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_LIVINGWAY_000_332: With that settled, might I suggest you rest a while?
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_LIVINGWAY_000_333: Proving oneself to Hydaelyn is never easy...and despite our unparalleled genius, we'll need a day to make the necessary calculations. You may as well take advantage of it!
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_GRAHATIA_000_334: You can chart a course through the sea of stars in a single day!? Ye gods...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_THANCRED_000_335: Shall we head above ground for some fresh air, then? And perhaps a nap...
TEXT_AKTKMF111_04449_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_3: I heard about your foray into the aetherial sea. The Students have ventured far and wide, but never quite so deep as that!
Are you experiencing any aftereffects from your prolonged exposure? Nausea? Dizziness? Hauntings? Hmm...
Well, have a pleasant sleep! And if you do experience any unusual phenomena, please let me know. I shall add it to our records!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_000: A great many of the helping hands that delivered the adamantite are still here in Sharlayan, and I for one couldn't be happier!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_001: Between the aetherburner to be refurbished, supplies to be transported, and meals to be prepared, we need all the assistance we can get.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_002: Even Lord Emmanellain has been doing his part, albeit at a snail's pace. Still, it's the thought that counts...but a bit more effort wouldn't go amiss.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_KRILE_000_010: . I trust you've had a good rest?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_KRILE_000_011: An envoy of Master Fourchenault's arrived not along ago with a message: the Loporrits have determined Meteion's location.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_KRILE_000_012: We've been asked to gather at the Rostra. I'll meet you there, along with the others.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Before coming, I thought to inquire after our comrades abroad. It seems that the effects of the Final Days have been observed further and further north of Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ALPHINAUD_000_021: For a blessing, those regions are largely uninhabited...but in any event, we mustn't misinterpret this as a geographical spread. There is no telling where in the world the phenomenon will strike next, unfortunately.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ALISAIE_000_025: Gods, I can hardly believe the Loporrits managed to find Meteion out there, hidden among the stars. The sheer distances involved are mind-boggling.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_THANCRED_000_030: Not feeling any ill effects from the Aitiascope, are you? After playing test subject for those new aetherytes, even the mention of aether sickness makes me feel a little queasy.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_URIANGER_000_035: I fear our recent travails within Labyrinthos and the aetherial sea have taken their toll on my mind, for last night I received a visitor in my dreams. Moenbryda...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_URIANGER_000_036: A vision not of the woman she was, nay, but the woman she would have become...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_YSHTOLA_000_040: Hydaelyn─the heart of this star─is gone... And yet, on the morrow, the sun will rise, and life will go on.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_YSHTOLA_000_041: When I look upon Sharlayan and its idyllic surrounds, there are moments when Her absence feels unreal. As do the Final Days. Would that it were so...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_GRAHATIA_000_045: How did you sleep? Well, I should hope. It's likely the last opportunity we will have to take a proper rest for quite some time.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_GRAHATIA_000_046: I...probably could have done with a few more winks myself. Ugh...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_GRAHATIA_000_047: The thought of what's to come was keeping me awake, you see. So, I thought to do a bit of research, hoping I might eventually feel weary enough to doze off.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_GRAHATIA_000_048: But before I realized it, it was already morning... No need to scold me─I already regret it, and will probably only feel that regret more keenly as the day wears on.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ESTINIEN_000_050: Since the Final Days first manifested, we've been tested as never before. Even more so in your case.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ESTINIEN_000_051: Nevertheless, our work is far from over. We cannot afford to falter now, not when the end is in sight.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_KRILE_000_055: While the Forum is not here in its entirety to brood and glare at us, Master Barnier's presence alone is enough to put me on edge.
