TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_060: What took you so long? We have much to discuss and scant time to do it.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BARNIER_000_065: If you would know the reason for this assembly, you had better ask Master Leveilleur.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_FOURCHENAULT_000_07: Everyone appears to be present and accounted for. Good.
As you know, the Loporrits have deduced the whereabouts of Meteion by means of a crystal bequeathed to us by Hydaelyn Herself.
Your quarry's location is a place far beyond the moon, in the farthest reaches of the sea of stars, at the edge of creation.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_YSHTOLA_000_074: Indeed... How then are we to reach it?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_075: An excellent question! Luckily for you, I have an equally excellent answer.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_076: In theory, with its advanced propulsion systems, the moon is capable of delivering you to Ultima Thule, but the myriad other facilities housed within would greatly impede travel through the sea of stars.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_077: Even the Mothercrystal may not possess aether enough to bear so massive a vessel to our destination and back.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_078: However, if we integrate our hyperhopper into your aetherburner...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_079: We should be able to fire things up and jump our way to the end of the universe in no time!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_FOURCHENAULT_000_08: Bear in mind this decision was not made solely at my discretion, but with the consent of the Forum.
Hearing the Loporrit's proposal, the Forum was faced with a grave decision.
To commit the ark to this endeavor would mean abandoning both our plans to evacuate to the moon, and to resettle on another star. Needless to say, the proposition invited fierce debate.
In the end, however, the Forum was swayed by the simple fact that Hydaelyn believed you possessed of the strength needed to overcome this crisis.

The great exodus was, after all, a plan of Hydaelyn's own making. Therefore, if in the eleventh hour She would proffer another means by which we may seek salvation, we would be fools to dismiss it out of hand.
Indeed, She sacrificed everything─Her very existence─to avert the destruction of this star.
That is why we have chosen to place our faith in Hydaelyn. In you. The ark will be made ready for your voyage to Ultima Thule.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ALISAIE_000_088: What of all the people that have labored so tirelessly to prepare for the evacuation? They must be furious.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_FOURCHENAULT_000_08: I would not be so sure. They have not forgotten your deeds on the Magna Glacies.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_FOURCHENAULT_000_09: Nor did your instrumental role in orchestrating the delivery of adamantite go unnoticed.
No, the people do not protest─quite the contrary. They have expressed unwavering support for you and your mission.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_URIANGER_000_092: Are the Loporrits too willing to abandon the exodus?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_093: Were you not listening when we said we were born of Hydaelyn's love for Etheirys and its people?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_094: If it means your survival, we would do anything to help.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_095: And you'll most certainly have need of our expertise where you're going. There's no guarantee Ultima Thule is a place that supports life, an otherwise vexing problem our know-how can remedy.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_096: Besides, Hydaelyn chose us to lead the way to Meteion. Why else would She give you a crystal only we can decipher?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_097: But more importantly, we were perfectly content to evacuate Etheirys until you brought us here, Urianger. And now we're enamored with the place, so what choice do we have but to save it?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_FOURCHENAULT_000_09: Of course, none of this is possible without you and the Scions, so I must ask─are you certain you wish to do this?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_A1_000_100: You couldn't stop us if you tried.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_A1_000_101: We'll avert the Final Days─whatever it takes!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_FOURCHENAULT_000_10: Very well. We shall inform the Forum of your decision, and begin preparations to bolster the ark with the, ah...“hyperhopper.”
The Loporrits will coordinate with the Ilsabard contingent to have the necessary components transported via the Tower of Babil.
Of course, it will take time until the work is complete.
For now, pray take your ease.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_YSHTOLA_000_107: 'Twould seem there is naught to do but rest and prepare. Shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_FOURCHENAULT_000_11: There is much to be done before the ark can be made ready for your voyage.
Would that I could be afforded time to speak with Alphinaud and Alisaie. Alas...
I can but pray they find a moment of quiet calm before the journey to come.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_LIVINGWAY_000_115: No need to worry about lending a hand with the hyperhopper. We already have more than enough help, so go and relax while you still can!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BARNIER_000_120: As you can imagine, not all Forum members were willing to endorse this plan.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BARNIER_000_121: Through no fault of yours, of course. Given what is at stake, it is only natural that opinions are divided.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BARNIER_000_122: That said, the final decision was reached with an overwhelming majority, much to my surprise.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ALISAIE_000_125: I wasn't expecting to have time on our hands. What should we do...?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_THANCRED_000_130: A rare opportunity to rest. I say we make the most of it.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_URIANGER_000_135: The Forum hath placed the fate of mankind in our hands. We must not betray their faith.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_YSHTOLA_000_140: I should very much like to speak with the Loporrits once their work is complete.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_YSHTOLA_000_141: 'Tis plain Hydaelyn has entrusted them with a great deal of knowledge, and I suspect there is more they could teach us.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_GRAHATIA_000_145: Hmmm... Perhaps now I can finish that book I was reading...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_GRAHATIA_000_146: Wh-What? Oh, pay me no mind. I'm sure you have better things to do with the time afforded us.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ESTINIEN_000_150: They bid us rest, but I'd much rather find something productive to do.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ESTINIEN_000_151: Hm. I suppose now is as good a time as any to hone my lance. Not that I've ever found it to be dull. Still, it eases my mind on the eve of battle.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_KRILE_000_155: In all honesty, I didn't think the Forum would approve this measure, and certainly not by such a large margin. I daresay, though, that Master Fourchenault's impassioned recounting of your audience with Hydaelyn helped sway the vote.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_KRILE_000_156: He has a way with words, after all. Where did you think Alphinaud got it from?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ALPHINAUD_000_160: Ere we depart, we must leave nothing undone.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_YSHTOLA_000_161: Quite, though it is difficult to conceive of how one can best prepare to brave a domain where dynamis governs all.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_YSHTOLA_000_162: Nevertheless, Hydaelyn deemed us worthy of the trials that await.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_YSHTOLA_000_163: For lack of any other feasible options at this late stage...let us trust in Her judgment and face Meteion as we are.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ALISAIE_000_164: Which leaves the not-so-small task of coordinating our efforts here to you and Tataru.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ALISAIE_000_165: If all goes to plan, we'll be back before you know it.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_KRILE_000_167: We will be praying for your safe return. Mayhap it will affect the dynamis for the better.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_ALPHINAUD_000_168: With that settled, we should get some rest, and make the most of the time we've been afforded.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_171: You were in there for so long, I started to worry. What did they have to say?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_172: The edge of creation. I see...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_173: Rest assured everything will remain in order until you return─and you will return.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_174: Actually, , could I borrow you for a moment?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_THANCRED_000_175: Looks like your plans for the interim are decided. When the two of you have finished, meet us back at the Baldesion Annex, all right?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_176: Come with me to the Agora. I have something to show you!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSARUDH_000_180: Did someone move the crate? I could have sworn it was here.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_191: I've always done my best to provide the Scions with fashionable attire, but in your case specifically, I make an extra effort to strive for the most functional-yet-stylish clothing one could ask for. Not that I'm playing favorites, but you are the Warrior of Light!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_192: Faced with this unprecedented crisis, I knew you would need an ensemble unlike anything I've created before, and that I wouldn't be able to do it alone.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_193: And so, after enlisting the aid of the world's finest artisans, I finally completed my career-defining masterpiece!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_194: But then inspiration struck, and I saw a golden opportunity just begging to be seized...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_195: With the help of some Thavnairian refugees, I decided to set up shop here in Sharlayan!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_196: Of course, I would never charge you for any of our works. Perish the thought!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_197: Varsarudh. How are things coming along?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSARUDH_000_198: Everything is in order, Mistress Tataru. We'll be ready to open shortly.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_199: Which is why I brought you here─to be our very first patron. Would you mind waiting here a moment longer?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_210: If you could wait here just a short while longer, we'll have everything up and running in no time!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_SYSTEM_000_220: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_Q2_000_221: Wait for Tataru's boutique to open?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_222: (-???-)Ah, I did not expect to find you here.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_223: I imagine Nidhana would also wish to offer her regards. Alas, after delivering our dragon scales to the engineers, she remained to assist with their work on the aetherburner.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_224: This simulacrum, too, will stay in Sharlayan, while I oversee matters in Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_225: It is a rather convenient means to keep abreast of developments pertaining to the Final Days or anything else.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_226: It also allows me, after a fashion, to watch over my people in this distant land.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_227: Varshahn, I was hoping you'd stop by! I can't thank you enough for allowing your artisans to work with me here at the boutique.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_228: Please, it is I who should be thanking you. This establishment has restored a sense of normalcy to their lives. You have blessed them with newfound purpose, and a means by which to support themselves in these troubled times.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_229: What's more, when they at last return home to Radz-at-Han, the experience and knowledge they have gained in your employ will no doubt prove a boon to the artistry and commerce of our land.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_230: In fact, I came here to see how your new employees are settling in, and to express my gratitude for granting them this opportunity.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_231: It's an opportunity for me as well, believe you me! Your artisans have taught me so much about Thavnairian craftsmanship. Their resourcefulness and ingenuity are nothing short of inspiring.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_232: I can't wait to see what kind of wonders we come up with!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_233: I pray you every success in your endeavors, Mistress Tataru.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_234: Before coming here, I heard word of the Forum's decision. Of what will soon be attempted.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_235: It was only then that I finally understood why my father called this star the last bastion of hope.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_236: Indeed, it was the last bastion, for the flame of every other star he encountered had likely been extinguished.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_237: In the boundless dark, the light of brimming life must have been blinding in its splendor...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_238: You journey unto the heavens to protect that light. May the scales of my kin serve you well.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_239: I have faith you will prevail, and restore peace and tranquility to this star.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_A3_000_241: Would that Ahewann were alive to see it.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_A3_000_242: I should like to visit Radz-at-Han again when this is all over.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_A3_000_243: I worry your faith in me may be misplaced.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_244: I will not see his sacrifice squandered, nor shall I rest until Radz-at-Han is returned to its former glory.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_245: And we should be honored to receive you. There is still much of Radz-at-Han you have yet to see.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_246: Perish the thought. You are our salvation and our deliverance. My father would not have relinquished his scales otherwise.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSHAHN_000_247: Forgive me, but I must take my leave. Fare you well, and remember─the people of this star have not yet given up hope, and neither must you.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_248: (-???-)Ugh... Where must I go to get a meal with some flavor in this wasteland of taste...?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_249: , old ! My, whatever are you doing here?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_250: A new boutique, you say? Hmm... I had been meaning to expand my wardrobe. Yes, something with a little more flair, perhaps, befitting a man of my station.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_251: Though I have nowhere to flaunt said raiments so long as my confinement continues indefinitely. Aye, the young Lord Fortemps insists that, so long as there is work to be done, no matter how trivial, I must abide here in Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_252: Thus do I toil, though every fiber of my being rails against it. Why, I've even suffered the company of that brute Sicard to see supplies transported in a timely fashion.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_253: Yet he was the one granted leave this morning to participate in some supposed “covert operation.”
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_254: So I suffer instead for his otherwise welcome absence, now burdened with extra busywork. And without Honoroit here, there is no one to prepare my meals...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_255: I came here in the hopes of finding a nice café, perhaps. Alas, the Sharlayan delicacies I've sampled were lacking in every respect...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_A4_000_257: Have you tried Archon loaf? You can find it in all the shops.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_A4_000_258: If a hearty meal is what you're after, I'd suggest the Last Stand.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_259: Archon loaf? It sounds...sophisticated. Like me.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_260: I thank you for the suggestion. With a full belly, I daresay I can endure this purgatory, if only a while longer. Ta-ta, old !
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_261: The café over on the pier? Their cuisine didn't appear all that appetizing, but...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_EMMANELLAIN_000_262: If you vouch for their cooking, then perhaps I will give it a try. Thank you for the suggestion, and ta-ta for now, old !
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_263: (-???-)Well, well, is that  and Tataru I spy?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_264: Hancock!? What are you still doing here?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_265: You said you were returning immediately after dropping off your cargo.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_266: Yes, that was my original plan. After all, any expertise required aside from the delivery of goods is well beyond my purview.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_267: But what manner of entrepreneur would squander an opportunity to study the markets of the northern seas? Worry not─I will return straightways to Kugane once I have finished.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_268: Of course you would find a way to turn this crisis to your advantage.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_269: She wounds me, the industrious woman running a new boutique.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_270: I am not blind to the travails of those who fight on the front lines to deliver us from ruin.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_271: Indeed, I have every confidence they will succeed, and I would make myself─and my business─ready for their return.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_272: If you believe in them so devoutly, then why not put your money where your mouth is?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_274: There is naught more I can do to help ready the ark and her heroes for their maiden voyage, but on your return, I shall host a grand celebration in your honor at the Bokairo Inn.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_275: Accommodations are quite costly, given the reputation of said establishment, but the East Aldenard Trading Company would be honored to foot the bill.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_A5_000_277: I appreciate the gesture, but no thank you.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_279: A pity. I'm rather fond of the place myself! Nevertheless, I have no doubt we will find another time and cause for celebration soon enough.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_280: Oho! A  of tart tastes, I see.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_281: Yes, there will be lemoncakes and much, much more─the finest delicacies the world and Lord Lolorito have to offer.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_HANCOCK_000_282: But let us speak more of this upon your return, lest I draw even more of Tataru's ire. Until next we meet.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BIGGS_000_283: (-???-)Ah, . Decided to spend your time at the markets, did you?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_285: Biggs! Wedge! I take it work on the ark proceeds apace?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BIGGS_000_286: Aye, it does indeed. Collaborating with the greatest minds of Sharlayan and Radz-at-Han has been a rewarding experience. And that's to say nothing of what we've learned from the Loporrits.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BIGGS_000_287: The ark is unlike anything we've ever had the pleasure to work on. Even Nero was rendered speechless on more than one occasion.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BIGGS_000_288: I can't wait for you to see it!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_WEDGE_000_289: And you'll never guess who paid us a visit before we came to Sharlayan─Alpha! I think he sensed the coming danger and returned to check on us.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_WEDGE_000_290: He was always one to turn up in a time of need, and I suppose that's why he decided to join us here in Sharlayan. Good thing, too. I don't know how he does it, but he has a knack for brightening your day just by being there.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BIGGS_000_291: It's still hard to believe we have the means to send you off into the great expanse, though. To the farthest known reaches of...well...everything!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BIGGS_000_292: I never thought I'd live to see such marvels, yet here I am.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BIGGS_000_293: More often than not, you and the Scions are the catalyst that sparks the need for these great innovations. To think how much I'd've missed out on had I not been a member of the Ironworks...
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_WEDGE_000_294: An awful lot of work, to be fair. And the privilege of being worked like a cart chocobo... <mumble> <mumble>
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BIGGS_000_296: As busy as we've been, I wish there was more we could do for you, .
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BIGGS_000_297: But no matter what happens, we have to keep believing. For a brighter future.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_A6_000_299: That we do, my friend. That we do.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_A6_000_300: And one filled with even more adventure!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_301: When you head back, would you tell the engineers I'll be along shortly with refreshments?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_BIGGS_000_302: That's very kind of you, Tataru─they'll be glad to hear it. And on that note, Wedge and I should get going. Still a few more supplies to gather before we return.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSARUDH_000_303: Terribly sorry for the wait. Right this way, if you please.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_304: Right! I don't believe the two of you have been formally introduced. This is Varsarudh, from Palaka's Stand.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSARUDH_000_308: The pleasure is mine. Thanks to Mistress Tataru, I and many of my friends have found gainful employment in this foreign land.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSARUDH_000_309: Ah, yes... It was you who helped us at Purusa, and again when crossing the ice fields, was it not?
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSARUDH_000_310: I doubt we exchanged little more than glances then, but it is kind of you to remember me.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSARUDH_000_311: Thanks to Mistress Tataru, I and many of my friends have found gainful employment in this foreign land.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSARUDH_000_312: It is only natural to feel fear in the face of calamity. In such times, we must look to one another for strength and succor.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSARUDH_000_313: I know not whether we will come to call this place home or return to Thavnair. But we are here today, and are glad to have contributed to the cause.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_314: And contribute they did by helping to make your new garments as durable as possible.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_315: We put our hearts and souls into them, and I have every confidence they'll keep you safe in the battle to come.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_316: Gods... To think how far we've come since our humble beginnings at the Waking Sands.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_317: From the Rising Stones to the Falling Snows─and even a certain insufferable someone's Ruby Bazaar─we were always fortunate to find friends along the way.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_318: Even when you were swept away to the First, G'raha Tia was there to grant you sanctuary.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_319: I'll never forget the relief I felt when you all returned to us. I thought my heart would burst.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_320: Yours has been a long, long journey, and I've been privileged to watch─often with bated breath─as you persevered time and again.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_321: For all the joy we've shared, there's been much sorrow as well. But I've long since learned you can't have one without the other.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_322: Which is why I promise to send you off to the sea of stars with a smile!
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_323: And you can be certain I'll be the first one to welcome you back on your return.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_TATARU_000_330: Don't forget to pick up your clothes from Varsarudh before you leave. They were expertly tailored just for you.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_VARSARUDH_000_340: In addition to your new ensemble, we have raiments and weaponry for every need. So please, feel free to browse our stock.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_SYSTEM_000_341: You may now obtain job-specific gear from Varsarudh.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_SYSTEM_000_342: The weapons and gear obtained can be equipped at level 89. However, all item stats will be subject to item level sync.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_SYSTEM_000_343: Upon reaching level 90 with the corresponding job, these items will no longer be synced.
TEXT_AKTKMG101_04450_SYSTEM_000_344: Furthermore, the gear can be dyed upon completion of the role quests associated with said job.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_TATARU_000_000: I realize you've still got lots to do before you depart, so I won't keep you any longer.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_TATARU_000_001: I do hope you can find a moment for yourself, and that the others can as well. They said they were returning to the Baldesion Annex, though I doubt they stayed for long.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_TATARU_000_002: If you decide to go looking for them, I'd suggest speaking with Krile first. I'm sure they would have told her their plans.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_TATARU_000_010: Be sure to stop by the boutique if you find yourself in need of more equipment!
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_KRILE_000_020: You're back. I take it you received your gift from Tataru?
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_KRILE_000_021: It was a surprise long in the making, with many, many long hours of fretting to get everything just right. I'm glad to see it realized, and with great success.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_KRILE_000_022: If you're looking for the others, though, they've already taken their leave.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_KRILE_000_023: Y'shtola, Thancred, and Urianger have gone to the Last Stand for a bite to eat.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_KRILE_000_024: Alisaie and G'raha Tia, meanwhile, thought their time would be better spent poring over books at Noumenon.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_KRILE_000_025: As for Alphinaud and Estinien, well... They've elected to pay a visit to the Leveilleur estate, though Estinien seemed somewhat reluctant to go.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_KRILE_000_026: I'm sure they would all be glad for your company if you've a mind to seek them out.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_KRILE_000_027: Should you be feeling peckish, I'd suggest heading to the Last Stand before Y'shtola and the others finish eating. But above all else, it would be foolish to run headlong into battle a fatigued mess, so do remember to get a good night's sleep.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_KRILE_000_030: I've a few matters to attend to myself before you and the others depart for Ultima Thule. But rest assured, Tataru and I will keep everything in order while you're all away.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_YSHTOLA_000_035: Try as she might, Tataru had no chance of standing between you and a hearty meal. Don't worry, we saved some for you.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_URIANGER_000_040: Hast thou perchance had opportunity to partake of the rainbow pudding? Owing to its striking flavor and somewhat garish appearance, 'tis quite popular. Indeed, so popular that the Last Stand's stock hath been entirely exhausted.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_URIANGER_000_041: I should hope, at the very least, Puddingway did sup upon this most delectable of desserts.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_THANCRED_000_050: ! Come to make our trio a quartet, have you?
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_THANCRED_000_051: Please, have a seat, and we'll see about getting you a drink.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_THANCRED_000_060: You can always count on your friends to help you maintain perspective. A pity mine take a perverse pleasure in it.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_THANCRED_000_061: I'd like to think I give as good as I get─though I'd fare better with the occasional assist from our consummate nodder.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_THANCRED_000_062: But it's all in good fun. And I wouldn't have it any other way.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_URIANGER_000_065: I say, , whence came this─hic!─simulacrum that standeth beside thee?
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_URIANGER_000_066: ...I see falsely? But Y'shtola and Thancred, but moments ago, employed the selfsame doubling magick...
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_YSHTOLA_000_070: Leaving so soon? I suppose it's for the best...if you'd rather not explore the bottom of a bottle with Urianger.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_YSHTOLA_000_071: I daresay the others would welcome your company as well. If you can find them, that is.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_YSHTOLA_000_072: In any case, as long as you make the most of your time, then that is all that matters.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_YSHTOLA_000_080: We will remain here a while longer. At the very least, until Urianger finds his legs again.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_ESTINIEN_000_090: What...? Surely this isn't the first time you've seen me without my armor.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_SYSTEM_000_100: You try speaking with Alisaie, but she is fast asleep.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_ALISAIE_000_110: Gods, I didn't realize I was so tired. One moment I was resting my eyes, and the next...
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_ALISAIE_000_111: I should go and get some air. Maybe a quick bout of training. But not sleep. I'll sleep when I'm dead.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_GRAHATIA_000_115: That's enough reading for one day. As we don't know how long we'll be away, I'd best return these books before we depart.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_GRAHATIA_000_116: And eat. I'm absolutely famished. What about you?
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_GRAHATIA_000_117: I see... Perhaps I'll stop at the Last Stand on my way back.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_KRILE_000_120: If nothing else, these two seem to be in good spirits. Still, I'll see them back to the annex for some proper rest, even if I have to drag them by the ears.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_ALPHINAUD_000_130: A few of our comrades decided to remain a while in Sharlayan after making their deliveries. Did you happen to pass any on your way here?
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_ESTINIEN_000_135: All that remains is to return to the annex and give my armor one last polish. I expect Alphinaud has maintenance to carry out on those...floating things of his, too.
TEXT_AKTKMG102_04451_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_1: Welcome back, ! Returned to catch a final few winks before embarking on your mission, I presume?
You'll be happy to know your chambers have been cleaned, and fresh linens laid out.
I pray you enjoy the sweetest dreams on this final night before the big day...
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_0: I suppose this is where we part ways. For now, at least.
Would that I had sage words of wisdom to share ere you depart... Mayhap the teachings of Galuf Baldesion will suffice?
"Surrender not to anger or hatred,“ he said. ”Look beyond them, and there find true strength.“
What one sees beyond is open to interpretation, I think, but for me, it would be the things I cherish most in life. Things I believe are worth fighting for.
Something to consider as you venture unto the sea of stars.
The others are already off to Thaumazein. Best not keep them waiting, eh?
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Let us hear what Father has to say.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ALISAIE_000_020: They said work on the ark is finished, but you certainly wouldn't know by looking at it.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_THANCRED_000_025: I wasn't expecting quite so many people to be seeing us off.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_URIANGER_000_030: That even Wilfsunn and Bloewyda should be in attendance is most unexpected, but I am nonetheless heartened by their presence.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_YSHTOLA_000_035: This is the pinnacle of aetherochemistry. A synthesis of modern innovation and the ancient wisdom of Allag. The ark's engine appears to be capable of processing condensed aether in quantities I never thought possible.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_GRAHATIA_000_040: So this is the ship that will bear us unto Ultima Thule...
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ESTINIEN_000_045: For so many to see us off like this seems wholly unnecessary. Still...I'll not begrudge them for wishing us well.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_LIVINGWAY_000_050: The ark is missing one last─but very crucial─component before we are ready to take off. It should be arriving shortly.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_EMMANELLAIN_000_055: It's troubling enough that that brute Sicard left without warning, leaving me to carry all those cumbersome containers, but that he failed to be present to send you off is absurd. What could possibly be more deserving of his attention at a time like this?
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_KRILE_000_060: Quite the turnout, wouldn't you say? Then again, who wouldn't want to be present for a once-in-a-lifetime event?
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_TATARU_000_065: I'll send word to the Alliance leaders the very moment the ship takes off. Obviously they couldn't be here, but I'm sure they'll be cheering for you every step of the way.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_WILFSUNN_000_070: Moenbryda has been on my mind more often of late. How different her life might have been if not for our research into teleportation magicks. Perhaps she would never have gained an interest in aetherological studies...
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_WILFSUNN_000_071: But to abandon our work out of misplaced guilt for who she could have been would be a disservice to the memory of who she was.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_WILFSUNN_000_072: Nay, it was because of her that we found the resolve to carry on. And now we stand at the edge of a new frontier, with a ship ready to bear you unto the distant stars and beyond. This ark is as much her accomplishment as it is ours. I regret nothing.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_BLOEWYDA_000_075: We were quite fortunate the Loporrits' hyperhopper was based on principles similar to those of aetherology. Integrating it with the ark's existing systems might well have been impossible otherwise.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_BLOEWYDA_000_076: We may have Sharlayan's wealth of knowledge at our disposal, but theirs is technology far beyond anything we have ever studied.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_BLOEWYDA_000_077: You are familiar with teleportation magicks, yes? The momentary conversion of the body into aether that it may travel via the Lifestream from one physical point to another.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_BLOEWYDA_000_078: Their hyperhopper enables transport through a similar method─but not one involving the Lifestream. Rather, it utilizes highly condensed aether to create an aetherial current of its own!
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_BLOEWYDA_000_079: This current is exponentially faster and more powerful than the naturally occurring ones to which we are accustomed. So much so, in fact, that aetherial conversion of the physical form is not a prerequisite for traversal.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_BLOEWYDA_000_080: If you are concerned about side effects, such as aetherial sickness, you needn't be. You should emerge at your destination hale and whole...in theory. At the very least, I can assure you it is safer than the experimental aetherytes you used to reach Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_HOARYBOULDER_000_08: Though our fellow Scions couldn't be here, they wanted me to tell you that, no matter what calamity may befall us, they will never give up, and neither should you.
No matter how far you may go, we will be with you in spirit. No matter how dark it may seem, your light will shine and endure.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_COULTENET_000_090: It is no easy thing to say “leave the star to us.” But we must, and we will. As proud members of the Scions, we have a duty to uphold.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_COULTENET_000_091: And we needn't do so alone. Those dark days when we were driven from the Rising Stones and hunted as traitors are a thing of the past. We have allies in abundance now.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_COULTENET_000_092: Which is to say, you needn't worry about us. Go forth in the knowledge that the Scions will labor without rest in your absence.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ERENVILLE_000_095: First the great exodus, and now this...it seems there's no end to our work.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ERENVILLE_000_096: In truth, more than a few gleaners were distressed to learn that their earlier efforts were for nothing. It was no easy task convincing them that the new plan was for the best, I can tell you that.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ERENVILLE_000_097: I can't tell you every man believes this is the wisest course, but I can say that all will be forgiven if you deliver us from the coming doom. And if you don't, well, at least you won't get the earful I certainly will.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_VARSHAHN_000_100: Man is said to fear what he does not know, yet you would venture unto the greatest of unknowns.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_VARSHAHN_000_101: I say to you,  of man, that you need not fear. So long as man shares a bond with dragonkind, so too does he share our kinship with the heavens, and our ancient home amidst the stars infinite.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_VARSHAHN_000_102: I pray you go forth, and prove this bond of ours, tempered and tested, shall endure unbroken for a thousand thousand years.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_NIDHANA_000_105: Mistress Krile tells me your investigation into my theories on akasa─and its relation to the Final Days─has made clear the source of our woes.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_NIDHANA_000_106: I am elated to know my work was of some benefit, but I could not have shared it had you not rescued me from the tower that day.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_NIDHANA_000_107: I yet owe you a great debt, one I may never fully repay. But I shall try nonetheless!
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_NIDHANA_000_108: Not only through my research, but through my desire to see you succeed, which I believe may influence the akasa in our favor, small though the effect may be. Yes, so long as we have hope, there is a chance we may influence the outcome of this calamity.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ALPHINAUD_000_110: The Ragnarok... And thus does Grandfather's legacy live on.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ALPHINAUD_000_111: We mustn't waste any more time. Let us board, and set out for Ultima Thule!
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ALISAIE_000_116: We will save this star and return home. I promise...
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_THANCRED_000_120: Venturing quite literally into the unknown, we have to be ready for anything.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_THANCRED_000_121: As I said before, whatever awaits us there, we will survive. We must.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_URIANGER_000_125: I am most grateful Wilfsunn and Bloewyda have devised a contingency should the need to flee arise, though I pray it shall not.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_URIANGER_000_126: We must needs strive for victory to the last, that Etheirys and her people survive, and that her champions return home. Without exception.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_YSHTOLA_000_130: Primal summoning...as it was intended... I never dared to consider they could be invoked without the danger of tempering.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_YSHTOLA_000_131: Change has come quickly to this star, and greater change yet awaits in the days to come. All the more reason we must not fail.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_GRAHATIA_000_135: So, the stage is set. I can but hope we are prepared to play our parts when we arrive on Ultima Thule.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_GRAHATIA_000_136: The key, I suspect, may lie with Hydaelyn's parting message to us.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_GRAHATIA_000_137: “Darkness and Light. Despair and hope. As goes one, so goes the other.” Knowing Meteion wields the power of despair, we must bring to bear hope in equal measure.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ESTINIEN_000_140: I'd rather not spend any longer mulling over strategy.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ESTINIEN_000_141: None of us are strangers to despair. If that is the source of her power, we are ready for it.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_FOURCHENAULT_000_14: Ameliance will not be joining us, I'm afraid. She could not bear to watch our children embark on so perilous a mission.
Make no mistake─I feel the same. I cannot tell you how many times I had to step away from my duties, so distracted by thoughts of all the ways it could go wrong...
Even now a part of me wants to drag them away and forbid─ ...Well. Not that they would listen. So I will see them off with pride in my heart and a prayer on my lips.
For my children, and for this star they love so dearly, you must prevail.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_CID_000_150: The Ragnarok is a collaborative effort in every sense.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_CID_000_151: The culmination of knowledge from the world's greatest minds, both past and present. Without question the greatest ship ever built.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_NERO_000_155: The world cannot end now, not when we've but scratched the surface of the Loporrits' technological know-how.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_NERO_000_156: So run along now, and do what it is you vaunted heroes do best. The world shall tremble before my genius soon enough, assuming you're able to prevent its destruction, that is.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_BIGGS_000_160: I'll have to remember to thank Tataru for her timely provisions of food and drink. Poor Wedge would've long since given up from exhaustion otherwise.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_BIGGS_000_161: But now the rest is up to you. Come back safe, all right?
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_WEDGE_000_165: You haven't forgotten anything, have you? No repairs or commissions? A delivery from retainers, perhaps? ...No?
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_WEDGE_000_166: Well! If there's nothing else, have a safe journey!
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_EMMANELLAIN_000_170: So that was the covert operation Sicard was assigned? Hmph! No doubt he thinks we were all impressed by the way he barged in here, beastmen in tow, hero of the hour.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_EMMANELLAIN_000_171: He leaves me with no choice but to give you the most spectacular of farewells. Yes, a display of such jubilance my arms may very well fall to pieces.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_AEGLYFFE_000_180: If you would come this way, I will direct you to the bridge.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_SYSTEM_000_181: Upon boarding the Ragnarok, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_SYSTEM_000_182: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_Q1_000_183: Are you prepared to board the Ragnarok?
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ALPHINAUD_000_200: It is as Livingway said. I can breathe well enough, but something about this place feels...wrong.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ALISAIE_000_205: It's so dark. I can barely see anything...
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_URIANGER_000_210: Didst thou witness what became of Thancred? So quickly was I overcome by Meteion's malevolence that I saw naught of their altercation.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_YSHTOLA_000_215: We were clearly no match for Meteion, yet we survived unscathed. But how...?
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_GRAHATIA_000_220: If Meteion should strike again with such overwhelming force, I honestly don't know how we are to oppose her.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_ESTINIEN_000_225: There is a dizzying, disorienting feeling about this place. As if I could lose my footing at any moment... We must be careful.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_LIVINGWAY_000_230: I can't guarantee it will be of help in these strange surrounds, but I've readied a provisions node in case of emergency.
TEXT_AKTKMG103_04452_LIVINGWAY_000_231: Of course, if you encounter any real danger here, I expect you to return to the Ragnarok at once.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALISAIE_000_000: It's so dark. I can barely see anything...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_URIANGER_000_005: Didst thou witness what became of Thancred? So quickly was I overcome by Meteion's malevolence that I saw naught of their altercation.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_YSHTOLA_000_010: We were clearly no match for Meteion, yet we survived unscathed. But how...?
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_GRAHATIA_000_015: If Meteion should strike again with such overwhelming force, I honestly don't know how we are to oppose her.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_020: There is a dizzying, disorienting feeling about this place. As if I could lose my footing at any moment... We must be careful.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_LIVINGWAY_000_025: Don't hesitate to make the most of the provisions node. There's no telling what you might run into out there, or if anything we have to offer might help, but I'd personally rather brave the unknown with a full pack than an empty one.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_030: We're fortunate this place can support life...albeit barely, I suspect, given the torpid, stale quality of the air...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_031: But never mind that. We must find Thancred. Let's begin our search from the prow of the ship. It seems as good a direction as any.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Try not to stray too far, lest we lose sight of one another.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALISAIE_000_040: I see no one else in this barren waste, do you? Then why do I feel like we're not alone...like there's another presence with us. Something dark...and mournful...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_URIANGER_000_045: These remains have long since turned to ash...and yet, they retain their form.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_YSHTOLA_000_050: There is a structure here in front of me, yes? A tower of some sort, partially melted? Hmm. In a strange twist of fate, it seems our perception of this place is not so different as it would be elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_YSHTOLA_000_051: The world as I used to see it... It feels as though I am dreaming while awake. This is more than the faded memory Meteion led us to believe.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Ruins. But of what, I wonder?
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Perhaps we can find something to help us understand the nature of this place. A relic, an inscription, anything...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Be careful, . I cannot shake the feeling we're being watched. Gods, you don't think there are ghosts here...do you?
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_SYSTEM_000_090: The metallic pillar has been partially melted, likely sometime in the distant past.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_SYSTEM_000_091: The damage does not appear to have been inflicted deliberately. Rather, it calls to mind the indiscriminate destruction often wrought in the heat of battle...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_GRAHATIA_000_100: Look here─this part is relatively intact.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_GRAHATIA_000_101: The intricate design of the top suggests it is man-made, though its builders were surely not men as we conceive of them.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_GRAHATIA_000_102: Having said that, I swear I have seen this pattern before...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_GRAHATIA_000_105: I know this pattern. But from where...?
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_110: I thought this hill might afford a better view of our surroundings... A poor decision in hindsight.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_111: Besides the light from the ship, all is shrouded in darkness. If Thancred is here, I'd never know it.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_112: From what I can tell, we are near the edge of an island─if you can call it that─surrounded by floating debris.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_115: Have care should you decide to climb higher. Were you to fall, you might well tumble through the great expanse for all eternity.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Were you able to find anything?
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_121: As I feared. And still no trace of Thancred.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALISAIE_000_122: There's nothing but emptiness as far as the eye can see, which, unfortunately, isn't very far.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALISAIE_000_123: Though I can't help but suspect that someone...or something is here.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALISAIE_000_124: There are times when I sense it drawing close...and then a chill washes over me, leaving me exhausted.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALISAIE_000_125: Leaving me with feelings of death and anguish...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_A1_000_127: I think I might see something over there...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_A1_000_128: I felt it too when I was near that thing...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALISAIE_000_129: What are you talking about? There's nothing there.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_YSHTOLA_000_130: Before we jump to any conclusions, perhaps we should search elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_131: Agreed. We've found only more questions when we are in desperate need of answers.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_132: There's a fair stretch of terrain from the ship's port side we've yet to explore.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_133: Let us try searching there, then.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_134: . A word, before we join the others.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_140: You see them too, don't you? The dragons.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_141: As I thought. Their presence is tenuous at best, but there's no mistaking it.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_142: No doubt your bond with Midgardsormr, and mine with Nidhogg, is what allows us to perceive them.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_143: Could these apparitions be related to the dragons that now live on Etheirys?
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_144: ...Bah. Better to leave such conjecture to the others. In any case, we must be careful. We may soon find dragons they can see as well.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_145: Hmm... Death and anguish. What happened to them, I wonder?
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ALPHINAUD_000_150: Look there! Are those...are those ghosts, do you think?
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_URIANGER_000_155: Surely, mine eyes deceive me. This cannot be possible.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_YSHTOLA_000_160: My sight may have been restored after a fashion, but I fear what I see cannot be trusted...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_YSHTOLA_000_161: It's as if Meteion herself has etched these images upon my heart. I doubt not that such a feat is within her power, given that she constructed this sanctuary herself.
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_GRAHATIA_000_165: Dragons... 'Tis true they are not of our world. But to find them in a prison of despair...
TEXT_AKTKMG104_04453_ESTINIEN_000_170: It seems these dragons have yet to succumb completely to the darkness of this place. Meaning the others should see them as well.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I understand now why the Loporrits were surprised to find that this environment could sustain life. There but for Thancred's sacrifice...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ALISAIE_000_005: He can't really be gone, can he? Meteion herself said his soul persists, that he is the reason we are still breathing. If so then maybe...maybe...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_YSHTOLA_000_010: His will was strong enough to reshape Ultima Thule that we might survive. That I might see again. His sacrifice must not be wasted.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_GRAHATIA_000_015: It's hard to believe Thancred was able to overcome Meteion's will. Yet here we are... Would that the price for his victory had not been so high.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_020: My aim was true. I had her.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_021: How are we to defeat an enemy we can't attack?
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_URIANGER_000_030: Soul without body... A form of being with which we are not wholly unfamiliar.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_URIANGER_000_031: Indeed, for we existed in a similar state when residing in the First.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_URIANGER_000_032: The circumstances are rather more dire than that, 'tis true, but I choose to believe he is not forever lost to us.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_URIANGER_000_033: Regardless...in sacrifice he hath afforded us a chance to prevail. Let us not squander it, and ascertain the nature of this realm that we might confront and defeat Meteion.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_URIANGER_000_034: Estinien. . Would you accompany me in speaking with these dragons? Mayhap they can enlighten us.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_URIANGER_000_035: I would ask the rest of you to survey these surrounds. If there is a path that may lead us to our quarry, we must find it.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Very well. We can reconvene here when everyone has finished.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ALPHINAUD_000_037: Meteion said these dragons are shadow and shade, from a world whose denizens sought oblivion.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ALPHINAUD_000_038: As such, they're not like to be amenable to company, let alone conversation. So please, be careful.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_URIANGER_000_039: Let us split up and gather what knowledge we may.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SEIHLOSKH_000_050: A visitor. Not of this star...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SEIHLOSKH_000_051: Could thy slender hands bring plague to our world... Thy breath extinguish life's feeble flame... Oh, how we would adore thee. Alas...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SEIHLOSKH_000_052: With time our flesh shall wither, our souls fade. And so we wait for its inexorable march unto oblivion.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SEIHLOSKH_000_053: If thou art not come to hasten our demise, I bid thee leave us. We crave not companionship. Only silence.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SEIHLOSKH_000_055: I pray thee leave us to our silence. To break it serves only to mark time's passage. We shall not suffer reminders of its flow.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_KOHMNOSKH_000_060: Beyond that distant veil... Paradise lost. So glorious. So beautiful...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_KOHMNOSKH_000_061: We were a proud and noble race. Strength embodied. We knew only love. Before they came...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_KOHMNOSKH_000_062: Metal monstrosities of black and silver. No bonds of blood did they share, nor conviction did they have to guide them.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_KOHMNOSKH_000_063: A crushing defeat. Never had we known such shame... Stilled now are the winds, though none could fill these wings burdened by ignominy. We fly no more, only sink into oblivion...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_KOHMNOSKH_000_065: I beg thee leave me to dream. To forget that which we have lost...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_WHEIFEHSK_000_070: Thou wouldst bid me speak? Hmph. Folly.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_WHEIFEHSK_000_071: I observe the lesson of stone. I shall not fly, nor speak, nor roar. Only watch, and wait, and end.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_WHEIFEHSK_000_072: But one sight yet stirreth my blood, tempteth me to raise my voice in lamentation: Ahm Nohl, the cradle of unsung dragons.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_WHEIFEHSK_000_073: No words, no songs are possessed of the weight to describe such tragedy... Go, if that be thy will. I shall remain.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_WHEIFEHSK_000_075: Stay and ponder the lesson, or go in ignorant defiance.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_WHEIFEHSK_000_076: I remain...for I dare not look upon Ahm Nohl, font of our greatest loss...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_080: They led you here as well, did they? It was described to me as the source of their woes and proof of their end. I think I'm beginning to see why.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_081: It's a hatching ground. Or, was... I've seen similar on Etheirys.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_082: Midgardsormr's kind must once have lived and thrived in a place such as this.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_083: Vrtra said his father was driven from their ancestral home by war and strife. This, then, is the fate of those who remained.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_084: Let's have a look around. Maybe these eggs have more to tell of what happened here.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_090: The stench of these eggs is as fierce as any weapon. Would that there were winds to carry it away.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SYSTEM_000_100: Inside the shattered egg you find the remains of an unborn dragon. The body has already begun to decompose.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SYSTEM_000_101: The gelatinous, half-dried membrane covering the corpse suggests it failed to emerge...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SYSTEM_000_105: A murky liquid has pooled inside this egg shell. The noxious foetor is indicative of contamination...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SYSTEM_000_110: Gingerly lifting a large egg from the viscous mire, you peer inside and see a formless mass soaking in a pool of embryonic fluid.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SYSTEM_000_111: Your stomach turns as you return the egg to its resting place.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_SYSTEM_000_120: This egg appears to have been broken from the inside out. Perhaps the dragonet within succeeded in hatching...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_121: What's this? I thought all the eggs had been ruined.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_122: If the dragonet was indeed hatched, there is no sign of it here─or its sire, for that matter.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_123: We should look for them. You start with the clifftops, and I'll search the plains.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ELDERDRAGON04454_00: The boisterous howling hath been quieted... By thy hand, I presume.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_141: Everything all right? I thought I heard a dragon, or something resembling one.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_142: Ah. I see what's happened here... Was that your child?
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ELDERDRAGON04454_00: Perhaps. Some eggs within Ahm Nohl are indeed mine. If life within one did quicken, the beast thou hast slain may be of my blood.
Yet I do not recognize it, twisted and malformed as it is.
Not a dragon in truth, but a reminder of our failure. A testament to our shame.
They descended from the heavens. Cold, heartless machines. And with them rode war and death.
With fire and fury, rage and rancor, we gave answer. 'Twas a long and bloody battle, but only the beginning...
Untold chaos and destruction swept over the star. In the end, the invaders were victorious.
Yet when they looked upon their prize, they deemed it unfit for requisition. We were abandoned to our ruin.
The survivors sought to put away their shame. To rebuild. A futile effort.
In purest soil replete with aether did we once cultivate our nesting grounds. But our lands were barren, and any eggs nurtured in such desolation were fated to rot.
What few survive to hatch emerge as...abominations. We shall have no new progeny.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_154: But there are dragons among you capable of journeying to other stars.
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ELDERDRAGON04454_00: That there are. Many would make the attempt, each bearing a clutch of eggs.
The richest stars were home to the harshest rulers, and the arrival of dragons incited contests for supremacy.
When the fires faded, the wars lost and won, they too were reduced to ash and waste.
'Tis the curse of those who seek life─to be drawn into conflict, to conquer or be conquered.
A vicious cycle we now choose to break. We tire of conflict. Of everything...
We wait now in sweet, merciful silence. Free from strife and suffering. Still as stone...
TEXT_AKTKMG105_04454_ESTINIEN_000_161: Wait! You claim your kind is doomed, but there is another star─
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ESTINIEN_000_010: They want only to brood in silence. To be left alone with their grief until time itself comes to an end.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ESTINIEN_000_011: The sole reward for senseless bloodshed. A pain I understand...and wish that I did not.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ESTINIEN_000_013: But now isn't the time for such thoughts.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ESTINIEN_000_014: The others will want to hear what we've learned. Come.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALISAIE_000_020: Good to see you made it back in one piece. The more I see of this place, the more bewildering it becomes.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_URIANGER_000_025: I chanced to gain audience with several dragons ere we returned, though I expect their tales are much the same as those you heard.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_YSHTOLA_000_030: We would hear what the dragons had to share with you. Even if it's no different from what they told Urianger, it would have value.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_GRAHATIA_000_035: Did your exploration prove eventful? Converse with any dragons?
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ESTINIEN_000_040: With luck, they'll have learned something to help us devise a plan of action.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Were you able to establish any meaningful contact with the dragons?
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_051: I see... They wish to escape what they perceive to be a cycle of conflict.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_053: As for our part, I believe we are more acutely aware of our confines than before...
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_054: We started by traversing the perimeter of the island, to see if there might be a path leading off of it. Sadly, there was nothing to be found.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ESTINIEN_000_055: There's no small amount of debris floating about. Could there be enough to serve as a bridge to lead us elsewhere?
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_056: I considered that, and so I tried throwing a stone onto a potential platform to judge its integrity...
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_057: But it never reached its mark. As it crossed an invisible threshold just beyond the boundaries of this island, it vanished, only to reappear above me, and fall at my feet. I would not be too quick to presume that what we see outside this space is as it appears.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALISAIE_000_058: Which is why I returned to the Ragnarok, and asked the Loporrits to search for a potential path.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALISAIE_000_059: However, the ship's instruments failed to provide conclusive data on the surrounding area. Until we know more, I think it too risky to attempt flying to another island.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_GRAHATIA_000_060: What Meteion told us before─that emotions dictate reality here─might be the key. But I'm not entirely sure what emotion might manifest a bridge to lead us to safety.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ESTINIEN_000_061: So what you're saying is, we've no way forward.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_YSHTOLA_000_062: At present, aye. If it is indeed emotion that governs this island, perhaps it is not Meteion's, but the dragons' that holds us here.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_YSHTOLA_000_063: They tire of conflict, and have chosen a path of oblivion to escape it.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_YSHTOLA_000_064: Or rather, they have chosen no path at all. Meaning there is no way for the dragons, or anyone here on this island, to advance.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_GRAHATIA_000_065: A sound theory, disheartening though it may be.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_066: If that is the case, what recourse do we have? They are not like to be persuaded to help us.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_067: Their reasoning is built on a history of turmoil and strife. Without irrefutable proof the future is not as bleak as they believe it to be...
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_YSHTOLA_000_068: Mayhap persuasion is not the answer.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_YSHTOLA_000_069: Meteion meant to unmake us then and there on the Ragnarok, and she would have succeeded if not for Thancred's determination.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_YSHTOLA_000_070: She conceded it was strong enough to overpower the despair that otherwise rules Ultima Thule, and reshape it to a degree. Perhaps it can be done again in like manner─by overpowering the prevailing emotions.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_URIANGER_000_071: 'Twas Ultima Thule's architect, Meteion herself, against whom Thancred did pit himself in a clash of wills. Though I marked no leader among them, as such, I did chance to encounter a dragon possessed of despair far more potent than most. Potent enough, mayhap, to dictate the course for others─and thus, their domain, to follow.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_URIANGER_000_072: He spoke but few words, carefully chosen, their tone and timbre alone threatening to rend my heart in twain. Challenging his desire to remain may allow us to alter the island upon which we stand.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_URIANGER_000_073: Alas, I fear my vaunted rhetoric availed me naught against his calcifying heart. But mayhap one of you will fare better...?
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_URIANGER_000_074: Then I shall guide thee. Al End, they call him, in the dragon tongue. Thou wilt find him nearby, eyes fixed upon the water.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALISAIE_000_075: Well, what have we to lose? Let's get going.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALISAIE_000_080: If I had known this place would claim Estinien too, I...
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALISAIE_000_081: No... No, it's what had to be done.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_URIANGER_000_085: As by the beating of mighty wings doth wind blow, where dragons may ne'er again touch the sky, he and the shade he bore shall soar free...
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_YSHTOLA_000_090: Must this always be the price paid for safe passage?
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_GRAHATIA_000_095: The wind has stayed the fog that covered this island. And the air... It no longer feels quite so stifling.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_SYSTEM_000_100: A confluence of wind has manifested before you...
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_111: This is Estinien's doing. I'm sure of it. We should ride its flow, and see where it leads.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Forgive me, , but could you go on ahead? I... I need a moment. To gather my thoughts...
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_SYSTEM_000_130: A powerful gale has delivered you to another island. The other Scions should arrive before long.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_131: He...he did it. He found a way forward for us.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_132: The dragons remain trapped within a prison of their own making, lamenting the horrors of war. Yet Estinien knew them better than most.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALPHINAUD_000_133: He was a man of honor and a dear friend, willing to fight to the very end for what he believed was right...
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALISAIE_000_134: And he's still fighting, Alphinaud. Just like Thancred.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALISAIE_000_135: Their sacrifices are why we can survive here. Why we still have a chance to stop her.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_ALISAIE_000_136: Even in spirit, they're unwilling to give in to despair, and we mustn't either.
TEXT_AKTKMG106_04455_YSHTOLA_000_137: Alisaie is right. We must press on. For their sake...
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALISAIE_000_000: We have to keep going. Even if Estinien isn't here to see it, I'm sure Alphinaud wouldn't want to disappoint him.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_URIANGER_000_005: No choice have we but to march onward, lest we squander their noble sacrifices...
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_010: Though it pains me to say it, we can ill afford to stop and grieve our comrades' passing. No, there will be time enough after.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_GRAHATIA_000_015: To feign bravery with bold words is a simple matter, but without the strength of will to match, we are powerless against dynamis.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_GRAHATIA_000_016: Naught less than unshakable conviction will suffice... Which makes me question if I am up to the task.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALPHINAUD_000_020: As Y'shtola and Alisaie said, we must continue.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Hmm. Notice the change in our surroundings? Perhaps this is the memory of an altogether different world.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALPHINAUD_000_022: 'Twould be prudent to learn more of it, then. Tread carefully, lest we lose our footing in this sand.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALPHINAUD_000_030: If not for the light emitted by these glyphs, I might well have overlooked this monolith.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_040: If you were worried about my vision, you needn't be. I can still see quite well.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_GRAHATIA_000_045: Another seemingly barren world... For a mercy, the air is nowhere near as stale, but still quite dry, and the sand will no doubt prove bothersome in due time.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_URIANGER_000_050: Were it not for the violet crystal embedded in its surface, 'twould appear as ordinary stone.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_URIANGER_000_051: A curious script hath been etched upon them. Alas, it is not a language with which I am familiar.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_052: I cannot say I recognize it either.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_GRAHATIA_000_053: Nor I. The dragons, from what I recall, preserve their knowledge in song and eschew the written word entirely, so we may assume this is the work of another race. One we have yet to encounter...
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_URIANGER_000_054: Meteion claimed the dragons' world suffered a slow death, seeking the release of oblivion.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_URIANGER_000_055: What life we find here, like as not, doth wend its way towards a similar end.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_URIANGER_000_060: Fascinating as this script is, we will glean naught from what we cannot decipher...
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALISAIE_000_070: What do you suppose that is over there?
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALPHINAUD_000_071: I'm not sure... It's hard to make out at this distance, but its surface seems to bear the same crystals as this monument.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALISAIE_000_072: Meaning there's a chance we may find whoever built them both. We should go and have a look. Come on.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_080: Hail, travelers. This is a most unexpected occurrence.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALISAIE_000_081: Oh, um... Hello there. Is this your home...?
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_082:
Indeed it is...
Ah, forgive me. I had forgotten─an exchange of introductions is expected when first meeting those with whom one is unacquainted.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_083: When the vibration of vocal folds was still required to convey our thoughts and intention, “Ea,” I believe, was the pronunciation used when referring to our people.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_084: Though it is not entirely applicable given our present state, you are welcome to use this appellation.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_085: As for nomenclature to address my individual person, I believe it would be pronounced “Coph-coodg.”
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_087: We have encountered beings that communicate intermittently through thought, but never one that is wholly without voice.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_088: I presume we are having this conversation via the medium of aether. Or dynamis, as this space is suffused with vast quantities of it. Fascinating in either case.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_089: (-Coph-coodg-)I gather your response to my presence is positive, then? That is well, for there is something I wish to ask of you.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_090: (-Coph-coodg-)Like yourselves, we Ea are aether-based life-forms. Therefore, it may be surmised that your bodies are of comparable biological composition to those we once possessed.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_091: (-Coph-coodg-)I have a number of queries regarding your subjective perception of the five senses─sight, sound, taste, touch, and smell.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_092: (-Coph-coodg-)In total, I have prepared one hundred ninety-eight billion seven hundred twelve million one hundred eighty thousand eight hundred and twenty-seven.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_GRAHATIA_000_093: Er... That's rather a lot, isn't it?
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_094: (-Coph-coodg-)Ah, my apologies. I have omitted a great many details necessary to understand the nature of my request.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_095: (-Coph-coodg-)Though we dispensed with our corporeal vessels long ago, we have rediscovered a need for the flesh, and have endeavored to recreate our erstwhile forms. However, all pertinent records have been lost due to the passage of time.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_096: (-Coph-coodg-)Take for example, the nervous system. It is well within our power to recreate, but we have no frame of reference for sensations once experienced by our people, which may compromise our ability to interact with our physical environment.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_GRAHATIA_000_097: And the reason you need to regain corporeal forms?
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_098: (-Coph-coodg-)Why, to bring an end to our existence, of course.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_099: (-Coph-coodg-)Though “need” is perhaps too strong a word. It would be a simple matter to unmake ourselves through use of aetheric exsanguinaters. But such a death seems...inadequate.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_100: (-Coph-coodg-)The traditionalists among us believe proper death requires an inescapable sense of impermanence in one's final moments. An experience found only with bodies of flesh.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_101: We should very much like to hear more of your plans. In exchange, we will answer any questions you have to the best of our ability.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_102: (-Coph-coodg-)Hmm... Such an exchange of information would indeed prove useful.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_103: (-Coph-coodg-)Very well. To ensure efficacious exchange, I hereby invite you to our home.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_104: (-Coph-coodg-)Yes. The abode of the Ea, where we traditionalists prepare for our demise.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_105: (-Coph-coodg-)I presume your consent to answer questions is indicative of a tacit approval of our plans? In which case, your cooperation is greatly appreciated.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_106: (-Coph-coodg-)I must caution you, however, to be mindful of the Ea wandering the desert. Their desire for bodies of flesh could be described as...overzealous. Now, if you would follow me.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALISAIE_000_107: This is going rather smoothly. Not that I'm complaining, mind.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_108: Even so, we mustn't forget their aim is oblivion, much like the dragons.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_109: Though I fail to see why a civilization so seemingly advanced would choose to unmake all they have created.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_110: At any rate, we will find no answers dallying here. Let us be on our way.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Something tells me we have different definitions of the word “abode.”
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALISAIE_000_125: They said there would be others, but... I don't know what I was expecting.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_URIANGER_000_130: The isle of dragons was shrouded in the silence of the dead, yet the stillness here doth suggest the Ea are, by and large, merely sleeping...?
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_135: I should not be surprised their concept of a village is so different from ours, and yet...
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_GRAHATIA_000_140: More violet-colored crystals. I cannot place my finger on it, but there is something unsettling about them.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_150: Welcome to our abode. Most of our compeers, you will find, remain idle in their domiciles. Though your quizzical expressions indicate my phrasing is unclear.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_151: I speak, of course, of the violet crystalline constructs hanging from the stone structures there.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_152: You say they remain idle, but what of your work to regain corporeal bodies?
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_153: An astute question. And understandable, given your finite nature.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_154: We have no desire to pursue our research, for it is no longer necessary.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_155: If, in our idleness, we are struck by sudden inspiration, we rise to pursue said inspiration to its conclusion. That is why I was present for your arrival, and why I continue to engage with you still.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_156: But while the others are not currently in a motile state, rest assured they would not object were you to disturb their respite.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_157: You need only cast your thoughts towards one of their crystalline domiciles to communicate.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_160: Even should they elect not to emerge, you need but cast your thoughts to the crystals to communicate with the Ea within.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALPHINAUD_000_165: I suppose there is a logic to creatures comprised of spiritual energy utilizing crystals as living spaces, but it is nevertheless surprising to see.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_ALISAIE_000_170: I've tried reaching out to whatever is inside this crystal, but all I can hear is sporadic moaning.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_URIANGER_000_175: Despite my best efforts, mine overtures have elicited no response from this crystal. I can but assume its resident sleepeth most soundly. Or so I hope...
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_180: Is it not strange they lack passion to research that which they desire above all else?
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_YSHTOLA_000_181: If we are fortunate, the Ea residing in these crystals will shed light on this contradiction.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_GRAHATIA_000_185: If I heard correctly, the Ea within this crystal says it will emerge from within shortly. Do you suppose they all appear as Coph-coodg does?
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_SYSTEM_000_190: You cast your thoughts toward the crystalline domicile, but there is no response...
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_LAHLAAKH_000_196: (-???-)Very well... Pray...a moment, if you would...
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_DEWDEEKH_000_200: (-???-)Why we seek our end, you ask? If you wish to know, I will tell you.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_DEWDEEKH_000_201: (-???-)Just a moment... I must remember... What form did I take when last I emerged?
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_SYSTEM_000_206: The strange moaning comes and goes, but soon fades into silence...
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_210: Did your inquiries yield satisfactory responses?
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_212: If they failed to answer, then it is likely because their minds have unraveled due to prolonged idleness. They are naught but concentrated aether now.
TEXT_AKTKMG107_04456_COPHCOODG_000_213: Worry not─there are no others who have need of those lodgings, and they will not prove a hindrance to remain as they are. But more importantly, you said some few did answer your request for an audience, yes? I imagine they will be with us ere long.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I suppose there is a logic to creatures comprised of spiritual energy utilizing crystals as living spaces, but it is nevertheless surprising to see.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALISAIE_000_005: I've tried reaching out to whatever is inside this crystal, but all I can hear is sporadic moaning.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_URIANGER_000_010: Despite my best efforts, mine overtures have elicited no response from this crystal. I can but assume its resident sleepeth most soundly. Or so I hope...
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_YSHTOLA_000_015: Is it not strange they lack passion to research that which they allegedly desire?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_YSHTOLA_000_016: If we are fortunate, the Ea residing in these crystals will shed light on this contradiction.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_GRAHATIA_000_020: If I heard correctly, the Ea within this crystal says it will emerge from within shortly. Do you suppose they all appear as Coph-coodg does?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALISAIE_000_030: <sigh> I had no luck, but everyone else fared well enough. Quite a few Ea have awakened.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_032: May I introduce to you Lah-laakh, Dew-deekh, and Neh-needg.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_LAHLAAKH_000_033: It has been too long, Coph-coodg. I daresay Sadr IV has since completed an orbit.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_034: Indeed. Until the travelers brought it to my attention, I hadn't noticed how unraveled some had become.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_NEHNEEDG_000_035: Travelers...? Ah, of course, of course. The ones who wished to know why we seek to regain corporeal forms.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_036: The truth of the matter is as plain to see as the neighboring systems, but my single account would fail to satisfy the requirement for scientific objectivity. Thus did I bid them awaken you.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_GRAHATIA_000_037: Am I the only one who struggles to tell who is speaking?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_URIANGER_000_038: Nay, thou art not. In the absence of corporeal forms and the divergence they afford, mayhap such similarity in voice is unavoidable.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_DEWDEEKH_000_039: By the way, Coph-coodg─have you already observed the requisite custom for the travelers?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_DEWDEEKH_000_040: That which one is expected to do when receiving guests. A matter of proper form.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_041: Ahhh, yes. So long has it been, it had completely escaped my mind...and still does. What was it again? I can't seem to remember...
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_DEWDEEKH_000_042: Neither do I. Pity. I was hoping you would...
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_NEHNEEDG_000_043: Perhaps we can search the archives for the answer.
