TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_044: Come now, Neh-needg, the archives have long been frozen, lest we subject ourselves to further dolor. Surely you recall that much.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_LAHLAAKH_000_045: ...Ah, of course. Food─the custom is to serve food.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_LAHLAAKH_000_046: Beings of flesh such as they must regularly replenish their aether. By contributing to their replenishment, we communicate our friendly intention.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_048: We duly invite you to join us in communal repast, after which we may engage in leisurely conversation.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALPHINAUD_000_049: If we have a chance to learn something, then I see no reason to decline.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_050: Excellent. If you would care to follow, we shall feast you on the purest aether.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_LAHLAAKH_000_060: How much aether would be adequate for your kind, I wonder... As I recall, there is a fine line between optimal satiation and violent sickness.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_DEWDEEKH_000_065: Throughout the universe, but few races have completely shed their flesh as we have. As a result, we seldom receive visitors from other systems.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_DEWDEEKH_000_066: Extreme differences can inhibit meaningful interaction, you see, and none more so than those which affect communication. Most entities, for example, cannot even comprehend our words.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_DEWDEEKH_000_067: You are rare indeed in your ability to do so. You avail yourselves of dynamis, yes? It is an impressive application...even if it is ultimately pointless like all the rest.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_NEHNEEDG_000_070: To think that I had forgotten what had become of the archives... How much has my essence deteriorated since last I was awake?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_NEHNEEDG_000_071: Not that I am averse to having my mind fade away in this manner. It isn't so unlike the natural degradation of one's flesh. How delightful.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALPHINAUD_000_075: If they are thus able to replenish their aether, the loss of vital sustenance isn't like to be the cause of their demise.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALISAIE_000_080: Aether, they said, but I can't help but feel a bit nervous...
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_URIANGER_000_085: Judging by the construction of this facility, 'twould seem the Ea directly draw upon the aether.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_YSHTOLA_000_090: If it is as I suspect, then this so-called feast...
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_YSHTOLA_000_091: ...Actually, let us just see it for ourselves. Fear not─we are not like to come to harm.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_GRAHATIA_000_095: We were told to stand wherever we like. This strikes me as less of a meal and more a ritual...
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_100: This facility is where we replenish our aether. There is no particular name for it, but we traditionalists sometimes use the word “restaurant.”
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_101: Now then, if you would take your place with your comrades, the space will soon be awash with purest aether. Please absorb as much as you like.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_110: If you are worried about the quality of aether, don't be. We guarantee it is the purest stuff.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_SYSTEM_000_120: You brace yourself for a rush of sweet, sweet aether...but nothing seems to happen. Perhaps you need to wait a little longer.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_SYSTEM_000_130: You brace yourself again. But again, nothing seems to happen.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_YSHTOLA_000_131: Just as I had suspected. As meticulously as one might recreate the Ea's home world, this is Ultima Thule. One cannot simply generate aether here.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_YSHTOLA_000_132: As recreations, our friends are oblivious to this fact. To the very truth of their existence. Much like the phantoms of the recreated Amaurot.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_YSHTOLA_000_133: However appearances may seem, we must ever be mindful that it is the memories of the dead with whom we deal.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_134: So, did you have your fill of aether?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_YSHTOLA_000_135: Alas, we couldn't absorb it. A deficiency in our forms, it would seem.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_136: Oh, how very unfortunate... May I ask how you normally replenish your aether?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_DEWDEEKH_000_137: Through your mouths, you say! How very primitive and quaint!
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_NEHNEEDG_000_138: To think that their mouths serve not only to expel sound, but draw in sustenance besides... Such life-forms have long since vanished from our systems!
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_URIANGER_000_139: Though we regrettably could not partake of your magnificent feast, rest assured we feel your welcome most keenly.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_URIANGER_000_140: In the course of acquainting ourselves with your sophisticated ways, however, we could not fail but wonder: wherefore do you wish to obtain vessels of flesh, and thence to vanish? Will you not favor us with an explanation?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_141: You flesh-and-blood beings are always so hasty. It does have its charm, however...
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_142: Very well, we shall indulge you. In the beginning, when the Ea yet possessed corporeal bodies, our ancestors dedicated themselves to the pursuit of knowledge and technological advancement.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_143: By transcending all limitations, we believed we would eliminate sorrow and abide in true happiness.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_LAHLAAKH_000_144: From the tangible such as land to the intangible such as labor, there exist myriad hindrances to progress. But the most confining of all was the flesh itself.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_LAHLAAKH_000_145: Our natural lifespan was distressingly middling, you see. Too short to enjoy unhurried lives, yet too long to be considered disposable.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_LAHLAAKH_000_146: Furthermore, to simply maintain the integrity of our bodies demanded considerable resources.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_NEHNEEDG_000_147: But we managed to solve this problem.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_NEHNEEDG_000_148: After long years, we discovered how to become noncorporeal entities with everlasting lives, untroubled by the failures of the flesh.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_DEWDEEKH_000_149: Thus changed, we had more time and freedom to continue our scientific pursuits.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_DEWDEEKH_000_150: We went on to make ever greater strides in our quest to transcend all limitations, until we finally decided to challenge the last of them all: the limit of knowledge.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_151: That is to say, deciphering the laws of creation.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_152: We sought to discover how the universe came into being and explain all extant phenomena, and thence predict the future.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_153: If we could but achieve this, we believed that we would be free from uncertainty and anxiety.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_YSHTOLA_000_154: And did you find the answers you sought?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_155: Yes, we did. Our efforts revealed to us a fundamental truth.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_LAHLAAKH_000_156: Knowledge of said truth is essential for the continuation of our conversation. If you would learn more, we will share it with you.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_DEWDEEKH_000_157: No, we mustn't. Primitive as they are, it would be unspeakably cruel to deprive them of their ignorance.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_NEHNEEDG_000_158: They are possessed of corporeal forms, their lives readily ended.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_NEHNEEDG_000_159: As those who have gone before, is it not our duty to warn them?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_161: We have deliberated and come to a consensus.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_162: If you are resolved to know it, we will disclose to you the truth we discovered. The truth of the universe.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_COPHCOODG_000_163: Seek us at the stone pillars just outside the bounds of the abode. A place called Elegeia.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALPHINAUD_000_170: 'Tis true that a lack of knowledge can beget fear. Therefore, in theory, by acquiring all knowledge, it may be possible to attain peace.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALPHINAUD_000_171: But as Hydaelyn told us, all those peoples who attempted to free their worlds from life's woes met with failure.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALPHINAUD_000_172: And the Ea are among them, as their presence here attests. The tale we are about to hear will not be a happy one.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALISAIE_000_175: You may be intimately familiar with a problem─know it like the back of your hand─yet be powerless to solve it.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_ALISAIE_000_176: In the course of my struggles, I've often been made keenly aware of this fact. I wonder, have the Ea never felt the same frustration?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_URIANGER_000_180: Like her master, Y'shtola seeketh the truth of creation.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_URIANGER_000_181: How will the truth of the Ea, who uncovered all only to desire the end, fall upon her ears...?
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_GRAHATIA_000_185: To define the laws of creation would have been no small feat, even for the Ea. Nay, having eternal life, and hence no sense of haste, would only have made it harder.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_GRAHATIA_000_186: Such tremendous drive for knowledge they once must have had, and I struggle to reconcile it with the listless beings before us. Whatever answers they found, it did not bring them happiness.
TEXT_AKTKMG108_04457_YSHTOLA_000_191: We will hear it, of course. Let us learn what has led such an enlightened people to this indolent end.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_ALPHINAUD_000_000: 'Tis true that a lack of knowledge can beget fear. Therefore, in theory, by acquiring all knowledge, it may be possible to attain peace.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_ALPHINAUD_000_001: But as Hydaelyn told us, all those peoples who attempted to free their worlds from life's woes met with failure.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_ALPHINAUD_000_002: And the Ea are among them, as their presence here indicates. The tale we are about to hear will not be a happy one.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_ALISAIE_000_005: You may be intimately familiar with a problem─know it like the back of your hand─yet be powerless to solve it.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_ALISAIE_000_006: In the course of my struggles, I've often been made keenly aware of this fact. I wonder, have the Ea never felt the same frustration?
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_YSHTOLA_000_010: Before we hear the climax of the Ea's tale, mayhap I should speak of...
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_YSHTOLA_000_011: ...On second thought, it would only be a distraction. We will talk more when the time is right.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_015: To define the laws of creation would have been no small feat, even for the Ea. Nay, having eternal life, and hence no sense of haste, would only have made it harder.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_016: Such tremendous drive for knowledge they once must have had, and I struggle to reconcile it with the listless beings before us. Whatever answers they found, it did not bring them happiness.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_020: Ere we join the Ea, there is one trifling matter I would fain investigate.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_021: , G'raha Tia─might I trouble you for your assistance?
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_023: My thanks. We shall head outside the abode, if you would kindly follow me.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_YSHTOLA_000_024: I know not what mischief you are plotting, Urianger...but I trust you have our best interests at heart.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_YSHTOLA_000_025: The rest of us shall go on ahead to Elegeia. Lest you worry, we won't start without you.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_ALPHINAUD_000_030: There is naught but desert out there. What could Urianger wish to investigate?
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_ALISAIE_000_035: As long as Urianger explains himself to you, then I shall be satisfied. Do lend him an ear in my stead.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_YSHTOLA_000_040: Go on and assist Urianger with his mysterious task. We shall wait for you.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_045: A spring, and a sizable one at that... I hadn't noticed it amidst the dunes.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_051: Is it the spring that you wished to investigate?
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_052: Pray forgive me, my friends...but there is naught to investigate.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_053: 'Twas but a pretense to speak in private.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_055: As we have established, here in Ultima Thule, those denizens of ruined stars are recreated in their twilight days.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_056: Yet one question doth arise in my mind.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_057: So faithfully formed are the simulacra, they believe themselves yet amongst the living. How dost thou suppose this is possible?
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_A1_000_059: Meteion has taken their hearts unto herself.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_A1_000_060: Meteion made contact with them while they still lived.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_062: I'm inclined to agree. If Meteion can take the emotions of others as her own, I daresay she would be able to recreate them more faithfully than had she relied on any historical account.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_063: By which logic, she must have visited them while they still lived─the dragons and the Ea both!
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_064: Of course! She must have visited the stars of the dragons and the Ea before either race perished in their entirety.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_065: Thus could she make their emotions her own, and with them create more faithful simulacra than had she relied on any historical account.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_066: Wait... What if Meteion visited the dragons and the Ea while they still lived?
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_067: If so, she could have made their emotions her own, and with them create more faithful simulacra than had she relied on any historical account.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_068: So too did I theorize and, upon that assumption, consider how those two races may have met their demise.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_069: According to thine own tale, Meteion perceiveth the emotions of those nearby as her own.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_070: A heightened sense of empathy intrinsic to her nature as an entelechy.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_071: In the course of her starfaring journey, if she encountered beings who strongly desired a cessation of their existence...
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_072: She would be powerless before that desire.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_073: Even as she possesseth the power to grant it─the power of dynamis.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_074: 'Tis my supposition that, overwhelmed by their longing for death, Meteion did unleash dynamis and ushered the dragons and the Ea unto their doom.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_075: Of course, such was not always the outcome; full many stars did she find already lost to ruin.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_076: In order to create a terminus, however, the fervent desire for the end is essential.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_077: Therefore, should you struggle to find the way forward, pray ask yourselves this: in the place where you stand, whose is the soul that yearneth most desperately for oblivion?
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_078: Why do you tell us this now?
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_079: Ne'er again would I betray your trust. This pledge I did make to my comrades. In bringing thee into my confidence, I would remain true to my word.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_080: As for thee... Let us consider it my fitting reward for the secrets I harbored for the Crystal Exarch.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_081: I once placed my faith in thy chosen path, walking at thy side full knowing that we were bound for thy demise.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_082: I ask now that thou returnest the favor, and abide in faith as I fulfill mine own destiny.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_083: If you say my debt has come due, how am I to refuse?
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_084: 'Tis indelicate of me, I know full well, and I can but beg thy forgiveness.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_085: Yet even if I must needs go to such lengths, I cannot well feign ignorance of the answer I have found within...
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_086: The answer to the question: in what moment might I stand strongest?
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_087: After all that we've been through, I will say only this.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_088: Do what you must. Do what you must, and see your conviction through.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_089: I shall, my friend. I shall.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_090: Without further ado, then, let us go to join our comrades.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_GRAHATIA_000_101: Let us be off too. To Elegeia.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_ALPHINAUD_000_110: I understand you've taken care of business. If you are ready to begin, then so are we.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_ALISAIE_000_115: While we waited, we mentioned our star's situation to the Ea. They nodded sagely...or something to that effect.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_URIANGER_000_120: Come, let us hear the Ea's tale, and learn what caused such enlightened beings to crave nihility.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_COPHCOODG_000_130: Oh, you are here already? Your comrades said you would be late...
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_LAHLAAKH_000_135: We have prepared for our recounting. To facilitate comprehension, the information will be simplified to match your primitive minds.
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_DEWDEEKH_000_140: Your companion in front─the one called Y'shtola. She seems the keenest to learn the truth. I pity her...
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_NEHNEEDG_000_145: It would seem your star, too, has been plunged into a panic-induced cataclysm. We hope that our tale will not serve to exacerbate it...
TEXT_AKTKMG109_04458_YSHTOLA_000_150: It seems everyone is accounted for. Shall we, then?
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Never have I felt such emptiness. It's as if a part of me is gone...
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALISAIE_000_006: Like I said, our quest doesn't end here.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_010: Are you all ready to continue on?
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_011: Then let us make for where that light shone. Y'shtola and Urianger have opened the way for us.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALISAIE_000_020: Some manner of Ea device. If our friends awakened it, then it should be safe to use.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_025: Judging by the direction, this should be the place.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Yes, I can feel it! The aether emanating from the arcane pattern!
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALPHINAUD_000_031: This is a portal, and no mistake. Let us see where it leads.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALPHINAUD_000_040: What manner of place awaits us, I wonder...
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALISAIE_000_061: Attacked as soon as you arrived!? Not the most welcoming of places, is it...
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_062: We must try to find denizens who are amenable to conversation.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALPHINAUD_000_063: We should also get the lay of the land, see how far we can go.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALISAIE_000_064: I'll help Alphinaud with that. In the meantime, you and G'raha can search for friendlier folk.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_065: Apart from hostile beings, take care with your footing. I mislike the look of this terrain.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALISAIE_000_066: Not knowing what the locals are like, you'd best take care yourselves. We'll find you once we've finished exploring.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_070: I expect the twins will seek the outermost bounds of the isle, so I propose we search the central area.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_071: There are machines patrolling here and there. Sentinels, in all likelihood.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_072: Like those you encountered, they will most certainly attack any who venture too close.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_073: So let us avoid them, and look for others that appear more approachable.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_SYSTEM_000_080: You see naught but patrolling machines in the area. They do not seem inclined to nonviolent intercourse.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_110: Look, . The machines here do not appear hostile. Let's see if we can communicate with them...
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_111: Begging your pardon, but we are searching for the denizens of this star.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M032_000_112: Bzzzt... Unknown life-forms detected. Assigning generic label: interplanetary travelers.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M032_000_113: Greetings and welcome to the planet. <blip> <bloooooop>
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_114: The planet...what? Could you please repeat that?
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M032_000_115: It appears your hearing organ is unable to process the name in our tongue. It may be translated into yours as “Alphatron.”
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M032_000_116: Our people, meanwhile, are called the Omicrons, and you stand within one of our outposts.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_117: The Omicrons, you say... And what is it that you do here?
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M032_000_119: As we presently do not have a designated target, you have nothing to fear.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M032_000_120: Should your star become designated, however, you will be taken into custody and or terminated.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_121: Not a little frightening, these Omicrons, but at least they seem to be forthright...
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_122: I will see what else I can learn from this fellow, if you could try speaking with the others?
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_130: Go on and try speaking with the other units here. With our combined findings, perhaps we can piece together the state of affairs for the Omicrons.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M032_000_135: The rules of engagement forbid the harming of neutral travelers. As long as you abide by our laws, you need not fear for your lives.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_N0055_000_140: <blip> <bloop> Autonomous weapon deployment: complete. Vanguard armament upgrade: complete. Munition levels: satisfactory.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_N0055_000_141: Combat readiness assessment: nominal. Awaiting instructions from Sir.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_N0055_000_145: Awaiting instructions from Sir. Please specify target... Please specify target...
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M097_000_150: Bzzzt... Greetings, traveler. When venturing outside the outpost, beware malfunctioning units.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M097_000_151: They do not heed Sir's commands, and indiscriminately attack all non-Omicrons.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M097_000_152: For the avoidance of confusion, be advised that “Sir” is the alias of Stigma-1. Sir issues instructions to our forces as the foremost of the six strategic matrices that bear the designation Stigma.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_M097_000_155: For the further avoidance of confusion, be advised that Sir is composed of multiple distinct-but-interconnected units, each of which performs a specific function.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_N0253_000_160:
Bzzzt... Measuring combat capability...
Result: negligible. Subject falls outside targeting parameters.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_N0253_000_161: Greetings, traveler. We are the Omicrons, and our objective is self-enhancement.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_N0253_000_162: In order to achieve this, we venture forth in conquest to acquire combat data and resources.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_N0253_000_163: Most recently, we succeeded in subjugating the home world of the beings whose strength was said to be without parallel: the dragons.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_N0253_000_164: Yet though the endeavor yielded a wealth of combat data, the star was rendered barren and unable to yield resources. A subsequent costing determined that the losses incurred exceeded the gains.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_N0253_000_165: Since conquering the dragons, no new instructions have come from Sir, but we stand ready for deployment.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_170: You learned a few things? So did I. Ere we share our findings, however, I believe it best to step outside the outpost. Come with me.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALPHINAUD_000_172: We've finished surveying the area. This will come as no surprise, but there was no way forward.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALISAIE_000_173: There were portals like the one we used to get here, but those that worked only sent us to isolated isles.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_174: Then as before, we must locate the embodiment of the emotion that bars the way.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALISAIE_000_175: What of yourselves? Did you find anyone to speak with?
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALPHINAUD_000_176: So the Omicrons seek to advance themselves through conquest...
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALPHINAUD_000_177: Following their victory over the dragons, they stand ready for the next campaign, but their leader has yet to issue new commands. And so they wait.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_178: In such a place, who could it be that fits Urianger's description? A soul whose yearning for oblivion surpasses all others...
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_180: During our investigation, before we joined you in Elegeia.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALISAIE_000_181: So that's the way of it... Why couldn't he just say it to all of us?
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALPHINAUD_000_182: Given what we know of this place, it's certainly a curious state of affairs.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_ALPHINAUD_000_183: While the dragons and the Ea longed for death, the Omicrons long for conflict. As much as that may lead to destruction, it must be considered a distinct desire.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_184: In order to find the source of the dominant emotion, I believe we should seek out their leader. This “Sir.”
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_185: According to M-032─the first Omicron with whom we spoke─there is a console by which we might communicate with it.
TEXT_AKTKMG110_04459_GRAHATIA_000_186: M-032 also added that it would be a “pointless exercise,” but that in itself, I believe, is worth investigating. What say you?
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Considering the Omicrons' single-minded character, the lack of new orders does seem unusual. I agree that we should seek out their leader.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALISAIE_000_005: “Pointless exercise”... What does that mean, I wonder...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_010: So, the console we seek lies on the far side of this isle.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_011: Given the nature of the ground, the route may not be entirely direct as it seems.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_012: Let us all watch our step as we make our way.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALPHINAUD_000_020: The glow would suggest it is still operational. But how are we to interact with it...?
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALISAIE_000_025: Greetings, Sir! Can you hear me? Say something if you can! Awaken! Activate! ...Password!
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_030: This appears to be the console.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_032: Would you care to take a look at it?
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_040: Judging by the size of the Omicrons we've met, I'm reasonably confident the console is controlled via the orb.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_SYSTEM_000_050: You try touching, smacking, and attuning with the console, but there is no response...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_052: But there must be a way to activate it. There must...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALISAIE_000_060: I remember when we set Omega loose to deal with Shinryu...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALISAIE_000_061: An Allagan weapon, we once thought. And here we are now, visiting a recreation of its home world.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALISAIE_000_062: I can only imagine how else these beings will surprise us...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_065: Though I never encountered Omega myself, in conceiving the means to send the Crystal Tower to the First, we borrowed much from its mastery of the rift.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_066: Indeed, so many times did I read the report of your battle, I believe I could recite it word for word.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_067: Omega's miniature likeness also survived to the future, if a little worse for the wear. I must confess, I was delighted to see it again in the present.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_070: Though I never encountered Omega myself, in conceiving the means to send the Crystal Tower to the First, we derived no small inspiration from its abilities.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_071: In the course of my research, I devoured every single piece of literature I could find on the being. To think that the knowledge would prove useful here, at the edge of existence...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Let us focus our search on the outpost.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALPHINAUD_000_081: Alisaie and I will try speaking with the Omicrons this time, in the hopes we might learn something new.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALPHINAUD_000_082: Meanwhile, perhaps you and G'raha could observe them from a distance.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALPHINAUD_000_083: These beings are systematic and routine by nature. If there are any that aren't, it shouldn't be too difficult to spot them.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALPHINAUD_000_084: If there are no questions, then let us begin at once!
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_085: As we came this way, I believe I spied a promising vantage point. Follow me.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALPHINAUD_000_090: We will be certain to ask about the extended operations unit.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_ALISAIE_000_095: Not only do they look the same; they say the same things as well...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_100: And here we are. I see the twins are wasting no time with their inquiries.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_101: Let us begin observing the Omicrons. They are supposed to be standing by, so we should look for any that aren't.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_SYSTEM_000_110: Search Base Omicron for errant Omicrons. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target an Omicron and examine it with .
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_113: It's left the base. Let's follow it!
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_120: It's not here, but it definitely came this way. It must have used the portal.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_121: Time to go through and see what we find...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_130: Nothing nearby save malfunctioning units. Come─the portal awaits.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_144: Quite an unusual specimen... What is the device attached to it?
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_M017_000_145: The tree is a sample collected from another star. As it cannot survive in our environment, however, it requires life support. That is the function of the device.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_146: To go to such lengths to sustain it... Is there something special about this tree?
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_M017_000_147: Being foreign matter, protocol requires that we study it. As this task has been completed, the specimen may be discarded.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_M017_000_148: However, when I behold the tree, I am made to feel as though...there is a problem.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_M017_000_149: In order to become strong, we have continued to enhance ourselves. Like we did countless others, we conquered the star whence this tree came.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_M017_000_150: It is the last remnant of a dead world, and there is nothing towards which it may aspire. Yet it grows. Extends its branches. Sprouts leaves. Produces seeds.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_M017_000_151: Why does it seek to continue?
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_M017_000_152: Why was it made to behave in such a way, and to what end? I do not understand.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_153: ...I see. Out of curiosity, does this pertain to your duty?
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_M017_000_154: ...No, it does not. My apologies, I shall return to my designated post and assume a state of combat readiness.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_155: So, it was acting outside of orders...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_156: Perhaps it is simply a malfunctioning Omicron. These are by no means uncommon.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_157: But it may also be a unit possessed of the ability to make decisions. One not unlike Sir...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_158: I believe this bears further investigation.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_159: To endeavor to live even if we must depend on forces beyond our control...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_160: Tell me, . One day, when this adventure becomes a part of your epic, do you think I will be mentioned in it?
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_A3_000_162: Of course. Why wouldn't you be?
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_A3_000_164: You're not here so you can be in a story.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_165: You truly think so? That would be a...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_166: Nay, I shouldn't say such things until the moment comes to pass. Never mind the embarrassment...
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_167: Oh, come now, how much would it have cost you to simply nod?
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_168: 'Tis no simple thing to earn a place beside you, this I know full well. But it is something to hope for as I forge on.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_169: ...Forgive me. Let there be no doubt that fame and glory could not be further from my mind.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_170: And yet...I would be lying if I said that I don't relish the thought of my name being spoken in the same breath as yours.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_171: ...Well, we had best get on with our task.
TEXT_AKTKMG111_04460_GRAHATIA_000_172: Tracking down Sir, and understanding the nature of the emotion which bars our way!
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_000: We should return to the outpost for now. The others will wish to hear about the errant Omicron.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALPHINAUD_000_010: It appears the two of you made a promising discovery.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_015: I have given them the short of it, if you would care to provide the full account.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_020: G'raha says you found a suspicious Omicron. That's good, because the units here were of no help.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_021: They all had the same thing to say about the extended operations unit: that there's no way to arrange a direct meeting.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_022: Still, that served to prove that it's business as usual at the outpost.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_023: But enough about us. Tell me you learned something more useful...
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_024: An Omicron trying to make sense of the meaning of life... None of the others were even a fraction as philosophical.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALPHINAUD_000_025: This unit may well be in a position of leadership. Perhaps even one of those that comprise Sir.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALPHINAUD_000_026: As we know, the Omicrons invade other stars and enhance themselves using the spoils of conquest.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALPHINAUD_000_027: With the technology at their disposal, they should be able to alter their bodies, be it in part or in whole.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALPHINAUD_000_028: Setting aside the question of motive, if Sir, for example, wished to have an ordinary Omicron's body, I see no reason why it would not be possible.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_029: The problem is how to go about ascertaining if that's what happened...
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_030: When I attempted to probe further, it promptly ended the conversation. If it is indeed Sir, I doubt it would willingly reveal its true identity.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_032: We use lightning on the console again, but we make it stronger. Much stronger.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_033: At that moment, should the unit exhibit a reaction, that could suggest that it has a connection to Sir.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_034: An inspired idea. I daresay it is worth a try.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_035: I had a feeling you'd be on board. This time, you must allow me to do the honors.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALPHINAUD_000_036: I will stand guard in case your incantation draws sentries to the scene.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_037: For my part, then, I will approach our suspect and divert its attention.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_038: During which time, , I want you to observe it closely for anomalous behavior.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALPHINAUD_000_039: I should mention that, shortly before you returned, an Omicron appeared from the same direction.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Rather than entering the outpost, however, it headed off towards the console. At first I assumed it was a unit on patrol, but perhaps...
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_041: That could only be our errant Omicron! We must seek it out and begin our operation at once!
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_042: All right, Alphinaud and I will stand by at the console. And when it's time, I'll unleash a veritable storm!
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_043: This will work, I'm sure of it. After all, our comrades are watching over us...
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_044: Come, my friend. Let us find this doubt-plagued Omicron!
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_M017_000_050: Bzzzt... It is you again. What is your query?
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_060: You are the one that was observing the tree, are you not? Full glad I am to find you again.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_061: I have a question for you, you see. About the device which sustains the tree.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_M017_000_062: Provided it does not necessitate the disclosure of restricted information, very well...
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_SYSTEM_000_063: G'raha has begun distracting the Omicron. Soon, Alisaie will strike the console with lightning.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_SYSTEM_000_064: Observe M-017 closely for anomalous behavior after Alisaie has cast her spell. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target an area and confirm it with .
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_M017_000_066: Performing diagnostic... Error confirmed. My connection to central command is suffering from intermittent failures.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_M017_000_067: I must leave at once and present myself for maintenance at the nearest facility. You will excuse me.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_068: What you need, my friend, isn't maintenance. It is to confront the truth.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_069: While we spoke, our comrade struck the console used to communicate with Sir.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_070: That is the cause of your anomaly. You are connected to Sir, aren't you?
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_M017_000_072: To what end you sought to assert this fact, I do not know. But before we speak further, we must move away from the other units.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_M017_000_073: I do not wish for them to know my true identity.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_074: Very well. Our friends are at the console. Let us head there.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALPHINAUD_000_080: If naught is amiss with the other Omicrons, I dare to hope we have found that which prevents our advance.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_085: A little jolt works wonders, doesn't it?
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_086: All that's left is to have this Omicron divulge the truth to us.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_090: This unit struggles to understand why the tree continues to grow despite being destined to die.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_GRAHATIA_000_091: Let us shed light on its doubts, that we may shine the way forward.
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALPHINAUD_000_100: A crystalline path... He has paved it for us...
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_110: They all leave so easily, as if it's nothing... How do they think we feel!?
TEXT_AKTKMG112_04461_ALISAIE_000_111: The next time we meet, I'll...I'll give him such a flick...and that'll be just to start...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_010: That crystalline path─G'raha has paved it for us.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Difficult as it is, we must carry on. For our friends, and all who await us in faith.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_012: So come, let us seek the path's beginning. It appears to be near the outpost.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_020: I won't let it break me, don't you worry. I never have, and I never will.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_031: It will surely deliver us true. It must.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_045: Look up, . It's as though the stars are being devoured by the dead sun...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_046: And that's where we're headed─into the maw of darkness.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Well, here is where the path begins. And it ascends to dizzying heights...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Let us make our way, one sure step at a time.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Now more than ever, we must walk as one. Will you go and take Alisaie's hand?
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_Q3_000_070: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Forgotten something, have you? Very well, we'll be waiting by the portal.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Aye, let us press on. One sure step at a time, till we win through to Meteion.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_SYSTEM_000_080: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_090: We should keep moving. Go and tell Alphinaud, will you?
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_SYSTEM_000_091: You should have Alphinaud accompanying you before setting forth.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_100: Our friends got us this far. Their courage, their strength. Their wisdom. Their love.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_101: We owe it to them to continue. No matter how long it takes...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_SYSTEM_000_102: Alphinaud and Alisaie are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_SYSTEM_000_103: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_SYSTEM_000_104: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Should you start to fall, we'll be here to catch you. I know you'll do the same for us.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_121: Alisaie appears to have fallen behind... We had best head back and fetch her.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_125: G'raha paved this path for us. We were meant to follow it.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_126: Where did Alphinaud disappear to now? We need to turn around and look for him.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_130: We understand, take what time you need. When you're ready to continue, we'll be waiting by the portal.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_135: If you're ready, then so am I. Let's follow the path where it leads!
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_140: The innumerable lights that shine in the distance─to think that they all could have birthed civilizations...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_141: To think that everything they built has gone to dust, their peoples lost to despair... Of the stars floating in this sea of midnight, ours is a lonely aberration.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_142: And yet...no matter how many worlds have met their ends, with you and Alisaie beside me, there is nothing I fear. No ocean so vast I cannot cross.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_145: Those broken stars I see─shattered, ruptured, unraveled─I wonder if they're also worlds recreated at their ends...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_146: The sight of them fills me with a sorrow I cannot describe...and a truth I cannot deny.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_147: Birth...and death. Whence we came and where we'll return. A wheel from which there is no escape.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_150: ...Thancred would scout the road ahead. Y'shtola and Urianger would trade opinions on esoteric subjects.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_151: G'raha would join in their discussion, or else chat with me and Alisaie about the mission. Estinien would be at the rear, apart yet present.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_152: All the while you would come and go. Wherever you are needed. And together, we would travel...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_155: All I can hear are my footfalls. My heartbeat. It's so much quieter now...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_156: But the fact we can breathe and continue on is proof that the others are still with us.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_157: They are... They are... Aren't they...?
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_160: The portal is barely visible from up here.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_161: ...Truly, we've come far. Much farther than would have been possible had we kept chasing perfect ideals as we did in the past.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_162: It is because we have known failure and frustration─that we have learned and grown from them─that Hydaelyn has entrusted us with this mission. With the fate of the very star.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_165: It's all a dream, isn't it...? A long, elaborate dream...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_166: Any moment now, I'll wake up in my bed. Still a student. Grandfather alive. I'd go about my day, relieved as the fragments of that other life fade away...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_167: And that would be happiness...wouldn't it? That none of it... No. No, I won't give up these experiences. Good and bad, they are mine. They are me.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_170: Rest assured I am fine...but thank you for your concern. What of yourself? Though we can't afford to be too leisurely, neither need we rush unduly.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_171: We've crossed an impossible distance to stand where we are now, and we're but a few steps away from journey's end. It will be over before we know it.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_175: Me...? Oh, I still have plenty of legs left in me, don't you worry. It's you I'm worried about.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_176: You always push yourself so hard for us─for everyone. And while we're here, we'll make sure to bear our share of the burden.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_180: Well, this is it. The end of the path, and the beginning of whatever awaits.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_181: There will be greater hardships. We may be made to feel powerless.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_182: Yet come what may, let us have no regrets. No, let us have pride in what we have achieved.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_183: In what we achieved, and how it changed us for the better... That's worth fighting for. And dying for. As they did...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_185: There are some structures up ahead. Still a ways to go before we reach the dead sun...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_186: Given...all this...I know how naive it must sound to hope it all works out somehow.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_187: Still, you'll forgive me if I wish for it all the same. And for you most of all.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_188: Not that you of all people need it. It's just...after all the help you've given me, for once I want to be the one to help you.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_190: Of all the recreated worlds we've seen, this one feels the most familiar...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_SYSTEM_000_195: You should have Alisaie accompanying you before continuing.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_201: Normal? It's not unlike many cities we know. But it's deathly quiet...
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_202: Mayhap the inhabitants are within the buildings. Or invisible to our senses.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_METEION_000_203: (-???-)Wrong on both counts. There is simply no one here.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_METEION_000_205: This is how I found it when I arrived. Another star which once pulsed with life, but no longer.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_METEION_000_206: How it ended, I do not know. Invasion, sickness, suicide─none can say.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_METEION_000_207: None lived to speak for the dead. They are gone. Gone. Search all you like, but you'll only end up turning back.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALISAIE_000_210: If what Meteion says is true, what are we supposed to do...?
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_220: If there is no one here, then neither should there be emotion to bar our way.
TEXT_AKTKMG113_04462_ALPHINAUD_000_221: Yet Meteion seems convinced we'll turn back. What riddle is this...?
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALPHINAUD_000_000: One way or another, we must find the way forward. Let us make a thorough search of the city.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_010: Whatever Meteion may have said, we should confirm it with our own eyes. We need to have a look around.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Indeed. At the very least, it doesn't appear to be a sprawling place like those before. If we split up, it shouldn't take too long to cover the area.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALPHINAUD_000_020: The isle's edge already, and there only appears to be this park here. How it must have bustled with life once upon a time...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_025: I'm trying to see if there are ways to reach the nearby isles. Just in case Meteion was bluffing...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_030: There doesn't seem to be anyone here. Perhaps you could try calling out...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_034: If anyone has heard you, they do not respond.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_040: The object resembles a tree, and appears to have been fashioned from a stone-like material.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_041: Erected in place of an actual tree...or to serve some other purpose, perhaps. Regardless, there is no one left to explain. To tell the story...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_045: Were it not for the thick layer of dust, one could imagine someone drinking from these cups but moments ago...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_050: This place is reminiscent of a bar, but neither patrons nor staff are anywhere to be seen.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_051: Egg-shaped containers line the shelves, with a loose few sitting on the counter. Vessels for the beverages, in all likelihood.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_052: A venue bustling with activity until it was not...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_055: Though set slightly off the ground, this appears to be a door, while the objects to the left could be letter boxes.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_056: The door is rusted shut, and the film of dust all over suggests no one has come through in a long, long time...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_060: In the distance, you glimpse Alisaie picking her way through the ruins, but otherwise spy no signs of life.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_A2_000_062: If anyone can hear me, say something!
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_064: Your call echoes faintly before being swallowed by the silence...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_SYSTEM_000_065: You strain your ears to catch something─anything─but hear not so much as the chirping of an insect...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_070: , take a look at this. If the road was a little longer, we could take it to just beneath the dead sun.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_071: But I suppose this is where the reconstruction ends...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_072: How about you? Did you find anything of interest?
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_073: I see. I noticed the same things─cups left upon tables, chairs out of place... I don't know what happened here, but I do know I don't want to be alone anymore...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_074: We've searched enough for now. Let's find Alphinaud and compare what we've learned.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_Q3_000_080: Continue with the main scenario quest?
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_090: (-Voice from the Past-)If you need a push, I'll be right there behind you.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_095: (-Voice from the Past-)Do not despair! You are not without allies.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_100: (-Voice from the Past-)What we have sown in blood, we have reaped in suffering, and it cannot go on.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_105: (-Voice from the Past-)Upon the souls of they who have sacrificed themselves to pave the way for peace, we will never abandon our cause.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_110: (-Voice from the Past-)While it is true that man succumbs all too often to anger and avarice, he may yet overcome his baser instincts through the forming of bonds with others.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_115: (-Voice from the Past-)Such victories are rarely won without sacrifice. But the prize is worth the price.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_120: (-Voice from the Past-)And we for our part are glad indeed to be able to welcome friends both old and new...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_125: (-Voice from the Past-)Save your tears for the morrow. You may be sure we will have ample cause to shed them, be they for joy or despair.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_130: (-Voice from the Past-)From tragedy and sacrifice we rise to greet a new dawn.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_135: (-Voice from the Past-)A future shaped by the choices we made, in ways we could never have foreseen.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_140: (-Voice from the Past-)Yet miracles do happen. So let us pray, and will our friends home.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_145: (-Voice from the Past-)I won't stop praying until I know they're safe.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_150: (-Voice from the Past-)Strong art thou, mortal.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_PASSER_000_155: (-Voice from the Past-)Look to the light within, that you may continue to serve as a beacon to others.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_170: I don't think I ever knew what to say to the man. In retrospect, it always felt like the wrong thing...
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_171: But the past notwithstanding, he came to your aid in your moment of need.
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_172: We are here, and we will not squander this chance he has given us!
TEXT_AKTKMG114_04463_ALISAIE_000_173: We will see this tale to a triumphant conclusion, and bid the final curtain fall!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_000: Let's usher in an ending worthy of the grandest ovation─one that will give all Etheirys cause to raise their voices in celebration!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Then let us set forth for the reckoning.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Having come this far, I know everyone's resolve is beyond doubt. So I will say only this.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Within that dead sun swirls the emotions that Meteion has hoarded. The emotions of innumerable souls who strove for happiness but failed.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_014: As it was with the denizens of Ultima Thule that barred our way, it is not for us to rebuke and admonish.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_015: 'Twas not by passing judgment on the tragic legacies of others that we arrived at this moment.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Rather, it was by opening our hearts to their despair─by understanding and acknowledging their fates, while still refusing to share in them ourselves. To hold fast to hope, not in ignorance but by choice.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Should you struggle to do so, I am here to help. As you have all helped me.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A1_000_021: Let's put an end to the end.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A2_000_032: Form a party and enter the Dead Ends.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Emet-Selch and Hythlodaeus created these flowers from our hopes.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_041: If so, mine and Alisaie's shall live on here...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_042: The hope that you will find happiness at journey's end.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_043: So let us go, , and see this tale to its conclusion!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_045: Just so you know, , I won't try to keep up with you in the coming battle.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_046: No, I mean to surpass you! If there's anyone who'll need to keep up, it's Estinien!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_047: I'm not joking. Both Alphinaud and I have worked hard and come far. It's time we set our sights higher.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_048: So you had better watch out, else you'll find yourself in my wake!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_050: It seems our arms and armor are in order, as are our personal effects.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_051: Most importantly, we have each other. We need only finish what we came here to do.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_052: Avert the end. For Minfilia, for Ryne, for all who aspire to live.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_055: Thus far, we have encountered recreations of some few stars. Doubtless they account for but a fraction of the innumerable worlds to whose fall Meteion did bear witness.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_056: Roiling with torment, the dead sun is forsooth oblivion's apotheosis. It shall be no small coup to breach this nexus of despair.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_057: And yet, as this vista doth prove, where there is hope, there is a way. So let us press forward together, as e'er we have, and find our way unto victory.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_060: As Alphinaud says, everyone's resolve is beyond doubt. Yet ere we set forth, there is a thought to which I must give voice.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_061: While you were in Elpis, I understand that people assumed you were a familiar.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_062: In contrast, those phantoms we encountered in the recreated Amaurot regarded us as children.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_063: As people, albeit naive and immature.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_064: The discrepancy, I posit, is a reflection of their creator's perspective. Having spent eons among sundered men, perhaps he came to acknowledge us, even if only subconsciously.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_065: With Emet-Selch gone, we may never learn the truth. But I will not suffer this and countless other mysteries to go unsolved. Our journey will not end this day.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_070: I am returned, thanks to you, but we still have work to do if we are to make our promise a reality.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_071: Having you show me the sights in Ishgard, then regaling me your greatest adventures, then embarking on a new adventure together... For these things and more, I will fight.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_072: ...What? Could there possibly be an adventure greater than this one?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_073: Of course! So long as you desire it and dare to take the first step, there is absolutely no limit!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_075: So, the moment of reckoning is finally upon us... I must say, when I pledged myself to your cause, never did I imagine that it would bring me to the very edge of existence.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_076: Not that I'm complaining, mind you. After casting aside vengeance and shedding title and duty, I found myself wanting for purpose. In journeying with you, there has been nary a dull moment.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_077: In the course of it all, I feel as though I have found a new place for myself. And a welcome opportunity to see how much the boy has grown.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_078: I owe you a debt, aye. But as you can guess, I've ever preferred to express my gratitude through action rather than word. My lance is yours.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_SYSTEM_000_095: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 90 or above to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_TATARU_000_100: Go on, ! Don't miss this chance to say a word to each of our friends!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_TATARU_000_101: After all you've been through together, I'm sure they'd appreciate it!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Oh, . Pray forgive me for delaying the gathering.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_111: I was writing a letter, you see. To my parents.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_112: As busy as Father has been, tending the aftermath of the exodus, he has been good enough to show concern for the Scions.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_113: And besides...I've made them worry enough for a lifetime. Henceforth, I will endeavor to write as often as I am able.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_114: A little effort to set their minds at ease while we continue to be away from Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_115: Both Alisaie and I are off to assist with Garlemald's recovery, you see. Though uncertainty remains over what will become of the nation, we cannot well leave the capital in its present state.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_116: We will rejoin those members of the Ilsabard contingent still stationed there. Lucia and Maxima helm the relief effort, with support from our allies─the people of Garlemald among them.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_117: They will gradually be joined by those who have finished treating the tempered across the lands.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_118: Lest you misunderstand, we do not seek redemption for failing Licinia and her sister. That is a burden we must always bear.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_119: Nay, we go because of the truth in Lord Quintus's words.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_120: The truth that, whatever ideals individuals may espouse, nations are not moved to action unless they stand to benefit...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_121: For the foreseeable future, the fallen Empire will be at the mercy of both internal and external forces.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_122: And though I do not doubt the intentions of the contingent, with greater powers involved in the relief effort, our allies may well find themselves drawn into a political agenda.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_123: In going, we seek to ensure that the needs of the people come first. To understand their hearts, that we might better help them to begin anew.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_127: Write you letters? Of course I would be glad to do so...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_128: But I would be gladder still were you to come and visit, and I believe I speak for Alisaie as well.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_129: By all means! Full glad would I be for your visit, and I believe I speak for Alisaie as well!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_130: For fairly as long as I've been in Eorzea, you've been at my side. Watching over me, in good times and in bad.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_131: How many times have we gathered to share tidings... None could possibly keep count.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_132: The world is changing and will continue to do so. Yet no matter what the future brings, I hope that I can ever look to you...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_133: In good times and in bad. As a dependable comrade and dear friend both.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_134: Thank you, . From the bottom of my heart.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_140: I've been keeping Arenvald abreast of the situation in letters, but unfortunately he could not be here today.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALPHINAUD_000_141: When it is convenient for both of us, we should pay him a visit.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_150: ! Seen to your preparations, have you?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_151: I'm just making another sweep of my belongings. Wouldn't do to find I've forgotten something halfway to my destination...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_152: Oh, in case you hadn't heard, we've received new reports detailing the devastation caused by the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_153: It appears the situation is gravest in the lands surrounding the Bounty, where the sky first began to burn.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_154: After that, the calamity was observed in the far north─in Garlemald and the frozen lands beyond.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_155: We also had reports of the heavens catching fire in isolated locations, one of which was an area in the Northern Empty. Had our quest taken any longer, Sharlayan too may have come under threat.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_157: To be sure, blasphemies and lesser beasts may still be roaming about, but these localized crises should be well within the capacities of each nation to handle on their own. The Scions are no longer needed.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_158: Which isn't to say that we won't help out where we can, of course. As individuals─no more of this order business.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_159: For my part, I'll be heading to Garlemald with Alphinaud. They were among the worst affected, and still need all the help they can get.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_161: An inevitable part of aiding those in need is coming face-to-face with tragedy.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_162: Knowing it doesn't make it any easier, though. That I'll curse my weakness. My inability to fix every problem and save every lost soul.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_163: But no matter how much it hurts, I won't give up.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_164: I'll do what I can for as many people as I can, begrudging no effort.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_165: And should I find myself discouraged, I'll remember you. Think back fondly to one of your many moments of triumph and the accompanying determined expression.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_166: Even those that still annoy me in retrospect, like when you activated the teleporter without warning!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_167: And should you hear about me, I want you to remember too.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_168: Remember that I'm out there somewhere, trying my very best.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A6_000_170: I look forward to hearing all about the legendary Alisaie Leveilleur.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A6_000_171: Think you can keep up with me?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_172: N-Not that I'm trying to become famous or anything...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_174: Heh, you asked for it, so you had better watch out!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_176: The next time we meet, I'll be vastly improved. So don't be surprised when you find yourself marveling at me!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_180: Hm, did I forget to mention anything? ...Ah, yes! The Hannish envoy who came to see Estinien also bore a letter from Matsya.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_181: He writes that Mehvan and Qerasaf's little girl is doing well, and he often goes to visit her.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ALISAIE_000_182: It won't be easy growing up without her parents, but with her fellow villagers watching over her, I dare to hope that she won't want for warmth as she grows up.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_190: Ah, our champion and savior. I was beginning to think my chance for an audience would never come!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_191: ...Ahem, that sounded more amusing in my head. Speaking of heads, I was worried about yours─and the rest of you, for that matter. On the mend, I trust?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_192: Glad to hear it. You were in a bad way, and healing magicks or no, I'm impressed by how swiftly you've recovered...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_193: Then again, 'tis hardly the first time you've cheated death. Your strength of will has never failed to astonish me.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_194: Look at what you've accomplished. Meteion defeated, her song of oblivion cut short. The Source and all her reflections delivered from the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_195: If you had faltered at the last, then all hope would have been lost. But you held fast.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_196: Now Ryne has a tomorrow to look forward to, and I could ask for no greater gift than that.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_197: As for a lesser gift, however... The next time you see her, I would appreciate you not describing my travel plans with Urianger as “aimless wandering.”
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_198: We've a purpose in our roaming, after all: keeping an eye on things in the absence of the Scions on the world stage.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_199: There'll never be an end to the little problems that go untended by nations. We will do our best to help out where and when we can.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_200: ...Which I suppose is an approach not far removed from “aimless wandering” when you get down to it.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_201: Perhaps you could tell her I am faring well, and leave it at that, eh?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_202: No need to mention this feeling of being uprooted...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_203: I've never been one to stand still for long, but when I think of home, 'tis the Rising Stones which comes to mind. How many times have we set out from this base, thence to return when our work was done?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_204: On the day the Scions came together, I only hoped for Minfilia to find a place where she belonged...but never did I expect to find one here for myself.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_205: Indulge me, . I have a question for you─and imagine Minfilia herself is asking.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_206: Are you glad you joined the Scions?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A7_000_209: There's never been a dull moment, that's for certain.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_210: Aye, I can honestly say the same.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_211: That's one way of putting it! In many ways, the experience has left us far stronger than when we began.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_212: But all good things must come to an end...at least for a time.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_213: Should you need a helping hand for infiltration or reconnaissance, you know who to ask. I'll come running, and you'll likely get a certain “funny-talking fortune-teller” into the bargain.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_215: In case you've not heard, the Waking Sands will be converted into a warehouse. We'll be keeping the place free of rats and cobwebs, so it can still serve as an outpost should the need arise.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_THANCRED_000_216: Considering Tataru's ambitions, however, I'd not be surprised if she claimed the lot for her budding empire...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_220: , thou hast spoken with our comrades?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_221: Though this parting be not forevermore, 'tis nonetheless occasion for sorrow. Akin to a pixie's path, the navigation of such farewells is a perilous endeavor indeed...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_222: For their part, however, the Loporrits embark upon a new beginning.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_223: Though bereft of its purpose as a vessel, the moon yet remaineth hospitable for the creatures of Etheirys.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_224: Thus do our lunar visitors convene with the Forum, intent upon assigning some new and beneficial role to our solitary satellite.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_225: Yet ere that may come to pass, there is much and more each party must learn of the other─a process which doth promise to be eventful indeed.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_226: To that end, a cadre of Loporrits hath gleefully dispersed across our lands in the name of mutual understanding.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_227: Hydaelyn, 'tis said, did imbue them with Her love for all things born of this star...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_228: ...And 'tis Venat's own nature, I believe, which doth manifest in this irrepressible, inexhaustible curiosity of theirs.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_229: Having witnessed that which they strove to achieve, I wish most keenly for their long labors to be rewarded─that their abiding affection for man result in a boon for all.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_230: Moreover, I hope to continue our acquaintance, and share in such knowledge as they see fit to impart...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A8_000_233: You are the first to truly understand them.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_235: Aye, I would be honored should they consider me a friend.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_236: For 'tis certainly true that I have grown fond of their company.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_238: The Loporrits are certainly possessed of a unique outlook, and it hath been my pleasure to act as their facilitator upon this star.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_239: Mayhap I might yet serve as a bridge betwixt them and our fellow man...as Moenbryda once did for me.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_240: Ah, but I shall digress no further. This day should belong to the Scions of the Seventh Dawn; to mine incomparable companions.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_241: Ofttimes hath mine reticence caused thee grief, and mine actions spurred allies to suspect betrayal...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_242: And yet, here amongst you I still stand. No amount of words could express my gratitude for thine acceptance and forgiveness.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_243: Thus instead, I do proffer my humble support.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_244: Be it unto the deepest abyss or the highest heavens, even if I must needs founder 'cross stormy seas, ever shall I answer thy summons.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_250: I understand that, following thy clash with Zenos, the teleportation device thou had discarded fell to thee from on high.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_251: To return to thee in such a manner... I did confer with Wilfsunn and Bloewyda, yet they insist the device was possessed of no such capability.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_URIANGER_000_252: 'Twas a miracle befitting the nature of that place, where emotion becometh tangible reality. Whence, then, arose this timely wonder? Thine ardent wish...or another's fervent prayer?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_260: Oh, are we saying our farewells, too? I hadn't, at present, planned on a journey of any great length...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_261: ...Not that I am averse to a moment or two of quiet reminiscence.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_262: In fact, there was something I'd been meaning to ask you─something that has been in my thoughts since the last flames of the Final Days subsided.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_263: During our travels, we have witnessed more than a lifetime's worth of oddities and spectacles. More than can be easily recalled or remembered...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_264: And nestled amongst those memories are certain essential facts─the history of Etheirys and the ancients; glimpses of the Ea─of their culture and philosophy.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_265: Rather than simply hoard such treasures in my mind, I wonder if I should not be disseminating them in formal records for wider consumption.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_266: When needed, I have penned reports and prepared briefings... But ever have I balked at the idea of binding the subject of my studies in a book or tablet.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_267: Truth is given shape in interpretation. When we seek to capture it with our words, it is invariably molded to fit a narrative─no matter how well-intentioned the rendering.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_268: An event is described as “sad.” A summation which fails to express the emotional complexity. Yet the word on the page is what endures. A pale shadow of reality.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_269: Throughout history, some have deliberately embellished the truth, but I believe many─if not most─deviations are the result of similar linguistic shortcomings, piling one upon the other, until the end result is unrecognizable from its origin.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_270: Which is why I fear that writing an account in my own words would be akin to diluting fine wine with water.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_271: Yet even with the potential for corrupted meaning, I do of course realize the importance of keeping written records. Without them, my search for wisdom would be a painful affair indeed.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_272: But what say you on this matter? Should I take up the quill? Reflect upon those experiences only we have shared, and seek to preserve them for posterity?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A9_000_274: Aye, let them be read and remembered.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A9_000_275: Nay, it's enough to hold them in your memories.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_276: Very well, then. I shall endeavor to pen what I can of the Ea, and the ancients, and of so many other wonders.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_277: But I am no scribe. It will be less a polished work, and more a reordering of scattered notes...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_278: Very well, then. I will refrain from publishing any formal work on the Ea, or the ancients, or on any of the wonders we encountered.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_279: I will, however, need to keep a few notes for future research. The passage of time can warp the truth just as surely as a poorly chosen word...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_280: In any case, I feel much better for having sought your opinion. Left to our own devices, we tend to overthink such things.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_281: I will otherwise return to following where my curiosity leads. After all, a safe method of travel to the First yet eludes me, and our venture into the great expanse has prompted an entirely new set of questions!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_282: Should you stumble into the unknown, or struggle with some impenetrable mystery, know that I am at your beck and call.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_283: It never hurts to see things from a different perspective, and mine is rather different than most!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_285: Lyse came to visit the other day. She peppered me with questions about the lasting repercussions of the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_286: I took the opportunity to explain our plans to “disband,” and she understood our reasoning immediately. Once a Scion, always a Scion, it would seem.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_YSHTOLA_000_287: She was eager to relive old times, and remember old friends... Bittersweet memories, mayhap, but from the look on her face, the joys outweighed the sorrows.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_290: Oh, . Might you have a moment to talk?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_291: With the Scions stepping away from the public eye, I've been left to consider what new endeavors I might pursue.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_292: And after speaking with Krile, I've decided. I will be assisting her in rebuilding the Students of Baldesion.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_293: Not only am I indebted to Master Galuf for giving me a new home, but had our order never existed, I would have never set foot within the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_294: How different my life might have been...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_295: I would have never met you. Never become caretaker of the tower. Never become a Scion.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_296: You gave me the chance to do so much good, and I hope to continue to do so with the Students.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_297: For an added benefit, new mysteries often find their way to our doorsteps─mysteries that could prove ideal for fulfilling our promise: to embark on a new adventure together, unlike any we've experienced before!
