TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_298: Whenever you have the time and inclination, my friend, I stand ready to accompany you unto the unknown!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_299: ...Do you recall in the realm of the Omicrons, when I asked if you thought I may someday be mentioned in your epic?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_300: While 'tis true that to earn a place at your side would be the stuff of dreams...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_301: In the end, nothing would give me greater joy than to stand with you in the here and now!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_302: It needn't be some grand endeavor. There needn't be a promise. Whenever adventure calls, I won't hesitate to invite you...and I hope that you will do the same for me.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A10_000_305: As long as you don't overexert yourself.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_306: Hah, I'll hold you to that!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_307: I know, I know. I can all but hear Lyna and Beq Lugg's voices each time you remind me.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_308: ...As much as we have already seen, there's still so much we haven't. Who knows─perhaps we will even encounter survivors of the Omicrons somewhere out there.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_309: After all, given how they took to the stars, it isn't implausible that some found themselves far from home.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_310: And should we encounter a wayward traveler awaiting commands that will never come...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_311: I would bid them seek adventure with someone, and with that partner find new purpose. A new dream.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_312: For if crystals can hold fast to dreams, why not Omicrons?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_313: Wherever your plans may lead, do not hesitate to send word. And should a commission of interest come my way, you will be the first to know!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_315: By the way, have you spoken with Feo Ul of late? Some days ago, they appeared to me in a dream─of the sleeping persuasion, that is.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_316: All is well in the First, they bade me tell you.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_GRAHATIA_000_317: When I asked why not tell you themself, they unleashed giant, ravenous beavers upon me... Have you perchance done something to incur their ire?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_320: ...If you have something to say, then out with it.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A11_000_322: Just worried how you'll earn your keep now.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A11_000_323: Just wondering how I'll earn my keep now.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_324: You talk as if the Scions' dissolution was more than mere pretense. There may be fewer calls to action, but we should be compensated as before.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_325: ...Why are you so concerned for me, anyway?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_326: What, I thought you adventurers had any number of ways to earn coin. And though the Scions' mode of operation has changed, we should be compensated as before.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_327: In any case, I do not want for options. Even if some are worse than others...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_328: No sooner did Aymeric hear about our disbandment than he offered me a position as a guardsman in the Empyreum district. As a former Azure Dragoon, I'm guaranteed to be popular, he said.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_329: Who does he take me for!? Even without his meddling, I'm perfectly capable of finding employment─and have!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_330: Some days ago, a Hannish envoy arrived with word from Vrtra. The wyrm requests my presence as soon as things have settled here.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_331: He didn't deign to mention why I'm needed, but it pertains to dragons, like as not.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_332: In Thavnair, like elsewhere, the phenomena caused by the Final Days abated when you defeated Meteion.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_333: Though it was too late for those who had already transformed, life is beginning to return to normal for the survivors.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_334: Of those who sought refuge in Sharlayan, most have already returned home.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_335: But many do not have a home to return to, nor loved ones. By an arrangement between Vrtra and the Forum, such souls may remain in Sharlayan if they wish, to work and study.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_336: Vrtra was always the satrap in truth. It's gratifying to see him become one in name as well─one who has the complete confidence of his people, if the envoy's tone was any indication.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_337: Hmph, I often find myself speaking favorably of dragons of late...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_338: Not so long ago, I would have assumed his benevolence hid ulterior motives. But 'tis clear he cares for his people, and they in turn revere him.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_339: To know such a nation may flourish is...comforting.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_340: Vrtra's kin sought release from conflict. So weary were they of the suffering it wrought, they surrendered to oblivion.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_341: But Midgardsormr didn't give up. In hope he made the journey to distant Etheirys with his clutch of eggs.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_342: And though his progeny went on to be embroiled in conflict with men, there were times when they transcended hatred to abide in harmony.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_343: That is their legacy and their triumph.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_344: In my lance, I feel the weight of their struggle and the strength of their resolve. And it lends me strength.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_345: These things, I might never have learned had I not joined you.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_346: Should you ever have need of me, I will come. At the very least, it might be an opportunity to earn coin.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_350: Word has it a false deity born in the Tower of Zot has survived, and occasionally appears to terrorize the locals.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_351: Those who vanquish the being and present proof in Radz-at-Han will receive a handsome reward. Though “handsome” isn't the word I would use to describe such outlandish garb...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_ESTINIEN_000_352: But while I'm in Thavnair, perhaps I will acquire a set to send to Aymeric in lieu of an answer to his job offer. Let him stand guard thus attired and be the talk of Empyreum, if not all Coerthas.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_360: Oh, . How are you feeling? Any lingering aches or pains?
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_361: I can't apologize enough for sending Zenos to find you in Ultima Thule...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_362: When he came to me in Sharlayan, I was truly torn. As ever, there was only one thing on his mind.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_363: Forced to make a decision, I reasoned that, if he would not be deterred from seeking you out, he might at least aid us in our cause. And so I struck a bargain...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_364: In the end, he was true to his word, and you defeated him despite your earlier exertions. But knowing the state you were found in, it could have ended very differently.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_365: My decision almost cost you your life, and no words could express the remorse I feel...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A12_000_367: It worked out. You did the right thing.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_A12_000_368: I won't lie─I thought that was it for me.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_369: It is a relief to hear you say that. Thank you.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_370: So did everyone... I'm so sorry, ...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_371: Time and time again, I've been made to feel woefully inadequate.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_372: I wasn't much use in battle, nor could I face the Forum without my nerves getting the better of me. It always fell to you and the others.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_374: And I shall begin with the restoration of the Students of Baldesion. Through our work, Sharlayan will strengthen its ties with other nations, that we may be better prepared to face whatever threats arise in future.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_375: Of course, this isn't something I can accomplish alone. But thankfully, I have the staunchest of help in Raha and Ojika and our other remaining members. Together, we'll continue Grandfather's work.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_376: As before, certain commissions will take us to dangerous locales, and we may need to call upon seasoned adventurers.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_377: In such times, might you be willing to assist us? Not because you feel obliged, mind you, but because you feel allure for the task itself.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_378: Marvelous. Should something of interest arise, I shan't hesitate to reach out to you.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_379: Until that day, I shall endeavor to become a more dependable comrade.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_385: Oh, I should mention that Erenville has kindly agreed to share aught of potential interest he hears from his fellow gleaners.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_386: In exchange, we will help them to restore the archives to their proper order. With the exodus abandoned, all items must be returned whence they came─a task no less grueling than their removal.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_387: Even now, Ojika assists in the sorting of arcane artifacts. Oh yes, not only is he a skilled administrator─he's also a certified appraiser specializing in relics from the Fifth Astral Era!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_KRILE_000_388: Despite his qualifications, though, he seems none too keen on the work. I shall have to go and relieve him as soon as I can...
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_TATARU_000_390: Spoken your fill, have you? If so, I'm thinking to send everyone off.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_TATARU_000_393: Your attention please! At risk of spoiling the mood, the time of departure is upon us.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_TATARU_000_394: In my capacity as your receptionist, I bid you all safe journeys. Till next we meet...be well!
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_SYSTEM_000_400: You have completed the main scenario quest “Endwalker”! Quests to unlock new content have now become available in Old Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_SYSTEM_000_401: Additionally, you may now enter the Dead Ends with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKMG115_04464_SYSTEM_000_402: Rest well, champion of Etheirys, for many and more adventures await you!
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_002: If you're not in too much of a rush, I was about to make a pot of tea. Would you like a cup?
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_003: Take a seat, then, and I'll find us something to nibble on as well.
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_050: Observe as the artiste refines her piece into a masterpiece!
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_051: And no napping this time! I only need a moment─you'll see!
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_052: A little more room in the shoulders...open up the cuffs...a final adjustment to the hem...
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_053: All done! Let's see how it looks on the mannequin.
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_054: Well, what do you think? Doesn't it just scream “ready for a bold new adventure”!?
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_A1_000_001: You've outdone yourself, Tataru, thank you!
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_A1_000_002: So, what do I owe you...?
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_058: Oh, don't be silly. Your approval is payment enough!
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_059: If you really want to thank me, though, all I ask is that you wear this on your travels!
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_060: Or at least anywhere lots of adventurers might gather, heh heh...
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_061: They'll look at you, a famous hero, and wonder, “Wherever did  purchase those stylish-yet-practical garments?”
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_062: And before you know it, hordes of new customers will be climbing over each other to place orders at Tataru Taru's Boutique!
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_063: Muahaha! I can hear it now─the merry clink-clink of gil overflowing from my coffers! Sweet music to my ears!
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_064: Ahem... Burgeoning merchant empires aside, you must be excited to start a fresh chapter of your life. New places to go, new people to meet─I often wonder how you remember all your experiences and exploits without taking at least a few notes...
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_TATARU_000_065: Oh! Maybe you should start doing just that! You never know when some odd past detail might become relevant, or if one day you'll take a blow to the head and forget the better part of the past decade. Something to keep in mind, in any case!
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_SYSTEM_000_067: The Unending Codex is now available under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKMH101_04526_SYSTEM_000_068: New entries for prominent terms and characters will be added to the codex as you progress through the main scenario quests.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_TATARU_000_001: As the, uh, “former” receptionist and sometimes intelligence gatherer of the Scions, allow me to offer you a word of advice...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_TATARU_000_002: Do not expect juicy rumors to simply fall into your lap!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_TATARU_000_003: Adventurers rely on gossip, and the best places to pick up information are taverns and markets.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_TATARU_000_004: At present, you only have a broad destination in mind. When you arrive in Thavnair, I suggest you explore your options at Mehryde's Meyhane─the finest drinking establishment in Radz-at-Han!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_TATARU_000_005: Charm the employees, and they'll not only point you in the direction of the local tale-tellers, but also share with you the tricks for loosening their tongues!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_TATARU_000_006: Now, I really must be getting back to running my boutique. Enjoy the journey, , and may fair fortune find you!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_030: There is nothing so perfect in this life as a full glass and an empty schedule. Now, what to order...?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MIHLEEL_000_051: Oh, hello, I did not recognize you at first! Are you here alone? Let me find you a table...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MIHLEEL_000_053: Would you be speaking of the sunken treasure vault? We have one regular─a historian, in fact─who could tell you all about it...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MIHLEEL_000_054: Ah, there he is! Professor Jalheen! I thought I saw him come in.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MIHLEEL_000_055: Although a somewhat private sort, the professor is quick to befriend those who share his fondness for the meyhane's unique beverages.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MIHLEEL_000_056: Offer him any drink from our selection, and he should happily share everything he knows about the vault you seek...and a few other odd bits besides!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MIHLEEL_000_057: Whatever you buy for him is on the house, by the way. If Mehryde found out I took coin from Thavnair's savior, she would have me scrubbing pots for a week.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MIHLEEL_000_100: Keep your purse strings tied, friend! We will cover whatever you purchase for the professor or yourself.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_SYSTEM_000_111: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_112: And what may I do for you, my Eorzean friend?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_A1_000_001: I want to ask you about the sunken vault in the Bounty.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_A1_000_002: Oh, just a friendly chat. How about a drink?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_114: ...And where did you hear of such a thing? Eh, I suppose I could tell you about it...except the tale is rather long and my throat is so very dry.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MIHLEEL_000_115: Here we are─one of Mehryde's finest. Enjoy!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_SYSTEM_000_117: Jalheen empties the cup in a single pull...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_118: Well, I certainly wouldn't say no to a drink freely offered.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_122: That was very kind of you, , but I know when I'm being softened up. What is it that you want from me?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_123: Oho, chasing down that old tale, are you? It does seem to appeal to the adventurous at heart.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_124: Now, where to begin... Might I assume you've heard of Alzadaal? He was khan of the Auri tribe which sailed to Thavnair from the mainland, and a key figure in the history of Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_125: His decision to aid the Arkasodara is what ultimately won them the war against the Gajasura, thus allowing our predecessors to lay the foundation for this thriving city-state.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_126: The truly fascinating stories, however, concern his grandson, Alzadaal III, who was known for his deeds as satrap in Radz-at-Han's earlier days.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_127: Some attest that this man traveled to another world entirely, and returned with glittering riches. Others that he brokered an alliance with a certain wyrm of the first brood...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_128: Then there is the tale of the sunken vault─the one you seem most curious about. According to this legend, Alzadaal III claimed a small island somewhere in the middle of the Bounty. There he built a structure reaching clear to the bottom of the sea─a deep and secret storehouse─and locked all his worldly wealth within.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_129: In the centuries since, whenever a natural disaster or hardship befell Radz-at-Han, folk would remember that tale of hidden treasure. Hearty souls would set out to claim their fortune...but precious few ever made it home.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_130: Would you like to hear more? <cough> Apologies, I have a slight tickle in─ Oh, my cup appears to be empty...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_A2_000_001: Mihleel, another round for the professor!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_132: Ah, I see we've reached an understanding! You're a sharp one, adventurer!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_134: Ohohoho! Today was a splendid day to visit the meyhane!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_SYSTEM_000_135: Jalheen gulps down his newest drink with gusto...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_136: I've had but one meager drink, my friend. Surely my learned wisdom is worth a little more than that, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_A3_000_001: Mihleel, another round for the professor!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_A3_000_002: Why don't you tell me something of yourself?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_138: Ah, I see we've reached an understanding! You're a sharp one, adventurer!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_142: I am a far less fascinating subject of conversation, you may be assured...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_143: <sigh> If you must know...these days I style myself a professor of history, but in my younger years I worked as an alchemist at the High Crucible.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_144: I was blessed with meaningful work, a loving companion, and all was right with the world. Until it wasn't.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_145: Ah, but this is too fine  for such maudlin talk. Please, let's have another drink and talk about something else.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_146: Where were we...? Ah─hic!─yes. Those who did return from seeking the treasure vault refused─I mean, flatly refused─to speak of what they saw.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_147: Did this discourage others? Nay! Quite the opposite! Such accounts only served to feed the legend, and the golden lure grew stronger than ever before.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_148: That reminds me of something Azahma was saying─Azahma's a fellow connoisseur of spirituous potables, yes, yes, he is.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_149: Anyway, he was saying that one of his acquaint─hic!─acquaintances went after the treasure himself. Hasn't been seen since he set sail, I hear, but he did have...ah. No, I can say no more.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_100_149: You seem a generous sort─what kind of man would I be to encourage what is clearly a foolhardy quest? If my words sent you to your death, I could never live with myself.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_A4_000_001: I am no stranger to peril.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_151: Is that so? Perhaps it's your turn to tell a tale, then. What manner of dangers have you faced?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_152: ...The very edge of existence!? From anyone else, I'd struggle to believe it, but I recognize you now. You're the─hic!─hero of the Final Days!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_153: A drink... I need another drink to settle my nerves... Mihleel! More of the same, if you please!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MIHLEEL_100_153: As you wish... But this one is on your coin, Professor.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_SYSTEM_000_154: Jalheen drains yet another cup dry...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_155: Is that─hic!─so? Well, I suppose any adventurer worth  salt can go and find the place , eh!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_SYSTEM_000_156: You have learned a few hints as to the nature of the undersea vault, but you cannot help but wonder if a longer conversation may have revealed further details...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_157: Anyway, you being who you are...I shuppose it wouldn't hurt to share a little more. Thish friend of Azahma's, he was deshperate to buy a treasure map...one which showed the way to the entranshe of...of the vault. Sheems he could only get it from shome merchant, what'sh-his-name...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_158: Bah, I forget. Let'sh drink a toasht to you, my new besht friend! ...Mihleel! More drinksh!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_SYSTEM_000_163: Jalheen throws back yet another cup...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_SYSTEM_100_164: Jalheen gulps down the cup of water...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_165: Pffft! That...that was water! Did you tell her to bring me water!?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_167: Shtill, that'sh...that'sh probably for the besht. Very kind of you, really. My head will shertainly thank you in the morning...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_168: Weren't we talkin' about Azahma..? You─hic─wanna know where Azahma is? Around thish time, he's ordinr...odarin...often at the...at the usual plashe...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_SYSTEM_000_169: You have learned some useful information regarding the undersea vault. If Jalheen were more coherent, however, he may have had more details to share...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_170: Ugh, I sheem to have overindulged... I am put in mind of the words of Mashter Jalzahn, “Be wary how much of the drink you shwallow, lesht it shwallow you.”
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_171: Forgive me─I will shubject you to no more of these unsheemly─ahem─unseemly antics. If you want to speak with Azahma, well, as I said, we share a taste for the meyhane's fine spirits. He probably came in as we were talking.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_172: I wish you fortune in...finding your fortune.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_SYSTEM_000_173: You appear to have learned all that Jalheen has to share regarding the undersea vault. To find out more, you will need to locate a man by the name of Azahma.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MIHLEEL_000_200: The professor was able to help you, I hope?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_100_205: Ugh, I think...I think I had one too many...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_JALHEEN_000_205: Perhaps I should find myself a new pastime...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_AZAHMA_000_210: Yes, I am Azahma. And who might you be?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_AZAHMA_000_211: ...All true, I'm afraid. My friend took a ship out in search of Alzadaal's Legacy, and I've been watching for his sails ever since.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_AZAHMA_000_212: I tried to dissuade him, of course, but he refused to listen. All he could talk about was finding that vault.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_AZAHMA_000_213: And that look in his eyes... I knew it wasn't common gold or jewels he lusted after. He was hunting Alzadaal III's “otherworldly” hoard, and his ambition would not be denied.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_AZAHMA_000_214: I see it in you, too─that appetite for the mysterious and the unknown.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_AZAHMA_000_215: But I'll not attempt to turn you from your path. I know too well the futility of that endeavor.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_AZAHMA_100_215: So I will tell you what my friend told me─how he convinced a merchant in the bazaar to give him the rough location of the vault's entrance.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_AZAHMA_200_215: It seems this merchant─one Zasshal, I believe─is selling a map which shows the exact route, but my friend's purse was too light for its exorbitant price.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_AZAHMA_300_215: With what meager wealth he had, he instead paid to learn that there are ruins on a small island somewhere in the Bounty. And within those ruins hides the path to the vault deep below.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_AZAHMA_000_216: If you truly intend on seeking Alzadaal's treasure, I suggest you put your affairs in order. I wish things were different, but I do not believe my friend is ever coming home...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_250: You will recall I spoke of visiting Thavnair at Vrtra's request?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_251: Well, he finally invited me to a feast...and made his proposal once I was too full of Hannish delights to refuse. He wishes me to train the Radiant Host in lancework...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_252: ...But that is a tale for another time. What we need now is a merchant or a trawler with a ship fit for the open seas.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_253: Matsya is a fisherman by trade, yes? We should head to Akyaali and see if he can help us.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_300: I am hoping to hire a ship, of course, rather than buy one. My funds would not stretch quite that far.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MATSYA_000_310: My friends, what brings you to our humble village?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MATSYA_000_311: ...So you need a seaworthy vessel to seek these ruins?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MATSYA_000_312: Considering it was your deeds which allowed us to return to fishing, I should think everyone would be glad for a chance to repay the favor!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MATSYA_000_313: Wait here, and I will have a boat stocked and ready for you in no time at all!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_314: Have you noticed our little shadow? He's been following us since we left the city.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_315: We see you there, boy. Show yourself.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_317: Do you know how far out of our way we walked so that you'd not cross paths with some wild beast?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_318: (-Ragged Waif-)I'm sorry, sir, but aren't you the heroes who saved Thavnair? You are. I know you are...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_319: (-Ragged Waif-)And I've gone and cheated you! I work with Zasshal, you see─the map merchant. It's my job to play the pleading orphan, and convince the crowd his wares are worth the price he asks.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_320: (-Ragged Waif-)I'm ashamed of what I've done, and beg for your forgiveness. If not for you, my sister and I would never have... Well, we'd be...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_321: Enough. I knew your game, and I paid the price willingly. A fortunate purchase as it turns out, for my friend here was seeking those very ruins.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_322: (-Ragged Waif-)You are kind to overlook the wrong I have done you...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_323: (-Ragged Waif-)But there is more you need to know.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_324: (-Ragged Waif-)The map you bought is very real, as is the island it shows. I overheard Zasshal selling the information to another customer.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_325: (-Ragged Waif-)He told that man where he needed to search, about the ruins, about the vault...about everything. Then the man sailed out to find his fortune, never to return.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_326: (-Ragged Waif-)You cannot go alone to that place! You should have more friends with you─maybe even a whole army!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_327: I do not doubt the ruins hold danger, but I assure you, between the two of us there is little we cannot overcome.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_328: (-Ragged Waif-)Please! I cannot bear the thought of...of...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_A6_000_002: We might need a hand moving the treasure...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_A6_000_003: Now you've gone and made him cry.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_330: ...That we could. And assuming we do find this treasure hoard, it may prove wise to have more hands along for the carrying.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_331: ...Assuming we find any. Still, it may prove wise to bring some companions along all the same.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_332: I did not─ That was not my intention.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_333: Oh, very well. Assuming we do find this treasure hoard, it may prove wise to have more hands along for the carrying.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_334: Any ideas on whom to approach? The Scions have scattered far and wide since our last gathering...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_337: Those two would answer our call, certainly. But they left the Rising Stones with a definite task in mind, and I am loath to interrupt their self-appointed mission.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_338: Little Lord Alphinaud and his sister? Were they not bound for Garlemald? They have far more important matters to attend to than delving for trinkets.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_339: Aye, Krile may have her hands full rebuilding the Students, but if you reach out to G'raha, he would surely leap at the invitation.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_200_339: Her magicks would be a welcome addition, aye, but I am loath to interrupt her research. Mayhap we could ask a less...prickly companion.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_340: Will that set your mind at ease?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_341: (-Ragged Waif-)Y-Yes, if that man is as strong as you. ...Is he though? Strong, I mean?
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_344: Well, Mehrahd, your life is yours to live as you will. But I suggest you find a more honest trade if you truly wish to keep your sister safe.
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_345: I'm not proud of what I do!
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_MEHRAHD_000_346: But what choice do I have? We need to eat, and everyone's too busy rebuilding their own lives to bother with two grubby orphans...
TEXT_AKTKMH102_04527_ESTINIEN_000_348: I didn't take this roundabout road just to see you end up in some creature's belly. Let me walk you back to the city gates.
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_MEHRAHD_000_000: Estinien is... I think he is not as gruff as he makes out to be.
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_ESTINIEN_000_001: I shall leave you to recruit G'raha. He'll appreciate the invitation that much more, I'm sure.
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_ESTINIEN_000_002: As I recall, he was based at the annex. Someone there ought to be able to point you in the right direction.
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_ESTINIEN_000_003: Let us be off too, Mehrahd. Do me a favor and don't stray from the path.
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_0: Oh, look who it is! Welcome back, !
What might the Students do for you?
G'raha? Yes, he's in the main hall with Mistress Krile.
They've been holed up in there for days. By all means, go and give them an excuse to take a break!
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_GRAHATIA_000_100: Well, she wasn't hard to find, at least...
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_GRAHATIA_000_150: I've visited Labyrinthos on several occasions recently, but I've not set foot in Thaumazein since the day we boarded the Ragnarok...
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_YSHTOLA_000_155: I don't see Thancred anywhere. Was he not supposed to be traveling with Urianger?
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_GRAHATIA_000_200: Ah, the thrill of imminent adventure! I never tire of this feeling.
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_URIANGER_000_210: In my travels, I spied many a child wandering alone─orphans, in all likelihood. Though homes razed by beasts and blasphemies can be rebuilt, the void left by those we have lost cannot so easily be filled...
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_MATSYA_000_215: I will pray to Sanduruva for your safe return. May the wealth of Her blessings guide you to the treasure you seek...
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_ESTINIEN_000_220: I send you to recruit G'raha and you return with an entire survey party.
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_ESTINIEN_000_221: I hope Matsya's boat is sturdy enough to carry us all...
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_YSHTOLA_000_222: What he means is, we are grateful for the use of one of your precious fishing vessels.
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_MATSYA_000_223: We are more than glad for the chance to provide it. I ask only that you take care to steer clear of the reefs in the shallows there.
TEXT_AKTKMH103_04528_ESTINIEN_000_224: Aye, we will keep an eye out.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_ESTINIEN_000_000: Despite his misgivings, I wager Mehrahd remains in that merchant's employ...
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_GRAHATIA_100_000: Ah, the thrill of imminent adventure! I never tire of this feeling.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_URIANGER_200_000: In my travels, I spied many a child wandering alone─orphans, in all likelihood. Though homes razed by beasts and blasphemies can be rebuilt, the void left by those we have lost cannot so easily be filled...
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_MATSYA_000_215: I will pray to Sanduruva for your safe return. May the wealth of Her blessings guide you to the treasure you seek...
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_YSHTOLA_000_001: Alzadaal III... I confess I am somewhat embarrassed that the tale of his journey to another world escaped my notice. Could it be more than simple folklore?
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_GRAHATIA_000_002: And what of the treasure he supposedly brought back? This undersea vault may hold relics from another reflection!
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_URIANGER_000_003: My friends, we should temper our expectations. The map doth promise ruins, but beyond that we know not what we will find.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_ESTINIEN_000_004: Not until we find it, aye.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_ESTINIEN_000_005: So let us dispense with the conjecture and set sail for the vault.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_A1_000_032: Form a party and enter Alzadaal's Legacy.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_YSHTOLA_000_050: I am aware that this story about an otherworldly journey may be just that─a story. But even the wildest tale often contains a few grains of truth, and that is worth investigating.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_GRAHATIA_000_055: One can only spend so many days hunched over a desk before it begins to take its toll. A spot of vigorous exploration is exactly what I needed!
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_ESTINIEN_000_060: None who enter these ruins come out alive... Well, we shall see about that.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_URIANGER_000_065: The treasure vault of a satrap will surely be filled with diverse traps and devilish deterrents. Caution is paramount.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_MATSYA_000_100: My boat is at your disposal!
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_YSHTOLA_000_150: I came here in search of something that might further my research. I did not anticipate a fully functioning voidgate.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_URIANGER_000_155: Even in the learned halls of Sharlayan, 'tis forbidden to throw wide the gates to the abyss. The peril is far too great...
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_ESTINIEN_000_160: Can such a tiny portal truly be so dangerous?
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_VARSHAHN_000_165: I expect you have more questions...
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_GRAHATIA_000_170: Voidgates and fissures are much the same thing in practice, in the sense that both allow passage between the Source and the Thirteenth. The difference in terminology refers to the circumstances of their creation.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_GRAHATIA_000_171: A fissure is an incidental tear in the fabric between worlds, whereas a voidgate is the product of deliberate action.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_GRAHATIA_000_172: I suspect this is the latter, judging by the elaborate mechanism put in place to control it.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_GRAHATIA_000_173: To think that our search for material riches would lead to this priceless discovery!
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_GRAHATIA_000_174: That swirling emptiness... It puts me in mind of old friends, not to mention old foes.
TEXT_AKTKMH104_04529_SYSTEM_000_200: You may now enter Alzadaal's Legacy with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_GRAHATIA_000_000: Perhaps I might linger a touch longer...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_URIANGER_000_001: Even in the learned halls of Sharlayan, 'tis forbidden to throw wide the gates to the abyss. The peril is far too great...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ESTINIEN_000_002: Can such a tiny portal truly be so dangerous?
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_003: I expect you have more questions...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_MATSYA_000_004: My boat is at your disposal!
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_GRAHATIA_000_050: The Thirteenth... What chaos must consume that world...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_URIANGER_000_055: Vrtra's grief for a lost sibling will be no mystery to Estinien. His hath been a life entwined with sorrow, even before he became host to Nidhogg's essence.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ESTINIEN_000_060: I wondered how one of the first brood could simply vanish and leave no trace of her passage. Now I have my answer.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_065: Millennia have passed since last I saw her. But I see Azdaja in memory still, clear and vivid...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_070: So they managed not only to expand the fissure, but also manipulate it as one might a gate...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_071: Astonishing. Is there any chance I could learn more of how this feat was accomplished?
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_072: I will tell you what I can. First, however, I must return to the High Crucible, and arrange to replace the guardians you so handily destroyed. It will not do to leave the gate undefended.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_073: Ah, my apologies─we were perhaps a touch zealous in our rush to uncover the vault's secrets. If the constructs can be repaired, we would be happy to offer our assistance...?
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_074: That will not be necessary. Much as I retain spare vessels for myself, we keep duplicate guardians on hand for such eventualities. In any case, we should return to Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_GRAHATIA_000_100: While I am loath to keep Krile waiting much longer, I cannot bring myself to leave before hearing more of Vrtra's tale...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_URIANGER_000_105: 'Twas a most enjoyable expedition, for which I am grateful. As for mine evaluation, I shall impress upon the Loporrits that a treasure vault is incomplete without daunting sentinels to test the mettle of any would-be intruders.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ESTINIEN_000_110: Vrtra speaks as if Azdaja is a lost cause. But I wager he feels differently in his heart of hearts.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_115: There is much about the voidgate that I cannot even begin to explain. I must convince Vrtra to share everything he knows...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ALCHEMIST04530_000_: This is quite the gathering. To what do we owe the pleasure...?
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_130: I promise we will discuss the voidgate further, but first I must attend to the matter of the vault's sentinels.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_131: As your instruments have no doubt informed you, the Kapikulu has been reduced to so much scrap. Please bring a new one out of storage, and see that it is conveyed to its post along with some few lesser constructs.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ALCHEMIST04530_100_: Was it tomb robbers? Fiends born of the Tower of Zot? By the Sisters, do not tell me a blasphemy yet roams free!
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ALCHEMIST04530_000_: Why such guilty faces!? Surely it isn't you who are responsible for this... Oh.
Ahem, well...the details aren't important! I shall see it done immediately.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_134: And with that, the vault will soon be secure once more. Now, I believe you had questions?
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_135: Quite a few, in fact. But I'd like to begin with the gate itself. It is still functional, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_136: Indeed, which is why I saw it sealed with an alchemically forged lock and warded it with my magicks. Such power must not fall into the wrong hands.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_137: In truth, the primary reason for the vault's construction was to keep the gate hidden from the outside world.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ESTINIEN_000_138: So much effort for such a little door.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_139: That “little door” you speak of leads to an abyss teeming with unspeakable horrors.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_140: That said, in its current state, it would admit only the lowliest of voidsent. And from this side, no man would be able to pass through.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ESTINIEN_000_141: No man? I should think Alphinaud would fit, given a firm enough push.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_142: Physical size is only one consideration. The true restriction hinges upon the aetheric density of the soul in transit.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_143: And yet you succeeded in expanding this diminutive portal and sending your simulacrum to the Thirteenth...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_144: Thanks to my brilliant alchemists. I should have destroyed the anomaly when I found it, but instead, I bade them devise a means to control it.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_145: After much experimentation, they accomplished the impossible. A method was conceived by which my magicks could manipulate the fissure and transform it into a serviceable gate.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_146: But the process has long since been forgotten. Once I had given up searching for Azdaja, there was no need to preserve such esoteric and dangerous knowledge.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_147: Thus has the gate lain dormant, for years uncounted.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_GRAHATIA_000_148: Our own passage to the Thirteenth was made relatively simple thanks to the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_GRAHATIA_000_149: An ancient mechanism channeled the tower's vast stores of energy to open a voidgate─one bound to a covenant made with the Cloud of Darkness.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_GRAHATIA_000_150: Once that sovereign entity was beaten back, however, the covenant was broken, and the doorway severed from its connection to the void.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_GRAHATIA_000_151: Theoretically, it should be possible to reconnect the gate by forging a new pact with another voidsent...but such deals usually end in betrayal and death.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_152: You seem to have struck a bargain of your own, . Though it serves you well in battle, be aware that the beneficial nature of your “arrangement” is the exception which proves the rule.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_153: In any case, we should attempt to gain an understanding of the Bounty gate. Mayhap you could resume the search for your sister...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_154: As I have already explained, I put those futile hopes to rest centuries ago. My place─and my duty─is here now.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_155: Ah, I had meant to ask... What prompted you to search for the vault in the first place?
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_A1_000_001: To see if the legends were true.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_157: As you have seen, the “fabulous wealth” from the stories is quite real, if not its rumored origin. But I'm afraid I must assert a prior claim.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_158: I've been adding to that trove for years, little by little. But the time has come to spend it, that I might alleviate my people's suffering.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ESTINIEN_100_158: As I recall, 'twas you who was chasing tales of undersea ruins.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_200_158: Well, as you have seen, the “fabulous wealth” from the stories is quite real, if not its rumored origin. But I'm afraid I must assert a prior claim.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_300_158: I've been adding to that trove for years, little by little. But the time has come to spend it, that I might alleviate my people's suffering.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ESTINIEN_000_159: Then we are of one mind. We had no intention of taking it for ourselves.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_161: Your Excellency. Would you object if I were to conduct a closer examination of the gate? I will make no attempt to open it, of course.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_162: I owe you and yours a debt that can never be repaid. Whatever boon you ask of me, you shall have it.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_163: You are most gracious. I shall take full advantage of your permission.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_URIANGER_000_164: Would that I could join thee in thy study, but the Loporrits will be anxious to receive my report. I beg my leave of you.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_GRAHATIA_000_165: And I must be off to Sharlayan, as well.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_GRAHATIA_000_166: Mistress Krile was eager to speak with you about that request, so please come back to the annex as soon as you are able. Farewell for now!
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_YSHTOLA_000_167: We can discuss my findings once I return. You'll not be rid of me so easily.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_SYSTEM_000_170: You may now undertake the Chronicles of a New Era quest series “Myths of the Realm.” Speak with the fresh-faced Student at the Baldesion Annex to accept the first quest.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ESTINIEN_000_200: I hope you enjoyed the expedition, at least. Otherwise it was a heavy purse to pay for a treasure map leading to a treasure we couldn't keep.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_210: The difficult part in all this will be deciding how best to put these riches to use...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_211: Will you lend me your assistance in these deliberations?
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_A2_000_002: Anything to make up for the constructs we broke...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_VARSHAHN_000_214: Then think of your employment as recompense. Serve me as guest advisors, and I will consider the broken constructs paid for in full.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_ESTINIEN_000_215: and I are in this together. I will follow  example.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_EARTHMONOLITH_000_2: (-Throne of Earth-)I sssensed the breaching of a gate, but it was not inssstigated from this ssside. 'Twas thrown open from the other...
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_FIREMONOLITH_000_25: (-Throne of Fire-)I, too, felt it. A rare occurrence, yes, but such a tiny portal is beneath our notice. There are more pressing matters at hand.
(-Throne of Fire-)An opportunity is upon us, the coming of which we have awaited for nigh on ten thousand years. We dare not let it slip our grasp.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_WINDMONOLITH_000_25: (-Throne of Wind-)Yet we must not underestimate  who bested the Cloud of Darkness. Even restrained by a covenant, the Cloud was no feeble wisp to be dispersed by some flesh-and-blood mortal.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_WATERMONOLITH_000_2: (-Throne of Water-)Bah, let  come! I will drown the world and watch this fleshling gasp for breath in  final moments!
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_BLACKKNIGHT_000_255: (-Knight in Black-)Your zeal is admirable, but forget not our cause.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_BLACKKNIGHT_000_256: (-Knight in Black-)Think back on our struggles beneath this sunless sky. Remember why we cede not our will to fight.
TEXT_AKTKMH105_04530_BLACKKNIGHT_000_257: (-Knight in Black-)'Tis time we set the war in motion, and win redemption for our star!
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_ESTINIEN_000_001: I hope you enjoyed the expedition, at least. Otherwise it was a heavy purse to pay for a treasure map leading to a treasure we couldn't keep.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_010: Shall we begin? If we are to spend the treasure wisely, then we must first determine which groups would benefit most from monetary assistance.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_100_010: Some of my citizens may find it intimidating to speak with the satrap directly, so I would ask that you act in my stead.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_011: , you are to visit Akyaali and Yedlihmad. Speak with Matsya and his people, and listen to their grievances.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_012: Estinien, I bid you do the same at Palaka's Stand. I will be conducting my own inquiries at the Giantsgall Grounds.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_013: Once you believe you have ascertained the needs of the populace, we can reconvene at Meghaduta.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MATSYA_000_050: Oh, ! I was so glad to see you had returned unharmed. You've finished with the boat, then?
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MATSYA_000_052: Well, I suppose Khalzahl's loss hit us the hardest.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MATSYA_000_053: I've been trying to find buyers for my fish, but although I sell a few here and there, it's so much more difficult than it was before.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MATSYA_000_054: Everyone's still struggling to rebuild their lives... For now, we're just banding together as best we can.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MATSYA_000_100: I liked leaving the selling to Khalzahl. I could just catch the fish, and not have to talk people into eating them...
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MERCHANT04368_000_1: Greetings and welcome, traveler! If this is your first visit to Thavnair, then you must try my special amra lassi! Its refreshing zest cannot be beat!

What could such a wonder cost, you wonder? Normally I part with three bottles for the generous price of nineteen thousand and eight hundred gil, but for you? I am willing to go as low as an even ten thousand! You'd be practically stealing from me!
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_A1_000_001: Stealing? At that price, you're the only thief around here.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_A1_000_002: Still not turning a profit these days?
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MERCHANT04368_000_1: Gah! Y-You...you're the one who was with that spear-toting fellow!

Well, you can hardly blame a man for trying... The world may no longer be on fire, but we are still sifting through the ashes, so to speak. Sisters spare me, we might as well have that ugly tower back for the scant few travelers we see these days.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MERCHANT04368_100_1: Times are harsh, my friend. The world may no longer be on fire, but we are still sifting through the ashes, so to speak. Sisters spare me, we might as well have that ugly tower back for the scant few travelers we see these days.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MERCHANT04368_300_1: You're the one who was with that spear-toting fellow! Well, you can hardly blame a man for trying...
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MERCHANT04368_400_1: The world may no longer be on fire, but we are still sifting through the ashes, so to speak. Sisters spare me, we might as well have that ugly tower back for the scant few travelers we see these days.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MERCHANT04368_000_1: I myself barely have the coin to buy at local prices. I tell you, if I didn't charge the odd adventurer a small fortune for afternoon tea, I'd be scavenging for scraps in the street...
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_PORTMANAGER04368_00: How fares the port? Well, it's in shambles, isn't it?
The trade routes are open once more now that the danger has passed, certainly.
But no small number of merchants have had to sell their ships to make ends meet in the short term.
Add to that the sailors we lost in the Final Days, and it's little wonder the flow of exports is no more than a pitiful trickle.
If Khalzahl and his consortium were still with us, I'm sure he'd have found a way to turn our fortunes around. Now that was a man who got things done, gods rest his soul.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_SYSTEM_000_122: You have spoken with key local figures, and gained an understanding of the populace's hardships. Varshahn awaits your report at Meghaduta.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_MERCHANT04368_000_1: Times are lean, my friend. ...Are you sure you wouldn't care for a slightly overpriced lassi?
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_PORTMANAGER04368_00: We'll scrape by for now, but what we really need is for someone to come in with a plan...and preferably some coin to spare.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_ESTINIEN_000_150: 'Twould seem my stint on Vrtra's back did not go unnoticed. I couldn't take two steps before another Hannish local was thanking me profusely for saving their home.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_160: Ah, my advisors return. I've just made it back myself.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_ESTINIEN_000_161: Why do you retain this vessel now that your true form is known? You could have flown across the island in a fraction of the time.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_162: Be that as it may, the sight of a massive creature descending from the sky can be startling to say the least. And there are few places I can enter comfortably without risk of flattening some cart or stall.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_ESTINIEN_000_164: As for my inquiries, the people of Palaka's Stand were unanimous in their reply.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_ESTINIEN_000_166: Resources were stretched to the limit when refugees were pouring in, but they persevered with some assistance from Yedlihmad.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_ESTINIEN_000_167: From what I understand, they have always been an independent community─hunters and foragers, and the like─and I was assured that the jungle provides for their needs. For the most part.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_168: Palaka's Stand has weathered the disaster better than most, it seems.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_169: I myself heard good news and bad.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_170: The quarrymen were cautiously optimistic, having just sold a full wagon of giantsgall to a foreign trader.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_171: But such visitors are few and far between. Compared to our best years, the weight of stone leaving Thavnair has been light indeed.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_172: Our nation is small and isolated, its prosperity dependent on a steady stream of exports...
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_173: We must identify any obstacles to the flow of trade so we may begin working to remove them. Tell me, what did you learn in Akyaali and Yedlihmad?
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_174: Hm, I see. Without a dedicated buyer, the average fisherman must struggle to off-load his daily catch...
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_175: Which is why I believe we should first address the lack of ships and shortage of able-bodied sailors in Yedlihmad.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_176: I am reminded of a child I spied as I made my way back to the palace. His father lost at sea when the beasts sunk their vessel...
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_177: So many variations of the same tragic tale, repeated over and over. So many lives lost...
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_178: Enough grief to drown in if we let ourselves be overcome...but we will not. , Estinien, I will consider the perspectives you've brought me, and devise a plan to help my people confront this adversity.
TEXT_AKTKMH106_04531_VARSHAHN_000_179: Come, I would like you to be in attendance when I announce the proposal to my assembled functionaries.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_ESTINIEN_000_001: Vrtra is warming to his role as satrap. Clearly all those years behind the curtain were not spent napping.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_WARRIOR04532_000_01: Thank you for putting forth Khalzahl's name. Those whose lives he enriched will take comfort in seeing his legacy honored.
You will forgive me for not speaking sooner, but I bear a message from Archon Y'shtola. She asks that you meet her at the High Crucible at your earliest convenience.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_ESTINIEN_000_013: Y'shtola must have finished her study of the voidgate. Shall we hear what she has to say, then?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_ESTINIEN_000_015: I thought the satrap would be too busy setting up the foundation...?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_VARSHAHN_000_016: My clerks have been the well-oiled cogs of this administration since before Ahewann assumed the office. They understand what needs to be done.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_VARSHAHN_000_017: And I am curious to learn what conclusions your Archon has reached concerning the gate's unique construction.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_ESTINIEN_000_018: As you wish. Allow me to lead the way, Your Excellency.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_WARRIOR04532_000_05: You can find your way to the High Crucible, I trust? I must rejoin my unit and assist with bringing the city's orphans under our care.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_ESTINIEN_000_055: For one who claims it is “too late” to save his sister, Vrtra seems awfully interested in whatever revelations Y'shtola might have to share.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_VARSHAHN_000_060: Shall we hear what your scholarly comrade has to say?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_110: If we're to enter Noumenon's restricted archives with a minimum of fuss, then we must secure the permission of the Forum.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_111: First, however, we shall need to enlist the cooperation of a member to broach the matter on our behalf. Who do you think might be inclined to assist us?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_119: He did come to G'raha's defense during the inquiry, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_120: 'Tis settled. Let us head to Phenomenon and see if he's willing to help us once more.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_SYSTEM_000_117: Y'shtola is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_SYSTEM_000_118: You can leave Y'shtola behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_SYSTEM_000_119: If you wish to have Y'shtola accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_150: I apprenticed to Master Matoya at the age of seven, and labored under her tutelage for a full decade. I never had the chance to attend the Studium...
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_155: Neither did Thancred, as I recall. Soon after Master Louisoix took him in off the streets, he was put in the care of another Archon. His was a rigorous and practical education in the arts of espionage and survival.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_160: I sometimes wonder what my life might have been like had I pursued studies here instead...
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_A2_000_001: Tea at the Last Stand after a day of lectures?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_170: Oh, that does sound lovely. Afternoons with friends spent sipping tea and debating theories.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_175: ...Still, I wouldn't give up my time with Master Matoya for the world.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_180: The dank cave I studied in was about as far from the bright, airy halls of academia as one could get. But it was a wondrous, magical childhood nonetheless.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_190: Oh, never mind me. 'Twas just an idle thought.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_201: If I was pressed to name our allies in the Forum, Scholarch Montichaigne would certainly be at the top of the list. Hopefully he agrees to aid us with our request.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_SYSTEM_000_202: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Y'shtola?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_203: Need to be somewhere? Very well, I will wait for you by the aetheryte.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_204: Oh, not to worry─I had plenty of reading to keep me occupied while you were busy. Shall we continue?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_MONTICHAIGNE_000_20: Archon Y'shtola wishes a word with me? Then I shall eagerly await her arrival!
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_SYSTEM_000_206: You must be accompanied by Y'shtola and have her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_SYSTEM_000_207: Y'shtola has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_MONTICHAIGNE_000_20: Ah, visitors! And quite esteemed ones at that. What may I do for you?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_209: Pray forgive the intrusion, Scholarch, but we were hoping you might help us secure permission to enter Noumenon's restricted archives.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_MONTICHAIGNE_000_21: Oho! No furtive forays into the stacks this time, eh?
I applaud this newfound sense of propriety. Yet in all this wide world of comparative serenity, what so compels you to disturb a vault of forbidden wisdom?
Fascinating. I had no idea such a technique existed.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_213: I would've been surprised if you had. If my assumption is correct, the research left behind by House Daemir has lain dormant in Sharlayan's archives for many centuries.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_MONTICHAIGNE_000_21: And if you unearth this research, what then? Surely you don't intend to cross over into the void?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_215: That is, in fact, precisely what we intend.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_217: To develop a method of traversing the rift, for one, that I might keep my word to a distant friend.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_100_217: Sentiment aside, I have journeyed to the end of existence. I have heard, felt, and thought endlessly about the truth of our world and the echo of its future. And yet I want to understand everything─to unravel it all down to its very last secret.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_218: What scholar worthy of the name wouldn't force open a voidgate or two if a grand revelation was the promised reward?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_MONTICHAIGNE_000_22: An audacious proposal worthy of Master Matoya herself!
And after hearing the whys and the wherefores, I for one do not believe you would use the knowledge for ill.
I see no reason not to present your request for the Forum's consideration.
Although... Your petition would be better received if you also had the support of another well-placed acquaintance.
Why, Master Fourchenault, of course! He can hardly ignore an earnest request from his dear children's most treasured comrades.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_225: I was hesitant to approach him directly, but there is no denying that having Master Fourchenault on our side would tip the balance in our favor. Very well. We will pay a visit to the Leveilleur estate and plead our case.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_MONTICHAIGNE_000_22: Ah, one last thing before you go. I would consider it a personal favor if you might share with me the discoveries you make in the void.
My appetite for knowledge is every bit as insatiable as yours, I'd wager, so if you could see your way to indulging an old man's curiosity...?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_228: Of course, Scholarch. We will be sure to pass on any revelations.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_MONTICHAIGNE_000_23: The Forum can be a cantankerous beast─one needs a persuasive voice to get it moving in the desired direction.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_250: Montichaigne seemed optimistic, but I doubt convincing Fourchenault to champion our cause will be as simple as showing up on his doorstep.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_BUTLER04532_000_254: Welcome to the Leveilleur residence. Have you come alone, or should we expect a larger party...?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_SYSTEM_000_255: You must be accompanied by Y'shtola and have her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_BUTLER04532_000_256: Ah,  , Mistress Y'shtola, how may I be of service?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_257: We've come to speak with Master Fourchenault. Is he home, by any chance?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_BUTLER04532_000_258: Yes, the master is in residence. I shall inform him that he has guests.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_FOURCHENAULT_000_25: Well, well. Ameliance would invite you inside for tea, but I assume this is not a social visit. You have some matter of import to discuss?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_FOURCHENAULT_000_26: Then pray proceed─you have my full attention.
Well, I suppose I should praise you for following the proper protocols this time around...
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_262: Scholarch Montichaigne expressed much the same sentiment. I assure you, we'll not attempt to circumvent the Forum's authority again...unless it is absolutely necessary, of course.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_FOURCHENAULT_000_26: You do understand that the restricted archives are restricted for good reason, yes? If no pressing need exists, then why risk the consequences of employing this forbidden knowledge?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_265: For a brother who misses his sister. She was his guardian and his friend─a selfless hero who crossed the rift between worlds to save her homeland from horror and suffering.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_200_265: But the brother has given up on thoughts of reunion. He spends his efforts elsewhere, watching over a people yet healing from the flames of the Final Days, loyal to his duty while betraying the longing in his heart.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_300_265: 'Tis no vital mission, perhaps, reuniting these siblings. But it feels a worthy cause to pursue, all the same.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_400_265: As one who feared losing his own loved ones, and spent years in research to prevent it, surely you appreciate how painful such a separation must be.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_FOURCHENAULT_000_26: Reflections are still very much a mystery to us. Offering to share your experiences in the First should constitute a fair exchange for our cooperation.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_FOURCHENAULT_000_27: Do not celebrate just yet. The Forum must still be convinced.
I will add your request to the list of today's deliberations, and deliver the decision to you at the Baldesion Annex.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_BUTLER04532_000_280: Please do come again. We are always glad to receive such close companions of the twins.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_300: The matter is out of our hands. All that remains is to return to the annex and await word of the Forum's decision.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_304: So. What did the Forum decide?
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_MONTICHAIGNE_000_30: To put it bluntly, Master Matoya has burned some bridges here in Sharlayan─and salted the earth for good measure. When it became clear that her student was the petitioner in question, well, no few members voiced their discontent...
Then the chamber was reminded─in no uncertain terms, I might add─of the incredible debt we owe to you and your companions.
That served to silence the grumbles and stiffen a few spines, and it was agreed that allowing you entry to the archives was the least we could do in return.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_308: That is wonderful news. Thank you both for speaking on our behalf.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_FOURCHENAULT_000_30: Yes, well... As I am sure you are aware, this permission was not extended lightly. Forbidden knowledge is to be treated with the utmost caution, and there will be repercussions if it is not.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_FOURCHENAULT_000_31: I wish you well in your endeavor, and bid you good day.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_312: Uncompromising? Aye, but that very stoicism is exactly what Sharlayan needed to guide it through not one, but two exoduses.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_MONTICHAIGNE_000_35: If I were but five years younger, I'd cast aside my lectern and join you on your adventures in a heartbeat...
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_360: That went rather well, I think.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_361: As a child, I dreamed up any number of schemes for getting my hands on those forbidden tomes... And now I can simply walk in through the door.
TEXT_AKTKMH107_04532_YSHTOLA_000_362: Our focus will be on finding House Daemir's research notes, of course, but the thought of so much knowledge at my disposal has me feeling a little giddy.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_001: I'd like to set out as soon as you're ready.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_MONTICHAIGNE_000_01: You'll be heading directly to the archives from here, I presume?
Then you'll want to speak with the index page when you arrive. It's been instructed to grant you access to the restricted section.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_013: Excellent. Once again, we thank you for all your help.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_MONTICHAIGNE_000_01: Oh, it was my pleasure, believe me. May you find the knowledge you seek!
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_016: Y'shtola is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_017: You can leave Y'shtola behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_018: If you wish to have Y'shtola accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_020: To think the set of instructions I laughingly imagined may actually exist but yalms away from where you found me napping...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_021: If I had known of Alzadaal III's exploits sooner, I could well have saved myself days of research. Even a children's book might have pointed me in the right direction.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_022: To achieve the impossible, one must needs be flexible of mind and look beyond conventional wisdom. A lesson I had already learned, but clearly not taken to heart.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_051: Come along, . Noumenon and its forbidden wisdom awaits.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_052: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Y'shtola?
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_053: Very well, but please do hurry back. I shall await you at the annex.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_054: All set this time? No forgotten chores or errands to call you away? Good─the forbidden tomes await!

TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_056: You must be accompanied by Y'shtola and have her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_057: Y'shtola has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.

TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_105: So many books I've yet to read...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_110: Yes, yes, we are here for one specific volume. You needn't remind me.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_120: (-Untitled Goldsmith's Journal-)Today, in a world not my own, I met the most beautiful voidborn creature. She was so unlike her ravenous brethren. Eyes blazing not with hunger, but trembling─like a candle's flame, threatening to flicker out at any moment.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_121: (-Untitled Goldsmith's Journal-)I wonder if “she” is even the proper word. Such distinctions seem inconsequential. Insignificant, even.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_122: (-Untitled Goldsmith's Journal-)All that matters is the love I feel for this exquisite, transcendent being!
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_123: Though you are tempted to read more, this does not seem to be the volume you are seeking...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_124: (-Primal Disquisitions-)In the year 1564 of the Sixth Astral Era, the Amalj'aa summoned Ifrit, their patron god. Accounts describe the being as a gigantic, lizard-like being with a potent command of fire-aspected magicks.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_125: (-Primal Disquisitions-)If we consider that primal summoning is an act fueled by faith and prayer, it is unsurprising, if not expected, that the resulting deiform entity should manifest the appearance and powers with which it is attributed by its worshipers.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_126: (-Primal Disquisitions-)What, then, might emerge from the aether should one who believes in an almighty omniscience attempt the same ritual? Would the Scholar Himself grace us with His presence? Some other embodiment of divine sagacity?
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_127: (-Primal Disquisitions-)Could this man-made god truly be all-knowing? And if it were, whence would such knowledge arise?
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_128: (-Primal Disquisitions-)I myself have many questions concerning the nature of the ancient world. With no spell to transport me back to the days of old, could I instead summon a being possessed of encyclopedic wisdom of every age? Yet with no means to verify its pronouncements, how could one be certain they were true?
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_129: Though your mind spins with the possibilities discussed therein, this does not seem to be the volume you are seeking...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_130: (-Epiphanies of House Daemir-)The following pages detail an advanced method for manipulating rift-spanning apertures as devised by Nuhashahn, the ninth patriarch of House Daemir.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_131: (-Epiphanies of House Daemir-)We present these research notes to the faculty of Sharlayan's Studium as both a token of our friendship and an expression of our boundless admiration.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_SYSTEM_000_132: You appear to have located the forbidden volume you seek. Y'shtola will need to make the final confirmation...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_150: Have something you'd like to show me, do you? My apologies─I flipped open but a single book and was completely absorbed by the contents...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_151: Well done, . I think you may have found our prize.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_GUIDE04533_000_200: CoNgRaTuLaTiOnS oN lOcAtInG tHe ObJeCt Of YoUr SeArCh. PlEaSe MoVe AlOnG.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_210: As much as I would love to start crafting the Atomos, I'm afraid this is far outside my field of expertise.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_211: Fortunately, we know a Hannish alchemist who would be delighted to involve herself in our House Daemir project.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_212: Our business here is concluded, for the moment. Please pass on our regards to the Forum.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_GUIDE04533_000_213: YoUr MeSsAgE wIlL bE cOnVeYeD. sHoUlD yOu WiSh To InDuLgE iN mOrE fOrBiDdEn LiTeRaTuRe, I wIlL bE hErE. pAtRoN mOdE dIsAbLeD. sEcUrItY mOdE eNgAgEd.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_214: If anyone can help us, Nidhana can. I say we return to Thavnair and look for her at the Great Work.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_250: All these sallow, sleep-deprived faces, but their eyes still burn with fiery zeal. Some things never change.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_260: Y'shtola tells me you are pursuing a most fascinating study! And that you want me to be a part of it.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_261: I have no doubt you will be interested. This research log should speak for itself.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_263: By the Sisters! This is the mark of House Daemir! I never even knew such a work existed...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_264: Few should. It was sequestered in Noumenon's restricted archives, after all.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_265: It was!? But...that means every word within is forbidden knowledge!
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_266: A forbidden tome filled with forbidden research, and you put it right into my unsuspecting hand!?
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_267: I can hardly wait to read it!
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_268: To think the Daemir were developing such marvelous techniques so long ago. How many innovations have been lost over the centuries, I wonder...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_269: Now that you've glanced over the notes, what say you to helping us build a new mock Atomos?
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_270: I say yes! A thousand times yes!
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_271: Work on a Daemir project that had even the redoubtable scholars of Sharlayan trembling in their sandals? No alchemist of the Great Work could resist!
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_272: You are a woman after my own heart.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_273: Oh, I suppose I should ask: what do you mean to do with this big-mouthed simulacrum once we've built it?
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_274: So, there's a secret voidgate...and it's sealed in the ruins at the bottom of the Bounty? Today is a day of revelations indeed.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_275: If the purpose of our man-made Atomos is to expand this hidden portal, then I will need to see it for myself, I think. Manipulating rift-spanning apertures is not the sort of thing you want to attempt without first taking into account every single factor.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_276: Then by all means, accompany us to the vault. I plan to lead us back there shortly...once we've finished gathering the components I require.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_277: Sharlayan's markets provided the raw aquamarine and pure water crystals...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_278: But I might need help obtaining a small quantity of astrally infused water.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_279: For such a liquid, you need go no further than the Font of Maya─the ascetics of old once favored the place for their meditations, and the water which pools there now is known to enliven the flow of aether.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_280: That sounds perfect. If you would be so kind as to fill a flask at the pool, I will petition Vrtra to join us. The idea I have in mind won't amount to much without his authority to command the voidgate.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_281: Shall we be about it, then? We meet back here anon.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_300: Ah, there is no greater joy than having a new puzzle to ponder...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_VARSHAHN_000_400: Archon Y'shtola requested that I join you, but of her plans she offered scant detail...
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_ESTINIEN_000_405: The boy Mehrahd was glad to hear the news of the foundation. It means a new life for him and his sister.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_NIDHANA_000_410: Oh, I forgot to mention! The Font of Maya attracts aggressive wildlife, and you should watch out for them when, uh...you go there next time. My apologies.
TEXT_AKTKMH108_04533_YSHTOLA_000_420: Do you have that flask for me?
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_VARSHAHN_000_001: Archon Y'shtola requested that I join you, but of her plans she offered scant detail...
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_ESTINIEN_000_005: The boy Mehrahd was glad to hear the news of the foundation. It means a new life for him and his sister.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_NIDHANA_000_010: Oh, I forgot to mention! The Font of Maya attracts aggressive wildlife, and you should watch out for them when, uh...you go there next time. My apologies.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_YSHTOLA_000_020: Look who I came across. Estinien seemed in need of diversion, and we, in turn, may have need of his lance...
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_YSHTOLA_000_021: Right, then. Now that our little party is assembled, let us make our way to the ruins.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_ESTINIEN_000_022: Will we have need of Matsya's boat again?
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_VARSHAHN_000_023: Not this time. Once Y'shtola informed me of our destination, I arranged for a vessel to be made ready at Akyaali.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_YSHTOLA_000_024: Your Excellency is ever the gracious host. Shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_YSHTOLA_000_050: Onto the boat, if you please. We can chat on the way there.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_ESTINIEN_000_055: 'Tis likely not needed with Vrtra along, but I held onto the map against the chance we might return to the ruins.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_VARSHAHN_000_060: You need not keep your weapons close at hand. The guardians will not attack if I am present, so I pray you leave them be...
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_NIDHANA_000_065: And all this time I thought the tales of Alzadaal's hoard were no more than drunken sailors' fancies!
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_WARRIOR04532_000_07: The ship is yours to command.
