TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_VARSHAHN_000_071: Our thanks. We set sail at once.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_NIDHANA_000_072: Oh, this is so exciting! Alzadaal's Legacy─to see the truth of a legend with mine own eyes!
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_WARRIOR04532_000_90: All aboard for the treasure vault!
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_YSHTOLA_000_100: Poor Vrtra─he really should have spoken with Estinien before we left. I shudder to think what we've cost them in terms of construct materials...
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_ESTINIEN_000_105: I thought we cleared this place of constructs the last time we came through. 'Twould seem a few stragglers remained.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_VARSHAHN_000_110: ...He laid waste to them ere I could utter a single word. <sigh>
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_WARRIOR04532_000_11: Will you be setting sail for the vault?
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_YSHTOLA_000_150: We need to wait for a time to ensure a meaningful result. Be patient, and keep watch for any intruders.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_ESTINIEN_000_155: I struggle to picture Y'shtola as a little girl. Easier to believe she sprang fully formed from one of Master Matoya's cauldrons.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_VARSHAHN_000_160: Every time I come here, it reminds me of that dark portal above the Crystal Tower...and the final lash of Azdaja's tail as she plunged into the void.
TEXT_AKTKMH109_04534_NIDHANA_000_165: Sisters save me, I will never see Y'shtola the same way again! “Froth and foam,” indeed!
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_ESTINIEN_000_001: Seeing the void's terrors firsthand was an experience. But I doubt fear of such creatures is at the root of Vrtra's hesitation...
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_WARRIOR04532_000_00: Will you be setting sail for the vault?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_010: Once Nidhana succeeds in replicating the mock Atomos, this door into the Thirteenth will be ours to open.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_011: Will you be crossing the threshold alongside us? I realize this is more my endeavor than yours...
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_ESTINIEN_000_012: Hm. To be honest, I've no interest in visiting the void myself.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_ESTINIEN_000_013: ...Might we discuss this later? There is something I must do first.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_014: Why does everyone insist on being so secretive? I at least had good reason for not wanting to explain my nixie ritual...
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_015: Ahem. Shall we proceed with our other preparations, then?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_016: As we saw, the warding scale can be effective at protecting the bearer from other sources of aetheric corruption. Nevertheless, the talisman's durability will need to be improved if it is to withstand the void's influence for a prolonged length of time.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_017: And I think that is a problem we can address without involving the brilliant but busy alchemists who created it. Who do we know who excels at this kind of structural augmentation?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_020: Perhaps they once did, but availing ourselves of Allagan insights tends to be an involved process in and of itself.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_021: Nay, I believe a more straightforward approach is in order: consulting with the engineers of Garlond Ironworks.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_024: What of Garlond Ironworks, then? They may have an engineer free to assist us.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_025: As I recall, Cid himself is no stranger to the void and its volatile energies.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_026: With his experienced hand at the helm, I have every confidence that the Ironworks can strengthen the warding scale.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_027: Come, let us visit their operation in Rhalgr's Reach and commission their best and brightest.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_050: Perhaps this young man can locate Cid for us.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_EMPLOYEE04535_000_0: ! What brings you to the Ironworks?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_061: We have a commission for you and your president, actually. Assuming he's available...?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_EMPLOYEE04535_000_0: Master Cid? Certainly, I'll see if he has a moment free.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_CID_000_063: A pleasure as always. I hear you have a job for us?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_CID_000_064: Heading into the void to find a lost dragon... That sounds almost pedestrian compared to your last adventure. Honestly, I don't know if you could say anything that would surprise me after Meteion and that bloody mess.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_CID_000_065: All right, let's take a look at this talisman of yours. You said there were signs of degradation?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_CID_000_066: Hm, it seems some manner of corrosion has set in around a scratch on its surface─much as the void's corruption seeped into Nero through his wounds. In which case, our best bet may be to simply prevent the scale from being damaged in the first place.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_067: And how might we achieve that?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_CID_000_068: We have a coating agent for strengthening trinkets and the like, but I'd be wary of applying any compound which might upset the scale's delicate alchemical balance. Far safer to dress it in armor.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_CID_000_069: We'll construct a protective casing─one utilizing metal alloys with high aetherial conductivity, so as not to impede the talisman's primary function.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_070: A suit of armor, as you said.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_CID_000_071: Nero has compiled data on the Thirteenth, so I'll have him pitch in with the design just to be sure.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_CID_000_072: If only it weren't such an ordeal to convince him to follow our safety protocols... I swear, I've never had such a reckless employee. In any case, we may need some time to untangle the particulars.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_CID_000_073: If only it weren't such an ordeal to convince him to follow our safety protocols... In any case, we may need some time to untangle the particulars.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_074: Understandable. We know how busy your schedule is, and the final result will doubtless be worth the wait.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_CID_000_075: Hah, the hard part will be ducking Jessie and her constant barrage of demands while we sneak about doing the fun stuff. We'll see what we can do.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_076: I think we can leave the rest in Cid's capable hands. Let's return to the Great Work, and see how Nidhana is getting on with the mock Atomos.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_100: I hope Nidhana has good news for us.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_VARSHAHN_000_105: The insatiable curiosity of our alchemists has ever amazed me...though I've largely left them to their own devices since we opened the gate together.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_VARSHAHN_000_150: I will not squander this chance you have given me. I will find Azdaja...
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_ESTINIEN_000_155: Convincing others to follow their hearts is not my forte. I would have gladly let our more...philosophical comrades take the lead, had they been here.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_NIDHANA_000_160: We'll have that Atomos built before you know it! When a project like this comes along, we give it our full and undivided attention. Sleep? Pah! Who needs it!
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_NIDHANA_100_160: Oh, that reminds me! I really should finish that other project I was working on for His Excellency...
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_NAHBDEEN_000_165: What? Someone needed to give that boy a good talking to.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_NAHBDEEN_000_170: (Uh, you don't suppose I'll be reprimanded, do you? I did just yell at the satrap...)
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_180: You surprise me, Estinien. For a lone wolf, you've shown an unusual degree of, shall we say, “involvement” in helping Vrtra reach this conclusion.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_ESTINIEN_000_181: 'Twas for the greater good. The wyrm's thundering sighs were keeping his citizens awake at night, and had travelers believing the palace wracked by some unnatural storm.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_182: What of your own answer, then? You seemed disinclined to venture into the void...
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_ESTINIEN_000_183: When I was one with Nidhogg, his vengeful thoughts were my thoughts. His endless rage my rage...
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_ESTINIEN_000_184: And the soul-chilling grief he nursed for Ratatoskr's death...
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_ESTINIEN_000_185: I would not wish such agony upon a foe, let alone a friend and ally. If there is a chance we can spare Vrtra that pain, then I will follow you.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_A2_000_001: An unusual crew we have here.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_A2_000_002: Any other “former” Scions we should call on?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_187: Indeed, but perfect for our purpose, I should think. I'd rather not bother the Scions with aught less than a dire threat to the star.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_188: I'd rather not bother our comrades with aught less than a dire threat to the star. We four should be sufficient for our purpose.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_189: With things as they are, I'd rather not bother our comrades with aught less than a dire threat to the star.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_190: It will make for an interesting journey besides. Traveling in a smaller party for a change─crowds can be a bit draining, don't you think?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_191: Unlike the First, where the Flood of Light was halted before its devastation was complete, the Thirteenth has been utterly subsumed by Darkness. My plan, as such, is to explore the void in stages, withdrawing to safety after each brief foray.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_192: 'Twould be more convenient had we some manner of base camp nearer to the gate itself...
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_VARSHAHN_000_193: One of the palace chambers should serve. Come, let us reconvene outside Meghaduta.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_ESTINIEN_000_200: I was put up in a guest room in the palace while I awaited my audience with Vrtra. I expect we'll be given the use of something similar.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_205: Conducting our expedition out of the Rising Stones would raise just as many questions as recruiting too many Scions. At least here in Radz-at-Han, we might be expected to appear road-weary from our “local” explorations.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_OFFICIAL04535_000_2: Please, may you aid the satrap in his endeavor, even as he aids you in yours.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_VARSHAHN_000_220: ...And so we will require suitable accommodations. Might we make something available for our guests?
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_OFFICIAL04535_000_2: All the chambers are presently hosting the great mounds of treasure we carried out of the vault. Once the foundation's activities begin in earnest, however, we can redistribute the trove and make a room or two ready for habitation.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_VARSHAHN_000_222: Good. Please inform me when you've completed the arrangements.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_VARSHAHN_000_223: As you heard, we will have you settled in Meghaduta in due time.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_224: As ever, you are most gracious, Your Excellency.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_VARSHAHN_000_225: You risk yourselves to aid me in my search for Azdaja. Providing comfortable quarters is the least I can do.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_226: I only wish we knew more about our destination. The gods only know how long our explorations might possibly take, or what our chances of success might possibly be...
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_VARSHAHN_000_227: Succeed or fail, I am grateful to you for convincing me to make the attempt.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_YSHTOLA_000_228: On that note, I will return to the Great Work and lend what help I can to Nidhana. If you've preparations to make ere we venture into the Thirteenth, now is the time.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_ESTINIEN_000_229: All I need is my armor and my lance. Perhaps I'll train with the Radiant Host to pass the time before we depart.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_VARSHAHN_000_230: You know what this means to me, , but my purpose need not consume you as well.
TEXT_AKTKMH110_04535_VARSHAHN_000_231: We are headed to another world. Find what joy you can in the experience. For you are a traveler─an adventurer at heart. This I know.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_001: Ah, excellent timing, . Just a moment ago, I received word from the Ironworks.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_100_001: They have completed their task, and are on their way with the reinforced warding scales.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_002: Similarly, our alchemists have also succeeded in creating an artificial Atomos.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_003: All is in readiness for our journey to the void.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_004: I have instructed our comrades to gather at the Great Work. Let us head there at once.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_100: Our comrades are here, but the Ironworks people have yet to arrive.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_ESTINIEN_000_105: To thus create a voidsent... Hannish alchemists are as clever as they are bold.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_YSHTOLA_000_111: I present to you the fruits of the alchemists' labor: the artificial Atomos.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_YSHTOLA_000_112: Though we've yet to put it to the proof, its aether is practically identical to that of the original. A truly remarkable feat in so short a time.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_113: Aye, our alchemists have outdone themselves yet again. Small wonder that they are the pride of Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_114: I would express my gratitude to Nidhana...but it appears she isn't here.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_YSHTOLA_000_115: She rushed off after bringing the Atomos to attend to a pressing task, but said that she would return ere we set forth.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_YSHTOLA_000_116: Which should be shortly after our friends from the Ironworks arrive with the warding scales...
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_CID_000_117: Did someone say warding scales? Because it just so happens we have them.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_YSHTOLA_000_118: Right on cue. 'Tis good to see you all again.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_YSHTOLA_100_118: But for the president himself to attend... Keen to bear witness to our little experiment, are you?
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_CID_000_119: You know I am. I was there at the Crystal Tower, lest you forget. I wouldn't miss this for the world.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_CID_000_120: You don't mind if we come along and see you off, I hope? It's thanks to these three that we could finish the work so quickly.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NERO_000_121: 'Twas my painstakingly collected data that made the reinforcement possible.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NERO_000_122: The scales will last a good ten years in the void with nary a hint of degradation.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_BIGGS_000_123: As the ones who did the actual reinforcing, we guarantee their quality as well. They'll keep you safe.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_WEDGE_000_124: But enough bragging─here are the scales!
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_125: With these, we can search for my sister without fear of corruption. I know not how to repay you.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_CID_000_126: Don't mention it. Midgardsormr came to our rescue in the rift. It's the least we can do to help his children.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_CID_000_128: Well, my friend, my only regret is that I won't be able to accompany you on this latest grand adventure.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NIDHANA_000_132: Before you depart, Your Excellency, there is something we wish to present to you.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NIDHANA_100_132: Will you please come with me?
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_133: You would not delay us without good cause. Very well.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_134: Forgive me, my friends, but I require a moment.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NERO_000_135: ...He's certainly taking his time. What sort of grand present could take so long to receive?
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_CID_000_136: The kind that'll help him in the void, I presume.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_CID_100_136: In that godsforsaken place, he'll need all the help he can get. But you of all people ought to know that, eh?
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NIDHANA_000_200: Since the people learned the truth about Master Vrtra, I had been thinking that it would be nice for him to have multiple vessels. This seemed the perfect occasion to create one.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NIDHANA_000_205: While I had help from my fellows, everyone was busy working on the Atomos, and we needed until the very last moment. Alas, a concoction that can extend the hours in a day doesn't exist...yet.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NIDHANA_000_210: Nevertheless, we managed to complete both an Atomos and a vessel for Master Vrtra that met with our satisfaction!
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_WARRIOR04532_000_22: The satrap and your fellows have already departed for the vault. Are you ready to set forth?
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_YSHTOLA_000_300: For my research into cross-rift travel, this is a moment of truth. For all those who helped us come this far, let us pray we succeed.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_ESTINIEN_000_305: They've upgraded the vault's guardians to contend with voidsent. A task which was made easier by the surplus of broken units.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_ESTINIEN_000_306: ...One could argue that I did them a favor.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NAHBDEEN_000_310: I must say, I'm beginning to feel nervous!
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_CID_000_315: It's not only us cheering you on, but the alchemists of old too. You couldn't possibly fail.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NERO_000_320: An undersea vault guarded by alchemical sentries... Such a place would be an ideal proving ground for new creations.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_BIGGS_000_325: Like us, the alchemists have tremendous passion for their work. If we were to collaborate, I reckon we could achieve some great things!
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_WEDGE_000_330: Good gods, but the treasures here! If I were a thief, I wouldn't notice a voidgate if it came and bit me in the rear!
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter the Fell Court of Troia.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_YSHTOLA_000_405: True to our friends' words, the warding scales are eminently reinforced. We needn't fear corruption even should we be wounded by voidsent.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_ESTINIEN_000_410: First time in a reflection or no, I can't say I'm feeling nervous. Not after having journeyed to the edge of existence.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_415: No looking back... I shall keep my eyes ever forward, and trust Radz-at-Han to my people.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NAHBDEEN_000_420: While the voidgate is open, we must remain vigilant. One voidsent past us is one voidsent too many!
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_CID_000_425: Once we've seen you off, we'll take our leave. Wouldn't want to get in the soldiers' way should it come to battle.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_CID_000_426: It'll be dangerous in the void, but you've been there before and returned safely. We have faith you'll do so again.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_NERO_000_430: I expect a comprehensive report upon your return. 'Tis the least I am owed for my invaluable contribution.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_BIGGS_000_435: To create a voidsent to expand a voidgate... It's inspired ideas like this that make the impossible possible!
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_WEDGE_000_440: I'm glad we can see you off properly─unlike when you were abruptly whisked away to the First. Anyway, please be safe!
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_ESTINIEN_000_700: It seems the minions are keeping their distance for now. Let's carry on.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_VARSHAHN_000_705: I never dreamed I would come this far. I can't thank you all enough for your cooperation.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_YSHTOLA_000_710: This castle should serve as a base of operations for now.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_YSHTOLA_000_712: Ere we set our sights elsewhere, let's see what there is to learn here.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_SYSTEM_000_713: From this point onward, you will not encounter aetherytes for a while. Should you leave Troia Castle, you may return here via Weaver's Warding.
TEXT_AKTKMI101_04592_SYSTEM_000_714: Additionally, you may now enter the Fell Court of Troia with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_YSHTOLA_000_001: Wherever I turn, there's Darkness as far as I can perceive; the only source of Light here is ourselves. The opposite was true in the First.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_ESTINIEN_000_005: It seems the minions are content to gawp for now. Let's carry on.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_010: The warding scale exhibits no change. It should be safe to remain here and begin our search.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_011: But whither now? I would sense Azdaja were she remotely near, but there is nothing...
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_ESTINIEN_000_012: Might you not call to her? Let her know that you have come.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_013: Alas, this vessel is not capable of calling across vast distances. For that, I require my true form.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_014: And even were it possible, a dragon's call is borne upon aether. 'Tis liable to draw more voidsent to us.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_YSHTOLA_000_015: In any case, there's little exploration to be done while we are confined to this isolated isle.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_YSHTOLA_000_016: I propose we begin by learning what we can from the castle's occupants. An understanding of their ways may prove useful to our cause.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_ESTINIEN_000_017: Very well. Let's hope a few of them are capable of speech.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_018: Let all remain vigilant while we go about our inquiries. We reconvene afterwards.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_YSHTOLA_000_100: Like the prevailing tongue in Norvrandt, the language of this world bears a resemblance to our own. It may be assumed that they share a common ancestor.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_ESTINIEN_000_105: This one does naught but stare...
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_110: Some seem willing enough to converse. Whether they have the ability to do so is another matter...
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_SYSTEM_000_122: The creature snarls and glares at you. It is unlikely that you will learn anything from it.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VOIDSENT04593B_000_: What enticing aether you have... Give me some! Give me some!
Awww... If only I were stronger, I'd be able to eat you...
Fine, fine. I'll find someone else to eat... <grumble>
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_SYSTEM_000_133: While able to communicate, this one seems to think only of feeding. Better to take your inquiries elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VOIDSENT04593B_000_: I want to eat you. I mustn't eat you. I want to eat you. I mustn't eat you...
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VOIDSENT04593C_000_: The mistress's eyes are beauteous! Sublime! To bask in her gaze is bliss!
But now she's gone... Never again will I feel her gaze...
No mistress. No orders. What am I to do now? What am I to do now?
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_SYSTEM_000_143: The creature mutters endlessly to itself, not sparing you so much as a glance.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VOIDSENT04593C_000_: No mistress. No orders. What am I to do now? What am I to do now?
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VOIDSENT04593D_000_: I serve! I obey! Please don't eat me!
A...dragon? What's that? Does it taste good? I don't know anything about it. Don't know about anything.
But the one we caught recently, they seemed to know lots.
We threw them in the dungeon, but clever ones are tasty. They might have been eaten already.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_SYSTEM_000_154: You've learned all you can from this voidsent. If you look in the dungeon, you may be able to find the clever one it mentioned.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VOIDSENT04593D_000_: We threw the clever one in the dungeon, but clever ones are tasty. If I had the chance, I don't think I could resist...
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_200: I have nothing to share. While those I approached had no will to fight, neither were they capable of holding a conversation worth the name.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_YSHTOLA_000_201: My experience was much the same. Lower-rung voidsent tend to have lower intelligence, 'twould seem.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_ESTINIEN_000_202: A pity Scarmiglione is dead. He was talkative at least.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_204: A clever voidsent in the dungeon...
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_ESTINIEN_000_205: That would be the area in which we emerged.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_YSHTOLA_000_207: Let's take ourselves back there and find this voidsent─preferably before its fellows make a meal of it.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_YSHTOLA_000_300: There appears to be someone within...
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_ESTINIEN_000_305: I mislike the feel of this. Stay on your guard.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_310: Could this be the clever voidsent?
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_ESTINIEN_000_400: Zenos's avatar, eh? What are the odds.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_ESTINIEN_000_405: We still know little about her, but for now I'm glad we found someone who can do more than moan for aether.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_410: I assume the dungeon was reserved for those intended for the mistress's consumption.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_VARSHAHN_000_415: 'Tis fortunate that we came here when we did. Fateful, even.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: When I served Zenos, my mind was shrouded in haze. But one thing was always clear─his obsession with the “friend.”
What the word means, I do not know exactly. I know only that it referred to you, and that yours was an important existence.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_YSHTOLA_000_430: As much as one might expect the unexpected, I doubt any of us could have foreseen this turn of events.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_YSHTOLA_000_431: She seems different from other voidsent─at least those we've met. And the change we witnessed, I suspect, is due to your crystal purging the excess Darkness in her.
TEXT_AKTKMI102_04593_YSHTOLA_000_432: Even so, she still harbors a great deal of Darkness. I'm very keen to hear what she can tell us─about herself and about her world.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_000_001: While the language of this world is similar to ours, it is her covenant with Zenos that should ensure we can understand one another.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_000_005: The magick for summoning voidsent also facilitates communication, you see. Without this component, a mage would struggle to make his mind known to his servant.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_ESTINIEN_000_010: Zenos's avatar, eh? What are the odds.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_ESTINIEN_000_015: We still know little about her, but for now I'm glad we found someone who can do more than moan for aether.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_000_020: I assume the dungeon was reserved for those intended for the mistress's consumption.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_000_025: 'Tis fortunate that we came here when we did. Fateful, even.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: So, I doubt you came to the dungeon by pure chance. What is it that you're after?
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_000_031: We were looking for a voidsent with whom we could converse, in the course of which we learned of you.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_000_032: We are visitors to this world, and know little and less of its workings and ways.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_000_033: We would be grateful if you could tell us about it. About yourself.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: What do you offer for it?
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Voidsent do not give unless we stand to gain.
If you desire something, you pay the price. That is the sole rule in this world you call the void.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_000_039: That makes sense. Pray forgive our ignorance.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_100_039: But what would be acceptable as payment? I suspect that such coin as we carry has no value here.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_000_040: Voidsent crave one thing alone: aether.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_000_041: In return for information, I offer you mine. Just not all of it, mind you. I still have need of my life.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Very well. I will tell you no more than you can afford to pay.
If we're to talk about the void, let us do so outside. Come with me.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_000_100: You needn't worry for me. My life force is a small price to pay for her knowledge, and I will recover it quickly enough once we've returned home.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_ESTINIEN_000_105: Their “one rule” is no different from that of many in our own world.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_ESTINIEN_100_105: It's those like Alphinaud who are a rare breed.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_000_110: We cannot allow Y'shtola to bear the burden alone. When next the opportunity arises, I will offer my own aether.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_000_200: No one else seems to be nearby. Perhaps it was just a trick of the wind...
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_100_200: If naught is out of the ordinary, I should like to hear more from Zero. I can't imagine there are many part voidsent like her who remember the world as it was.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_ESTINIEN_000_205: We may have subdued the voidsent here, but I doubt they'll remain that way. Remain vigilant.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: “Beginning”... A curious notion in a world where all has come to an end.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_000_220: I must say, we are rather exposed here.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_100_220: Perhaps we should continue the conversation within the castle.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_000_221: The throne room is defensible, given its few points of ingress. Let us head back there.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Moving wasn't part of the bargain. I'll comply, but I expect my payment promptly.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_000_223: You shall have it as soon as we've arrived.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_000_300: I will see to the payment, and then we may ask Zero what she knows about Azdaja.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_ESTINIEN_000_305: I feel eyes on us. Stay alert.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_SYSTEM_000_320:
Upon proceeding, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_SYSTEM_000_321: In addition, you will be required to participate in battle. Your progress will be saved at certain points. In the event that you are defeated, you will be able to try again from the most recent of these.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_SYSTEM_000_322: Please note that if you enter battles associated with other quests or log out from the game, this progress will be lost.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_SYSTEM_000_323: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 90 or above to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_ESTINIEN_000_500: We've vanquished one of Golbez's archfiends, but three remain. As troublesome as this one, I expect.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_VARSHAHN_000_505: If Golbez has Azdaja at his mercy, then we must find him. Hopefully Zero has knowledge that will aid us in our search...
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: There is nothing like the aether of a living mortal. I haven't felt so satisfied since my return.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_000_520: In light of our recent experiences, I expect we all have questions. I trust Zero can answer some few of them.
TEXT_AKTKMI103_04594_YSHTOLA_000_521: We should still be owed at least that much, I daresay.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_001: From memoria to Golbez and his archfiends, we have more questions now than answers. But that is a sign that we are making progress.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_005: If Golbez has Azdaja at his mercy, then we must find him. Hopefully Zero has knowledge that will aid us in our search...
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: There is nothing like the aether of a living mortal. I haven't felt so satisfied since my return.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_020: Hmm... , you've come to the Thirteenth before, yes? You fought voidsent here.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_021: But clearly you didn't know they could regenerate, else you would have shared that detail beforehand.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_A1_000_001: They seemed to stay dead at the time, yes.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_A1_000_002: I was in a bit of a rush and didn't have time to wait around and see...
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_023: I doubt not that they did. There must be a reason why the ones you defeated did not return, in contravention of the natural order.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_024: Do you remember aught out of the ordinary? A sealing magick like Zero's, perhaps?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_025: From what I know of your foray, I can hardly blame you.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_026: Perhaps they returned after you left. But if they didn't, there must be a reason why.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: There are circumstances in which we're unable to return. If you like, I can tell you about this.
The more you devour, the more powerful you grow. But in the process, your essence is blended with those of your prey.
If you were to lose your flesh, the souls you had come to harbor may break free and coalesce into distinct voidsent once more.
And before you yourself return, your own soul might be devoured by your enemies or your erstwhile prey. A fate more likely for stronger beings, who require more time to regenerate.
However, even assuming you survive the process, it's highly uncommon to return as you were.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_034: Yet despite his greater strength, Scarmiglione managed to resurrect rather swiftly. Are there others capable of the same?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Not that I'm aware of. His attachment to his flesh must've been unique for him to develop such an ability.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_036: I believe we understand the fundamentals of rebirth now.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_037: If I may, I would ask you about your power. Will you tell us about it?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: What you saw should speak for itself. I can bind the aether of the soul in crystal.
Many wielded this power during the Contramemoria, but I'm the only one left.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_040: I am told that heroes of the Thirteenth once sealed gods in stones called auracite. Are they and memoria one and the same?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: “Auracite”... I do not know this word, but the world is vast, and perhaps memoria had different names elsewhere. But it does sound quite similar.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_042: How does one come to wield memoria? And what happened to your peers?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Hm, I've never thought about that... I do know, though, that voidsent can't use the power. I assume I can because I'm mortal in part.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_045: Zero, I wish to ask you about the man called Golbez.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_046: He may well have my sister in his clutches. Is there aught you can tell us of him?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: The name sounds vaguely familiar, though I can't say how I know it.
If he is powerful, however, someone in the castle may have heard of him.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_049: Then we must try talking to the other voidsent again!
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_100_049: Let us entrust the task to .  Echo will help facilitate communication.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_110_049: More importantly,  should be able to maintain  composure better than a concerned sibling.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_051: Forgive me, but will you not ask about Golbez in my stead? On the terraces to begin with, perhaps.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_052: Thank you. We shall remain here and discuss what other avenues we might pursue in the meantime.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_100: Scarmiglione, too, appeared surprised by Zero's power. As she says, it must be a lost art.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_105: This makes her invaluable to our cause─far more than someone who can simply communicate.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_110: I know what it feels like to have my essence blended with that of another.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_115: Yet tumultuous though it was, it was only one wyrm's soul. To be bound to scores of others over thousands of years sounds horrible.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_120: According to your vision, Golbez recruited his champions and raised an army by offering a dragon's aether in exchange.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_125: Whatever his crusade, 'tis unconscionable to use a dragon's life force as fodder. He will answer for his deeds.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: So with this “Echo” of yours, you can see into the past? Interesting.
Those memories may as well be all that remains of it, though. Everything and everyone was warped by Darkness. However storied it may appear, this castle is simply the product of its mistress's mind.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VOIDSENT04593B_000_: Ugh, the tasty one returns to tempt me. I mustn't eat you, I mustn't eat you...
...Golbez? I know of him from those I've eaten.
He has minions. And those minions have minions. No one ever sees him.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_SYSTEM_000_143: With his army of minions, Golbez would seldom have need to act personally. It will not be easy to reach him.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VOIDSENT04593B_000_: Golbez must be strong. Very strong. If I were you, I wouldn't try to eat him.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VOIDSENT04593C_000_: If the one who devoured her dies, perhaps the mistress will return. Then I may bask in her gaze again...
G-Golbez, you say!? My mistress spoke of him!
He commands the archfiends! They are very powerful and have conquered many domains!
The mistress bade us defend the castle from them. Yes, yes, she did!
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_SYSTEM_000_154: It seems the archfiends have been attacking other domains. Their fearsome reputation precedes them.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VOIDSENT04593C_000_: I'll defend the castle from the archfiends. And when the mistress returns, perhaps she'll favor me with a long gaze...
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VOIDSENT04593D_000_: So the clever one hadn't been eaten? If no one wants it, then perhaps...
Golbez? Of course I know of him. Only a fool without ears wouldn't.
His archfiends lead armies to ravage and conquer. They devour those they deem useless. Those who can't fight.
If you don't want to be eaten, then you had better flee. Though soon there will be nowhere to run...
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_SYSTEM_000_164: It seems the archfiends keep only those who are fit for battle. Others must escape or be consumed.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VOIDSENT04593D_000_: Obey or be eaten. Obey but eventually be eaten anyway. I don't want to live like that...
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_200: Oh, you've finished already? Or did we get carried away talking...
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_205: There's no easy way to mark the passage of time in this world. Nor do I imagine such things concern voidsent.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_210: It would take considerable mental fortitude to still care after millennia in this endless night.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_215: No trouble on your end either? Good.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_220: I daresay Scarmiglione's fate served as sufficient warning. Let's hope that those elsewhere have the same sense.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Is there no end to their questions? <sigh> I should've demanded more aether...
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_240: Welcome back, . Were you able to learn aught of value?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_241: So countless voidsent answer to the archfiends, who in turn answer to Golbez─as your vision did suggest.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_242: Scarmiglione's aggression is also consistent with the claims that the archfiends conquer other domains.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_243: The question is, how do we reach Golbez if he surrounds himself with armies of minions?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_244: We could target his other archfiends...or perhaps those who have fled his service. Either may yield useful information.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_245: That said, we can't do much while we're stuck on this isle.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_246: Zero, I would ask a favor of you.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_247: I am determined to save my sister Azdaja. If there is even a faint possibility that Golbez has her, then I must find him.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_100_247: To that end, I want you to lend us your strength and knowledge. Will you accompany us on our quest?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Forgotten the way of my world already? If you want help, offer payment.
None here will aid you out of the kindness of their hearts. Any who claim otherwise are liars and betrayers.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: Or is this less a request and more a threat? If I refuse, will you force me to serve?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_A2_000_001: If you accompany us, we can offer you protection.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_A2_000_002: Surely you must desire something. Name it.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_A2_000_003: We're not like Zenos. We would never, ever force you to serve.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Protection? I have no need of such.
I was a prisoner, yes, but only because I couldn't be bothered to resist. I could have easily broken free had I desired to do so.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_100_252: If you're truly such an aimless creature, then you could do worse than to join us. You needn't expend as much energy to defend yourself as you would alone.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Trying to be clever, are you? But even if you had a point, your protection isn't enough to persuade me.
I have no purpose. Why would I desire anything?
That's why I didn't bother to resist when the ones here fell upon me. What matters in a world that's already dead?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_100_255: By that logic, you've no reason to refuse our requests. The payment need but be to your satisfaction, correct?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: <sigh> Did I not already say as much from the start?
You aren't forcing your avatar to serve against its will, that's true. Yours is an equitable covenant.
That being the case, I can believe your words. You would provide fair payment.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_110_258: Very well, Zero. I propose you travel with us, and whenever you perform a deed that requires payment, we will provide it in aether.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: That's all you had to say. Everything else was superfluous.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_262: Either a place the archfiends may strike next, or where refugees and deserters may seek sanctuary...
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I know the latter. I'll take you there.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_265: I assume you also know how we can get off this isle?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I was brought here on a mount. We can leave the same way.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_267: Now that you mention it, I did notice some flying creatures near the terraces.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Given our numbers, we'll need a large one. But regardless of size, all can be won over with aether.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_269: Excellent. Let us go and find our mount at once.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_SPYVOIDSENT_000_270: (-Snooping Voidsent-)Not good... Lord Golbez must hear of this!
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_300: Zero will best know how to handle the creatures. Let us watch and learn.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_305: Not all voidsent can fly. It stands to reason that some would be made to serve as mounts.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_310: Were I here in my true form, I would be able to carry you all. But even were it possible to so enlarge the gate, the risk would be too great.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: We should be able to find a mount here. With the castle in disarray, the creatures will be hungry. Just a little aether should suffice.
Are you ready?
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_YSHTOLA_000_400: 'Tis said that a person's domain is a reflection of what abides in their heart. If true, this place may offer a glimpse into Zero's past.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_ESTINIEN_000_405: The longer one lives, the more one yearns for peace. I understand why some would sequester themselves here.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_VARSHAHN_000_410: 'Tis quite a gathering of voidsent. I pray one among them has the knowledge we seek.
TEXT_AKTKMI104_04595_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: This is my abode. The others won't come near, so you may be at ease.
While they know their place, if tantalizing aether were to walk by, I can't guarantee they wouldn't pounce.
It is a voidsent's nature to consume. Their sole purpose. Even if the pursuit of aether may lead to their undoing, many succumb to instinct.
But any who succumb here will have to answer to me. This is my domain's one and only rule─and it is absolute.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_YSHTOLA_000_001: 'Tis said that a person's domain is a reflection of what abides in their heart. If true, this place may offer a glimpse into Zero's past.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_ESTINIEN_000_005: The longer one lives, the more one yearns for peace. I understand why some would sequester themselves here.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VARSHAHN_000_010: 'Tis quite a gathering of voidsent. I pray one among them has the knowledge we seek.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Consider yourselves duly warned. If you wish to go among the voidsent here, that is your choice to make.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: All have fled from one master or another. But whether any of those masters in turn served Golbez, I do not know. You must ask them yourselves.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_11: Most have traveled to your world, so it shouldn't be difficult to communicate.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VARSHAHN_000_022: We shall go about making inquiries at once. Thank you for your counsel.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VARSHAHN_100_022: Once we've learned all we can, let us reconvene at yonder plaza.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: You're going too, of course? In which case, I shall accompany you.
I wish only to observe. Do not expect me to help.
Then it's settled. I'm ready when you are.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_YSHTOLA_000_100: As you may recall, when a larger voidsent is summoned, only its soul makes the journey to the Source.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_YSHTOLA_000_105: Upon its arrival, it takes possession of a host body. But during that time, what becomes of its actual body here in the Thirteenth?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_YSHTOLA_000_110: The answer to this question may give us valuable insight into cross-rift travel.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_YSHTOLA_000_115: To that end, while asking after Golbez, I shall also see what the voidsent can tell me about their experiences when summoned.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_ESTINIEN_000_120: If a voidsent is too weak to create its own domain, it must join with others for protection.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_ESTINIEN_000_125: Alternately, it might devour them in a bid to become stronger, but in so doing risk losing its sense of self.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VARSHAHN_000_135: 'Twas in order to strike down the Cloud of Darkness that my sister crossed over into the void.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VARSHAHN_000_140: What befell her after she vanished into the gate? How did she become Golbez's captive? These things and more, I hope to learn...
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Ready? Then lead the way. I leave it to you to decide with whom you speak.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_SYSTEM_000_151: Zero is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_SYSTEM_000_152: You can leave Zero behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_SYSTEM_000_153: If you wish to have Zero accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Although this is my domain, I don't make a habit of strolling about. 'Tis a strange feeling...
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_SYSTEM_000_214: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Zero?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: You have other business? Fine. Come and find me at my abode when you've finished.
Finished tending to your other affairs? Then let us continue on.
I call this my abode, but spend hardly any time here. I return only for meditation.
While physical wounds can be healed by replenishing one's aether, you can't preserve your form if you lose sight of yourself.
Such is the risk inherent in consuming another's soul. It dilutes your sense of self. Alters you inside and out.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: To guard against this, I meditate. Visualize who I am, in a place all my own.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: This is the heart of my domain. Normally it's deserted, but you and yours have drawn everyone out.
I don't recall this statue, though...
However it came to be here, I certainly didn't wish for it.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596A_000_: I thought you were her prey, but they say you're her minions. Which are you?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596B_000_: Are you really a mortal? I've never seen a mortal before...
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596C_000_: <slurp> I bet you taste good. But I can't eat you, else I'll be eaten too...
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_SYSTEM_000_220: You must be accompanied by Zero and have her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_SYSTEM_000_221: Zero has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596A_000_: To walk around with her like that... You're her minion, then?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: You know I don't take minions.  has some questions, and I want you to answer them.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596A_000_: Golbez? I don't know that one. Only Scathach.
When she led us beyond the veil, I grew scared and fled.
I've been here since. I don't know anyone else, nor do I wish to. That's all I can tell you.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Scathach was a powerful voidsent who ruled over a vast domain. That was a long time ago, though, so I doubt she has any connection to Golbez.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596A_000_: I told you─I don't know anyone else, nor do I wish to. Leave me be.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596B_000_: You're one of the mortals! Is it true? When you die over there, you really die?
So it is, so it is! What brings you here, then?
Ah yes, Golbez. He seeks strong minions to grow his army, so I hear.
But recently, he stopped doing that. Instead, he devours all.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Perhaps he's gathered enough fodder and is now intent on bolstering his own strength. A sure sign that he is about to make a move.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596B_000_: By the way, why haven't you died already? Over there, you can do so any time, no? Don't miss your chance, or you'll end up like us.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596C_000_: <rumble> Stay away from me... If you don't want to be eaten, stay away...
Golbez, Golbez... I've heard the name before.
Ah, I remember! Always speaking of a great crusade. I don't know what that is, but it sounds delicious. <slurp>
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: A crusade, you say? From whom did you hear this?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596C_000_: Farfarello. He was a minion of another minion. Went on and on about the terrible things he saw.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I see... Perhaps Farfarello can tell us more.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VOIDSENT04596C_000_: Why do you want to know about Golbez? Do you have a crusade too?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Satisfied with what you've learned? Ah─but let's step away before you become too tempting to resist.
It seems the rumors of Golbez reach even my remote domain.
Fair to assume he's gathering strength for his crusade─whatever that may be.
But I must say, I wouldn't have guessed that Farfarello once fought in Golbez's army. It's a miracle he survived serving an archfiend.
Ah, I suppose I should explain.
Farfarello is the weakest among us. Constantly in fear of being devoured, he seldom consorts with others.
The only one he's comfortable with is Ciriatto.
He's a fellow coward who runs the instant he senses a threat, and won't stop until he's exhausted.
When their hunger grows too intense, they feed on each other's aether. Such is their relationship.
But I ramble. You intend to seek out Farfarello, I presume?
Then I'll come with you. He's less likely to hide that way.
Farfarello keeps to the fringes of my domain. This way.
The voidsent here don't answer to a master. They can do as they please.
But all must answer to the hunger, and seek out prey when they need aether.
Except Farfarello and Ciriatto, that is─they are content to take from one another. Barring an incident, they dare not venture out.
When he takes flight, Ciriatto will not seek shelter until he is utterly spent. Farfarello, on the other hand, prefers to hide in the same place. Come.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: Uwaaaaaah! P-Please don't eat me...but I suppose you have to...
Oh, whatever will I do now? <whimper>
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Ciriatto... This is rather unexpected. Where is Farfarello?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: <gulp>
Farfarello...isn't here anymore. He's...left. Y-Yes, that's right!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Left? That doesn't sound like him at all.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: W-Well, he's gone, all right? Wh-What more do you want me to say?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: And off he flees, as he is wont to do.
But something about this doesn't sit well with me...
What do you make of Ciriatto's behavior?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_A1_000_001: He seemed frightened. Perhaps someone had threatened him?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_A1_000_002: I don't think he was telling the truth.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I doubt it. Had he been threatened, we wouldn't have found him in one place.
No, he would run in circles until he could run no more. That's his nature.
So you think so too.
As he says, Farfarello is gone. But that is quite unusual.
As is the fact that Ciriatto, who was clearly frightened by something, chose not to flee but instead hid here, where Farfarello usually─
We must go after Ciriatto. Now.
I know Farfarello was our quarry, but Ciriatto's behavior troubles me. We must find him.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: I-I don't have time for this... You'd best keep your distance if you know what's good for you!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Ciriatto, we need to talk.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: Th-There's no time! The wind rises! We must flee!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: The wind rises...? What is he talking about?
After him.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: Uwaaah, the wind howls! Louder and louder!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: What's gotten into you? What do you mean, the wind rises?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: When the wind rises, she comes! Barbariccia!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Barba...riccia? Who in the world is that?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: We must flee, all of us! There's no time!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I don't sense anything, but he seems convinced.
It's a dead end beyond. We'll corner him.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: Ahhh, it's too late! The wind is already upon us!
We're doomed! There's nowhere to run!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: What are you running from?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: I-I already told you! Barbariccia, the archfiend of wind!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Archfiend, you say?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: We will be devoured or forced to serve. To fight in the crusade. But it makes no difference. In the end, all are eaten by her or her enemies.
I didn't want to fight anymore. That's why I fled and came here!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I see. That explains everything...almost.
I thought it was Farfarello who used to serve an archfiend. Not you.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: Not you, who always ran at the first sign of trouble. You who now speak as though you were Barbariccia's minion. There's only one explanation...
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_20: Indeed, that would account for his uncharacteristic behavior.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: So, is that the way of it? Did you devour Farfarello?
And not just a portion of his aether, but his entire being.
Tell me true, Ciriatto. You devoured Farfarello, didn't you?
And not just a portion of his aether, but his entire being.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: ...H-How did you know?
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: It wasn't only your behavior that felt strange.
You felt strange. As if there was more than you present.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: Now, I don't believe you would've lost control. More likely it was at Farfarello's behest.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: I can't hide anything from you...
I admit it. Farfarello didn't leave. I ate him.
He feared Barbariccia more than anything. Hated the endless fighting.
So he begged me to devour him, that he would never have to fight again.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: Rather than an eternity of fighting, he chose a moment of pain...
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: For all the good it did. I can still hear his voice in my head. He's frightened, so very frightened...
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: When you're eaten, your essence is blended with that of your devourer. And though you have no control, your consciousness in part endures.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: Were this a world where the wheel of life and death still turned, the soul wouldn't linger so stubbornly.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_11: In time, it would return to the great flow.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_12: But there's no such end here. No escape. All know this. In making his choice, Farfarello must have been desperate indeed.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: And now that desperation has joined with Ciriatto's fear, driving him to act erratically.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: This place will become a battlefield. We don't want to be eaten. Neither me nor Farfarello. But there's nowhere to go! Nowhere!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Then tell me about Barbariccia. I would know who it is we face.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_FORMERMINIONVOIDSEN: It's too late. She's as good as here, and no one can escape her winds! No one!
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_YSHTOLA_000_900: What little I learned in your absence did not pertain to the archfiends. That discussion can wait until after we've tended to Barbariccia.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VARSHAHN_000_905: Just you wait, Barbariccia. I will have answers from you yet...
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I have no intention of demanding anyone's aether until afterwards. Weakening you now would only reduce my chances of getting paid.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_ESTINIEN_000_920: The less time we give the enemy to prepare, the better. If everyone is ready, then let us set forth.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VARSHAHN_000_921: Indeed. And yet...my heart weighs heavy for those Barbariccia struck down. Were it not for us, she would not have come here.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_VARSHAHN_100_921: Should you require a moment, Zero...
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: For what? Barbariccia took what she could. She was wise to strike quickly─as we would be.
TEXT_AKTKMI105_04596_ESTINIEN_000_924: Agreed. This is no time for sentiment. Only the battle matters now.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_YSHTOLA_000_001: What little I learned in your absence did not pertain to the archfiends. That discussion can wait until after we've tended to Barbariccia.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_ESTINIEN_000_005: Scarmiglione possessed the power of regeneration. Let us see what Barbariccia can do with her winds.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_VARSHAHN_000_010: Just you wait, Barbariccia. I will have answers from you yet...
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: A word of warning. Barbariccia spoke as if she would give us answers if we were to defeat her.
But even assuming she'll talk─which I doubt─I trust I needn't tell you how foolish it is to give an archfiend a second chance. Best to seal her away at the earliest opportunity.
If you wish to peer into her past, the memoria will suffice.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_A1_000_001: I can't wield the power at will.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_A1_000_002: I'll try, but I make no guarantees.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Well then, you had better hope it favors you when the time comes.
You do that. And if you fail, well...you'll just have to search elsewhere for answers.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_YSHTOLA_000_026: Rest assured this won't be our last opportunity to learn about Azdaja.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_YSHTOLA_100_026: If another archfiend were to fall, Golbez would surely be compelled to respond.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_YSHTOLA_000_027: We need only wait for our quarry to come to us.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_VARSHAHN_000_028: Indeed. If our struggles with Scarmiglione taught us aught, 'tis that we must hold nothing back when facing an archfiend.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_VARSHAHN_000_029: Let us heed Zero's advice and seal her away at the earliest opportunity.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: If we're all in agreement, then let us be off. We travel by nisroch.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_YSHTOLA_000_100: Scarmiglione was the archfiend of earth, while Barbariccia is of the wind. In this world given to Darkness, I wonder what significance their elemental titles hold.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_ESTINIEN_000_105: Barbariccia will use every advantage she has. Traps, ambushes─we must be prepared for all that and more.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_VARSHAHN_000_110: This is not the first trial we have faced since coming to this world. Nor will it be the last. But with you all beside me, I am confident we will prevail. So come, let us sally forth!
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: To transform a voidsent into memoria, we must first drain them of their aether. To wit, we must wound her gravely.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_ESTINIEN_000_400: In her present state, Zero is easy prey for other voidsent. We must be on our guard.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_VARSHAHN_000_405: Zero hasn't so much as stirred. Such power she must have expended...
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_SYSTEM_000_410: Though so slow as to be nearly imperceptible, Zero's chest rises and falls in a steady rhythm...
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_YSHTOLA_000_420: Though Zero remains unconscious, she appears otherwise fine.
TEXT_AKTKMI106_04597_YSHTOLA_000_421: ...Insofar as I can discern, at any rate. Being part voidsent, her physiology may be rather different from ours. Let us observe her for a while as we discuss our next move.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_YSHTOLA_000_001: Even those part voidsent require rest, I imagine. And her own abode seems as good a place as any.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_YSHTOLA_100_001: Unlike the Source, however, there is scant ambient aether for her to draw upon here...
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_ESTINIEN_000_005: In her present state, Zero is easy prey for other voidsent. We must be on our guard.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_SYSTEM_000_010: Though so slow as to be nearly imperceptible, Zero's chest rises and falls in a steady rhythm...
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_020: How long do you suppose she will remain this way?
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_YSHTOLA_000_024: I haven't the faintest inkling, nor can I say whether the aether we can afford to share will be enough to awaken her.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_YSHTOLA_000_025: 'Twould be best to take her back with us to the Source. There, she would be guaranteed all she requires.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_026: Zero cannot give her consent, but it seems we have no choice. The alternative would be to leave her here, defenseless.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_100_026: Should she later desire it, we can bring her home.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_027: , might I ask you to hold on to Barbariccia's memoria? It may yet serve a purpose.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VOIDSENT04596B_000_: We have a newcomer─a former minion of Barbariccia.
Let her know when she wakes, will you?
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_YSHTOLA_000_033: Why not go and find this newcomer? So we have something to tell Zero, if nothing else.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_034: May I trouble you to join me, ? With luck, we might learn something of Golbez.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_YSHTOLA_000_100: Worry not, we will keep an eye on Zero. Go and meet this newcomer.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_ESTINIEN_000_105: When the leader falls, the minions pledge themselves to the enemy. There's no loyalty─only survival.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_110: This appears to be the newcomer.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VOIDSENT04598_000_1: <gasp> Y-You're the ones who felled Barbariccia!
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VOIDSENT04598_100_1: I-I won't make trouble. I-I'll obey. So please, let me stay!
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_121: If you would obey, then tell me all you know of Golbez.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VOIDSENT04598_000_1: Th-There isn't much I can tell. Only the archfiends are allowed into his domain, wherever it is. None but they know.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_124: I see... No better way to guard oneself than keeping one's location secret.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_100_124: How does Golbez communicate with his minions afield?
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VOIDSENT04598_000_1: He has these...scepters? Staves? Whatever they are, he uses them to talk to those far away.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_127:
Not unlike linkpearls, at least in function...
That will be all. My thanks for your cooperation.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_128: My thanks to you as well for affording me the time.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_100_128: I am satisfied, so let us rejoin the others and head home.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_YSHTOLA_000_200: Vrtra has told all. Golbez goes to great lengths indeed to conceal his whereabouts.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_ESTINIEN_000_205: While I'm sure Nahbdeen has matters under control, I can't help but worry. Let's not keep them waiting.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VOIDSENT04598_000_2: Whenever Barbariccia moved her domain, some would get left behind. No such worries here.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_220: I trust you understand that once we leave the Thirteenth, we will not return until we are prepared to resume our search. Knowing this, are you ready to depart?
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_SYSTEM_000_221: You will not be able to freely return to the Thirteenth. Are you certain you wish to leave?
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_VARSHAHN_000_222: Back to Troia, then, and thence home...
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_MEGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_0: , we have been expecting you. If you would follow me, I will show you to the guest chambers.
TEXT_AKTKMI107_04598_SYSTEM_000_401: Proceed to the Meghaduta guest chambers?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_ESTINIEN_000_001: My chamber is much the same as this one. Too opulent for my taste, but at least it has space to train.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_005: She seems to be faring better here. Praise be to the Sisters...
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_SYSTEM_000_010: Zero's breathing appears to be less strained than it was in the Thirteenth.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_0: Ah,  . If you would follow me, I will show you to the guest chambers.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_SYSTEM_000_020: Proceed to the Meghaduta guest chambers?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_YSHTOLA_000_030: If I may excuse myself, I wish to pay a visit to the High Crucible.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_YSHTOLA_000_031: While the scales functioned admirably, it would be prudent to have them inspected for signs of degradation.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_032: By all means. I shall do the same for this vessel.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_ESTINIEN_000_033: Then I'll go and meet with the soldiers. Share with them what I learned fighting voidsent in the Thirteenth.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_034: What of you, my friend? Have you any immediate plans?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_A1_000_003: I might go and tend to my island.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_036: In that case, might I trouble you with a small task?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_037: In that case, might I trouble you with a small task?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_038: Truly? Had I known you had such interests, I might have entrusted you with the development of our nearby isles to attract visitors.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_100_038: At any rate, should you be in no hurry, might I trouble you with a small task first?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_039: I wish to have food ready for Zero when she awakens, you see. Would you be willing to go to Mehryde's Meyhane and ask for suitable refreshments?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_041: Excellent. In the meantime, Nidhana shall watch over Zero. She is already en route.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_042: Let us each then tend to our respective businesses and reconvene anon.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_000_100: Welcome to Mehryde's Meyhane! Please make yourself comfortable.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_000_101: What? A guest of the satrap has collapsed from hunger?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_000_102: Of course I would be happy to help. You need only tell me what you desire.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_A3_000_001: Your most expensive dish, just for good measure.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_A3_000_002: Something light and refreshing. Like fruit perhaps.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_A3_000_003: A rich and hearty meal with plenty of meat.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_A3_000_004: A modest quantity of a living mortal's aether should suffice.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_100_102: While that can certainly be arranged, I fear it would be too rich for someone coming out of a long slumber.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_101_102: I would recommend something gentler on the stomach, like these apples here. They're sweet, juicy, and nutritious!
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_110_102: Ah yes, that would be perfect for someone coming out of a long slumber. Please take these apples with you, then. They've just come in, and I can guarantee their freshness.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_120_102: While that might be perfect for an adventurer preparing to raid a treasure vault, I fear it would be too much for someone coming out of a long slumber.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_121_102: I would recommend something gentler on the stomach, like these apples here. They've just come in, and I can guarantee their freshness.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_130_102: Er, I'm afraid we don't serve that particular...delicacy...
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_131_102: If I may, I would recommend something gentle on the stomach, like these apples here. They've just come in, and I can guarantee their freshness.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_000_103: Afterwards, once your guest feels better, she's welcome to sample whatever else we can provide. Just let me know!
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_000_200: Oh, this is a while ago now, but Professor Jalheen and Azahma were overjoyed to learn of your safe return from the treasure vault. And so they celebrated, and got just about every other patron involved.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_000_205: Not in recent memory has the meyhane been so lively. It was all Mihleel and I could do to keep things orderly, but we too shared in their joy.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_0: Ah, welcome back. Lest you worry, Mistress Nidhana has been taking good care of our guest.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_1: Will you be joining them now?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_SYSTEM_000_211: Proceed to the Meghaduta guest chambers?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_YSHTOLA_000_300: While at the High Crucible, I spoke with the alchemists about Zero. If you require any assistance, don't hesitate to let them know.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_ESTINIEN_000_305: The Thirteenth was far colder than Thavnair. Let's hope Zero doesn't collapse again from the heat...
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_NIDHANA_000_310: Should walking prove too taxing, there is always the Aethernet. She shouldn't have trouble making use of it.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_315: 'Twas my pleasure to show you the city when first you arrived. I shall enjoy doing the same for Zero.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: This world is brimming with aether... I feel invigorated just standing here in the breeze.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_321: Glad am I to hear that. So─is there any place in particular you wish to see?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Hmmm...
Perhaps where that food came from─apple, was it? While I don't expect I'll collapse again, it would be good to know where I can procure more if necessary.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_324: Mehryde's Meyhane it is, then. I shall introduce you to the head waitress, Mihleel.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_SYSTEM_000_325: Varshahn and Zero are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_SYSTEM_000_326: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_SYSTEM_000_327: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: While bound to Zenos, I never saw vibrant cities like this. Only ruined places, not so different from the void.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_406: Do you recall the time we traveled together to the outpost? Should our tour take us outside the city, we must make use of hamsa again.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_SYSTEM_000_411: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Do as you will, but the condition was that you accompany me. I will return to the palace.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_413: You have urgent business? Very well, we shall await you back at Meghaduta.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: You're here. Good. We can set out again.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_415: If you have concluded your business, then let us resume our tour.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: This is the place? The air is different here, and I speak not of the heat.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_11: There's a texture to it─a fullness─unlike that of elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_120_407: You smell the cooking, I believe. Hannish cuisine is quite fragrant─and delicious, I hope you will agree.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_409: We could attempt to introduce Zero to Mehryde herself, but Mihleel is more likely to be available.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MIHLEEL_000_416: Welcome to Mehryde's Meyhane! Are you by yourself ?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_SYSTEM_000_417: You must be accompanied by Varshahn and Zero, and have them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_SYSTEM_000_418: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_420: Greetings, Mihleel, and may I introduce you to Zero. She is an esteemed guest, and I ask that you see to her meals during her stay.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MIHLEEL_000_421: Ah, yes, Mehryde has told me all! Please come to us whenever you're hungry. We'll look after you.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_100_422: While the palace cooks can prepare whatever you desire, 'tis certainly a quick and convenient food.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: ...Who are the ones there, moving their bodies about? Is it for some ritual related to eating?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_426: The dancers? They move their bodies to bring pleasure to those who are watching.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_427: 'Tis a form of entertainment. Part of our culture.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: How needlessly complicated. We voidsent prefer simpler pleasures.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_429: That may be the way of it now, but your world, too, must have had such “complicated” diversions once.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: ...I don't remember.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_431: Well, let us move on. I propose we visit Balshahn Bazaar, where goods the world over may be found.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MIHLEEL_000_500: Be it food, drinks, or dancers, we provide only the finest for your enjoyment!
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRYDE_000_505: I'm pleased to see that His Excellency's guest is back on her feet. She is always welcome here, as are you.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: What are all these things for? What do you do here?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_511: This is a marketplace─where people buy and sell goods. Since its earliest days, Radz-at-Han has served as a trading hub, and here you'll find not only local products, but wares from distant lands.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_512: I should mention that the vendors generally only accept payment in coin or tomestones. If there is aught you desire, I shall take care of it.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: So that's what tomestones are for... Voidsent returned with them on occasion, but I never knew their purpose.
They struck me as useless trinkets, and I couldn't understand your obsession with them.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_515: On that subject, there appeared to be no shops in the Thirteenth. Do you never make bargains in which possessions are exchanged?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: We do, but rarely. We strike bargains when we want something done. If we desire an object, we kill whoever has it.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_517: I see, I see. Your bargains may be likened to employment, I believe. I shall bear this in mind.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_519: With that, let us continue on. I propose we head to the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_ISU_000_600: We were told the satrap has a special guest. Is she not with you?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_ISU_000_601: Why, Master Vrtra! How may we serve you this ? If you're here for your vessel, I'm afraid we're still tending to it...
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_602: No, no, there is no rush. Pray take as much time as you require, and know that I have complete faith in your work.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_605: The High Crucible is home to the finest alchemists. They are the ones who created my bodies, and can provide you with healing as well.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_606: Hmmm... Now that I think on it, you weren't at all surprised when I changed forms. Were you aware of my nature from the start─that I was a soul occupying a vessel not my own?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: It's hardly uncommon in our world. When given the chance, many shed their bodies to claim stronger ones.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_ISU_000_609: Oh, you must be the rumored guest! We've been most eager to meet you!
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_ISU_000_610: If you have a moment, would you care to stay for some tea? The Sisters know we'd love to hear your tales!
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: No. I've had enough food for now, and can always obtain more without the need for inane chatter.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_612: Now, now, no need to decline outright. I daresay you are tired, so let us save it for another time and return to Meghaduta. If aught catches your eye en route, do not hesitate to say so.
