TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_ISU_000_700: Artificial voidsent are a concept we understand well, but partial voidsent─now that is something that upends our established theories! I do hope we have the chance to speak with her at length. And perform a few tests, perhaps...
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: ...Some sort of fruit? Pitiful things, though. I imagine you'd need to eat a lot to derive any satisfaction.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_711: These are mulberry trees. While the fruits are indeed edible, more important are the leaves, which we feed to silkworms. Without the creatures, we wouldn't have the silk to make our famous Thavnairian weave.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_712: Furthermore, the bark of the tree also possesses medicinal properties. You would be hard-pressed to find a more useful plant.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Is that so... Aside from food, I wouldn't have considered any other purpose for it.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRAHD_000_714: (-Familiar Boy's Voice-)<gasp> Master Vrtra! And  too!
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_715: If it isn't young Mehrahd. And that must be your sister, Yahsra. Is all well at the orphanage?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRAHD_000_716: Yes, Your Excellency. The other children are very nice, and we all look out for one another.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_YAHSRA_000_717: Oh, oh! Just the other day, Estinien came to see us! Everyone was really excited!
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_718: Truly? Estinien paid you a visit?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Friend... You know what that is?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_722: She is a visitor from a faraway land, you see, and is still unfamiliar with our language.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_YAHSRA_000_723: Then we'll teach you! A friend is someone you like to play with!
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Play with...
Zenos seemed to be enjoying himself when he fought you. Is that the same thing?
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: I see. But...is having someone to play with so fulfilling? I still do not understand why.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_11: Then I'm no closer to understanding it.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Why he traversed the great expanse─why he risked life and limb...for you...
...But I waste energy dwelling on such things. I am not Zenos. I stand to gain nothing by knowing his heart.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_YAHSRA_000_730: I'm sorry I couldn't explain it well...
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: There's no need to apologize. The fault is not yours, but mine for failing to make sense of your words.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MEHRAHD_000_732: Well, we had better get back to our errand.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_YAHSRA_000_733: Good-bye! It was nice meeting you!
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_VARSHAHN_000_800: What is a friend? 'Tis a seemingly simple question, but the answer is anything but. Only a child, innocent and pure, could reply with nary a moment's hesitation.
TEXT_AKTKMI108_04599_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Through Zenos, I thought I understood the ways of your world.
But the more I learn of it, the more I realize how little I actually know. It's all so strange─your behavior and your reasons. I find myself baffled at every turn.
...But the feeling is not unwelcome. I'm...learning, bit by bit. It was the right decision to join you.
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_YSHTOLA_000_001: During his brief reign, Zenos ruled over the ruins of Garlemald. A stark contrast from the vibrance of Radz-at-Han. I trust Zero enjoyed it, in her own way.
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_ESTINIEN_000_005: I'm not surprised that Zero is unfamiliar with money. If she means to stay in Radz-at-Han for a while, we'll need to teach her how to deal with the local merchants.
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Darkness warped all life in the void. Even plants. Only now do I recall flowers, and the value they held.
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_MEGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_0: Ah,  . I shall be glad to show you to the guest chambers.
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_SYSTEM_000_020: Proceed to the Meghaduta guest chambers?
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_VARSHAHN_000_030: I believe Zero's time here has been rewarding, and 'twas in no small part due to your company. My thanks for agreeing to join us.
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_VARSHAHN_000_032: Come, let us return to Meghaduta.
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_MEGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_0: Welcome back,  . Will you be heading to the guest chambers?
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_SYSTEM_000_101: Proceed to the Meghaduta guest chambers?
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_VARSHAHN_000_200: Though our time in the void was short, we managed to ascertain that my sister yet lives. And it cannot be overstated how fortunate we are to have met Zero.
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_VARSHAHN_000_201: But the greater blessing is nevertheless you, my friend. For your encouragement to embark upon my search anew, and your help in overcoming the challenges thus far.
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_VARSHAHN_000_209: Golbez and his minions will seek to stymie our efforts. Of this we can be sure.
TEXT_AKTKMI109_04600_VARSHAHN_000_210: But with you all at my side, I have confidence that we will succeed. That we will find and liberate my sister. And that we shall return home together.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_VARSHAHN_000_000: Ah, . As always, your timing is most fortuitous. I wish to share with you news concerning Zero.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_VARSHAHN_000_001: You will recall that, in exchange for aether, she agreed to aid us in our search for my sister.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_VARSHAHN_000_002: At Y'shtola's suggestion, I began providing said aether in the form of food. Zero has found the arrangement to be agreeable, and has been eating steadily.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_VARSHAHN_000_003: In large part due to that, she claims to have already made a full recovery.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_VARSHAHN_000_004: If you and the others are ready as well, I would set forth for the void once more.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_VARSHAHN_000_007: Excellent. I shall inform Y'shtola and Estinien, and then go to collect my other vessel from the alchemists.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_VARSHAHN_000_008: In the meantime, might I ask you to fetch Zero?
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_VARSHAHN_000_009: She was absent when I visited her chambers earlier, but I suspect you will find her in the corridor connecting Yuj and Kama. It seems she's grown partial to the view of the city it affords.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_VARSHAHN_000_010: Once we have attended to our respective tasks, let us gather here.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_YSHTOLA_000_020: I've been at the Great Work, discussing our experiences in the void with the alchemists.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_YSHTOLA_000_025: Though they found much of it surprising, they were especially shocked to learn that Darkness prevents souls from finding rest.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_ESTINIEN_000_030: If you're ready to get back to it, then so am I.
TEXT_AKTKMJ101_04670_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: So much aether... I can't remember the last time I felt such fullness. I could get used to this.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_YSHTOLA_000_005: We have no reason to doubt Vrtra. Let us depart for Garlemald as soon as possible.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: So that was a dragon's roar. Quite a trick, imbuing one's voice with aether.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ESTINIEN_000_020: By all accounts, Azdaja is Golbez's prisoner, yet if she was in the Source...
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ESTINIEN_000_021: It could be that she managed to escape from the void, if only for a fleeting moment.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ESTINIEN_000_022: But that is mere conjecture. If we want the truth, then we must go and find it.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ESTINIEN_000_024: Come, let's make for Tertium. Our friends are waiting.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_VARSHAHNBIG_000_030: I thought to depart from Radz-at-Han sooner, but Y'shtola insisted I bring warmer clothes.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_VARSHAHNBIG_000_031: This vessel does not feel cold as such, but she reminded me that, so long as I am Varshahn, it would be prudent not to appear overly conspicuous.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_YSHTOLA_000_035: I trust you know the “associates” who will be joining us. Hopefully they have been keeping well.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: People live in such places, do they? Not that I would presume to know their preferences, but it seems...uncomfortable.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_VARSHAHNBIG_000_050: I had tempered my hopes, but thanks to Alphinaud and Alisaie, we might yet learn something of Azdaja.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_YSHTOLA_000_055: Nothing appears to be out of the ordinary here at the camp. Let us see what we find at this village.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ESTINIEN_000_060: I knew the twins wouldn't disappoint.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: A village of voidsent users... Lest you think I have feelings on this─I don't. What others do is not my concern.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALPHINAUD_000_070: I expect it's been a while since you spoke with Jullus. He will be glad to see you.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_075: The people here struggle to survive as it is. The last thing they need is for Garlemald to be overrun with voidsent.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_081: And I see you're traveling with a large crew as usual...
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_082: Not to suggest that's an inconvenience for us. We'd be happy to share our supplies with you and your allies, should you require any.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALPHINAUD_000_084: Apologies if we interrupt, Jullus, but there is a matter we wish to discuss.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_085: We've just finished our routine briefing, so you come at a good time. Is this about the voidsent?
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALPHINAUD_000_086: It is. From what we can discern, they're coming from the mountains to the east.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALPHINAUD_000_087: Practitioners of the reaper arts once lived in that area, did they not?
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_088: Yes, they had a village there in the Lapis Manalis caverns.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_089: The scythe-wielders forged pacts with voidsent, and took to battle with the beings at their side. For a time they played an invaluable role in our military, but the advent of magitek saw them fall out of favor.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_090: And when some were unmasked as insurrectionists, the order was outlawed. The village is believed to be long abandoned.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_091: Speaking of their art...it seems you've picked it up. Who was it that taught you?
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_092: ...Well, I suppose it's neither here nor there now.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_VARSHAHNBIG_000_093: My sister has been taken captive by voidsent. I sensed her presence in this land, and have come in search of her.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_VARSHAHNBIG_000_094: If voidsent have been sighted here, then I believe there is a connection. We should like to investigate these caverns you mention, but Alphinaud tells us they are not easily reached.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_095: I'm afraid so. Deep snow and tumultuous winds rule out walking and flying.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_096: If you want to get anywhere, you're going to need a magitek snowcraft. Alas, the last remaining functional one we had has broken down. Should still be over in Cerulea Ingens, where it was abandoned.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_097: Is there anyone who can fix it?
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_098: Perhaps the former engineers at Tapper's Den.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_099: Their duty included transporting ceruleum tanks to Juturna Platform G using snowcraft. I expect they had to maintain a few over the years.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_100: That's worth looking into, I'd say.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_101: In the course of delivering provisions, I've come to know the people there quite well. If they can help us, I'm sure they will.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALPHINAUD_000_102: May I ask you to accompany her? Given the presence of voidsent, it's best that we avoid traveling alone.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_VARSHAHNBIG_000_103: In the meantime, will you not tell me more about the mountain? I would like to learn as much as I can before commencing our search in earnest.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_JULLUS_000_104: Come with me. I'll introduce you to someone who's well versed in the local geography.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Alisaie, was it? I wish to speak with you.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_0106: In that case, why don't you come with us to Tapper's Den? We can chat on the way.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALPHINAUD_000_110: I shall go and brief the contingent on the voidsent issue, that they too may be prepared.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: If you want to eavesdrop, be my guest. It doesn't matter to me.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_117: We should get back to it, but before we do...
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_118: Are you all right, Zero? Did I say something that confused or upset you?
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: ...No. I'm simply trying to understand your perspective. If you wish to continue, I am ready and able.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_100_119: Well, that's a relief! This isn't the sort of place you want to mull over things.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_110_119: It's not much farther to Tapper's Den. I doubt we'll have much trouble finding an engineer when we arrive, so let's speak with the first one we spot.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_120: This is one of the engineers, I think.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Because it's the right thing to do...
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ENGINEER04671_000_1: Wait, I know you. You're the one who roughed up the guards!
After you left, your contingent friends came along. Our lives are a lot easier now thanks to them.
They understood our plight, and offered to help─whether we wanted to stay here or return home. For that, we're truly grateful.
We're grateful to you too, Alisaie. The trip across the lake is hardly pleasant, but you make it all the same to bring us provisions.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_134: Oh, don't mention it. We're just glad we can help.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_135: That said, we were actually hoping to ask a favor of you today...
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_136: We need a magitek snowcraft repaired─the one abandoned in Cerulea Ingens. We were told you might be up to the task.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ENGINEER04671_000_1: Ah, so you want to ride the mammoth!
That's what we took to calling the crafts on account of their size.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ENGINEER04671_100_1: As often as I used them on rigs, I know a thing or two about their maintenance. I'll see if I can get your mammoth roaring again─it's the least I can do to repay your kindness.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_139: Wonderful! Please come with us back to Camp Broken Glass, and we'll take it from there.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_140: So far so good, ! Let's be on our way.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_150: Thank goodness we were able to find someone to help with repairs.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: You mortals are more sensitive to the cold than I realized. My body is made differently, so I feel nothing.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ENGINEER04671_000_1: Don't you worry─the mammoth is in good hands!
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALPHINAUD_100_170: I presume this is the engineer who will help us with the craft?
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ENGINEER04671_000_1: I'll do everything I can to get her up and running again!
But I doubt I'll be able to do so quickly─at least on my own. The mammoth is big, and so are its parts. Some strong backs should make the work go faster.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALPHINAUD_000_174: You've finished learning about the mountain, I take it?
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_VARSHAHNBIG_000_175: Aye, we have a solid grasp of that area, as well as the site of the snowcraft.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_YSHTOLA_000_177: My back is perhaps not as strong as some, but I should be glad to stand guard for voidsent and other unruly wildlife.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ENGINEER04671_000_1: Much obliged, miss. Then let's all head over to the mammoth and assess what needs fixing.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALPHINAUD_000_179: They have matters here well in hand. Which means we can resume our duties.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALPHINAUD_000_180: Would you care to assist us, ?
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I will assist you as well. As payment for answering my question.
TEXT_AKTKMJ102_04671_ALISAIE_000_183: It's hardly something that demands payment...but we'd be glad for your contribution nonetheless.
TEXT_AKTKMJ103_04672_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I can't say I understand Alisaie's answer, but a debt is a debt.
TEXT_AKTKMJ103_04672_ALISAIE_000_005: At first I didn't know what to make of Zero, but her frankness speaks to me. I like her!
TEXT_AKTKMJ103_04672_ALPHINAUD_000_010: My thanks again for agreeing to help.
TEXT_AKTKMJ103_04672_ALPHINAUD_000_011: The Ilsabard contingent brings in shipments of food, medicine, and other necessities by airship.
TEXT_AKTKMJ103_04672_ALPHINAUD_000_012: We have yet to deliver a share of supplies to Tertium, and I would appreciate it if one of you could assist us with the task today.
TEXT_AKTKMJ103_04672_ALISAIE_000_014: Well, . It looks like you're with me, then.
TEXT_AKTKMJ103_04672_ALISAIE_000_015: Voidsent sightings have been increasing by the day, which is why I had a mind to go out and patrol the Eblan Rime. Shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMJ103_04672_ALISAIE_000_020: Voidsent were spotted here not long ago. Considering the proximity to Camp Broken Glass, everyone is understandably concerned.
TEXT_AKTKMJ103_04672_ALISAIE_000_021: But hopefully not for much longer. You follow this road eastward, and I'll have a look to the north. If you should encounter any voidsent, I won't begrudge you for dispatching them without me.
TEXT_AKTKMJ103_04672_SYSTEM_000_040: You survey your surroundings, but do not spy any errant voidsent...
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALISAIE_000_005: I've got a bad feeling about this.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Well? Shouldn't you see what's wrong?
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_JULLUS_000_015: He was out on patrol, so if he's come back early, then...
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_GARLEANSOLDIER10320: Forgive me the interruption, but I come with grave news!
A horde of voidsent are approaching from the mountains to the east. Their numbers are beyond anything we've ever seen!
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALISAIE_000_022: What!? But Y'shtola and the others...
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Anyone outside of Tertium is in danger. We must find and bring them all here at once!
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALISAIE_000_024: Can we count on your aid, Zero?
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I've already settled the debt for my question. I'm not obligated to help.
What's more, death in this world is absolute. You ask me to put my life on the line.
Without suitable payment, I will do no such thing.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALISAIE_000_029: That's fair... What do we have to offer that might be enough?
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_JULLUS_000_030: You're right, Zero. You're not obligated to help, and I wouldn't presume otherwise.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_JULLUS_100_030: Nevertheless, we are in need. Assuming the buuz I gave you is worth anything, would you at least be willing to stand watch at this encampment?
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_JULLUS_110_030: That way, more of us will be able to go out and see the people to safety.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: ...Very well. Unless we come under attack, I'll do no more than stand watch.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALPHINAUD_000_035: I daresay Tertium will be safe enough with Zero here.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Let us go and find Y'shtola and the others, and assist with the evacuation.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Do what you must. I will remain here.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_JULLUS_000_045: Please hurry. Time is of the essence.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_GARLEANSOLDIER10320: Never have I seen so many voidsent... We've got to round up as many hands as we can to assist with the evacuation effort.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALISAIE_000_055: Come, we need to find our comrades.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Tertium will be fine. Jullus and his people have weathered far worse.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALPHINAUD_000_061: We must make haste to the snowcraft, where our friends and the engineer should be.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Given their position, they may soon find themselves at the mercy of the voidsent. If it comes to it, we must be prepared for battle.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_SYSTEM_000_065:
Upon departing from Tertium, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_SYSTEM_000_066: In addition, you will be required to participate in battle. Your progress will be saved at certain points. In the event that you are defeated, you will be able to try again from the most recent of these.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_SYSTEM_000_067: Please note that if you enter battles associated with other quests or log out from the game, this progress will be lost.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_SYSTEM_000_069: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 90 or above to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALPHINAUD_000_070: For a mercy, there appears to have been no casualties in Tertium or elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_JULLUS_000_075: I've also received word that the transport arrived safely at Camp Broken Glass. They send their thanks to the “woman in black.”
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALISAIE_000_091: Zero's convalescing aboard the train. Jullus has already given her something to eat, so I suppose all we can do is wait.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALISAIE_000_092: I can't help but wonder, though... What possessed her to go and fight all those voidsent on her own? Not that I know the going rate for such things, but I doubt one buuz would suffice. I think someone has been a bad influence on her.
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALISAIE_000_093: Oh, I'm just joking. Or am I?
TEXT_AKTKMJ104_04673_ALISAIE_000_094: In any case, many people owe her their lives. I'll be sure to thank her when she's back on her feet.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALISAIE_000_000: Thank goodness we found Zero when we did.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_JULLUS_000_005: I've also received word that the transport arrived safely at Camp Broken Glass. They send their thanks to the “woman in black.”
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALPHINAUD_000_020: As Alisaie said, many people owe Zero their lives.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALPHINAUD_000_021: This is not her world, nor her battle to fight, yet she risked life and limb for us nonetheless. That will not be soon forgotten.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Now then, I expect that our friends will return soon. Once everyone has gathered, we can take stock of the situation.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALPHINAUD_000_030: We've naught to do but wait for the others. They should not be much longer.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALISAIE_000_035: Perhaps you should have a rest too.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Apologies for the delay. I've finished replenishing my aether.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Full glad am I to hear it. We must thank you again, Zero.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALISAIE_000_042: Indeed, many are still alive because of you. Those soldiers not least of all.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: ...How fared you? Better than I did, by all accounts.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALISAIE_000_044: We had to contend with our fair share of voidsent en route to the snowcraft, but we had the benefit of numbers.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ESTINIEN_000_045: With their help, we quickly dispatched all the voidsent that came our way. Thankfully, they stay dead in our world.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ESTINIEN_000_046: We were trying to decide what to do next when we received word about the transport.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALPHINAUD_000_048: Which is how Alisaie, , and I came to find you.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_049: While the immediate threat has been addressed, we cannot rest easy yet. For voidsent to appear in such numbers, we must assume that a voidgate has indeed been opened nearby.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_JULLUS_000_051: Meaning more of them can come through at their leisure.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_JULLUS_000_052: It seems the best course of action is to investigate Lapis Manalis, as you intend. What is the state of the snowcraft?
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_053: Nearly operational, I believe. Vrtra is with the engineer, who is hard at work as we speak. Why don't we join them in Cerulea Ingens?
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALISAIE_000_054: Finally, a chance to go on the offensive!
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALISAIE_000_056: I wouldn't dream of refusing you. But...what did you have in mind for payment?
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I will do this because...I want to.
You have...kindled something within me. A compulsion─a desire to act─that has been burning since you came to my aid out in the snow.
I do not understand it, but I wish to, and to that end I will heed it. Then perhaps I'll understand your answer.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALPHINAUD_000_062: I would also like to join you in tracing the voidsent to their origin. Though that would mean neglecting my duties here...
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_JULLUS_100_062: Don't worry about us. Between my people and the contingent, we can keep things running well enough. Just find where the voidsent are coming from, and see that they stop.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALPHINAUD_000_070: For the sake of our friends, I pray we succeed in our mission.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALPHINAUD_000_075: The voidgate is of course our main objective, but if we can also find useful salvage, then all the better.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALISAIE_000_080: I'm glad the engineer is safe. I'd never forgive myself if something had happened to him on our account.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ESTINIEN_000_085: Vrtra insisted on staying behind to guard the snowcraft. He's anxious to get up that mountain, and understandably so.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_090: “Mammoth” is an apt name for the craft. Its prodigious size made defending it difficult, but it came through unscathed.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: To have to go to such lengths to traverse a single mountain... The people of this land do not have easy lives.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_VARSHAHNBIG_000_100: 'Tis good to see you all safe and well. The craft stands ready, I am pleased to say. Our engineer friend has worked tirelessly, his zeal a match for any of my alchemists.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ENGINEER04671_000_1: There you are! Your timing couldn't be better.
Thanks to Varshahn's help, I've managed to finish the repairs faster than I anticipated. The mammoth's ready for the snow once more!
You can leave the piloting to me, too. It'd be my pleasure to get you to where you need to go!
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALISAIE_000_113: You are too kind. Thank you.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALISAIE_000_114: Let's be on our way then, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Lapis Manalis.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALPHINAUD_000_120: As we hopefully demonstrated, we're still capable of holding our own in battle. Which is to say, please don't hesitate to rely on us.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ALISAIE_000_125: When we find whoever's responsible for unleashing the voidsent, I'm going to give them a piece of my mind!
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ESTINIEN_000_130: I don't make a habit of fighting atop magitek, but it shouldn't be any more difficult than doing so astride a dragon. I welcome the change of pace.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_135: Once aboard the mammoth, we will all need to change into attire more suitable for combat.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_0140: It can be no coincidence that a voidgate has opened where Vrtra sensed his sister. In all likelihood, something is in the offing, and we must be prepared.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: If there is indeed a voidgate, then there will be voidsent, and not merely lesser ones.
Be on your guard for all manner of threats.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_VARSHAHNBIG_000_150: Come, . Let us find the truth of my sister's aura!
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ENGINEER04671_000_1: Just say the word and we're off.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ESTINIEN_000_175: That they should go so far as to use Azdaja's eye as bait... What could they be after?
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Why does he look so defeated? We are closer to finding his sister, are we not?
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_190: So, we have discovered the source of the voidsent outbreak in Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ESTINIEN_000_191: A gate forced open from the void...
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_192: The barrier between our worlds is especially thin here, I suspect.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_193: Elsewise I see little reason why the reapers chose to live in such an inhospitable place.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ESTINIEN_000_195: Even if the conditions are ideal, we're talking about a gate that could pass an archfiend. Opening one so large could not have been easy.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_196: In the age of Allag, Emperor Xande created an enormous portal using a prodigious amount of aether harnessed by the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_197: In theory, a similar feat should be possible from within the void. One need but have the requisite amount of aether...such as that harbored by a great wyrm's eye.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_VARSHAHNBIG_000_198: And its aether is indeed greatly diminished...
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_ESTINIEN_000_199: In 's vision, Golbez let his archfiends feed upon Azdaja's aether. If he has also taken an eye to open this gate...
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_201: It does not bode well, I know. Nevertheless, we must remain hopeful and continue our search.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_202: What I find curious is why our foes chose to strike now, some five thousand years after Azdaja vanished into the void.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_YSHTOLA_000_203: And while their overarching plan remains a mystery, what exactly was Cagnazzo's part in it that he had finished?
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_SYSTEM_000_210: You may now enter Lapis Manalis with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKMJ105_04674_SYSTEM_000_211: Moreover, be advised that you may use mounts within Lapis Manalis, but only during this quest.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_YSHTOLA_000_000: If Cagnazzo's intent was for his parting words to give us pause, then he has succeeded.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_YSHTOLA_000_001: To embrace death, to find satisfaction in oblivion... Perhaps it is indeed true that many voidsent yearn to return to the Lifestream.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Why does he look so defeated? We are closer to finding his sister, are we not?
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ESTINIEN_000_010: The eye explains how they managed to cross over, but we still don't know why they chose this time and this place for an incursion.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ENGINEER04671_000_0: Looking to head back to Lapis Manalis? Just say the word.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_VARSHAHNBIG_000_020: Oh, Azdaja... What has become of you, that even your eye should be so spent of aether...
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_VARSHAHNBIG_000_021: I cannot bear the thought of her being held captive a moment longer, but how will I find her? What must I do?
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ESTINIEN_000_023: I appreciate that you are upset, but such passion clouds your judgment. You must endeavor to remain composed.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ESTINIEN_000_024: When your mind is clear, we may consider how to proceed with our search.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ESTINIEN_000_026: In the meantime, I will help Alphinaud and Alisaie back at the village.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_YSHTOLA_000_027: That sounds like a fine idea. We should go as well.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ESTINIEN_000_035: Leave Vrtra be. He needs time alone with his thoughts.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_YSHTOLA_000_040: Let us take comfort in the knowledge that the voidgate is closed, and that the people of Garlemald need fear the voidsent hordes no longer.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: We're to help Alphinaud and Alisaie, are we? There's little else of interest here, so I wouldn't be opposed to the diversion.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_VARSHAHNBIG_000_050: Pray give me a moment longer.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALPHINAUD_000_060: I don't see Vrtra with you. Is everything all right?
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ESTINIEN_000_061: He needs a moment to himself. While he is indisposed, we thought we'd lend you a hand.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALISAIE_000_062: I've just finished patrolling the area, so we're fine on that front.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALISAIE_100_062: There are no signs of voidsent, and I doubt we'll see any more now that the gate has been closed.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALISAIE_000_063: As for Alphinaud, he's set his sights on the ceruleum spring. We're hoping to take as much of the stuff as the snowcraft can bear.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALISAIE_000_064: That much fuel would keep the people warm for a good while.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALPHINAUD_000_0065: We've managed to procure a few suitable containers for transporting the ceruleum, and were about to return to the spring.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ESTINIEN_000_066: If you've a mind to scrounge up more containers, I can take what you have now and get them filled.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALPHINAUD_000_067: Thank you, Estinien. The more we can load into the snowcraft, the better.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALISAIE_000_068: Would you and Y'shtola mind helping us with our search, then?
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALISAIE_000_069: You'll need to take any suitable containers to the spring, and then back to the snowcraft once you've filled them with ceruleum.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALISAIE_000_075: Hmmm, will this be solid enough?
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_YSHTOLA_000_080: It is a welcome change to have Zero helping of her own volition. Perhaps she is finally beginning to trust us.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_SYSTEM_000_090: This is less a container and more a sieve, given its poor condition and visible holes...
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_SYSTEM_000_091: The container appears to be well suited for repurposing. It would be a fine choice for ceruleum storage.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: We just need to carry this liquid fire to the snowcraft? Sounds simple enough.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_SYSTEM_000_105: The container is now filled to the brim with ceruleum.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: If that one has been filled, you should hurry and take it to the snowcraft.
Estinien has already seen to the rest.
Go on ahead. The others asked that I remain here in the event they find more.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ESTINIEN_000_110: Good work, my friend. I expect we'll have a sizable load to deliver.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_SYSTEM_000_120: The snowcraft is all but overflowing with ceruleum containers. However, several of your comrades have yet to arrive. Perhaps a nearby vantage point will afford you a more favorable view of their return.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALISAIE_000_130: It was good seeing you again. I hope you'll remember to call on us sooner the next time you need help.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ESTINIEN_000_135: Vrtra has quelled the tempest within his heart. He should be fine.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_YSHTOLA_000_140: That Azdaja's eye hasn't succumbed to Darkness bespeaks her incredible resilience.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_YSHTOLA_000_141: So let us trust in this sign that she yet lives, and be not deterred in our efforts.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I'm not your keeper, nor do I know what you expect of me. But I will keep my word.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_VARSHAHNBIG_000_155: I must apologize for my bout of melancholy. To be so easily shaken ill becomes a great wyrm.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_VARSHAHNBIG_000_156: You have remained at my side and ever offered me support and encouragement. I haven't the words to thank you.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALPHINAUD_000_160: I suppose this is where we part ways for now.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALPHINAUD_000_161: Though we have every faith in you, we will pray for your safety all the same.
TEXT_AKTKMJ106_04675_ALISAIE_000_162: I'm glad we had the chance to talk, Zero. Take care, and till next time!
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_ESTINIEN_000_000: Vrtra has quelled the tempest within his heart. He should be fine.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_YSHTOLA_000_005: That Azdaja's eye hasn't succumbed to Darkness bespeaks her incredible resilience.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_YSHTOLA_000_006: So let us trust in this sign that she yet lives, and be not deterred in our efforts.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_VARSHAHNBIG_000_010: I must apologize for my bout of melancholy. To be so easily shaken ill becomes a great wyrm.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_VARSHAHNBIG_000_011: You have remained at my side and ever offered me support and encouragement. I haven't the words to thank you.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Am I right in assuming that we are to return to the void?
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_VARSHAHNBIG_000_022: Now that matters here have been settled, yes. But first, we should return to Radz-at-Han to prepare. When everyone is ready, let us convene at Meghaduta.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: We know the fiend was headed north...
But that still leaves a lot of ground for us few to cover.
We need a way to conduct our search more efficiently. Do you have any ideas?
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_A1_000_001: I know people who may have seen something.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_A1_000_002: We split up and make inquiries.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: In other words, we seek help from the locals? If you think it best, then very well.
In other words, we seek help from the locals? If you think it best, then very well.
The Great Work and the encampment at the Hamsa Hatchery? If both places are to the north, then the people there may indeed have seen something.
Very well, I will head to the Great Work, and leave the encampment to you.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_NAHBDEEN_000_038: Ah, . Is this about the happenings at the Bhaflau remnants?
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_IMHUDI_000_040: Saw the light over at the Bhaflau remnants too, did you? We've sent scouts to investigate, but they've yet to report back.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_IMHUDI_000_041: We will continue to keep watch here, but if you learn anything, be sure to let us know.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_KHUTEEYU_000_042: These fishermen saw a fiend emerge from the Bhaflau remnants before heading north, you say?
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_KHUTEEYU_000_043: I saw what I thought was a ball of flame flung from the explosion, but now I wonder...
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_KHUTEEYU_000_044: It flew north, in the direction of Khadga. If it is in fact a fiend, then we have trouble on our hands. We must remain vigilant.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_IMHUDI_000_050: Ever since that explosion, we've seen nothing else unusual come from the waters, but there's no telling what our scouts may report.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_KHUTEEYU_000_055: In case you're unfamiliar, Khadga is the massive rock formation that juts out over the water. That's where the ball of flame flew.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_NAHBDEEN_000_060: I presume you've come to investigate the explosion at the Bhaflau remnants as well.
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_NAHBDEEN_000_061: We've yet to ascertain precisely what happened. Is there any information you can share with us?
TEXT_AKTKMJ107_04676_NAHBDEEN_000_062: A fiend emerged from the explosion and flew towards Khadga!? By the Sisters! Had I learned of this sooner─never mind. There is no time to waste!
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_NAHBDEEN_000_010: Confound it. We were so concerned with the explosion that we failed to recognize that the threat had not yet passed!
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_NAHBDEEN_000_011: We must alert command at once and instruct the people to seek shelter.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_A1_000_001: Is there a way to the top of Khadga?
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_A1_000_003: I'll go and see if the fiend is indeed there.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_NAHBDEEN_000_014: What? You mean to go there to investigate!?
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_NAHBDEEN_000_016: But there is no telling what manner of enemy this may be!
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_NAHBDEEN_100_016: Then again...you are more than capable of defending yourself... As you wish. We will leave this in your hands.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_NAHBDEEN_000_017: The Giantsgall Grounds are situated at the base of Khadga. I myself am not familiar with the mountain paths, but the quarry workers are bound to know many.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_NAHBDEEN_000_019: Qetanur, for instance─he has worked there the longest. Go well, my friend, and may the Sisters keep you.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_NAHBDEEN_000_030: If someone can tell you how to scale Khadga, it will be Qetanur. Seek him out at the Giantsgall Grounds.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_QETANUR_000_040: You want to climb Khadga!? You couldn't have chosen a worse time...
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_QETANUR_000_041: There was an earthquake earlier, and it triggered a rockslide. I'm afraid the main path to the summit may be blocked.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_QETANUR_000_042: But if you're determined to go, then I suggest you speak with Sramul. He climbs like a langur, and might know some other way up, if not the gentlest.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_QETANUR_000_050: If you commit to climbing Khadga, take care not to slip. Most routes were treacherous before, and I don't dare to imagine how they are now.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_NAHBDEEN_000_055: I thank you for your offer of help. I pray the Sisters speed your way to the summit─and keep you safe from whatever you find there.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_SRAMUL_000_060: How to reach the top of Khadga!? After what has happened, that should be the last place anyone sane would want to be...
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_SRAMUL_000_061: But yes, I am familiar with another route that should still be passable. I was once afraid of heights, you see, and used it to build up my courage.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_SRAMUL_000_062: Though I cannot say I have the courage to brave it under these conditions! I'll take you to where the route starts, but no further, all right?
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_SRAMUL_000_070: I can show you where my route to the top of Khadga begins, but you'll have to head up there on your own. Some may call me a coward, but they will not call me a fool.
TEXT_AKTKMJ108_04677_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: My inquiries delayed me. I'm not accustomed to conversation.
But I'm glad I arrived in time to speak with Rubicante...
As much as I understand his motives, I believe there's a better way─yours.
The future you strive for is one I wish to see.
And I want to know why I feel this way. Why this fire burns in my breast.
TEXT_AKTKMJ109_04678_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: There's nothing more for us here. What of Alzadaal's Legacy? Has there been word from Y'shtola and the others?
I see... Frustrating, perhaps, but better that the gate be destroyed than used to unleash more voidsent.
We should return to Meghaduta and rejoin the others.
It seems the others are already inside. Let's join them.
TEXT_AKTKMJ109_04678_OFFICIAL04535_000_0: It is good to see you both returned hale and whole.
TEXT_AKTKMJ109_04678_OFFICIAL04535_100_0: Your friends arrived not long ago, and are already with the satrap. Shall I show you in?
TEXT_AKTKMJ109_04678_VARSHAHN_000_030: Before you leave, I would once more express my gratitude.
TEXT_AKTKMJ109_04678_VARSHAHN_100_030: By your hand has Thavnair been saved yet again.
TEXT_AKTKMJ109_04678_VARSHAHN_000_031: But before you delivered my people, you helped me rediscover hope. When the sight of my sister's eye left me bereft and adrift for a time.
TEXT_AKTKMJ109_04678_VARSHAHN_000_032: We may have lost the gate in Alzadaal's Legacy, but there must be another way to travel to the void. And together, we will find it.
TEXT_AKTKMJ109_04678_VARSHAHN_000_033: For now, I bid you rest and recover your strength. I, too, shall have my vessel improved ahead of our next foray.
TEXT_AKTKMJ109_04678_VARSHAHN_000_034: To achieve his ends, Golbez has sacrificed his four generals. Such a ruthless foe is unpredictable in the extreme. But no matter what he plots, we shall do our utmost to see that he does not succeed.
TEXT_AKTKMJ109_04678_SYSTEM_000_040: Meanwhile, on the moon in the Thirteenth...
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_000: , 'tis good to see you. Have you any news from Old Sharlayan?
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_001: We've yet to hear from Y'shtola regarding her search for a means to return to the void. I must confess that her silence has left me feeling...restless.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_002: Nor am I alone in this─Estinien has such an excess of energy that he has been helping to train our soldiers with nary a grumble.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_006: No, no.  paid us a visit, and so I was apprising  of recent developments─or the lack thereof.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_009: A rare but most welcome invitation! Timely too, I might add.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_010: I myself was thinking of venturing out into the city. It would be my pleasure to join you.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_011: You will accompany us, of course?
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Come, then. I've an errand to run at the bazaar first.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_020: If you would gauge the city's prosperity, there is no surer way than to visit the bazaar and observe the people. This I learned from Ahewann and his predecessors.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SPICEMERCHANT04735_: You're with Mistress Zero? How rare to see her with others!
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I'm picking up some more spice. Mehryde told me to do so before my next visit.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SPICEMERCHANT04735_: Mistress Zero has quite the tolerance, you see. The Sisters know we Hannish are fond of spicy food, but I doubt any of us could keep up with her.
With just the spices they normally have on hand, the meyhane can't quite satisfy her. Which is why I'm happy to provide what they need to achieve more rigorous flavors!
Now then, variety being the spice of life, perhaps you'd like to choose something extra to blend with Mistress Zero's usual?
It'll help to keep things interesting! What do you say?
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Fine by me. You can appreciate the nuances of this world's sustenance far better than I can, I expect.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_040: What impressive samples. You'll not find a larger or finer selection in all the world.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: So long as it's stimulating, I care not what you choose.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SPICEMERCHANT04735_: You're welcome to sample the spices, but bear in mind that what I recommend to Mistress Zero is potent!
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_060: A colorful array of spices peer out from hempen sacks.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_061: Bright red in color, this powder is hot just to look at. It will likely induce a healthy sweat when consumed.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_062: These corns tickle your nose with their pungent-yet-enticing aroma. One can imagine them lending dishes an appetizing accent.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_063: These tiny husks give off a citrus-like scent. Perhaps they will imbue dishes with a zesty note.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_064: These flakes appear to have been grated from a thick root. Their sharp aroma suggests a bracing flavor.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SPICEMERCHANT04735_: Ah, that's a fine choice. But don't take my word for it─here, have a taste!
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_068: Zero may wish to observe your reaction. It would be considerate to sample the spice in her presence.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_070: I doubt you need to be told this, but have care not to take too much at once...
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SPICEMERCHANT04735_: Go on, then! Have a taste and see what you think.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_090: Zero may wish to observe your reaction. It would be considerate to sample the spice in her presence.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_091: You tentatively place some of the spice on your tongue...
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_092: A veritable blaze engulfs your mouth!
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_093: An intense and aromatic heat fills your nostrils!
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_094: A tingling, tangy numbness grips your mouth!
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_095: A jolt of fire courses through your entire body!
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SPICEMERCHANT04735_: Always a pleasure, Mistress Zero! And do give Mehryde my regards.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_100: I am pleased to see that Zero has become a regular here, and so much so as to bring her own spice.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_SYSTEM_000_115: The spicy curry has left you slightly flushed and set your heart racing. Whatever challenges await, you are ready to face them head-on─and with feeling!
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_VARSHAHN_000_120: I did not expect so many to take up the challenge, but I am glad to see everyone enjoying themselves.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_MEHRYDE_000_130: Well, that proved to be an exciting event! I daresay word of Zero's singular curry will draw more diners to our establishment.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_MIHLEEL_000_135: What a remarkable curry! I must try a bowl myself─when I can muster the courage, that is!
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_RHULMEIRA_000_140: Quite an adventurous crowd we had today. A few drinks will do that to you. For better or worse...
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_ARDARACA_000_145: A traveler, are you? Well, I'm no layabout. I'm simply recovering from that fiery devastation, you understand.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_DARFIYE_000_150: Drink, dance, and damned good curry! It couldn't possibly get better than this in Radz-at-Han!
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_HANNISHMAN04735B_00: By the Sisters, I thought that curry would be the end of me. I...I must eat it again.
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_HANNISHMAN04735A_00: My poor nose... It still tingles...
TEXT_AKTKMK101_04735_EGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_00: Master Estinien? Yes, he has returned to his chambers. I shall be happy to escort you.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHN_000_000: I cannot thank you enough for your constant support.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: You have no shortage of allies at your disposal.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_EGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_00: Shall I escort you to Master Estinien's chambers?
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_010: If one and all are ready, then let us set forth, our preparations to complete.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHN_000_011: If I may, I beg a moment to exchange this vessel for its grown counterpart. It is in the keeping of alchemists of the High Crucible.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_012: Of course. We shall accompany thee thither, and thence begin our journey.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Opening a gate is about as difficult as I expected.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_031: My, that is a striking simulacrum indeed. Well suited to the work ahead, I doubt not.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_032: Allow me to explain Y'shtola's plan in greater detail.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_033: As you know, we seek to open a voidgate in Mare Lamentorum, that we might gain direct passage to the moon of the Thirteenth.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_034: Whilst our comrades labor upon the moon, we must needs accomplish two tasks.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_035: The first is the procurement of a substantial quantity of aether, and subsequent delivery of it unto the Tower of Babil.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_036: Said structure was once used to siphon the land's essence by way of the Telophoroi's spires.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_100_036: Such a method, however, doth pose an unacceptable risk to the greater aetherial balance of our world. Thus must we seek an alternate means of conveying our requisite resource.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_037: Our second task doth pertain to the use of the Tower of Babil itself.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_100_037: You may recall that this portal unto the moon was placed under the supervision of the Ilsabard contingent.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_038: If we would employ it to different ends, we must first obtain the contingent's express permission.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHNBIG_000_039: I should like to believe they would not refuse us, so perhaps we should concern ourselves with the aether problem first. Have you any idea whence we might source the vast quantity needed?
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_040: Aye, a likely location doth come to mind. Let us make for the airship landing─there, I shall reveal more.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHNBIG_000_050: I am most keen to know more of Urianger's potential solution. In the worst case, I was prepared to offer one of my eyes, but it seems it will not come to that.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I sometimes come here for the view. It's...beautiful.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_060: All are present and accounted for? Excellent. We shall travel to Sharlayan, and thence seek the nearby Isle of Haam.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_062: Near unto the surface of this isle do rivers of aether converge. The churning energy of this confluence is released by the way of geysers.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_063: Originally, the Ragnarok was to be powered by aether harvested from the isle...
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_064: But as well you know, an alternate power source was ultimately found for the vessel.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_100_064: Passage unto Ultima Thule─to the very limits of existence─was facilitated by naught less than the strength of the Mothercrystal Herself.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_065: As such, the Isle of Haam's vast aether deposits remain untouched. We may help ourselves to that energy─provided we are able to secure the Forum's permission.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: Yet again with needing permission. Is nothing straightforward in this world?
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_066: Such is the nature of politics, I fear. And as the Scions of the Seventh Dawn have been “officially” disbanded, no longer are we a recognized collective. A somewhat disadvantaged position, bureaucratically speaking.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_067: Fortunately, however, there is a recognized and respected body upon which we might prevail: the Students of Baldesion. Upon arriving in Sharlayan, let us seek our friends at the annex.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_070: While Mistress Krile hath burdens enough of her own, we may be confident she will do her utmost to assist us.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHNBIG_000_007: When last I came here, it was to deliver my sire's scales. How long ago it seems now...
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: An island literally bursting with aether... That's the sort of paradise voidsent dream of.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_0: Welcome back, ! What brings you here today? And in such colorful company...
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_091: Greetings, Ojika. On this occasion, we are come to seek the Students' assistance in a matter of some urgency.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_0: In that case, you'll want to speak with Krile. She's in the main hall, sorting through our archives.
There's a visitor with her at the moment, but it's no one you don't know, so feel free to show yourself in!
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_100: I believe we have found our researcher.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHNBIG_000_105: Though it is not the first time I have seen it, I remain in awe of this sky's magnificence. Never did it occur to me that such an expansive facsimile was within men's power to create.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: The first person Urianger asked about our target immediately told us where to go. Is there a place where you do not have allies?
Worry not, I shall pen our petition at once and submit it to the Forum!
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MARGRAT_000_121: Visitors? How delightful! If you require assistance, then ask away! It so happens you've caught me in postdeadline bliss.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_122: Forgive us the abruptness of our inquiry, but 'tis our understanding that thou had charge of the Ragnarok's propulsion systems.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_100_122: We should like to know how aether harvested on the Isle of Haam was to be stored and transported to the ark. If the disclosure of such information is permitted.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MARGRAT_000_123: Oh, it's no bother at all. We built special tanks that can store aether just like we use casks to store wine. Simple, really!
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MARGRAT_000_124: Simple, but quite brilliant in construction. They rivaled even crystals for aetherial capacity. A pity we never got to use them.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MARGRAT_000_125: Aaah, how muddled and distant the memory. When doom's deadline loomed large, and we extricated ourselves from a waist-high mire of work only to end up chin-deep in another...
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MARGRAT_100_125: I was at one with the world, a conduit for the energies of creation, but now─now I am truly alive! Who would have thought that sleeping in a bed and eating warm meals could make such a difference!
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MARGRAT_000_126: Why, I feel positively functional! I daresay it rivals the thrill of dancing on the knife-edge of failure! Ahahahahaha!
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHNBIG_100_126: ...We are glad for you. Quite. On the subject of the aether tanks, do you know what became of them?
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MARGRAT_000_127: Er... What did become of them? For the life of me, I can't seem to remember...
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MARGRAT_000_128: Oh, but I do remember someone who might remember! He should be back by now. Just look for the fellow wearing an outfit that screams, “I've been on vacation and you haven't!”
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_129: Very well, we shall seek out this conspicuous colleague of thine. Our sincerest gratitude, Margrat, and do look after thyself.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_130: Come, let us seek out this individual attired in a manner suggestive of recent furlough.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MARGRAT_000_140: Aaah, life outside of work─what a concept! Ahahahahaha!
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_145: ...All is well, and I pray 'tis the same with thee and thine. Now, dost thou perchance know of one recently returned from a vacation?
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHNBIG_000_150: If we can avail ourselves of these tanks, we shall be well on our way to securing the aether we require.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I do not know what a “vacation” is...but that man strikes me as more relaxed than most.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_1: The face that launched our teeny-tiny toy boat! How've you been, ? Able to catch a bit of rest?
Well, if I don't know about the aether tanks, who in Byregot's name would? Born right in me very own workshop, they were.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_162: A pleasure as always, Master Kokkol. I trust thy respite proved rejuvenating?
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_KOKKOLDANKKOL_100_1: And then some! But I won't bore you with the details─at least not without a drink in me. So! Why the interest in our little ol' tanks?
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_1: I see, I see... Think I've got the long and short of it.
It goes without sayin', but we all owe you more than we can ever repay. If you need our aether tanks, then they're at your disposal.

There's just one problem: you need the Forum's approval to set foot on the Isle of Haam. Were it up to me, you'd be on the next ship out, but that lot can't wipe their arses unless it's in accordance with procedural motions.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_FOURCHENAULT_000_16: You may be assured that my backside is immaculate.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_1: Thaliak's thumpin' thighs─er, Master Fourchenault! A-And Scholarch Montichaigne! What a...what a surprise!
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_FOURCHENAULT_000_16: Pardon the intrusion. The Forum has deliberated your petition, and we decided to deliver our verdict directly.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_FOURCHENAULT_100_16: I would hope that the matter of Pandæmonium has not been overshadowed by other concerns...but that is a discussion for another time.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_FOURCHENAULT_000_16: You have been granted special dispensation to travel to the Isle of Haam for the purposes of aetheric extraction─on one condition.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_FOURCHENAULT_100_16: On account of its rich deposits of aether, the isle is home to throngs of vicious beasts. We ask that you cull any such creatures you encounter.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: ...That's all? Given the vast amount of aether we seek, I expected a far higher price.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MONTICHAIGNE_000_17: Oh, believe me─we do not underestimate the value of what you desire.
Nay, we simply owe the Students of Baldesion and their esteemed collaborators a debt of gratitude, and we felt that expediting your request was a suitable way to repay it.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_FOURCHENAULT_000_17: We have taken the liberty of arranging your passage to the Isle of Haam. Your vessel awaits in Scholar's Harbor.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_KOKKOLDANKKOL_000_1: Th-Then I'd better get those aether tanks loaded onto the airship! We'll be ready to take 'em where you need─assumin' it's safe!
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_KRILE_000_176: I shall head back to the annex, but should you need anything else, don't hesitate to call!
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_180: That Master Fourchenault and Scholarch Montichaigne should personally deliver these glad tidings... We must endeavor to repay their faith in us.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHNBIG_000_185: All proceeds apace thus far, and it is thanks to the enduring bonds you have forged.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: It seems this Forum is like Alisaie─they help others simply because they want to.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_A2_000_002: Form a party and enter the Aetherfont.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_200: Naught remaineth to bar us from the Isle of Haam. Let us set sail forthwith.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHNBIG_000_205: No matter what, we must return to the void. The acquisition of this aether is but the first step.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: He does not strike me as the mentoring sort...
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_THANCRED_000_215: Social struggles aside, Zero seems more than capable of handling herself. Still, I shall aid her in what capacity I can.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_HAAMBORTMAN_000_220: So you know, the isle's hemmed in by drift ice all year round. I'll bring you as close to the shore as possible, but you'll have to walk the rest of the way.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_VARSHAHNBIG_000_230: We are truly indebted to Kokkol. I must invite him to Radz-at-Han as a guest of honor.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: By simply staying close to you, will I really learn about trust?
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_THANCRED_000_240: Zero's straight as an arrow, isn't she? A refreshing contrast to our more circuitous company.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_250: To not only allow us use of the tanks, but to arrange their transportation to Garlemald besides... Blessed are we to count Kokkol among our allies.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_URIANGER_000_251: Unto thee we must also give thanks, Thancred, for coming to our aid on such short notice.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_THANCRED_000_252: Please, you know I'm always happy to help. Don't hesitate to call on me again.
TEXT_AKTKMK102_04736_SYSTEM_000_254: You may now enter the Aetherfont with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_VARSHAHNBIG_000_000: We are truly indebted to Kokkol. I must invite him to Radz-at-Han as a guest of honor.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: By simply staying close to you, will I really learn about trust?
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_URIANGER_000_010: With the tanks' transportation thus arranged, our first task is complete.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_URIANGER_000_011: We may now turn our attention to the second.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_URIANGER_000_012: To wit, obtaining the blessing of the Ilsabard contingent to use the Tower of Babil to channel energy unto the moon.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_URIANGER_000_013: Our destination is Camp Broken Glass, where we may present our petition to Commander Lucia.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_VARSHAHNBIG_000_020: Per Y'shtola's advice, I have changed into clothing more suited to these surrounds. The better to blend in. ...I hope this will suffice.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_URIANGER_000_035: Glad am I to hear that Garlemald's restoration proceedeth apace, and the people no longer want for warmth. Be that as it may, there is no substitute for appropriate garments in such frigid climes, as I can personally attest...
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MAXIMA_000_040: You are, as ever, welcome, . I do not believe I have met all your comrades...?
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_LUCIA_000_050: . Allow me to personally thank you for your assistance during the recent voidsent incursion. Your actions saved many.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_VARSHAHNBIG_000_052: Pray forgive us for not sending word in advance, Commander, but we seek your cooperation in a matter of great import...
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_LUCIA_000_053: Indeed... We appreciate you consulting with us instead of taking unilateral action.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_LUCIA_000_054: 'Tis no simple matter to activate the Tower of Babil, and I speak not only of the technological challenges.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_LUCIA_000_055: Personally, I think we must consider the emotional impact of such an action above all else.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MAXIMA_000_056: Pending a more official name, we refer to those who remain here as the Garlean community.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MAXIMA_000_057: Though we have yet to reestablish a governing body, we provisionally refer to those who remain here as the Garlean community.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MAXIMA_000_058: As you would expect, they are predominantly native Garleans─most of whom are uncomfortable with aetherial manipulation.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MAXIMA_000_059: To compound matters, the trauma inflicted by Anima is still fresh. If the tower were to suddenly light up again, it is like to cause distress and reopen old wounds.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Better that than facing a mass invasion by Golbez and his voidsent hordes, surely.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MAXIMA_000_061: Of course. We acknowledge the gravity of the situation, as well as the promised bloodshed should we fail to act.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MAXIMA_000_062: Yet, even were we to convey your warning to the public, many simply do not understand the workings of magic or the rift. They will struggle to comprehend why they must be forced to relive personal horrors for the sake of something they cannot imagine.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: What's there to imagine? Haven't these people seen voidsent with their own eyes?
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MAXIMA_000_063: ...Let us suppose you encounter someone who is freezing in this cold. A natural thing to do might be to make them a fire, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MAXIMA_000_064: But what if that person's sole experience with fire was being badly burned by it, and they harbored an acute fear?
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MAXIMA_100_064: Despite the benefits─nay, the necessity─of the warmth you offer, they may flee on instinct. Or worse, misinterpret your actions for aggression and lash out.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_VARSHAHNBIG_100_065: So like the fire that torments this individual, the Tower of Babil torments the people of Garlemald...
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_VARSHAHNBIG_000_066: ...Yet we cannot afford to falter here. We must find a way to help them overcome their fear.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_LUCIA_000_067: I agree. To that end, the contingent will assist however we can.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_VARSHAHNBIG_000_068: We should speak with Alphinaud and Alisaie. With the rapport they have established with the Garlean people, I daresay they can provide us with valuable insights.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_VARSHAHNBIG_000_069: In the meantime, Urianger, might I ask that you remain here to oversee the technical aspects of the tower's activation?
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_VARSHAHNBIG_000_080: I have taken the liberty of explaining our objective.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: To dread fire even when one is freezing. To become a prisoner of one's fear. 'Tis a fate to which voidsent too can succumb, aye...
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_URIANGER_000_090: Full faith have I that you will win over the Garlean populace. In the meantime, I shall see to it that all is in readiness with the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_ALISAIE_000_095: I knew you wouldn't be able to stay away!
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_ALPHINAUD_000_110: I am glad to see you, . Vrtra has explained our present dilemma.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_ALPHINAUD_000_111: 'Tis no unfounded concern that the Garleans might take poorly to the reactivation of the Tower of Babil.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_JULLUS_000_112: That's putting it mildly. Many would be up in arms over it.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_JULLUS_000_113: Trust in the Ilsabard contingent is fragile enough. We need to tread lightly, or we risk jeopardizing everything we've achieved.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_ALISAIE_000_115: Well, it seems to me there's naught for it but to speak with the people.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_ALISAIE_000_116: Rather than harping on about the necessity of the plan, we need to lend an ear to their concerns. Then, perhaps, we can begin working towards a compromise.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_JULLUS_000_118: In that case, I'll take you to meet the community leaders. They're at a station called Senatus, near the Senaculum Imperialis.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_VARSHAHNBIG_100_118: I would be honored to speak with them...though it would be prudent to learn where people elsewhere stand as well. But that I will leave to the others─save Zero. Might you accompany me?
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_ALISAIE_110_118: I'm sure those in Tapper's Den will have their own opinions. Alphinaud, if I may drag you along?
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_ALPHINAUD_000_119: Tertium, we leave to you. You are no stranger to the people here, so it should take little prodding to convince them to speak freely.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_JULLUS_000_122: Then it's settled. Once you've learned what you can, let's all meet in Forum Solius, where we'll have what I hope is a productive discussion.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_GARLEANPEOPLEA04737: But what's it got to do with voidsent? I can't say I understand...
Still, your people have done much and more for us Garleans. If you say it's necessary, then that's good enough for me.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_GARLEANPEOPLEB04737: The tower is evil! It'll turn us all evil! I don't wanna hear it! Leave me alone!
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_GARLEANPEOPLEC04737: Fie, fie... That tower isn't right, I tell you. All those magicks.
Years ago, when I lived in the provinces, the locals razed our village to the ground with the stuff. Made things appear and disappear and fly and burn. Can still see it when I close my eyes.
You've done us a good turn, dear, but let's not talk about that tower any longer. It's unnatural.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MALLIUS_000_134: Activate the Tower of Babil? Are you out of your mind!?
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MALLIUS_000_135: That abomination transformed my friends and family into monsters! I can't even bear to look at it whenever I step outside... If you want to do something for us, tear the bloody thing down!
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_POPPAEA_000_136: Whatever its present state, the imperial palace was once the pride of Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_POPPAEA_000_137: I mean no disrespect to you and yours, but...shouldn't the Garlean people be its caretakers instead of foreigners?
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_POPPAEA_000_138: Though if we dared speak thus to some of the contingent, they might make assumptions. Cut our rations, or worse... No, no─forget I said anything. Please...
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MALLIUS_000_160: Just when I thought I'd take a walk... No matter where I go, I'm in the shadow of that damned tower.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_POPPAEA_000_165: We only want to survive. To be given the chance to rebuild, that our people might stand on their own again one day...
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Jullus is on his way with the others.
I hope you found the people more receptive than we did...
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_JULLUS_000_172: ... May I present to you Lords Gnaeus and Mettius, magistrates of our political council.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_JULLUS_000_173: They have been spearheading the efforts to establish a new system of government here.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_JULLUS_000_174: When we raised the subject of the Tower of Babil, they insisted that we speak no further until joined by representatives of the Ilsabard contingent. I see Alphinaud and Alisaie have yet to arrive, though, so perhaps we should wait...
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_METTIUS_000_175: It doesn't matter if only some of you are present. We simply wish to make one thing perfectly clear.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_METTIUS_000_176: The tower is the manifestation of Garlean ingenuity and authority. It was once the abode of the imperial family, and it will forever bear tremendous cultural significance.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_METTIUS_000_177: It is insulting enough that we have had to suffer foreigners occupying it under the guise of rendering aid─and now you propose reactivating it!? Nay. We have had enough!
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_GNAEUS_000_178: The Garlemald of old may have fallen. But she fell in civil war, to her own people. Not to Eorzea nor any other land.
TEXT_AKTKMK103_04737_GNAEUS_000_179: We came here to assert our unequivocal claim to our territory. Garlemald─and all that lies within her bounds─is beholden to no one.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: There is no common ground to be found with these men. In spite of this, you would still engage with them?
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_002: I do not begrudge them their hostility─they merely seek to protect their homeland. That said, we must strive to reach an understanding with one another.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_URIANGER_000_004: Full faith have I that you will win over the Garlean populace. In the meantime, I shall see to it that all is in readiness with the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_METTIUS_000_007: Our sovereignty is of paramount importance. On this point, there can be no concessions.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_GNAEUS_000_009: We will treat with the Ilsabard contingent, if only to assert our rights. If your intentions are as benevolent as you claim, then you will agree to our demands.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_JULLUS_000_010: Since Their Excellencies are resolved to negotiate with the contingent, I will escort them to Tertium. I'll also instruct Alphinaud and Alisaie to meet us there.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_012: ...Lord Mettius, Lord Gnaeus. By your leave, my comrades and I would speak with the residents of Senatus.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_100_012: Though the Ilsabard contingent holds the Tower of Babil, it is I who wishes for it to be reactivated, and thus I think it meet that I be present for this discussion.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_110_012: Yet my understanding of your people's hardships─of their hopes and desires, of their dreams for the future─is sorely lacking. In my ignorance, I would struggle to contribute.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_013: Lest you worry, I will not plead our case to the community in your absence. I wish only to identify common ground, upon which we might build a relationship that sees us overcome our differences.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_GNAEUS_000_015: ...Very well. But know that the guards will not hesitate to escort you from the premises should they judge your actions to be inappropriate.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_JULLUS_000_016: If it's settled, then, you should all head to Senatus.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_JULLUS_000_017: I'll join you there after I see Their Excellencies safely to Tertium.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Their defenses bespeak a cautious mindset. More so than Tertium.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_PRIMUS_000_022: Jullus has told us all. You have Lord Gnaeus's permission to enter and speak with our residents, but not to petition them directly for support. Remember that.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_JULLUS_000_024: Formal talks will have to wait until all parties are present.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_METTIUS_000_026: Hmph. I have no interest in idle chatter.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_GNAEUS_000_028: We will do what we must to protect the interests of the Garlean people.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_030: Here it is─Senatus. A temporary refuge for political dignitaries, hence the tight security.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_100_030: I am given to understand that outsiders are not normally permitted so much as a glimpse inside. We should consider ourselves fortunate to be given this opportunity.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I hope it will be worth the trouble.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_032: As do I, Zero. As do I...
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: The basic design is reminiscent of Tertium, though somewhat...embellished.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_033: To begin, I propose we split up and ask the residents for their views on the Ilsabard contingent and the current state of affairs.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_034: We would also do well to learn more about this enclave itself. Should you observe anything of note, pray keep it in mind.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_100_034: It is through open hearts and open minds that I believe we may yet convince their leaders to work with us for the greater good.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_035: Please, I wish to hear your concerns regarding the tower.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: The furnishings are quite lavish. I am reminded of Troia...
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MARCUS_000_040: How do I feel about the contingent? Conflicted, to say the least.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MARCUS_000_041: I've been tasked with the distribution of supplies, and I know as well as any that we couldn't survive without outside aid.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MARCUS_100_041: Be that as it may, even though the Empire has collapsed, we have our pride. People don't want to be beholden to others forever. And there's no denying that it chafes to see our benefactors occupying the imperial palace...
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_PELAGIA_000_042: You want to know what I think? I'm a soldier. I try not to think about politics at all.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_PELAGIA_000_043: I'll say this much. Our leaders labor to preserve our culture, our way of life. What remains of it, at any rate. I trust them to do what's best for Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_SYSTEM_000_044: The stockpile of assorted supplies bears markings indicating they were provided by the Ilsabard contingent. The enclave is clearly reliant upon the Alliance for aid.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_SYSTEM_000_045: You recognize the large casks as the very same you and your comrades used to transport ceruleum from Lapis Manalis. Why they are in Senatus is unclear...
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MARCUS_000_048: While our present welfare is important, we must be willing to endure hardship if it helps us to secure our nation's future. Strong leaders like Lord Gnaeus understand this.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_PELAGIA_000_049: Keep your voice down. There are people resting inside.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_005: Finished touring the enclave, have you? What were you able to learn?
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_100_050: Much the same as me, then. They accept the contingent's help out of necessity, and harbor a measure of resentment.
