TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: They have only themselves to blame. If they don't like the bargain, they should reject it.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_SECUNDUS_000_053: (-???-)How many times must I tell you!? It's absolutely out of the question!
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_055: We were wondering the very same. We came running when we heard shouting.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_SECUNDUS_000_057: Oh, n-no, I was just trying to explain...
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_ILSABARDCONTINGENT0: Ah, mayhap you can clear this up. The contingent has made a reasonable request, but this man insists that it's impossible.
It concerns the magitek weapons which run rampant throughout Regio Urbanissima. Every time we deliver supplies here, we have to dispatch extra men to defend against potential attacks.
To address the issue once and for all, we've proposed the elimination of all machina that loiter near the supply route. But you heard him─they refuse to even consider it.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_SECUNDUS_000_061: The magistrates have already spoken on this matter! “Rampant” or no, those warmachina are Garlean assets. Furthermore, who is to say they are as dangerous as you attest?
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_SECUNDUS_000_062: It has been suggested that this could be a pretense to scavenge magitek materiel for your own ends. I know not if that is the case, but the fact remains, we cannot allow you to destroy them.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_JULLUS_000_063: More speculation by the magistrates, I presume. Ridiculous, but they have spoken, and unless we want to inflame tensions further, there's naught we can do...
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: How complicated relations become when not grounded in a clear and equitable arrangement...
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_066: Well do I understand the difficulty of your position. As a soldier, you must do your duty, and obey your superiors.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_067: I have an idea, but I must first speak with Commander Lucia. May I take charge of this matter?
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_069: Let us return to Camp Broken Glass, where we might discuss a solution I believe will satisfy all parties.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_LUCIA_000_0080: You are returned. With glad tidings, I hope.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_URIANGER_000_082: I have completed mine inspection of the tower. Thou shalt be pleased to hear that the transference of aether will pose no difficulty.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_JULLUS_000_084: What do you suppose he has in mind?
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_086: Leave this to me, my friend.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_ILSABARDCONTINGENT0: Er, who is this person again...?
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MAXIMA_000_101: Welcome back, all of you. I pray there have been positive developments in your efforts to appeal to the Garlean community.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_102: Mayhap not yet, but there is a method by which I believe all stand to gain.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_100_102: As satrap, I intend to propose a trade agreement between Radz-at-Han and the people of Garlemald.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_104: The people of this nation have lived through its collapse and more. Yet they have chosen to remain, for it is their home.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_105: That they have been able to survive thus far is thanks to the Ilsabard contingent. Or rather, in less flattering terms, they are entirely at your mercy.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_106: Despite your noble intentions, this one-sided relationship has fueled feelings of frustration and resentment. 'Tis no surprise then that some Garleans are loath to engage with foreigners, for fear of indebting themselves further, or surrendering more of their already limited autonomy.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_107: That is why I wish to present them with an equitable arrangement.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_108: One that would restore to them a sense of agency after having been forced to rely upon charity.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_JULLUS_000_109: Easier said than done. What exactly did you have in mind?
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_110: Long have Garlemald and Radz-at-Han abided by a treaty of noninterference. Freely have we traded with one another, and I wish but to continue in this tradition.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_111: We would provide your people with such supplies as you require, in return for which you would grant us leave to use the Tower of Babil, as well as share your magitek resources and expertise.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_112: As we become more reliant upon your technologies, we will of course require more ceruleum to fuel them. This you possess in abundance, and for it you will be duly compensated. Radz-at-Han's culture will be enriched by your magitek wonders, and our ever-increasing demand for your wares will see Garlemald grow wealthy and prosperous.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_113: Only when both sides keep the interests of the other in mind can an equitable relationship be forged. 'Tis a principle I once thought I understood, but have come to appreciate all the more in recent days─thanks to the sage counsel of a friend from beyond the rift.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MAXIMA_000_114: Your Excellency, thank you for your careful consideration of Garlemald's future. Though I cannot speak for every Garlean, I myself see no reason to object to your proposal.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MAXIMA_000_115: Indeed, if Radz-at-Han were to take the initiative, other nations may follow suit and seek to normalize trade relations with us.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_116: If you see the sense in my proposal, then I ask you to join me in the negotiations at Tertium. Your support may be instrumental in winning over Lords Gnaeus and Mettius.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_LUCIA_000_117: By all means, go with them. I have matters here well in hand.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_URIANGER_000_118: I have learned all that I may regarding the tower's operation, so I too shall hie me to Tertium.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_LUCIA_000_120: An equitable arrangement... The satrap has a pragmatic vision for the future.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_ILSABARDCONTINGENT0: If a trade agreement can be forged, I dare to hope it will thaw relations with the Garleans. Until then, I'll keep on trying to convince them of the need to decommission these dangerous weapons. Diplomatically, that is.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_GNAEUS_000_130: Can we finally begin the negotiations?
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_METTIUS_000_140: A crowd you may have brought, but numbers will not intimidate us. The Tower of Babil is ours by rights, and nothing you do will convince us otherwise!
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_141: Rest assured, it is not our intent to infringe upon the rights of the people of Garlemald. Let us instead discuss the future.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_VARSHAHNBIG_000_142: As the satrap of Radz-at-Han, I wish to establish a new trade agreement between our nations.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MAXIMA_000_143: The aid we presently receive will not last forever, my lords. Sooner or later, we must stand on our own two feet.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_MAXIMA_000_144: But to do so, we must secure a means to replenish our coffers, and the proposed agreement presents a rare opportunity.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_GNAEUS_000_145: Hmmm... 'Tis true we do not want for magitek and ceruleum, and foreign currency will be needed to procure such things as we lack...
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_GNAEUS_000_146: It would depend on the precise terms, but I can see the merits.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_METTIUS_000_147: What!? I can't believe what I'm hearing! You served the Emperor─were a proud patriot─yet now you entertain selling national resources like a common merchant!?
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_GNAEUS_000_148: Like you, I weep for what we have lost. But if we are to rebuild Garlemald, we must make use of what precious few assets remain to us.
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_METTIUS_000_149: Nonsense. Utter nonsense. You are a traitor, Gnaeus, and there will be a reckoning. Oh yes. When the people of Senatus learn of this, they will cry out for your blood!
TEXT_AKTKMK104_04738_JULLUS_000_150: Lord Mettius, wait! It isn't safe out there!
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I'm not surprised. Some people cannot be moved by mere words.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_VARSHAHNBIG_000_005: While I am thrilled Lord Gnaeus was willing to consider my proposal, I am worried about Lord Mettius...
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_URIANGER_000_010: To the best of my knowledge, Lord Mettius is a civil servant with no combat experience. Should he meet with misfortune, he may fare poorly.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_GNAEUS_000_020: An embarrassing display. A man of Mettius's station should have the capacity to keep his emotions in check.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_JULLUS_000_030: It's far too dangerous for a civilian to be outside alone! We must go after Lord Mettius!
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_VARSHAHNBIG_000_031: Let us leave matters here in Maxima's care while the rest of us join in the search.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_VARSHAHNBIG_000_032: If Lord Mettius is bound for Senatus, we may be able to catch up to him in Regio Urbanissima. I pray he has not come to any harm...
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_MAXIMA_000_040: Do not worry about us. Just see that Lord Mettius does not come to harm. Please.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_JULLUS_000_050: When I first met Zero, I wasn't sure what to make of her forthright-to-a-fault nature. But now I understand she is simply an honest soul to the core.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Thank you. I feel at last as though I've found the answers I sought, and I owe it all to you and Jullus.
Right, then. I expect the others have already arrived back at Tertium. We should join them.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_MAXIMA_000_101: Full glad am I to see everyone returned, and none the worse for wear.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_MAXIMA_000_102: Various representatives of the Garlean community are gathered here this very moment. I daresay this is a fine opportunity to announce the trade agreement.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_GNAEUS_000_103: You've read the memorandum─I trust you find the terms acceptable?
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_METTIUS_000_104: I do. And, Gnaeus... I pray you forgive my disgraceful conduct earlier. I am ashamed not only of my behavior, but of placing the burden of negotiations solely on your shoulders in my absence.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_ALISAIE_000_105: You should know that, when we brought up the subject of the tower's reactivation to the people at Tapper's Den, some reacted quite strongly.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_ALISAIE_000_106: Once we explained that it would be to prevent another voidsent invasion, however, they were more receptive. It's fair to say the recent episode is still fresh in their minds.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_JARECK_000_107: I tagged along to deliver a supply of ceruleum. Have to say, I didn't expect to see such a large crowd. Even the stuffy imperials who normally keep to themselves in Senatus are here.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_GNAEUS_000_108: Ahem. My friends and countrymen, lend me your ears!
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_GNAEUS_000_109: I am pleased to inform you all on this joyous occasion that we, the people of Garlemald, have entered into a trade agreement with Radz-at-Han!
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_GNAEUS_000_110: To inaugurate our accord, we intend to grant the individuals before you access to the Tower of Babil. In return, Radz-at-Han will provide us with supplies, which shall be equally distributed amongst the settlements of our nation.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_GNAEUS_000_111: Let me be clear on one point: this is not an act of charity, but trade. A bargain struck between equals, rooted in trust and respect. And it marks a significant step towards rebuilding our nation and regaining true independence.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_VARSHAHNBIG_000_112: Radz-at-Han holds Garlean technology and ingenuity in the highest esteem. It is my hope that, through this agreement, our peoples will enjoy a mutually beneficial relationship for years to come.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_METTIUS_000_113: Now then, we bid you gather round to hear the particulars, that you might convey them to those elsewhere.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_ALPHINAUD_000_114: So burdened by hardship and trauma were the people of Garlemald that they were unable to imagine a brighter future.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_ALPHINAUD_000_115: To be recognized as equals─as a nation with something of value to offer to others... That validation alone is enough to rekindle their hope.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_URIANGER_000_116: 'Tis by virtue of this partnership that we may access the Tower of Babil. A rather timely development given the aether tanks' impending arrival.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_ALPHINAUD_000_117: Once the tower's stores have been replenished, we need but await Y'shtola's signal to channel the energy to the moon, yes?
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_ALISAIE_000_118: Then you can leave that and anything else on this end to me and Alphinaud. No need to worry─devote all your energies to the mission in the void.
TEXT_AKTKMK105_04739_VARSHAHNBIG_000_119: As ever, I am in your debt.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I'm not wrong to call them that, am I? Friends.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_VARSHAHNBIG_000_005: Garlean technology shall enrich my people's lives and empower them to achieve great new feats. I am particularly eager to see what our alchemists are inspired to create.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_JULLUS_000_010: Moments like these give me hope that we still have a place in this world...
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Both Radz-at-Han and Garlemald stand to benefit greatly from this agreement. It may well mark the beginning of a long and fruitful relationship.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_ALISAIE_000_020: "Good friends,“ eh? And coming from her, you know she's not just saying it to be nice.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: The moon... When Zenos brought me here, I remember feeling surprised that such a desolate place could exist in the Source.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_ALPHINAUD_000_040: The trade agreement discussions do not require our input, so Alisaie and I are free to attend to the Tower of Babil without distractions.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: This seal we mean to erect─I assume it won't hinder a half-voidsent like me from going in the other direction.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_URIANGER_000_055: Y'shtola hath done well indeed to devise a seal in so short a time. 'Tis a testament to her ingenuity in times of need.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_ESTINIEN_000_060: How did you fare with the preparations below?
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_NIDHANA_000_065: So this is one of the brands that once imprisoned Zodiark... Were I to describe it to my comrades back home, I doubt my words could do it justice.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: What aid I lend in restoring the brands is insignificant next to that which you and yours must accomplish.
When my part is complete, I shall stand apart and observe, as I have ever done. For it was to you that Venat has entrusted the future.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_YSHTOLA_000_070: Now then, to the matter at hand.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_YSHTOLA_000_071: With the watcher's assistance, we shall reforge each of Zodiark's brands, and use them to erect a barrier capable of repelling voidsent.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_YSHTOLA_000_072: Yet though we expect it to be effective against larger beings on account of its original purpose, there is a chance it will allow lesser voidsent to slip through.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_YSHTOLA_000_073: Therefore we shall require a second line of defense─and I believe the Loporrits' supporters would be suitable for this purpose.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_YSHTOLA_000_074: Urianger, ─the two of you have a strong rapport with our lunar allies. I would have you meet with Livingway in Bestways Burrow and provide any assistance they require.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I will join you. As a voidsent, my knowledge may be of use.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_YSHTOLA_000_076: An excellent idea. In the meantime, the rest of us will see to reforging the brands. I will send word when we have finished─pray do the same.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_URIANGER_000_085: Livingway, I trust thou hast been well?
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_YSHTOLA_000_087: First, we shall see to this brand.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_ESTINIEN_000_088: We have matters here well in hand. Go, meet with the Loporrits.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_NIDHANA_000_089: We will have the brands in working order before you know it!
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_LIVINGWAY_000_090: There you are! Y'shtola has apprised me of your present undertaking.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_LIVINGWAY_000_091: I understand that she wishes to deploy our pride and joy─the veritable carrots of our eye─our unrivaled combat supporters─as a precautionary measure in case this voidsent containment seal of hers proves lacking.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_LIVINGWAY_000_092: As we speak, my fellows are rounding up what units they can, and will bring them to the northeast corner in short order. Please wait there.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Despite their bestial appearance, these creatures are highly intelligent. And much like you and yours, they take pleasure in helping others...
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_JULLUS_000_105: Ever grateful am I for the Loporrits' irrepressible compulsion to help.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_SYSTEM_000_108: The Loporrits' eyes twinkle with anticipation as they await your buoyant extollation. To wit, they yearn for you to rally their spirits.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I wonder if these creatures also once existed on the void's moon... But even if they did, they must all be voidsent by now.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_JULLUS_000_115: Though I fear my laudations will leave them wanting, I shall do mine utmost to rally the Loporrits.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_LIVINGWAY_000_120: To be clear, we will always do everything within our power to aid the people of Etheirys. As I'm sure you'll agree, though, it doesn't hurt to have a little encouragement!
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_MAPPINGWAY_000_130: The repairs? Oh, they proceed apace, I assure you! But...they might go even more swiftly if you were to spur us on. Rally us, as it were... <wink> <wink>
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_SINGINGWAY_000_132: Oh, what could be more splendiferous than to repair our supporters under the loving gaze of people from Etheirys! Nothing, I tell you! Nothing! Save for one such individual to rally us while we go about it, but a humble Loporrit can only dream...
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_GROWINGWAY_000_133: N-Never fear, we shall ensure the supporters are ready for any voidsent brazen enough to slip through! And if they seem to struggle, we'll rally them! Or at least we would, if someone were kind enough to demonstrate...
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_SYSTEM_100_133: The Loporrits are doing their best to meet your expectations, and it is only fair that you return the favor. Shower them with all the encouragement you can muster and rally their spirits.
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_MAPPINGWAY_000_134: What a marvelous feeling! There's nothing like wild gesticulations of encouragement to fire you up!
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_SLEEPINGWAY_000_136: Oh, sorry, I was in the midst of... Forgive me. The sight of precision parts is strangely soothing and sleep...inducing... But...I'll try to...keep moving... <yawn>
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_SINGINGWAY_000_137:
Hum hum-hummm～♪
With you cheering me on, I can do naught less than my very best!
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_GROWINGWAY_000_138: Oooh, thank you very, very much! You don't know how uplifting it is to have you encouraging us! I mean, uh, showing us the proper technique so we may keep our supporters operating at peak efficiency!
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_MAPPINGWAY_000_140: Forget two─at this rate, we'll finish in a carrot and a half!
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_SINGINGWAY_000_150: Next to the maintenance of the atmospheric circulation system, making adjustments to these supporters is as easy as changing your socks!
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_GROWINGWAY_000_155: Overclocking to increase maximum output... For the sake of the people of Etheirys, we cannot settle for “good enough”!
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_LIVINGWAY_000_160: My, everyone is in high spirits indeed!
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_LIVINGWAY_000_161: Thanks to your encouragement, we'll have the supporters up and running again in no time at all!
TEXT_AKTKMK106_04740_LIVINGWAY_000_162: Pray attend to your remaining busywork, and leave the deployment of our new and improved voidsent slaughter-bots to us!
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_YSHTOLA_000_005: Ah, . We can begin as soon as the others arrive.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_ESTINIEN_000_010: Some manner of cactuar attempted to make mischief, but no one came to harm. How did you fare?
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_NIDHANA_000_015: With Estinien keeping us safe, we were able to finish repairing the brands without incident!
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_WATCHEROFMOON_000_0: What aid I lend in restoring the brands is insignificant next to that which you and yours must accomplish.
When my part is complete, I shall stand apart and observe, as I have ever done. For it was to you that Venat has entrusted the future.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_URIANGER_000_020: The brands are ready, I presume? Excellent. With the Loporrits having deployed their supporters, we are ready to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_URIANGER_000_021: Let us rejoin Y'shtola posthaste, and prise open our gate unto the void.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_URIANGER_000_035: I have duly informed Y'shtola of our task's completion.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_URIANGER_000_036: While you all tend to matters in the Thirteenth, I shall remain here and ensure the integrity of gate and seal both.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_YSHTOLA_000_040: My thanks for seeing to the supporters. With this, all is in readiness for the ritual.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_YSHTOLA_000_041: First, I shall give the order to Alphinaud and Alisaie in the Tower of Babil to channel aether to the moon.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_YSHTOLA_000_042: Once we have amassed a sufficient amount of energy, Urianger and I shall begin our incantations to open a voidgate.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_YSHTOLA_000_043: If all goes well, a tear will form in the fabric of reality, at which point you must activate the brands and put in place the containment seal.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_YSHTOLA_000_044: That is all. If there are no questions, then let us begin!
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_SYSTEM_000_051: Zero appears to be lost in thought, her gaze fixed upon the fathomless abyss...
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_ESTINIEN_000_055: My lance will be ready should any more of Golbez's pawns appear.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_YSHTOLA_000_060: No sign of a watcher or any Loporrits. Perhaps they were swallowed up in the Flood of Darkness...or perhaps they never existed here.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_SYSTEM_000_070: The surface of the moon is a grim shade of crimson. A consequence of the Flood of Darkness perhaps.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_SYSTEM_000_071: No matter how you strain your eyes, you spy no signs of life. In all directions extends a desolate waste without end.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_SYSTEM_000_072: You hold your breath in an attempt to catch the faintest noise. Save for the sounds of your comrades, there is nothing.
TEXT_AKTKMK107_04741_SYSTEM_000_073: So far, you have failed to find any clues as to Azdaja's whereabouts. Perhaps Zero has noticed something you missed...
TEXT_AKTKMK108_04742_YSHTOLA_000_000: A place Golbez visits without fail... If there were some distortion in the ambient aether, I would be able to find it with ease...
TEXT_AKTKMK108_04742_ESTINIEN_000_005: 'Tis a comfort to see that Azdaja's spirit remains unbroken. Let's find this mystery location Golbez so favors.
TEXT_AKTKMK108_04742_VRITRA_000_007: We must do no less than defeat Golbez in order to free my sister. Make sure thou art prepared for anything.
TEXT_AKTKMK108_04742_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: The others have already begun searching for clues. Let us do the same.
I'll take charge of this area. If you could see to the south.
Leave this area to me and see to the south.
TEXT_AKTKMK108_04742_YSHTOLA_000_022: I have only performed a cursory search, but I doubt there is anything of note further west. Perhaps you could try looking to the southeast.
TEXT_AKTKMK108_04742_ESTINIEN_000_024: Nothing here... Mayhap further south, then?
TEXT_AKTKMK108_04742_VRITRA_000_026: I could not discern a structure of any kind from above. Whatever this place or object might be, Golbez hath hidden it well.
TEXT_AKTKMK108_04742_SYSTEM_000_030: A glint from beneath the rock catches your eye.
TEXT_AKTKMK108_04742_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: ...We made it back safely, at least.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_YSHTOLA_000_009: In light of this development, that we escaped with our lives is an accomplishment unto itself.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_YSHTOLA_100_009: Would that we could have anticipated Azdaja's yearning to return home could be manipulated in this fashion. Alas, we must now contend with a newborn voidsent hells-bent on breaching the rift.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_11: And one with such prodigious strength. Zeromus is unlike anything I have ever seen.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_12: So named for an ancient hero, as Golbez said. Though none can say if there is even a sliver of truth to the legends.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_13: Perhaps Golbez chose it in the hopes that his champion will do that which no one could in the Contramemoria: save the world.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_14: But a true hero would not damn another world to save his own.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_ESTINIEN_150_009: And we're not about to let that happen, but regardless, we need to regroup.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_YSHTOLA_000_010: Aye. Loath though I am to admit it, we are in no state to face a voidsent of Zeromus's might.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_YSHTOLA_000_011: Vrtra not least of all, in body and mind both. For now, let us return to Radz-at-Han and take stock of the situation.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_YSHTOLA_000_012: ─might I trouble you to head to Bestways Burrow and apprise Urianger of the situation?
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_YSHTOLA_000_013: The rest of us shall tend Vrtra's wounds before returning to Radz-at-Han. Pray join us there anon.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_YSHTOLA_000_020: Dire though these circumstances may seem, Vrtra must keep the faith. For despite Golbez's claim, there is still a war to fight. A war we must win.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_ESTINIEN_000_025: Y'shtola expended a great deal of aether to open the voidgate, and Zero took a vicious blow from Zeromus.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_ESTINIEN_000_026: But worry not, I'm well enough to keep everyone safe. And when we've finished here, be sure to get some rest. You've earned it.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_URIANGER_000_030: Ah, , thou art returned. I am pleased to say it hath been blessedly uneventful in your absence, but more importantly─what of your mission in the void?
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_URIANGER_000_031: Heavens forfend... That Azdaja should be used to birth a dread voidsent born of Zodiark's residual aether...
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_URIANGER_000_032: Although we could not have predicted this outcome, there is one small mercy: the voidsent containment seal. As we employed the selfsame brands that once imprisoned Zodiark in its creation, the seal should serve to hinder Zeromus.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_URIANGER_100_032: Yet for how long, none can say, for our enemy's strength is unknowable, whilst the barrier was erected in haste.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_URIANGER_000_033: Thou shalt rejoin our comrades anon to deliberate measures, yes? Then I shall remain here to maintain my vigil over the seal.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_URIANGER_000_034: Should we observe signs of an impending incursion, rest assured I shall send word without delay. Go well, my friend.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_URIANGER_000_040: Concern thyself not with matters here. Pray return to Radz-at-Han, where thou art needed.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_OFFICIAL04535_000_0: Ah,  , we have been expecting you.
When the satrap and your comrades returned earlier, I couldn't help but notice that they were in low spirits. I hope it is nothing too serious...
But forgive me, you must be eager to join them. If you would follow me...
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_VARSHAHN_000_059: Azdaja is my sister, and long have I dreamed of saving her.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_VARSHAHN_000_060: But if I am to do so, I must be better than I have been. Blessed though I am to have you and yours as comrades, I cannot well ask you to lift me up every time doubt and despair creep into my heart.
TEXT_AKTKMK109_04743_VARSHAHN_000_061: I won't falter again. This I swear. I will hold fast to my conviction, , and I pray that you will stand with me to the last.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VARSHAHN_000_001: Ah, . I was about to call for you.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VARSHAHN_000_002: There have been developments concerning the voidgate that I would discuss with everyone.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VARSHAHN_000_003: Coincidentally, I am told Y'shtola will be returning shortly.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VARSHAHN_000_004: I dare to hope she has made some progress in devising a way to harness the First's Light...
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VARSHAHN_000_005: Come, let us await the others in my chambers.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VRITRA_000_008: I pray thou art come with glad tidings?
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_009: With findings well worth many sleepless nights, I am pleased to report.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_011: You may leave it there, thank you.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VRITRA_000_010: Eager though I am to hear the details, I must first share tidings of my own. Grave ones.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VRITRA_000_012: Urianger hath sent word from the voidgate in Mare Lamentorum. The situation is precarious.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VRITRA_000_013: They continue to rely upon the brands to contain the forces which would otherwise flow freely into the Source.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VRITRA_000_014: Yet though these measures were sufficient to imprison a fragment of Zodiark for eons, against our enemy's determined onslaught, they are degrading at an unsettling rate.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VRITRA_000_015: The Loporrits are sparing no effort to sustain the brands, but 'tis only a matter of time ere they fail.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VRITRA_000_016: Unless we act soon, there shall be no stopping Golbez from realizing his ambition.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_018: That Zeromus should so test the seal even when not at full strength... 'Tis every bit as terrible as we feared.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VRITRA_000_019: Aye. We must needs vanquish it, to which end we require a means to pierce its Dark shroud.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: So, did you find it? A way to bring resplendent Light to bear against our foe?
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_021: As a matter of fact, I have.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_024: The theory was simple. We harness Light from the First and channel it to the Thirteenth.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_025: Such a feat would require us to manipulate vast amounts of energy, to say the least...
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_027: And so I consulted Cid and his fellows, who rose to the challenge and produced bespoke devices: aether transmitters.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_028: These marvelous contraptions can be placed at locations of our choosing to facilitate the flow of aether. In other words, we can use them to create aetherial currents.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VRITRA_000_029: That such a thing should be possible...
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_030: We shall first direct aether from Nabaath Areng, where the Flood of Light was halted, into the Crystal Tower. We all know from personal experience the wonders of which it is capable─wonders which suit our needs perfectly.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_031: I should mention that the knowledge G'raha Tia acquired from the archmagus Noah was also a source of inspiration.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_032: I should mention that the structure in the Azim Steppe which the Allagans built to redirect aether was also a source of inspiration.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_033: Once we have infused the Crystal Tower with sufficient aether, we shall send it into the rift.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_034: And the aether transmitters shall guide the energy unto the Thirteenth, like so.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_035: In this way, we shall have a lance of Light with which to pierce the shield of Darkness.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_036: ...Or so I hope. No tests we performed were close to the scale of what we ultimately seek to achieve. I cannot guarantee success.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_A1_000_001: With such great minds on our side, how could we possibly fail?
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_A1_000_002: It would hardly be the first time we played it by ear.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_038: Indeed. We've harnessed the wisdom of the past, present, and future to further this cause. I too have faith that it will be enough in the end.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_039: True enough. But that's not a point of pride for me personally.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_ESTINIEN_000_040: Science and theory aside, we need to place one or more of these transmitters in the First, I take it?
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_041: A task we must entrust to you, . Rest assured I will provide you with what support I can.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I wish to go as well.
This world that you brought back from the brink, I would see it with my own eyes.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VRITRA_000_044: But...how dost thou intend to make the journey?
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: In a spirit vessel. That's how you and yours managed it, yes?
Voidsent summoning also sees the soul separated from flesh. This separation I can do at will. The principles are similar enough.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_047: If you aren't averse to traveling with company, I should be glad to lend Zero my vessel.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_048: Then it's settled. I shall finish preparing the transmitters and then help Zero transfer her soul.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_049: Pray see to your own preparations, and then let us reconvene at Meghaduta.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_ESTINIEN_000_050: For a moment, I misunderstood and thought Y'shtola was proposing that Zero borrow her body. Which would have been...odd.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VARSHAHN_000_100: Y'shtola will be along after she has seen to Zero's soul. Let us await her here.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_102: Everything went smoothly. Zero's soul is now safely within the spirit vessel.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VARSHAHN_100_103: I shall have the alchemists attend her body until she returns.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_104: The vessel I place in your care, along with the transmitters and a set of garments for Zero.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_100_104: I've also included instructions on how to operate the Crystal Tower, courtesy of G'raha Tia.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_ESTINIEN_000_109: While you're away, I'll join Urianger and the Loporrits on the moon. They'll need help should the brands fail.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_VARSHAHN_000_110: A fine idea. For my part, I shall continue to coordinate our efforts while I recover from my wounds.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_111: Given the task at hand, I suggest you speak with Ryne. With her power over Light, she is bound to be helpful in our efforts.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_112: But ere you do that or aught else, seek out Beq Lugg. As the First's foremost authority on soulcraft, they should be able to grant Zero a corporeal form.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_113: As I recall, the old Nu Mou was rather fond of the Cabinet of Curiosity, so that should be your first stop.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_YSHTOLA_000_114: That's all from me. Go forth, Warrior of Darkness, and make your triumphant return to the First!
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_BEQLUGG_000_200: Is that you, ? What brings you back across the rift?
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_BEQLUGG_000_201: Honestly! First you ask me to extract a soul from a spirit vessel...
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_BEQLUGG_000_202: And then you tell me you have designs to channel Light to another reflection!? Wicked white, , is nothing ever simple with you?
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_BEQLUGG_100_202: <sigh> I suppose some people can't help but find themselves at the center of world-changing events. Very well. If your home is in peril, then I shall do all in my power to aid you.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_BEQLUGG_000_203: Honestly! First you ask me to extract another soul from a spirit vessel...
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_BEQLUGG_000_204: And then you tell me you have designs to channel Light to the void!? Wicked white, , is nothing ever simple with you?
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_BEQLUGG_100_204: <sigh> I suppose some people can't help but find themselves at the center of world-changing events. Very well. If your home is in peril, then I shall do all in my power to aid you. And if it helps Unukalhai with his work, all the better.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_BEQLUGG_000_206: While I tend to your companion, you should go and speak with Ryne.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_BEQLUGG_000_207: By all accounts, she practically lives at the Hortorium these days. I will look for you there once I've finished.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_BEQLUGG_000_210: Like I said, you'll most likely find Ryne at the Hortorium. Run along for now.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_RYNE_000_300: We restored peace to the world, and I want to ensure that peace is preserved. That's why I'm learning everything I can.
TEXT_AKTKML101_04744_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I've heard something of your deeds here. Of how the Warrior of Darkness fought on, despite Light ravaging  very being.
Had I the selfsame strength of spirit, perhaps I could've done more for my world...
No. It isn't over yet. The Thirteenth isn't beyond saving. That's why we're here.
So, where to? Just lead the way.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I see they use aetherytes here as well. Not that I'll be able to, having not attuned to any. I trust you're willing to walk with me?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_010: Let's head for Nabaath Areng. Since Zero can't teleport to the aetheryte there, we should probably travel by amaro.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_011: Ah, there you are. Thank goodness I'm not too late.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_012: Lyna! I take it Beq Lugg told you why 's here?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_014: Greetings and welcome. I am Lyna, captain of the guard here at the Crystarium.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Zero. Is there something you require...?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_016: When I learned of your plan to gather Light at the Crystal Tower, I felt compelled to warn you of the potential repercussions.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_017: I know well that you would never use the tower for ill, nor without due caution. Even so...
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I believe I understand.
Ever since the Flood, Light has been a source of pain and misery. Some fear it still, no doubt.
Which is to say that some would be uncomfortable at the sight of it wielded as we intend. That is your concern, is it not?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_022: It was Light that nearly consumed our world. To use the Crystal Tower to harness this destructive force risks turning the tower into an object of fear.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_023: You may convince the Crystarium of the necessity of your cause, but it will not be so easy to win over those outside our walls.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_024: I worry this will undermine the fragile trust that we have only begun to build with some communities. They may misunderstand your intentions.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Tell me who they are and what misunderstandings they may have. I shall allay their concerns.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_026: and I will go with her. People know us. Our presence will put them at ease.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_027: Thank you. I realize this will delay the execution of your plans, but I see no other way.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_028: As for where to begin...I daresay Eulmore would be as good a place as any.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_029: Though ours is an amicable relationship now, we were at odds for long years.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_030: Eulmore was once ruled by a tyrant who wielded the power of Light. Though he promised salvation, in truth he made slaves of his subjects, and sought to destroy any who defied him.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_031: He's gone now, thankfully, and a good man named Chai-Nuzz was elected mayor. Relations between our cities have improved much since then.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_032: Even so, there's a lingering rivalry between us. If the Crystarium were to harness Light without warning, some Eulmorans might suspect we have ulterior motives.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_033: Thus would it be prudent to give them prior notice. If you explain that you seek to save the Warrior of Darkness's home, though, I should hope that they would give you their blessing.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Once again, yours is a name that commands respect and trust in the domain of your former enemies. As it does in Garlemald...
Where else should we visit?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_036: After Eulmore, I would suggest the Rak'tika Greatwood.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_037: There you will find the Night's Blessed, a small collective which worships Darkness, as well as the Viis, guardians of the secrets of ancient Ronka.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_038: The Viis are insular and will likely not object unless the Light encroaches upon their territory. The Night's Blessed, on the other hand, would greatly benefit from your assurances that your actions will not adversely affect their lives.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: People who worship Darkness... Fitting for a world all but consumed by Light.
Very well. We will treat with the people of Eulmore and the Night's Blessed.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_041: Here, take these whisperweeds. I will let you know when all is in readiness with the tower.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_042: Right, then. I should tend to my own tasks...
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_LYNA_000_043: Explaining the situation to the people of the Crystarium, and arranging for your transmitters to be placed here and in Nabaath Areng.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_044: We're truly grateful. Thank you, Lyna.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_045: Come, let's head to Eulmore. Hopefully Chai-Nuzz will know how best to present our plan to everyone.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: This is the great and powerful leader of Eulmore...? He must be possessed of subtle qualities that make him uniquely suited to the position.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_055: Look, Dulia-Chai and Wrenden are here too. Between the three of them, we should be able to get some good advice.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_WRENDEN_000_060: Greetings, Warrior of Darkness. If you've come out of concern for our esteemed mayor, fear not. He runs the city well, and as ever prefers to work closely with the people, the better to hear their voice.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_DULIACHAI_000_065: , Ryne! Oh, what a wonderful surprise this is! And you've even brought a new friend!
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_100_100: To what do we owe the pleasure? Not another world-ending threat, surely not. Surely not...?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_A1_000_001: We're planning a grand undertaking that may be of concern to the people of Eulmore.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_A1_000_002: There's a sensitive matter about which we thought it best to consult the city's esteemed mayor.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_200_100: Ah. And you wished to consult with me before making your plans known to the populace? Very well. What exactly did you have in mind...?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_210_100: I doubt I'd ever describe myself as such, but anyway. I can tell you're up to something─the kind of something I might want nothing to do with, but regardless, I should probably know. What is it?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_101: Gathering Light with the Crystal Tower, you say...
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_102: I would be lying if I said that doesn't bring back unpleasant memories, and I believe I speak for most Eulmorans.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_104: We have no reason to question your motives, of course. Neither yours nor those of the Crystarium's leadership.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_105: A world engulfed in Darkness, its corrupted inhabitants attempting to invade your own... It's rather a lot to process. But the desire to save one's home is something anyone can understand.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_109: I'm touched that you show such concern for our feelings despite the gravity of your plight. Very well. You have my support.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_DULIACHAI_000_110: As if there was ever any doubt! Right─let's gather the people at once. An explanation from you ought to ensure everyone understands.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_111: N-Not so fast, dearest. If I were to reveal everything at this juncture, many would be deeply unsettled, regardless of any assurances I offered.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_112: No, we need to first set the stage. Spread word of the Warrior of Darkness's plight─that  is on a mission to save  world, as  once did ours.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_113: Once the tale is common knowledge, I shall call an assembly and explain the need to harness the power of Light to a populace far more amenable to the idea.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_116: To that end, might I trouble you to speak with our citizens about your predicament? 'Twould be more effective to hear the details from the hero . More likely to inspire solidarity for your cause.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_WRENDEN_000_117: So we appeal to the desire to aid the Warrior of Darkness to present Light in a more positive...light. Well played, Master Chai.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_126: If it's best that you do the talking, then we'll come with you.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Fine by me. I'm content to observe.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_128: Once you have finished your rounds, I ask that you report to me. I should like to know how the people react.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_129: Lead the way, . We'll be right behind you.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_130: I am acutely aware of my limitations and know that I am not the most persuasive speaker, thank you. We should do our utmost to make the people more receptive before I address them.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_WRENDEN_000_135: The people of Eulmore have tremendous faith in both you and Master Chai. They would not still be here otherwise─I myself included.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_DULIACHAI_000_140: So Zero can travel here freely like you? Would that Alphinaud could do the same. I miss him dearly...
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_145: While Lyna and Master Chai couldn't be more different, they're both mindful of how their actions may affect others. They're both good leaders, and there's much I hope to learn from them.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: From that conversation alone, I could see how much the people here trust you.
Thanks to Jullus and Thancred, I've grown better at recognizing it.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_203: I mean, uh... Right. Of course you have. I don't know why I said that...
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_100_203: Right, let's find some citizens to speak with. I suggest we start here in the Canopy before heading down to the Understory and then the Derelicts.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_SYSTEM_000_205: Zero and Ryne are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_SYSTEM_000_206: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_SYSTEM_000_207: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: A tower, growing more decadent as it rises, set upon an isolated sliver of land... Reminiscent of a voidsent domain.
Built by those who yearned for better times. Who ached for the shadow of a memory.
Yet I saw no such desperation in the Crystarium. Despite their shared tragedy, the two cities couldn't feel more different.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_215: Though the Crystarium is my home now, I still visit Eulmore on occasion.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_100_215: Though the Crystarium is my home now, I still visit Eulmore on occasion, together with Gaia.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_216: And each time I'm here, I can feel that the city has changed. The mood is brighter, and the people happier.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_217: We can't allow all that hard-won progress to be undone. Let's do our best to reassure everyone.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_SYSTEM_000_218: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: You have other business? There's nothing else I care to do here, so I will wait for you at the main plaza.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_220: Oh, has something come up? That's all right. Zero and I can wait for you at the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: There you are. Back to it, then.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_222: Taken care of things, have you? Then lead the way!
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: A tavern, and an extravagant one at that. But those dancers engage with the poles in such strange ways.
Are they pantomiming a battle? A soldier thrusting their spear into the ground and using it to launch themselves at an enemy, perhaps...?
Given this world's violent history, it makes sense that displays of martial prowess would become popular entertainment.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_228: Thancred once told me that people come to these places to “savor some memories and drown the others.”
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_229: I imagine the Beehive was built primarily to help Eulmorans forget about sin eaters, even if only for a time. But now they can simply enjoy themselves.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_230: I can see the appeal... But don't worry! I know I'm still a bit too young for it...
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: That thing there cleaning up the debris... For a moment I thought it might be a voidsent.
In case you didn't know, it's not uncommon for our kind to use statues as vessels.
But I see now that it's more akin to the mechanical soldiers used by the Garleans. They come in all shapes and sizes, don't they?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_234: When Vauthry tried to keep us out of the city, many free citizens died in the chaos.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_235: Some had no kin to inherit their wealth, and so Eulmore decided to use it to help fund the reconstruction of the Derelicts.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_236: It's part of a greater effort to improve the living conditions down here, which is important since there's simply not enough room for everyone in the city proper.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CITIZEN04745A_000_3: Hm? Haven't I seen you somewhere before?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CITIZEN04745B_000_3: You keep looking over your shoulder. Are you waiting for someone...?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CITIZEN04745C_000_3: Gods, how am I supposed to go on like this. <sigh> I need another drink.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_SYSTEM_000_303: You must be accompanied by Ryne and Zero, and have them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_SYSTEM_000_304: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CITIZEN04745A_000_3: You're the Warrior of Darkness! I never dreamed I'd have the honor...but why are you in Eulmore, if I may ask?
Your home is in danger, and you've come seeking help...

If there's anything we can do for you, you need only ask. Things could be better here, of course, and we've got a long road ahead of us, but we wouldn't be here if it wasn't for you and yours. And we'll never forget that.
I once feared the sin eaters and the Light with every fiber of my being, but no longer. There's too much that wants for doing; we can't afford to be ruled by fear. You taught me that.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CITIZEN04745B_000_3: Well now, the Warrior of Darkness and the Oracle of Light both! How may I be of service?
Your enemies plot to invade your world!? Having heard tales of sin eaters ravaging countless villages, your plight feels all too familiar...

Come what may, I urge you to remain strong. You overcame the Lightwardens─you can overcome any adversity. And for what it's worth, I'm sure everyone here would be willing to help in whatever way we can.
Have courage, my friend. You saved our world once before, and I have faith you will save your own. That said, if I or my brethren can be of assistance, please don't hesitate to ask.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CITIZEN04745C_000_3: I used to live for the moment, not caring what might happen on the morrow. But now that we have peace, I find myself thinking about the future...and feeling anxious...
What? Your home is threatened with destruction? Wicked white, why are you wasting time in a drinking hole!?
Ugh, but as I say it, I feel the sting of hypocrisy... Gods, I need to take control of my life. Need to face my troubles head-on─and the same goes for you!
No one ever found answers at the bottom of a cup. None worth a damn, at least. We both know exactly what we need to do, don't we?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_WRENDEN_000_335: Spoken with the people, have you? While they're not without their worries, I'd like to think that, on the whole, they're not as prone to melancholy as they once were.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_DULIACHAI_000_340: The people know and respect you, . I've no doubt that everyone will rally around you in your hour of need!
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_400: Ah, you're back. Good. But where are Ryne and Zero?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_401: So the people are of one mind in their desire to help. Good, good.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_DULIACHAI_000_402: Why, just earlier, I overheard a conversation about how the Warrior of Darkness is seeking to save their home. Your tale is spreading quickly.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_WRENDEN_000_403: Then the plan has unfolded precisely as you envisioned.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_404: All that remains, then, is to assemble the citizens and explain 's need to gather Light...
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_405: For better or worse, I'm mayor of this city. I'll do my best to win them over.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_PATIENT03631_000_40: Yes, you're her! The young lady who saved me from Vauthry!
I'd eaten enough meol to fall under his control, but you cured me. I wouldn't be alive today if not for you.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_409: Oh, I remember you too! I'm glad to see you're doing well.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_PATIENT03631_000_41: I only learned later that it was the Oracle of Light herself who saved me─saved all of us. I didn't know if I'd ever get the chance to express my gratitude...
I'm sure it was nothing for someone with your power, but thank you. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: What is this “meol”?
Food made from the Light-tainted flesh of sin eaters, you say?
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: I see. The more they ate, the more the Light's corruption spread.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_415: Right. And because of that, they became susceptible to Vauthry's commands, as he could make the sin eaters do his bidding.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_418: Thankfully, I was able to suppress Light's influence and free everyone from his control, and there seems to be no lingering effects.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: You say that as if it were some small feat.
I've seen countless souls corrupted by Darkness. Someone with the power to heal them would be regarded as a great figure─and never know peace.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_421: My gift has been a burden. Many have suffered for it. Died for it.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_422: There were times when I wished I didn't have it. When I wanted to run away from everyone and everything.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_423: But I had friends to encourage and guide me─to help me learn not just to embrace my gift, but to take charge of my life. To change my fate.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: And so you did just that...
The people of this world are resilient indeed.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_RYNE_000_430: When I tended to the people after Vauthry fled, I wasn't sure how much of a difference it would make. It's a relief to see so many that I treated are alive and well.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_CHAINUZZ_000_435: My thanks again for your consideration, . The rest, you may leave to us.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_WRENDEN_000_440: We appreciate the Crystarium's concern for the welfare of our people. May we continue to strengthen the ties between our two cities.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_DULIACHAI_000_445: Brief though it was, it was wonderful to see you. Do visit again soon─hopefully when the fate of a world isn't weighing on your mind.
TEXT_AKTKML102_04745_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: That a half-voidsent like me managed to escape the Flood of Darkness...
For all these years, I never stopped to wonder why. To wonder if I had a greater part to play.
Well. Perhaps it's time I took charge and considered what I might be able to do for others.
The answer is here in the First, and I will find it.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_000_001: When I tended to the people after Vauthry fled, I wasn't sure how much of a difference it would make. It's a relief to see so many that I treated are alive and well.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_CHAINUZZ_000_002: My thanks again for your consideration, . The rest, you may leave to us.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_WRENDEN_000_003: We appreciate the Crystarium's concern for the welfare of our people. May we continue to strengthen the ties between our two cities.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_DULIACHAI_000_004: Brief though it was, it was wonderful to see you. Do visit again soon─hopefully when the fate of a world isn't weighing on your mind.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: If we have no further business here, let's move on. Where to next?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_000_011: Slitherbough, the home of the Night's Blessed in the Rak'tika Greatwood. We'll explain the situation to their leader, Runar.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Little wonder those who revere Darkness would gather here. Yet dark as this wood may seem, it is a blazing torch next to the void.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_000_020: I've not visited here in some time, but it's much as I remember. Which is good.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_100: ! You're a sight for sore eyes, my friend. Will you be staying long in Slitherbough?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_100_100: Though having said that, I suspect this isn't just a social call...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_A3_000_001: A great plan is in motion, and the Night's Blessed deserve to know...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_A3_000_002: We need to speak with you as leader of the Night's Blessed. It's important.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_110_100: Hmm, when you put it that way... Very well. On behalf of my people, I would hear what you have to say.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_120_100: Ah, so it is more of a formal visit. That's fine. Why don't we get right to it, then?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_101: What? Your world─Master Matoya's world─is in grave danger!?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_000_103: (Y'shtola. She took another name in accordance with custom when she lived among the Night's Blessed. They believe Light taints everything that it touches─even their true names. Out of respect, don't speak hers here.)
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_104: You are Zero, yes? The one come from a world consumed by Darkness. I struggle to conceive of such a place...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: A pitch-black pall shrouds the sky, which neither the light of the sun nor the stars can pierce. It is the opposite of what you once knew here in Norvrandt.
That being the case, I'm sure you can relate to our situation.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_107: All too well. You have my deepest sympathies.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_108: And in order to beat back the Darkness in your world, you would harness Light from ours...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_109: 'Tis a simple yet brilliant idea! Only Master Matoya could have conceived of such.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_110: That Norvrandt is still in her thoughts... That we are still...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: So...you're not opposed to our plan?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_112: We Night's Blessed may place our faith in the Dark, but we have never sought to force our beliefs upon others.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_113: If your deliverance lies in Light, then by all means avail yourselves of it.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I'm surprised. From what I was told of your people, I was certain you would disapprove of our methods.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_115: Do not mistake our reverence for Darkness as a desire for it to be ascendant. Rather, in Darkness there is a peace that we seek to make our own through prayer and self-reflection.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_116: And while Light may have wrought suffering in our world, anything in excess can be harmful. Even Darkness, as you and yours know all too well.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_117: It is the wielder who is righteous or evil─not the weapon. If you would wield Light for a noble cause, then who are we to deny you?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_100_117: ...An easy thing for me to say now that night has been restored to our world, perhaps. Nevertheless.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_110_117: I wish you the best in your fight, Zero. May light shine your way in the darkness.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_120_117: Now then! To mark this joyous occasion, I must offer you a proper welcome to Slitherbough.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_130_117: You might find this interesting, Zero.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_122: Right, let us begin with the customary greeting.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_123: , I trust you remember how to announce yourself as a friend of the Blessed?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_SYSTEM_000_124: With the chat mode in Say, enter “allin tuta” to offer Runar a traditional greeting.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: This is a watchword, I take it.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_000_130: Our first visit here was nerve-racking but exciting. I'll never forget how the villagers warmed to me when I spoke the words.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_135: Don't tell me you've forgotten the words. What would Master Matoya think?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_200: Friends old and new, I bid you welcome to Slitherbough.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Allin tuta... What does it mean?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_202: In the language of Ronka, it is one of several ways one might say “good evening.” This greeting allows us to quickly discern friend from foe.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_204: A simple expression, but in a world bereft of night, the words held deep meaning.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_205: They were a reminder of the world as it was, when the sun and the moon and the stars yet danced across the sky, and we wished one another well as the day gave way to night.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: A communal tradition. So the words serve to bind us.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_207: Indeed. We are no longer strangers, you and I. Next, we shall have you cleansed of Light's impurities. Present yourself to Davith in yonder room. He will be glad to assist you.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: No sooner had I greeted this Davith than he poured a pot of water over me. I wasn't expecting a literal cleansing...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_000_215: It's nice to guide a new friend through the same experiences, isn't it?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_220: I'm reminded of when you first came to us. When Master Matoya was still here...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_225: Ah, but don't let me keep you. Go on and join your friends.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_DAVITH_000_300: There you are. Your friend has just been cleansed.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_DAVITH_000_303: Hahaha, I would've been surprised if you'd said otherwise. Even so, it is customary to cleanse ourselves of Light with water blessed by our priests.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: But you have Darkness again, do you not? Why continue the custom?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_DAVITH_000_307: Why, for the same reason that it was conceived: to pray for the safety of friends and visitors alike. As we pray for yours this .
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_DAVITH_000_308: Safe travels, friend, and may blessed shadow keep you.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Right... If that's all, let's return to Runar and see if there's any other customs I must observe.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_000_425: The memories of those I've met and the bonds we've forged will always be a part of me. She may find these moments strange now, but one day she'll look back on them fondly...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_430: How does Zero like our welcoming customs, I wonder.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_DAVITH_000_435: Though we call it a ritual, it's not exactly unusual or elaborate. I hope your friend's disappointment is not due to her expectations.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_11: And...while I can't explain it, I feel more confident than I did before. Just a touch...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_120_500: I'm glad to hear it. With the Warrior of Darkness at your side, I've no doubt that you will save your two worlds.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_13: If we can defeat Zeromus, then aye, the Source would be safe.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_14: But nothing would change for my own world. There would just be one less voidsent to struggle over scraps with the rest.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_150_500: Is that so? Forgive me, I spoke out of turn...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_15: It's fine. I was under no illusion.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_16: I wish it were different, of course...
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_LYNA_000_522: (-Lyna-), can you hear me? Have you met with the people of Eulmore and Rak'tika?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_LYNA_000_523: (-Lyna-)Excellent. Then we may proceed to the next phase of the plan without worry.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_LYNA_000_524: (-Lyna-)Beq Lugg has informed me that the tower is ready, so make for Nabaath Areng at your leisure.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_LYNA_000_525: (-Lyna-)I've arranged for you to rendezvous with Cassard en route as well.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_LYNA_000_526: (-Lyna-)Not only can he take you to the site of the Flood, but he will also know where best to place the transmitters, given his familiarity with the route between the Crystarium and Amh Araeng.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_LYNA_000_527: (-Lyna-)He will be in Twine on business shortly, so I've asked him to wait for you there.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_000_528: It's all coming together. To Twine, then!
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RUNAR_000_530: Zero's pessimism notwithstanding, we will pray for her world. Take care, my friend...and tell Master Matoya that she is ever in our hearts.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_DAVITH_000_535: I'm pleased to hear that Zero found the cleansing ritual rewarding, if only a little.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_CASSARD_000_600: Your timing couldn't be better, . I've just finished up my business here.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_CASSARD_000_601: Lyna has told me all. It would be my pleasure to take you to Nabaath Areng.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_CASSARD_000_605: ...As soon as the other helpers arrive, that is. They're supposed to be along any moment now.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_GHENGEN_000_607: We understand you are faced with quite a predicament. And when an esteemed customer is in need, the merchants of Mord Souq are eager to provide!
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_CRYSTARIUMGUARD_000: The captain bade us assist you, . To ensure that Light is delivered to the Crystarium.
Members of our guard will place transmitters in Lakeland, and the good people of Mord Souq will do likewise in the Hills of Amber. You need but focus on your own task in Nabaath Areng.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Yet more people clamoring to help you. It'd almost be more surprising if they hadn't shown up.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_CASSARD_000_611: If everyone is ready, then let's get to work!
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MAGNUS_000_613: You're heading to Nabaath Areng and didn't think to call on us?
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_THAFFE_000_614: While most of our Talos are still in a sorry state, we've spared no effort in maintaining the trolley.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_JERYK_000_615: We've even upgraded it, as a matter of fact! It's faster than ever and can deliver you to Nabaath Areng in no time at all!
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MAGNUS_000_616: After everything you've done for us, we can't just stand idly by. Thancred would never let us hear the end of it.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_000_617: Thank you. Thank you all so much.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I daresay we have ample help. Come, let's go and acquire our Light.
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_RYNE_000_620: Though I've only known Zero for a short while, I feel as though her struggle is my own. For her sake, and her world's, we must succeed!
TEXT_AKTKML103_04746_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: We've done our part, and I trust that the others will see the Light to our destination.
It's time we returned to the Source. I shall seek out Beq Lugg and have them return my soul to the spirit vessel.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_RYNE_000_001: Well, I suppose this is it. I don't know if you had any other preparations to attend to or people to visit, but I'll go on ahead to the Ocular.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_RYNE_000_005: It seems Zero is already back in the vessel. I would have liked to talk to her more, but it'll have to wait till next time. And there will be a next time. I'm sure of it.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_LYNA_000_010: Before we said our farewells, Zero thanked me, saying that she learned much during her time in Norvrandt. While I don't believe I'm owed such gratitude, I'm nonetheless glad that she found the experience worthwhile.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_BEQLUGG_000_100: The tower stands ready to send Light into the rift, and Zero's soul is secure in her vessel once more.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_LYNA_000_101: Our helpers across the realm have also sent word that the transmitters are in place.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_LYNA_000_102: Once the others have been set on the moon of Zero's world, we should have the foundation for our aetherial current.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_BEQLUGG_100_102: To make matters easier, the transmitters broadcast a powerful signal that can be detected by the tower even across the rift. Upon confirming that the void ones are active, we will send forth the Light!
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_RYNE_110_102: The rest will be up to you. We'll all be praying for your success.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_BEQLUGG_000_103: Now go─make haste back to the Source, and save your worlds!
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_BEQLUGG_000_105: Worry not, I can manage the tower well enough. Return to the Source, and finish it!
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_RYNE_000_110: With so many people willing us on, I have faith that we will succeed.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_LYNA_000_115: The Exarch's spirit abides in this tower. It will surely deliver the Light where it is needed.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_YSHTOLA_000_120: Welcome back, . I presume the preparations in the First are complete? That is well, for time grows short.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_VARSHAHN_000_131: The Loporrits report that the brands are on the verge of failing. We have no time to spare.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_YSHTOLA_000_132: I shall restore Zero to her body at once.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I was worried that the soul transference process might affect the Light I absorbed, but it feels as potent as before.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_YSHTOLA_000_135: The radiance of your soul was impossibly blinding. I don't know how you would have managed without Ryne's help.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: While Ryne helped me to contain the Light, it was you─all of you─who gave me the courage to even make the attempt. Your friendship. Your acceptance.
That includes the people of the First. The Night's Blessed, in particular, showed me great kindness. As did Runar─whose only regret seemed to be that you could not join us.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_YSHTOLA_000_138: A regret we share. Ours is a reunion long overdue.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_VARSHAHN_000_139: If all is in readiness, then I will assume my dragon form and fly to the moon.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_VARSHAHN_000_140: In the meantime, pray make your own way to the Drowning Brand. There we shall reconvene before sallying forth once more into the void.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_URIANGER_000_145: The Darkness groweth stronger with every passing moment. Doubt not but that Zeromus shall soon attain full strength.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_ESTINIEN_000_150: The hour is upon us. If everyone is ready, then so am I.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_YSHTOLA_000_155: 'Tis a terrible Darkness indeed that should so test the restraints which once held Zodiark, but with the Light from the First, I am confident we will prevail.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Golbez will be ready for our return. We must likewise be ready for him.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_MAPPINGWAY_000_165: Oh, thank goodness you're back! The seal will break at any moment, ! Any moment!
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_LIVINGWAY_000_200: Time to take the fight to the enemy, is it?
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_LIVINGWAY_000_201: The Darkness has been utterly relentless, gnawing at the seal like I might an iron carrot.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_LIVINGWAY_000_202: Strike fast and hard, because you won't get another chance.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_MAPPINGWAY_000_203: As a precaution, we've further enhanced the combat supporters. You don't need to worry about us while you're away.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_URIANGER_000_204: I shall maintain my vigil over the brands. Pray see that thou art ready to depart as soon as Vrtra and the others have assembled.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_URIANGER_000_205: May the Light shine the way to victory, and deliver you all safely home.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_YSHTOLA_000_210: In order to unleash the most concentrated burst of Light possible, we will route the energy to multiple transmitters before directing it to converge at a single point. I will survey the area for suitable locations.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_ESTINIEN_000_215: It's too quiet. Surely they know we're here...
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_VRITRA_000_220: This time, Sister... This time, I will save you...
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: The dark pall over the crater has grown thicker.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_10: And on the other side lies Golbez's domain. He'll have altered the terrain to hinder us.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: I don't sense his presence, but I wager he is in the crater...
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_YSHTOLA_000_302: 'Twould be ideal if he were. I shall hurry and place the transmitters.
TEXT_AKTKML104_04747_YSHTOLA_000_303: Once they are activated, our cross-rift aetherial current will be established, and Light will flow freely from the First. In theory, at least.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_YSHTOLA_000_001: Glad though I am that the plan worked, we are in no position to celebrate. The day is not won yet!
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_ESTINIEN_000_005: She's no longer the cold, distant soul we met in the void. Or perhaps, until now, she just never had a chance to be who she truly is.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: This radiance is just the beginning. We must see it cast into the deepest depths of the moon.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_VRITRA_000_015: My dragon form shall remain here to secure our escape route. The voidsent who dare to approach the gate will reckon with me.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_VARSHAHN_000_020: Rest assured I will not let my emotions overwhelm me. When the moment comes, I will call to my sister, and I will wrest her free from Zeromus.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_VARSHAHN_000_021: The crater awaits. Woe betide any who bar our path.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter the Lunar Subterrane.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_YSHTOLA_000_030: The lingering Light illuminates the way to our foe. It will not escape us.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_ESTINIEN_000_035: We've no time to waste. The voidsent we felled will return ere long.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_VARSHAHN_000_040: “Take heart, and protect them well”... I will live up to my own words. This I swear.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: When we find Golbez, let me speak with him─please. There is something I must know.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_YSHTOLA_000_300: To yearn to save the world, only to bring about its unmaking... 'Tis a tragic tale. But it changes nothing.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_ESTINIEN_000_305: We rarely believe ourselves the villain. But if our ends demand unconscionable sacrifice, what else can we be?
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_VARSHAHN_000_310: He speaks of salvation─of fulfilling an honored friend's legacy. Yet he does not scruple to discard others for his ambitions...
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_SYSTEM_000_405: In the darkest recesses of the moon await Golbez and Zeromus. They are resolved to save their world...and condemn yours.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_SYSTEM_000_406: Are you prepared to brave the dark?
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_YSHTOLA_000_600: That Azdaja lives is a miracle made possible by the unique nature of the void...
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_YSHTOLA_000_601: ...Ah, yes. The aether transmitters, I shall leave with Zero. They will be of more use in the Thirteenth than in the Source.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_ESTINIEN_000_605: I've already seen Varshahn safely to Vrtra. Many would be heartbroken if their “little brother” failed to return home.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_VRITRA_000_610: Never again shall we be parted, Sister. Never again.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: Never did I imagine that the Light I bore could bring about such change.
As our domains are shaped by our innermost desires, perhaps this is a reflection of the hope that had quickened in my heart.
You came to the Thirteenth to rescue Azdaja and protect your world. Our meeting was happenstance, and our association one of mutual convenience.
Yet you and yours always treated me with kindness. As a friend. And through your friendship, I've found a new beginning.
TEXT_AKTKML105_04748_SYSTEM_000_705: You may now enter the Lunar Subterrane with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_YSHTOLA_000_001: That Azdaja lives is a miracle made possible by the unique nature of the void...
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_YSHTOLA_000_002: ...Ah, yes. The aether transmitters, I shall leave with Zero. They will be of more use in the Thirteenth than in the Source.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ESTINIEN_000_005: I've already seen Varshahn safely to Vrtra. Many would be heartbroken if their “little brother” failed to return home.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_MYSTERIOUSPERSON_00: It should come as no surprise that Golbez has a means to travel between the moon and the star, of which we may avail ourselves shortly.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_URIANGER_000_015: We have awaited your return with bated breath. As should be apparent, naught of note occurred in your absence.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_MAPPINGWAY_000_020: A pity there was no need to employ our combat supporters... Still, everyone is safe, and that's all that matters.
