TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_YSHTOLA_000_025: Urianger and the Loporrits are to be commended for ensuring that the seal held fast.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ESTINIEN_000_030: To think this all began with a simple treasure hunt. Gods, I could sleep for a week...
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_LIVINGWAY_000_100: Oh, welcome back, everyone! While you were away, a rent in the fabric of reality suddenly appeared! Through it, we could observe you locked in furious battle with Zeromus!
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_LIVINGWAY_100_100: By the time it closed up, we had seen your victory─well done, by the way─but we still couldn't breathe easy until we knew for certain you were safe and sound. And here you are, thank heavens!
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_LIVINGWAY_000_101: Dare I hope Azdaja is safe too? And Zero?
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_YSHTOLA_000_103: Though we could not return Azdaja to her original form, Vrtra granted her a new vessel using one of his eyes. Her circumstances are unique, but it nevertheless gives me hope that there may be a way to save other voidsent.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_YSHTOLA_000_104: As for Zero, she has chosen to remain in her world, and do what she can to restore it.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_LIVINGWAY_000_105: Ah, so the light of hope shines again amidst the darkness!
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_LIVINGWAY_000_106: Hers is an admirable dream, and I pray that she hops and skips her way to making it reality!
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_MAPPINGWAY_000_107: Perhaps our research into environments capable of supporting life would be of use in the Thirteenth.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_LIVINGWAY_000_109: A day may come when the people of the Source and the Thirteenth work hand in hand. In anticipation of this, we must accumulate even more useful technology!
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_LIVINGWAY_000_110: And I must inform Jammingway as well! I spy an opportunity for the Last Dregs to expand into the void!
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_LIVINGWAY_000_111: Ah, but don't let us detain you with our cavalcade of brilliant ideas. We'll see that the gate is closed and the seal deactivated, so go home and get some rest─that includes you, Urianger!
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_URIANGER_000_112: As thou dost command. Pray convey our gratitude to the watcher for his timely assistance.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_YSHTOLA_100_112: 'Twould seem Vrtra is preparing to depart. Come, let us descend to the Tower of Babil.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_URIANGER_000_113: Upon arriving in Garlemald, 'twould be meet to inform Jullus of our mission's outcome. Let us seek him out at Tertium.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_LIVINGWAY_000_115: I suppose we'll have to rename our voidsent slaughter-bots now. A shame. The name just rolls off the tongue, doesn't it? Still, it was a joy to be of aid to the people of Etheirys again!
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_MAPPINGWAY_000_120: Wouldn't it be grand if we could make it possible for people to spend time in the void without protective talismans...
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_WATCHEROFMOON_000_1: To rekindle Light in the Thirteenth and pave the way for its restoration...
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_WATCHEROFMOON_100_1: Her crystal helped set these events into motion, did it not? Then through you and Zero, She was able to serve a greater purpose one last time.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ALPHINAUD_000_125: Ah, 'tis you. What news of your mission in the void?
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ALISAIE_000_130: The fact you've come all this way can only mean there've been developments. I'm all ears.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_YSHTOLA_000_200: It cannot be overstated how invaluable Lord Fourchenault's cooperation was. We must thank him profusely.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ESTINIEN_000_205: I've lost count of how many times I've come here, but it's apparently enough that the immigration officials no longer interrogate me. Small blessings, eh?
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_URIANGER_000_210: Without further ado, let us tend to business.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ALPHINAUD_000_215: Father has many demands on his time, but I should hope he can spare us a moment...
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ALISAIE_000_220: Having been away for so long, it might be nice to stay a while. If only to set Father and Mother's minds at ease.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ATHELEYS_000_300: Wait, aren't you the Scions of the Seventh Dawn? Or were, rather─I understand you've disbanded...?
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ATHELEYS_000_301: An audience with Lord Fourchenault? You are in luck. The Forum has just this moment adjourned, and he is still inside with the scholarch.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ATHELEYS_000_302: Please wait here while I inform them of your presence.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_FOURCHENAULT_000_30: Apologies to have kept you. I trust you won't object if Scholarch Montichaigne also attends.
My incorrigible children... Were you not assisting with Garlemald's reconstruction?
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_ALPHINAUD_000_305: Our hosts were most insistent that we take a rest, so here we are. But more importantly,  has news that  would share with you.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_MONTICHAIGNE_000_30: So the threat has passed! These are glad tidings indeed.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_FOURCHENAULT_000_30: Harnessing Light from the First. A technological triumph...that could have ended in catastrophic failure.
But let us not dwell on hypotheticals.
Like the aether from the Isle of Haam, you employed the Light for peaceful─albeit unanticipated─purposes.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_FOURCHENAULT_000_31: “Knowledge exists to serve the greater good,” as my father was fond of saying. I'm inclined to agree─in this instance.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_MONTICHAIGNE_000_31: It has been established that world-ending crises in the reflections are connected to calamities in the Source.
As such, the strides you made in understanding the nature of and effecting a change in a reflection may one day prove vital for mankind's preservation.
The Forum will be eager to review your accounts thoroughly, for every drop of water serves to swell the great river of knowledge.
Might we prevail upon you to prepare a comprehensive report, Y'shtola? On the subjects of the void and cross-rift travel both.
TEXT_AKTKML106_04749_FOURCHENAULT_000_31: We will share these tidings with those who aided you─Kokkol Dankkol not least of all. Now, if you'll excuse us, we must be on our way.
I should be glad to speak with you both later.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_ESTINIEN_000_001: If I didn't know better, I'd say father dearest is warming to us. I've no interest in sipping tea at the family estate again, though. Drinks at the tavern, on the other hand...
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_URIANGER_000_005: Although Master Louisoix hath left us, he liveth on in his teachings. 'Tis gratifying to see that Master Fourchenault, too, hath come to acknowledge the wisdom in them.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I look forward to telling my father of our efforts in Garlemald. He will have sage counsel to offer, I'm sure.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_ALISAIE_000_015: You're of course welcome at our home─Mother, for one, would be thrilled to have you─but I won't twist your arm if you have other matters to attend to.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_ATHELEYS_000_018: If I heard correctly, it seems you've saved the world yet again!
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_020: With that, our obligations here are concluded.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_021: Oh, Nidhana. What news from Thavnair?
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_022: They've returned, then? Wonderful. Rest assured all is well with us too.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_024: We would be honored, of course. I shall relay this to the others.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_025: A great feast will be held in Radz-at-Han to celebrate Azdaja's homecoming. We have all been invited.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_ALPHINAUD_000_026: I'm afraid my sister and I must decline. We have only just returned home; to leave again so soon would be inconsiderate to our parents.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_URIANGER_000_027: With regret, I too must excuse myself from attendance. A prior commitment requireth that I remain in Sharlayan for a time.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_URIANGER_000_028: Let not our absence deter you, however. Pray enjoy yourselves to the fullest.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_ESTINIEN_000_029: I've no plans in particular, so you can count me in. I may as well visit the Radiant Host while I'm there.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_A1_000_001: Far be it from me to turn down free food!
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_A1_000_002: I have a delivery to make to the First.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_033: Ah, but what about the memoria crystal? 'Twould be remiss of us not to deliver it promptly to our friends in the First.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_034: Ah, of course. The memoria crystal. 'Twould be remiss of us not to deliver it promptly to our friends.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_100_034: Also, if they are to transfer Light and Dark between worlds, they will need command over the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_035: In which case, I shall give you my spirit vessel to take again. When you arrive in the Crystarium, the sentry at the tower should be able to round up everyone for you.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_036: Once you have seen to matters there, come and join us at Meghaduta.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_ALISAIE_000_037: Give everyone our regards, you hear?
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_CRYSTALGATEKEEPER_0: Welcome back, . Mistress Ryne is still in the Ocular. Will you be joining her?
Very good. If you would care to head inside, I shall send for Captain Lyna and Beq Lugg at once.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_BEQLUGG_000_105: For so long I was loath to trust in others, fearful of my research being misused again. That it may serve noble ends comes as a relief. I shall spare no effort to restore balance between Light and Dark!
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_RYNE_000_110: A brighter tomorrow awaits. Zero's Light will shine the way.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_RYNE_000_115: Hmm... If I had Gaia's help, I wonder if I could take in Darkness the same way Zero took in Light...
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_LYNA_000_200: It was a mighty struggle, but I had faith that you would be victorious in the end.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_LYNA_000_201: And I doubt not that the people of Norvrandt will cheer when they learn that the Warrior of Darkness managed to save  home.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_LYNA_000_203: I know you are a busy , so don't let us keep you. Rest assured that we will continue the work we've begun.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_LYNA_000_205: If the Crystal Tower is to be used for research, it may be prudent to bolster its security.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_LYNA_100_205: It is the Exarch's legacy, and we must spare no effort to keep it safe.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_MEGHADUTAEMPLOYEE_0: , you honor us with your presence!
Though I am but a humble servant, I offer you my heartfelt thanks for rescuing the satrap's beloved sister.
But without further ado, the great feast to celebrate this joyous occasion is about to begin! The venue is Mehryde's Meyhane, and you are a guest of honor!
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_400: 'Twas a lively feast, was it not? And it impressed upon me once again how dear Vrtra is to his people.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_401: Well, as much as I should like to linger, 'tis past time I took my leave. If you mean to depart as well, I suggest you call on Vrtra before setting out.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_YSHTOLA_000_402: And before I forget─thank you. For everything we learned, and for everything we accomplished, I couldn't be more grateful.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_SYSTEM_000_410: Azdaja regards you with keen interest.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_VARSHAHN_000_500: , I hope you enjoyed the festivities. To be able to celebrate Azdaja's return with everyone was...moving beyond words.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_VARSHAHN_000_501: Lest you wonder, I've chosen to use this vessel for now, the better to escort my sister about Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_VARSHAHN_000_502: This leaves my true form without an eye, but I do not anticipate having need of it in the immediate future.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_VARSHAHN_000_503: Long have I dreamed of showing Azdaja my beautiful city, a glittering jewel born of unity. And I shall relish every moment of it.
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_VARSHAHN_000_505: Now then, I believe both Y'shtola and Estinien have embarked on their respective journeys, but have you yourself business elsewhere?
TEXT_AKTKML107_04750_VARSHAHN_000_506: If not, you are welcome to remain here as long as you like. Should aught of import arise, we will inform you─but until such a day arrives, I bid you take your ease.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_VARSHAHN_000_001: Ah, . One of my clerks was just here with a message for you.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_VARSHAHN_000_002: The Students of Baldesion request your presence in Sharlayan at your earliest convenience.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_VARSHAHN_000_003: Indebted as I am to our friends, I had hoped that I too might be of service, but it is you alone that they require.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_VARSHAHN_000_004: If you've no pressing business, pray make your way to the Baldesion Annex at once. Ojika awaits your arrival.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_VARSHAHN_000_005: In the meantime, I shall continue showing Azdaja the city. From notable landmarks to the people's lives, there is still much and more for her to see.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_VARSHAHN_000_006: Farewell for now, my friend. I look forward to the day we set forth on another adventure together.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_1: A warm and hearty welcome to you, ! I gather you received our message?
Please wait here while I fetch Krile and G'raha.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_KRILE_000_102: Thank you for coming on such short notice.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_KRILE_100_102: And forgive us for sending for you so soon after your trials in the void.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_KRILE_110_102: And forgive us for sending for you so soon after your trials in the void, to say nothing of your grueling battle against the Twelve.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_KRILE_000_103: Now then, we aren't actually the ones who require your presence, but Erenville.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_KRILE_000_104: He stopped by recently, you see, and asked us to reach out to you on his behalf.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_KRILE_000_105: I imagine you're as surprised as we are, given that he was supposed to be away on a long expedition.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_GRAHATIA_000_106: Something must have necessitated a change in his plans.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_KRILE_000_108: All he would tell me is that there is someone whom he wishes  to meet.
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_KRILE_000_109: He also mentioned that he would be tending to business at the Studium. Shall we look for him there?
TEXT_AKTKMM101_04751_GRAHATIA_000_115: Erenville's early return likely has something to do with this visitor. Who could it be, I wonder...
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_005: That's the long and short of it. At the very least, I ask that you go on this hunt of hers and take her measure for yourself.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_WUKLAMAT_000_010: So, where to for our hunt? The stronger the prey, the better!
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_GRAHATIA_000_020: The chance to see not only Tural, but the fabled golden city besides... This is the stuff of grand adventures, my friend!
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_GRAHATIA_100_020: Wh-Which is not to say you should hastily accept this invitation, mind. There's still a great deal we do not know.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_GRAHATIA_000_021: So let us begin to rectify that by first getting acquainted with our visitor in the manner she suggests.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_GRAHATIA_000_022: I'm not certain what might be a suitable location for her hunt, however...
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_023: When I was at the guild earlier, I learned about a petition from researchers on the Isle of Haam.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_024: You went there not long ago and culled some unruly fauna, of course, but according to recent reports, other ordinarily docile fauna have grown savage.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_025: It's believed that they've been unsettled by some manner of predator, and so the researchers seek assistance with identifying and dispatching it. As part of your hunt, perhaps you might answer the petition?
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_GRAHATIA_000_026: The isle isn't far, and we would also be helping those in need...
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_WUKLAMAT_000_028: Just so you know─I've honed my skills against some of the fiercest beasts in Tural.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_WUKLAMAT_000_029: Whatever this creature is, it had better be able to put up a proper fight, or it'll end before we have the chance to get acquainted.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_KRILE_000_030: And before we can prove ourselves capable and dependable companions...
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_KRILE_000_031: My apologies, but I must see to some preparations. Pray go on ahead to the isle─I will join you as soon as possible.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_032: If the rest of you are ready, let us head to the harbor. This being guildship business, it should be simple enough to secure a vessel.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_GRAHATIA_000_035: Krile was acting a little strange, don't you think? This is just a simple hunt. I wonder what preparations she needs to make...
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_040: We have the loan of a ship from one of the captains─a cheery fellow. I can operate the vessel, so we don't need to trouble him to take us.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_WUKLAMAT_000_100: So we have to take a ship? Ugh, and I've barely set foot on dry land...
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_WUKLAMAT_000_101: Oh well, I suppose it's for a good cause─a hunt!
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_SYSTEM_000_103:
Upon boarding the ship, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_SYSTEM_000_104: In addition, you will be required to participate in battle. Your progress will be saved at certain points. In the event you are defeated, you will be able to try again from the most recent of these.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_SYSTEM_000_105: Please note that if you enter battles associated with other quests or log out from the game, this progress will be lost.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_SYSTEM_000_106: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 90 or above to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_KRILE_000_200: Thanks to Wuk Lamat, we now know who sent the letter to Grandfather, among other things. But many questions still remain...
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_GRAHATIA_000_205: I understand Krile's feelings all too well. The desire to do one's part. It can be daunting to try and keep up, but nothing will change unless we take the first step.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_WUKLAMAT_000_210: Ah, what an exciting hunt that was! And now, it's time to savor the reward!
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_290: With the wildlife pacified and the researchers safe, our task is complete.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_295: That just leaves the matter of the colibri meat...
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_300: For better or for worse, there's really only one place we can take it to here in Sharlayan: the Last Stand.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_301: Come, let us see what Dickon can cook up for us.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_DICKON_000_400: Well now, there's a famished face if I've ever seen one. What can I get you, ?
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_DICKON_000_401: Oho, bird meat from the hunt, you say? Leave it to me─I have just the recipe.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_DICKON_000_403: It's a new dish I recently learned from some sailors, and for you lot, it's on the house. Have as much as you like, you hear?
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_GRAHATIA_000_405: Judging by Wuk Lamat's reaction, it appears Turali cuisine isn't excessively fiery.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_500: Whether Wuk Lamat has the makings of a ruler, I couldn't say. But I do know that she deeply cares for her nation and her people.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_501: Whether you choose to help her, though, is for you and you alone to decide. Think on it well.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_502: Now then, it's past time I reported our mission's success to the guildship. I would've done so sooner, except Her Highness needed to have her royal meal.
TEXT_AKTKMM102_04752_ERENVILLE_000_503: I shall come by the annex later. Till then.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_001: Well, I daresay we now have a fair grasp of Wuk Lamat's situation.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_002: Still, you've been afforded time to consider her invitation. Why not use it to learn more about Tural? Noumenon is bound to have some information on the continent.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_A1_000_001: It certainly wouldn't hurt to be better informed.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_A1_000_002: Just the thought of burying myself in books is making me feel sleepy...
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_007: Quite right. Not only would it help you to make an informed decision, but if you do choose to go, you would be better prepared for what awaits.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_008: We're talking about mysterious lands and unknown wonders here! I'm confident we'll find reports so thrilling as to drive any thoughts of napping from your mind.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_009: Come, my friend. Let us be off to the archives.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_010: History, geography, botany... The public archives alone should suffice to provide a solid grounding on Tural.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753A_100_020: (-Eorzean Cuisine: A History-)It is impossible to adequately discuss Eorzean cuisine without speaking of that land from which many of our modern-day staples hail: the far-western continent of Tural.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753A_000_020: (-Eorzean Cuisine: A History-)Ogre pumpkins, ruby tomatoes, even the ubiquitous popoto─these crops and more that regularly grace Eorzean dining tables trace their origins to the “New World,” as the place is known to most.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753A_000_021: (-Eorzean Cuisine: A History-)The tale of this culinary immigration begins in the year 1498 of the Sixth Astral Era, when a Lominsan sailor named Ketenramm successfully traversed the Indigo Deep to arrive at the theretofore unknown continent.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753A_000_022: (-Eorzean Cuisine: A History-)Ketenramm spent several moons exploring inland, in the course of which he encountered the denizens of the sprawling nation of Mamool Ja. He was even granted an audience with their supreme leader, whose confidence he won along with permission to roam freely.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753A_000_023: (-Eorzean Cuisine: A History-)Ketenramm would return to Tural several times, but during his first expedition he charted the land and gathered myriad root vegetables and seeds to bring back to Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753A_000_024: (-Eorzean Cuisine: A History-)The most notable of these was the popoto, whose ease of cultivation and nutritional value saw it quickly spread to all corners of Eorzea.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753A_000_025: (-Eorzean Cuisine: A History-)Produce was far from the only bounty of Ketenramm's expeditions to Tural. Many tantalizing recipes such as the bean-filled burrito and gripping legends such as that of the golden city reached our shores by way of his ship.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753A_000_026: (-Eorzean Cuisine: A History-)To those outside of Ketenramm's circle, Tural largely remains shrouded in mystery, yet its influence on our cuisine cannot be overstated. Many scholars─myself included─would relish the chance to immerse themselves in the culinary culture of that faraway continent.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753B_000_028: (-The Flora and Fauna of Tural-)Every land has given rise to unique wildlife, and the continent of Tural is no exception. Yet while some of her creatures have become a familiar sight in Eorzea, many and more exist that are rarely seen this side of the Indigo Deep.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753B_000_029: (-The Flora and Fauna of Tural-)This tome introduces a select variety of species as described in the testimonies of sailors and adventurers.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753B_000_030:
(-The Flora and Fauna of Tural-)Alpaca
Accustomed to Tural's craggy mountain ranges, this four-legged beastkin has been domesticated for seemingly hundreds, if not thousands, of years.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753B_000_031: (-The Flora and Fauna of Tural-)Their soft, white fleece is highly prized by weavers, while their strong legs and sure-footedness make them capable beasts of burden.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753B_000_032:
(-The Flora and Fauna of Tural-)Wivre
This ferocious scalekin is native to the dense jungles of Tural. The Mamool Ja have succeeded in taming them and utilize their prodigious strength for manual labor.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753B_000_033: (-The Flora and Fauna of Tural-)Given their immense size and power, it should come as no surprise that the wivre is also employed as a siege beast. Enemy fortifications cannot long withstand this horned brute's rampage.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753B_000_034:
(-The Flora and Fauna of Tural-)Valigarmanda
Turali folklore holds that this birdlike creature is the mightiest of beasts and the very embodiment of nature's power. Whether it exists beyond myth, however, is uncertain.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753C_000_035: (-Lines in the Sand: The Geopolitics of Hydaelyn-)Let us begin by comparing the geographical characteristics of the Three Great Continents and Tural. The former stretches from east to west, and lies entirely within the northern hemisphere.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753C_000_036: (-Lines in the Sand: The Geopolitics of Hydaelyn-)In contrast, the latter extends to the far reaches of both northern and southern hemispheres, and a difference immediately presents itself in the form of climate variance.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753C_000_037: (-Lines in the Sand: The Geopolitics of Hydaelyn-)Shifts in climate tend to be gentler when moving east and west, but harsher when moving north and south. Owing to this fact, longitudinal migration is far more common in history, whether it be by men, animals, or plants.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753C_000_038: (-Lines in the Sand: The Geopolitics of Hydaelyn-)A case in point is the Allagans, who rose to power in Aldenard before advancing east into Ilsabard. Their movement would be mirrored thousands of years later by the Garleans.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753C_000_039: (-Lines in the Sand: The Geopolitics of Hydaelyn-)Meanwhile, although the disparate tribes of Tural waged war with one another for generations, stymied by the climate, none could make any great headway north or south.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753C_000_040: (-Lines in the Sand: The Geopolitics of Hydaelyn-)Tribes hailing from frozen lands withered beneath the desert sun, while those that thrived in open plains could not pierce dense jungle. Such was the way of it─until the leader of the Mamool Ja succeeded in bringing the continent under one banner.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753C_000_041: (-Lines in the Sand: The Geopolitics of Hydaelyn-)Given the land's divided history and the reason thereof, one cannot help but be in awe of this feat. Truly, it is a testament to the Autarch's greatness.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753D_000_042: (-Principles of Blue Magic and Spell Acquisition-)The origins of blue magic can be traced back to the esoteric practices of the Whalaqee, a tribe in the distant continent of Tural.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753D_000_043: (-Principles of Blue Magic and Spell Acquisition-)The tribe holds nature in the highest, and in seeking to cultivate a spiritual connection with it, they have learned to harness the power of the wildlife around them.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753D_000_044: (-Principles of Blue Magic and Spell Acquisition-)In exchange for teaching them the common tongue, I was permitted to live among them and train in their ways. Those days were some of the most grueling I remember, but they were tremendously rewarding.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753D_000_045: (-Principles of Blue Magic and Spell Acquisition-)For instance, I had the privilege of visiting Lapis Canyon, the tribe's sacred grounds. It is so named for the ceruleum deposit that wells up to the surface, turning the entire canyon a brilliant blue.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753D_000_046: (-Principles of Blue Magic and Spell Acquisition-)Under a shaman's watchful eye, I finally managed to master the Whalaqee's art and make the animals' powers my own. As no name existed for it in the common tongue, I took the liberty of naming it blue magic.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_BOOK04753D_000_047: (-Principles of Blue Magic and Spell Acquisition-)The reason I chose this color, as you will have doubtless gleaned, is for the significance it holds to the Whalaqee. I cannot think of a name more fitting to honor the people from whom this noble magic was born.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_SYSTEM_000_051: Having perused a wide selection of books relating to Tural, you are somewhat better informed about your potential destination. G'raha Tia will be eager to know what you have discovered.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_SYSTEM_000_052: Should you wish to read these books again, speak with the reference page.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_100: Scoured the library to your satisfaction, have you? Excellent.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_101: While there are few books wholly dedicated to the subject of Tural, I daresay you've found tidbits of useful information scattered here and there.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_102: But come, let's continue this outside. The mammets do not take kindly to chatter.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_103: Now then, I'm quite keen to hear your honest impressions.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_104: I couldn't help but notice that we read the very same book on cuisine. I was pleasantly surprised to find references to Tural within.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_105: Among them, did anything in particular pique your interest?
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_A2_000_001: I was rather taken with the tale of Ketenramm.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_A2_000_002: Popotoes─I have a newfound appreciation for them.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_107: Ah yes, the renowned Lominsan explorer who traversed the Indigo Deep and discovered the unknown west!
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_108: And his accomplishments didn't end there. He traveled Tural extensively, and even forged a friendship with the Dawnservant.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_109: If we were able to meet Ketenramm, what things we could learn. Alas, all of this happened nigh four score years ago, and he may no longer be alive to tell his tales...
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_110: As have I. Despite having just enjoyed a hearty meal, I found myself craving popotoes.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_111: As they keep well, they were a boon to sailors, and it was that same property that allowed them to survive the voyage to Eorzea.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_112: The book also mentioned a method of preservation which sees popotoes repeatedly frozen and dried. The resultant product was apparently used in a stew by people in mountainous regions. I should like to sample that dish one day─that and all the unique cuisines of that vast continent.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_113: Hah! I suspected any mention of the city of gold would catch your eye. 'Tis truly a mystery among mysteries.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_114: Here is a city whose location is unknown, that no one has ever seen. And yet whispers of its existence continue to persist.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_115: Countless souls have set off in search of it, never to return. I can imagine it being a suitable challenge for the ritual of succession.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_116: But moving on, did you perchance learn aught about the fauna of Tural? Given your adventuring background, I expect the topic would interest you.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_118: Ah yes, the alpaca. In addition to serving as beasts of burden, they provide clothing for people by way of their lush fleece.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_119: They are especially prized by mountain tribes, who hold certain rare specimens sacred.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_120: Ah, yes. The great horned beasts kept by the Mamool Ja, who unleash them on fortified positions to devastating effect.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_121: That reminds me. I recall hearing that a few specimens were brought to Vylbrand not long ago. Perhaps it's possible to see them on the island.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_122: Now why do I get the impression you're imagining pitting your skills against the fell beast?
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_123: Unfortunately, I found scant details on your would-be prey. One source simply described it as an “enormous, winged creature with scales hard as steel that rules the skies.” I should like to see it with my own eyes─presuming it even exists.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALISAIE_000_124: I thought I heard familiar voices.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALISAIE_000_125: Fancy running into the two of you here.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_126: Well, well. Have some research of your own, do you?
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALPHINAUD_000_127: Aye, we hope to arm ourselves with knowledge that may benefit the Garlean people.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALPHINAUD_100_127: Having forged a new trade agreement with Radz-at-Han, they will next look to foster relations with other nations. This includes former imperial provinces.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALPHINAUD_000_128: In view of this, we hope to find hints in history on how neighbors of differing races and ideologies might engage with one another.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALPHINAUD_000_129: And what of the two of you? What endeavor brings you here this day?
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALPHINAUD_000_130: A nation composed of the disparate peoples of Tural...
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALPHINAUD_000_131: I daresay this is precisely the kind of example we seek. We'd do well to read up on Tuliyollal ourselves.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALISAIE_000_132: The contest─is  the only one allowed to help Wuk Lamat?
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_133: There was no mention of such restrictions, as I recall. On the contrary, Wuk Lamat gave us the impression that she could have several champions.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALISAIE_000_134: I think I know how to make the most of our respite. Follow me, Alphinaud! We have planning to do!
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_ALPHINAUD_000_136: <sigh> 'Twould seem our plans have changed. If you'll excuse me...
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_137: They never could rest on their laurels...
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_138: Come, let us return to the annex.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_GRAHATIA_000_200: Pray do not mind me. I shall be along as soon as I have what I seek.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_3: Welcome back, . If you're looking for Wuk Lamat, she is currently with the others in her chambers.
If you like, I can go and fetch them for you?
Understood! Please wait in the main hall.
Please go ahead to the main hall. It won't be long.
TEXT_AKTKMM103_04753_OJIKATSUNJIKA_000_5: Lest you wonder about your passage to Tural, Erenville will arrange a ship through his guild. You need only worry about your own preparations.
Speaking of which, please take this with you─a rugged and ready knapsack! May it serve you well on your coming adventures!
Now, I'm not sure when departure will be, but rest assured I'll let you know when I hear something. Till then, please take your ease!
